import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Download,
  ExternalLink,
  FileText,
  Link2,
  Video,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { EmbeddedVideoFrame } from "@/components/training/embedded-video-frame";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getLessonForViewer } from "@/lib/training/service";
import { parseEmbeddableVideoUrl } from "@/lib/media/video-url";

export const metadata = {
  title: "درس تدريبي",
};

const LESSON_TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  TEXT: "نص",
  VIDEO: "فيديو",
  EXTERNAL_VIDEO: "فيديو خارجي",
  RESOURCE: "مصدر تعلّم",
};

const LESSON_ICONS: Record<string, LucideIcon> = {
  TEXT: FileText,
  VIDEO: Video,
  EXTERNAL_VIDEO: Link2,
  RESOURCE: Download,
};

/**
 * Classify an external video URL. YouTube formats covered: watch?v=,
 * youtu.be/, /embed/, /shorts/, /live/ and m.youtube.com — plus extra
 * query parameters such as timestamps (t=/start=). Returns null when
 * the URL cannot be safely embedded — the UI then renders a plain
 * external link instead (no server fetch, no R2 routing).
 */
function embedUrlFor(raw: string): string | null {
  return parseEmbeddableVideoUrl(raw)?.embedUrl ?? null;
}

function navHref(courseId: string, lessonId: string | null): string | null {
  return lessonId ? `/academy/courses/${courseId}/lessons/${lessonId}` : null;
}

/**
 * Lesson player: uploaded videos are stored in lesson.videoUrl as an
 * /api/media/… proxy path (NOT in attachmentId). For teachers, VIDEO
 * lessons redirect to the learning hub — the only surface wired to the
 * mandatory player and the server heartbeat ledger that credits
 * completion. External videos render as allow-listed embeds, text
 * renders safely as plain text, and resources download through the
 * access-checked files route.
 */
export default async function LessonPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string; lessonId: string }>;
}) {
  const { id, lessonId } = await params;
  const user = await requireUser();
  const viewer = { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const result = await getLessonForViewer(viewer, id, lessonId);
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    redirect("/forbidden");
  }
  const { course, lesson, outline, prevLessonId, nextLessonId, sectionTitle } =
    result.data;

  // Mandatory learning enforcement: for TEACHERS this legacy route is
  // never a watch surface — ALL lesson types redirect to the learning
  // hub, the single governed surface wired to the server heartbeat
  // ledger and the sequential gate. Before this change EXTERNAL_VIDEO
  // lessons (YouTube links) played here through a free embed with the
  // provider's native seek bar and speed menu, and the prev/next
  // navigation ignored the sequence — that was the playback regression.
  if (user.role === "TEACHER") {
    redirect(`/academy/learn/${course.id}`);
  }

  const prevHref = navHref(course.id, prevLessonId);
  const nextHref = navHref(course.id, nextLessonId);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={lesson.titleAr}
        description={lesson.description ?? undefined}
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الأكاديمية التدريبية", href: "/academy" },
          { label: course.titleAr, href: `/academy/courses/${course.id}` },
          { label: sectionTitle },
        ]}
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b px-4 py-3">
            <span className="rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">
              {LESSON_TYPE_LABELS[lesson.type] ?? lesson.type}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
              {sectionTitle}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 sm:p-6">
            {lesson.type === "VIDEO" &&
              (lesson.videoUrl ? (
                /* Reaches staff only (teachers are redirected to the
                   governed player in the learning hub). YouTube links
                   preview embedded; direct files use the native player. */
                embedUrlFor(lesson.videoUrl) ? (
                  <EmbeddedVideoFrame src={lesson.videoUrl} title={lesson.titleAr} />
                ) : (
                  <video
                    controls
                    preload="metadata"
                    playsInline
                    src={lesson.videoUrl}
                    className="w-full rounded-lg bg-black"
                  >
                    متصفحك لا يدعم تشغيل الفيديو.
                  </video>
                )
              ) : (
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-amber-800">
                  لا يوجد فيديو محفوظ لهذا الدرس — غالبًا لأن الرفع فشل وقت
                  إنشائه. أعد رفع الفيديو من صفحة إدارة الدورة ثم أعد فتح هذه
                  الصفحة.
                </div>
              ))}

            {lesson.type === "EXTERNAL_VIDEO" && lesson.videoUrl && (
              <>
                {embedUrlFor(lesson.videoUrl) ? (
                  <div className="aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-black">
                    <iframe
                      src={embedUrlFor(lesson.videoUrl) ?? undefined}
                      title={lesson.titleAr}
                      allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
                      allowFullScreen
                      referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
                      className="size-full"
                    />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <a
                    href={lesson.videoUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-brand-700 transition-colors hover:bg-brand-50"
                  >
                    <ExternalLink className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    فتح الفيديو الخارجي في نافذة جديدة
                  </a>
                )}
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  الفيديو مستضاف خارجيًا على منصة مسموح بها (YouTube/Vimeo).
                </p>
              </>
            )}

            {lesson.type === "RESOURCE" && lesson.attachmentId && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-4 py-4">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold">
                    {lesson.attachmentName ?? "مرفق الدرس"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    ملف قابل للتنزيل — يُقدَّم عبر مسار مصادق عليه يتحقق من
                    صلاحيتك.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <a
                  href={`/api/files/${lesson.attachmentId}`}
                  download
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700"
                >
                  <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  تنزيل الملف
                </a>
              </div>
            )}

            {lesson.type === "TEXT" && lesson.content && (
              <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-7 text-foreground">
                {lesson.content}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {prevHref ? (
            <Link
              href={prevHref}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              الدرس السابق
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <span />
          )}
          {nextHref ? (
            <Link
              href={nextHref}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700"
            >
              الدرس التالي
              <ChevronLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <Link
              href={`/academy/courses/${course.id}`}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700 transition-colors hover:bg-brand-50"
            >
              العودة إلى الدورة
              <ChevronLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>

        <SectionCard
          title="خطة الدورة"
          description="جميع الدروس المنشورة — موقعك الحالي مميّز."
        >
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {outline.map((section, sectionIndex) =>
              section.lessons.length === 0 ? null : (
                <div key={section.id}>
                  <p className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                    <span className="flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded bg-brand-100 text-[10px] font-extrabold text-brand-700">
                      {sectionIndex + 1}
                    </span>
                    {section.titleAr}
                  </p>
                  <ul className="space-y-0.5 ps-6">
                    {section.lessons.map((item) => {
                      const Icon = LESSON_ICONS[item.type] ?? FileText;
                      const isCurrent = item.id === lesson.id;
                      return (
                        <li key={item.id}>
                          <Link
                            href={`/academy/courses/${course.id}/lessons/${item.id}`}
                            aria-current={isCurrent ? "page" : undefined}
                            className={
                              isCurrent
                                ? "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-brand-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700"
                                : "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
                            }
                          >
                            <Icon className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                            <span className="truncate">{item.titleAr}</span>
                          </Link>
                        </li>
                      );
                    })}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )
            )}
          </div>
        </SectionCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import {
  BookOpen,
  Clock,
  Download,
  ExternalLink,
  FileText,
  Layers,
  Link2,
  PlayCircle,
  UserRound,
  Video,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/platform/status-badge";
import { EnrollButton } from "@/components/training/enroll-button";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  courseLevelLabel,
  LESSON_TYPE_LABELS,
  trainingCategoryLabel,
} from "@/config/training";
import { getCourseForViewer } from "@/lib/training/service";

export const metadata = {
  title: "تفاصيل الدورة",
};

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar", { dateStyle: "long" });

const LESSON_ICONS: Record<string, LucideIcon> = {
  TEXT: FileText,
  VIDEO: Video,
  EXTERNAL_VIDEO: Link2,
  RESOURCE: Download,
};

/**
 * Course learning view — description, instructor, and the full
 * published outline. Only published lessons appear; drafts stay
 * invisible. Teachers enroll here; managers get a preview banner.
 */
export default async function CourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const user = await requireUser();
  const viewer = { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const result = await getCourseForViewer(viewer, id);
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    redirect("/forbidden");
  }
  const view = result.data;
  const { course } = view;

  const isManager =
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER";
  const isTeacher = user.role === "TEACHER";

  const firstLessonId = view.sections[0]?.lessons[0]?.id ?? null;
  const level = courseLevelLabel(course.level);

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={course.titleAr}
        description={course.descriptionAr}
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الأكاديمية التدريبية", href: "/academy" },
          { label: course.titleAr },
        ]}
        meta={
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
              {trainingCategoryLabel(course.category)}
            </span>
            {level && (
              <span className="rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                {level}
              </span>
            )}
            {course.estimatedHours !== null && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                <Clock className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                {course.estimatedHours} ساعة تقديرية
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
              <Layers className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
              {view.sections.length} قسم · {view.publishedLessonsCount} درس منشور
            </span>
            {course.programName && (
              <span className="rounded-md bg-brand-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-700">
                {course.programName}
              </span>
            )}
            {view.enrollment && (
              <StatusBadge tone="success">
                مسجّل منذ {dateFormatter.format(view.enrollment.enrolledAt)}
              </StatusBadge>
            )}
          </div>
        }
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        {isManager && course.status !== "PUBLISHED" && (
          <div
            role="status"
            className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-warning/40 bg-warning-soft/50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-warning"
          >
            <span>
              معاينة إدارية — هذه الدورة {course.status === "DRAFT" ? "مسودة" : "مؤرشفة"} ولا يراها المعلمون.
            </span>
            <Link
              href={`/academy/manage/${course.id}`}
              className="rounded-lg border border-warning/50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-warning-soft"
            >
              الانتقال إلى إدارة المحتوى
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <SectionCard
            title="عن الدورة"
            description={
              course.instructorName
                ? `المدرّب المسؤول: ${course.instructorName}`
                : undefined
            }
            className="lg:col-span-2"
          >
            <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed text-foreground">
              {course.descriptionAr}
            </p>
            {course.descriptionEn && (
              <p dir="ltr" className="mt-3 whitespace-pre-wrap border-t pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                {course.descriptionEn}
              </p>
            )}
            {course.schoolName && (
              <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <UserRound className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                تابعة لِـ{course.schoolName}
              </p>
            )}
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard title="ابدأ الآن" description="سجّل ثم تابع الدروس بالترتيب.">
            {view.enrollment || !isTeacher ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {firstLessonId ? (
                  <Link
                    href={
                      isTeacher
                        ? `/academy/learn/${course.id}`
                        : `/academy/courses/${course.id}/lessons/${firstLessonId}`
                    }
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700"
                  >
                    <PlayCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    {view.enrollment ? "متابعة الدورة" : "استعراض الدروس"}
                  </Link>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    لم يُنشر محتوى لهذه الدورة بعد.
                  </p>
                )}
                {isManager && !view.enrollment && (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    التسجيل متاح للمعلمين فقط — أنت تتصفح كإداري.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} />
            )}
          </SectionCard>
        </div>

        <SectionCard
          title="محتوى الدورة"
          description="الأقسام والدروس المنشورة بالترتيب — اضغط أي درس لفتحه."
        >
          {view.publishedLessonsCount === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={BookOpen}
              title="لم يُنشر محتوى بعد"
              description="أُنشئت الدورة ولم تُنشر دروسها بعد — عوداً لاحقاً."
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {view.sections.map((section, sectionIndex) =>
                section.lessons.length === 0 ? null : (
                  <div key={section.id} className="rounded-xl border">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b px-4 py-3">
                      <span className="flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-brand-100 text-xs font-extrabold text-brand-700">
                        {sectionIndex + 1}
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-sm font-bold">{section.titleAr}</p>
                      <span className="ms-auto text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                        {section.lessons.length} درس
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <ul className="divide-y">
                      {section.lessons.map((lesson) => {
                        const Icon = LESSON_ICONS[lesson.type] ?? FileText;
                        return (
                          <li key={lesson.id}>
                            <Link
                              href={`/academy/courses/${course.id}/lessons/${lesson.id}`}
                              className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors hover:bg-muted/30"
                            >
                              <span
                                className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                              >
                                <Icon className="size-4" />
                              </span>
                              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                                <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold">
                                  {lesson.titleAr}
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                                  {LESSON_TYPE_LABELS[lesson.type as keyof typeof LESSON_TYPE_LABELS] ?? lesson.type}
                                </span>
                              </span>
                              <ExternalLink
                                className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground/60"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                              />
                            </Link>
                          </li>
                        );
                      })}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </SectionCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { listImpactOverview } from "@/lib/surveys/impact";
import { AccessDenied, Card, EmptyState, PageHeader, StatTile } from "@/app/assignments/ui";

/**
 * Batch 1 — لوحة قياس الأثر (impact measurement overview).
 *
 * The Next.js equivalent of the original HTML renderImpactDashboard:
 * one card per course with impact tools — response count, average
 * rating and completion count — for training managers, plus a link to
 * the per-question breakdown on each course learning page.
 */
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function ImpactOverviewPage() {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const viewer = { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const result = await listImpactOverview(viewer);
  if (!result.ok) {
    return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  }
  const rows = result.data;

  const totalResponses = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.responsesCount, 0);
  const averages = rows
    .map((row) => row.overallAverage)
    .filter((value): value is number => value !== null);
  const globalAverage = averages.length
    ? Number((averages.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / averages.length).toFixed(2))
    : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="قياس الأثر"
        subtitle="نتائج أدوات قياس أثر التدريب على مستوى المدارس — الاستجابات والتقييمات والإكمالات"
      />

      <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatTile label="دورات بأدوات قياس" value={rows.length} tone="brand" />
        <StatTile label="إجمالي الاستجابات" value={totalResponses} tone="success" />
        <StatTile
          label="متوسط التقييم العام"
          value={globalAverage !== null ? `${globalAverage}/5` : "—"}
          tone="warning"
        />
        <StatTile
          label="إكمالات مسجلة"
          value={rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.completionsCount, 0)}
        />
      </div>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <EmptyState
            title="لا توجد أدوات قياس أثر بعد"
            hint="تُنشأ أدوات القياس من الاستبيانات المرتبطة بالدورات — اربط استبيان أثر بدورة منشورة لتظهر نتائجه هنا."
          />
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <Card key={row.courseId}>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900">
                    {row.courseTitleAr}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {row.completionsCount} إكمالًا مسجلًا
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Link
                  href={`/academy/learn/${row.courseId}`}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  عرض التفاصيل
                </Link>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 text-center">
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3">
                  <p className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                    {row.responsesCount}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">استجابات</p>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3">
                  <p className="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                    {row.overallAverage !== null ? `${row.overallAverage}/5` : "—"}
                  </p>

import { useActionState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

import {
  addCourseCommentAction,
  type LearningActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/learning";

/**
 * Batch 1 — حائط الدورة (course wall comments).
 *
 * The course-scoped dialogue between the teacher and the training team,
 * bound to real user ids (the Next.js replacement for the original
 * HTML v14/v15 comment flows). Posts through the server action; the
 * action revalidates the route so fresh rows arrive with the render.
 */

interface CommentRow {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  createdAt: string;
  authorId: string;
  authorName: string;
  authorRole: string;
}

const initialState: LearningActionState = { ok: false };

const ROLE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  TEACHER: "معلم",
  EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR: "المشرف التربوي",
  EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY: "الوكيل التعليمي",
  DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: "مدير مكتب التطوير",
  SCHOOL_MANAGER: "مدير المدرسة",
  SUPER_ADMIN: "إدارة المنصة",
  IT_COORDINATOR: "تقنية المعلومات",
};

export function CourseComments({
  courseId,
  initialComments,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  initialComments: Array<{
    id: string;
    body: string;
    createdAt: Date | string;
    authorId: string;
    authorName: string;
    authorRole: string;
  }>;
  canComment: boolean;
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    addCourseCommentAction,
    initialState
  );
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);

  // Clear the textarea after a successful post.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.ok) formRef.current?.reset();
  }, [state]);

  const rows: CommentRow[] = initialComments.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    createdAt:
      typeof row.createdAt === "string"
        ? row.createdAt
        : row.createdAt.toISOString(),
  }));

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-800">نقاش الدورة</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
        تواصل مع فريق التدريب وزملائك حول هذا التدريب — تُسجَّل المشاركات بأسماء حساباتها.
      </p>

      <form ref={formRef} action={formAction} className="mt-4">
        <input type="hidden" name="courseId" value={courseId} />
        <textarea
          name="body"
          rows={3}
          maxLength={2000}
          required
          placeholder="اكتب مشاركتك أو سؤالك…"
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 p-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
        />
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {!state.ok && state.message ? (
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-600">{state.message}</p>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              {state.ok ? "تمت إضافة مشاركتك." : "بحد أقصى 2000 حرف."}
            </p>
          )}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={pending}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {pending ? "جارٍ النشر…" : "نشر المشاركة"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {rows.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-5 space-y-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <li key={row.id} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3.5">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-800">
                  {row.authorName}
                </span>
                <span className="rounded-full bg-white px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6] ring-1 ring-blue-100">
                  {ROLE_LABELS[row.authorRole] ?? row.authorRole}

                    dateStyle: "short",
                    timeStyle: "short",
                  })}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1.5 whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-700">
                {row.body}
              </p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

interface ImpactQuestion {

  textAr: string;

  minScore: number | null;

 *  openImpact pre-fill rule: re-opening the form shows the teacher's
 *  earlier answers so re-submitting is an EDIT, not a blind replace. */

  1: "ضعيف جدًا",

  4: "جيد",

}: {
  courseId: string;

              {index + 1}. {question.textAr}
              {question.required && <span className="text-red-500"> *</span>}
            </legend>
            {question.helpTextAr && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{question.helpTextAr}</p>
            )}

            {question.type === "RATING" && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

/**

 *

 * (content -> exam -> certificate -> impact). This component is pure
 * presentation of server decisions: every lock, chip, reason and CTA
 * below mirrors `computeCourseJourney` + the server actions; the real
 * enforcement lives in the lesson gate, the assessment service and the
 * completion/certificate/impact services.
 *
 * The exam runs INSIDE this stepper (stage 2) — there is no separate
 * exams section in the sidebar; the journey is the only entry point.
 */

const emptyExamState: JourneyExamActionState = { ok: false };

const STAGE_ICONS = {
  content: BookOpenCheck,
  exam: ClipboardList,
  certificate: Award,
  impact: TrendingUp,
} as const;

function stateChip(state: JourneyStage["state"]) {
  switch (state) {
    case "locked":
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500">
          <Lock className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
          مقفلة
        </span>
      );
    case "available":
      return (
        <span className="rounded-full border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">
          متاحة الآن
        </span>
      );
    case "in_progress":
      return (
        <span className="rounded-full border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">
          قيد الإنجاز
        </span>
      );
    case "completed":
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
          <CheckCircle2 className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
          مكتملة
        </span>
      );
  }
}

function formatCountdown(totalSeconds: number): string {
  const hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
  const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
  const pad = (value: number) => String(value).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes)}:${pad(seconds)}`;
}

          : "border-slate-200",
        stage.state === "locked" && !current && "bg-slate-50/60"
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3">
          <span
            className={cn(

              stage.state === "completed"

            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            {stage.state === "completed" ? (

            ) : stage.state === "locked" ? (
              <Lock className="size-5" />

              )}
            </p>

function ExamRunner({ courseId, exam }: { courseId: string; exam: JourneyExamRow }) {
  const attempt = exam.activeAttempt;
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    submitExamAttemptAction,
    emptyExamState
  );
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const draftTimer = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const [remainingSeconds, setRemainingSeconds] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Countdown to the SERVER-enforced deadline — the browser timer is
  // cosmetic; the service re-checks the deadline on submission.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!attempt?.deadlineAt) return;
    const deadline = new Date(attempt.deadlineAt).getTime();
    const tick = () =>
      setRemainingSeconds(Math.max(0, Math.floor((deadline - Date.now()) / 1000)));
    tick();
    const timer = window.setInterval(tick, 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [attempt?.deadlineAt]);

  // Silent draft autosave (debounced) — answers survive a page refresh;
  // the server restores them through savedAnswers on the next render.
  const scheduleDraftSave = () => {
    if (!formRef.current) return;
    if (draftTimer.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(draftTimer.current);
    draftTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (!formRef.current) return;
      const formData = new FormData(formRef.current);
      void saveExamDraftAction(emptyExamState, formData);
    }, 4000);
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (draftTimer.current !== null) window.clearTimeout(draftTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!attempt) return null;

  const expired = remainingSeconds !== null && remainingSeconds <= 0;
  const savedByQuestion = new Map<string, ExamSavedAnswer>(
    attempt.savedAnswers.map((answer) => [answer.questionId, answer])
  );

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6]/30 bg-blue-50/40 p-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-xs font-extrabold text-[#1D5BD6]">
          محاولة جارية — أكمل الأسئلة ثم سلّم الإجابات (التسليم نهائي)
        </p>
        {attempt.deadlineAt && remainingSeconds !== null && (
          <span
            className={cn(
              "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-extrabold",
              expired
                ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700"
                : remainingSeconds < 300
                  ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800"
                  : "bg-white text-[#1D5BD6] ring-1 ring-blue-100"
            )}
          >
            <Timer className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
            {expired ? "انتهى الوقت" : `المتبقي ${formatCountdown(remainingSeconds)}`}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {expired && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-red-700">
          <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            انتهى وقت هذه المحاولة — لن يُقبل التسليم بعد المهلة وستُسجَّل كمنتهية.
            حدّث الصفحة لبدء محاولة جديدة إذا توفرت محاولات.
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {exam.instructionsAr && (
        <details className="mt-3">
          <summary className="cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">
            تعليمات الاختبار
          </summary>
          <p className="mt-1.5 whitespace-pre-line rounded-lg bg-white p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-700">
            {exam.instructionsAr}
          </p>
        </details>
      )}

      <form
        ref={formRef}
        action={formAction}
        onChange={scheduleDraftSave}
        className="mt-4 space-y-3"
      >
        <input type="hidden" name="courseId" value={courseId} />
        <input type="hidden" name="attemptId" value={attempt.id} />

        {attempt.questions.map((question) => (
          <ExamQuestionField
            key={question.id}
            question={question}
            saved={savedByQuestion.get(question.id)}
          />
        ))}
        {attempt.questions.length === 0 && (
          <p className="rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800">
            لا توجد أسئلة منشورة لهذا الاختبار — راجع فريق التدريب.
          </p>
        )}

        {state.ok && state.data?.status === "PASSED" && (
          <p className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-3 text-sm font-extrabold text-emerald-700">
            🎉 تم قبول إجاباتك — نجحت في الاختبار وانتقلت إلى مرحلة الشهادة.
          </p>
        )}
        {state.ok && state.data?.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW" && (
          <p className="rounded-lg border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">
            تم استلام إجاباتك — الأسئلة النصية بانتظار مراجعة المدرب.
          </p>
        )}
        {state.ok && state.data?.status === "FAILED" && (
          <p className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm font-bold text-red-700">
            لم تجتز هذه المحاولة — يمكنك المحاولة مجددًا وفق قواعد الاختبار.
          </p>
        )}
        {!state.ok && state.message && (
          <p className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs font-bold text-red-700">
            {state.message}
          </p>
        )}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            تُحفظ مسودتك تلقائيًا أثناء الإجابة، والتصحيح يجري على الخادم حصريًا.
          </p>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={pending}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {pending ? "جارٍ التسليم…" : "تسليم الإجابات نهائيًا"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function ExamCard({ journey, exam }: { journey: JourneyView; exam: JourneyExamRow }) {
  const attemptsLabel =
    exam.attemptLimit === null
      ? `${exam.attemptsUsed} محاولة`
      : `${exam.attemptsUsed}/${exam.attemptLimit} محاولات`;

  return (
    <li className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900">{exam.titleAr}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
            درجة النجاح: {exam.passingScore}/{exam.maxScore}
            {" · "}
            المحاولات: {attemptsLabel}
            {exam.timeLimitMinutes !== null && ` · المدة: ${exam.timeLimitMinutes} دقيقة`}
          </p>
        </div>
        {exam.passed && (
          <span className="rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
            مجتاز{exam.bestPercentage !== null ? ` — ${exam.bestPercentage}%` : ""}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {exam.activeAttempt && <ExamRunner courseId={journey.courseId} exam={exam} />}

      {!exam.passed && !exam.activeAttempt && exam.pendingReview && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#1D5BD6]">
          <ClipboardList className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            سُلّمت إجاباتك — الأسئلة المقالية بانتظار تقييم المشرف. تظهر النتيجة
            النهائية ودرجتك هنا بعد التصحيح، وتُفتح مرحلة الشهادة تلقائيًا عند
            الاجتياز.
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!exam.passed && !exam.activeAttempt && !exam.pendingReview && exam.startBlockReason && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-800">
          <Lock className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>{exam.startBlockReason}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!exam.passed && !exam.activeAttempt && !exam.pendingReview && exam.canStart && (
        <>
          {exam.attemptsUsed > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-800">
              <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>
                لم تجتز المحاولة السابقة — يمكنك إعادة المحاولة وفق قواعد الاختبار
                (نفس درجة النجاح ونفس حد المحاولات).
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          <ExamStartForm
            courseId={journey.courseId}
            exam={exam}
            label={exam.attemptsUsed > 0 ? "إعادة المحاولة" : "بدء الاختبار النهائي"}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

function ExamSection({ journey }: { journey: JourneyView }) {
  const examStage = journey.stages.find((stage) => stage.key === "exam");
  if (!examStage || examStage.state === "locked") return null;

  if (journey.exams.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
        لا يوجد اختبار نهائي منشور لهذه الدورة — تم استيفاء متطلب الاختبار.
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mt-3">
      {examStage.state === "available" && (
        <div className="mb-3 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-3.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#1D5BD6]">
          <span className="font-extrabold">أكملت جميع دروس الدورة — الاختبار النهائي متاح الآن: </span>
          ابدأ المحاولة من البطاقة أدناه (نفس قواعد درجة النجاح والمحاولات والمهلة)،
          وعند الاجتياز ستنتقل تلقائيًا إلى مرحلة الشهادة.
        </div>
      )}
      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {journey.exams.map((exam) => (
          <ExamCard key={exam.id} journey={journey} exam={exam} />
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export function JourneyStepper({ journey }: { journey: JourneyView }) {
  const currentIndex = journey.stages.findIndex(
    (stage) => stage.state !== "completed"
  );

  return (
    <section
      id="journey"
      className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-800">
            رحلة إتمام الدورة — أربع مراحل إلزامية بالترتيب
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-500">
            محتوى الدورة ← الاختبار النهائي ← الشهادة ← قياس الأثر. تُفتح كل مرحلة
            تلقائيًا بعد إنهاء ما قبلها، والقفل والفتح يُفرضان على الخادم.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full max-w-52 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">
            <span>تقدم الرحلة</span>
            <span className="text-[#1D5BD6]">{journey.overallPercent}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100">
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-[#1D5BD6] transition-all"
              style={{ width: `${journey.overallPercent}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {!journey.isTeacher && (
        <p className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
          وضع معاينة الإدارة — تقدم الرحلة يُسجَّل لحسابات المعلمين فقط.
        </p>
      )}

      <ol className="mt-4 space-y-3">
        {journey.stages.map((stage, index) => (
          <StageCard
            key={stage.key}
            stage={stage}
            current={index === currentIndex}
          >
            {stage.key === "content" && stage.state !== "completed" && (
              <a
                href="#lessons"
                className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#1D5BD6] transition hover:bg-blue-50"
              >
                <PlayCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                الانتقال إلى الدروس
              </a>
            )}

            {stage.key === "exam" && <ExamSection journey={journey} />}

            {stage.key === "certificate" && journey.certificate.issued && journey.certificate.href && (
              <Link
                href={journey.certificate.href}
                className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
              >
                <Award className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                عرض الشهادة
              </Link>
            )}
            {stage.key === "certificate" &&
              stage.state === "in_progress" &&
              journey.certificate.pendingReason && (
                <p className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-800">
                  {journey.certificate.pendingReason}
                </p>
              )}

            {stage.key === "impact" && stage.state === "available" && (
              <a
                href="#impact"
                className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
              >
                <TrendingUp className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                فتح أدوات قياس الأثر
              </a>
            )}
          </StageCard>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";

  CheckCircle2,
  Circle,
  PlayCircle,
  FileText,
  Lock,
  Paperclip,
  ExternalLink,

  isYouTubeUrl,
  parseEmbeddableVideoUrl,

  markLessonCompleteAction,
  type LearningActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/learning";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * Batch 1 — the lesson checklist of the learning page.
 *
 * Mandatory-learning edition (regression fix):
 *   - EVERY governable video lesson (type VIDEO, or EXTERNAL_VIDEO whose
 *     URL is a YouTube link / direct file) renders the server-gated
 *     mandatory player for teachers — one surface, one heartbeat ledger.
 *     The old split (EXTERNAL_VIDEO -> a free EmbeddedVideoFrame with the
 *     provider's native seek bar + speed menu) is exactly what re-opened
 *     seeking and playback-speed cheating; it is gone now.
 *   - The manual إتمام toggle remains only for lessons the server can
 *     honestly verify manually (TEXT / RESOURCE / plain external links) —
 *     the backend now rejects manual marks for governable videos anyway
 *     (markLessonComplete VIDEO_WATCH_REQUIRED rule), so UI and server agree.
 *   - Locked lessons render a clear Arabic lock card — the server
 *     enforces the same rule on every action and on the media proxy, so
 *     this is presentation of a server decision, not the enforcement.
 *   - Staff viewers keep the free preview surfaces (they never write
 *     progress).
 */

interface WatchSnapshot {
  lastPositionSeconds: number;
  maxPositionSeconds: number;
  watchSeconds: number;
}

export interface ChecklistLesson {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  type: string;
  typeLabel: string;
  description: string | null;
  content: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  attachmentName: string | null;
  durationSeconds: number | null;
  /** Server-computed sequential lock. */
  locked: boolean;
  lockedByTitle: string | null;
  /** The first not-yet-completed lesson in the whole course order. */
  current: boolean;
  watch: WatchSnapshot | null;
}

interface LessonChecklistProps {
  courseId: string;
  isTeacher: boolean;
  thresholdPercent: number;
  completedIds: string[];
  lessons: ChecklistLesson[];
}

const initialState: LearningActionState = { ok: false };

export function LessonChecklist({
  courseId,
  isTeacher,
  thresholdPercent,
  completedIds,
  lessons,
}: LessonChecklistProps) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    markLessonCompleteAction,
    initialState
  );
  // After each successful mark the server action revalidates this
  // route, so the fresh completedIds prop replaces the list render.
  const completed = new Set(completedIds);

  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
      {lessons.map((lesson) => {
        const done = completed.has(lesson.id);
        const videoUrl = lesson.videoUrl;
        const hasVideo = videoUrl !== null && videoUrl.length > 0;
        // Governable = the mandatory player can actually enforce it:
        // YouTube links (IFrame API branch) or direct/R2 files (native
        // branch). Vimeo and arbitrary page links stay "external".
        const governedUrl =
          hasVideo &&
          videoUrl !== null &&
          (lesson.type === "VIDEO" || isYouTubeUrl(videoUrl));
        const embeddableUrl =
          hasVideo && videoUrl !== null
            ? parseEmbeddableVideoUrl(videoUrl)
            : null;
        const isGovernedVideo = hasVideo && governedUrl;
        const canPlayVideo = isGovernedVideo && !lesson.locked;
        const manualCompletionAllowed =
          isTeacher && !done && !lesson.locked && !isGovernedVideo;

        return (
          <li
            key={lesson.id}
            className={cn(
              "px-5 py-4",
              lesson.current && !done && "bg-blue-50/40"
            )}
          >
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-3">
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    "mt-0.5 shrink-0",
                    done
                      ? "text-emerald-600"
                      : lesson.locked
                        ? "text-slate-300"
                        : "text-[#1D5BD6]"
                  )}
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  {done ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="size-5" />
                  ) : lesson.locked ? (
                    <Lock className="size-5" />
                  ) : (
                    <Circle className="size-5" />
                  )}
                </span>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                    {lesson.titleAr}
                    <span className="ms-2 rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      {lesson.typeLabel}
                    </span>
                    {lesson.current && !done && (
                      <span className="ms-2 rounded-full bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                        الدرس الحالي
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </p>
                  {lesson.description && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-500">
                      {lesson.description}
                    </p>
                  )}

                  {/* Locked — server-enforced; this card only explains. */}
                  {lesson.locked ? (
                    <div className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-800">
                      <Lock className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                      <span>
                        هذا الدرس مقفل حاليًا — أكمل درس
                        {lesson.lockedByTitle ? (
                          <span className="font-extrabold"> «{lesson.lockedByTitle}» </span>
                        ) : (
                          " ما قبله "
                        )}
                        أولًا ليُفتح بالترتيب.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {lesson.content && (
                        <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-line rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-700">
                          {lesson.content}
                        </p>
                      )}

                      {/* Governed video — ONE mandatory player for teachers
                          across VIDEO and EXTERNAL_VIDEO (YouTube included).
                          Staff get a free preview: embeds for YouTube/Vimeo,
                          native video for files. */}
                      {canPlayVideo && videoUrl && (
                        <div className="mt-3">
                          {isTeacher ? (
                            done ? (
                              <details className="group">
                                <summary className="inline-flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#1D5BD6] transition hover:bg-blue-50">
                                  <PlayCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                                  إعادة مشاهدة الدرس
                                </summary>
                                <div className="mt-3">
                                  <MandatoryVideoPlayer
                                    courseId={courseId}
                                    lessonId={lesson.id}
                                    src={videoUrl}
                                    title={lesson.titleAr}
                                    durationSeconds={lesson.durationSeconds}
                                    thresholdPercent={thresholdPercent}
                                    initial={{
                                      lastPositionSeconds: lesson.watch?.lastPositionSeconds ?? 0,
                                      maxPositionSeconds: lesson.watch?.maxPositionSeconds ?? 0,
                                      watchSeconds: lesson.watch?.watchSeconds ?? 0,
                                      completed: true,
                                    }}
                                  />
                                </div>
                              </details>
                            ) : (
                              <MandatoryVideoPlayer
                                courseId={courseId}
                                lessonId={lesson.id}
                                src={videoUrl}
                                title={lesson.titleAr}
                                durationSeconds={lesson.durationSeconds}
                                thresholdPercent={thresholdPercent}
                                initial={{
                                  lastPositionSeconds: lesson.watch?.lastPositionSeconds ?? 0,
                                  maxPositionSeconds: lesson.watch?.maxPositionSeconds ?? 0,
                                  watchSeconds: lesson.watch?.watchSeconds ?? 0,
                                  completed: false,
                                }}
                              />
                            )
                          ) : embeddableUrl ? (
                            /* Staff preview — embeddable providers render in-page. */
                            <EmbeddedVideoFrame
                              src={videoUrl}
                              title={lesson.titleAr}
                              className="mt-2 aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-black"
                            />
                          ) : (
                            /* Staff preview — free playback, no ledger. */
                            <video
                              controls
                              preload="metadata"
                              playsInline
                              src={videoUrl}
                              className="mt-2 aspect-video w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-black"
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* External video that is NOT governable (Vimeo or
                          any non-YouTube/direct link): embeddable providers
                          play in-page, anything else stays a plain external
                          link. No ledger here by honest design — the manual
                          completion button below is the verification, and
                          the server allows the manual mark for these. */}
                      {!isGovernedVideo && lesson.type === "EXTERNAL_VIDEO" && videoUrl && (
                        <div className="mt-2">
                          {embeddableUrl ? (

                              title={lesson.titleAr}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            <a
                              href={videoUrl}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noopener noreferrer"
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6] hover:text-[#174aa8]"
                            >
                              <PlayCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                              فتح الفيديو
                              <ExternalLink className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                            </a>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {lesson.attachmentName && (
                        <p className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
                          <Paperclip className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          <FileText className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          {lesson.attachmentName}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {manualCompletionAllowed && (
                <form action={formAction} className="shrink-0">
                  <input type="hidden" name="courseId" value={courseId} />
                  <input type="hidden" name="lessonId" value={lesson.id} />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={pending}
                    className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    {pending ? "جارٍ التسجيل…" : "إتمام الدرس"}
                  </button>
                </form>
              )}
              {done && (
                <span className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
                  تم الإنجاز ✓
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
      {state.ok && state.message && (
        <li className="border-t border-slate-100 bg-blue-50/60 px-5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
          {state.message}
        </li>
      )}
      {!state.ok && state.message && (
        <li className="border-t border-slate-100 bg-red-50/60 px-5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-red-700">
          {state.message}
        </li>
      )}
    </ul>
  );
}

import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getCourseForViewer } from "@/lib/training/service";
import { getCourseLearningStatus } from "@/lib/training/progress";
import { computeCourseJourney } from "@/lib/training/journey";
import { computeSequentialLocks } from "@/lib/training/sequence";
import { getMyImpactStatus } from "@/lib/surveys/impact";
import { listCourseComments } from "@/lib/comments/service";
import { trainingTypeLabel } from "@/config/training-domains";
import { AccessDenied } from "@/app/assignments/ui";

import { ImpactForm } from "./impact-form";

function formatArabicDate(iso: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", { dateStyle: "long" }).format(
      new Date(iso)
    );
  } catch {
    return iso.slice(0, 10);
  }
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes >= 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
  return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
}

/**
 * Batch 1 + Mandatory journey — صفحة التعلّم (course learning hub).
 *
 * The teacher's single page for the whole journey — the Next.js
 * equivalent of the original HTML training player (openTraining +
 * v11 player + test gating + certificate + impact measurement):
 *   - the four-stage MANDATORY journey stepper (content -> exam ->
 *     certificate -> impact), computed by the server journey service;
 *     the exam runs INSIDE the journey — there is no separate exams
 *     section anywhere else,
 *   - published lessons with per-lesson completion state,
 *   - mandatory sequential unlocking + mandatory video playback
 *     (server-enforced; the UI only mirrors the server decision),
 *   - progress bar + completion card with the auto-issued certificate,
 *   - impact measurement form (after completion) + course wall comments.
 */
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const LESSON_TYPE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  VIDEO: "فيديو",
  EXTERNAL_VIDEO: "فيديو خارجي",
  RESOURCE: "مصدر تعلّم",
  TEXT: "نص",
};

export default async function CourseLearnPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ courseId: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const viewer = { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  const { courseId } = await params;

  const [viewResult, statusResult, impactResult, commentsResult, journeyResult] =
    await Promise.all([
      getCourseForViewer(viewer, courseId),
      getCourseLearningStatus(viewer, courseId),
      getMyImpactStatus(viewer, courseId),
      listCourseComments(viewer, courseId),
      computeCourseJourney(viewer, courseId),
    ]);

  if (!viewResult.ok) {
    return <AccessDenied hint={viewResult.message ?? "هذه الدورة غير متاحة لك"} />;
  }
  const view = viewResult.data;
  const status = statusResult.ok ? statusResult.data! : null;
  const impact = impactResult.ok ? impactResult.data : null;
  const comments = commentsResult.ok ? commentsResult.data : null;
  const journey = journeyResult.ok ? journeyResult.data : null;

  const completion = status?.completion ?? null;
  const isTeacher = user.role === "TEACHER";
  const threshold = status?.lessonCompletionThreshold ?? 95;

  // Mandatory sequential unlocking — computed on the SERVER from the
  // completion ledger; the checklist only renders the verdict.
  const orderedLessons = view.sections.flatMap((section) =>
    section.lessons.map((lesson) => ({ id: lesson.id, titleAr: lesson.titleAr }))
  );
  const enforceSequence = isTeacher && (status?.requireSequentialLessons ?? true);
  const locks = computeSequentialLocks(
    orderedLessons,
    status?.completedLessonIds ?? [],
    enforceSequence
  );
  const watchByLesson = new Map(
    (status?.watchStates ?? []).map((row) => [row.lessonId, row])
  );

  const buildChecklistLesson = (
    lesson: (typeof view.sections)[number]["lessons"][number]
  ): ChecklistLesson => {
    const lock = locks.get(lesson.id);
    const watch = watchByLesson.get(lesson.id);
    return {
      id: lesson.id,
      titleAr: lesson.titleAr,
      type: lesson.type,
      typeLabel: LESSON_TYPE_LABELS[lesson.type] ?? lesson.type,
      description: lesson.description,
      content: lesson.content,
      videoUrl: lesson.videoUrl,
      attachmentName: lesson.attachmentName,
      // The instructor-captured length (DB) — the player reports it with
      // every heartbeat as a fallback duration so YouTube lessons (whose
      // length can NOT be captured at save time) still reach a server-
      // verified completion threshold.
      durationSeconds: lesson.durationSeconds,
      locked: lock?.locked ?? false,
      lockedByTitle: lock?.lockedByTitle ?? null,
      current: lock?.current ?? false,
      watch: watch
        ? {
            lastPositionSeconds: watch.lastPositionSeconds,
            maxPositionSeconds: watch.maxPositionSeconds,
            watchSeconds: watch.watchSeconds,
          }
        : null,
    };
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl">
      {/* Course header */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
              {view.course.programName && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                  {view.course.programName}
                </span>
              )}
              <span>{view.course.category}</span>
              {view.course.level && <span>· {view.course.level}</span>}
              {view.course.estimatedHours !== null && (
                <span>· {view.course.estimatedHours} ساعات</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">
              {view.course.titleAr}
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
              {view.course.descriptionAr}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
              {view.course.instructorName && <span>المدرب: {view.course.instructorName}</span>}
              {view.course.schoolName && <span>المدرسة: {view.course.schoolName}</span>}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
              <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                نوع التدريب: {trainingTypeLabel(view.course.trainingType)}
              </span>
              {view.course.subcategory && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold">
                  التصنيف الفرعي: {view.course.subcategory}
                </span>
              )}
              {view.course.scheduledAt && (
                <span>تاريخ التدريب: {formatArabicDate(view.course.scheduledAt)}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Progress ring / completion badge */}
          <div className="w-full max-w-56 shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4 text-center">
            {completion ? (
              <>
                <p className="text-3xl" aria-hidden="true">🏁</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-extrabold text-emerald-700">دورة مكتملة</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  {completion.hours ? `${completion.hours} ساعات تدريبية` : "أحسنت!"}
                </p>
                {completion.certificateId && (
                  <a
                    href={`/certificates/${completion.certificateId}`}
                    className="mt-3 inline-block rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
                  >
                    عرض الشهادة
                  </a>
                )}

                  >

                    <span className="rounded-full bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">

                    </span>

          </h2>
          {impact.survey.purposeAr && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{impact.survey.purposeAr}</p>
          )}
          {impact.submitted ? (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-sm text-emerald-800">
              شكرًا لمساهمتك — تم استلام استجابتك. يمكنك تعديل إجاباتك بإعادة الإرسال.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
              شاركنا تجربتك بعد التطبيق — إجاباتك تساعد في تحسين التدريبات القادمة.
            </p>
          )}
          <ImpactForm
            courseId={courseId}
            surveyTitle={impact.survey.titleAr}
            instructions={impact.survey.instructionsAr}
            questions={impact.survey.questions}
          />
        </section>
      )}

      {/* Course wall */}
      <section className="mt-6">
        <CourseComments
          courseId={courseId}
          initialComments={comments?.rows ?? []}
          canComment={true}
        />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

              {sectionsCount} قسم · {lessonsCount} درس

          }}

          instructors={instructors}
          showScope={false}
          defaultScope={course.schoolId === null ? "platform" : "school"}
        />

          courseId={course.id}
          courseStatus={course.status}
          sections={course.sections}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

import { listSchools } from "@/lib/schools/service";
import { CourseForm } from "@/components/training/course-form";

import {
  getInstructorOptions,
} from "@/lib/training/service";

export const metadata = {
  title: "دورة تدريبية جديدة",
};

/**
 * Create-course page. Scope options and instructor candidates depend on
 * the actor: office managers are fixed to their own school; the platform
 * admin picks the scope and gets instructor candidates grouped by school.
 */
export default async function NewCoursePage() {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();

  const schools =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? await listSchools() : [];

  const instructors =
    ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
      ? (await getInstructorOptions(ctx, ctx.schoolId)).map((instructor) => ({
          ...instructor,
          schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
        }))
      : await db.user.findMany({
          where: {
            role: { in: ["TEACHER", "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"] },
            isActive: true,
            schoolId: { not: null },
          },
          select: { id: true, name: true, schoolId: true },
          orderBy: { name: "asc" },
        });

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="دورة تدريبية جديدة"
        description="أنشئ الدورة كمسودة ثم انتقل مباشرة إلى بانى المحتوى لإضافة الأقسام والدروس."
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "إدارة الدورات", href: "/academy/manage" },
          { label: "دورة جديدة" },
        ]}
      />
      <CourseForm
        mode="create"
        schools={schools.map((school) => ({ id: school.id, nameAr: school.nameAr }))}
        instructors={instructors}
        showScope={ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"}
        defaultScope="school"
        fixedSchoolId={ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ? ctx.schoolId : undefined}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  courseLevelLabel,

  trainingCategoryLabel,
} from "@/config/training";

export const metadata = {
  title: "الأكاديمية التدريبية",
};

/**
 * Phase 5 — teacher-facing academy catalog. Only PUBLISHED courses
 * visible to the viewer's school (or platform-wide) are listed; drafts
 * and archived courses never reach this page. Filters are URL-driven.
 *
 * EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR is the ONE exception — and deliberately so:
 * the supervisor's academy renders a SINGLE unified listing (their own
 * trainings, any status, with search/filters and full card actions in
 * AcademySupervisorTrainings). The published catalog used to render
 * BELOW that section as well, re-showing the supervisor's own
 * published trainings as a second set of cards — the duplicate
 * listing. The fix is structural, not cosmetic: for supervisors the
 * catalog queries are skipped entirely and the catalog JSX is never
 * rendered — no CSS hiding, no duplicated data path.
 */
export default async function AcademyPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const viewer = { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const params = await searchParams;
  const flat = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(params).map(([key, value]) => [
      key,
      Array.isArray(value) ? (value[0] ?? "") : (value ?? ""),
    ])
  );
  const mine = flat.mine === "1";

  const isManager =
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER";
  const isSupervisor = user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR";

  /* Catalog data — fetched ONLY for non-supervisor roles. The
   * supervisor never sees the catalog, so its queries are skipped
   * entirely (no unnecessary data duplication). */
  const result = isSupervisor
    ? null
    : await listPublishedCourses(viewer, {
        q: flat.q,
        category: flat.category,
        programId: flat.programId,
        mine,
        page: Number.parseInt(flat.page || "1", 10) || 1,
      });

  // Program filter options — published programs in the viewer's scope.
  const programs: { id: string; nameAr: string; schoolId: string | null }[] =
    isSupervisor
      ? []
      : await db.trainingProgram.findMany({
          where:
            user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
              ? { status: "PUBLISHED" }
              : {
                  status: "PUBLISHED",
                  OR: [
                    { schoolId: null },
                    ...(user.schoolId ? [{ schoolId: user.schoolId }] : []),
                  ],
                },
          select: { id: true, nameAr: true, schoolId: true },
          orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
        });

  function pageHref(page: number): string {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams(
      Object.entries(flat).filter(([, v]) => v !== "" && v !== undefined)
    );
    sp.set("page", String(page));
    return `/academy?${sp.toString()}`;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="الأكاديمية التدريبية"
        description="الدورات التدريبية المنشورة والمتاحة لك — تصفّح، سجّل، وابدأ التعلّم وفق صلاحياتك."
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "الأكاديمية التدريبية" }]}
        actions={
          isManager ? (
            <Link
              href="/academy/manage"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700 transition-colors hover:bg-brand-50"
            >
              <MonitorPlay className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              إدارة الدورات
            </Link>
          ) : isSupervisor ? (
            <Link
              href="/supervision/training/new"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700 transition-colors hover:bg-brand-50"
            >
              <MonitorPlay className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              إنشاء تدريب جديد
            </Link>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        {/* 1) The supervisor's ONE unified training listing — their own
            trainings (any status), with search/filters and full card
            actions (Open/Manage, Edit, Delete). Rendered for the
            supervisor only; returns null for every other role. */}
        <AcademySupervisorTrainings q={flat.q} category={flat.category} />

        {/* 2) The public catalog — untouched for every OTHER role
            (teachers, managers, admins). NEVER rendered for the
            supervisor: it re-showed their own published trainings as
            the duplicated second listing. */}
        {result && (
          <>
            <CatalogFilters
              action="/academy"
              q={flat.q}
              category={flat.category}
              programId={flat.programId}
              programs={programs.map((program) => ({
                id: program.id,
                nameAr: program.nameAr,
                platformWide: program.schoolId === null,
              }))}
              showMine
              mine={mine}
            />

            {result.ok ? (
              result.data.rows.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState
                  icon={BookOpen}
                  title={
                    mine
                      ? "لم تسجّل في أي دورة بعد"
                      : "لا توجد دورات متاحة مطابقة"
                  }
                  description={
                    mine
                      ? "تصفّح الكتالوج وسجّل في ما يناسبك — ستظهر دوراتك هنا."
                      : "جرّب تعديل الفلاتر أو كلمات البحث — أو عوداً لاحقاً فسيتم نشر دورات جديدة."
                  }
                />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                    {result.data.rows.map((course) => {
                      const level = courseLevelLabel(course.level);
                      return (
                        <Link
                          key={course.id}
                          href={`/academy/courses/${course.id}`}
                          className="group flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs transition-shadow hover:shadow-md"
                        >
                          <div className="relative h-36 w-full overflow-hidden bg-brand-50">
                            {course.coverAttachmentId ? (
                              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                              <img
                                src={`/api/files/${course.coverAttachmentId}`}
                                alt=""
                                className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform group-hover:scale-[1.03]"
                              />
                            ) : (
                              <div
                                className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-brand-300"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                              >
                                <BookOpen className="size-10" strokeWidth={1.5} />
                              </div>
                            )}
                            {course.enrolled && (
                              <span className="absolute end-2 top-2 rounded-full bg-success-soft px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-success">
                                مسجّل
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2 p-4">
                            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground transition-colors group-hover:text-brand-700">
                              {course.titleAr}
                            </h3>
                            {course.programName && (
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                                {course.programName}
                              </p>
                            )}
                            <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">

                                {trainingCategoryLabel(course.category)}
                              </span>
                              {level && (

                              {course.estimatedHours !== null && (
