import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { listSchools } from "@/lib/schools/service";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { ProgramManager } from "@/components/training/program-manager";
import { listProgramsForManage } from "@/lib/training/service";

export const metadata = {
  title: "البرامج التدريبية",
};

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar", { dateStyle: "medium" });

/**
 * Phase 5 — training program management. SUPER_ADMIN manages platform
 * programs plus every school's; office managers manage their own
 * school's programs only (service-enforced).
 */
export default async function ProgramsPage() {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();

  const result = await listProgramsForManage(ctx);
  if (!result.ok) {
    return (
      <div
        role="alert"
        className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5 p-6 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-destructive"
      >
        {result.message}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const schools =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? await listSchools() : [];

  const programs = result.data.map((program) => ({
    ...program,
    updatedAtLabel: dateFormatter.format(program.updatedAt),
  }));

  return (
    <div>

export async function AcademySupervisorTrainings({
  q = "",
  category = "",
}: {
  q?: string;
  category?: string;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();
  if (user.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !user.schoolId) return null;

  // Same shape requireSupervisorContext builds — already role-guarded above.
  const ctx = {
    id: user.id,
    name: user.name,
    role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" as const,
    schoolId: user.schoolId,
  };

  const allTrainings = await listSupervisorAcademyTrainings(ctx);

  /* URL-driven narrowing of the ONE listing (display-level filter on
   * an already school-fenced, ownership-scoped read). */
  const qTrim = q.trim();
  const categoryTrim = category.trim();
  const trainings = allTrainings.filter((training) => {
    const matchesQ = qTrim.length === 0 || training.titleAr.includes(qTrim);
    const matchesCategory =
      categoryTrim.length === 0 || training.category === categoryTrim;
    return matchesQ && matchesCategory;
  });
  const isFiltered = qTrim.length > 0 || categoryTrim.length > 0;

  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby="my-trainings-heading"
      className="rounded-xl border-2 border-brand-600/30 bg-brand-600/[0.04]"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-brand-600/20 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2
            id="my-trainings-heading"
            className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm font-black text-foreground"
          >
            <MonitorPlay className="size-4 text-brand-600" aria-hidden="true" />
            تدريباتي — مساحة إدارة التدريب
            <span className="rounded-full bg-brand-600/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-brand-600">
              {trainings.length}
            </span>
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            كل تدريب أنشأته في مكان واحد وبمرة واحدة فقط: افتح أي تدريب
            للوصول إلى مساحة إدارته الكاملة — المحتوى والفيديوهات والمرفقات
            والاختبار وقياس الأثر وإسناد المعلمين والنتائج والشهادات
            والنشر — أو حرّره أو احذفه مباشرة من البطاقة.

/**
 * Phase 11 — forgot-password form (client). Shows the neutral response
 * plus the HONEST email-configuration state returned by the server action.

import { useActionState } from "react";
import {
  requestPasswordResetAction,
  type AccountActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/account";

const initialState: AccountActionState = { ok: false };

export function ForgotPasswordForm() {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    async (prev: AccountActionState, formData: FormData) =>
      requestPasswordResetAction(prev, formData),
    initialState,
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <form action={formAction} className="space-y-3">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="forgot-email" className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
            البريد الإلكتروني المسجل
          </label>
          <input
            id="forgot-email"
            type="email"
            name="email"
            required
            dir="ltr"
            placeholder="name@school.example"
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-800 focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:outline-none"
          />
        </div>
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="w-full rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? "جارٍ الإرسال…" : "إرسال رابط إعادة التعيين"}
        </button>
      </form>

      {state.message && (
        <div
          className={`rounded-lg border p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line ${
            state.ok
              ? state.emailConfigured === false
                ? "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700"
                : "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
              : "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700"
          }`}
        >
          {state.message}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — /account/reset-password — public single-use reset flow.
 * Consuming the token rotates the password, bumps tokenVersion (all
 * sessions invalidated) and fires the PASSWORD_CHANGED security notice.
 */

import { Card } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { ResetPasswordForm } from "@/app/account/reset-password/reset-password-form";

interface PageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{ token?: string }>;
}

export default async function ResetPasswordPage({ searchParams }: PageProps) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const token = (params.token ?? "").trim();

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-md p-6">
      <Card title="إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور">
        {token ? (
          <>
            <p className="mb-4 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-500">

            </p>
            <ResetPasswordForm token={token} />
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-red-700">
            لا يوجد رابط إعادة تعيين صالح في هذه الصفحة. افتح الرابط كما وصلك في بريدك الإلكتروني.
          </p>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 11 — reset-password form (client). Validates match/length inline,
 * then lets the server enforce the real single-use token contract.
 */

import { useActionState } from "react";
import { resetPasswordAction, type AccountActionState } from "@/app/actions/account";

const initialState: AccountActionState = { ok: false };

export function ResetPasswordForm({ token }: { token: string }) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    async (prev: AccountActionState, formData: FormData) => resetPasswordAction(prev, formData),
    initialState,
  );

  if (state.ok) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">تم تحديث كلمة المرور</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-emerald-600">{state.message}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-3">
      <input type="hidden" name="token" value={token} />
      <div>
        <label htmlFor="reset-password" className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
          كلمة المرور الجديدة
        </label>
        <input
          id="reset-password"
          type="password"
          name="password"
          required
          minLength={8}
          dir="ltr"
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-800 focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:outline-none"
        />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label htmlFor="reset-confirm" className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
          تأكيد كلمة المرور
        </label>
        <input
          id="reset-confirm"
          type="password"
          name="confirm"
          required
          minLength={8}
          dir="ltr"
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-800 focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:outline-none"
        />
      </div>
      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
        className="w-full rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        {pending ? "جارٍ التحديث…" : "تحديث كلمة المرور"}
      </button>
      {!state.ok && state.message && (
        <p className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-red-700">
          {state.message}
        </p>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 12 — email-verification confirmation form (client).
 *
 * The single-use token is consumed ONLY when the user presses the
 * confirmation button (POST server action). Link prefetchers, mail
 * scanners and messaging-app preview bots can no longer burn the token
 * by merely opening the emailed URL — they would only render this form.
 */

import { useActionState } from "react";
import { verifyEmailAction, type VerifyEmailActionState } from "@/app/actions/account";
import { Card } from "@/app/assignments/ui";

const initialState: VerifyEmailActionState = { ok: false };

const FAILURE_MESSAGES: Record<string, { title: string; hint: string }> = {
  INVALID: {
    title: "الرابط غير صالح",
    hint: "رابط التأكيد غير صحيح أو تم حذفه. اطلب رابطًا جديدًا من إدارة مدرستك أو أعد الطلب إن كانت الخدمة متاحة.",
  },
  EXPIRED: {
    title: "انتهت صلاحية الرابط",
    hint: "روابط التأكيد صالحة لمدة 24 ساعة فقط. اطلب رابطًا جديدًا لإكمال التفعيل.",
  },
  USED: {
    title: "تم استخدام الرابط مسبقًا",
    hint: "روابط التأكيد تُستخدم مرة واحدة فقط. إن لم يكن حسابك مفعّلًا بعد فاطلب رابطًا جديدًا.",
  },
};

export function VerifyEmailForm({ token }: { token: string }) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    async (prev: VerifyEmailActionState, formData: FormData) =>
      verifyEmailAction(prev, formData),
    initialState,
  );

  if (state.status === "ACTIVATED") {
    return (
      <Card title="تم تأكيد بريدك وتفعيل حسابك">
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">
            أصبح بريدك الإلكتروني مؤكدًا وتم تفعيل حسابك داخل المنصة.
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-emerald-600">
            أرسلنا لك إشعارًا داخليًا بالتفعيل — تجده في جرس الإشعارات أعلى الصفحة.
          </p>
        </div>
        <a
          href="/dashboard"
          className="mt-4 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
        >
          الانتقال إلى لوحتي
        </a>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (state.status === "ALREADY_VERIFIED") {
    return (
      <Card title="حسابك مؤكد مسبقًا">
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">
            كان بريدك الإلكتروني مؤكدًا من قبل — لا حاجة لأي إجراء.
          </p>
        </div>
        <a
          href="/dashboard"
          className="mt-4 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
        >
          الانتقال إلى لوحتي
        </a>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (
    state.status === "INVALID" ||
    state.status === "EXPIRED" ||
    state.status === "USED"
  ) {
    const failure = FAILURE_MESSAGES[state.status];
    return (
      <Card title="تعذّر تأكيد البريد">
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-700">{failure.title}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-red-600">{failure.hint}</p>
        </div>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card title="تأكيد بريدك الإلكتروني">
      <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
        وصل رابط التأكيد الخاص بك. اضغط الزر أدناه لإكمال تفعيل حسابك — لن يتم
        أي إجراء قبل تأكيدك الصريح.
      </p>
      <form action={formAction} className="mt-4">
        <input type="hidden" name="token" value={token} />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="inline-flex items-center rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? "جارٍ التأكيد…" : "تأكيد بريدي وتفعيل حسابي"}
        </button>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

import * as React from "react";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  changeOwnEmailAction,
  changeOwnPasswordAction,
  type AccountSecurityActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/account-security";

const initialState: AccountSecurityActionState = { ok: false };

/**
 * Batch 2 — the self-service security forms. After a successful
 * password change the server action re-issues the CURRENT session
 * cookie (all other devices stay logged out).
 */
export function AccountSecurityForms({ mode }: { mode: "password" | "email" }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [passwordState, passwordAction, passwordPending] = React.useActionState(
    changeOwnPasswordAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [emailState, emailAction, emailPending] = React.useActionState(
    changeOwnEmailAction,
    initialState
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (passwordState.ok && passwordState.message) {
      toast({ title: "تم التغيير 🔐", description: passwordState.message });
    }
  }, [passwordState, toast]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (emailState.ok && emailState.message) {
      toast({ title: "تم التحديث ✉", description: emailState.message });
    }
  }, [emailState, toast]);

  if (mode === "password") {
    return (
      <form action={passwordAction} className="space-y-3">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="currentPassword">كلمة المرور الحالية</Label>
          <Input
            id="currentPassword"
            name="currentPassword"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
          />
          {passwordState.fieldErrors?.currentPassword && (
            <p className="text-xs text-error">
              {passwordState.fieldErrors.currentPassword}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="newPassword">كلمة المرور الجديدة</Label>
          <Input
            id="newPassword"
            name="newPassword"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            minLength={8}
            required
          />
          {passwordState.fieldErrors?.newPassword && (
            <p className="text-xs text-error">{passwordState.fieldErrors.newPassword}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="confirmPassword">تأكيد كلمة المرور الجديدة</Label>
          <Input
            id="confirmPassword"
            name="confirmPassword"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            minLength={8}
            required
          />
          {passwordState.fieldErrors?.confirmPassword && (
            <p className="text-xs text-error">
              {passwordState.fieldErrors.confirmPassword}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        {passwordState.message && !passwordState.ok && (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-error-soft px-3 py-2 text-sm text-error">
            {passwordState.message}
          </p>
        )}
        <Button type="submit" disabled={passwordPending} className="rounded-xl">
          {passwordPending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
          <KeyRound className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          تغيير كلمة المرور
        </Button>
      </form>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form action={emailAction} className="space-y-3">
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="emailCurrentPassword">كلمة المرور الحالية (للتأكيد)</Label>
        <Input
          id="emailCurrentPassword"
          name="currentPassword"
          type="password"
          autoComplete="current-password"
          required
        />
        {emailState.fieldErrors?.currentPassword && (
          <p className="text-xs text-error">{emailState.fieldErrors.currentPassword}</p>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="newEmail">البريد الإلكتروني الجديد</Label>
        <Input
          id="newEmail"
          name="newEmail"
          type="email"
          dir="ltr"
          autoComplete="email"
          required
        />
        {emailState.fieldErrors?.newEmail && (
          <p className="text-xs text-error">{emailState.fieldErrors.newEmail}</p>
        )}
      </div>
      {emailState.message && !emailState.ok && (
        <p className="rounded-lg bg-error-soft px-3 py-2 text-sm text-error">
          {emailState.message}
        </p>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={emailPending} className="rounded-xl">
        {emailPending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
        <Mail className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        تغيير البريد الإلكتروني
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

"use server";

/**
 * Phase 11 — account security server actions (forgot/reset password).
 *
 * Anti-enumeration: the forgot-password response is IDENTICAL whether or
 * not the email exists. Honesty: when the email provider is not configured
 * the response says so explicitly instead of claiming a message was sent.
 *
 * Phase 12 — abuse controls:
 *   - per-email flood control lives in lib/auth/tokens.ts (3 / 15 min);
 *     a rate-limited request returns the same neutral message so the
 *     response never becomes an account-existence oracle;
 *   - per-IP limits (10 / 15 min) additionally bound request floods from
 *     a single source across many candidate addresses.
 */

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import {
  consumePasswordResetToken,
  requestPasswordReset,
} from "@/lib/auth/tokens";
import { checkRateLimit, clientKeyFromHeaders } from "@/lib/security/rate-limit";

export interface AccountActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  /** Global deployment fact — safe to render (no secret values). */
  emailConfigured?: boolean;
  /** Token-consumption failure reason for inline field errors. */
  reason?: string;
}

const NEUTRAL_SUCCESS =
  "إذا كان هذا البريد مسجلًا لدينا فستصلك رسالة تحتوي رابط إعادة التعيين خلال دقائق. تحقق أيضًا من مجلد الرسائل غير المرغوبة.";

const IP_REQUEST_LIMIT = 10;
const IP_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

export async function requestPasswordResetAction(
  _prev: AccountActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<AccountActionState> {
  const email = String(formData.get("email") ?? "").trim();
  if (!email || !email.includes("@")) {
    return { ok: false, message: "أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صحيحًا" };
  }

  // Per-IP flood control (defense in depth on top of the per-email limit).
  const headerList = await headers();
  const ipKey = clientKeyFromHeaders(headerList);
  const ipLimit = checkRateLimit("password-reset-ip", ipKey, IP_REQUEST_LIMIT, IP_WINDOW_MS);
  if (!ipLimit.allowed) {
    console.warn(
      `[security] password-reset IP rate-limited (retry in ${ipLimit.retryAfterSeconds}s)`
    );
    // Identical neutral message — no existence or throttling oracle.
    return { ok: true, message: NEUTRAL_SUCCESS };
  }

  const outcome = await requestPasswordReset(email);
  if (outcome.note === "INVALID_INPUT") {
    return { ok: false, message: "أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صحيحًا" };
  }

  // Per-email limiter suppressed this request: keep the exact neutral
  // message (no "email sent" claim, no configuration warning either).
  if (outcome.rateLimited) {
    return { ok: true, message: NEUTRAL_SUCCESS };
  }

  if (outcome.emailSent) {
    return { ok: true, emailConfigured: true, message: NEUTRAL_SUCCESS };
  }
  if (!outcome.emailConfigured) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      emailConfigured: false,
      message: `${NEUTRAL_SUCCESS}\nملاحظة مهمة: خدمة إرسال البريد غير مُهيأة حاليًا في هذا النشر، لذا لن تصل رسالة فعلية — تواصل مع إدارة المدرسة لإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور يدويًا.`,
    };
  }
  // Provider configured but the send failed — say it honestly (global
  // delivery state, still nothing about the specific account).
  return {
    ok: true,
    emailConfigured: true,
    message: `${NEUTRAL_SUCCESS}\nتنبيه: تعذّر إرسال الرسالة حاليًا بسبب خلل لدى مزوّد البريد (${outcome.note ?? "UNKNOWN"}) — أعد المحاولة بعد قليل.`,
  };
}

export async function resetPasswordAction(
  _prev: AccountActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<AccountActionState> {
  const token = String(formData.get("token") ?? "").trim();
  const password = String(formData.get("password") ?? "");
  const confirm = String(formData.get("confirm") ?? "");

  if (!token) return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID", message: "رابط إعادة التعيين غير صالح" };
  if (password.length < 8) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "WEAK_PASSWORD", message: "كلمة المرور يجب ألا تقل عن 8 أحرف" };
  }
  if (password !== confirm) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "WEAK_PASSWORD", message: "كلمتا المرور غير متطابقتين" };
  }

  // Per-IP bound on reset attempts (the 256-bit single-use token is the
  // real gate; this only stops senseless hammering).
  const headerList = await headers();
  const ipKey = clientKeyFromHeaders(headerList);
  const ipLimit = checkRateLimit("password-reset-consume-ip", ipKey, IP_REQUEST_LIMIT, IP_WINDOW_MS);
  if (!ipLimit.allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "INVALID",
      message: "محاولات كثيرة من هذا الجهاز — أعد المحاولة بعد قليل",
    };
  }

  const result = await consumePasswordResetToken(token, password);
  if (!result.ok) {
    const messages: Record<string, string> = {
      INVALID: "رابط إعادة التعيين غير صالح",
      EXPIRED: "انتهت صلاحية رابط إعادة التعيين — اطلب رابطًا جديدًا",
      USED: "تم استخدام هذا الرابط مسبقًا — روابط إعادة التعيين تُستخدم مرة واحدة فقط",
      WEAK_PASSWORD: "كلمة المرور يجب ألا تقل عن 8 أحرف",
    };
    return { ok: false, reason: result.reason, message: messages[result.reason] ?? "تعذّر إعادة التعيين" };
  }

  revalidatePath("/dashboard");
  return {
    ok: true,
    message: "تم تحديث كلمة مرورك بنجاح وإنهاء جميع الجلسات النشطة — يمكنك تسجيل الدخول بكلمة المرور الجديدة.",
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Phase 12 — email verification consumed via POST, never GET          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface VerifyEmailActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  /** undefined = form not submitted yet. */
  status?: "ACTIVATED" | "ALREADY_VERIFIED" | "INVALID" | "EXPIRED" | "USED";
}

/**
 * Consumes an email-verification token. Runs ONLY from the explicit
 * confirmation form (POST) so mail-client prefetchers and link scanners
 * can no longer burn the single-use token before the user clicks it.
 */
export async function verifyEmailAction(
  _prev: VerifyEmailActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<VerifyEmailActionState> {
  const token = String(formData.get("token") ?? "").trim();
  if (!token) return { ok: false, status: "INVALID" };

  const result = await import("@/lib/auth/tokens").then((m) =>
    m.consumeEmailVerificationToken(token)
  );
  if (!result.ok) return { ok: false, status: result.reason };
  return {
    ok: true,
    status: result.alreadyVerified ? "ALREADY_VERIFIED" : "ACTIVATED",
  };
}

"use server";

/**
 * Batch 2 — self-service account security actions (HTML v27 parity,
 * hardened): password change and email change, both behind current-
 * password re-authentication. After a password change every OTHER
 * session dies (tokenVersion) and the CURRENT session is re-issued
 * transparently.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import {
  changeOwnEmail,
  changeOwnPassword,
} from "@/lib/account-security/service";
import {
  createSessionCookie,
  getCurrentUser,
} from "@/lib/auth/session";

export interface AccountSecurityActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: {
    newEmail?: string;
    verificationEmailSent?: boolean;
  };
}

function failure(
  message: string,
  code?: string,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): AccountSecurityActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

export async function changeOwnPasswordAction(
  _prev: AccountSecurityActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AccountSecurityActionState> {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const currentPassword = String(formData.get("currentPassword") ?? "");
    const newPassword = String(formData.get("newPassword") ?? "");
    const confirmPassword = String(formData.get("confirmPassword") ?? "");
    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      return failure("كلمتا المرور الجديدتان غير متطابقتين", "VALIDATION_ERROR", {
        confirmPassword: "غير متطابقة",
      });
    }
    const result = await changeOwnPassword(user.id, currentPassword, newPassword);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    // Re-issue the CURRENT session against the new tokenVersion —
    // every other device/session stays revoked.
    await createSessionCookie(user.id, result.data.tokenVersion);
    revalidatePath("/account-security");
    return { ok: true, message: "تم تغيير كلمة المرور بنجاح — تم إنهاء الجلسات الأخرى" };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export async function changeOwnEmailAction(
  _prev: AccountSecurityActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AccountSecurityActionState> {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const currentPassword = String(formData.get("currentPassword") ?? "");
    const newEmail = String(formData.get("newEmail") ?? "");
    const result = await changeOwnEmail(user.id, currentPassword, newEmail);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidatePath("/account-security");
    revalidatePath("/my-profile");
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: result.data.verificationEmailSent
        ? `تم تحديث بريدك إلى ${result.data.email} — أُرسلت رسالة توثيق للبريد الجديد، وثّقه لتفعيل الدخول.`
        : `تم تحديث بريدك إلى ${result.data.email} — تعذر إرسال رسالة التوثيق الآن، تواصل مع مكتب التطوير.`,
      data: {
        newEmail: result.data.email,
        verificationEmailSent: result.data.verificationEmailSent,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

"use server";

/**
 * Phase 10 — "use server" wrappers around the archive service.
 *
 * Every wrapper resolves the actor from the SESSION (never from the
 * payload) via toAnalyticsActor, then delegates to the archive service
 * which re-validates role/tenant/state on its own. Only follow-up
 * archive/restore and the content restores (assignment / course /
 * program / assessment) are exposed — archiving for surveys keeps its
 * Phase 9 lifecycle action (terminal by design).
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { toAnalyticsActor } from "@/lib/analytics/access";
import {
  archiveFollowUp,
  restoreAssessment,
  restoreAssignment,
  restoreCourse,
  restoreFollowUp,
  restoreProgram,
} from "@/lib/archive/service";

export interface ArchiveActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

function stateFrom(result: { ok: boolean; message?: string; data?: { id: string } }): ArchiveActionState {
  if (result.ok) {
    revalidatePath("/archive");
    return { ok: true, data: { id: result.data?.id } };
  }
  return { ok: false, message: result.message };
}

async function actor() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  return user ? toAnalyticsActor(user) : null;
}

export async function archiveFollowUpAction(
  _prev: ArchiveActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<ArchiveActionState> {
  const current = await actor();
  if (!current) return { ok: false, message: "الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد" };
  const followUpId = String(formData.get("followUpId") ?? "").trim();
  if (!followUpId) return { ok: false, message: "معرّف سجل المتابعة مفقود" };
  return stateFrom(await archiveFollowUp(current, followUpId));
}

export async function restoreFollowUpAction(
  _prev: ArchiveActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<ArchiveActionState> {
  const current = await actor();
  if (!current) return { ok: false, message: "الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد" };
  const followUpId = String(formData.get("followUpId") ?? "").trim();

"use server";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Phase 6 server actions — thin wrappers. Authorization and scoring    */
/* live in the service layer; these extract input (including JSON       */
/* payloads for questions/answers), call the service and refresh pages. */
/* Nothing security-relevant happens on the client.                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface AssessmentFormState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Set by attempt actions so the client can route/confirm. */
  attemptId?: string;
  assessmentId?: string;
}

function str(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  return String(formData.get(key) ?? "");
}

/** Select placeholders submit the sentinel "none" — map it to empty. */
function formValue(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const raw = str(formData, key);
  return raw === "none" ? "" : raw;
}

function checkbox(formData: FormData, key: string): boolean {
  const raw = formData.get(key);
  return raw === "on" || raw === "true" || raw === "1";
}

/** Parse a JSON list payload submitted by a client component. */
function jsonPayload(formData: FormData, key: string): unknown {
  const raw = str(formData, key);
  if (!raw) return undefined;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function refreshAssessments(assessmentId?: string, attemptId?: string) {
  revalidatePath("/");
  revalidatePath("/assessments");
  revalidatePath("/assessments/manage");
  if (assessmentId) {
    revalidatePath(`/assessments/manage/${assessmentId}`);
    revalidatePath(`/assessments/${assessmentId}`);
  }
  if (attemptId) {
    revalidatePath(`/assessments/attempts/${attemptId}`);
  }
}

export async function createAssessmentAction(
  _prev: AssessmentFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AssessmentFormState> {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();
  const result = await createAssessment(
    {
      titleAr: str(formData, "titleAr"),
      titleEn: formValue(formData, "titleEn"),
      instructionsAr: str(formData, "instructionsAr"),
      instructionsEn: formValue(formData, "instructionsEn"),
      courseId: formValue(formData, "courseId"),
      scope: formValue(formData, "scope") || "school",
      schoolId: formValue(formData, "schoolId"),
      passingScore: formValue(formData, "passingScore"),
      timeLimitMinutes: formValue(formData, "timeLimitMinutes"),
      attemptLimit: formValue(formData, "attemptLimit"),
      availableFrom: formValue(formData, "availableFrom"),
      availableUntil: formValue(formData, "availableUntil"),
    },
    ctx
  );
  if (result.ok) {
    refreshAssessments(result.data.id);
    // Creation lands on the editor so the manager can add questions.
    redirect(`/assessments/manage/${result.data.id}`);
  }
  return { ok: false, message: result.message, fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors };
}

"use server";

/**
 * Phase 7 — thin "use server" wrappers around the assignment service.
 *
 * Every wrapper resolves the actor from the SESSION (never from the
 * payload): the current user is narrowed to an explicit role literal
 * before it is passed on as an AssignmentActor. The service
 * re-validates role/tenant/scope again on its own — these wrappers
 * only adapt FormData payloads and trigger revalidation.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import type { AssignmentActor, ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/assignments/access";
import {
  createAssignment,
  deleteSubmissionFile,
  gradeSubmission,
  markUnderReview,
  returnSubmission,
  saveRubric,
  saveSubmissionDraft,
  setAssignmentStatus,
  submitSubmission,
  updateAssignment,
  uploadSubmissionFile,
} from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Serializable action state (no Dates crosses the RSC boundary)        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface FormActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  code?: string;
  data?: {
    id?: string;
    status?: string;
    isLate?: boolean;
    scoreTotal?: number;
    fileId?: string;
    totalPoints?: number;
  };
}

function failure(
  message: string,
  code: string,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): FormActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* FormData helpers                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function str(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const value = formData.get(key);
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

function strArray(formData: FormData, key: string): string[] {
  return formData
    .getAll(key)
    .filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string")
    .filter((value) => value.trim() !== "");
}

function parseJsonField<T>(raw: string): { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false } {
  if (!raw.trim()) return { ok: false };
  try {
    return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(raw) as T };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false };
  }
}

async function teacherViewer(): Promise<ViewerIdentity | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

/**
 * Office-manager actor for assignment management actions. Built ONLY
 * from the session user after an explicit role check — client payloads
 * can never widen it.
 */
async function managerActor(): Promise<AssignmentActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || user.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || !user.schoolId) {
    return null;
  }
  return { id: user.id, role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

/**
 * Review actor (office manager = whole school, supervisor = own
 * assigned teachers — the narrowing itself happens in the service).
 */
async function reviewActor(): Promise<AssignmentActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || !user.schoolId) return null;
  if (user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return { id: user.id, role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  if (user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return { id: user.id, role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

function revalidateAssignment(assignmentId: string): void {
  revalidatePath("/assignments");
  revalidatePath(`/assignments/${assignmentId}`);
  revalidatePath("/assignments/overview");
  revalidatePath("/my-assignments");
  revalidatePath(`/my-assignments/${assignmentId}`);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Office — assignment management                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function createAssignmentAction(
  _prev: FormActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<FormActionState> {
  try {
    const ctx = await managerActor();
    if (!ctx) {
      return failure("إدارة التكليفات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const result = await createAssignment(
      {
        titleAr: str(formData, "titleAr"),
        titleEn: str(formData, "titleEn"),
        descriptionAr: str(formData, "descriptionAr"),
        descriptionEn: str(formData, "descriptionEn"),
        programId: str(formData, "programId"),
        courseId: str(formData, "courseId"),
        sectionId: str(formData, "sectionId"),
        lessonId: str(formData, "lessonId"),
        audienceMode: str(formData, "audienceMode") || "ALL_TEACHERS",
        teacherIds: strArray(formData, "teacherIds"),
        branchIds: strArray(formData, "branchIds"),
        dueAt: str(formData, "dueAt"),
        allowLate: str(formData, "allowLate"),
        lateUntil: str(formData, "lateUntil"),
      },
      ctx
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidatePath("/assignments");
    return { ok: true, data: { id: result.data.id } };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export async function updateAssignmentAction(
  _prev: FormActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<FormActionState> {
  try {
    const assignmentId = str(formData, "assignmentId");
    const ctx = await managerActor();
    if (!ctx) {
      return failure("إدارة التكليفات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const result = await updateAssignment(
      {
        assignmentId,
        titleAr: str(formData, "titleAr"),
        titleEn: str(formData, "titleEn"),
        descriptionAr: str(formData, "descriptionAr"),
        descriptionEn: str(formData, "descriptionEn"),
        programId: str(formData, "programId"),
        courseId: str(formData, "courseId"),
        sectionId: str(formData, "sectionId"),
        lessonId: str(formData, "lessonId"),
        audienceMode: str(formData, "audienceMode") || "ALL_TEACHERS",
        teacherIds: strArray(formData, "teacherIds"),
        branchIds: strArray(formData, "branchIds"),
        dueAt: str(formData, "dueAt"),
        allowLate: str(formData, "allowLate"),
        lateUntil: str(formData, "lateUntil"),
      },
      ctx
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidateAssignment(assignmentId);
    return { ok: true, data: { id: result.data.id } };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

interface RubricCriterionPayload {
  titleAr?: unknown;
  maxPoints?: unknown;
}

export async function saveRubricAction(
  _prev: FormActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<FormActionState> {
  try {
    const parsed = parseJsonField<RubricCriterionPayload[]>(
      str(formData, "criteriaJson")
    );
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      return failure("بيانات سلّم التقييم غير صالحة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const criteria = parsed.value
      .filter(
        (item): item is { titleAr: string; maxPoints: number } =>
          typeof item?.titleAr === "string" && typeof item?.maxPoints === "number"
      )
      .map((item) => ({ titleAr: item.titleAr, maxPoints: item.maxPoints }));

    const ctx = await managerActor();
    if (!ctx) {
      return failure("إدارة التكليفات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const result = await saveRubric(
      {
        assignmentId: str(formData, "assignmentId"),
        criteria,
      },
      ctx
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidateAssignment(str(formData, "assignmentId"));
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: { id: result.data.id, totalPoints: result.data.totalPoints },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export async function uploadSubmissionFileAction(
  _prev: FormActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<FormActionState> {
  try {
    const viewer = await teacherViewer();
    if (!viewer) return failure("الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد", "FORBIDDEN");
    const file = formData.get("file");
    const result = await uploadSubmissionFile(viewer, {
      assignmentId: str(formData, "assignmentId"),
      file,
    });
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidateAssignment(str(formData, "assignmentId"));

export async function gradeSubmissionAction(
  _prev: FormActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<FormActionState> {
  try {
    const ctx = await reviewActor();
    if (!ctx) {
      return failure(
        "مراجعة التسليمات متاحة للمشرفين التربويين ومديري مكاتب التطوير فقط",
        "FORBIDDEN"
      );
    }
    const parsed = parseJsonField<ScorePayload[]>(str(formData, "scoresJson"));
    const scores = parsed.ok
      ? parsed.value
          .filter(
            (item): item is { criterionId: string; points: number } =>
              typeof item?.criterionId === "string" && typeof item?.points === "number"
          )
          .map((item) => ({ criterionId: item.criterionId, points: item.points }))
      : [];
    const result = await gradeSubmission({
      submissionId: str(formData, "submissionId"),
      feedbackText: str(formData, "feedbackText"),
      scores,
      directScore: str(formData, "directScore") || undefined,
    }, ctx);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidatePath("/assignments");
    revalidatePath(`/assignments/${str(formData, "assignmentId")}/submissions`);
    revalidatePath("/my-assignments");
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        id: result.data.id,
        status: result.data.status,
        scoreTotal: result.data.scoreTotal,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

"use server";

import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { isRateLimited, recordLoginFailure, recordLoginSuccess, retryAfterSeconds } from "@/lib/auth/rate-limit";
import {
  createSessionCookie,
  destroySessionCookie,
  sanitizeNextPath,
} from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  authenticateCredentials,
  registerTeacher,
  requestPasswordReset,
  resetPassword,
  resendVerificationEmail,
} from "@/lib/users/service";
import {
  forgotPasswordSchema,
  loginSchema,
  zodAuthFieldErrors,
} from "@/lib/validation/auth";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Auth server actions — thin, non-testable wrappers around             */
/* src/lib/users/service.ts (all rules live in the service layer).      */
/* Client components get typed state objects; security decisions are    */
/* never delegated to the client.                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface AuthFormState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Extra flag for the pending-verification screen (email not sent). */
  emailSent?: boolean;
  email?: string;
}

/** Derive the absolute app base URL from request headers (no env needed). */
async function appBaseUrl(): Promise<string> {
  const h = await headers();
  const host = h.get("x-forwarded-host") ?? h.get("host") ?? "localhost:3000";
  const proto = h.get("x-forwarded-proto") ?? "http";
  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}

function clientIp(h: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof headers>>): string {
  return h.get("x-forwarded-for")?.split(",")[0]?.trim() ?? "local";
}

/* ------------------------------- Login ---------------------------- */

export async function loginAction(
  _prevState: AuthFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AuthFormState> {
  const parsed = loginSchema.safeParse({
    email: String(formData.get("email") ?? ""),
    password: String(formData.get("password") ?? ""),
  });
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodAuthFieldErrors(parsed.error),
    };
  }

  const h = await headers();
  const ip = clientIp(h);
  if (isRateLimited(parsed.data.email, ip)) {
    const wait = retryAfterSeconds(parsed.data.email, ip);
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: `محاولات كثيرة خاطئة — حاول مجددًا بعد ${Math.ceil(wait / 60)} دقيقة تقريبًا`,
    };
  }

  const result = await authenticateCredentials(parsed.data.email, parsed.data.password);
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.code === "INVALID_CREDENTIALS") {
      recordLoginFailure(parsed.data.email, ip);
    }
    return { ok: false, message: result.message };
  }

  recordLoginSuccess(parsed.data.email, ip);
  await createSessionCookie(result.userId, result.tokenVersion);

  const next = sanitizeNextPath(String(formData.get("next") ?? ""));
  redirect(next);
}

/* ------------------------------- Logout --------------------------- */

export async function logoutAction(): Promise<void> {
  await destroySessionCookie();
  redirect("/login");
}

/* ------------------------ Teacher registration -------------------- */

export async function registerAction(
  _prevState: AuthFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AuthFormState> {
  const result = await registerTeacher(
    {
      token: String(formData.get("token") ?? ""),
      name: String(formData.get("name") ?? ""),
      email: String(formData.get("email") ?? ""),
      password: String(formData.get("password") ?? ""),
      confirmPassword: String(formData.get("confirmPassword") ?? ""),
      branchId: String(formData.get("branchId") ?? ""),
      stage: String(formData.get("stage") ?? ""),
      subject: String(formData.get("subject") ?? ""),
    },
    { appBaseUrl: await appBaseUrl() }
  );

  if (!result.ok) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: result.message,
      fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors,
    };
  }

  // Both "created" and "duplicate_suppressed" lead to the SAME generic
  // pending screen — no account-existence disclosure.
  const email = String(formData.get("email") ?? "").trim();
  redirect(
    `/verify-email/pending?email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}&sent=${result.emailSent ? "1" : "0"}`
  );
}

/* ------------------------ Resend verification --------------------- */

export async function resendVerificationAction(
  _prevState: AuthFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AuthFormState> {
  const email = String(formData.get("email") ?? "").trim();
  if (!email) {
    return { ok: false, message: "أدخل بريدك الإلكتروني أولًا" };
  }
  await resendVerificationEmail(email, await appBaseUrl());
  // Always generic — never reveal whether the address has an account.
  return {
    ok: true,
    message: "إذا كان البريد مسجلًا وغير مُوثّق فستصلك رسالة تأكيد جديدة خلال دقائق",
  };
}

/* --------------------------- Forgot password ---------------------- */

export async function forgotPasswordAction(
  _prevState: AuthFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AuthFormState> {
  const parsed = forgotPasswordSchema.safeParse({
    email: String(formData.get("email") ?? ""),
  });
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صحيحًا",
      fieldErrors: zodAuthFieldErrors(parsed.error),
    };
  }

  await requestPasswordReset(parsed.data.email, await appBaseUrl());
  // Generic response — no account-existence disclosure.
  return {
    ok: true,
    message: "إذا كان هذا البريد مسجلًا في المنصة فستصلك رسالة لإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور خلال دقائق",
  };
}

/* --------------------------- Reset password ----------------------- */

export async function resetPasswordAction(
  _prevState: AuthFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<AuthFormState> {
  const result = await resetPassword({
    token: String(formData.get("token") ?? ""),
    password: String(formData.get("password") ?? ""),
    confirmPassword: String(formData.get("confirmPassword") ?? ""),
  });

  if (!result.ok) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: result.message,
      fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors,
    };
  }

  redirect("/login?reset=1");
}

"use server";

/**
 * Phase 8 — thin "use server" wrappers around the certificate service.
 *
 * Every wrapper resolves the actor from the SESSION (never from the
 * payload): the current user is narrowed to an explicit role literal
 * before it is passed on as a CertificateActor. The service
 * re-validates role/tenant/eligibility again on its own — these
 * wrappers only adapt FormData payloads and trigger revalidation.
 *
 * SCHOOL_MANAGER issues/revokes with the same powers as the office
 * manager, inside its own school only — the actor keeps its REAL role
 * literal (no spoofing) and the service's structural scope fence does
 * the confinement.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import type { CertificateActor, CertificateViewer } from "@/lib/certificates/access";
import { issueCertificate, revokeCertificate } from "@/lib/certificates/service";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Serializable action state (no Dates cross the RSC boundary)          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CertificateActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  code?: string;
  data?: {
    id?: string;
    status?: string;
    certificateNumber?: string;
    verificationCode?: string;
  };
}

function failure(
  message: string,
  code: string,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): CertificateActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* FormData helpers                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function str(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const value = formData.get(key);
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

/**
 * Office-manager OR school-manager actor for issuance/revocation.
 * Built ONLY from the session user after an explicit role check —
 * client payloads can never widen it.
 */
async function officeActor(): Promise<CertificateActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  if (user.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" && user.role !== "SCHOOL_MANAGER") {
    return null;
  }
  if (!user.schoolId) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

/**
 * Full viewer projection (any authenticated role incl. TEACHER) for
 * pages/actions whose authorization is ownership-or-scope based and is
 * re-enforced inside the service.
 */
export async function certificateViewer(): Promise<CertificateViewer | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

function revalidateCertificates(certificateId?: string): void {
  revalidatePath("/certificates");
  revalidatePath("/certificates/issue");
  revalidatePath("/my-certificates");
  if (certificateId) revalidatePath(`/certificates/${certificateId}`);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Actions                                                              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function issueCertificateAction(
  _prev: CertificateActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<CertificateActionState> {
  try {
    const ctx = await officeActor();
    if (!ctx) {
      return failure(
        "إصدار الشهادات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس فقط",
        "FORBIDDEN"
      );
    }
    const result = await issueCertificate(ctx, {
      teacherId: str(formData, "teacherId"),
      contentType: str(formData, "contentType"),
      contentId: str(formData, "contentId"),
      titleAr: str(formData, "titleAr"),
      titleEn: str(formData, "titleEn"),
      descriptionAr: str(formData, "descriptionAr"),
      descriptionEn: str(formData, "descriptionEn"),
      expiresAt: str(formData, "expiresAt"),
    });
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidateCertificates(result.data.id);
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        id: result.data.id,
        status: result.data.status,
        certificateNumber: result.data.certificateNumber,
        verificationCode: result.data.verificationCode,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export async function revokeCertificateAction(
  _prev: CertificateActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<CertificateActionState> {
  try {
    const ctx = await officeActor();
    if (!ctx) {
      return failure(
        "إلغاء الشهادات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس فقط",
        "FORBIDDEN"
      );
    }
    const result = await revokeCertificate(ctx, {
      certificateId: str(formData, "certificateId"),
      reason: str(formData, "reason"),
    });
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidateCertificates(result.data.id);
    return { ok: true, data: { id: result.data.id, status: result.data.status } };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

"use server";

/**
 * Batch 2 — growth ladder actions (HTML v48SetTeacherLevel /
 * v48CheckPromotion). The actor is ALWAYS resolved from the session;
 * the 60% promotion gate is re-checked server-side by the service.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  approvePromotion,
  setTeacherLevel,
  type GrowthActor,
} from "@/lib/growth/service";

export interface GrowthActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  data?: {
    changed?: boolean;
    promoted?: boolean;
    from?: string;
    to?: string;
    completed?: number;
    assigned?: number;
    percent?: number;
  };
}

function failure(message: string, code?: string): GrowthActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

async function actor(): Promise<GrowthActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

function revalidateGrowth(teacherId: string): void {
  revalidatePath("/supervision/growth");
  revalidatePath("/teachers");
  revalidatePath(`/teachers/${teacherId}`);
  revalidatePath("/reports");
  // Part 2/2 — the new growth surfaces also read these rows.
  revalidatePath("/growth");
  revalidatePath("/my-growth");
  revalidatePath(`/growth/${teacherId}`);
}

export async function setTeacherLevelAction(
  _prev: GrowthActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<GrowthActionState> {
  try {
    const context = await actor();
    if (!context) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const teacherId = String(formData.get("teacherId") ?? "");
    const level = String(formData.get("level") ?? "");
    const note = String(formData.get("note") ?? "");
    if (!teacherId || !level) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const result = await setTeacherLevel(context, teacherId, level, note);
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    revalidateGrowth(teacherId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: result.data.changed
        ? "تم تحديث تصنيف المعلم"
        : "التصنيف الحالي مطابق — لا تغيير",
      data: {
        changed: result.data.changed,
        from: result.data.from,
        to: result.data.to,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export async function approvePromotionAction(
  _prev: GrowthActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<GrowthActionState> {
  try {
    const context = await actor();
    if (!context) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const teacherId = String(formData.get("teacherId") ?? "");
    if (!teacherId) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const result = await approvePromotion(context, teacherId);
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    revalidateGrowth(teacherId);
    if (!result.data.promoted) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        message: result.data.message,
        data: {
          promoted: false,
          completed: result.data.completed,
          assigned: result.data.assigned,
          percent: result.data.percent,
        },
      };
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: `تم اعتماد انتقال المعلم إلى ${result.data.to}`,
      data: { promoted: true, from: result.data.from, to: result.data.to },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/**
 * Mandatory journey — exam server actions.
 *
 * The ONLY entry points for starting/submitting course exams from the
 * learning page journey (stage 2). Every wrapper:
 *   - resolves the actor from the SESSION (never from the payload),

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { lessonGateMessage, lessonGateStatus } from "@/lib/training/progress";
import type { ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/training/access";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Serializable action state (no Dates cross the RSC boundary)          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface JourneyExamActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  data?: {
    attemptId?: string;
    resumed?: boolean;
    status?: string;
  };
}

function failure(
  message: string,
  code: string
): JourneyExamActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

/** Session-safe viewer identity — TEACHER only for the journey exam. */
async function teacherViewer(): Promise<
  { ok: true; viewer: ViewerIdentity } | { ok: false; state: JourneyExamActionState }
> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      state: failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN"),
    };
  }
  if (user.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      state: failure("الاختبار النهائي متاح للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN"),
    };
  }
  return { ok: true, viewer: { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId } };
}

function str(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const value = formData.get(key);
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

function revalidateJourney(courseId: string): void {
  revalidatePath(`/academy/learn/${courseId}`);
  revalidatePath("/academy");
}

/**
 * One exam answer as the assessment service schema expects: exactly the
 * field matching the question type — choice (ids) / bool / text.
 */
interface JourneyExamAnswer {
  questionId: string;
  choice?: string[];
  bool?: boolean;
  text?: string;
}

/**
 * Collect the exam answers from the form fields (q_<questionId>) using
 * the REAL question types of THIS assessment from the database — so a
 * tampered payload can never smuggle a foreign question or a mismatched
 * answer shape (the service validates this again anyway).
 */
async function collectExamAnswers(
  assessmentId: string,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<JourneyExamAnswer[]> {
  const questions = await db.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId },
    select: { id: true, type: true },
  });
  const answers: JourneyExamAnswer[] = [];
  for (const question of questions) {
    const values = formData
      .getAll(`q_${question.id}`)
      .filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string")
      .map((value) => value.trim())
      .filter((value) => value.length > 0);
    if (values.length === 0) continue;
    if (question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE") {
      answers.push({ questionId: question.id, choice: [values[0]] });
    } else if (question.type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE") {
      answers.push({ questionId: question.id, choice: values });
    } else if (question.type === "TRUE_FALSE") {
      answers.push({ questionId: question.id, bool: values[0] === "true" });
    } else if (question.type === "SHORT_ANSWER") {
      answers.push({
        questionId: question.id,
        text: values[0].slice(0, 2000),
      });
    }
  }
  return answers;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Start (or resume) the exam attempt                                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function startExamAttemptAction(
  _prev: JourneyExamActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<JourneyExamActionState> {
  try {
    const viewerResult = await teacherViewer();
    if (!viewerResult.ok) return viewerResult.state;
    const viewer = viewerResult.viewer;

    const courseId = str(formData, "courseId");
    const assessmentId = str(formData, "assessmentId");
    if (!courseId || !assessmentId) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION");
    }

    // The exam must be a PUBLISHED assessment bound to THIS course.
    const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assessmentId },
      select: { id: true, courseId: true, status: true, schoolId: true },
    });
    if (!assessment || assessment.courseId !== courseId) {
      return failure(
        "هذا الاختبار لا يخص هذه الدورة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة",
        "NOT_FOUND"
      );
    }
    if (!canViewPublishedAssessment(viewer, assessment)) {
      return failure("هذا الاختبار غير متاح لك", "FORBIDDEN");
    }

    // Defense in depth — the mandatory lessons gate, re-checked HERE on
    // top of the service's own gate inside startAttempt.
    const gate = await lessonGateStatus(viewer, courseId);
    if (!gate.unlocked) {
      return failure(lessonGateMessage(gate), "LESSON_GATE");
    }

    const result = await startAttempt(viewer, assessmentId);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code ?? "UNKNOWN");
    }

    revalidateJourney(courseId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        attemptId: result.data.attemptId,
        resumed: result.data.resumed,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Submit + grade (server-side scoring inside the service transaction)  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function submitExamAttemptAction(
  _prev: JourneyExamActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<JourneyExamActionState> {
  try {
    const viewerResult = await teacherViewer();
    if (!viewerResult.ok) return viewerResult.state;
    const viewer = viewerResult.viewer;

    const courseId = str(formData, "courseId");
    const attemptId = str(formData, "attemptId");
    if (!courseId || !attemptId) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION");
    }

    // Ownership + course binding — the attempt must belong to the caller
    // AND to this course's exam.
    const attempt = await db.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
      where: { id: attemptId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        userId: true,
        status: true,
        assessment: {
          select: { id: true, courseId: true, status: true },
        },
      },
    });
    if (!attempt || attempt.assessment.courseId !== courseId) {
      return failure(
        "هذه المحاولة لا تخص هذه الدورة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة",
        "NOT_FOUND"
      );
    }
    if (attempt.userId !== viewer.id) {
      return failure("لا يمكن تسليم محاولة معلم آخر", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    if (attempt.status !== "IN_PROGRESS") {
      return failure(
        "تم تسليم هذه المحاولة من قبل — حدّث الصفحة لعرض النتيجة",
        "ALREADY_SUBMITTED"
      );
    }

    // Defense in depth — the mandatory lessons gate must STILL be open
    // at submission time (a newly published lesson re-locks the exam).
    const gate = await lessonGateStatus(viewer, courseId);
    if (!gate.unlocked) {
      return failure(lessonGateMessage(gate), "LESSON_GATE");
    }

    const answers = await collectExamAnswers(attempt.assessment.id, formData);
    const result = await submitAttempt(viewer, { attemptId, answers });
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code ?? "UNKNOWN");
    }

    // A PASSED attempt triggers maybeCompleteCourse inside the service
    // (post-commit) — the journey page re-render picks up stages 3/4.
    revalidateJourney(courseId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: { attemptId: result.data.attemptId, status: result.data.status },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Draft autosave — silent best-effort (no revalidation, no UI noise)   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function saveExamDraftAction(
  _prev: JourneyExamActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<JourneyExamActionState> {
  try {
    const viewerResult = await teacherViewer();
    if (!viewerResult.ok) return viewerResult.state;
    const viewer = viewerResult.viewer;

    const courseId = str(formData, "courseId");
    const attemptId = str(formData, "attemptId");
    if (!courseId || !attemptId) {
      return { ok: false };
    }

    const attempt = await db.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
      where: { id: attemptId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        userId: true,
        assessmentId: true,
        assessment: { select: { courseId: true } },
      },
    });
    if (
      !attempt ||
      attempt.userId !== viewer.id ||
      attempt.assessment.courseId !== courseId
    ) {
      return { ok: false };
    }

    const answers = await collectExamAnswers(attempt.assessmentId, formData);
    await saveAttemptDraft(viewer, { attemptId, answers });
    // Intentionally NO revalidatePath — a rerender would wipe the
    // unsaved inputs; the draft is restored on the next full load.
    return { ok: true };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false };
  }
}

"use server";

/**
 * Batch 1 — thin "use server" wrappers for the learning loop:
 * lesson progress, course completion, impact measurement and course
 * comments. Every wrapper resolves the actor from the SESSION (never
 * from the payload) and revalidates the course learning page after
 * each mutation, mirroring the certificates actions convention.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import type { ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  markLessonComplete,
  maybeCompleteCourse,
} from "@/lib/training/progress";
import { submitImpactResponse } from "@/lib/surveys/impact";
import { addCourseComment } from "@/lib/comments/service";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Serializable action state (no Dates cross the RSC boundary)          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface LearningActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: {
    lessonsPercent?: number;
    alreadyCompleted?: boolean;
    courseCompleted?: boolean;
    certificateId?: string | null;
    certificateBlockedReason?: string | null;
    replaced?: boolean;
    commentId?: string;
  };
}

function failure(
  message: string,
  code: string,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): LearningActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

function str(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const value = formData.get(key);
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

/** Session-safe viewer identity for the learning services. */
async function viewer(): Promise<ViewerIdentity | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

function revalidateLearning(courseId: string): void {
  revalidatePath(`/academy/learn/${courseId}`);
  revalidatePath("/academy");
  revalidatePath("/academy/impact");
  revalidatePath("/notifications");
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Lesson progress                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function markLessonCompleteAction(
  _prev: LearningActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<LearningActionState> {
  try {
    const identity = await viewer();
    if (!identity) {
      return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const courseId = str(formData, "courseId");
    const lessonId = str(formData, "lessonId");
    if (!courseId || !lessonId) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION");
    }
    const result = await markLessonComplete(identity, courseId, lessonId);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code ?? "UNKNOWN");
    }
    revalidateLearning(courseId);

    // Journey transition indicator — the exact moment the teacher
    // finishes the last required lesson, the checklist strip points
    // at the next stage. The journey card above refreshes through
    // the revalidation and flips المرحلة الثانية to متاحة الآن.
    const successMessage = result.data.alreadyCompleted
      ? undefined
      : result.data.courseCompleted?.created === true
        ? "أكملت جميع متطلبات الدورة — راجع بطاقة رحلة التعلّم للمراحل التالية"
        : result.data.lessonsPercent >= 100
          ? "أكملت جميع دروس الدورة — راجع بطاقة رحلة التعلّم للمرحلة التالية"
          : undefined;

    return {
      ok: true,
      message: successMessage,
      data: {
        lessonsPercent: result.data.lessonsPercent,
        alreadyCompleted: result.data.alreadyCompleted,
        courseCompleted: result.data.courseCompleted?.created === true,
        certificateId:
          result.data.courseCompleted?.certificate?.certificateId ?? null,
        certificateBlockedReason:
          result.data.courseCompleted?.certificateBlockedReason ?? null,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Course completion (manual re-check button on the learning page)     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function completeCourseAction(
  _prev: LearningActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<LearningActionState> {
  try {
    const identity = await viewer();
    if (!identity) {
      return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const courseId = str(formData, "courseId");
    if (!courseId) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION");
    }
    if (identity.role !== "TEACHER") {
      return failure("إتمام الدورات متاح للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const outcome = await maybeCompleteCourse(identity.id, courseId);
    if (!outcome) {
      return failure(
        "لم تكتمل متطلبات الدورة بعد — أكمل الدروس والتقييمات أولًا",
        "REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET"
      );
    }
    revalidateLearning(courseId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        courseCompleted: outcome.created,
        certificateId: outcome.certificate?.certificateId ?? null,
        certificateBlockedReason: outcome.certificateBlockedReason,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Impact measurement                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function submitImpactAction(
  _prev: LearningActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<LearningActionState> {
  try {
    const identity = await viewer();
    if (!identity) {
      return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const courseId = str(formData, "courseId");
    if (!courseId) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION");
    }

    // Each impact tool renders one named field group (impact_<questionId>)
    // whose value depends on the tool type — normalize into the
    // service's answer objects.
    const answers: Array<{
      questionId: string;
      valueNumber?: number;
      valueText?: string;
      selectedOption?: string;
    }> = [];
    for (const [key, value] of formData.entries()) {
      if (!key.startsWith("impact_") || typeof value !== "string") continue;
      const questionId = key.slice("impact_".length);
      const text = value.trim();
      if (!text) continue;
      if (/^-?\d+$/.test(text)) {
        answers.push({ questionId, valueNumber: Number(text) });
      } else {
        answers.push({ questionId, valueText: text, selectedOption: text });
      }
    }
    if (answers.length === 0) {
      return failure("أجب عن أداة قياس واحدة على الأقل", "VALIDATION");
    }

    const result = await submitImpactResponse(identity, courseId, { answers });
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(
        result.message,
        result.code ?? "UNKNOWN",
        result.fieldErrors
      );
    }
    revalidateLearning(courseId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: "تم إرسال قياس الأثر بنجاح — شكرًا لمساهمتك",
      data: { replaced: result.data.replaced },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Course comments                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function addCourseCommentAction(
  _prev: LearningActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<LearningActionState> {
  try {
    const identity = await viewer();
    if (!identity) {
      return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const courseId = str(formData, "courseId");
    const body = str(formData, "body");
    if (!courseId) {
      return failure("بيانات ناقصة — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة", "VALIDATION");
    }
    const result = await addCourseComment(identity, courseId, body);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(
        result.message,
        result.code ?? "UNKNOWN",
        result.fieldErrors
      );
    }
    revalidateLearning(courseId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: { commentId: result.data.id },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

"use server";

/**
 * Mandatory video playback — thin "use server" wrapper for the watch
 * heartbeat. The actor always comes from the SESSION; the heavy
 * anti-cheat and sequential gating live in
 * src/lib/training/sequence.ts (recordWatchHeartbeat).
 */

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { recordWatchHeartbeat } from "@/lib/training/sequence";

export interface WatchActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  data?: {
    watchSeconds?: number;
    maxPositionSeconds?: number;
    lastPositionSeconds?: number;
    watchedPercent?: number;
    completed?: boolean;
    justCompleted?: boolean;
    thresholdPercent?: number;
    skipped?: boolean;
  };
}

/**
 * One playback heartbeat: { courseId, lessonId, positionSeconds,
 * durationSeconds?, ended? }. Called by the mandatory player every
 * ~10s while playing, plus on pause/ended/tab-hide. The client can
 * never declare completion — the server decides.
 */
export async function reportWatchProgressAction(
  input: unknown
): Promise<WatchActionState> {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();
    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      return { ok: false, message: "انتهت الجلسة — سجّل الدخول من جديد.", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
    }
    if (typeof input !== "object" || input === null) {
      return { ok: false, message: "بيانات ناقصة.", code: "VALIDATION" };
    }
    const raw = input as Record<string, unknown>;
    const courseId = typeof raw.courseId === "string" ? raw.courseId : "";
    const lessonId = typeof raw.lessonId === "string" ? raw.lessonId : "";
    const positionSeconds =
      typeof raw.positionSeconds === "number" && Number.isFinite(raw.positionSeconds)
        ? raw.positionSeconds
        : NaN;
    const durationSeconds =
      typeof raw.durationSeconds === "number" && Number.isFinite(raw.durationSeconds)
        ? raw.durationSeconds
        : null;
    const ended = raw.ended === true;

    if (!courseId || !lessonId || !Number.isFinite(positionSeconds)) {
      return { ok: false, message: "بيانات التقدم غير صالحة.", code: "VALIDATION" };
    }

    const result = await recordWatchHeartbeat(
      { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
      courseId,
      lessonId,
      { positionSeconds, durationSeconds, ended }
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      return { ok: false, message: result.message, code: result.code };
    }

    if (result.data.justCompleted) {
      // Refresh the learning page so the next lesson unlocks in place.
      revalidatePath(`/academy/learn/${courseId}`);
    }

    return { ok: true, data: result.data };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر تسجيل تقدم المشاهدة — أعد المحاولة.", code: "UNKNOWN" };
  }
}
