"use server";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Media server actions — the ONLY gateway to Cloudflare R2 uploads.    */
/*                                                                      */
/* Flow (presigned direct upload — large videos never cross Next.js):   */
/*   1. requestMediaUploadAction — session + kind + MIME + size checks, */
/*      then a presigned PUT URL scoped to the caller's tenant.         */
/*   2. The browser PUTs the file straight to R2 (XHR progress).        */
/*   3. confirmMediaUploadAction — HEAD-verifies the object, then       */
/*      (optionally) registers an Attachment row and wires it to a      */
/*      course cover / program cover / lesson primary media.            */
/*                                                                      */
/* Every step fails CLOSED with honest Arabic copy. When the R2 env is  */
/* missing, uploads are refused with the exact missing variables — the  */
/* platform NEVER claims uploads work while they cannot.               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

import { z } from "zod";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  isAllowedMimeType,
  maxBytesFor,
  missingR2Env,
  readR2Config,
} from "@/lib/media/config";
import {
  buildMediaKey,
  headObject,
  MediaStorageError,
  presignedPutUrl,
  publicUrlFor,
} from "@/lib/media/r2";
import { releaseMediaIfUnreferenced } from "@/lib/media/references";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Shared types                                                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface RequestMediaUploadSuccess {
  ok: true;
  uploadUrl: string;
  key: string;
  /** Final DB-ready URL (public CDN base or /api/media proxy path). */
  publicUrl: string;
  expiresIn: number;
}

export interface MediaFailure {
  ok: false;
  message: string;
  /** Present only when the failure is missing R2 configuration. */
  missingEnv?: string[];
}

export type RequestMediaUploadResult = RequestMediaUploadSuccess | MediaFailure;

const MANAGER_ROLES = [
  "SUPER_ADMIN",
  "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER",
  "SCHOOL_MANAGER",
  // Educational supervisors build their school's course content
  // (covers, lesson videos) — same tenant fence, verified below.
  "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
] as const;

function isManager(user: { role: string }): boolean {
  return (MANAGER_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(user.role);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 1) Request a presigned direct-upload URL                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const requestSchema = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["image", "video", "document"]),
  fileName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200),
  mimeType: z.string().trim().min(3).max(120),
  sizeBytes: z.number().int().positive(),
});

export async function requestMediaUploadAction(
  input: unknown
): Promise<RequestMediaUploadResult> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || !user.isActive) {
    return { ok: false, message: "يجب تسجيل الدخول قبل رفع الملفات." };
  }

  const parsed = requestSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return { ok: false, message: "بيانات الرفع غير صالحة." };
  }
  const { kind, fileName, mimeType, sizeBytes } = parsed.data;

  if (!isAllowedMimeType(kind, mimeType)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        kind === "image"
          ? "صيغ الصور المدعومة: PNG أو JPG أو WEBP أو GIF."
          : kind === "document"
            ? "صيغ المرفقات المدعومة: PDF أو Word أو Excel أو PowerPoint أو صوت (MP3/WAV/M4A) أو نص."
            : "صيغ الفيديو المدعومة: MP4 أو WEBM أو MOV.",
    };
  }
  if (sizeBytes > maxBytesFor(kind)) {
    const limitMb = Math.round(maxBytesFor(kind) / (1024 * 1024));
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: `حجم الملف يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${limitMb} ميجابايت).`,
    };
  }

  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        "خدمة الرفع السحابي غير مُهيأة على الخادم بعد — أضف متغيرات Cloudflare R2 (R2_ACCOUNT_ID وR2_ACCESS_KEY_ID وR2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY وR2_BUCKET_NAME) ثم أعد النشر. إدخال الروابط الخارجية يعمل بشكل طبيعي.",
      missingEnv: missingR2Env(),
    };
  }

  // Tenant-scoped keys: school users upload under their school; only
  // SUPER_ADMIN may write platform-level media. A user bound to no
  // school (rare office account) cannot upload — fail closed.
  let scopeSchoolId: string | null = null;
  if (user.schoolId) {
    scopeSchoolId = user.schoolId;
  } else if (user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    scopeSchoolId = null;
  } else {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة — تواصل مع مدير المنصة.",
    };
  }

  try {
    const key = buildMediaKey({
      kind,
      mimeType,
      originalName: fileName,
      schoolId: scopeSchoolId,
    });
    const uploadUrl = await presignedPutUrl(key, mimeType);
    return {
      ok: true,
      uploadUrl,
      key,
      publicUrl: publicUrlFor(key),
      expiresIn: 600,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof MediaStorageError) {
      return { ok: false, message: "تعذر الاتصال بخدمة التخزين — حاول لاحقًا." };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر تجهيز الرفع — حاول مرة أخرى." };
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 2) Confirm + (optionally) register the uploaded object               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type AttachTarget =
  | { type: "course-cover"; courseId: string }
  | { type: "program-cover"; programId: string }
  | { type: "lesson-media"; lessonId: string }
  | { type: "course-attachment"; courseId: string };

export interface ConfirmMediaUploadInput {
  key: string;
  publicUrl: string;
  originalName: string;
  mimeType: string;
  kind: "image" | "video" | "document";
  /** When set, the object is registered as the owner's primary media. */
  attachTo?: AttachTarget;
}

export type ConfirmMediaUploadResult =
  | { ok: true; url: string; attachmentId?: string }
  | MediaFailure;

const confirmSchema = z.object({
  key: z.string().trim().min(3).max(400),
  publicUrl: z.string().trim().min(1).max(2048),
  originalName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200),
  mimeType: z.string().trim().min(3).max(120),
  kind: z.enum(["image", "video", "document"]),
  attachTo: z
    .union([
      z.object({ type: z.literal("course-cover"), courseId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64) }),
      z.object({ type: z.literal("program-cover"), programId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64) }),
      z.object({ type: z.literal("lesson-media"), lessonId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64) }),
      z.object({ type: z.literal("course-attachment"), courseId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64) }),
    ])
    .optional(),
});

export async function confirmMediaUploadAction(
  input: ConfirmMediaUploadInput
): Promise<ConfirmMediaUploadResult> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || !user.isActive) {
    return { ok: false, message: "انتهت الجلسة — سجّل الدخول من جديد." };
  }

  const parsed = confirmSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return { ok: false, message: "بيانات التأكيد غير صالحة." };
  }
  const { key, publicUrl, originalName, mimeType, kind, attachTo } = parsed.data;

  if (!isAllowedMimeType(kind, mimeType)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "صيغة الملف غير مدعومة على الخادم.",
    };
  }

  // The key must belong to the caller's scope (no cross-tenant writes).
  const ownsScope =
    key.startsWith(`media/school-${user.schoolId ?? "-"}/`) ||
    (user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" && key.startsWith("media/platform/"));
  if (!ownsScope) {
    return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية تأكيد هذا الملف." };
  }

  // Server-side verification — never trust the client's word that the
  // upload happened: HEAD the object and enforce the size ceiling.
  let info;
  try {
    info = await headObject(key);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof MediaStorageError && error.code === "R2_NOT_CONFIGURED") {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "خدمة التخزين غير مُهيأة على الخادم.",
        missingEnv: missingR2Env(),
      };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر التحقق من الملف على التخزين." };
  }
  if (!info) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لم نجد الملف على التخزين — أعد المحاولة أو أعد اختيار الملف.",
    };
  }
  if (info.sizeBytes > maxBytesFor(kind)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: `حجم الملف الفعلي يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${Math.round(
        maxBytesFor(kind) / (1024 * 1024)
      )} ميجابايت).`,
    };
  }

  if (!attachTo) {
    // Plain media (e.g. school logo flow) — the URL alone is enough.
    return { ok: true, url: publicUrl };
  }

  // Registration paths are manager-only and school-checked below.
  if (!isManager(user)) {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذه العملية متاحة لمديري المدرسة فقط." };
  }

  try {
    if (attachTo.type === "course-cover") {
      const course = await db.course.findUnique({
        where: { id: attachTo.courseId },
        select: { schoolId: true, coverAttachmentId: true },
      });
      if (!course) return { ok: false, message: "الدورة غير موجودة." };
      if (user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && course.schoolId !== user.schoolId) {
        return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية التعديل على هذه الدورة." };
      }
      const oldUrl = await urlOfAttachment(course.coverAttachmentId);
      const attachment = await db.attachment.create({
        data: {
          originalName,
          storageKey: key,
          mimeType,
          sizeBytes: info.sizeBytes,
          kind: "COVER",
          courseId: attachTo.courseId,
          uploadedById: user.id,
          provider: "R2",
        },
      });
      await db.course.update({
        where: { id: attachTo.courseId },
        data: { coverAttachmentId: attachment.id },
      });
      await releaseAttachmentObject(oldUrl);
      return { ok: true, url: publicUrl, attachmentId: attachment.id };
    }

    if (attachTo.type === "program-cover") {
      const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
        where: { id: attachTo.programId },
        select: { schoolId: true, coverAttachmentId: true },
      });
      if (!program) return { ok: false, message: "البرنامج غير موجود." };
      if (user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && program.schoolId !== user.schoolId) {
        return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية التعديل على هذا البرنامج." };
      }
      const oldUrl = await urlOfAttachment(program.coverAttachmentId);
      const attachment = await db.attachment.create({
        data: {
          originalName,
          storageKey: key,
          mimeType,
          sizeBytes: info.sizeBytes,
          kind: "COVER",
          programId: attachTo.programId,
          uploadedById: user.id,
          provider: "R2",
        },
      });
      await db.trainingProgram.update({
        where: { id: attachTo.programId },
        data: { coverAttachmentId: attachment.id },
      });
      await releaseAttachmentObject(oldUrl);
      return { ok: true, url: publicUrl, attachmentId: attachment.id };
    }

    if (attachTo.type === "course-attachment") {
      const course = await db.course.findUnique({
        where: { id: attachTo.courseId },
        select: { schoolId: true },
      });
      if (!course) return { ok: false, message: "الدورة غير موجودة." };
      if (user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && course.schoolId !== user.schoolId) {
        return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية إضافة مرفقات لهذه الدورة." };
      }
      const attachment = await db.attachment.create({
        data: {
          originalName,
          storageKey: key,
          mimeType,
          sizeBytes: info.sizeBytes,
          kind: "RESOURCE",
          courseId: attachTo.courseId,
          uploadedById: user.id,
          provider: "R2",
        },
      });
      return { ok: true, url: publicUrl, attachmentId: attachment.id };
    }

    // lesson-media
    const lesson = await db.courseLesson.findUnique({
      where: { id: attachTo.lessonId },
      select: {
        attachmentId: true,
        section: { select: { course: { select: { schoolId: true } } } },
      },
    });
    if (!lesson) return { ok: false, message: "الدرس غير موجود." };
    const courseSchoolId = lesson.section?.course?.schoolId ?? null;
    if (user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && courseSchoolId !== user.schoolId) {
      return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية التعديل على هذا الدرس." };
    }
    const oldUrl = await urlOfAttachment(lesson.attachmentId);
    const attachment = await db.attachment.create({
      data: {
        originalName,
        storageKey: key,
        mimeType,
        sizeBytes: info.sizeBytes,
        kind: "RESOURCE",
        lessonId: attachTo.lessonId,
        uploadedById: user.id,
        provider: "R2",
      },
    });
    await db.courseLesson.update({
      where: { id: attachTo.lessonId },
      data: { attachmentId: attachment.id },
    });
    await releaseAttachmentObject(oldUrl);
    return { ok: true, url: publicUrl, attachmentId: attachment.id };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر ربط الملف بالسجل — حاول مرة أخرى." };
  }
}

async function urlOfAttachment(attachmentId: string | null): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!attachmentId) return null;
  const row = await db.attachment.findUnique({
    where: { id: attachmentId },
    select: { storageKey: true, provider: true },
  });
  if (!row || row.provider !== "R2") return null;
  return publicUrlFor(row.storageKey);
}

/** Best-effort release of a replaced R2 object (never throws). */
async function releaseAttachmentObject(url: string | null): Promise<void> {
  if (!url) return;
  try {
    await releaseMediaIfUnreferenced(url);
  } catch {
    // Orphan cleanup is retried by maintenance; never block the save.
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 3) Remove a managed media object (reference-safe)                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function removeMediaAction(url: string): Promise<
  | { ok: true }
  | { ok: false; message: string }
> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || !user.isActive) {
    return { ok: false, message: "انتهت الجلسة — سجّل الدخول من جديد." };
  }
  try {
    const result = await releaseMediaIfUnreferenced(url);
    if (!result.released && result.reason === "STILL_REFERENCED") {
      // The file stays — something else still uses it. Not an error:
      // the caller's record simply stops pointing at it.
      return { ok: true };
    }
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof MediaStorageError && error.code === "R2_NOT_CONFIGURED") {
      return { ok: false, message: "خدمة التخزين غير مُهيأة على الخادم." };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر حذف الملف من التخزين — سيُنظّف تلقائيًا لاحقًا." };
  }
}

"use server";

/**
 * Batch 2 — supervisor->teacher messaging actions (HTML v38/v40).
 * Recipients are validated server-side against the sender's scope;
 * delivery persists a TeacherMessage row and notifies the recipient.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  markMessageRead,
  sendMessage,
  type MessageActor,
} from "@/lib/messages/service";

export interface MessageActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  data?: { messageId?: string };
}

function failure(message: string, code?: string): MessageActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

async function actor(): Promise<MessageActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

export async function sendMessageAction(
  _prev: MessageActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<MessageActionState> {
  try {
    const context = await actor();
    if (!context) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const recipientId = String(formData.get("recipientId") ?? "");
    const type = String(formData.get("type") ?? "");
    const body = String(formData.get("body") ?? "");
    if (!recipientId || !type || !body.trim()) {
      return failure("اختر المعلم واكتب نص الرسالة أولًا", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const result = await sendMessage(context, { recipientId, type, body });
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    revalidatePath("/messages");
    revalidatePath("/notifications");
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: "تم إرسال الرسالة إلى حساب المعلم داخل المنصة",
      data: { messageId: result.data.id },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export async function markMessageReadAction(
  _prev: MessageActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<MessageActionState> {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const messageId = String(formData.get("messageId") ?? "");
    if (!messageId) return failure("بيانات ناقصة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    const marked = await markMessageRead(user.id, messageId);
    revalidatePath("/messages");
    return { ok: true, message: marked ? "تم" : "لا تغيير" };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

"use server";

/**
 * Phase 11 — notification server actions.
 *
 * Session-derived identity only (never payload-trusted); ownership is
 * re-enforced inside the service layer on every call. All actions return
 * a serializable state object for useActionState consumers.
 */

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  markAllNotificationsRead,
  markNotificationRead,
  updatePreferences,
  type PreferencePatch,
} from "@/lib/notifications/service";

export interface NotificationActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  changed?: number;
}

export async function markNotificationReadAction(
  _prev: NotificationActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<NotificationActionState> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false, message: "الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد" };

  const notificationId = String(formData.get("notificationId") ?? "").trim();
  if (!notificationId) return { ok: false, message: "معرّف الإشعار مفقود" };

  const result = await markNotificationRead(user.id, notificationId);
  revalidatePath("/notifications");
  return {
    ok: true,
    changed: result.changed ? 1 : 0,
    message: result.changed ? "تم تحديد الإشعار كمقروء" : "الإشعار مقروء مسبقًا",
  };
}

export async function markAllNotificationsReadAction(
  _prev: NotificationActionState,
): Promise<NotificationActionState> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false, message: "الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد" };

  const changed = await markAllNotificationsRead(user.id);
  revalidatePath("/notifications");
  return { ok: true, changed, message: changed > 0 ? `تم تحديد ${changed} إشعارًا كمقروء` : "لا توجد إشعارات غير مقروءة" };
}

const PREFERENCE_KEYS = [
  "inAppEnabled",
  "emailEnabled",
  "assignments",
  "assessments",
  "courses",
  "surveys",
  "followups",
  "certificates",
  "platform",
] as const;

export async function updateNotificationPreferencesAction(
  _prev: NotificationActionState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<NotificationActionState> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return { ok: false, message: "الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد" };

  const patch: PreferencePatch = {};
  for (const key of PREFERENCE_KEYS) {
    const raw = formData.get(key);
    if (raw === "on" || raw === "true") patch[key] = true;
    else if (raw === "false" || raw === "off" || raw === "") patch[key] = false;
    // Absent checkboxes mean "off" for unchecked booleans — handled by
    // the hidden false input pattern in the form.
  }
  // Checkbox pattern: each toggle ships a hidden "false" input followed by
  // the checkbox; formData.getAll returns both — checkbox wins when on.
  for (const key of PREFERENCE_KEYS) {
    const values = formData.getAll(key).map(String);
    if (values.includes("on")) patch[key] = true;
    else if (values.length > 0) patch[key] = false;
  }

  await updatePreferences(user.id, patch);
  revalidatePath("/notifications/preferences");
  return { ok: true, message: "تم حفظ تفضيلات الإشعارات" };
}

"use server";

/**
 * Batch 3 — platform settings mutation (SUPER_ADMIN only).
 *
 * The acting user is always re-read from the session on the server; a
 * client can never widen its role. Values are validated with Zod before
 * touching SystemSetting, and credentials/tokens never pass through
 * this action.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";

import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS,
  savePlatformSetting,
} from "@/lib/platform-settings";

const platformSettingsSchema = z.object({
  platformName: z.string().trim().min(2, "اسم المنصة مطلوب (حرفان على الأقل)").max(60),
  platformTagline: z.string().trim().max(120).optional(),
  supportEmail: z
    .union([z.literal(""), z.string().email("صيغة البريد الإلكتروني غير صحيحة")])
    .optional(),
  activeAcademicYear: z.string().trim().max(20).optional(),
});

export interface PlatformSettingsState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Partial<Record<"platformName" | "supportEmail", string>>;
}

export async function updatePlatformSettings(
  _prevState: PlatformSettingsState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<PlatformSettingsState> {
  const user = await requireUser();
  if (user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "إعدادات المنصة متاحة لمدير المنصة فقط",
    };
  }

  const parsed = platformSettingsSchema.safeParse({
    platformName: formData.get("platformName") ?? "",
    platformTagline: formData.get("platformTagline") ?? "",
    supportEmail: formData.get("supportEmail") ?? "",
    activeAcademicYear: formData.get("activeAcademicYear") ?? "",
  });

  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: PlatformSettingsState["fieldErrors"] = {};
    for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
      const field = issue.path[0];
      if (field === "platformName" || field === "supportEmail") {
        fieldErrors[field] = issue.message;
      }
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "تحقق من الحقول المطلوبة", fieldErrors };
  }

  try {
    await savePlatformSetting(
      PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.platformName,
      parsed.data.platformName
    );
    await savePlatformSetting(
      PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.platformTagline,
      parsed.data.platformTagline ?? ""
    );
    await savePlatformSetting(
      PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.supportEmail,
      parsed.data.supportEmail ?? ""
    );
    await savePlatformSetting(
      PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.activeAcademicYear,
      parsed.data.activeAcademicYear ?? ""
    );
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر حفظ الإعدادات — أعد المحاولة" };
  }

  revalidatePath("/settings");
  return { ok: true, message: "تم حفظ إعدادات المنصة وتطبيقها" };
}

"use server";

import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { requireAdminContext, type AdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import {
  createRegistrationLink,
  registrationLinkUrl,
  revokeRegistrationLink,
} from "@/lib/registration-links/service";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Registration-link management actions (Development Office Manager).   */
/* Thin wrappers: context comes from the session, tenant scope and all  */
/* rules live in the service layer. The raw token appears ONLY in the   */
/* creation response — it is never logged and never stored in clear.    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface RegistrationLinkActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  /** Creation only — the copyable URL, shown exactly once. */
  linkUrl?: string;
  expiresAt?: string | null;
  code?: string;
}

/** Absolute app base URL from request headers (no env needed). */
async function appBaseUrl(): Promise<string> {
  const h = await headers();
  const host = h.get("x-forwarded-host") ?? h.get("host") ?? "localhost:3000";
  const proto = h.get("x-forwarded-proto") ?? "http";
  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}

async function actor(): Promise<AdminContext> {
  return requireAdminContext();
}

export async function createRegistrationLinkAction(
  _prevState: RegistrationLinkActionState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<RegistrationLinkActionState> {
  const ctx = await actor();

  const result = await createRegistrationLink(ctx, {
    schoolId: String(formData.get("schoolId") ?? ""),
    expiresInDays: String(formData.get("expiresInDays") ?? ""),
  });

  if (!result.ok) {
    return { ok: false, message: result.message, code: result.code };
  }

  revalidatePath("/registration-links");

  return {
    ok: true,
    message: "تم توليد رابط التسجيل — انسخه الآن، فلن يُعرض مرة أخرى",
    linkUrl: registrationLinkUrl(await appBaseUrl(), result.data.rawToken),
    expiresAt: result.data.expiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  };
}

export async function revokeRegistrationLinkAction(
  _prevState: RegistrationLinkActionState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<RegistrationLinkActionState> {
  const ctx = await actor();

  const result = await revokeRegistrationLink(ctx, {
    linkId: String(formData.get("linkId") ?? ""),
  });

  if (!result.ok) {
    return { ok: false, message: result.message, code: result.code };
  }

  revalidatePath("/registration-links");

  return {
    ok: true,
    message:
      "تم إلغاء الرابط — لن يُقبل أي تسجيل جديد عبره، وحسابات المعلمين المسجلة سابقًا لم تتأثر",
  };
}

"use server";

/**
 * Batch 2 — yearly training archive actions (HTML v26ArchiveYear /
 * v26StartYear). Writes are gated server-side to canAdministerSchool.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { archiveYear, startAcademicYear, type ArchiveActor } from "@/lib/training/archive";

export interface ArchiveActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  data?: { year?: string; previousYear?: string };
}

function failure(message: string, code?: string): ArchiveActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

async function actor(): Promise<ArchiveActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

export async function archiveYearAction(
  _prev: ArchiveActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<ArchiveActionState> {
  try {
    const context = await actor();
    if (!context) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const year = String(formData.get("year") ?? "").trim();
    if (!year) return failure("حدد العام الدراسي", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    const result = await archiveYear(context, year);
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    revalidatePath("/training-archive");
    revalidatePath("/reports");
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: `تمت أرشفة بيانات التدريب للعام الدراسي ${year} ويمكن الرجوع إليها لاحقًا.`,
      data: { year },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export async function startAcademicYearAction(
  _prev: ArchiveActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<ArchiveActionState> {
  try {
    const context = await actor();
    if (!context) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const year = String(formData.get("year") ?? "").trim();
    if (!year) return failure("أدخل العام الدراسي — مثال 1449هـ", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    const result = await startAcademicYear(context, year);
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    revalidatePath("/training-archive");
    revalidatePath("/reports");
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: `تم اعتماد العام الدراسي ${result.data.year} كسنة العمل الحالية (كان ${result.data.previousYear}).`,
      data: { year: result.data.year, previousYear: result.data.previousYear },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { promises as fs } from "fs";
import path from "path";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { resolveManageableSchoolId } from "@/lib/branding";
import {
  LOGO_MAX_BYTES,
  LOGO_MIME_TYPES,
  logoExtensionFor,
  schoolBrandingSchema,
} from "@/lib/branding/validation";
import {
  PRESIGN_PUT_EXPIRES_SECONDS,
  readR2Config,
} from "@/lib/media/config";
import {
  headObject,
  MediaStorageError,
  presignedPutUrl,
  publicUrlFor,
} from "@/lib/media/r2";
import { releaseMediaIfUnreferenced } from "@/lib/media/references";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Server actions for school branding management.                       */
/*                                                                      */
/* Authorization is resolved from the SESSION on every call:            */
/*   • SUPER_ADMIN  → any school (explicit schoolId allowed).           */
/*   • DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER → their own school ONLY; a client     */
/*     hint pointing at another tenant is a hard rejection.             */
/*   • everyone else → fail-closed rejection.                           */
/*                                                                      */
/* Logo storage — two honest paths:                                     */
/*   1. CLOUD (production): when the R2 environment is configured the   */
/*      logo rides the SAME presigned direct-upload pipeline as every   */
/*      other media file (request URL → browser PUT → server-side HEAD  */
/*      verification → DB commit). File bytes never pass through a      */
/*      server action, so the 1MB action-body limit stops mattering.    */
/*      The object lives under media/school-<id>/branding/ — inside the */
/*      tenant scope the media system already owns.                     */
/*   2. LOCAL (dev / no R2 yet): the legacy public/uploads write.       */
/*      requestSchoolLogoUploadAction reports mode:"local" and the      */
/*      client falls back to uploadSchoolLogoAction. On a read-only     */
/*      production filesystem that fallback fails HONESTLY and the      */
/*      real error is logged server-side instead of being swallowed.    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface BrandingActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Updated logo URL after a successful upload (upload action). */
  logoUrl?: string | null;
}

/** Refresh every route that renders branding (the shell reads it at the
 * root layout, so a layout-level revalidate reaches the whole app). */
function revalidateBrandingPaths(schoolId?: string | null) {
  revalidatePath("/", "layout");
  revalidatePath("/login");
  revalidatePath("/schools/branding");
  if (schoolId) revalidatePath(`/schools/${schoolId}`);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Shared branding auth — resolves the actionable school or rejects.    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function resolveBrandingTarget(requested: string) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  const target = resolveManageableSchoolId(
    user ? { role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId } : null,
    requested
  );
  if (!target.ok) {
    return {
      ok: false as const,
      message:
        target.code === "TENANT_MISMATCH"
          ? "لا يمكنك تعديل هوية مدرسة أخرى."
          : "لا تملك صلاحية إدارة هوية المدرسة.",
    };
  }
  if (!target.schoolId) {
    return { ok: false as const, message: "اختر المدرسة أولًا ثم ارفع الشعار." };
  }
  return { ok: true as const, schoolId: target.schoolId };
}

function logoMimeTypeOk(mimeType: string): boolean {
  return (LOGO_MIME_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(mimeType);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Logo upload — step 1: request a presigned URL (or report local).     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type RequestSchoolLogoResult =
  | {
      ok: true;
      mode: "cloud";
      uploadUrl: string;
      key: string;
      publicUrl: string;
      expiresIn: number;
    }
  | { ok: true; mode: "local" }
  | { ok: false; message: string };

export async function requestSchoolLogoUploadAction(
  schoolIdHint: string,
  mimeType: string,
  sizeBytes: number
): Promise<RequestSchoolLogoResult> {
  const target = await resolveBrandingTarget(schoolIdHint);
  if (!target.ok) return { ok: false, message: target.message };
  const schoolId = target.schoolId;

  if (!logoMimeTypeOk(mimeType)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "الصيغ المدعومة: PNG أو JPG أو WEBP (لا يُسمح بـ SVG).",
    };
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(sizeBytes) || sizeBytes <= 0) {
    return { ok: false, message: "اختر ملف شعار صالحًا." };
  }
  if (sizeBytes > LOGO_MAX_BYTES) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الحد الأقصى لحجم الشعار 2 ميجابايت." };
  }

  // No R2 environment yet — report the local disk path so development
  // keeps working unchanged. The caller falls back to the legacy action.
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) return { ok: true, mode: "local" };

  const ext = logoExtensionFor(mimeType);
  if (!ext) return { ok: false, message: "صيغة الملف غير مدعومة." };

  // Tenant-scoped branding key — same media/school-<id>/ scope the media
  // system owns, so reference-counted cleanup sees it as managed media.
  const key = `media/school-${schoolId}/branding/logo-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;

  try {
    const uploadUrl = await presignedPutUrl(key, mimeType);
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: "cloud",
      uploadUrl,
      key,
      publicUrl: publicUrlFor(key),
      expiresIn: PRESIGN_PUT_EXPIRES_SECONDS,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof MediaStorageError) {
      return { ok: false, message: "تعذر الاتصال بخدمة التخزين — حاول لاحقًا." };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر تجهيز الرفع — حاول مرة أخرى." };
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Logo upload — step 2: verify on storage and commit to the school.    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CommitSchoolLogoInput {
  schoolIdHint: string;
  key: string;
  mimeType: string;
}

export async function commitSchoolLogoUploadAction(
  input: CommitSchoolLogoInput
): Promise<BrandingActionState> {
  const target = await resolveBrandingTarget(input.schoolIdHint);
  if (!target.ok) return { ok: false, message: target.message };
  const schoolId = target.schoolId;

  // The key must be a branding object of THE resolved school — a client
  // pointing at another tenant's key (or any non-branding key) is rejected.
  const key = String(input.key ?? "");
  if (!key.startsWith(`media/school-${schoolId}/branding/logo-`)) {
    return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية تأكيد هذا الملف." };
  }
  if (!logoMimeTypeOk(input.mimeType)) {
    return { ok: false, message: "صيغة الملف غير مدعومة على الخادم." };
  }

  try {
    // Never trust the client's word that the upload happened: HEAD the
    // object and enforce the size ceiling server-side.
    let info;
    try {
      info = await headObject(key);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof MediaStorageError && error.code === "R2_NOT_CONFIGURED") {
        return {
          ok: false,
          message:
            "خدمة الرفع السحابي غير مُهيأة على الخادم — أضف متغيرات Cloudflare R2 (R2_ACCOUNT_ID وR2_ACCESS_KEY_ID وR2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY وR2_BUCKET_NAME) ثم أعد النشر.",
        };
      }
      return { ok: false, message: "تعذر التحقق من الشعار على التخزين." };
    }
    if (!info) {
      return { ok: false, message: "لم نجد الشعار على التخزين — أعد المحاولة." };
    }
    if (info.sizeBytes > LOGO_MAX_BYTES) {
      return { ok: false, message: "حجم الشعار الفعلي يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (2 ميجابايت)." };
    }

    const publicUrl = publicUrlFor(key);

    const school = await db.school.findUnique({
      where: { id: schoolId },
      select: { logoUrl: true },
    });

    await db.school.update({ where: { id: schoolId }, data: { logoUrl: publicUrl } });

    // Best-effort cleanup of the replaced logo — legacy disk files are
    // unlinked, old R2 objects go through reference-safe release.
    const previous = school?.logoUrl;
    if (previous && previous.startsWith(`/uploads/schools/${schoolId}/`)) {
      try {
        await fs.unlink(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", previous));
      } catch {
        // the old file may already be gone — never fail the upload for it
      }
    }
    try {
      await releaseMediaIfUnreferenced(previous);
    } catch {
      // Orphan cleanup is retried by maintenance; never block the save.
    }

    revalidateBrandingPaths(schoolId);
    return { ok: true, logoUrl: publicUrl, message: "تم رفع الشعار وحفظه." };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[school-branding] logo commit failed:", error);
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر حفظ الشعار على الخادم — حاول مرة أخرى." };
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Logo upload — legacy local-disk fallback (dev / no R2 configured).   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function uploadSchoolLogoAction(
  _prevState: BrandingActionState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<BrandingActionState> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  const requested = String(formData.get("schoolId") ?? "");
  const target = resolveManageableSchoolId(
    user ? { role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId } : null,
    requested
  );
  if (!target.ok) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        target.code === "TENANT_MISMATCH"
          ? "لا يمكنك تعديل هوية مدرسة أخرى."
          : "لا تملك صلاحية إدارة هوية المدرسة.",
    };
  }
  if (!target.schoolId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "اختر المدرسة أولًا ثم ارفع الشعار." };
  }
  const schoolId = target.schoolId;

  const file = formData.get("logo");
  if (!(file instanceof File) || file.size === 0) {
    return { ok: false, fieldErrors: { logo: "اختر ملف شعار صالحًا." } };
  }
  if (!logoMimeTypeOk(file.type)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      fieldErrors: { logo: "الصيغ المدعومة: PNG أو JPG أو WEBP (لا يُسمح بـ SVG)." },
    };
  }
  if (file.size > LOGO_MAX_BYTES) {
    return { ok: false, fieldErrors: { logo: "الحد الأقصى لحجم الشعار 2 ميجابايت." } };
  }

  const ext = logoExtensionFor(file.type);
  if (!ext) return { ok: false, fieldErrors: { logo: "صيغة الملف غير مدعومة." } };

  try {
    const school = await db.school.findUnique({
      where: { id: schoolId },
      select: { logoUrl: true },
    });

    const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads", "schools", schoolId);
    await fs.mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
    const fileName = `logo-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
    const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(dir, fileName), buffer);

    const logoUrl = `/uploads/schools/${schoolId}/${fileName}`;

    // Best-effort cleanup of the previous locally-stored logo.
    const previous = school?.logoUrl;
    if (previous && previous.startsWith(`/uploads/schools/${schoolId}/`)) {
      try {
        await fs.unlink(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", previous));
      } catch {
        // the old file may already be gone — never fail the upload for it
      }
    }

    await db.school.update({ where: { id: schoolId }, data: { logoUrl } });
    revalidateBrandingPaths(schoolId);
    return { ok: true, logoUrl, message: "تم رفع الشعار وحفظه." };
  } catch (error) {
    // The real cause (permissions / read-only FS / DB) is now visible in
    // the server terminal instead of being swallowed by a bare catch.
    console.error("[school-branding] local logo save failed:", error);
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر حفظ الشعار على الخادم — حاول مرة أخرى." };
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Save branding (name, tagline, palette)                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function saveSchoolBrandingAction(
  _prevState: BrandingActionState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<BrandingActionState> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();

  const parsed = schoolBrandingSchema.safeParse({
    schoolId: String(formData.get("schoolId") ?? "") || undefined,
    nameAr: String(formData.get("nameAr") ?? "").trim() || undefined,
    tagline: String(formData.get("tagline") ?? "").trim(),
    primary: String(formData.get("primary") ?? ""),
    secondary: String(formData.get("secondary") ?? ""),
    accent: String(formData.get("accent") ?? ""),
    neutral: String(formData.get("neutral") ?? ""),
  });

  if (!parsed.success) {
    const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
      const key = String(issue.path[0] ?? "form");
      if (!fieldErrors[key]) fieldErrors[key] = issue.message;
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "تحقق من القيم المدخلة.", fieldErrors };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const target = resolveManageableSchoolId(
    user ? { role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId } : null,
    input.schoolId ?? null
  );
  if (!target.ok) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        target.code === "TENANT_MISMATCH"
          ? "لا يمكنك تعديل هوية مدرسة أخرى."
          : "لا تملك صلاحية إدارة هوية المدرسة.",
    };
  }
  if (!target.schoolId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "اختر المدرسة المراد تعديل هويتها." };
  }
  const schoolId = target.schoolId;

  try {
    const school = await db.school.findUnique({
      where: { id: schoolId },
      select: { isActive: true },
    });
    if (!school || !school.isActive) {
      return { ok: false, message: "المدرسة غير موجودة أو غير مفعلة." };
    }

    await db.school.update({
      where: { id: schoolId },
      data: {
        ...(input.nameAr ? { nameAr: input.nameAr } : {}),
        brandTagline: input.tagline === "" ? null : (input.tagline ?? null),
        ...(input.primary ? { brandColor: input.primary } : {}),
        ...(input.secondary ? { brandColorSecondary: input.secondary } : {}),
        ...(input.accent ? { brandColorAccent: input.accent } : {}),
        ...(input.neutral ? { brandColorNeutral: input.neutral } : {}),
      },
    });

    revalidateBrandingPaths(schoolId);
    return { ok: true, message: "تم حفظ هوية المدرسة — التغييرات ظاهرة الآن." };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر حفظ الهوية — حاول مرة أخرى." };
  }
}

/* Remove the logo (keeps everything else).                             */

export async function removeSchoolLogoAction(
  _prevState: BrandingActionState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<BrandingActionState> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  const requested = String(formData.get("schoolId") ?? "");
  const target = resolveManageableSchoolId(
    user ? { role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId } : null,
    requested
  );
  if (!target.ok || !target.schoolId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية إدارة هوية المدرسة." };

    const school = await db.school.findUnique({

      where: { id: target.schoolId },
      data: { logoUrl: null },
    });

    // Cleanup AFTER the reference is gone: legacy disk files are unlinked,
    // R2 objects only when nothing else in the DB still points at them.

    if (previous && previous.startsWith(`/uploads/schools/${target.schoolId}/`)) {
      try {
        await fs.unlink(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", previous));
      } catch {
        // best-effort cleanup
      }
    }
    try {
      await releaseMediaIfUnreferenced(previous);
    } catch {
      // best-effort cleanup — maintenance retries orphans
    }

    revalidateBrandingPaths(target.schoolId);
    return { ok: true, logoUrl: null, message: "تم حذف الشعار." };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[school-branding] logo remove failed:", error);
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر حذف الشعار — حاول مرة أخرى." };
  }
}

"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

  createBranch,
  createSchool,
  setBranchActive,
  setSchoolActive,
  updateBranch,
  updateSchool,
  type SchoolWithBranchCount,
} from "@/lib/schools/service";
import type { ServiceResult } from "@/lib/validation/schools";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Server actions for the school management module.                    */
/*                                                                     */
/* Thin, non-testable wrappers around src/lib/schools/service.ts:      */
/* they add cache invalidation only. ALL validation, authorization     */
/* (dev admin today) and tenant-ownership checks live in the service   */
/* layer and run on the server for every call.                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function revalidateSchoolPaths(schoolId?: string) {
  revalidatePath("/");
  revalidatePath("/schools");
  if (schoolId) revalidatePath(`/schools/${schoolId}`);
}

export type SchoolFormState = ServiceResult<SchoolWithBranchCount> | { ok: false } | null;

export async function createSchoolAction(
  _prevState: SchoolFormState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<SchoolFormState> {
  const payload = {
    nameAr: String(formData.get("nameAr") ?? ""),
    nameEn: String(formData.get("nameEn") ?? ""),
    slug: String(formData.get("slug") ?? ""),
    logoUrl: String(formData.get("logoUrl") ?? ""),
    brandColor: String(formData.get("brandColor") ?? ""),
    isActive: formData.get("isActive") === "on",
  };

  const result = await createSchool(payload);
  if (result.ok) {
    revalidateSchoolPaths(result.data.id);
    redirect(`/schools/${result.data.id}`);
  }
  return result;
}

export async function updateSchoolAction(
  _prevState: SchoolFormState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<SchoolFormState> {
  const payload = {
    id: String(formData.get("id") ?? ""),
    nameAr: String(formData.get("nameAr") ?? ""),
    nameEn: String(formData.get("nameEn") ?? ""),
    slug: String(formData.get("slug") ?? ""),
    logoUrl: String(formData.get("logoUrl") ?? ""),
    brandColor: String(formData.get("brandColor") ?? ""),
  };

  const result = await updateSchool(payload);
  if (result.ok) revalidateSchoolPaths(result.data.id);
  return result;
}

): Promise<ServiceResult<SchoolWithBranchCount>> {

"use server";

/**
 * Batch 2 — Excel/CSV import actions for teacher-supervisor assignments
 * and teacher data (HTML v21/v26). The file is parsed and validated
 * SERVER-SIDE; the client only ever sees the serializable preview.
 */
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  commitImport,
  previewImport,
  type CommitOptions,
  type ImportActor,
  type ImportPreview,
} from "@/lib/staffing/import";

export interface ImportActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  code?: string;
  /** The validated preview (client renders it, then commits the same file). */
  preview?: ImportPreview;
  commit?: {
    applied: number;
    skipped: number;
    createdAccounts: number;
    notes: string[];
  };
}

function failure(message: string, code?: string): ImportActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

async function actor(): Promise<ImportActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

/** Read the uploaded file as UTF-8 text (accepts .csv — Excel-compatible). */
async function readCsvFile(file: FormDataEntryValue | null): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!file || typeof file === "string") return null;
  const blob = file as File;
  if (blob.size <= 0 || blob.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
  const text = await blob.text();
  return text.length > 0 ? text : null;
}

export async function previewImportAction(
  _prev: ImportActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<ImportActionState> {
  try {
    const context = await actor();
    if (!context) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const csvText = await readCsvFile(formData.get("file"));
    if (csvText === null) {
      return failure(
        "اختر ملف CSV صالحًا (حتى 2MB) — يفتح ويُحفظ من Excel مباشرة",
        "VALIDATION_ERROR"
      );
    }
    const result = await previewImport(context, csvText);
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: `تمت قراءة ${result.data.total} سجلًا — راجع الإسناد ثم اضغط «اعتماد الإسناد».`,
      preview: result.data,
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("تعذر قراءة الملف — تأكد أنه CSV صحيح وأن الصف الأول أسماء الأعمدة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/**
 * Commit the import. The server re-parses and re-validates the SAME
 * file contents (posted as `csvText`) — a stale or tampered client
 * cannot inject rows that were never validated.
 */
export async function commitImportAction(
  _prev: ImportActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<ImportActionState> {
  try {
    const context = await actor();
    if (!context) return failure("يجب تسجيل الدخول أولًا", "FORBIDDEN");
    const csvText = String(formData.get("csvText") ?? "");
    if (!csvText.trim()) return failure("لا توجد بيانات معتمدة — اختر الملف أولًا", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    const options: CommitOptions = {
      createMissingAccounts: formData.get("createMissingAccounts") === "on",
      updateSchool: formData.get("updateSchool") === "on",
    };
    const result = await commitImport(context, csvText, options);
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    revalidatePath("/teachers");
    revalidatePath("/users");
    revalidatePath("/supervision/growth");
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: `✓ تم اعتماد ${result.data.applied} إسنادًا. ${result.data.skipped} سجل يحتاج مراجعة.`,
      commit: result.data,
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع أثناء الاعتماد — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export interface SurveyActionState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  code?: string;
  data?: {
    id?: string;
    status?: string;
    surveyTitle?: string;
    submittedAt?: string;
  };

function failure(
  message: string,
  code: string,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): SurveyActionState {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* FormData helpers                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function str(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const value = formData.get(key);
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

function json(formData: FormData, key: string): unknown {
  const raw = str(formData, key);
  if (raw.trim() === "") return undefined;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

/**
 * General back-office actor for survey management. Built ONLY from the
 * session user after an explicit role check — client payloads can never
 * widen it. SUPER_ADMIN passes the role literal but every operational
 * service path rejects it via surveyScopeError.
 */
export async function surveyActor(): Promise<SurveyActor | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  if (
    user.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    user.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" &&
    user.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" &&
    user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN"
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    id: user.id,
    role: user.role,
    schoolId: user.schoolId,
  };
}

/** Any authenticated viewer (teachers included) for response paths. */
export async function surveyViewer(): Promise<SurveyViewer | null> {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return null;
  return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

function revalidateSurveys(surveyId?: string): void {
  revalidatePath("/surveys");
  revalidatePath("/my-surveys");
  revalidatePath("/impact");
  if (surveyId) {
    revalidatePath(`/surveys/${surveyId}`);
    revalidatePath(`/surveys/${surveyId}/results`);
    revalidatePath(`/my-surveys/${surveyId}`);
  }
}

function revalidateFollowUps(followUpId?: string): void {
  revalidatePath("/follow-ups");
  revalidatePath("/my-follow-ups");
  revalidatePath("/impact");
  if (followUpId) revalidatePath(`/follow-ups/${followUpId}`);
}

export async function transitionSurveyAction(
  _prev: SurveyActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<SurveyActionState> {
  try {
    const ctx = await surveyActor();
    if (!ctx) {
      return failure("إدارة دورة حياة الاستبيان متاحة للأدوار الإدارية المعتمدة فقط", "FORBIDDEN");

    const surveyId = str(formData, "surveyId");

    const action = rawAction as SurveyTransitionAction;
    const result = await transitionSurvey(ctx, surveyId, action);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code);
    }
    revalidateSurveys(result.data.id);
    return { ok: true, data: { id: result.data.id, status: result.data.status } };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");

/**
 * Batch 2 — administrative teacher profile actions:

const profileSchema = z.object({
  name: nameFieldRules(),
  stage: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(60, "المرحلة طويلة جدًا")
    .optional()
    .transform((value) => (value && value.length > 0 ? value : null)),
  subject: z

    .trim()

/** Administrative teacher profile edit (extends the existing Phase 4 edit). */
export async function updateTeacherProfileAction(
  _prev: TeacherAdminActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<TeacherAdminActionState> {
  try {
    const actorContext = await adminActor();
    if (!actorContext) return failure("هذه العملية متاحة للإدارة فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    const teacherId = String(formData.get("teacherId") ?? "");
    if (!teacherId) return failure("بيانات ناقصة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");

    const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: teacherId },
      select: { id: true, role: true, schoolId: true, teacherSupervision: { select: { id: true } } },
    });
    if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER") {
      return failure("المعلم غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
    }
    if (
      actorContext.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
      teacher.schoolId !== actorContext.schoolId
    ) {
      return failure("هذا المعلم خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
    }

    const parsed = profileSchema.safeParse({
      name: String(formData.get("name") ?? ""),
      stage: String(formData.get("stage") ?? ""),
      subject: String(formData.get("subject") ?? ""),
      supervisorId: String(formData.get("supervisorId") ?? ""),
      deputyId: String(formData.get("deputyId") ?? ""),
    });
    if (!parsed.success) {
      const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
        const key = String(issue.path[0] ?? "_form");
        if (!fieldErrors[key]) fieldErrors[key] = issue.message;
      }
      return failure("راجع الحقول المطلوبة", "VALIDATION_ERROR", fieldErrors);
    }
    const input = parsed.data;

    // Supervisor/deputy must be ACTIVE staff of the teacher's school.
    const staffSchoolId = teacher.schoolId;
    if (input.supervisorId) {
      const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
        where: { id: input.supervisorId },
        select: { role: true, isActive: true, schoolId: true },
      });
      if (
        !supervisor ||
        supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
        !supervisor.isActive ||
        (staffSchoolId && supervisor.schoolId !== staffSchoolId)
      ) {
        return failure("المشرف المحدد غير صالح لهذا المعلم", "VALIDATION_ERROR", {
          supervisorId: "المشرف غير صالح",
        });
      }
    }
    if (input.deputyId) {
      const deputy = await db.user.findUnique({
        where: { id: input.deputyId },
        select: { role: true, isActive: true, schoolId: true },
      });
      if (
        !deputy ||
        deputy.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
        !deputy.isActive ||
        (staffSchoolId && deputy.schoolId !== staffSchoolId)
      ) {
        return failure("الوكيل المحدد غير صالح لهذا المعلم", "VALIDATION_ERROR", {
          deputyId: "الوكيل غير صالح",
        });
      }
    }

    await db.user.update({
      where: { id: teacherId },
      data: {
        name: input.name,
        stage: input.stage,
        subject: input.subject,
      },
    });

    // The teacher -> supervisor row is UNIQUE per teacher. supervisorId
    // is NOT NULL in the schema: a cleared supervisor only updates the
    // deputy of an EXISTING row; without any row AND without a supervisor
    // the write is rejected with a clear Arabic message.
    if (!staffSchoolId) {
      return failure("المعلم غير مرتبط بمجمع تعليمي — حدّد مدرسته أولًا", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    if (input.supervisorId) {
      await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.upsert({
        where: { teacherId },
        create: {
          teacherId,
          supervisorId: input.supervisorId,
          deputyId: input.deputyId,
          schoolId: staffSchoolId,
        },
        update: {
          supervisorId: input.supervisorId,
          deputyId: input.deputyId,
        },
      });
    } else {
      const existingAssignment = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findUnique({
        where: { teacherId },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      if (existingAssignment) {
        await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.update({
          where: { teacherId },
          data: { deputyId: input.deputyId },
        });
      } else {
        return failure(
          "اختر مشرفًا تربويًا — لا يمكن إنشاء إسناد بدون مشرف",
          "VALIDATION_ERROR",
          { supervisorId: "المشرف مطلوب لإنشاء الإسناد" }
        );
      }
    }

    revalidateTeacher(teacherId);
    return { ok: true, message: "تم حفظ بيانات المعلم" };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/** Secure temporary-password reset — the secret is returned ONCE. */
export async function adminResetPasswordAction(
  _prev: TeacherAdminActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<TeacherAdminActionState> {
  try {
    const actorContext = await adminActor();
    if (!actorContext) return failure("هذه العملية متاحة للإدارة فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    const teacherId = String(formData.get("teacherId") ?? "");
    if (!teacherId) return failure("بيانات ناقصة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    const result = await adminSetTemporaryPassword(actorContext, teacherId);
    if (!result.ok) return failure(result.message, result.code);
    revalidateTeacher(teacherId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      message:
        "تم تعيين كلمة مرور مؤقتة وإلغاء جميع جلسات الحساب — انسخها الآن، لن تُعرض مرة أخرى.",
      data: { temporaryPassword: result.data.temporaryPassword },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

/** Administrative email update (uniqueness + re-verification). */
export async function adminUpdateEmailAction(
  _prev: TeacherAdminActionState,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<TeacherAdminActionState> {
  try {
    const actorContext = await adminActor();
    if (!actorContext) return failure("هذه العملية متاحة للإدارة فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    const teacherId = String(formData.get("teacherId") ?? "");
    const newEmail = String(formData.get("newEmail") ?? "");
    if (!teacherId || !newEmail.trim()) {
      return failure("أدخل البريد الإلكتروني الجديد", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const result = await adminUpdateEmail(actorContext, teacherId, newEmail);
    if (!result.ok) {
      return failure(result.message, result.code, result.fieldErrors);
    }
    revalidateTeacher(teacherId);
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: result.data.verificationEmailSent
        ? `تم تحديث البريد إلى ${result.data.email} وأُرسلت رسالة توثيق — يجب توثيق البريد قبل الدخول.`
        : `تم تحديث البريد إلى ${result.data.email} — يجب توثيق البريد قبل الدخول (تعذر إرسال رسالة التوثيق الآن).`,
      data: {
        newEmail: result.data.email,
        verificationEmailSent: result.data.verificationEmailSent,
      },
    };
  } catch {
    return failure("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة", "UNKNOWN");
  }
}

export interface TrainingFormState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Returned by upload actions so the client can link the attachment. */
  attachmentId?: string;
  attachmentName?: string;
  courseId?: string;
}

function str(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  return String(formData.get(key) ?? "");
}

/** Select placeholders submit the sentinel "none" — map it to empty. */
function formValue(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const raw = str(formData, key);
  return raw === "none" ? "" : raw;
}

function checkbox(formData: FormData, key: string): boolean {
  const raw = formData.get(key);
  return raw === "on" || raw === "true" || raw === "1";
}

/** Extract a File entry (uploads) or null. */
function fileEntry(formData: FormData, key: string): File | null {
  const value = formData.get(key);
  return value instanceof File && value.size > 0 ? value : null;
}

function refreshTraining(courseId?: string) {
  revalidatePath("/");
  revalidatePath("/academy");
  revalidatePath("/academy/manage");
  revalidatePath("/academy/programs");
  if (courseId) {
    revalidatePath(`/academy/manage/${courseId}`);
    revalidatePath(`/academy/courses/${courseId}`);
  }
}

  formData: FormData
): Promise<TrainingFormState> {

  const result = await createProgram(

      nameEn: formValue(formData, "nameEn"),
      descriptionAr: str(formData, "descriptionAr"),

      category: formValue(formData, "category"),
      scope: formValue(formData, "scope") || "school",
      schoolId: formValue(formData, "schoolId"),

    ctx
  );
  if (result.ok) {
    refreshTraining();
    return { ok: true, message: "تم إنشاء البرنامج بنجاح — يبدأ كمسودة" };
  }
  return { ok: false, message: result.message, fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors };

export async function uploadCourseCoverAction(
  _prev: TrainingFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<TrainingFormState> {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();
  const file = fileEntry(formData, "file");
  if (!file) {
    return { ok: false, message: "اختر ملف صورة الغلاف أولًا" };
  }
  const ownerType = str(formData, "ownerType");
  const result = await uploadAttachment(
    ownerType === "program"
      ? { kind: "COVER", programId: str(formData, "ownerId"), file }
      : { kind: "COVER", courseId: str(formData, "ownerId"), file },
    ctx
  );
  if (result.ok) {
    refreshTraining(ownerType === "course" ? str(formData, "ownerId") : undefined);
    revalidatePath("/academy/programs");
    return { ok: true, message: "تم رفع صورة الغلاف", attachmentId: result.data.id };
  }
  return { ok: false, message: result.message };
}

  _prev: TrainingFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<TrainingFormState> {

  const file = fileEntry(formData, "file");
  if (!file) {
    return { ok: false, message: "اختر الملف أولًا" };

  const kind = str(formData, "kind") === "VIDEO" ? "VIDEO" : "RESOURCE";
  const result = await uploadAttachment(
    {

      lessonId: formValue(formData, "lessonId") || undefined,
      file,
    },
    ctx
  );
  if (result.ok) {
    refreshTraining(str(formData, "courseId"));
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: "تم رفع الملف بنجاح",
      attachmentId: result.data.id,
      attachmentName: result.data.originalName,
    };
  }
  return { ok: false, message: result.message };
}

  _prev: TrainingFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<TrainingFormState> {

  const result = await enrollTeacher(
    { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
    { courseId: str(formData, "courseId") }
  );
  if (result.ok) {
    revalidatePath("/academy");
    revalidatePath(`/academy/courses/${str(formData, "courseId")}`);
    return {
      ok: true,
      message: result.data.alreadyEnrolled
        ? "أنت مسجّل في هذه الدورة بالفعل"
        : "تم تسجيلك في الدورة — يمكنك البدء الآن",
    };
  }
  return { ok: false, message: result.message };
}

"use server";

import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  assignTeacherSupervisor,
  createStaffAccount,
  removeTeacherSupervisor,
  setDeputyScope,
  setSupervisorBranches,
  updateUserProfileByAdmin,
  updateOwnProfile,
} from "@/lib/users/directory";
import { setAccountActive } from "@/lib/users/service";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Phase 4 server actions — thin wrappers. Every authorization rule     */
/* lives in the service layer (src/lib/users/directory.ts + service.ts);*/
/* these functions only extract input, call the service and refresh the */
/* affected pages. Nothing security-relevant happens on the client.     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface UserFormState {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  emailSent?: boolean;
}

/** Derive the absolute app base URL from request headers. */
async function appBaseUrl(): Promise<string> {
  const h = await headers();
  const host = h.get("x-forwarded-host") ?? h.get("host") ?? "localhost:3000";
  const proto = h.get("x-forwarded-proto") ?? "http";
  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}

function refreshUserPaths(userId?: string) {
  revalidatePath("/users");
  revalidatePath("/");
  if (userId) revalidatePath(`/users/${userId}`);
}

/**
 * Select placeholders submit the sentinel "none" — map it to empty so
 * the optional-field validation treats it as "not chosen".
 */
function formValue(formData: FormData, key: string): string {
  const raw = String(formData.get(key) ?? "");
  return raw === "none" ? "" : raw;
}

/* ------------------------ Staff account creation ------------------- */

export async function createStaffAccountAction(
  _prevState: UserFormState | null,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<UserFormState> {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();

  const result = await createStaffAccount(
    {
      name: String(formData.get("name") ?? ""),
      email: String(formData.get("email") ?? ""),
      password: String(formData.get("password") ?? ""),
      role: String(formData.get("role") ?? ""),
      branchId: formValue(formData, "branchId"),
      schoolId: formValue(formData, "schoolId"),
    },
    ctx,
    { appBaseUrl: await appBaseUrl() }
  );

  if (result.ok) {
    refreshUserPaths(result.data.id);
    return {
      ok: true,
      emailSent: result.data.emailSent,
      message: result.data.emailSent
        ? `تم إنشاء حساب ${result.data.name} — أُرسل رابط تأكيد البريد إلى ${result.data.email}`

    };

    ok: false,
    message: result.message,
    fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors,
  };
}

/**
 * Phase 7 — authenticated download endpoint for submission attachments.
 *
 * Access is decided SERVER-SIDE per request:
 *   - the owning teacher,
 *   - the school's development-office manager,
 *   - an educational supervisor whose persisted TeacherSupervisorAssignment
 *     covers this exact teacher (same school).
 * Deputies get summaries only — no file access. Anonymous requests get 401.
 */
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { readSubmissionObject } from "@/lib/assignments/storage";

export async function GET(
  _request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
): Promise<Response> {
  const { id } = await params;

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return new Response("غير مصرّح", { status: 401 });
  }

  const file = await db.submissionFile.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: {
      submission: {
        select: {
          teacherId: true,
          schoolId: true,
          assignment: { select: { id: true, titleAr: true } },
        },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!file) {
    return new Response("المرفق غير موجود", { status: 404 });
  }

  const submission = file.submission;
  let allowed = user.id === submission.teacherId;

  if (!allowed && user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" && user.schoolId === submission.schoolId) {
    allowed = true;
  }

  if (!allowed && user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" && user.schoolId === submission.schoolId) {
    const link = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findUnique({
      where: { teacherId: submission.teacherId },
      select: { supervisorId: true, schoolId: true },
    });
    allowed = link?.supervisorId === user.id && link.schoolId === user.schoolId;
  }

  if (!allowed) {
    return new Response("لا تملك صلاحية الاطلاع على هذا المرفق", { status: 403 });
  }

  let bytes: Buffer;
  try {
    bytes = await readSubmissionObject(file.storageKey);
  } catch {
    return new Response("تعذر قراءة الملف المخزّن", { status: 500 });
  }

  const encodedName = encodeURIComponent(file.fileName);
  return new Response(new Uint8Array(bytes), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": file.mimeType,
      "Content-Length": String(bytes.length),
      "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="submission-file"; filename*=UTF-8''${encodedName}`,
      "Cache-Control": "private, no-store",
    },
  });
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\app\api\cron\dispatch\route.ts

/**
 * Phase 11 — secured scheduled-job trigger: POST|GET /api/cron/dispatch
 *
 * Production scheduling contract (documented in docs/notifications.md):
 *   - An EXTERNAL scheduler (system crontab, Vercel Cron, GitHub Actions,
 *     Cloud Scheduler…) calls this endpoint every minute (or any interval)
 *     with the shared secret.
 *   - Secret is supplied via `x-cron-secret` header OR
 *     `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`; compared in constant time.
 *     (Phase 12: the URL query-parameter channel was REMOVED — secrets in
 *     URLs leak into access logs and browser history.)
 *   - If CRON_SECRET is not configured the endpoint responds 503 and runs
 *     NOTHING — it never silently processes unauthenticated work.
 *   - Phase 12: any step that THROWS turns the response into HTTP 500
 *     (body still carries the honest per-step report) so status-code
 *     based monitoring can alert; handled per-item delivery failures
 *     remain a 200 with their counts — they are tracked in EmailDelivery
 *     and visible in /integrations.
 *
 * Per tick (each step reports honestly and independently):
 *   1. Assignment-deadline reminder scan (idempotent per UTC day).
 *   2. Course-completion scan (idempotent per teacher+course lifetime).
 *   3. Email outbox dispatch (bounded retries, no provider → honest no-op).
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { safeSecretEquals } from "@/lib/auth/tokens";
import { scanAssignmentDeadlineReminders, scanCourseCompletions } from "@/lib/notifications/reminders";
import { processEmailOutbox } from "@/lib/notifications/dispatcher";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function unauthorized() {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { ok: false, error: "UNAUTHORIZED", message: "سر المجدول غير صحيح أو مفقود" },
    { status: 401 },
  );
}

async function handle(request: Request) {
  const secret = (process.env.CRON_SECRET ?? "").trim();
  if (!secret) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: "CRON_NOT_CONFIGURED",
        message:
          "لم يتم ضبط CRON_SECRET على هذا النشر — نقطة المجدول معطّلة عمدًا وتشغيل المهام غير مسموح بدون مصادقة",
      },
      { status: 503 },
    );
  }

  const provided =
    request.headers.get("x-cron-secret")?.trim() ||
    (request.headers.get("authorization") ?? "").replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, "").trim() ||
    "";
  if (!provided || !safeSecretEquals(provided, secret)) return unauthorized();

  const startedAt = new Date();
  const errors: string[] = [];

  let deadlineScan: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scanAssignmentDeadlineReminders>> | null = null;
  let courseScan: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof scanCourseCompletions>> | null = null;
  let dispatch: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof processEmailOutbox>> | null = null;

  try {
    deadlineScan = await scanAssignmentDeadlineReminders();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push("deadline-scan");
    console.error("[cron] deadline scan failed:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  }
  try {
    courseScan = await scanCourseCompletions();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push("course-scan");
    console.error("[cron] course scan failed:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  }
  try {
    dispatch = await processEmailOutbox();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push("email-dispatch");
    console.error("[cron] email dispatch failed:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
  }

  const failed = errors.length > 0;
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      ok: !failed,
      ranAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
      deadlineScan,
      courseScan,
      dispatch,
      ...(failed ? { errors } : {}),
    },
    // 500 keeps status-code monitoring honest: a thrown step is a real
    // infrastructure failure, not a normal empty tick.
    { status: failed ? 500 : 200 }
  );
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  return handle(request);
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  return handle(request);
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\app\api\files\[id]\route.ts

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { canAccessAttachment } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { getAttachmentForAccess } from "@/lib/training/content";
import { getStorage } from "@/lib/storage";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Authenticated attachment delivery.                                   */
/*                                                                      */
/* Files stored by the academy never live under /public — every byte    */
/* passes through this route, which re-checks session + school scope +  */
/* publication status on EVERY request. Supports HTTP Range requests    */
/* so uploaded videos can seek in the browser player.                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function GET(
  request: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const { id } = await params;

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return new NextResponse("Unauthorized", { status: 401 });
  }

  const attachment = await getAttachmentForAccess(id);
  if (!attachment) {
    return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 });
  }

  const allowed = canAccessAttachment(
    { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
    { courseId: attachment.courseId, programId: attachment.programId },
    attachment.courseId ? attachment.course : null,
    attachment.programId ? attachment.program : null
  );
  if (!allowed) {
    return new NextResponse("Forbidden", { status: 403 });
  }

  const data = await getStorage().get(attachment.storageKey);
  if (!data) {
    // The metadata row exists but the file is gone from the backend —
    // report honestly instead of pretending.
    return new NextResponse("File unavailable", { status: 404 });
  }

  const total = data.byteLength;

  /** BodyInit wants a concrete ArrayBuffer in this TS lib — copy once. */
  function toBody(bytes: Uint8Array): ArrayBuffer {
    const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(bytes.byteLength);
    new Uint8Array(buffer).set(bytes);
    return buffer;
  }

  const contentType = attachment.mimeType || "application/octet-stream";
  const baseHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    "Content-Type": contentType,
    "Content-Disposition": `inline; filename*=UTF-8''${encodeURIComponent(
      attachment.originalName
    )}`,
    "Accept-Ranges": "bytes",
    "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=300",
  };

  const rangeHeader = request.headers.get("range");
  if (rangeHeader) {
    const match = /^bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$/.exec(rangeHeader.trim());
    if (match) {
      let start = match[1] === "" ? undefined : Number.parseInt(match[1], 10);
      let end = match[2] === "" ? undefined : Number.parseInt(match[2], 10);

      // Suffix range: bytes=-N (last N bytes).
      if (start === undefined && end !== undefined) {
        start = Math.max(0, total - end);
        end = total - 1;
      }
      if (start === undefined) start = 0;
      if (end === undefined || end >= total) end = total - 1;

      if (Number.isNaN(start) || Number.isNaN(end) || start > end || start >= total) {
        return new NextResponse(null, {
          status: 416,
          headers: { "Content-Range": `bytes */${total}` },
        });
      }

      const chunk = data.slice(start, end + 1);
      return new NextResponse(toBody(chunk), {
        status: 206,
        headers: {
          ...baseHeaders,
          "Content-Range": `bytes ${start}-${end}/${total}`,
          "Content-Length": String(chunk.byteLength),
        },
      });
    }
  }

  return new NextResponse(toBody(data), {
    status: 200,
    headers: { ...baseHeaders, "Content-Length": String(total) },
  });
}
