/**
 * Phase 12 — public health check: GET /api/health
 *
 * Minimal, honest, secret-free. Returns 200 only when the database
 * answers; 503 otherwise so uptime monitors can alert. Email/scheduler
 * are reported as deployment FACTS (configured / not configured) — they
 * degrade gracefully elsewhere and are never a failure of this probe.
 *
 * No credentials, no masked emails, no queue contents — safe to expose.
 */

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getPlatformIntegrationStatus } from "@/lib/integrations/status";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  let database: "up" | "down" = "down";
  try {
    await db.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
    database = "up";
  } catch {
    database = "down";
  }

  // Global, non-sensitive deployment facts (same projections the
  // /integrations page uses — no key material, no recipients).
  let email: "configured" | "unconfigured" = "unconfigured";
  let scheduler: "external" | "internal-fallback" | "none" = "none";
  try {
    const status = getPlatformIntegrationStatus();
    email = status.email.configured ? "configured" : "unconfigured";
    scheduler = status.scheduler.internalSchedulerEnabled
      ? "internal-fallback"
      : status.scheduler.cronSecretConfigured
        ? "external"
        : "none";
  } catch {
    // Status introspection must never break the health probe itself.
  }

  const ok = database === "up";
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      ok,
      service: "manarat-qurtubah-platform",
      time: new Date().toISOString(),
      latencyMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
      checks: { database, email, scheduler },
    },
    { status: ok ? 200 : 503, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
  );
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\app\api\media\[...key]\route.ts

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Private media proxy — GET /api/media/<key…>                          */
/*                                                                      */
/* Used when R2_PUBLIC_URL is NOT configured: stored URLs point here    */
/* and this route 302-redirects authorized, signed-in users to a short- */
/* lived presigned GET on the bucket. The bucket itself stays fully     */
/* private — no public object access is ever required.                  */
/*                                                                      */
/* When R2_PUBLIC_URL IS configured, uploaded URLs point straight at    */
/* the public base and this route simply is not used for them.          */
/*                                                                      */
/* Mandatory learning enforcement: the attachment is resolved back to   */
/* its owning course/lesson and the request is rejected unless the      */
/* viewer may access that content — including the sequential lesson     */
/* lock, so locked lesson media cannot be pulled by URL manipulation.   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  PRESIGN_GET_EXPIRES_SECONDS,
  readR2Config,
} from "@/lib/media/config";
import {
  headObject,
  MediaStorageError,
  presignedGetUrl,
} from "@/lib/media/r2";
import {
  canAccessAttachment,
  type ViewerIdentity,
} from "@/lib/training/access";
import { assertLessonPlayable } from "@/lib/training/sequence";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function jsonError(status: number, message: string) {
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, message }, { status });
}

export async function GET(
  _request: NextRequest,
  context: { params: Promise<{ key: string[] }> }
) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || !user.isActive) {
    return jsonError(401, "يجب تسجيل الدخول لعرض الملفات.");
  }
  const viewer: ViewerIdentity = {
    id: user.id,
    role: user.role,
    schoolId: user.schoolId,
  };

  const { key: segments } = await context.params;
  if (!segments || segments.length === 0) {
    return jsonError(400, "مسار ملف غير صالح.");
  }

  let key: string;
  try {
    key = segments.map((segment) => decodeURIComponent(segment)).join("/");
  } catch {
    return jsonError(400, "مسار ملف غير صالح.");
  }

  // Path traversal + scope guard: only well-formed media/… keys.
  if (!key.startsWith("media/") || key.includes("..") || key.includes("\\")) {
    return jsonError(400, "مسار ملف غير صالح.");
  }

  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) {
    return jsonError(
      503,
      "خدمة التخزين غير مُهيأة على الخادم — أضف متغيرات Cloudflare R2."
    );
  }

  // Content-level authorization: resolve the object back to its owning
  // attachment (storage keys are server-generated, so this map is
  // authoritative), then enforce course/program visibility AND the
  // sequential lesson lock for lesson-bound media.
  const attachment = await db.attachment.findUnique({
    where: { storageKey: key },
    select: { lessonId: true, courseId: true, programId: true },
  });
  if (attachment) {
    let scopeOk = viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN";
    if (!scopeOk) {
      if (attachment.courseId) {
        const course = await db.course.findUnique({
          where: { id: attachment.courseId },
          select: { status: true, schoolId: true },
        });
        scopeOk = canAccessAttachment(
          viewer,
          { courseId: attachment.courseId, programId: null },
          course,
          null
        );
      } else if (attachment.programId) {
        const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
          where: { id: attachment.programId },
          select: { status: true, schoolId: true },
        });
        scopeOk = canAccessAttachment(
          viewer,
          { courseId: null, programId: attachment.programId },
          null,
          program
        );
      }
    }
    if (!scopeOk) {
      return jsonError(403, "هذا الملف تابع لمحتوى غير متاح لك.");
    }

    if (attachment.lessonId) {
      const lesson = await db.courseLesson.findUnique({
        where: { id: attachment.lessonId },
        select: { section: { select: { courseId: true } } },
      });
      const courseId = lesson?.section.courseId ?? attachment.courseId;
      if (courseId) {
        const gate = await assertLessonPlayable(viewer, courseId, attachment.lessonId);
        if (!gate.ok) {
          return jsonError(403, gate.message);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    const info = await headObject(key);
    if (!info) return jsonError(404, "الملف غير موجود.");

    const signed = await presignedGetUrl(key);
    return NextResponse.redirect(signed, {
      status: 302,
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=60",
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof MediaStorageError && error.code === "OBJECT_NOT_FOUND") {
      return jsonError(404, "الملف غير موجود.");
    }
    return jsonError(502, "تعذر الوصول إلى التخزين — حاول لاحقًا.");
  }
}

  _request: Request,
  context: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, message: "الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد" },

  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, data: { changed: result.changed } });
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\app\api\notifications\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  listNotifications,
  markAllNotificationsRead,
  markNotificationRead,
  unreadCount,
} from "@/lib/notifications/center";

/**
 * Batch 1 — notifications API for the topbar bell.
 *
 * GET  -> the owner's latest notifications + unread count (session-scoped).
 * POST -> { action: "markAll" } or { action: "markRead", id } — the owner
 *         column is enforced server-side on every write.
 */

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function relativeTime(date: Date): string {
  const seconds = Math.max(1, Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 1000));
  if (seconds < 60) return "الآن";
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `قبل ${minutes} دقيقة`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `قبل ${hours} ساعة`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  if (days < 30) return `قبل ${days} يوم`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("ar-SA");
}

export async function GET() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "UNAUTHENTICATED" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const [items, unread] = await Promise.all([
    listNotifications(user.id),
    unreadCount(user.id),
  ]);

  return NextResponse.json({
    unread,
    items: items.map((notification) => ({
      id: notification.id,
      title: notification.titleAr,
      description: notification.bodyAr,
      time: relativeTime(notification.createdAt),
      read: notification.readAt !== null,
      url: notification.destinationUrl,
    })),
  });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "UNAUTHENTICATED" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  let payload: { action?: string; id?: string };
  try {
    payload = (await request.json()) as { action?: string; id?: string };
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "INVALID_BODY" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (payload.action === "markAll") {
    const updated = await markAllNotificationsRead(user.id);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, updated });
  }

  if (payload.action === "markRead" && payload.id) {
    const ok = await markNotificationRead(user.id, payload.id);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ error: "UNKNOWN_ACTION" }, { status: 400 });
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — authenticated report export endpoint.
 *
 * GET /api/reports/[reportId]/export?format=csv|xls&schoolId=...&dateFrom=...
 *
 * Security:
 *   • Session-resolved actor only; anonymous requests get 401.
 *   • The SAME filter validation and report builder as the preview page
 *     run here — exports can never widen a user's data scope.
 *   • Failures return explicit error responses; a broken export NEVER
 *     silently degrades to an empty file.
 */
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { canExportReports, toAnalyticsActor } from "@/lib/analytics/access";
import { buildReport, parseReportFilters } from "@/lib/reports/service";
import { buildReportCsv, buildReportExcelXml, contentDispositionFor } from "@/lib/reports/export";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(
  request: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ reportId: string }> }
): Promise<Response> {
  const { reportId } = await params;

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "غير مصرّح — سجّل الدخول من جديد" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  const actor = toAnalyticsActor(user);
  if (!actor || !canExportReports(actor.role)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "تصدير التقارير متاح للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية والإدارة العامة فقط" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const format = (url.searchParams.get("format") ?? "csv").toLowerCase();
  if (format !== "csv" && format !== "xls") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "صيغة التصدير غير مدعومة — الصيغ المتاحة: csv و xls" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const filtersResult = await parseReportFilters(actor, Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries()));
  if (!filtersResult.ok) {
    const status = filtersResult.code === "VALIDATION_ERROR" ? 400 : filtersResult.code === "NOT_FOUND" ? 404 : 403;
    return NextResponse.json({ error: filtersResult.message }, { status });
  }

  const report = await buildReport(actor, reportId, filtersResult.data);
  if (!report.ok) {
    const status = report.code === "VALIDATION_ERROR" ? 400 : report.code === "NOT_FOUND" ? 404 : 403;
    return NextResponse.json({ error: report.message }, { status });
  }

  try {
    if (format === "csv") {
      const body = buildReportCsv(report.data);
      return new Response(body, {
        status: 200,
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
          "Content-Disposition": contentDispositionFor(report.data.meta.titleAr, "csv"),
          "Cache-Control": "no-store",
        },
      });
    }
    const body = buildReportExcelXml(report.data);
    return new Response(body, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/vnd.ms-excel; charset=utf-8",
        "Content-Disposition": contentDispositionFor(report.data.meta.titleAr, "xls"),
        "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // Explicit failure — never an empty/fake download.
    console.error("[reports/export] generation failed", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "فشل توليد ملف التصدير — حاول مرة أخرى أو راجع سجل الخادم" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\app\api\reports\export\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  buildAccountsReport,
  buildBundleReport,
  buildCoursesReport,
  buildSupervisorAnalytics,
  buildTeachersReport,
  buildTrainingReport,
  type ReportActor,
} from "@/lib/reports/datasets";
import { downloadHeaders } from "@/lib/reports/csv";

/**
 * Batch 2 — real-data report exports (CSV/JSON downloads).
 *
 * GET /api/reports/export?type=<type>[&format=json]
 *
 * Types (original HTML file names preserved):
 *   training   -> Qurtuba_Training_Report.csv
 *   teachers   -> Qurtuba_Teachers.csv
 *   courses    -> Qurtuba_Courses.csv
 *   supervisor -> Qurtuba_Supervisor_Teachers_Analytics.csv (supervisor scope)
 *   accounts   -> Qurtuba_User_Accounts.csv (WITHOUT passwords — hardened)
 *   bundle     -> Qurtuba_Manara_Report.json (format=json forced)
 *
 * Tenant rules: the office manager AND the school manager are ALWAYS
 * confined to their own school (session-derived scope; a manager with
 * no school binding gets an explicit 403 — fail-closed); the supervisor
 * gets only its own scope analytics; SUPER_ADMIN covers the platform
 * (and passes an optional schoolId filter).
 */

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const VALID_TYPES = ["training", "teachers", "courses", "supervisor", "accounts", "bundle"] as const;
type ReportType = (typeof VALID_TYPES)[number];

function isReportType(value: string): value is ReportType {
  return (VALID_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "UNAUTHENTICATED" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const url = new URL(request.url);
  const type = url.searchParams.get("type") ?? "";
  if (!isReportType(type)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "UNKNOWN_REPORT_TYPE" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (
    user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" &&
    user.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    user.role !== "SCHOOL_MANAGER" &&
    user.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "FORBIDDEN" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  // Fail-closed: a school-scoped manager WITHOUT a school binding gets
  // an explicit 403 — never an empty-scoped actor.
  if (
    (user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || user.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER") &&
    !user.schoolId
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "FORBIDDEN" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const actor: ReportActor =
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? { role: "SUPER_ADMIN", id: user.id, schoolId: user.schoolId }
      : user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
        ? { role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", id: user.id, schoolId: user.schoolId }
        : {
            // DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER | SCHOOL_MANAGER — النطاق يأتي
            // من الجلسة (الحساب غير المرتبط بمدرسة رُفض أعلاه).
            role: user.role as "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" | "SCHOOL_MANAGER",
            id: user.id,
            schoolId: user.schoolId as string,
          };

  try {
    if (type === "supervisor") {
      if (actor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" && actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "FORBIDDEN" }, { status: 403 });
      }
      const report = await buildSupervisorAnalytics({
        role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
        id: user.id,
        schoolId: user.schoolId,
      });
      return new NextResponse(report.body, {
        headers: downloadHeaders(report.filename, report.mime),
      });
    }

    if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "FORBIDDEN" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    let file;
    switch (type) {
      case "training":
        file = await buildTrainingReport(actor);
        break;
      case "teachers":
        file = await buildTeachersReport(actor);
        break;
      case "courses":
        file = await buildCoursesReport(actor);
        break;
      case "accounts":
        file = await buildAccountsReport(actor);
        break;
      case "bundle":
        file = await buildBundleReport(actor);
        break;
      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "UNKNOWN_REPORT_TYPE" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    return new NextResponse(file.body, {
      headers: downloadHeaders(file.filename, file.mime),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[reports/export] failed", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "REPORT_FAILED" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 10 — archive/restore action forms (client). Each button posts
 * a server action whose actor comes from the session; failures surface
 * the service's Arabic message verbatim.
 */
import { useActionState } from "react";

import {
  archiveFollowUpAction,
  restoreAssignmentAction,
  restoreAssessmentAction,
  restoreCourseAction,
  restoreFollowUpAction,
  restoreProgramAction,
  type ArchiveActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/archive";

const initialState: ArchiveActionState = { ok: false };

function ActionButton({
  action,
  idField,
  id,
  label,
  tone = "brand",
}: {
  action: (prev: ArchiveActionState, formData: FormData) => Promise<ArchiveActionState>;
  idField: string;
  id: string;
  label: string;
  tone?: "brand" | "outline" | "danger";
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(action, initialState);
  const toneClasses =
    tone === "brand"
      ? "bg-[#1D5BD6] text-white hover:bg-[#174bb3]"
      : tone === "danger"
        ? "border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-100"
        : "border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-100";
  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="inline-flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
      <input type="hidden" name={idField} value={id} />
      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
        className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-60 ${toneClasses}`}
      >
        {pending ? "جارٍ التنفيذ…" : label}
      </button>
      {state.message ? (
        <p className={`text-[11px] ${state.ok ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-red-600"}`}>{state.message}</p>
      ) : null}
    </form>
  );
}

export function ArchiveFollowUpButton({ followUpId }: { followUpId: string }) {
  return (
    <ActionButton
      action={archiveFollowUpAction}
      idField="followUpId"
      id={followUpId}
      label="أرشفة السجل"
      tone="danger"
    />
  );
}

export function RestoreFollowUpButton({ followUpId }: { followUpId: string }) {
  return (
    <ActionButton
      action={restoreFollowUpAction}
      idField="followUpId"
      id={followUpId}
      label="استعادة"
      tone="outline"
    />
  );
}

    />
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — الأرشيف: unified archive center.
 *
 * Shows archived records per entity type (scoped by role), the
 * append-only archive audit trail, and — for follow-ups, the only
 * entity without a prior archive mechanism — the archiving action.
 * Content entities (programs/courses/assessments/assignments) keep
 * their existing phase-managed archive transitions; this center adds
 * their missing RESTORE paths. Survey archiving keeps its Phase 9
 * lifecycle action (ARCHIVED is terminal there by design).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";

import {
  listArchivableFollowUps,

} from "@/lib/archive/service";

  type ArchiveEntityType,
} from "@/config/analytics";

const TAB_TYPES: (ArchiveEntityType | null)[] = [
  null,
  "PROGRAM",
  "COURSE",
  "ASSESSMENT",
  "ASSIGNMENT",
  "SURVEY",
  "FOLLOW_UP",
];

function formatDateTime(date: Date | null): string {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(date);
}

export default async function ArchivePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const rawQuery = await searchParams;
  const rawType = Array.isArray(rawQuery.type) ? rawQuery.type[0] : rawQuery.type;
  const entityType = TAB_TYPES.includes((rawType ?? null) as ArchiveEntityType | null)
    ? ((rawType ?? null) as ArchiveEntityType | null)
    : null;

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const actor = toAnalyticsActor(user);
  if (!actor || !canViewArchive(actor.role)) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="مركز الأرشيف متاح للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية والإدارة العامة فقط." />;
  }

  const [archiveResult, eventsResult, archivableResult] = await Promise.all([
    listArchivedRecords(actor, entityType, 1),
    listArchiveEvents(actor),
    canOperateArchiveLocal(actor) ? listArchivableFollowUps(actor) : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);

  const canOperate = canOperateArchiveLocal(actor);
  const scopeNote =
    actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? "عرض الأرشيف العام على مستوى المنصة (المحتوى غير المرتبط بمدرسة) — للقراءة فقط"
      : actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
        ? "عرض للقراءة فقط ضمن نطاق التفويض"
        : actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
          ? "سجلات المتابعة والاستبيانات ضمن نطاق إشرافك"
          : "أرشيف مدرستك";

    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="الأرشيف — السجلات المؤرشفة"
        subtitle={`حفظ آمن للسجلات المغلقة دون حذف — كل سجل يحتفظ بعلاقاته وتاريخه. ${scopeNote}`}
      />

      <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {TAB_TYPES.map((type) => (
          <Link
            key={type ?? "all"}
            href={`/archive${type ? `?type=${type}` : ""}`}
            className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
              entityType === type
                ? "border-[#1D5BD6] bg-[#1D5BD6] text-white"
                : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-[#1D5BD6]"
            }`}
          >
            {type === null ? "الكل" : ARCHIVE_ENTITY_LABELS[type]}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>

        <AccessDenied hint={archiveResult.message} />
      ) : (
        <Card title={`السجلات المؤرشفة (${archiveResult.data.total})`}>
          {archiveResult.data.rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              title="لا توجد سجلات مؤرشفة في هذا النطاق"
              hint="الأرشفة تحدث من صفحات السجلات نفسها (تكليف/استبيان) أو من نموذج أرشفة المتابعات أدناه."
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">النوع</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">السجل</th>

                      <td className="px-3 py-2">

                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>

function canOperateArchiveLocal(actor: { role: string }): boolean {
  return actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR";
}

function RestoreControls({ entityType, entityId }: { entityType: ArchiveEntityType; entityId: string }) {
  switch (entityType) {
    case "FOLLOW_UP":
      return <RestoreFollowUpButton followUpId={entityId} />;
    case "ASSIGNMENT":
      return <RestoreAssignmentButton assignmentId={entityId} />;
    case "COURSE":
      return <RestoreCourseButton courseId={entityId} />;
    case "PROGRAM":
      return <RestoreProgramButton programId={entityId} />;
    case "ASSESSMENT":
      return <RestoreAssessmentButton assessmentId={entityId} />;
    case "SURVEY":
      return <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">نهائي — النتائج محفوظة</span>;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { TakeAssessment } from "@/components/assessments/take-assessment";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getAssessmentForTaking } from "@/lib/assessment/service";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export const metadata = {
  title: "أداء الاختبار",
};

/**
 * The live attempt screen. Guards (server-side): signed-in owner with an
 * IN_PROGRESS attempt for a PUBLISHED assessment — otherwise the teacher
 * is bounced to the honest state on the detail page. No answer keys are
 * ever loaded into this view.
 */
export default async function TakeAssessmentPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { id } = await params;
  const viewer = { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const detail = await getAssessmentForTaking(viewer, id);
  if (!detail.ok) {
    if (detail.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    redirect(`/assessments/${id}`);
  }
  const { activeAttempt } = detail.data;
  if (!activeAttempt) {
    redirect(`/assessments/${id}`);
  }

  // Load the attempt WITH its assessment + questions — the teacher's own
  // IN_PROGRESS attempt only (ownership checked again here).
  const attempt = await db.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
    where: { id: activeAttempt.id },
    include: {
      assessment: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          titleEn: true,
          instructionsAr: true,
          instructionsEn: true,
          timeLimitMinutes: true,
          maxScore: true,
          passingScore: true,
          status: true,
          questions: {
            orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
            select: {
              id: true,
              type: true,
              textAr: true,
              textEn: true,
              points: true,
              isRequired: true,
              optionsJson: true,
              // answerKeyJson + explanation are DELIBERATELY omitted —
              // they must never reach the browser before submission.
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (
    !attempt ||
    attempt.userId !== user.id ||
    attempt.status !== "IN_PROGRESS" ||
    attempt.assessment.status !== "PUBLISHED"
  ) {
    redirect(`/assessments/${id}`);
  }

  const savedAnswers = attempt.answersJson
    ? (JSON.parse(attempt.answersJson) as { questionId: string }[])
    : [];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={attempt.assessment.titleAr}
        description="أجب عن الأسئلة ثم راجع إجاباتك قبل التسليم النهائي."
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الاختبارات والتقييم", href: "/assessments" },
          { label: attempt.assessment.titleAr, href: `/assessments/${id}` },
          { label: "أداء الاختبار" },
        ]}
      />

      <TakeAssessment
        view={{
          attempt: {
            id: attempt.id,
            startedAt: attempt.startedAt,
            deadlineAt: attempt.deadlineAt,
            assessmentId: attempt.assessment.id,
          },
          assessment: {
            id: attempt.assessment.id,
            titleAr: attempt.assessment.titleAr,
            titleEn: attempt.assessment.titleEn,
            instructionsAr: attempt.assessment.instructionsAr,
            instructionsEn: attempt.assessment.instructionsEn,
            timeLimitMinutes: attempt.assessment.timeLimitMinutes,
            maxScore: attempt.assessment.maxScore,
            passingScore: attempt.assessment.passingScore,
          },
          questions: attempt.assessment.questions.map((question) => ({
            id: question.id,
            type: question.type,
            textAr: question.textAr,
            textEn: question.textEn,
            points: question.points,
            isRequired: question.isRequired,
            options: question.optionsJson
              ? (JSON.parse(question.optionsJson) as { id: string; textAr: string }[])
              : [],
          })),
          savedAnswers,
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Attempt result for the OWNER only (service enforces it). Correct
 * answers + explanations are revealed after submission; short-answer
 * questions show their explicit awaiting-review state until the
 * manager's review finalizes the grade.
 */
export default async function AttemptResultPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ attemptId: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { attemptId } = await params;

  const result = await getAttemptResult(
    { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
    attemptId
  );
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title="نتيجة المحاولة"

        />

          role="alert"

        >
          {result.message}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { attempt, assessment, breakdown } = result.data;
  const revealed = attempt.status !== "EXPIRED";

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={`نتيجة محاولتك — ${assessment.titleAr}`}
        description="تفصيل درجاتك لكل سؤال مع التغذية الراجعة."
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الاختبارات والتقييم", href: "/assessments" },
          { label: assessment.titleAr, href: `/assessments/${assessment.id}` },
          { label: "النتيجة" },
        ]}
        meta={
          <StatusBadge tone={attemptStatusTone(attempt.status)}>
            {attemptStatusLabel(attempt.status)}
          </StatusBadge>
        }
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        {/* Score summary */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-3.5">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">
              <Target className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
              الدرجة
            </span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-lg font-extrabold tabular-nums">

                ? "—"
                : attempt.earnedScore === null
                  ? "بانتظار المراجعة"
                  : `${attempt.earnedScore} / ${attempt.maxScore}`}
            </span>

            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">النسبة</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-lg font-extrabold tabular-nums">
              {attempt.percentage === null ? "—" : `${attempt.percentage}%`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-3.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">درجة النجاح</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-lg font-extrabold tabular-nums">
              {assessment.passingScore}
            </span>

              التسليم
            </span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-xs font-bold">
              {attempt.submittedAt
                ? dateFormatter.format(attempt.submittedAt)
                : attempt.status === "EXPIRED"
                  ? "انتهى الوقت دون تسليم"
                  : "—"}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {attempt.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW" && (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/40 bg-warning-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-warning">
            أسئلة الإجابة القصيرة في محاولتك تُراجع يدويًا — ستُعتمد النتيجة النهائية بعد
            اطلاع المشرف عليها.
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Per-question breakdown */}
        <SectionCard
          title="تفصيل الأسئلة"

              : "المحاولة انتهت بالوقت دون تسليم — تُعرض إجاباتك المحفوظة فقط دون المفاتيح."
          }
        >
          <ol className="space-y-4" role="list">

                  </p>

                    {item.points} نقاط · {questionTypeLabel(item.type)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Your answer */}
                <div className="mt-2 text-xs">
                  <span className="font-bold text-muted-foreground">إجابتك: </span>

                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">— بدون إجابة —</span>
                  ) : item.yourAnswer.optionTexts.length > 0 ? (
                    <span className="font-semibold">{item.yourAnswer.optionTexts.join("، ")}</span>
                  ) : item.yourAnswer.bool !== null ? (
                    <span className="font-semibold">
                      {item.yourAnswer.bool ? TRUE_FALSE_LABELS.true : TRUE_FALSE_LABELS.false}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="font-semibold whitespace-pre-wrap">
                      {item.yourAnswer.text || "— نص فارغ —"}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Correct answer + points (after submission) */}
                {revealed && item.correct && (
                  <div className="mt-2 space-y-1 text-xs">
                    <span className="font-bold text-muted-foreground">الإجابة الصحيحة: </span>
                    {item.correct.optionTexts.length > 0 ? (
                      <span className="font-semibold text-success">
                        {item.correct.optionTexts.join("، ")}
                      </span>
                    ) : item.correct.bool !== null ? (
                      <span className="font-semibold text-success">
                        {item.correct.bool ? TRUE_FALSE_LABELS.true : TRUE_FALSE_LABELS.false}
                      </span>
                    ) : item.correct.modelAnswer ? (
                      <span className="font-semibold text-success whitespace-pre-wrap">
                        {item.correct.modelAnswer}
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">تُحدَّد في المراجعة اليدوية</span>
                    )}

                    <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                      {item.isCorrect === true && (
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-success">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          إجابة صحيحة
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {item.isCorrect === false && (
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-error">
                          <XCircle className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          إجابة غير صحيحة
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                        النقاط:{" "}
                        {item.type === "SHORT_ANSWER"
                          ? item.earnedPoints === null
                            ? "بانتظار المراجعة"
                            : item.earnedPoints
                          : item.earnedPoints ?? 0}
                        {" / "}
                        {item.points}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {item.explanation && (
                  <p className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-info-soft px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-info">
                    <Circle className="mt-0.5 size-2 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                    {item.explanation}
                  </p>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        </SectionCard>

        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <Link
            href="/assessments"
            className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-700 hover:underline"
          >
            قائمة الاختبارات
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={`/assessments/${assessment.id}`}
            className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:underline"
          >
            صفحة الاختبار
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function AssessmentEditorPage({

                          (key && "optionIds" in key && key.optionIds.includes(option.id));
                        return (

                          </li>
                        );
                      })}

                  )}

        >
          {attempts.length === 0 ? (

              className="border-0 bg-transparent"
            />
          ) : (
            <ul className="space-y-3" role="list">

                      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
                        {attempt.userName}

                          {attempt.earnedScore ?? attempt.objectiveScore}/

                        </span>
                      )}
                      {attempt.submittedAt && (
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {dateFormatter.format(attempt.submittedAt)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                  {attempt.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW" &&
                    attempt.shortAnswers.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="mt-3 border-t pt-3">
                        <AttemptReviewForm
                          attemptId={attempt.id}
                          shortAnswers={attempt.shortAnswers}
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </SectionCard>

        <div>
          <Link
            href="/assessments/manage"
            className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-700 hover:underline"

            العودة إلى قائمة الاختبارات
          </Link>

/* --------------------- Read-only results list ---------------------- */

function ReadOnlyResults({
  result,
}: {
  result: AssessmentResult<ReadOnlyAttemptRow[]>;
}) {
  if (!result.ok) {
    return (
      <div role="alert" className="text-sm font-semibold text-destructive">
        {result.message}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (result.data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={ClipboardCheck}
        title="لا توجد نتائج في نطاقك بعد"
        description="ستظهر نتائج المحاولات المكتملة هنا فور تسليمها."
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-start text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b bg-muted/40 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-start font-bold">المعلم</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-start font-bold">الاختبار</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-start font-bold">الحالة</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-start font-bold">النتيجة</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-start font-bold">التسليم</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y">
            {result.data.map((attempt) => (
              <tr key={attempt.id} className="transition-colors hover:bg-muted/20">
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold">{attempt.teacherName}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs">{attempt.assessmentTitle}</td>
                <td>
                  <StatusBadge tone={attemptStatusTone(attempt.status)}>
                    {attemptStatusLabel(attempt.status)}
                  </StatusBadge>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs tabular-nums">
                  {attempt.earnedScore === null
                    ? "—"
                    : `${attempt.earnedScore}/${attempt.maxScore} (${attempt.percentage}%)`}
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {attempt.submittedAt ? dateFormatter.format(attempt.submittedAt) : "—"}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 7 — edit an assignment (office manager). DRAFT rows get a full
 * edit (audience/content/rubric); PUBLISHED rows get text + deadline
 * policy only — the service enforces the split, the form mirrors it.
 */
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import {
  getAssignmentForManage,
  listAudienceOptions,
  listContentOptions,
} from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import { AccessDenied, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { AssignmentForm } from "@/app/assignments/assignment-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function EditAssignmentPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();
  if (ctx.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return <AccessDenied hint="إدارة التكليفات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط." />;
  }

  const [detail, audience, content] = await Promise.all([
    getAssignmentForManage(ctx, id),
    listAudienceOptions(ctx),
    listContentOptions(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!detail.ok) {
    if (detail.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return <AccessDenied hint={detail.message} />;
  }
  if (!audience.ok || !content.ok) {
    return <AccessDenied hint={!audience.ok ? audience.message : content.ok ? "" : content.message} />;
  }

  const { assignment, criteria } = detail.data;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={`تعديل: ${assignment.titleAr}`}
        subtitle={
          assignment.status === "PUBLISHED"
            ? "تكليف منشور — تعديل النصوص والمواعيد فقط"
            : "تكليف مسودة — تعديل كامل متاح"
        }
      />
      <AssignmentForm
        initial={{
          id: assignment.id,
          status: assignment.status,
          titleAr: assignment.titleAr,
          titleEn: assignment.titleEn,
          descriptionAr: assignment.descriptionAr,
          descriptionEn: assignment.descriptionEn,
          programId: assignment.programId,
          courseId: assignment.courseId,
          sectionId: assignment.sectionId,
          lessonId: assignment.lessonId,
          audienceMode: assignment.audienceMode,
          targetTeacherIds: assignment.targetTeacherIds,
          targetBranchIds: assignment.targetBranchIds,
          dueAt: assignment.dueAt.toISOString(),
          allowLate: assignment.allowLate,
          lateUntil: assignment.lateUntil ? assignment.lateUntil.toISOString() : null,
          totalPoints: assignment.totalPoints,
        }}
        audience={audience.data}
        content={content.data}
        criteria={criteria}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { canReviewSubmissions, type AssignmentActor } from "@/lib/assignments/access";
import { getSubmissionForReview } from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  SubmissionStatusBadge,
  formatBytes,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function SubmissionReviewPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string; submissionId: string }>;
}) {
  const { id, submissionId } = await params;
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || !canReviewSubmissions(user.role) || !user.schoolId) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="مراجعة التسليمات متاحة للمشرفين التربويين ومديري مكاتب التطوير فقط." />;
  }
  // canReviewSubmissions narrows the runtime set to exactly these two
  // roles — the literal below keeps the union type intact for callers.
  const ctx: AssignmentActor =
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
      ? { id: user.id, role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", schoolId: user.schoolId }
      : { id: user.id, role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const result = await getSubmissionForReview(ctx, submissionId);
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  }
  const { submission, assignment, teacher, criteria, rubricScores, files, revisions } = result.data;
  const scoreByCriterion = new Map(rubricScores.map((score) => [score.criterionId, score.points]));

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
            <Link href={`/assignments/${id}/submissions`} className="text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline">
              تسليمات التكليف
            </Link>{" "}
            / {assignment.titleAr}
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">مراجعة تسليم: {teacher.name}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            {teacher.email} — الفرع: {teacher.branchName ?? "—"}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <SubmissionStatusBadge status={submission.status} />
          {submission.isLate ? (
            <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-amber-700">
              سُلِّم متأخرًا
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="space-y-6 lg:col-span-2">
          <Card title="نص التسليم">
            {submission.responseText && submission.responseText.trim().length > 0 ? (
              <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-7 text-slate-800">
                {submission.responseText}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">لا يوجد نص — التسليم بمرفقات فقط.</p>
            )}
            <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
              أول تسليم: {formatDate(submission.submittedAt)} — آخر تحديث: {formatDate(submission.lastSubmittedAt)} — عدد مرات إعادة التسليم: {submission.resubmitCount}
            </div>
          </Card>

          <Card title={`المرفقات (${files.length})`}>

            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {files.map((file) => (

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 7 — review actions (supervisor / office manager):
 *   - claim for review (SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW),
 *   - return for revision with a mandatory reason,
 *   - grade against the rubric (scoresJson hidden input, the same
 *     Phase 6 pattern) or a direct score when no rubric exists.
 * Bounds are enforced again on the server; this UI only guides.
 */
import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import {
  gradeSubmissionAction,
  markUnderReviewAction,
  returnSubmissionAction,
  type FormActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/assignments";
import type { CriterionRow } from "@/lib/assignments/service";

const inputCls =
  "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";

export function ReviewActions({
  submissionId,
  assignmentId,
  status,
  criteria,
  existingScores,
  existingFeedback,
  hasRubric,
}: {
  submissionId: string;
  assignmentId: string;
  status: string;
  criteria: CriterionRow[];
  existingScores: { criterionId: string; points: number }[];
  existingFeedback: string | null;
  hasRubric: boolean;
}) {
  const actionable = status === "SUBMITTED" || status === "UNDER_REVIEW";
  const initialScores = new Map(existingScores.map((score) => [score.criterionId, score.points]));
  const [scores, setScores] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(criteria.map((criterion) => [criterion.id, String(initialScores.get(criterion.id) ?? "")]))
  );
  const [directScore, setDirectScore] = useState("");

  const [reviewState, reviewAction, reviewPending] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    markUnderReviewAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const [returnState, returnFormAction, returnPending] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    returnSubmissionAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const [gradeState, gradeFormAction, gradePending] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    gradeSubmissionAction,
    { ok: false }
  );

  const rubricTotal = criteria.reduce((sum, criterion) => {
    const value = Number(scores[criterion.id]);
    return sum + (Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 0);
  }, 0);

  if (!actionable) {
    return (
      <p className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
        {status === "GRADED"
          ? "تم تقييم هذا التسليم — التقييم النهائي ظاهر للمعلم."
          : status === "RETURNED"
            ? "أُعيد هذا التسليم للمعلم للتعديل — بانتظار إعادة التسليم."
            : "لم يُسلَّم هذا التكليف بعد."}
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {status === "SUBMITTED" ? (
        <form action={reviewAction} className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <input type="hidden" name="submissionId" value={submissionId} />
          <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={assignmentId} />
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={reviewPending}
            className="rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            بدء المراجعة
          </button>
          {reviewState.message && !reviewState.ok ? (
            <span className="text-xs text-red-600">{reviewState.message}</span>
          ) : null}
        </form>
      ) : null}

      <form action={returnFormAction} className="rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/50 p-4">
        <input type="hidden" name="submissionId" value={submissionId} />
        <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={assignmentId} />
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-amber-800">إعادة للتعديل</h3>
        <textarea
          name="feedbackText"
          required
          minLength={3}
          maxLength={4000}
          rows={3}
          placeholder="اكتب ملاحظات واضحة توجّه المعلم لما يجب تحسينه…"
          className={inputCls}
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={returnPending}
          className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-amber-600 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {returnPending ? "جارٍ الإرسال…" : "إعادة التسليم للتعديل"}
        </button>
        {returnState.message && !returnState.ok ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-600">{returnState.message}</p>
        ) : null}
      </form>

      <form action={gradeFormAction} className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/40 p-4">
        <input type="hidden" name="submissionId" value={submissionId} />
        <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={assignmentId} />
        <h3 className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-800">التقييم النهائي</h3>

        {hasRubric ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {criteria.map((criterion) => (
              <div key={criterion.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="flex-1 text-sm text-slate-700">{criterion.titleAr}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">من {criterion.maxPoints}</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={criterion.maxPoints}
                  name={`score-${criterion.id}`}
                  value={scores[criterion.id] ?? ""}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setScores((prev) => ({ ...prev, [criterion.id]: event.target.value }))
                  }
                  className="w-24 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
                />
              </div>
            ))}
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
              المجموع الحالي: <strong className="text-[#1D5BD6]">{rubricTotal}</strong> نقطة
            </p>
            <input
              type="hidden"
              name="scoresJson"
              value={JSON.stringify(
                criteria
                  .filter((criterion) => scores[criterion.id] !== "" && Number.isFinite(Number(scores[criterion.id])))
                  .map((criterion) => ({
                    criterionId: criterion.id,
                    points: Number(scores[criterion.id]),
                  }))
              )}
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <label className="text-sm text-slate-700" htmlFor="directScore">الدرجة المباشرة (من 100)</label>
            <input
              id="directScore"
              name="directScore"
              type="number"
              min={0}
              max={100}
              value={directScore}
              onChange={(event) => setDirectScore(event.target.value)}
              className="w-24 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <label className="mt-3 mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700" htmlFor="feedbackText">
          التغذية الراجعة للمعلم — اختياري (تظهر بعد التقييم)
        </label>
        <textarea
          id="feedbackText"
          name="feedbackText"
          defaultValue={existingFeedback ?? ""}
          rows={3}
          maxLength={4000}
          className={inputCls}
        />

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={gradePending}
          className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {gradePending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : "اعتماد التقييم"}
        </button>
        {gradeState.message && !gradeState.ok ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-600">{gradeState.message}</p>
        ) : null}
        {gradeState.ok ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-emerald-700">
            تم اعتماد التقييم — الدرجة والتغذية الراجعة ظاهرة للمعلم الآن.
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 7 — "تسليمات المعلمين" review workspace (office manager +
 * educational supervisor). Supervisors are narrowed to their persisted
 * teacher set inside the service; URL manipulation cannot widen it.
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { listSubmissionsForReview } from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import { canReviewSubmissions, type AssignmentActor } from "@/lib/assignments/access";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  SubmissionStatusBadge,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function AssignmentSubmissionsPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const { status } = await searchParams;
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || !canReviewSubmissions(user.role) || !user.schoolId) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="مراجعة التسليمات متاحة للمشرفين التربويين ومديري مكاتب التطوير فقط." />;
  }
  // canReviewSubmissions narrows the runtime set to exactly these two
  // roles — the literal below keeps the union type intact for callers.
  const ctx: AssignmentActor =
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
      ? { id: user.id, role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", schoolId: user.schoolId }
      : { id: user.id, role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const rows = await listSubmissionsForReview(ctx, id, { status });
  if (!rows.ok) {
    if (rows.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return <AccessDenied hint={rows.message} />;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="تسليمات المعلمين"
        subtitle="مراجعة محتوى التسليمات والمرفقات ثم التقييم أو الإعادة للتعديل"
        actions={
          <Link
            href={`/assignments/${id}`}
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
          >
            بيانات التكليف
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <Card>
        <form className="mb-4 flex items-end gap-3" method="get">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="status">الحالة</label>
            <select
              id="status"
              name="status"
              defaultValue={status ?? ""}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
            >
              <option value="">الكل</option>
              <option value="SUBMITTED">مُسلَّم</option>
              <option value="UNDER_REVIEW">قيد المراجعة</option>
              <option value="RETURNED">أُعيد للتعديل</option>
              <option value="GRADED">مُقيَّم</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
            تصفية
          </button>
        </form>

        {rows.data.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="لا توجد تسليمات مطابقة"
            hint="ستظهر هنا تسليمات المعلمين المستهدفين بعد تقديمها."
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المعلم</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الفرع</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الحالة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">التسليم</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">تعديلات</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">متأخر</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الدرجة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium"></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.data.map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/60">
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 font-medium text-slate-800">{row.teacherName}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-500">{row.branchName ?? "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3"><SubmissionStatusBadge status={row.status} /></td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{formatDate(row.lastSubmittedAt)}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.resubmitCount}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      {row.isLate ? (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-amber-700">متأخر</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">في الموعد</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      {row.scoreTotal !== null ? (
                        <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600">{row.scoreTotal}</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-400">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      <Link
                        href={`/assignments/${id}/submissions/${row.id}`}
                        className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline"
                      >
                        مراجعة وتقييم
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 7 — assignment create/edit form (office manager).
 * Client-side UX only: every rule is re-validated on the server.
 * Rubric editing appears only for DRAFT assignments (published rubrics
 * feed real scores and are frozen).
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useActionState, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import type { AudienceOptions, ContentOptions, CriterionRow } from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import {
  AUDIENCE_MODE_LABELS,
  MAX_RUBRIC_CRITERIA,
  type AudienceMode,
} from "@/config/assignments";
import {
  createAssignmentAction,
  saveRubricAction,
  updateAssignmentAction,
  type FormActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/assignments";
import { FieldError } from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export interface AssignmentFormInitial {
  id?: string;
  status?: string;
  titleAr?: string;
  titleEn?: string | null;
  descriptionAr?: string;
  descriptionEn?: string | null;
  programId?: string | null;
  courseId?: string | null;
  sectionId?: string | null;
  lessonId?: string | null;
  audienceMode?: string;
  targetTeacherIds?: string[];
  targetBranchIds?: string[];
  dueAt?: string | null;
  allowLate?: boolean;
  lateUntil?: string | null;
  totalPoints?: number;
}

const inputCls =
  "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 shadow-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";
const labelCls = "mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700";

/** ISO string -> datetime-local value (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, local clock). */
function toDatetimeLocal(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return "";
  const date = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

export function AssignmentForm({
  initial,
  audience,
  content,
  criteria = [],
}: {
  initial?: AssignmentFormInitial;
  audience: AudienceOptions;
  content: ContentOptions;
  criteria?: CriterionRow[];
}) {
  const isEdit = Boolean(initial?.id);
  const isDraft = !isEdit || initial?.status === "DRAFT";

  const [audienceMode, setAudienceMode] = useState<AudienceMode>(
    (initial?.audienceMode as AudienceMode) ?? "ALL_TEACHERS"
  );
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState(initial?.courseId ?? "");
  const [sectionId, setSectionId] = useState(initial?.sectionId ?? "");
  const [allowLate, setAllowLate] = useState(Boolean(initial?.allowLate));

  const [rubric, setRubric] = useState<{ titleAr: string; maxPoints: string }[]>(
    criteria.map((criterion) => ({
      titleAr: criterion.titleAr,
      maxPoints: String(criterion.maxPoints),
    }))
  );
  const [rubricState, rubricFormAction, rubricPending] = useActionState<
    FormActionState,
    FormData
  >(saveRubricAction, { ok: false });

  const [mainState, mainFormAction, mainPending] = useActionState<
    FormActionState,
    FormData
  >(isEdit ? updateAssignmentAction : createAssignmentAction, { ok: false });
  const router = useRouter();

  // After creating a draft, jump straight to its edit page (rubric lives there).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEdit && mainState.ok && mainState.data?.id) {
      router.push(`/assignments/${mainState.data.id}/edit`);
    }
  }, [isEdit, mainState, router]);

  const sections = useMemo(
    () => content.sections.filter((section) => !courseId || section.courseId === courseId),
    [content.sections, courseId]
  );
  const lessons = useMemo(
    () => content.lessons.filter((lesson) => !sectionId || lesson.sectionId === sectionId),
    [content.lessons, sectionId]
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {mainState.message && !mainState.ok ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">
          {mainState.message}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {mainState.ok && isEdit ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-emerald-700">
          حفظت التعديلات بنجاح.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <form action={mainFormAction} className="space-y-6">
        {isEdit ? <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={initial?.id} /> : null}

        <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="mb-4 text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">البيانات الأساسية</h2>
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="titleAr">عنوان التكليف (بالعربية) *</label>
              <input id="titleAr" name="titleAr" defaultValue={initial?.titleAr ?? ""} className={inputCls} required maxLength={200} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="titleEn">العنوان (بالإنجليزية) — اختياري</label>
              <input id="titleEn" name="titleEn" defaultValue={initial?.titleEn ?? ""} className={inputCls} maxLength={200} dir="ltr" />
            </div>
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="descriptionAr">الوصف والتعليمات (بالعربية) *</label>
              <textarea id="descriptionAr" name="descriptionAr" defaultValue={initial?.descriptionAr ?? ""} className={`${inputCls} min-h-32`} required maxLength={5000} />
            </div>
            <div className="md:col-span-2">
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="descriptionEn">الوصف (بالإنجليزية) — اختياري</label>
              <textarea id="descriptionEn" name="descriptionEn" defaultValue={initial?.descriptionEn ?? ""} className={`${inputCls} min-h-24`} maxLength={5000} dir="ltr" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="mb-4 text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">الربط بالمحتوى التدريبي (اختياري)</h2>
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="programId">البرنامج التدريبي</label>
              <select id="programId" name="programId" defaultValue={initial?.programId ?? ""} className={inputCls}>
                <option value="">— بدون —</option>
                {content.programs.map((program) => (
                  <option key={program.id} value={program.id}>{program.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="courseId">الدورة التدريبية</label>
              <select
                id="courseId"
                name="courseId"
                value={courseId}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setCourseId(event.target.value);
                  setSectionId("");
                }}
                className={inputCls}
              >
                <option value="">— بدون —</option>
                {content.courses.map((course) => (
                  <option key={course.id} value={course.id}>{course.titleAr}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="sectionId">القسم</label>
              <select
                id="sectionId"
                name="sectionId"
                value={sectionId}
                onChange={(event) => setSectionId(event.target.value)}
                className={inputCls}
                disabled={!courseId}
              >
                <option value="">— بدون —</option>
                {sections.map((section) => (
                  <option key={section.id} value={section.id}>{section.titleAr}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="lessonId">الدرس</label>
              <select id="lessonId" name="lessonId" defaultValue={initial?.lessonId ?? ""} className={inputCls} disabled={!sectionId}>
                <option value="">— بدون —</option>
                {lessons.map((lesson) => (
                  <option key={lesson.id} value={lesson.id}>{lesson.titleAr}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          {initial?.status === "PUBLISHED" ? (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
              التكليف منشور: تعديل الفئة المستهدفة والربط بالمحتوى متوقف لحماية أهلية التسليمات الجارية.
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </section>

        <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="mb-4 text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">الفئة المستهدفة</h2>
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
            {(Object.keys(AUDIENCE_MODE_LABELS) as AudienceMode[]).map((mode) => (
              <label
                key={mode}
                className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm ${
                  audienceMode === mode
                    ? "border-[#1D5BD6] bg-blue-50 font-medium text-[#1D5BD6]"
                    : "border-slate-300 text-slate-600"
                }`}
              >
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="audienceMode"
                  value={mode}
                  checked={audienceMode === mode}
                  onChange={() => setAudienceMode(mode)}
                  disabled={initial?.status === "PUBLISHED"}
                />
                {AUDIENCE_MODE_LABELS[mode]}
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>

          {audienceMode === "BRANCHES" ? (
            <div className="mt-4">
              <p className={labelCls}>اختر الفروع *</p>
              <div className="grid max-h-44 gap-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {audience.branches.map((branch) => (
                  <label key={branch.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      name="branchIds"
                      value={branch.id}
                      defaultChecked={initial?.targetBranchIds?.includes(branch.id) ?? false}
                      disabled={initial?.status === "PUBLISHED"}
                    />
                    {branch.name}
                  </label>
                ))}
                {audience.branches.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">لا توجد فروع مسجلة لهذه المدرسة بعد.</p>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {audienceMode === "TEACHERS" ? (
            <div className="mt-4">
              <p className={labelCls}>اختر المعلمين *</p>
              <div className="grid max-h-56 gap-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {audience.teachers.map((teacher) => (

                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      name="teacherIds"

                      defaultChecked={initial?.targetTeacherIds?.includes(teacher.id) ?? false}
                      disabled={initial?.status === "PUBLISHED"}
                    />
                    {teacher.name}
                    {teacher.branchName ? (
                      <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">({teacher.branchName})</span>
                    ) : null}
                  </label>
                ))}
                {audience.teachers.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">لا يوجد معلمون في هذه المدرسة بعد.</p>
                ) : null}

            </div>
          ) : null}
        </section>

        <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">

              </label>

            {allowLate ? (
              <div>
                <label className={labelCls} htmlFor="lateUntil">نهاية القبول المتأخر — اختياري</label>
                <input
                  id="lateUntil"
                  name="lateUntil"
                  type="datetime-local"
                  defaultValue={toDatetimeLocal(initial?.lateUntil)}
                  className={inputCls}
                />
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">اتركه فارغًا للقبول المتأخر دون حد زمني.</p>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </section>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={mainPending}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {mainPending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : isEdit ? "حفظ التعديلات" : "إنشاء التكليف (مسودة)"}
          </button>
          <Link href="/assignments" className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700">
            إلغاء
          </Link>
        </div>
      </form>

      {isDraft ? (
        <RubricEditor
          assignmentId={initial?.id}
          state={rubricState}
          formAction={rubricFormAction}
          pending={rubricPending}
          rows={rubric}
          setRows={setRubric}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function RubricEditor({
  assignmentId,
  state,
  formAction,
  pending,
  rows,
  setRows,
}: {
  assignmentId?: string;
  state: FormActionState;
  formAction: (formData: FormData) => void;
  pending: boolean;
  rows: { titleAr: string; maxPoints: string }[];
  setRows: (rows: { titleAr: string; maxPoints: string }[]) => void;
}) {
  const total = rows.reduce(
    (sum, row) => sum + (Number(row.maxPoints) || 0),
    0
  );

  if (!assignmentId) {
    return (
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">سلّم التقييم (اختياري)</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
          أنشئ التكليف أولًا ثم عدّل صفحته لإضافة عناصر سلّم التقييم.
        </p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">سلّم التقييم (اختياري)</h2>
        <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          المجموع: <strong className="text-[#1D5BD6]">{total}</strong> نقطة
        </span>
      </div>

      {state.message && !state.ok ? (
        <p className="mb-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">{state.message}</p>
      ) : null}
      {state.ok ? (
        <p className="mb-3 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-700">
          تم حفظ سلّم التقييم بنجاح.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <form action={formAction} className="space-y-3">
        <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={assignmentId} />
        <input
          type="hidden"
          name="criteriaJson"
          value={JSON.stringify(
            rows
              .filter((row) => row.titleAr.trim() && Number(row.maxPoints) > 0)
              .map((row) => ({ titleAr: row.titleAr.trim(), maxPoints: Number(row.maxPoints) }))
          )}
        />

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {rows.map((row, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <input
                className={`${inputCls} flex-1`}
                placeholder={`عنصر التقييم ${index + 1}`}
                value={row.titleAr}
                maxLength={200}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const next = [...rows];
                  next[index] = { ...next[index], titleAr: event.target.value };
                  setRows(next);
                }}
              />
              <input
                className={`${inputCls} w-28`}
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={100}
                placeholder="الدرجة"
                value={row.maxPoints}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const next = [...rows];
                  next[index] = { ...next[index], maxPoints: event.target.value };
                  setRows(next);
                }}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                onClick={() => setRows(rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}
              >
                حذف
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:opacity-60"
            disabled={rows.length >= MAX_RUBRIC_CRITERIA}
            onClick={() => setRows([...rows, { titleAr: "", maxPoints: "" }])}
          >
            + إضافة عنصر
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={pending || rows.length === 0}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
          >
