"use client";

/**
 * Phase 7 — status transition buttons (office manager): publish, close,
 * re-open, archive. The service re-validates every guard server-side;
 * this component only surfaces the returned Arabic message.
 */
import { useActionState } from "react";

import { setAssignmentStatusAction, type FormActionState } from "@/app/actions/assignments";

const btn =
  "rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold shadow-sm transition disabled:opacity-60";

export function AssignmentStatusActions({
  assignmentId,
  status,
}: {
  assignmentId: string;
  status: string;
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    setAssignmentStatusAction,
    { ok: false }
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <form action={formAction} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={assignmentId} />
        {status === "DRAFT" ? (
          <button type="submit" name="status" value="PUBLISHED" disabled={pending} className={`${btn} bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700`}>
            نشر التكليف
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {status === "PUBLISHED" ? (
          <button type="submit" name="status" value="CLOSED" disabled={pending} className={`${btn} bg-amber-500 text-white hover:bg-amber-600`}>
            إغلاق التسليم
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {status === "CLOSED" ? (
          <button type="submit" name="status" value="PUBLISHED" disabled={pending} className={`${btn} bg-[#1D5BD6] text-white hover:bg-[#174aa8]`}>
            إعادة الفتح
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {status !== "ARCHIVED" ? (
          <button type="submit" name="status" value="ARCHIVED" disabled={pending} className={`${btn} border border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50`}>
            أرشفة
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </form>
      {state.message ? (
        <p className={`text-xs ${state.ok ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-red-600"}`}>{state.message}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 7 — create a new assignment (office manager). The form starts
 * as a DRAFT; the rubric editor becomes available on the edit page.
 */
import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { listAudienceOptions, listContentOptions } from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import { AccessDenied, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { AssignmentForm } from "@/app/assignments/assignment-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function NewAssignmentPage() {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();
  if (ctx.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return <AccessDenied hint="إدارة التكليفات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط." />;
  }

  const [audience, content] = await Promise.all([
    listAudienceOptions(ctx),
    listContentOptions(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!audience.ok || !content.ok) {
    return (
      <AccessDenied
        hint={!audience.ok ? audience.message : content.ok ? "" : content.message}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="تكليف جديد"
        subtitle="يُنشأ التكليف كمسودة ولا يراه المعلمون قبل النشر"
      />
      <AssignmentForm audience={audience.data} content={content.data} />
    </div>
  );
}

 *   - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: own school,
 *   - EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY: granted schools/branches (read-only),
 *   - SUPER_ADMIN: platform-level stats only (no mutations anywhere).
 * Denominators count ELIGIBLE teachers only (targeting + scope).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { AssignmentActor } from "@/lib/assignments/access";
import { getAssignmentsOverview } from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  AssignmentStatusBadge,

  EmptyState,

  StatTile,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  const OVERVIEW_ROLES = ["DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY", "SUPER_ADMIN"];
  if (!user || !OVERVIEW_ROLES.includes(user.role)) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="متابعة التكليفات متاحة لمديري المكاتب والوكلاء التعليميين." />;
  }
  // Managers and deputies are school-scoped; the super admin is platform-level.
  if (user.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && !user.schoolId) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة." />;
  }
  // The runtime set is exactly these three roles (checked above); the
  // literal branches keep the AssignmentActor union type intact.
  const ctx: AssignmentActor =
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
      ? { id: user.id, role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", schoolId: user.schoolId }
      : user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
        ? { id: user.id, role: "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY", schoolId: user.schoolId }
        : { id: user.id, role: "SUPER_ADMIN", schoolId: user.schoolId };

  const result = await getAssignmentsOverview(ctx);
  if (!result.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  const { cards, rows, schools, scope } = result.data;

  const scopeLabel =
    scope === "platform"
      ? "إحصاءات على مستوى المنصة (قراءة فقط)"
      : scope === "deputy"
        ? "نطاق الصلاحيات الممنوحة لك (قراءة فقط)"
        : "نطاق مدرستك";

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="متابعة التكليفات ونسب الإنجاز"
        subtitle={scopeLabel}
      />

      <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-7">
        <StatTile label="تكليفات منشورة" value={cards.assignmentsPublished} tone="brand" />
        <StatTile label="أزواج مستهدف/تكليف" value={cards.targetedPairs} />
        <StatTile label="تسليمات" value={cards.submissionsActive} />
        <StatTile label="بانتظار المراجعة" value={cards.pendingReview} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="أُعيدت للتعديل" value={cards.returnedCount} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="مُقيَّمة" value={cards.gradedCount} tone="success" />
        <StatTile label="نسبة الإنجاز" value={cards.completionRate === null ? "—" : `${cards.completionRate}%`} tone="success" />
      </div>

      {schools.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="mb-6">
          <Card title="تفصيل حسب المدرسة">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المدرسة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">تكليفات منشورة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">تسليمات</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">مُقيَّمة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">نسبة الإنجاز</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {schools.map((school) => (
                    <tr key={school.schoolId} className="border-b border-slate-100">
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 font-medium text-slate-800">{school.schoolName}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-slate-600">{school.assignmentsPublished}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-slate-600">{school.submissionsActive}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-slate-600">{school.gradedCount}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                        {school.completionRate === null ? "—" : `${school.completionRate}%`}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <Card title="التكليفات">
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لا توجد تكليفات في نطاقك بعد" />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">العنوان</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الحالة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الاستحقاق</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المستهدفون</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">سَلَّم</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">قيد المراجعة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">أُعيد</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">مُقيَّم</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">متأخر</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الإنجاز</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium"></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/60">
                    <td className="px-3 py-2.5 font-medium text-slate-800">{row.titleAr}</td>

                    <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-slate-600">{row.late}</td>

/**

 *
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER / SCHOOL_MANAGER → the full management

 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR → READ-ONLY register of assignments that
 *     target their assigned teachers, with a jump into submissions
 *     review (their existing review capability, unchanged).
 *   SUPER_ADMIN → READ-ONLY platform-wide register, school-labelled.
 *
 * The branch decision happens on the session user BEFORE any admin
 * context is required — supervisors and the platform owner are no
 * longer bounced to /forbidden by the old office-manager-only guard.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";

} from "@/lib/assignments/read-scope";

  AccessDenied,
  AssignmentStatusBadge,

  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type SearchParams = Promise<{ q?: string; status?: string; page?: string }>;

export default async function AssignmentsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {

}) {

    });

    }

                placeholder="اكتب جزءًا من العنوان…"
                className="w-64 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="status">الحالة</label>
              <select
                id="status"
                name="status"
                defaultValue={params.status ?? ""}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
              >
                <option value="">الكل</option>
                <option value="DRAFT">مسودة</option>
                <option value="PUBLISHED">منشور</option>
                <option value="CLOSED">مغلق</option>
                <option value="ARCHIVED">مؤرشف</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <button type="submit" className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
              تصفية
            </button>
          </form>

          {result.rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="لا توجد تكليفات مطابقة" hint="ستظهر هنا تكليفات جميع المدارس المسجلة." />
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">العنوان</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المدرسة</th>

                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">التسليمات</th>

                      <td className="px-3 py-3 font-medium text-slate-800">{row.titleAr}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.schoolName ?? "—"}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3"><AssignmentStatusBadge status={row.status} /></td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{formatDate(row.dueAt)}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.submissionsTotal}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          {result.pageCount > 1 ? (
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
              <span>الصفحة {result.page} من {result.pageCount} — {result.total} تكليفًا</span>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {result.page > 1 ? (
                  <Link href={`/assignments?page=${result.page - 1}`} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50">السابق</Link>
                ) : null}
                {result.page < result.pageCount ? (
                  <Link href={`/assignments?page=${result.page + 1}`} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50">التالي</Link>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AccessDenied hint="هذه الوحدة متاحة لإدارة المكتب والمدارس والمشرفين التربويين." />
  );
}

export default async function ReviewQueuePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();

    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"

/**
 * Phase 7 — small server-safe presentational helpers shared by the
 * assignment pages (no client directives here).
 */
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import {
  ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_CLASSES,
  ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_LABELS,
  SUBMISSION_STATUS_CLASSES,
  SUBMISSION_STATUS_LABELS,
  type AssignmentStatus,
  type SubmissionStatus,
} from "@/config/assignments";

export function formatDate(date: Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(date);
}

export function formatBytes(sizeBytes: number): string {
  if (sizeBytes < 1024) return `${sizeBytes} بايت`;
  if (sizeBytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.round(sizeBytes / 1024)} كيلوبايت`;
  return `${(sizeBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} ميغابايت`;
}

export function PageHeader({
  title,
  subtitle,
  actions,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  actions?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">{title}</h1>
        {subtitle ? <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">{subtitle}</p> : null}
      </div>
      {actions ? <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{actions}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Card({
  title,
  children,
  actions,
}: {
  title?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
      {title || actions ? (
        <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-4">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-800">{title}</h2>
          {actions ? <div className="flex items-center gap-2">{actions}</div> : null}
        </header>
      ) : null}
      <div className="p-5">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

export function AssignmentStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const label =
    ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_LABELS[status as AssignmentStatus] ?? status;
  const cls =
    ASSIGNMENT_STATUS_CLASSES[status as AssignmentStatus] ??
    "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${cls}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function SubmissionStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const label =
    SUBMISSION_STATUS_LABELS[status as SubmissionStatus] ?? status;
  const cls =
    SUBMISSION_STATUS_CLASSES[status as SubmissionStatus] ??
    "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${cls}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function StatTile({
  label,
  value,
  tone = "default",
  hint,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: ReactNode;
  tone?: "default" | "brand" | "warning" | "success";
  /** Phase 10 — optional denominator/definition note under the value. */
  hint?: string;
}) {
  const tones: Record<string, string> = {
    default: "border-slate-200 bg-white",
    brand: "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50",
    warning: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50",
    success: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50",
  };
  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-sm ${tones[tone]}`}>
      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">{value}</p>
      {hint ? <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-400">{hint}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function EmptyState({ title, hint }: { title: string; hint?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 p-10 text-center">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">{title}</p>
      {hint ? <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">{hint}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AccessDenied({ hint }: { hint?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-8 text-center">
      <p className="text-base font-semibold text-red-700">لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى هذه الصفحة</p>
      {hint ? <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-500">{hint}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function FieldError({ message }: { message?: string }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">{message}</p>;
}

/**
 * Phase 8 (Premium print revision) — certificate detail + printable
 * sheet. One route serves:
 *   - the certified TEACHER (owner-only, server-checked),
 *   - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER / SCHOOL_MANAGER /
 *     EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR / EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY (own school),
 *   - SUPER_ADMIN (platform-wide read-only records).
 * Authorization is enforced inside getCertificateView — this page only
 * renders the returned result or an access panel.
 *
 * Print flow (طباعة / حفظ PDF): the browser print dialog with a
 * dedicated print layout — everything outside the sheet is removed
 * from the print flow (display:none cascade, not the old
 * visibility:hidden trick that reserved layout space and produced a
 * second blank page), the sheet fills exactly one A4 landscape page.
 * A dedicated bare print route (/certificates/<id>/print) also exists
 * for a guaranteed one-page output.
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { headers } from "next/headers";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { roleLabel } from "@/lib/auth/roles";
import { getCertificateView } from "@/lib/certificates/service";
import { qrDataUrl } from "@/lib/certificates/qr";
import { CERTIFICATE_EVENT_TYPE_LABELS } from "@/config/certificates";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  PageHeader,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import {
  EffectiveStatusBadge,
  formatIssueDate,
} from "@/app/certificates/ui";
import { CertificateSheet } from "@/app/certificates/certificate-sheet";
import { PrintButton } from "@/app/certificates/print-button";
import { RevokeForm } from "@/app/certificates/revoke-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function CertificateViewPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const { id } = await params;
  const result = await getCertificateView(user, id);
  if (!result.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  const view = result.data;

  // Training hours snapshot (course.estimatedHours) — read-only extra
  // fact for the sheet; programs and legacy rows simply show none.
  const hoursRow = await db.certificate.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    select: { course: { select: { estimatedHours: true } } },
  });
  const trainingHours = hoursRow?.course?.estimatedHours ?? null;

  // Verification URL for the QR code + printed footer (host from
  // request headers; no internal ids beyond the route the viewer is
  // already on — the code is the lookup key).
  const headerList = await headers();
  const host = headerList.get("host") ?? "localhost:3000";
  const proto = headerList.get("x-forwarded-proto") ?? "http";
  const verifyUrl = `${proto}://${host}/verify?code=${view.verificationCode}`;
  const qr = await qrDataUrl(verifyUrl);

  // Revocation follows canRevokeCertificates: office manager OR school
  // manager (both confined to their own school by the service).
  const canRevoke =
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER";
  const isOwner = user.role === "TEACHER" && user.id === view.teacherId;

  return (
    <div id="certificate-page-root">
      <div className="no-print">
        <PageHeader
          title={view.titleAr}
          subtitle={`رقم الشهادة: ${view.certificateNumber}`}
          actions={
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <PrintButton />
              <Link
                href={`/certificates/${id}/print`}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                صفحة الطباعة المخصصة
              </Link>
              {isOwner ? (
                <Link
                  href="/my-certificates"
                  className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  رجوع إلى شهاداتي
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <Link
                  href="/certificates"
                  className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  رجوع إلى الإدارة
                </Link>
              )}
            </div>
          }
        />
      </div>

      <div className="no-print mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <EffectiveStatusBadge status={view.effectiveStatus} />
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          المعلم: <strong className="text-slate-700">{view.teacherName}</strong>
        </span>
        {view.contentTitle ? (
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            المحتوى: <strong className="text-slate-700">{view.contentTitle}</strong>
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* printable sheet — the ONLY element kept in the print flow */}
      <section id="certificate-print-section">
        <CertificateSheet
          view={view}
          qrDataUrl={qr}
          verifyUrl={verifyUrl}
          trainingHours={trainingHours}
        />
      </section>

      {/* dedicated print stylesheet — scoped to this page. Removes the
          shell and every non-sheet block from the print flow entirely
          (display, NOT visibility — hidden-but-displayed elements still
          reserve layout height and used to spawn a second page). */}
      <style>{`
        @media print {
          html, body {
            background: #FFFFFF !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
          }
          /* application chrome out of the print flow */
          aside, header, nav, footer, .no-print { display: none !important; }
          /* page siblings + non-sheet page sections out of the flow */
          main > div > *:not(#certificate-page-root) { display: none !important; }
          #certificate-page-root > *:not(#certificate-print-section) { display: none !important; }
          /* collapse every wrapper around the sheet */
          main, main > div, #certificate-page-root, #certificate-print-section {
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            max-width: none !important;
            width: 100% !important;
          }
          /* the sheet occupies EXACTLY the printable box (281×194mm at
             8mm page margins) and can never grow past it — one page. */
          /* shell wrappers may carry min-height:100vh — that alone
             re-creates a second page in print; collapse them. */
          body > div, body > div > div { min-height: 0 !important; height: auto !important; }

            width: 280mm !important;
            max-width: 280mm !important;
            height: 193mm !important;

            border-radius: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;

            display: flex !important;

          }
          .cert-head { padding-bottom: 8px !important; gap: 12px !important; }
          .cert-head img, .cert-head .cert-logo-fallback { height: 44px !important; width: 44px !important; }

              <dt className="text-slate-500">انتهاء الصلاحية</dt>
              <dd className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                {view.expiresAt ? formatIssueDate(view.expiresAt) : "غير محدد (سارية دائمًا)"}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-slate-500">رقم الشهادة</dt>
              <dd dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                {view.certificateNumber}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-slate-500">رمز التحقق</dt>
              <dd dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold tracking-widest text-slate-700">
                {view.verificationCodeGrouped}
              </dd>
            </div>
            {trainingHours !== null ? (
              <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                <dt className="text-slate-500">الساعات التدريبية</dt>
                <dd className="font-medium text-slate-700">{trainingHours}</dd>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
              <dt className="text-slate-500">المُصدر</dt>
              <dd className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                {view.issuerName ?? "—"}
                {view.issuerRoleLabel ? (
                  <span className="mr-1 text-xs text-slate-400">({view.issuerRoleLabel})</span>
                ) : null}
              </dd>
            </div>
            {view.schoolSignatoryName ? (
              <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                <dt className="text-slate-500">توقيع مدير المدرسة</dt>
                <dd className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                  {view.schoolSignatoryName}
                  {view.schoolSignatoryTitle ? (
                    <span className="mr-1 text-xs text-slate-400">({view.schoolSignatoryTitle})</span>
                  ) : null}
                </dd>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {view.revocation ? (
              <>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                  <dt className="text-slate-500">تاريخ الإلغاء</dt>
                  <dd className="font-medium text-red-700">{formatDate(view.revocation.at)}</dd>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                  <dt className="text-slate-500">سبب الإلغاء</dt>
                  <dd className="max-w-64 text-left text-xs text-red-600">{view.revocation.reason}</dd>
                </div>
                {view.revocation.byName ? (
                  <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
                    <dt className="text-slate-500">أُلغيت بواسطة</dt>
                    <dd className="font-medium text-slate-700">{view.revocation.byName}</dd>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </>
            ) : null}
          </dl>

          {canRevoke && view.status === "ISSUED" ? (
            <div className="mt-6 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
              <RevokeForm certificateId={view.id} />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </Card>

        <Card title="سجل تدقيق الشهادة">
          {view.events.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">لا توجد أحداث مسجلة.</p>
          ) : (
            <ol className="space-y-4">
              {view.events.map((event, index) => (
                <li key={`${event.type}-${event.createdAt.toISOString()}-${index}`} className="flex gap-3">
                  <span
                    className={`mt-1 h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${
                      event.type === "ISSUED" ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-red-500"

                    aria-hidden
                  />
                  <div className="min-w-0">

                      {event.type === "ISSUED" ? " — إصدار الشهادة" : " — إلغاء الشهادة"}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                      {formatDate(event.createdAt)}
                      {event.actorName ? ` — ${event.actorName}` : ""}
                      {event.actorRole ? ` (${roleLabel(event.actorRole)})` : ""}
                    </p>
                    {event.note ? (
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{event.note}</p>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
          )}

          {view.snapshot ? (
            <div className="mt-6 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">
                نتائج الاستحقاق المسجلة لحظة الإصدار
              </p>
              <ul className="mt-2 space-y-2 text-xs">
                {view.snapshot.rules.map((rule) => (
                  <li key={rule.key} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                    <span
                      className={`mt-0.5 inline-flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${
                        rule.met ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-red-400"
                      }`}
                      aria-hidden
                    >
                      {rule.met ? "✓" : "✕"}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-600">
                      <span className="font-medium">{rule.label}:</span> {rule.detail}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Auto-print trigger for the dedicated certificate print route.
 *
 * Fires the browser print dialog once the sheet has settled (fonts +
 * QR image decoded). Falls back to a visible manual button when the
 * automatic trigger is delayed or blocked — the user is never stuck.
 * The whole control is marked .no-print and never appears on paper.
 */
import * as React from "react";
import { Printer } from "lucide-react";

export function AutoPrint({ certificateNumber }: { certificateNumber: string }) {
  const [armed, setArmed] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      setArmed(true);
      // Double rAF: guarantees a painted frame (incl. the QR <img>) exists
      // before the print snapshot is taken.
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => window.print());
      });
    }, 450);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="no-print mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3">
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-800">
          صفحة طباعة الشهادة — نسخة A4 أفقية واحدة
        </p>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500">
          في نافذة الطباعة اختر «حفظ كـ PDF» مع الاتجاه الأفقي (Landscape)
          وهو مضبوط تلقائيًا — رقم الشهادة{" "}
          <span dir="ltr" className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-700">
            {certificateNumber}
          </span>
          .
        </p>
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => window.print()}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
      >
        <Printer className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        {armed ? "طباعة / حفظ PDF" : "إعادة فتح نافذة الطباعة"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Dedicated certificate PRINT page — /certificates/[id]/print.
 *
 * A bare, print-optimized route: no page chrome of its own, only the
 * certificate sheet + the auto-print trigger. The application shell
 * (sidebar/topbar/footer) is still mounted by the root layout for the
 * interactive view, but the scoped print stylesheet below removes it
 * from the print flow completely, so the browser prints EXACTLY ONE
 * A4-landscape page containing the sheet alone.
 *
 * Authorization is identical to the detail page — getCertificateView
 * enforces ownership/scope server-side before anything renders.
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { headers } from "next/headers";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getCertificateView } from "@/lib/certificates/service";
import { qrDataUrl } from "@/lib/certificates/qr";
import { AccessDenied } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { CertificateSheet } from "@/app/certificates/certificate-sheet";
import { AutoPrint } from "./auto-print";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata = {
  title: "طباعة الشهادة",
};

export default async function CertificatePrintPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const { id } = await params;
  const result = await getCertificateView(user, id);
  if (!result.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  const view = result.data;

  const hoursRow = await db.certificate.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    select: { course: { select: { estimatedHours: true } } },
  });
  const trainingHours = hoursRow?.course?.estimatedHours ?? null;

  const headerList = await headers();
  const host = headerList.get("host") ?? "localhost:3000";
  const proto = headerList.get("x-forwarded-proto") ?? "http";
  const verifyUrl = `${proto}://${host}/verify?code=${view.verificationCode}`;
  const qr = await qrDataUrl(verifyUrl);

  return (
    <div id="certificate-print-page-root">
      <AutoPrint certificateNumber={view.certificateNumber} />

      <CertificateSheet
        view={view}
        qrDataUrl={qr}
        verifyUrl={verifyUrl}
        trainingHours={trainingHours}
      />

      <div className="no-print mt-6 text-center">
        <Link
          href={`/certificates/${id}`}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
        >
          العودة إلى صفحة الشهادة
        </Link>
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @media print {
          html, body { background: #FFFFFF !important; margin: 0 !important; }
          aside, header, nav, footer, .no-print { display: none !important; }
          main > div > *:not(#certificate-print-page-root) { display: none !important; }
          #certificate-print-page-root > *:not(#certificate-print-area) { display: none !important; }
          main, main > div, #certificate-print-page-root {
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            max-width: none !important;
            width: 100% !important;
          }
          /* shell wrappers may carry min-height:100vh — that alone
             re-creates a second page in print; collapse them. */
          body > div, body > div > div { min-height: 0 !important; height: auto !important; }
          #certificate-print-area {
            width: 280mm !important;
            max-width: 280mm !important;
            height: 193mm !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            border-radius: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
          }
          #certificate-print-area > div:first-child { height: 100% !important; }
          .cert-frame-inner {
            height: 100% !important;
            padding: 10px 26px 8px !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
          }
          .cert-head { padding-bottom: 8px !important; gap: 12px !important; }
          .cert-head img, .cert-head .cert-logo-fallback { height: 44px !important; width: 44px !important; }
          .cert-title { margin-top: 6px !important; font-size: 30px !important; line-height: 1.25 !important; }
          .cert-subtitle-en { margin-top: 2px !important; }
          .cert-grant { margin-top: 14px !important; }
          .cert-name { margin-top: 4px !important; font-size: 34px !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; }
          .cert-underline { margin-top: 8px !important; }
          /* balance: the free vertical space splits evenly between the
     statement block and the footer rail (classic certificate rhythm) */
  .cert-statement { margin-top: auto !important; padding-top: 10px !important; }
          .cert-desc { margin-top: 4px !important; }
          .cert-info-grid { margin-top: auto !important; padding-top: 10px !important; gap: 20px !important; }
          .cert-qr { height: 66px !important; width: 66px !important; }
          .cert-seal-wrap { bottom: 12px !important; left: 14px !important; }
          .cert-seal-wrap svg { height: 80px !important; width: 80px !important; }
          .cert-footline { margin-top: 10px !important; }
        }
        @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 8mm; }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 8 (Premium revision) — the printable certificate sheet.
 *
 * Design contract: an official academic certificate, NOT a dashboard
 * card. A4-landscape, premium white paper, deep blue brand + restrained
 * gold accents, elegant double borders, an academic seal, a large
 * teacher name and a clearly structured information section with the
 * QR verification block and the authorized signature.
 *
 * Identity rules (critical):
 *   - Platform identity = «منارة» (PLATFORM_NAME_AR) — never a school
 *     name, and never the legacy «منارة قرطبة» compound.
 *   - School identity = the certificate's own School row (nameAr +
 *     logoUrl + brandColor) loaded dynamically by the service layer.
 *     Nothing about any school is hardcoded here; the SAME template
 *     renders every school correctly.
 *
 * Privacy: the sheet shows the teacher NAME, school name, certificate
 * number, verification code and the verification URL — never emails,
 * internal ids, scores or notes. The QR encodes the verification page
 * URL with the code prefilled; the page itself is auth-gated.
 */
import type { CertificateView } from "@/lib/certificates/service";
import {
  CERTIFICATE_GOLD,
  DEFAULT_BRAND_COLOR,
  PLATFORM_NAME_AR,
  PLATFORM_SUBTITLE_AR,
} from "@/config/certificates";
import { formatIssueDate } from "@/app/certificates/ui";

/** Arabic pluralization for training hours (0/1/2/3-10/11+). */
function trainingHoursLabel(hours: number): string {
  if (hours === 1) return "ساعة تدريبية واحدة";
  if (hours === 2) return "ساعتان تدريبيتان";
  if (hours >= 3 && hours <= 10) return `${hours} ساعات تدريبية`;
  return `${hours} ساعة تدريبية`;
}

/**
 * Display-time brand normalization: certificates issued BEFORE the
 * platform-identity correction carry the legacy compound «منارة قرطبة»
 * inside their stored descriptionAr snapshot. The stored row is history
 * and is never rewritten — but the PRINTED sheet must always show the
 * correct platform identity «منارة» (school identity is rendered
 * separately from view.school.nameAr and is never affected).
 */
function normalizeDescriptionAr(raw: string | null): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  return raw.replace(/منصة\s*منارة\s*قرطبة/g, "منصة منارة").trim();
}

/** The academic seal — inline SVG so it prints identically everywhere. */
function CertificateSeal({ brand, issuedAt }: { brand: string; issuedAt: Date }) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 120 120"
      role="img"
      aria-label="ختم الاعتماد الأكاديمي"
      className="h-20 w-20 sm:h-24 sm:w-24"
    >
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="56" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke={brand} strokeWidth="2.5" />
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" fill="none" stroke={CERTIFICATE_GOLD} strokeWidth="1" />
      <circle
        cx="60"
        cy="60"
        r="45"
        fill="none"
        stroke={CERTIFICATE_GOLD}
        strokeWidth="0.75"
        strokeDasharray="2.5 3"
      />
      <defs>
        <path
          id="cert-seal-arc"
          d="M 60,60 m -36,0 a 36,36 0 1,1 72,0 a 36,36 0 1,1 -72,0"
          fill="none"
        />
      </defs>
      <text fontSize="8.5" fontWeight="700" fill={brand} letterSpacing="0.5">
        <textPath href="#cert-seal-arc" startOffset="25%" textAnchor="middle">
          منارة • مكتب التطوير التربوي
        </textPath>
      </text>
      {/* five-pointed star */}
      <path
        d="M60 38 L64.7 51.3 L78.8 51.3 L67.6 59.7 L71.9 73 L60 64.8 L48.1 73 L52.4 59.7 L41.2 51.3 L55.3 51.3 Z"
        fill={CERTIFICATE_GOLD}
        stroke={brand}
        strokeWidth="0.8"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
      />
      <text x="60" y="88" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="10" fontWeight="800" fill={brand}>
        {issuedAt.getFullYear()}
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

export function CertificateSheet({

  const brand = view.school.brandColor || DEFAULT_BRAND_COLOR;

  const descriptionText = normalizeDescriptionAr(view.descriptionAr);

        >

          <span aria-hidden className="absolute -top-[5px] -left-[5px] h-2.5 w-2.5 rotate-45" style={{ backgroundColor: CERTIFICATE_GOLD }} />
          <span aria-hidden className="absolute -bottom-[5px] -right-[5px] h-2.5 w-2.5 rotate-45" style={{ backgroundColor: CERTIFICATE_GOLD }} />
          <span aria-hidden className="absolute -bottom-[5px] -left-[5px] h-2.5 w-2.5 rotate-45" style={{ backgroundColor: CERTIFICATE_GOLD }} />

/**
 * Phase 8 — issuance flow (office manager / school manager):
 *   1. Pick qualifying content (course or program) from a server-
 *      computed, tenant-scoped list.
 *   2. Review the per-teacher eligibility table — every rule is
 *      computed SERVER-SIDE from real enrollment/assessment data; the
 *      UI never asserts eligibility.
 *   3. Issue per eligible teacher (service re-validates everything at
 *      submit time and blocks duplicates).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import {
  getIssueEligibility,
  listIssueContentOptions,
} from "@/lib/certificates/service";
import { CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS, type CertContentType } from "@/config/certificates";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { EffectiveStatusBadge } from "@/app/certificates/ui";
import { IssueCertificateButton } from "@/app/certificates/issue-button";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function IssueCertificatePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ type?: string; id?: string }>;
}) {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();
  if (
    ctx.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    ctx.role !== "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
  ) {
    return (
      <AccessDenied hint="إصدار الشهادات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس فقط." />
    );
  }

  const params = await searchParams;
  const optionsResult = await listIssueContentOptions(ctx);
  if (!optionsResult.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={optionsResult.message} />;
  const options = optionsResult.data;

  const selectedType =
    params.type === "COURSE" || params.type === "PROGRAM"
      ? (params.type as CertContentType)
      : null;
  const selectedId = params.id?.trim() || null;

  // ---- step 1: content selector ------------------------------------
  if (!selectedType || !selectedId) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title="إصدار شهادة"
          subtitle="اختر الدورة أو البرنامج التدريبي لعرض المعلمين المستوفين لمتطلبات الإتمام"
          actions={
            <Link
              href="/certificates"
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              رجوع إلى القائمة
            </Link>
          }
        />
        <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
          <Card title="دورات تدريبية">
            {options.courses.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="لا توجد دورات منشورة في نطاق مدرستك بعد" />
            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {options.courses.map((course) => (
                  <li key={course.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">{course.titleAr}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                        {CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS.COURSE}
                        {course.scope === "platform" ? " — منصة (مشتركة)" : " — مدرسة"}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <Link
                      href={`/certificates/issue?type=COURSE&id=${course.id}`}
                      className="shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
                    >
                      عرض المستوفين
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </Card>
          <Card title="برامج تدريبية">
            {options.programs.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="لا توجد برامج منشورة في نطاق مدرستك بعد" />
            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {options.programs.map((program) => (
                  <li key={program.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">{program.nameAr}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                        {CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS.PROGRAM}
                        {program.scope === "platform" ? " — منصة (مشتركة)" : " — مدرسة"}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <Link
                      href={`/certificates/issue?type=PROGRAM&id=${program.id}`}
                      className="shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
                    >
                      عرض المستوفين
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ---- step 2: eligibility table ------------------------------------
  const eligibilityResult = await getIssueEligibility(ctx, selectedType, selectedId);
  if (!eligibilityResult.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={eligibilityResult.message} />;
  const { content, rows, teachersTotal } = eligibilityResult.data;
  const eligibleCount = rows.filter((row) => row.eligible).length;
  const issuedCount = rows.filter((row) => row.alreadyIssued).length;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={`إصدار شهادة — ${content.titleAr}`}
        subtitle={`${CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS[content.type]} — قائمة المعلمين ومتطلبات الإتمام محسوبة من سجلات التدريب الفعلية`}
        actions={
          <Link
            href="/certificates/issue"
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
          >
            تغيير المحتوى
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-6 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 p-4 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-600">
        <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700">قواعد الاستحقاق المعتمدة</p>
        <p>
          1) الالتحاق: سجلّ التحاق نشط في {content.type === "COURSE" ? "الدورة" : "أحد دورات البرنامج"}.
        </p>
        <p>
          2) التقييمات: اجتياز كل تقييم منشور مرتبط بالمحتوى وفق درجة النجاح المحددة لكل تقييم
          (دون تقييمات منشورة، يُستوفى الشرط تلقائيًا ولا يُطلب أي معيار بديل).
        </p>
        <p>3) لا تُصدر شهادة مكررة لنفس المعلم عن نفس المحتوى.</p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-xs text-slate-500">
          <span>إجمالي المعلمين: <strong className="text-slate-700">{teachersTotal}</strong></span>
          <span>مستوفون للإصدار: <strong className="text-emerald-600">{eligibleCount}</strong></span>
          <span>صدرت لهم شهادات: <strong className="text-slate-700">{issuedCount}</strong></span>
        </div>

        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لا يوجد معلمون نشطون في مدرستك بعد" />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المعلم</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الفرع</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المتطلبات</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الإجراء</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.teacherId} className="border-b border-slate-100 align-top hover:bg-slate-50/60">
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 font-medium text-slate-800">{row.teacherName}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{row.branchName ?? "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      <ul className="space-y-1 text-xs">
                        {row.requirements.map((requirement) => (

                            <span
                              className={`mt-0.5 inline-flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${
                                requirement.met ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-red-400"
                              }`}
                              aria-hidden
                            >
                              {requirement.met ? "✓" : "✕"}
                            </span>
                            <span className={requirement.met ? "text-slate-600" : "text-red-600"}>
                              <span className="font-medium">{requirement.label}:</span>{" "}
                              {requirement.detail}
                            </span>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      {row.alreadyIssued ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
                          <EffectiveStatusBadge status={row.alreadyIssued.status === "ISSUED" ? "ISSUED" : "REVOKED"} />
                          <Link

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 8 — per-teacher issuance button on the eligibility table.
 * The service re-computes eligibility server-side at submit time; the
 * button is only a convenience. Success shows the generated identifiers
 * and refreshes the roster (the row flips to "already issued").
 */
import { useActionState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

import {
  issueCertificateAction,
  type CertificateActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/certificates";

export function IssueCertificateButton({
  teacherId,
  contentType,
  contentId,
  disabled,
}: {
  teacherId: string;
  contentType: string;
  contentId: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<CertificateActionState, FormData>(
    issueCertificateAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.ok) router.refresh();
  }, [state.ok, router]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
      <form action={formAction}>
        <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={teacherId} />
        <input type="hidden" name="contentType" value={contentType} />
        <input type="hidden" name="contentId" value={contentId} />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending || disabled}
          className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? "جارٍ الإصدار…" : "إصدار الشهادة"}
        </button>
      </form>
      {state.ok && state.data?.certificateNumber ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-emerald-600">
          صدرت الشهادة رقم {state.data.certificateNumber}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {!state.ok && state.message ? (
        <p className="max-w-xs text-xs text-red-600">{state.message}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 8 (Batch 3 revision) — "الشهادات" — role-aware root:
 *
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER / SCHOOL_MANAGER → the full management
 *     workspace exactly as before (metrics, eligibility, issue, revoke).
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR → READ-ONLY list of certificates belonging to
 *     their assigned teachers, each opening the standard certificate view.
 *   SUPER_ADMIN → READ-ONLY platform-wide register, school-labelled.
 *     Issuance stays manager-only (enforced again by the service layer).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  getCertificateMetrics,
  listCertificatesForManage,
} from "@/lib/certificates/service";
import {
  listCertificatesForSupervisor,
  listCertificatesPlatform,
} from "@/lib/certificates/read-scope";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  StatTile,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import {
  CertificateStatusBadge,
  EffectiveStatusBadge,
} from "@/app/certificates/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type SearchParams = Promise<{ q?: string; status?: string; page?: string }>;

export default async function CertificatesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: SearchParams;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* School managers — the unchanged management workspace              */
  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  if (
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
  ) {
    const ctx = await requireAdminContext();
    const params = await searchParams;
    const page = Number(params.page ?? "1") || 1;
    const [listResult, metricsResult] = await Promise.all([
      listCertificatesForManage(ctx, { q: params.q, status: params.status, page }),
      getCertificateMetrics(ctx),
    ]);
    if (!listResult.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={listResult.message} />;
    const { rows, total, pageCount, page: currentPage } = listResult.data;
    const metrics = metricsResult.ok ? metricsResult.data : null;

    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title="إدارة الشهادات"
          subtitle="مراجعة المعلمين المستوفين لإصدار شهادات إتمام البرامج والدورات وإدارتها"
          actions={
            <Link
              href="/certificates/issue"
              className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
            >
              + إصدار شهادة
            </Link>
          }
        />

        {metrics ? (
          <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <StatTile label="إجمالي الشهادات" value={metrics.total} tone="brand" />
            <StatTile label="صادرة وسارية" value={metrics.active} tone="success" />
            <StatTile label="بانتظار الإصدار (أزواج مستوفية)" value={metrics.eligibleAwaiting ?? 0} tone="warning" />
            <StatTile label="مُلغاة" value={metrics.revoked} />
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <Card>
          <form className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3" method="get">
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="q">
                بحث
              </label>
              <input
                id="q"
                name="q"
                defaultValue={params.q ?? ""}
                placeholder="رقم الشهادة أو العنوان أو اسم المعلم…"
                className="w-72 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="status">
                الحالة
              </label>
              <select
                id="status"
                name="status"
                defaultValue={params.status ?? ""}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
              >
                <option value="">الكل</option>
                <option value="ISSUED">صادرة</option>
                <option value="REVOKED">مُلغاة</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              تصفية
            </button>
          </form>

          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              title="لا توجد شهادات مطابقة"
              hint="ابدأ بمراجعة المعلمين المستوفين وإصدار الشهادات من زر «إصدار شهادة»."
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">رقم الشهادة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">العنوان</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المعلم</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المحتوى</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">تاريخ الإصدار</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الحالة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المُصدر</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium"></th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {rows.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/60">
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <span dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                          {row.certificateNumber}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <p className="max-w-56 font-medium text-slate-800">{row.titleAr}</p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.teacherName}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.contentTitle ?? "—"}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{formatDate(row.issuedAt)}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                          <CertificateStatusBadge status={row.status} />
                          {row.effectiveStatus === "EXPIRED" ? (
                            <EffectiveStatusBadge status={row.effectiveStatus} />
                          ) : null}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{row.issuerName ?? "—"}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <Link
                          href={`/certificates/${row.id}`}
                          className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline"
                        >
                          التفاصيل
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          {pageCount > 1 ? (
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">

                الصفحة {currentPage} من {pageCount} — {total} شهادة

                    التالي
                  </Link>
                ) : null}
              </div>

          ) : null}
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* Supervisor — read-only certificates of assigned teachers          */
  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  if (user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const params = await searchParams;
    const result = await listCertificatesForSupervisor(
      { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
      { q: params.q, status: params.status, page: Number(params.page ?? "1") || 1 }
    );
    if (!result.ok) {
      return <AccessDenied hint={result.message ?? "غير مصرح"} />;
    }

    return (
      <div>

          title="شهادات معلميّ"
          subtitle="قراءة فقط — شهادات معلميك المسندين. الإصدار والإلغاء من صلاحيات إدارة المدرسة."
        />

              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="q">
                بحث
              </label>
              <input
                id="q"
                name="q"
                defaultValue={params.q ?? ""}
                placeholder="رقم الشهادة أو العنوان أو اسم المعلم…"
                className="w-72 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
              />

            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="status">
                الحالة
              </label>
              <select
                id="status"
                name="status"
                defaultValue={params.status ?? ""}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
              >
                <option value="">الكل</option>
                <option value="ISSUED">صادرة</option>
                <option value="REVOKED">مُلغاة</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              تصفية
            </button>
          </form>

          {result.rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              title="لا توجد شهادات لمعلميك بعد"
              hint="ستظهر هنا شهادات معلميك المسندين فور إصدارها من إدارة المدرسة."
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">رقم الشهادة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">العنوان</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المعلم</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المحتوى</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">تاريخ الإصدار</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الحالة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium"></th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {result.rows.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/60">
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <span dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                          {row.certificateNumber}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <p className="max-w-56 font-medium text-slate-800">{row.titleAr}</p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.teacherName}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.contentTitle ?? "—"}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{formatDate(row.issuedAt)}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                          <CertificateStatusBadge status={row.status} />
                          {row.effectiveStatus === "EXPIRED" ? (
                            <EffectiveStatusBadge status={row.effectiveStatus} />
                          ) : null}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3">
                        <Link
                          href={`/certificates/${row.id}`}

                        </Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}

          )}

                  </Link>
                ) : null}
                {result.page < result.pageCount ? (
                  <Link href={`/certificates?page=${result.page + 1}`} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50">
                    التالي
                  </Link>
                ) : null}
              </div>

          ) : null}
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* Platform owner — read-only cross-school register                  */

/**

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 8 — revocation control (office manager only by service guard).
 * Requires an explicit reason (Zod-validated server-side); the
 * conditional updateMany flip in the service makes double-revocation
 * impossible even if two admins submit simultaneously.
 */
import { useActionState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect } from "react";

import {
  revokeCertificateAction,
  type CertificateActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/certificates";

export function RevokeForm({ certificateId }: { certificateId: string }) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<CertificateActionState, FormData>(
    revokeCertificateAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.ok) router.refresh();
  }, [state.ok, router]);

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="no-print flex flex-col gap-2">
      <input type="hidden" name="certificateId" value={certificateId} />
      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="revoke-reason">
        سبب إلغاء الشهادة (يُسجَّل في سجل التدقيق)
      </label>
      <textarea
        id="revoke-reason"
        name="reason"
        rows={3}
        required
        placeholder="مثال: تبين عدم استيفاء متطلبات الإتمام بعد إعادة التدقيق"
        className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
      />
      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
        className="w-fit rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-red-700 disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        {pending ? "جارٍ الإلغاء…" : "إلغاء الشهادة نهائيًا"}
      </button>
      {state.message ? (
        <p className={`text-xs ${state.ok ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-red-600"}`}>
          {state.message}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </form>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 8 — small server-safe presentational helpers shared by the
 * certificate pages (no client directives here). Generic building
 * blocks (PageHeader, Card, StatTile, EmptyState, AccessDenied,
 * formatDate) are reused from the Phase 7 assignments UI module.
 */
import {
  CERTIFICATE_STATUS_CLASSES,
  CERTIFICATE_STATUS_LABELS,
  EFFECTIVE_STATUS_CLASSES,
  EFFECTIVE_STATUS_LABELS,
  type CertificateStatus,
  type CertificateEffectiveStatus,
} from "@/config/certificates";

/** Date-only Arabic formatting (certificates never print time-of-day). */
export function formatIssueDate(date: Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "long",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(date);
}

export function CertificateStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const label =
    CERTIFICATE_STATUS_LABELS[status as CertificateStatus] ?? status;
  const cls =
    CERTIFICATE_STATUS_CLASSES[status as CertificateStatus] ??
    "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${cls}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Shows ISSUED / REVOKED / EXPIRED (expiry derived from expiresAt). */
export function EffectiveStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const label =
    EFFECTIVE_STATUS_LABELS[status as CertificateEffectiveStatus] ?? status;
  const cls =
    EFFECTIVE_STATUS_CLASSES[status as CertificateEffectiveStatus] ??
    "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200";
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${cls}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\app\dashboard\page.tsx

/**
 * Phase 10 — لوحة التحكم role-adaptive dashboard router.
 *
 * One route, five server-side views. The role comes from the session —
 * never from a query param — and each view queries only what that role
 * may see:
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                → platform-wide aggregates (read-only)
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER → own-school operational dashboard
 *   EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY         → granted schools (read-only)
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     → assigned teachers + granted branches
 *   TEACHER                    → personal records only
 */
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { toAnalyticsActor } from "@/lib/analytics/access";
import { AccessDenied } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { PlatformDashboardView } from "@/app/dashboard/platform-view";
import { SchoolDashboardView } from "@/app/dashboard/school-view";
import { SupervisorDashboardView } from "@/app/dashboard/supervisor-view";
import { TeacherDashboardView } from "@/app/dashboard/teacher-view";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const actor = toAnalyticsActor(user);
  if (!actor) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="دور الحساب غير معروف — راجع مدير المنصة." />;
  }

  if (actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return <PlatformDashboardView actor={actor} />;
  }
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    return <SchoolDashboardView actor={actor} />;
  }
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return <SupervisorDashboardView actor={actor} />;
  }
  return <TeacherDashboardView />;
}

/**

 * operational view of their school) and EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY (same

 * All figures come from computeSchoolStats — explicit denominators,

    { href: "/analytics", label: "التحليلات والمؤشرات" },
    { href: "/reports", label: "مركز التقارير" },

        ]
      : []),
    { href: "/impact", label: "قياس الأثر" },
    { href: "/growth", label: "النمو المهني" },

        <StatTile label="الالتحاقات النشطة" value={stats.enrollmentsTotal} />
        <StatTile
          label="نسبة الالتحاق"
          value={stats.enrollmentRatePercent === null ? "—" : `${stats.enrollmentRatePercent}%`}
          tone="success"
          hint="معلمون بالتحاق واحد على الأقل ÷ المعلمون النشطون"
        />
        <StatTile
          label="استيفاء متطلبات الدورات"
          value={stats.coursesCompletedPairs}
          hint="نفس قاعدة أهلية الشهادات"
        />
        <StatTile label="برامج منشورة" value={stats.programsPublished} />
        <StatTile label="دورات منشورة" value={stats.coursesPublished} />
      </div>

      <SectionTitle>التقييمات</SectionTitle>

        <Link href="/reports" className="font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">

/**
 * Phase 10 — EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR dashboard: restricted to assigned
 * teachers + granted branches. Surfaces exactly what requires
 * supervisory action: submissions awaiting review, manual-review
 * attempts, overdue/upcoming follow-ups, and covered teachers'
 * progress (reusing the growth roster rules — one source of truth).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import type { AnalyticsActor } from "@/lib/analytics/access";
import { getSupervisorDashboard } from "@/lib/analytics/service";
import { FOLLOW_UP_STATUS_LABELS, type FollowUpStatus } from "@/config/surveys";
import { AccessDenied, Card, EmptyState, PageHeader, StatTile } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { DashboardLinks, DataTable, SectionTitle } from "@/app/dashboard/ui";

function formatDate(date: Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(date);
}

export async function SupervisorDashboardView({ actor }: { actor: AnalyticsActor }) {
  const result = await getSupervisorDashboard(actor);
  if (!result.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  const stats = result.data;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="لوحة التحكم — المشرف التربوي"
        subtitle={`${stats.scopeLabel} — ${stats.coverageTeacherCount} معلمًا عبر ${stats.coverageBranchCount} فرعًا ممنوحًا`}
      />

      <DashboardLinks
        links={[
          { href: "/analytics", label: "التحليلات والمؤشرات" },

          { href: "/archive", label: "الأرشيف" },
          { href: "/assignments/review", label: "مراجعة التسليمات" },
          { href: "/surveys/new", label: "استبيان جديد" },
          { href: "/follow-ups/new", label: "متابعة جديدة" },
        ]}
      />

      <SectionTitle>مهام تنتظر إجراءك</SectionTitle>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <StatTile label="تسليمات بانتظار المراجعة" value={stats.submissionsPendingReview} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="محاولات بانتظار التصحيح اليدوي" value={stats.attemptsNeedingReview} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="متابعات متأخرة" value={stats.followUpsOverdue} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="متابعات قادمة (14 يومًا)" value={stats.upcomingFollowUps.length} tone="brand" />
        <StatTile
          label="متوسط نتائج معلميك"
          value={stats.avgPercentage === null ? "—" : `${stats.avgPercentage}%`}
          hint="المحاولات النهائية لمعلمي النطاق"
        />
      </div>

      <SectionTitle>قائمة المراجعة — أحدث التسليمات</SectionTitle>
      <Card>
        {stats.pendingReviewSample.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لا توجد تسليمات بانتظار المراجعة" hint="عندما يرسل معلموك تسليمات ستظهر هنا." />
        ) : (
          <DataTable headers={["التكليف", "المعلم", "آخر إرسال", "إجراء"]}>

                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{row.teacherName}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-500">{formatDate(row.lastSubmittedAt)}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <Link href="/assignments/review" className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                    فتح قائمة المراجعة

                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </DataTable>
        )}
      </Card>

      <SectionTitle>متابعات قادمة</SectionTitle>

                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{row.teacherName}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-500">{formatDate(row.followUpDate)}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">
                  {FOLLOW_UP_STATUS_LABELS[row.status as FollowUpStatus] ?? row.status}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </DataTable>
        )}
      </Card>

      <SectionTitle>نطاق الإشراف بالأرقام</SectionTitle>
