/**
 * Phase 10 — TEACHER personal dashboard. Every query is bound to the
 * signed-in user id; other teachers' records and school-wide data are
 * structurally out of reach (the data functions filter by userId —
 * there is no scope flag a payload could widen).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getTeacherDashboard } from "@/lib/analytics/service";
import { AccessDenied, Card, EmptyState, PageHeader, StatTile } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { DashboardLinks, DataTable, SectionTitle } from "@/app/dashboard/ui";

function formatDate(date: Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!date) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(date);
}

export async function TeacherDashboardView() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || user.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return <AccessDenied hint="لوحة المعلم متاحة لحسابات المعلمين فقط." />;
  }
  const result = await getTeacherDashboard({ id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId });
  if (!result.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  const stats = result.data;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="لوحتي"
        subtitle="مؤشراتك الشخصية من بياناتك أنت فقط — لا تظهر هنا بيانات زملائك أو أرقام عامة للمدرسة"
      />

      <DashboardLinks
        links={[
          { href: "/my-assignments", label: "تكليفاتي" },
          { href: "/my-surveys", label: "استبياناتي" },
          { href: "/my-certificates", label: "شهاداتي" },
          { href: "/my-growth", label: "نموي المهني" },
          { href: "/my-follow-ups", label: "متابعاتي المشتركة" },
        ]}
      />

      <SectionTitle>دوراتي وتقدمي</SectionTitle>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <StatTile label="دوراتي النشطة" value={stats.courses.length} tone="brand" />
        <StatTile label="دورات استوفت متطلباتها" value={stats.coursesCompleted} tone="success" />
        <StatTile label="تقييمات متاحة قبل أن أجرّبها" value={stats.availableAssessments} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="محاولاتي النهائية" value={stats.attemptsFinalized} />
        <StatTile label="محاولات ناجحة" value={stats.attemptsPassed} tone="success" />
        <StatTile
          label="متوسط نتائجي"
          value={stats.avgPercentage === null ? "—" : `${stats.avgPercentage}%`}
          hint="محاولاتي النهائية فقط"
        />
      </div>

      <SectionTitle>دوراتي</SectionTitle>
      <Card>
        {stats.courses.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لست ملتحقًا بدورات بعد" hint="ستظهر دوراتك هنا بمجرد التحاقك من أكاديمية التدريب." />
        ) : (
          <DataTable headers={["الدورة", "البرنامج", "المدرب", "الحالة"]}>
            {stats.courses.map((course) => (
              <tr key={course.courseId} className="border-b border-slate-100">
                <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-slate-700">{course.titleAr}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{course.programName ?? "—"}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{course.instructorName ?? "—"}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <span
                    className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                      course.completed
                        ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
                        : "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-[#1D5BD6]"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {course.completed ? "استوفيت المتطلبات" : "قيد التقدم"}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </DataTable>
        )}
      </Card>

      <SectionTitle>تكليفاتي</SectionTitle>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatTile label="بانتظار إنجازي / مُعادة" value={stats.assignmentsPending} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="مرسلة بانتظار التصحيح" value={stats.assignmentsAwaitingReview} />
        <StatTile label="مصححة" value={stats.assignmentsGraded} tone="success" />
        <StatTile label="استبيانات تنتظر ردي" value={stats.surveysAwaiting} tone="brand" />
      </div>

      <SectionTitle>أحدث ملاحظات المصححين</SectionTitle>
      <Card>
        {stats.recentFeedback.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لا توجد ملاحظات تصحيح بعد" hint="ستظهر ملاحظات المصحح على تسليماتك هنا بعد التصحيح." />
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {stats.recentFeedback.map((feedback, index) => (
              <div
                key={`${feedback.assignmentTitle}-${index}`}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/60 p-3"
              >
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">{feedback.assignmentTitle}</p>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]" dir="ltr">
                    {feedback.scoreTotal ?? "—"}/{feedback.totalPoints}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {feedback.feedbackText ? (
                  <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-line text-xs text-slate-600">{feedback.feedbackText}</p>
                ) : null}
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">صُحح في {formatDate(feedback.reviewedAt)}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <SectionTitle>أحدث نتائجي في التقييمات</SectionTitle>
      <Card>
        {stats.recentAttempts.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لا توجد محاولات تقييم منتهية بعد" />
        ) : (
          <DataTable headers={["التقييم", "النسبة", "النتيجة", "التاريخ"]}>
            {stats.recentAttempts.map((attempt, index) => (
              <tr key={`${attempt.assessmentTitle}-${index}`} className="border-b border-slate-100">
                <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-slate-700">{attempt.assessmentTitle}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600" dir="ltr">
                  {attempt.percentage === null ? "—" : `${attempt.percentage}%`}
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <span
                    className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                      attempt.passed
                        ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700"
                        : "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-600"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {attempt.passed ? "ناجحة" : "غير ناجحة"}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-500">{formatDate(attempt.submittedAt)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </DataTable>
        )}
      </Card>

      <SectionTitle>شهاداتي ومتابعاتي المشتركة</SectionTitle>
      <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <Card title="شهاداتي">
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">{stats.certificatesActive}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">شهادات سارية</p>
          <Link href="/my-certificates" className="mt-3 inline-block text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
            عرض شهاداتي وطباعتها
          </Link>
        </Card>
        <Card title="متابعات مشتركة من مشرفي">
          {stats.sharedFollowUpsCount === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="لا توجد متابعات مشتركة حاليًا" hint="المشرف يشارك ما يختاره صراحةً فقط." />
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">{stats.sharedFollowUpsCount}</p>
              <Link href="/my-follow-ups" className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                عرض التفاصيل المشتركة
              </Link>
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>

      <SectionTitle>نشاطي — ستة أشهر</SectionTitle>
      <Card>
        <p className="mb-3 text-xs text-slate-500">

        </p>

/**
 * Phase 10 — server-safe chart & indicator primitives for dashboards
 * and the analytics page. Pure SVG/div rendering (no client JS, no new
 * dependencies), RTL-safe, brand blue only. Every renderer shows an
 * honest empty state when its dataset is empty — charts are never
 * fabricated to look populated.
 */
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

import type { TrendSeries } from "@/lib/analytics/service";

/** Multi-series trend line chart (SVG polyline over a fixed month grid). */
export function TrendChart({
  series,
  labels,
  height = 140,
}: {
  series: { name: string; values: number[]; color: string }[];
  labels: string[];
  height?: number;
}) {
  const width = 320;
  const padding = 8;
  const max = Math.max(1, ...series.flatMap((entry) => entry.values));
  const stepX = (width - padding * 2) / Math.max(1, labels.length - 1);
  const hasAnyData = series.some((entry) => entry.values.some((value) => value > 0));

  if (!hasAnyData) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 p-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
        لا توجد بيانات في نافذة الأشهر الستة الأخيرة — سيظهر المنحنى تلقائيًا عند تسجيل أنشطة.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const pointsFor = (values: number[]) =>
    values
      .map((value, index) => {
        const x = padding + index * stepX;
        const y = height - padding - (value / max) * (height - padding * 2);
        return `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`;
      })
      .join(" ");

  return (
    <div dir="ltr" className="w-full">
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} className="w-full" role="img" aria-label="منحنى الاتجاه الزمني">
        {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75].map((fraction) => (
          <line
            key={fraction}
            x1={padding}
            x2={width - padding}
            y1={height - padding - fraction * (height - padding * 2)}
            y2={height - padding - fraction * (height - padding * 2)}
            stroke="#e2e8f0"
            strokeWidth="1"
          />
        ))}
        <line x1={padding} x2={width - padding} y1={height - padding} y2={height - padding} stroke="#cbd5e1" strokeWidth="1" />
        {series.map((entry) => (
          <g key={entry.name}>
            <polyline
              points={pointsFor(entry.values)}
              fill="none"
              stroke={entry.color}
              strokeWidth="2.5"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
            {entry.values.map((value, index) => {
              const x = padding + index * stepX;
              const y = height - padding - (value / max) * (height - padding * 2);
              return <circle key={`${entry.name}-${index}`} cx={x} cy={y} r="3" fill={entry.color} />;
            })}
          </g>
        ))}
      </svg>
      <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between px-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400" dir="rtl">
        {labels.map((label) => (
          <span key={label}>{label}</span>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3" dir="rtl">
        {series.map((entry) => (
          <span key={entry.name} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
            <span aria-hidden className="inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: entry.color }} />
            {entry.name}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const TREND_COLORS = {
  enrollments: "#1D5BD6",
  submissions: "#0ea5e9",
  certificates: "#059669",
  surveyResponses: "#d97706",
} as const;

const TREND_NAMES: Record<keyof typeof TREND_COLORS, string> = {
  enrollments: "الالتحاقات",
  submissions: "التسليمات",
  certificates: "الشهادات",
  surveyResponses: "ردود الاستبيانات",
};

/** Standard 4-series activity chart used by platform & school views. */
export function ActivityTrendChart({ trends }: { trends: TrendSeries }) {
  return (
    <TrendChart
      labels={trends.labels}
      series={[
        { name: TREND_NAMES.enrollments, values: trends.enrollments, color: TREND_COLORS.enrollments },
        { name: TREND_NAMES.submissions, values: trends.submissions, color: TREND_COLORS.submissions },
        { name: TREND_NAMES.certificates, values: trends.certificates, color: TREND_COLORS.certificates },
        { name: TREND_NAMES.surveyResponses, values: trends.surveyResponses, color: TREND_COLORS.surveyResponses },
      ]}
    />
  );
}

/** Horizontal bar list (RTL-safe: bars grow from the right). */
export function BarList({
  items,
  emptyMessage = "لا توجد بيانات بعد",
}: {
  items: { label: string; value: number; hint?: string }[];
  emptyMessage?: string;
}) {
  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 p-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
        {emptyMessage}
      </div>
    );
  }
  const max = Math.max(1, ...items.map((item) => item.value));
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2.5">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <div key={item.label}>
          <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{item.label}</span>
            <span dir="ltr" className="text-slate-500">
              {item.value}
              {item.hint ? <span className="mr-1 text-slate-400">({item.hint})</span> : null}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100">
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-[#1D5BD6]"
              style={{ width: `${Math.round((item.value / max) * 100)}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Rate chip with an explicit denominator note (null → honest dash). */
export function RateChip({ label, percent, note }: { label: string; percent: number | null; note?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/60 px-3 py-2">
      <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900" dir="ltr">
        {percent === null ? "—" : `${percent}%`}
      </p>
      {note ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-400">{note}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Section heading inside dashboards. */
export function SectionTitle({ children, action }: { children: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-3 mt-8 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 first:mt-0">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">{children}</h2>
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Shared quick-links strip (only links the role may actually open). */

  return (
    <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {links.map((link) => (
        <Link
          key={link.href}
          href={link.href}
          className="rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-blue-50"
        >
          {link.label}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DataTable({
  headers,
  children,
  emptyMessage,
}: {
  headers: string[];
  children: ReactNode;
  emptyMessage?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto">

          <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {headers.map((header) => (
              <th key={header} className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">
                {header}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>{children}</tbody>
      </table>

/**
 * Phase 9 — follow-up edit page (operational roles with edit rights).
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { listFollowUpFormOptions, listFollowUpLinkOptions } from "@/lib/followups/service";
import { getFollowUpManageView } from "@/lib/followups/service";
import { listSurveyLinkOptions } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import { AccessDenied, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import FollowUpForm, { type FollowUpFormInitial } from "@/app/follow-ups/follow-up-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null }): SurveyActor | null {
  if (user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

export default async function EditFollowUpPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="تعديل سجلات المتابعة متاح لمديري المكاتب والمشرفين التربويين فقط." />;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const [viewResult, formOptions, linkOptions, surveyOptions] = await Promise.all([
    getFollowUpManageView(ctx, id),
    listFollowUpFormOptions(ctx),
    listFollowUpLinkOptions(ctx),
    listSurveyLinkOptions(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!viewResult.ok) {
    if (viewResult.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return <AccessDenied hint={viewResult.message} />;
  }
  if (!formOptions.ok || !linkOptions.ok || !surveyOptions.ok) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="تعذر تحميل بيانات النموذج." />;
  }

  const view = viewResult.data;
  if (!view.canEdit) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="لا تملك صلاحية تعديل هذا السجل." />;
  }

  const initial: FollowUpFormInitial = {
    teacherId: view.teacherId,
    supervisorId: view.supervisorId,
    titleAr: view.titleAr,
    purposeAr: view.purposeAr ?? "",
    followUpDate: view.followUpDate.toISOString(),
    nextFollowUpAt: view.nextFollowUpAt ? view.nextFollowUpAt.toISOString() : "",
    programId: view.programId ?? "",
    courseId: view.courseId ?? "",
    surveyId: view.surveyId ?? "",
    assignmentId: view.assignmentId ?? "",
    observationAr: view.observationAr ?? "",
    progressAr: view.progressAr ?? "",
    challengesAr: view.challengesAr ?? "",
    supportNeedsAr: view.supportNeedsAr ?? "",
    recommendationsAr: view.recommendationsAr ?? "",
    sharedWithTeacher: view.sharedWithTeacher,
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="تعديل سجل المتابعة"
        subtitle="تحديث بيانات المتابعة — يُسجَّل التعديل في سجل التاريخ"
        actions={
          <Link href={`/follow-ups/${id}`} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
            رجوع للتفاصيل
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <FollowUpForm
        mode="edit"
        followUpId={id}
        initial={initial}
        isOfficeManager={ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"}
        options={{
          teachers: formOptions.data.teachers,
          supervisors: formOptions.data.supervisors,
          programs: linkOptions.data.programs,
          courses: linkOptions.data.courses,
          surveys: surveyOptions.data,
          assignments: linkOptions.data.assignments,
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 9 — follow-up record actions: status transitions + sharing
 * toggle. Server re-checks role, scope and transition validity.

import { useActionState } from "react";

import {
  changeFollowUpStatusAction,
  setFollowUpSharingAction,
  type SurveyActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/surveys";

export default function FollowUpActions({
  followUpId,
  status,
  sharedWithTeacher,
}: {
  followUpId: string;
  status: string;
  sharedWithTeacher: boolean;
}) {
  const [statusState, statusAction, statusPending] = useActionState<SurveyActionState, FormData>(
    changeFollowUpStatusAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const [shareState, shareAction, sharePending] = useActionState<SurveyActionState, FormData>(
    setFollowUpSharingAction,
    { ok: false }
  );

  const terminal = status === "COMPLETED" || status === "CANCELLED";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {statusState.message && !statusState.ok ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">{statusState.message}</div>
      ) : null}
      {statusState.ok ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-emerald-700">
          تم تحديث الحالة — حدّث الصفحة.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <form action={statusAction} className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <input type="hidden" name="followUpId" value={followUpId} />
        {status === "PLANNED" ? (
          <button
            type="submit" name="status" value="IN_PROGRESS" disabled={statusPending}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            بدء التنفيذ
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {status === "PLANNED" || status === "IN_PROGRESS" ? (
          <>
            <button
              type="submit" name="status" value="COMPLETED" disabled={statusPending}
              className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-100 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              إنهاء (مكتملة)
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit" name="status" value="CANCELLED" disabled={statusPending}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              إلغاء
            </button>
          </>
        ) : null}
        {terminal ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">هذا السجل نهائي — أنشئ سجل متابعة جديدًا لمواصلة الدورة.</p>
        ) : null}
      </form>

      {shareState.message && !shareState.ok ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">{shareState.message}</div>
      ) : null}
      {shareState.ok ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-emerald-700">
          تم تحديث المشاركة — حدّث الصفحة.
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <form action={shareAction}>
        <input type="hidden" name="followUpId" value={followUpId} />
        <input type="hidden" name="shared" value={sharedWithTeacher ? "false" : "true"} />
        <button
          type="submit" disabled={sharePending}
          className={`rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-60 ${
            sharedWithTeacher
              ? "border-slate-300 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
              : "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-100"
          }`}
        >
          {sharePending ? "جارٍ التنفيذ…" : sharedWithTeacher ? "إيقاف المشاركة مع المعلم" : "مشاركة السجل مع المعلم"}
        </button>
      </form>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
        المشاركة تكشف للمعلم: العنوان والغرض والتواريخ والحالة والتوصيات فقط — الملاحظات الداخلية لا تُشارك أبدًا.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

    return <AccessDenied hint="سجلات المتابعة متاحة للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية فقط." />;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const result = await getFollowUpManageView(ctx, id);
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  }
  const view = result.data;
  const isDeputy = ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY";

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={view.titleAr}
        subtitle={`متابعة المعلم ${view.teacherName} — المسؤول: ${view.supervisorName}`}
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {view.canEdit ? (
              <Link
                href={`/follow-ups/${id}/edit`}
                className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                تعديل
              </Link>
            ) : null}
            <Link
              href="/follow-ups"
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              رجوع للقائمة
            </Link>
          </div>
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <FollowUpStatusBadge status={view.status} />
        <SharedBadge shared={view.sharedWithTeacher} />
        {isDeputy ? (
          <span className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">عرض للقراءة فقط</span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="space-y-6 lg:col-span-2">
          <Card>
            <h2 className="mb-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">بيانات السجل</h2>
            <dl className="grid gap-x-6 gap-y-3 text-sm md:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">تاريخ المتابعة</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 text-slate-700">{formatDate(view.followUpDate)}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">المتابعة القادمة</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 text-slate-700">{formatDate(view.nextFollowUpAt)}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">تاريخ الإكمال</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 text-slate-700">{formatDate(view.completedAt)}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">الغرض</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-line text-slate-700">{view.purposeAr ?? "—"}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">المحتوى المرتبط</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 text-slate-700">
                  {view.programTitle ?? view.courseTitle ?? view.assignmentTitle ?? "—"}
                  {view.surveyTitle ? (
                    <Link href={`/surveys/${view.surveyId}/results`} className="mr-2 text-xs font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline">
                      استبيان: {view.surveyTitle}
                    </Link>
                  ) : null}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <h2 className="mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">ملاحظات المشرف (سرية)</h2>
            <p className="mb-4 text-[11px] text-slate-400">هذه الملاحظات لا تظهر للمعلم في أي حال.</p>
            <dl className="space-y-4 text-sm">
              {[
                { label: "ملاحظات التطبيق الصفي", value: view.observationAr },
                { label: "التقدم المُلاحظ", value: view.progressAr },
                { label: "التحديات", value: view.challengesAr },
                { label: "احتياجات الدعم", value: view.supportNeedsAr },
              ].map((item) => (
                <div key={item.label}>
                  <dt className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">{item.label}</dt>
                  <dd className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-line rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3 text-slate-700">
                    {item.value ?? "—"}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">التوصيات (تُشارك عند التفعيل)</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-line rounded-lg bg-emerald-50/50 p-3 text-slate-700">
                  {view.recommendationsAr ?? "—"}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-6">
          {!isDeputy && view.canEdit ? (
            <Card>
              <h2 className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">إجراءات السجل</h2>
              <FollowUpActions followUpId={id} status={view.status} sharedWithTeacher={view.sharedWithTeacher} />
            </Card>
          ) : null}

          <Card>
            <h2 className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">سجل التاريخ</h2>
            {view.events.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">لا توجد أحداث.</p>
            ) : (
              <ol className="space-y-3">
                {view.events.map((event) => (
                  <li key={event.id} className="border-r-2 border-[#1D5BD6]/30 pr-3">
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">

                    </p>
                    {event.note ? <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">{event.note}</p> : null}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ol>
            )}
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 9 — follow-up create/edit form. The whole definition is
 * serialized to `definitionJson` and re-validated server-side
 * (teacher/supervisor/content links + scope). Supervisors are assigned
 * automatically server-side; the supervisor select appears only for
 * office managers.
 */
import { useActionState, useState } from "react";

import {
  createFollowUpAction,
  updateFollowUpAction,
  type SurveyActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/surveys";
import { FieldError } from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export interface FollowUpFormOptions {
  teachers: { id: string; name: string; branchName: string | null }[];
  supervisors: { id: string; name: string }[];
  programs: { id: string; nameAr: string }[];
  courses: { id: string; titleAr: string }[];
  surveys: { id: string; titleAr: string; stage: string | null }[];
  assignments: { id: string; titleAr: string }[];
}

export interface FollowUpFormInitial {
  teacherId: string;
  supervisorId: string;
  titleAr: string;
  purposeAr: string;
  followUpDate: string; // datetime-local value
  nextFollowUpAt: string;
  programId: string;
  courseId: string;
  surveyId: string;
  assignmentId: string;
  observationAr: string;
  progressAr: string;
  challengesAr: string;
  supportNeedsAr: string;
  recommendationsAr: string;
  sharedWithTeacher: boolean;
}

function toDateInput(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  const pad = (num: number) => String(num).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

export default function FollowUpForm({
  mode,
  followUpId,
  initial,
  options,
  isOfficeManager,
}: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  followUpId?: string;
  initial: FollowUpFormInitial;
  options: FollowUpFormOptions;
  isOfficeManager: boolean;
}) {
  const action = mode === "create" ? createFollowUpAction : updateFollowUpAction;
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<SurveyActionState, FormData>(action, { ok: false });

  const [teacherId, setTeacherId] = useState(initial.teacherId);
  const [supervisorId, setSupervisorId] = useState(initial.supervisorId);
  const [titleAr, setTitleAr] = useState(initial.titleAr);
  const [purposeAr, setPurposeAr] = useState(initial.purposeAr);
  const [followUpDate, setFollowUpDate] = useState(toDateInput(initial.followUpDate || null));
  const [nextFollowUpAt, setNextFollowUpAt] = useState(toDateInput(initial.nextFollowUpAt || null));
  const [programId, setProgramId] = useState(initial.programId);
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState(initial.courseId);
  const [surveyId, setSurveyId] = useState(initial.surveyId);
  const [assignmentId, setAssignmentId] = useState(initial.assignmentId);
  const [observationAr, setObservationAr] = useState(initial.observationAr);
  const [progressAr, setProgressAr] = useState(initial.progressAr);
  const [challengesAr, setChallengesAr] = useState(initial.challengesAr);
  const [supportNeedsAr, setSupportNeedsAr] = useState(initial.supportNeedsAr);
  const [recommendationsAr, setRecommendationsAr] = useState(initial.recommendationsAr);
  const [sharedWithTeacher, setSharedWithTeacher] = useState(initial.sharedWithTeacher);

  function buildDefinitionJson(): string {
    return JSON.stringify({
      teacherId,
      supervisorId: supervisorId === "" ? null : supervisorId,
      titleAr,
      purposeAr,
      followUpDate: followUpDate === "" ? "" : new Date(followUpDate).toISOString(),
      nextFollowUpAt: nextFollowUpAt === "" ? null : new Date(nextFollowUpAt).toISOString(),
      programId: programId === "" ? null : programId,
      courseId: courseId === "" ? null : courseId,
      surveyId: surveyId === "" ? null : surveyId,
      assignmentId: assignmentId === "" ? null : assignmentId,
      observationAr,
      progressAr,
      challengesAr,
      supportNeedsAr,
      recommendationsAr,
      sharedWithTeacher,
    });
  }

  const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";
  const labelClass = "mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500";

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-6">
      <input type="hidden" name="definitionJson" value={buildDefinitionJson()} />
      {mode === "edit" ? <input type="hidden" name="followUpId" value={followUpId ?? ""} /> : null}

      {state.ok ? null : state.message ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{state.message}</div>
      ) : null}

      <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="mb-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">بيانات المتابعة</h2>
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>المعلم *</label>
            <select className={inputClass} value={teacherId} onChange={(event) => setTeacherId(event.target.value)}>
              <option value="">— اختر المعلم —</option>
              {options.teachers.map((teacher) => (
                <option key={teacher.id} value={teacher.id}>
                  {teacher.name}{teacher.branchName ? ` — ${teacher.branchName}` : ""}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.teacherId} />
          </div>
          {isOfficeManager ? (
            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>المشرف المسؤول *</label>
              <select className={inputClass} value={supervisorId} onChange={(event) => setSupervisorId(event.target.value)}>
                <option value="">— اختر المشرف —</option>
                {options.supervisors.map((supervisor) => (
                  <option key={supervisor.id} value={supervisor.id}>{supervisor.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.supervisorId} />
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <div className="md:col-span-2">
            <label className={labelClass}>عنوان المتابعة *</label>
            <input className={inputClass} value={titleAr} onChange={(event) => setTitleAr(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.titleAr} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>تاريخ المتابعة *</label>
            <input type="datetime-local" className={inputClass} value={followUpDate} onChange={(event) => setFollowUpDate(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.followUpDate} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>موعد المتابعة القادمة (اختياري)</label>
            <input type="datetime-local" className={inputClass} value={nextFollowUpAt} onChange={(event) => setNextFollowUpAt(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.nextFollowUpAt} />
          </div>

        <h2 className="mb-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">الربط التدريبي (اختياري)</h2>

              {options.programs.map((program) => (
                <option key={program.id} value={program.id}>{program.nameAr}</option>
              ))}
            </select>

            <label className={labelClass}>الدورة التدريبية</label>

/**
 * Phase 9 — "سجل متابعة جديد" (office manager / supervisor).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { listFollowUpFormOptions, listFollowUpLinkOptions } from "@/lib/followups/service";
import { listSurveyLinkOptions } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import { AccessDenied, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import FollowUpForm, { type FollowUpFormInitial } from "@/app/follow-ups/follow-up-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null }): SurveyActor | null {
  if (user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

const EMPTY_INITIAL: FollowUpFormInitial = {
  teacherId: "",
  supervisorId: "",
  titleAr: "",
  purposeAr: "",
  followUpDate: "",
  nextFollowUpAt: "",
  programId: "",
  courseId: "",
  surveyId: "",
  assignmentId: "",
  observationAr: "",
  progressAr: "",
  challengesAr: "",
  supportNeedsAr: "",
  recommendationsAr: "",
  sharedWithTeacher: false,
};

export default async function NewFollowUpPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="إنشاء سجلات المتابعة متاح لمديري المكاتب والمشرفين التربويين فقط." />;
  }

  const [formOptions, linkOptions, surveyOptions] = await Promise.all([
    listFollowUpFormOptions(ctx),
    listFollowUpLinkOptions(ctx),
    listSurveyLinkOptions(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!formOptions.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={formOptions.message} />;
  if (!linkOptions.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={linkOptions.message} />;
  if (!surveyOptions.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={surveyOptions.message} />;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="سجل متابعة جديد"
        subtitle="توثيق زيارة متابعة التطبيق الصفي بعد نشاط تدريبي — الملاحظات الداخلية سرية"
        actions={
          <Link href="/follow-ups" className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
            رجوع للقائمة
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <FollowUpForm
        mode="create"
        initial={EMPTY_INITIAL}
        isOfficeManager={ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"}
        options={{
          teachers: formOptions.data.teachers,
          supervisors: formOptions.data.supervisors,
          programs: linkOptions.data.programs,
          courses: linkOptions.data.courses,
          surveys: surveyOptions.data,
          assignments: linkOptions.data.assignments,
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — "متابعة التطبيق" list: follow-up records within the
 * actor's real scope (manager = school, supervisor = responsible-or-
 * covered, deputy = read-only within grants), with status/upcoming
 * filters and summary tiles.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { getFollowUpMetrics, listFollowUps } from "@/lib/followups/service";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  StatTile,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { FollowUpStatusBadge, SharedBadge } from "@/app/follow-ups/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null }): SurveyActor | null {
  if (
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
  ) {
    return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

export default async function FollowUpsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ status?: string; teacherId?: string; upcoming?: string; page?: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="سجلات المتابعة متاحة للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية فقط — للمعلّم: السجلات المشتركة معك في «سجلات المتابعة»." />;
  }

  const params = await searchParams;
  const page = Number(params.page ?? "1") || 1;
  const [listResult, metricsResult] = await Promise.all([
    listFollowUps(ctx, {
      status: params.status,
      teacherId: params.teacherId,
      upcoming: params.upcoming,
      page,
    }),
    getFollowUpMetrics(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!listResult.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={listResult.message} />;
  const { rows, total, pageCount, page: currentPage } = listResult.data;
  const metrics = metricsResult.ok ? metricsResult.data : null;
  const isDeputy = ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY";

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="متابعة التطبيق"
        subtitle={
          isDeputy

                      </Link>

                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {pageCount > 1 ? (

            <span>الصفحة {currentPage} من {pageCount} — {total} سجل</span>

/**

import { FOLLOW_UP_STATUS_LABELS, type FollowUpStatus } from "@/config/surveys";

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<FollowUpStatus, string> = {
  PLANNED: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border-sky-200",
  IN_PROGRESS: "bg-blue-50 text-[#1D5BD6] border-blue-200",
  COMPLETED: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200",
  CANCELLED: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border-slate-200",
};

export function FollowUpStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const label = FOLLOW_UP_STATUS_LABELS[status as FollowUpStatus] ?? status;
  const style = STATUS_STYLES[status as FollowUpStatus] ?? STATUS_STYLES.PLANNED;
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${style}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function SharedBadge({ shared }: { shared: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
        shared ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-500"
      }`}
    >
      {shared ? "مشترك مع المعلم" : "غير مشترك"}
    </span>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import { KeyRound, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { forgotPasswordAction, type AuthFormState } from "@/app/actions/auth";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

function SubmitButton() {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return (
    <Button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending}
      className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-l from-brand-600 to-brand-500 text-[15px] font-bold shadow-lg shadow-brand-600/25 transition-all hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-brand-600/30 hover:brightness-105 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
    >
      {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
      {pending ? "جارٍ الإرسال…" : "إرسال رابط إعادة التعيين"}
    </Button>
  );
}

/**
 * Forgot-password form — the server response is ALWAYS generic (it never
 * discloses whether the address belongs to an account), so the UI simply
 * renders whatever honest message the action returns.
 */
export function ForgotPasswordForm() {
  const [state, formAction] = React.useActionState<AuthFormState | null, FormData>(
    forgotPasswordAction,
    null
  );

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-5" noValidate>
      {state && !state.ok && !state.message?.includes("صحيحًا") && state.message && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-success"
        >
          {state.message}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label htmlFor="forgot-email" className="text-[13px] font-semibold">
          البريد الإلكتروني
        </label>
        <Input
          id="forgot-email"
          name="email"
          type="email"
          dir="ltr"
          autoComplete="email"
          placeholder="name@school.edu"
          required
          aria-invalid={Boolean(state?.fieldErrors?.email)}
          aria-describedby={
            state?.fieldErrors?.email ? "forgot-email-error" : undefined
          }
          className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-background text-[15px] aria-[invalid=true]:border-destructive"
        />
        {state?.fieldErrors?.email && (
          <p id="forgot-email-error" className="text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
            {state.fieldErrors.email}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <SubmitButton />

      {state?.ok && state.message && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold leading-relaxed text-success"
        >
          {state.message}
        </p>
      )}
      {state && !state.ok && state.message?.includes("صحيحًا") && (
        <p
          role="alert"
          className="rounded-xl border border-error/30 bg-error-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-error"
        >
          {state.message}
        </p>
      )}

      <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
        لم يصلك الرابط؟ تحقق من مجلد الرسائل غير المرغوبة، أو تواصل مع
        تقنية المعلومات في مدرستك — يمكن للمنسق إرسال رابط استعادة مباشرة
        إلى بريدك المسجل.
      </p>
    </form>
  );
}

export const metadata = {
  title: "استعادة كلمة المرور | منارة قرطبة",
};

/**
 * Public "forgot password" gate — the page the login screen links to
 * (this route was previously dangling: the action existed, the login
 * link pointed here, but no page rendered it).
 *
 * The optional ?school={slug|id} context (carried by the login footer
 * link) only resolves PUBLIC branding fields — same contract as the
 * login page — so the recovery screen keeps the school's identity
 * without exposing any tenant data.
 */
export default async function ForgotPasswordPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ school?: string }>;
}) {
  const { school } = await searchParams;
  const resolved = await resolvePublicBranding(school);
  const wrapperStyle = resolved.cssVars as CSSProperties;

  const loginHref = resolved.school
    ? `/login?school=${encodeURIComponent(resolved.school.slug)}`
    : "/login";

  return (
    <div style={wrapperStyle}>
      <AuthCard
        branding={resolved.branding}
        className="max-w-md"
        title="استعادة كلمة المرور"
        description="أدخل بريدك الإلكتروني وسنرسل لك رابطًا آمنًا لإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور — يُستخدم مرة واحدة وينتهي بعد ساعة."
      >
        <ForgotPasswordForm />
      </AuthCard>

      <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        تذكرت كلمة المرور؟{" "}
        <Link
          href={loginHref}
          className="font-semibold text-brand-600 transition-colors hover:text-brand-700 hover:underline"
        >

  );

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  canManageTeacherGrowth,
  getTeacherGrowth,
} from "@/lib/growth/service";
import { GrowthProjection } from "@/app/growth/growth-projection";
import {
  GrowthHistoryTimeline,
  GrowthLadder,
} from "@/app/growth/ui";

export const metadata = {
  title: "ملف النمو المهني | منارة قرطبة",
};

/**
 * Batch 2 (part 2/2) — one teacher's growth file (/growth/[teacherId]):
 * the T0–T5 ladder position, the 60% gate, the 35-hour annual target,
 * every real learning artifact and the append-only journey history.
 *
 * Access (fail-closed):
 *   - the teacher themselves -> /my-growth
 *   - their supervisor / school office / super admin -> full projection
 *   - everyone else -> /forbidden
 * Classification & promotion CONTROLS live on /supervision/growth —
 * this page is the read-only projection shared by all authorized roles.
 */
export default async function TeacherGrowthPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ teacherId: string }>;
}) {
  const { teacherId } = await params;
  const user = await requireUser();

  if (user.role === "TEACHER") {
    // Teachers read their own journey on /my-growth — nothing else.
    if (user.id === teacherId) redirect("/my-growth");
    redirect("/forbidden");
  }

  const allowed = await canManageTeacherGrowth(
    { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
    teacherId
  );
  if (!allowed) redirect("/forbidden");

  const data = await getTeacherGrowth(teacherId);
  if (!data) notFound();

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={`النمو المهني — ${data.teacher.name}`}
        description={[
          data.teacher.schoolName ?? "غير محدد",
          data.teacher.stage ?? null,
          data.teacher.subject ?? null,
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(" · ")}
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الرئيسية" },
          { label: "النمو المهني" },
          { label: data.teacher.name },
        ]}
        meta={
          user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ? (
            <Link
              href="/supervision/growth"
              className="rounded-xl border bg-brand-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700"
            >
              تصنيف واعتماد الانتقال
            </Link>
          ) : null
        }
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <GrowthLadder currentLevel={data.currentLevel} />

        <GrowthProjection data={data} />

        <SectionCard
          title="رحلة النمو — السجل الكامل"
          description="كل تصنيف وكل انتقال معتمد يُسجَّل هنا ولا يُحذف (سجل إضافي فقط)."
        >
          <GrowthHistoryTimeline events={data.history} />
        </SectionCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function formatDate(value: Date | string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", { dateStyle: "medium" }).format(
      new Date(value)
    );
  } catch {
    return "—";
  }
}

function SectionTitle({
  icon: Icon,
  title,
  count,
}: {
  icon: typeof BookOpen;
  title: string;
  count: number;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-black">
        <Icon className="size-4 text-brand-600" aria-hidden />
        {title}
      </h3>
      <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">
        {count}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowUp, CheckCircle2, CircleDashed } from "lucide-react";

import type { GrowthHistoryEvent } from "@/lib/growth/service";
import { GROWTH_LEVELS, growthLevelLabel } from "@/config/growth";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 (part 2/2) — shared growth UI building blocks.              */
/*                                                                     */
/* Presentational-only (no hooks, no client APIs): the same components */
/* render inside server pages (/growth, /my-growth, /growth/[id]) and  */
/* inside the client projection component. Blue brand only — لا بنفسجي. */

/** The T0..T5 ladder badge (the exact HTML label format). */
export function LevelBadge({
  level,
  tone = "current",
}: {
  level: string;
  tone?: "current" | "next" | "muted";
}) {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "current"
      ? "bg-brand-600 text-white"
      : tone === "next"
        ? "bg-brand-50 text-brand-700 ring-1 ring-brand-200"
        : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground";
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${toneClass}`}
    >
      {growthLevelLabel(level)}
    </span>
  );
}

/** 60% promotion-gate progress bar (marker line at the threshold). */
export function GrowthProgressBar({
  percent,
  threshold = 60,
}: {
  percent: number;
  threshold?: number;
}) {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent));
  return (
    <div
      className="relative h-3 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted"
      role="progressbar"
      aria-valuenow={safe}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
    >
      <div
        className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand-600 transition-all"
        style={{ width: `${safe}%` }}
      />
      <span
        className="absolute inset-y-0 w-0.5 bg-brand-900/40"
        style={{ insetInlineStart: `${threshold}%` }}
        aria-hidden
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** Eligible / not-yet pill for the promotion gate. */
export function EligibilityBadge({ eligible }: { eligible: boolean }) {
  return eligible ? (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
      <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
      مستحق للانتقال
    </span>
  ) : (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">
      <CircleDashed className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
      لم يكتمل شرط 60% بعد
    </span>
  );
}

/** The static T0..T5 journey stepper (current level highlighted). */
export function GrowthLadder({ currentLevel }: { currentLevel: string }) {
  const currentIndex = GROWTH_LEVELS.findIndex((level) => level.id === currentLevel);
  return (
    <ol className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">
      {GROWTH_LEVELS.map((level, index) => {
        const state =
          index < currentIndex
            ? "border-brand-600 bg-brand-600 text-white"
            : index === currentIndex
              ? "border-brand-600 bg-brand-50 text-brand-800 ring-2 ring-brand-600"
              : "border-border bg-muted text-muted-foreground";
        return (
          <li
            key={level.id}
            className={`rounded-xl border p-3 text-center ${state}`}
          >
            <p className="text-sm font-black">{level.id}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold leading-4">{level.nameAr}</p>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}

/**
 * The growth journey timeline — append-only GrowthEvent rows
 * (تصنيف المشرف / اعتماد الانتقال), newest first.
 */
export function GrowthHistoryTimeline({
  events,
}: {
  events: GrowthHistoryEvent[];
}) {
  if (events.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        لا توجد أحداث نمو مسجّلة بعد — يظهر هنا كل تصنيف أو انتقال معتمد.
      </p>
    );
  }
  return (
    <ol className="relative space-y-4 border-s border-border ps-5">
      {events.map((event) => (
        <li key={event.id} className="relative">
          <span
            className="absolute -start-[26px] top-1 flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand-600 text-white"
            aria-hidden
          >
            <ArrowUp className="size-3" />
          </span>
          <p className="text-sm font-bold">
            {event.fromLabel
              ? `${event.fromLabel} ← ${event.toLabel}`
              : `تصنيف أول: ${event.toLabel}`}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {event.reasonLabel}
            {event.actorName ? ` — بواسطة ${event.actorName}` : ""}
            {" · "}
            {new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
              dateStyle: "medium",
              timeStyle: "short",
            }).format(event.createdAt)}
          </p>
          {event.note && (
            <p className="mt-1 rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-xs">{event.note}</p>
          )}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

export function TeacherGrowthLink({ teacherId }: { teacherId: string }) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={`/growth/${teacherId}`}
      className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-700 underline-offset-4 hover:underline"

    </Link>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — "قياس الأثر" role-adaptive outcome dashboard:
 *   SUPER_ADMIN → platform-wide aggregates per school (read-only).
 *   MANAGER / SUPERVISOR / DEPUTY → school/scope overview combining
 *   survey response metrics, follow-up completion and stage-pair
 *   candidates for pre/post analysis.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import {
  getPlatformImpactStats,
  getSchoolImpactOverview,
  listStagePairCandidates,
} from "@/lib/impact/service";
import { SURVEY_STAGE_LABELS, type SurveyStage } from "@/config/surveys";
import { AccessDenied, Card, EmptyState, PageHeader, StatTile } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { SurveyStageBadge } from "@/app/surveys/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null }): SurveyActor | null {
  if (
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
  ) {
    return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

export default async function ImpactDashboardPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx) {
    return (
      <AccessDenied hint="لوحة قياس الأثر متاحة للأدوار الإدارية — للمعلّم: مؤشراتك المهنية في صفحة النمو المهني." />
    );
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------- Super Admin: platform */
  if (ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    const stats = await getPlatformImpactStats(ctx);
    if (!stats.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={stats.message} />;
    const { totals, schools } = stats.data;
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title="مؤشرات التنمية المهنية — على مستوى المنصة"
          subtitle="إحصاءات مجمعة من بيانات المدارس الحقيقية — بدون صلاحيات تشغيلية على بيانات أي مدرسة"
        />
        <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-5">
          <StatTile label="المدارس" value={totals.schools} tone="brand" />
          <StatTile label="الاستبيانات" value={totals.surveys} />
          <StatTile label="الردود المرسلة" value={totals.submittedResponses} tone="success" />
          <StatTile label="سجلات المتابعة" value={totals.followUps} />
          <StatTile label="متابعات مكتملة" value={totals.completedFollowUps} tone="warning" />
        </div>
        <Card>
          <h2 className="mb-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">تفصيل المدارس</h2>
          {schools.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="لا توجد مدارس" />
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المدرسة</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الاستبيانات</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الردود</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المتابعات</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">مكتملة</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {schools.map((school) => (
                    <tr key={school.schoolId} className="border-b border-slate-100">
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-slate-700">{school.schoolName}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{school.surveysCount}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{school.submittedResponses}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{school.followUpsCount}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{school.completedFollowUps}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /* --------------------------------- School-scoped impact overview */
  const [overview, candidates] = await Promise.all([
    getSchoolImpactOverview(ctx),
    listStagePairCandidates(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!overview.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={overview.message} />;
  const { surveys, followUps, stageSurveyCount } = overview.data;
  const stagePairs = candidates.ok ? candidates.data.filter((row) => row.hasComparisonData) : [];

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="قياس الأثر"
        subtitle="مؤشرات الاستجابة والإنجاز المحسوبة من بيانات حقيقية — كل مؤشر بمقام معلن"

/**
 * Phase 11 — /integrations — حالة التكاملات (role-scoped, secret-free).
 *
 * SUPER_ADMIN: provider configuration state (booleans + non-secret
 * from-address + documented env-var names) and PLATFORM-wide delivery
 * health. DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: delivery health for their school
 * only. EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY: read-only aggregate for granted schools.
 * Supervisors/Teachers: access denied (they have preferences instead).
 *
 * Nothing here can expose a secret: keys are rendered as
 * configured/not-configured, emails are masked, and delivery rows carry
 * sanitized error categories only.

  );
}

export default async function IntegrationsPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  const actor = user ? toAnalyticsActor(user) : null;
  if (!user || !actor) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد" />;
  }

  const health = await getDeliveryHealth(actor);
  const platformStatus = getPlatformIntegrationStatus();

  if (!health.ok) {
    return <AccessDenied hint={health.message} />;
  }

  const canSeeProviderConfig = actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN";
  const totals = health.data.totals;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl p-4 sm:p-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="حالة التكاملات"
        subtitle={
          health.data.scope === "PLATFORM"
            ? "حالة تكاملات المنصة ومؤشرات تسليم البريد — بيانات مجمّعة دون الاطلاع على محتوى الرسائل"
            : "مؤشرات تسليم البريد داخل نطاق مدرستك — دون إظهار بيانات مدارس أخرى"
        }
        actions={
          <Link
            href="/notifications"
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-[#1D5BD6] hover:text-[#1D5BD6]"
          >
            الإشعارات
          </Link>
        }
      />

      {canSeeProviderConfig ? (
        <div className="mb-4">
          <ProviderCards status={platformStatus} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
          إعدادات مزوّد البريد على مستوى المنصة تديرها إدارة المنصة (المدير الأعلى) — هذه الصفحة تعرض
          مؤشرات التسليم داخل نطاقك فقط.
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="mb-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatTile label="تم الإرسال" value={totals.SENT ?? 0} tone="success" hint="رسائل أكدها المزوّد" />
        <StatTile label="في قائمة الانتظار" value={totals.QUEUED ?? 0} tone="brand" hint="بانتظار محاولة إرسال" />
        <StatTile label="قيد المعالجة" value={totals.PROCESSING ?? 0} hint="محاولة جارية الآن" />
        <StatTile label="فشل الإرسال" value={totals.FAILED ?? 0} tone="warning" hint="بعد استنفاد المحاولات أو خطأ دائم" />
      </div>

      <Card title="أحدث حالات الفشل (لأغراض التشخيص المصرّح به)">
        {health.data.recentFailures.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لا توجد حالات فشل" hint="لم يُسجَّل أي فشل تسليم في النطاق المعروض حتى الآن." />
        ) : (
          <DataTable headers={["الرسالة", "المستلم", "التصنيف", "المحاولات", "المعرّف لدى المزوّد", "آخر محاولة"]}>
            {health.data.recentFailures.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0">
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <span className="block max-w-60 truncate font-semibold text-slate-700">{row.subject}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400" dir="ltr">{row.template}</span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600" dir="ltr">{row.toEmailMasked}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2">
                  <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-red-700">
                    {row.errorCategoryLabel ?? row.errorCategory ?? "—"}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600" dir="ltr">{row.attemptCount}/{row.maxAttempts}</td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-[10px] text-slate-400" dir="ltr">
                  {row.providerMessageId ? `${row.provider} · ${row.providerMessageId}` : "—"}
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-500" dir="ltr">
                  {formatNotificationDate(row.lastAttemptAt)}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </DataTable>
        )}
      </Card>

  );
}

function SubmitButton({
  label,
  pendingLabel,
  variant = "primary",
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  pendingLabel: string;
  variant?: "primary" | "ghost";
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return (
    <button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending}
      className={
        variant === "primary"
          ? "inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
          : "inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-3 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground disabled:opacity-60"
      }
    >
      {pending ? (
        <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
      ) : (
        icon
      )}
      {pending ? pendingLabel : label}
    </button>
  );
}

function AssignCell({
  teacherId,
  currentSupervisorId,
  supervisors,
}: {
  teacherId: string;
  currentSupervisorId: string | null;
  supervisors: { id: string; name: string }[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [assignState, assignAction] = React.useActionState<
    ItActionState | null,
    FormData
  >(assignItTeacherAction, null);
  const [removeState, removeAction] = React.useActionState<
    ItActionState | null,
    FormData
  >(removeItTeacherSupervisorAction, null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (assignState?.ok || removeState?.ok) router.refresh();
  }, [assignState?.ok, removeState?.ok, router]);

  const feedback = assignState && !assignState.ok
    ? { ok: false, message: assignState.message }
    : assignState?.ok
      ? { ok: true, message: assignState.message }
      : removeState && !removeState.ok
        ? { ok: false, message: removeState.message }
        : removeState?.ok
          ? { ok: true, message: removeState.message }
          : null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-stretch gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
      <form action={assignAction} className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={teacherId} />
        <select
          name="supervisorId"
          defaultValue={currentSupervisorId ?? ""}
          required
          className="h-9 w-52 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-2 text-xs outline-none focus-visible:border-ring"
          aria-label="المشرف التربوي"
        >
          <option value="" disabled>
            اختر المشرف التربوي…
          </option>
          {supervisors.map((s) => (
            <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
              {s.name}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <SubmitButton
          label={currentSupervisorId ? "نقل الإسناد" : "إسناد"}
          pendingLabel="جارٍ التنفيذ…"
          icon={<UserCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
      </form>
      {currentSupervisorId && (
        <form action={removeAction}>
          <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={teacherId} />
          <SubmitButton
            label="إزالة الإسناد"
            pendingLabel="جارٍ…"
            variant="ghost"
            icon={<UserMinus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />}
          />
        </form>
      )}
      {feedback && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className={
            feedback.ok
              ? "flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-success"
              : "flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-error"
          }
        >
          {feedback.ok ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <XCircle className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          {feedback.message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AssignmentsClient({
  data,

}: {

    <div className="space-y-5">
      <FilterBar branches={data.branches} initial={initial} />

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { requireItCoordinatorContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { listItWorkspace } from "@/lib/it/service";
import { itTeacherQuerySchema } from "@/lib/validation/it";
import { AssignmentsClient } from "./assignments-client";

export const metadata = {
  title: "إسناد المعلمين | منارة قرطبة",
};

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * IT coordinator — teacher↔supervisor assignment workspace. The context
 * (identity + school) comes from the session; listItWorkspace FORCES the
 * school scope server-side regardless of any filter tampering. Filters
 * travel as query params so the screen works without JavaScript.
 */
export default async function ItAssignmentsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const ctx = await requireItCoordinatorContext();
  const params = await searchParams;

  const first = (v: string | string[] | undefined) =>
    Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v;

  const parsed = itTeacherQuerySchema.safeParse({
    q: first(params.q) ?? "",
    branchId: first(params.branchId) ?? "",
    status: first(params.status) ?? "UNASSIGNED",
    page: first(params.page) ?? "1",
  });

  const query = parsed.success
    ? parsed.data
    : { status: "UNASSIGNED" as const, page: 1 };

  const result = await listItWorkspace(ctx, query);
  const data = result.ok ? result.data : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="إسناد المعلمين إلى المشرفين"
        description="قائمة المعلمين داخل مدرستك — إسناد ونقل وإزالة، كل عملية تتحقق من انتماء الطرفين لمدرستك على الخادم."
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الرئيسية" },
          { label: "تقنية المعلومات" },
          { label: "الإسناد" },
        ]}
      />
      <AssignmentsClient
        data={data}
        initial={{
          q: query.q ?? "",
          branchId: query.branchId ?? "",
          status: query.status ?? "UNASSIGNED",
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  searchParams,

import "./globals.css";
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { Cairo } from "next/font/google";

import { AppShell } from "@/components/layout/app-shell";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { navIdsForRole } from "@/lib/auth/roles";
import { resolveViewerBranding } from "@/lib/branding";
import type { CurrentUser } from "@/lib/types";

/**
 * Cairo — the platform identity font (Arabic-first typography).
 *
 * next/font/google self-hosts the font files from our own origin
 * (/_next/static/media), which keeps the strict CSP from next.config.ts
 * intact (font-src 'self') — no third-party font CDN is contacted at
 * runtime. The font is exposed as the --font-cairo variable that the
 * design system in globals.css consumes for --font-sans.
 */
const cairo = Cairo({
  subsets: ["arabic", "latin"],
  variable: "--font-cairo",
  display: "swap",
});

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  // Dynamic identity: the signed-in user's school names the product in
  // the tab (e.g. «منارة قرطبة»); anonymous requests keep the platform
  // identity «منارة».
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser();
    const resolved = await resolveViewerBranding(user);
    return { title: resolved.branding.productName };
  } catch {
    return { title: "منارة" };
  }
}

// Every page in this platform is session-driven; rendering is dynamic
// end-to-end (all pages already export force-dynamic themselves).
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Avatar initials from the display name — presentation only, no
 * security meaning. First letter of the first and last words:
 * "أحمد محمود" -> "أم", "Sara Ali" -> "SA". Safe fallback for an
 * empty/whitespace name.
 */
function initialsOf(name: string): string {
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return "؟";
  const first = [...parts[0]][0] ?? "؟";
  const last = parts.length > 1 ? [...parts[parts.length - 1]][0] ?? "" : "";
  return `${first}${last}`.toUpperCase();
}

export default async function RootLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  // Session identity for the application shell. getCurrentUser() returns
  // null for anonymous/invalid/revoked sessions; AppShell then renders
  // the gate screens (login, registration, verification, recovery) in a
  // bare layout. Module visibility is computed on the SERVER from the
  // session role (navIdsForRole) — the client only receives serializable
  // ids and resolves icons locally.
  const user = await getCurrentUser();

  // Multi-school branding: the signed-in user's school drives the whole
  // shell identity (name, logo, palette). Colors are emitted as CSS
  // variables on <body>; the design system already resolves every
  // brand-* utility through them, so shared components never hardcode
  // school colors.
  const resolved = await resolveViewerBranding(user);
  const bodyStyle: CSSProperties = resolved.cssVars as CSSProperties;

  // Bridge the session projection (SafeUser) to the shell's display type
  // (CurrentUser): `initials` is derived presentation state, computed on
  // the server so the client receives a ready-to-render object.
  const shellUser: CurrentUser | null = user
    ? { ...user, initials: initialsOf(user.name) }
    : null;

  const allowedModuleIds = navIdsForRole(user?.role);

  return (
    <html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
      <body className={`${cairo.variable} font-sans`} style={bodyStyle}>
        <AppShell
          user={shellUser}
          allowedModuleIds={allowedModuleIds}
          branding={resolved.branding}
        >
          {children}
        </AppShell>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

/**
 * Arabic RTL login form — validation and rate limiting run on the
 * server. The form only adds presentation polish: icon-affordance
 * fields, a password visibility toggle, field-level error wiring
 * (aria-describedby), a success flash and a repositioned recovery link.
 */
export function LoginForm({ nextPath, forgotHref = "/forgot-password" }: LoginFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [state, formAction] = React.useActionState<AuthFormState | null, FormData>(
    loginAction,
    null
  );
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);

  // loginAction redirects on success; refresh guarantees the shell
  // re-renders with the fresh session (role-aware navigation).
  React.useEffect(() => {

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import type { Metadata } from "next";

import { AuthCard } from "@/components/auth/auth-card";
import { resolvePublicBranding } from "@/lib/branding";
import { LoginForm } from "./login-form";

export async function generateMetadata({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ school?: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { school } = await searchParams;
  const resolved = await resolvePublicBranding(school);
  return { title: `تسجيل الدخول — ${resolved.branding.productName}` };
}

interface LoginPageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string; reset?: string; school?: string }>;
}

/**
 * Unified login gate with DYNAMIC school identity.
 *
 * The school context arrives as ?school={slug|id} (carried by school
 * links). Only PUBLIC branding fields are ever resolved from it — name,
 * logo and colors — so a manipulated parameter cannot leak or mutate
 * tenant data; authentication itself stays school-agnostic (email +
 * password). Without the parameter the platform identity renders
 * («منارة — مكتب التطوير التربوي»).
 *
 * The premium composition (identity header, decorated background,
 * elevated card and platform footer) lives in the shared AuthCard so
 * every gate screen stays consistent. The footer is school-agnostic by
 * design: self-registration runs ONLY through the school's dedicated
 * registration link (a hashed token URL generated from
 * /registration-links), so there is intentionally no clickable
 * /register/{slug} shortcut here — the old slug links landed on the
 * "school_closed" screen and are gone from this page.
 */
export default async function LoginPage({ searchParams }: LoginPageProps) {
  const { next, reset, school } = await searchParams;
  const resolved = await resolvePublicBranding(school);
  const wrapperStyle = resolved.cssVars as CSSProperties;

  // Keep the school context attached to the recovery link so related
  // authentication pages can resolve the same identity.
  const forgotHref = resolved.school
    ? `/forgot-password?school=${encodeURIComponent(resolved.school.slug)}`
    : "/forgot-password";

  const footer = (
    <span>
      معلم جديد؟ التسجيل يتم عبر رابط مدرستك المخصص — اطلب الرابط من مكتب
      التطوير في مدرستك ثم افتحه لإنشاء حسابك وتأكيد بريدك.
    </span>
  );

  return (
    <div style={wrapperStyle}>
      <AuthCard
        branding={resolved.branding}
        className="max-w-md"
        title="تسجيل الدخول"
        description={`ادخل بيانات حسابك للوصول إلى مساحة عملك في ${resolved.branding.productName}.`}
        footer={footer}
      >
        {reset === "1" && (
          <div
            className="mb-5 rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-success"
            role="status"
          >
            تم تغيير كلمة المرور بنجاح — سجّل الدخول بكلمة المرور الجديدة.
          </div>
        )}
        <LoginForm nextPath={next} forgotHref={forgotHref} />
      </AuthCard>
    </div>
  );
}
