"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { CheckCheck, Loader2, Send } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";
import { MESSAGE_TYPES, MESSAGE_TYPE_LABELS } from "@/config/growth";
import type { MessageRecipient, MessageRow } from "@/lib/messages/service";
import {
  markMessageReadAction,
  sendMessageAction,
  type MessageActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/messages";

const initialState: MessageActionState = { ok: false };

function formatDate(value: Date | string): string {
  const date = typeof value === "string" ? new Date(value) : value;
  return date.toLocaleString("ar-EG", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

/**
 * Batch 2 — the messages surface: inbox + sent tabs, ownership-safe
 * mark-read, and the compose dialog (recipients resolved server-side;
 * the six original message types preserved verbatim).
 */
export function MessagesClient({
  inbox,
  sent,
  recipients,
  canCompose,
  prefillRecipientId,
}: {
  inbox: MessageRow[];
  sent: MessageRow[];
  recipients: MessageRecipient[];
  canCompose: boolean;
  prefillRecipientId: string | null;
}) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [tab, setTab] = React.useState<"inbox" | "sent">("inbox");
  const [composeOpen, setComposeOpen] = React.useState(Boolean(prefillRecipientId));
  const [state, action, pending] = React.useActionState(sendMessageAction, initialState);
  const [readState, readAction, readPending] = React.useActionState(
    markMessageReadAction,
    initialState
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (state.ok && state.message) {
      toast({ title: "أُرسلت ✅", description: state.message });
      setComposeOpen(false);
    }
  }, [state, toast]);

  const unread = inbox.filter((message) => message.readAt === null).length;
  const list = tab === "inbox" ? inbox : sent;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex gap-2" role="tablist">
          <button
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={tab === "inbox"}
            onClick={() => setTab("inbox")}
            className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition-colors ${
              tab === "inbox" ? "bg-brand-600 text-white" : "border hover:bg-accent"
            }`}
          >
            الوارد {unread > 0 && `(${unread})`}
          </button>
          {canCompose && (
            <button
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={tab === "sent"}
              onClick={() => setTab("sent")}
              className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition-colors ${
                tab === "sent" ? "bg-brand-600 text-white" : "border hover:bg-accent"
              }`}
            >
              المرسلة ({sent.length})
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {canCompose && (
          <Button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setComposeOpen((open) => !open)}
            className="rounded-xl"
          >
            <Send className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            رسالة جديدة
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {canCompose && composeOpen && (
        <form
          action={action}
          className="space-y-3 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-4 shadow-sm"
        >
          <p className="text-sm font-black">✉ رسالة إلى المعلم</p>
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="recipientId">المعلم</Label>
              <select
                id="recipientId"
                name="recipientId"
                defaultValue={prefillRecipientId ?? ""}
                required
                className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
              >
                <option value="" disabled>
                  اختر المعلم…
                </option>
                {recipients.map((recipient) => (
                  <option key={recipient.id} value={recipient.id}>
                    {recipient.name}
                    {recipient.schoolName ? ` — ${recipient.schoolName}` : ""}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="type">نوع الرسالة</Label>
              <select
                id="type"
                name="type"
                defaultValue="FOLLOW_UP"
                className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
              >
                {MESSAGE_TYPES.map((type) => (
                  <option key={type} value={type}>
                    {MESSAGE_TYPE_LABELS[type]}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="body">نص الرسالة</Label>
            <textarea
              id="body"
              name="body"
              required
              minLength={2}
              maxLength={2000}
              rows={4}
              placeholder="اكتب الرسالة للمعلم…"
              className="w-full rounded-xl border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
            />
          </div>
          {state.message && !state.ok && (
            <p className="rounded-lg bg-error-soft px-3 py-2 text-sm text-error">
              {state.message}
            </p>
          )}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="rounded-xl">
            {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
            ✓ إرسال عبر المنصة
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}

      <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card shadow-sm">
        {list.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Send}
            title={tab === "inbox" ? "لا توجد رسائل واردة" : "لم ترسل رسائل بعد"}
            description={
              tab === "inbox"
                ? "ستظهر رسائل المشرف التربوي والمكتب هنا وتصلك إشعارات فورية."
                : "اختر «رسالة جديدة» وأرسل توجيهًا مهنيًا لأحد معلميك."
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y" role="list">
            {list.map((message) => (
              <li
                key={message.id}
                className={
                  tab === "inbox" && message.readAt === null
                    ? "bg-brand-50/60 p-4"
                    : "p-4"
                }
              >
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-black">
                      <span className="rounded-lg bg-brand-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700">
                        {message.typeLabel}
                      </span>
                      <span className="ms-2">
                        {tab === "inbox" ? `من: ${message.senderName}` : `إلى: ${message.recipientName}`}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed">
                      {message.body}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {formatDate(message.createdAt)}
                      {message.readAt ? " · تمت القراءة" : " · غير مقروءة"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  {tab === "inbox" && message.readAt === null && (
                    <form action={readAction}>
                      <input type="hidden" name="messageId" value={message.id} />
                      <Button
                        type="submit"
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={readPending}
                        className="rounded-xl"
                      >
                        {readPending ? (

                        ) : (

                        تحديد كمقروءة

            ))}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import {
  composeRecipients,
  listInbox,
  listSent,
} from "@/lib/messages/service";
import { MessagesClient } from "@/app/messages/messages-client";

export const metadata = {
  title: "الرسائل | منارة قرطبة",
};

/**
 * Batch 2 — supervisor/office -> teacher messaging (HTML v38/v40
 * parity): the teacher inbox with the six original message types, the
 * sent view for senders, and the compose dialog limited to the actor's
 * real scope (resolved server-side).
 */
export default async function MessagesPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ to?: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { to } = await searchParams;

  const canCompose =
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN";

  const [inbox, sent, recipients] = await Promise.all([
    listInbox(user.id),
    canCompose ? listSent(user.id) : Promise.resolve([]),
    canCompose
      ? composeRecipients({
          id: user.id,
          role: user.role,
          schoolId: user.schoolId,
        })
      : Promise.resolve([]),
  ]);

  if (!canCompose && to) redirect("/messages");

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="الرسائل"
        description={
          canCompose
            ? "رسائل المعلمين إليك، وتوجيهاتك المهنية المرسلة — إرسال عبر المنصة بحسابات حقيقية."
            : "رسائلك من المشرف التربوي والمكتب — تظهر أيضًا في جرس الإشعارات."
        }
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "الرئيسية" }, { label: "الرسائل" }]}
      />
      <MessagesClient
        inbox={inbox}
        sent={sent}
        recipients={recipients}
        canCompose={canCompose}
        prefillRecipientId={to ?? null}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

              ) : (
                <p className="rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-amber-700">
                  أُعيد التسليم إليك للتعديل — عدّل المحتوى ثم أعد التسليم قبل الموعد.
                </p>
              )}
              <p className="mt-3 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3 text-sm text-slate-700">
                {mySubmission.feedbackText}
              </p>
              {mySubmission.reviewedAt ? (
                <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">آخر مراجعة: {formatDate(mySubmission.reviewedAt)}</p>
              ) : null}
            </Card>
          ) : mySubmission && ["SUBMITTED", "UNDER_REVIEW"].includes(mySubmission.status) ? (
            <Card title="حالة المراجعة">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">
                {mySubmission.status === "UNDER_REVIEW"
                  ? "تسليمك قيد المراجعة الآن من المشرف التربوي."
                  : "تسليمك مستلم — بانتظار بدء المراجعة."}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">
                سيظهر التقييم والتغذية الراجعة هنا بعد اعتمادهما.
              </p>
            </Card>
          ) : null}

          {mySubmission && mySubmission.files.length > 0 && !mySubmission.canEdit ? (
            <Card title={`مرفقاتك (${mySubmission.files.length})`}>
              <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {mySubmission.files.map((file) => (
                  <li key={file.id} className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 text-sm">
                    <a
                      href={`/api/assignment-files/${file.id}`}
                      className="text-slate-700 hover:text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline"
                    >
                      {file.fileName}
                    </a>
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">{formatBytes(file.sizeBytes)}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </Card>
          ) : null}

          {mySubmission?.canEdit || !mySubmission ? (
            <Card title={mySubmission ? "تعديل التسليم" : "تسليم العمل"}>
              {result.data.windowState === "closed" ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">{windowLabel}</p>
              ) : (
                <SubmissionWorkspace
                  assignmentId={assignment.id}
                  initialText={mySubmission?.responseText ?? ""}
                  files={(mySubmission?.files ?? []).map((file) => ({
                    id: file.id,
                    fileName: file.fileName,
                    sizeLabel: formatBytes(file.sizeBytes),
                  })) satisfies SubmissionFileView[]}
                  canEdit={mySubmission?.canEdit ?? true}
                  windowLabel={windowLabel}
                />
              )}
            </Card>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 7 — the teacher's submission workspace: response text, file
 * attachments (upload/delete with server-enforced type/size/count),
 * draft saving and final submission with confirmation.
 * All rules re-run server-side; this UI mirrors their outcomes.
 */
import { useActionState, useRef } from "react";

import {
  deleteSubmissionFileAction,
  saveSubmissionDraftAction,
  submitSubmissionAction,
  uploadSubmissionFileAction,
  type FormActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/assignments";

const inputCls =
  "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";

export interface SubmissionFileView {
  id: string;
  fileName: string;
  sizeLabel: string;
}

export function SubmissionWorkspace({
  assignmentId,
  initialText,
  files,
  canEdit,
  windowLabel,
}: {
  assignmentId: string;
  initialText: string;
  files: SubmissionFileView[];
  canEdit: boolean;
  windowLabel: string;
}) {
  const [draftState, draftFormAction, draftPending] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    saveSubmissionDraftAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const [submitState, submitFormAction, submitPending] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    submitSubmissionAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const [uploadState, uploadFormAction, uploadPending] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    uploadSubmissionFileAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const [deleteState, deleteFormAction] = useActionState<FormActionState, FormData>(
    deleteSubmissionFileAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  if (!canEdit) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {submitState.ok ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-emerald-700">
          {submitState.data?.isLate
            ? "تم استلام تسليمك (مسجل كتسليم متأخر وفق سياسة القبول المتأخر)."
            : "تم استلام تسليمك بنجاح — سيصلك التقييم والتغذية الراجعة بعد المراجعة."}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {submitState.message && !submitState.ok ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">
          {submitState.message}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <form action={submitFormAction}>
        <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={assignmentId} />
        <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700" htmlFor="responseText">
          نص التسليم
        </label>
        <textarea
          id="responseText"
          name="responseText"
          defaultValue={initialText}
          rows={8}
          maxLength={10000}
          placeholder="اكتب إجابتك أو وصف العمل المرفق…"
          className={inputCls}
        />
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">{windowLabel}</p>

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="submit"
            formAction={submitFormAction}
            disabled={submitPending}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {submitPending ? "جارٍ التسليم…" : "تسليم نهائي"}
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            formAction={draftFormAction}
            disabled={draftPending}
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {draftPending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : "حفظ كمسودة"}
          </button>
        </div>
        {draftState.message && !draftState.ok ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-600">{draftState.message}</p>
        ) : null}
        {draftState.ok ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-emerald-600">حُفظت المسودة.</p>
        ) : null}
      </form>

      <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">المرفقات ({files.length}/5)</h3>
        {uploadState.message && !uploadState.ok ? (
          <p className="mb-2 text-xs text-red-600">{uploadState.message}</p>
        ) : null}
        <form action={uploadFormAction} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <input type="hidden" name="assignmentId" value={assignmentId} />
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            name="file"
            accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.txt,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.ppt,.pptx"
            className="block w-full max-w-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm file:mr-3 file:rounded file:border-0 file:bg-blue-50 file:px-3 file:py-1 file:text-xs file:font-medium file:text-[#1D5BD6]"
            required
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={uploadPending || files.length >= 5}
            className="rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-blue-50 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {uploadPending ? "جارٍ الرفع…" : "رفع المرفق"}
          </button>
        </form>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-400">
          الأنواع المسموحة: PDF، صور، Word، Excel، PowerPoint، نص — بحد أقصى 10 ميغابايت للملف.
        </p>

        {files.length > 0 ? (
          <ul className="mt-3 divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {files.map((file) => (
              <li key={file.id} className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 text-sm">
                <a href={`/api/assignment-files/${file.id}`} className="text-slate-700 hover:text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline">
                  {file.fileName}
                </a>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">{file.sizeLabel}</span>
                  <form action={deleteFormAction}>
                    <input type="hidden" name="fileId" value={file.id} />
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="text-xs font-medium text-red-500 hover:underline"
                    >
                      حذف
                    </button>
                  </form>
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : null}
        {deleteState.message && !deleteState.ok ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-600">{deleteState.message}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 7 — "التكليفات" teacher workspace list. Rows are filtered by
 * server-side targeting (school + audience) — a teacher can never see
 * another school's or a non-targeted assignment.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { listTeacherAssignments } from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  AssignmentStatusBadge,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  SubmissionStatusBadge,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const WINDOW_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  open: "التسليم مفتوح",
  late: "التسليم متاح متأخرًا",
  closed: "انتهى موعد التسليم",
};

export default async function MyAssignmentsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ q?: string; status?: string; page?: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user || user.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return <AccessDenied hint="قائمة التكليفات متاحة للمعلمين فقط." />;
  }

  const params = await searchParams;
  const page = Number(params.page ?? "1") || 1;
  const result = await listTeacherAssignments(user, {
    q: params.q,
    status: params.status,
    page,
  });
  if (!result.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={result.message} />;
  const { rows, total, pageCount, page: currentPage } = result.data;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="التكليفات"
        subtitle="التكليفات الموجهة إليك من مكتب التطوير بمدرستك"
      />

      <Card>
        <form className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3" method="get">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="q">بحث بالعنوان</label>
            <input
              id="q"
              name="q"
              defaultValue={params.q ?? ""}
              placeholder="اكتب جزءًا من العنوان…"
              className="w-64 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="status">الحالة</label>
            <select
              id="status"
              name="status"
              defaultValue={params.status ?? ""}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
            >
              <option value="">الكل</option>
              <option value="PUBLISHED">منشور</option>
              <option value="CLOSED">مغلق</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <button type="submit" className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
            تصفية
          </button>
        </form>

        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="لا توجد تكليفات موجَّهة إليك حاليًا"
            hint="ستظهر هنا التكليفات فور نشرها وتوجيهها لك."
          />
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            {rows.map((row) => (
              <li key={row.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 py-4">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <Link
                      href={`/my-assignments/${row.id}`}
                      className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 hover:text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline"
                    >
                      {row.titleAr}
                    </Link>
                    <AssignmentStatusBadge status={row.status} />
                    {row.myStatus ? <SubmissionStatusBadge status={row.myStatus} /> : null}
                    {row.myIsLate ? (
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-amber-700">
                        سُلِّم متأخرًا
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    الاستحقاق: {formatDate(row.dueAt)} — {WINDOW_LABELS[row.windowState] ?? ""}
                    {row.courseTitle ? ` — ${row.courseTitle}` : ""}
                    {row.myScoreTotal !== null ? ` — الدرجة: ${row.myScoreTotal}/${row.totalPoints}` : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Link
                  href={`/my-assignments/${row.id}`}
                  className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
                >
                  {row.myStatus ? "عرض التسليم" : "فتح التكليف"}
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}

        {pageCount > 1 ? (
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
            <span>الصفحة {currentPage} من {pageCount} — {total} تكليفًا</span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {currentPage > 1 ? (
                <Link href={`/my-assignments?page=${currentPage - 1}`} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50">السابق</Link>
              ) : null}
              {currentPage < pageCount ? (
                <Link href={`/my-assignments?page=${currentPage + 1}`} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50">التالي</Link>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

 * persisted level only ever changes through the supervisor's v48
 * controls (تصنيف المشرف / اعتماد الانتقال).
 */
export default async function MyGrowthPage() {
  const user = await requireUser();

  // Role routing: teachers here; managers to the platform board;
  // supervisors to their v48 classification board.
  if (user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    redirect("/growth");
  }
  if (user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") redirect("/supervision/growth");
  if (user.role !== "TEACHER") redirect("/forbidden");

  const data = await getTeacherGrowth(user.id);
  if (!data) redirect("/forbidden");

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="نموي المهني"
        description={`تقدمك على سلّم T0–T5 — التصنيف الحالي: ${data.currentLabel} — العام الدراسي ${data.academicYear}.`}
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "الرئيسية" }, { label: "نموي المهني" }]}
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <GrowthLadder currentLevel={data.currentLevel} />

        <GrowthProjection data={data} />

        <SectionCard
          title="رحلة نموي — السجل الكامل"
          description="كل تصنيف وكل انتقال معتمد يظهر هنا بالتاريخ والسبب — سجل إضافي لا يُحذف."
        >
          <GrowthHistoryTimeline events={data.history} />
        </SectionCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — take-survey page: eligibility + open-window are re-checked
 * server-side before the taker is rendered; draft state is restored
 * from the teacher's own persisted row.
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getSurveyForTaking } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import { AccessDenied, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import SurveyTaker from "@/app/my-surveys/[id]/survey-taker";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function TakeSurveyPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  if (user.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الاستجابة للاستبيانات متاحة للمعلمين فقط." />;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const result = await getSurveyForTaking(
    { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
    id
  );
  if (!result.ok) {
    if (result.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return (
      <AccessDenied
        hint={result.message}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="استجابة الاستبيان"
        subtitle=""
        actions={
          <Link
            href="/my-surveys"
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
          >
            رجوع للقائمة
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <SurveyTaker data={result.data} />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 9 — the respondent experience: renders questions by type,
 * validates required answers client-side (mirrored server-side), saves
 * drafts (identified surveys) and submits with a confirmation screen.
 *
 * Server-side validation is the ONLY authority: type, scale bounds and
 * option membership are all re-checked in the service; this component
 * merely prevents obvious mistakes before they hit the wire.
 */
import { useActionState, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { LIKERT_OPTIONS } from "@/config/surveys";
import {
  saveResponseDraftAction,
  submitResponseAction,
  type SurveyActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/surveys";
import { formatDate } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import type { SurveyTakeData } from "@/lib/surveys/service";

interface AnswerMap {
  [questionId: string]: {
    valueNumber?: number;
    valueText?: string;
    selectedOptions?: string[];
  };
}

export default function SurveyTaker({ data }: { data: SurveyTakeData }) {
  const { survey, questions, myResponse, alreadySubmitted, duplicateNote } = data;

  const initialAnswers = useMemo<AnswerMap>(() => {
    const map: AnswerMap = {};
    for (const answer of myResponse?.answers ?? []) {
      map[answer.questionId] = {
        valueNumber: answer.valueNumber ?? undefined,
        valueText: answer.valueText ?? undefined,
        selectedOptions: answer.selectedOptions,
      };
    }
    return map;
  }, [myResponse]);

  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<AnswerMap>(initialAnswers);
  const [clientError, setClientError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitState, submitFormAction, submitPending] = useActionState<SurveyActionState, FormData>(
    submitResponseAction,
    { ok: false }
  );
  const [draftState, draftFormAction, draftPending] = useActionState<SurveyActionState, FormData>(
    saveResponseDraftAction,
    { ok: false }
  );

  function setAnswer(questionId: string, patch: AnswerMap[string]): void {
    setAnswers((prev) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: { ...prev[questionId], ...patch } }));
  }

  function buildPayloadJson(): string {
    return JSON.stringify({
      answers: questions.map((question) => {
        const answer = answers[question.id];
        return {
          questionId: question.id,
          valueNumber: answer?.valueNumber ?? null,
          valueText: answer?.valueText ?? "",
          selectedOptions: answer?.selectedOptions ?? [],
        };
      }),
    });
  }

  function validateRequired(): boolean {
    for (const question of questions) {
      if (!question.required) continue;
      const answer = answers[question.id];
      const hasValue =
        answer &&
        ((answer.valueNumber !== undefined && answer.valueNumber !== null) ||
          (answer.valueText !== undefined && answer.valueText!.trim() !== "") ||
          (answer.selectedOptions !== undefined && answer.selectedOptions.length > 0));
      if (!hasValue) {
        setClientError(`السؤال الإلزامي لم يُجب عليه: ${question.textAr}`);
        return false;
      }
    }
    setClientError(null);
    return true;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------ Confirmation */
  if (submitState.ok) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-8 text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-2xl text-emerald-600">✓</div>
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-lg font-bold text-emerald-800">تم إرسال ردك بنجاح</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">
          شكرًا لمشاركتك في «{submitState.data?.surveyTitle}» — {formatDate(submitState.data?.submittedAt ? new Date(submitState.data.submittedAt) : null)}
        </p>
        {survey.anonymous ? (
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-emerald-600">
            هذا الاستبيان مجهول الهوية: لا يوجد سجل شخصي لردك، ولن يظهر في سجل ردودك.
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (alreadySubmitted) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-blue-50 text-2xl text-[#1D5BD6]">✓</div>
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">أرسلت ردك مسبقًا</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          تم تسجيل استجابتك على هذا الاستبيان {myResponse?.submittedAt ? `في ${formatDate(myResponse.submittedAt)}` : ""} — لا يمكن تعديل الرد بعد الإرسال.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">{survey.titleAr}</h2>
        {survey.descriptionAr ? (
          <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-line text-sm text-slate-600">{survey.descriptionAr}</p>
        ) : null}
        {survey.purposeAr ? <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600"><strong>الغرض:</strong> {survey.purposeAr}</p> : null}
        {survey.instructionsAr ? (
          <p className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3 text-sm text-slate-600">{survey.instructionsAr}</p>
        ) : null}
        {survey.anonymous ? (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
            استبيان مجهول الهوية — لا يُربط ردك باسمك إطلاقًا، ولا يدعم الحفظ المؤقت. {duplicateNote ? duplicateNote : null}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
            يمكنك حفظ مسودة واستكمالها لاحقًا. بعد الإرسال لا يمكن تعديل الرد.
            {survey.closesAt ? ` — يُغلق: ${formatDate(survey.closesAt)}` : ""}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <form action={submitFormAction} className="space-y-5" onSubmit={validateRequired}>
        <input type="hidden" name="surveyId" value={survey.id} />
        <input type="hidden" name="payloadJson" value={buildPayloadJson()} />

        {clientError ? (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{clientError}</div>
        ) : null}
        {submitState.message ? (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{submitState.message}</div>
        ) : null}
        {draftState.ok ? (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-emerald-700">تم حفظ المسودة.</div>
        ) : null}
        {!draftState.ok && draftState.message ? (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{draftState.message}</div>
        ) : null}

        <ol className="space-y-5">
          {questions.map((question, index) => {
            const answer = answers[question.id];
            return (
              <li key={question.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">
                  {index + 1}. {question.textAr}
                  {question.required ? <span className="mr-1 text-red-500">*</span> : null}
                </p>
                {question.helpTextAr ? <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{question.helpTextAr}</p> : null}

                <div className="mt-3">
                  {question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {question.options.map((option) => (
                        <label key={option} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700">
                          <input
                            type="radio"
                            name={`q-${question.id}`}
                            checked={answer?.selectedOptions?.[0] === option}
                            onChange={() => setAnswer(question.id, { selectedOptions: [option] })}
                            className="accent-[#1D5BD6]"
                          />
                          {option}
                        </label>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}

                  {question.type === "MULTI_CHOICE" ? (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {question.options.map((option) => (
                        <label key={option} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={(answer?.selectedOptions ?? []).includes(option)}
                            onChange={(event) => {
                              const current = answer?.selectedOptions ?? [];
                              setAnswer(question.id, {
                                selectedOptions: event.target.checked
                                  ? [...current, option]
                                  : current.filter((item) => item !== option),
                              });
                            }}
                            className="accent-[#1D5BD6]"
                          />
                          {option}
                        </label>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}

                  {question.type === "RATING" ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {Array.from(
                        { length: (question.maxScore ?? 5) - (question.minScore ?? 1) + 1 },
                        (_, i) => (question.minScore ?? 1) + i
                      ).map((value) => (
                        <button
                          key={value}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setAnswer(question.id, { valueNumber: value })}
                          className={`h-10 w-10 rounded-lg border text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                            answer?.valueNumber === value
                              ? "border-[#1D5BD6] bg-[#1D5BD6] text-white"
                              : "border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-[#1D5BD6]"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {value}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}

                  {question.type === "LIKERT" ? (
                    <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-5">
                      {LIKERT_OPTIONS.map((label, labelIndex) => {
                        const value = 5 - labelIndex;
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={label}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setAnswer(question.id, { valueNumber: value })}
                            className={`rounded-lg border px-2 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition ${
                              answer?.valueNumber === value
                                ? "border-[#1D5BD6] bg-[#1D5BD6] text-white"
                                : "border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-[#1D5BD6]"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {label}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}

                  {question.type === "YES_NO" ? (
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      {[{ value: 1, label: "نعم" }, { value: 0, label: "لا" }].map((item) => (
                        <button
                          key={item.value}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setAnswer(question.id, { valueNumber: item.value })}
                          className={`rounded-lg border px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition ${
                            answer?.valueNumber === item.value
                              ? "border-[#1D5BD6] bg-[#1D5BD6] text-white"
                              : "border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-[#1D5BD6]"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.label}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : null}

                  {question.type === "SHORT_TEXT" ? (
                    <input
                      className={inputClass}
                      value={answer?.valueText ?? ""}
                      onChange={(event) => setAnswer(question.id, { valueText: event.target.value })}
                    />
                  ) : null}

                  {question.type === "LONG_TEXT" ? (
                    <textarea
                      className={inputClass}
                      rows={4}
                      value={answer?.valueText ?? ""}
                      onChange={(event) => setAnswer(question.id, { valueText: event.target.value })}
                    />
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitPending}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {submitPending ? "جارٍ الإرسال…" : "إرسال الرد"}
          </button>
          {!survey.anonymous ? (
            <button
              type="submit"
              formAction={draftFormAction}
              disabled={draftPending}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {draftPending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : "حفظ مسودة"}
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — "الاستبيانات" teacher workspace: surveys targeted at the
 * signed-in teacher (eligibility re-checked server-side per survey),
 * with submission state. Anonymous surveys never show a personal
 * submission record — the row explains that honestly.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getMyResponseHistory, listSurveysForTeacher } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  StatTile,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { SurveyStageBadge } from "@/app/surveys/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function MySurveysPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  if (user.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return <AccessDenied hint="قائمة الاستبيانات متاحة للمعلمين فقط." />;
  }

  const [listResult, historyResult] = await Promise.all([
    listSurveysForTeacher({ id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId }),
    getMyResponseHistory({ id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId }),
  ]);
  if (!listResult.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={listResult.message} />;

  const rows = listResult.data;
  const history = historyResult.ok ? historyResult.data : [];
  const openCount = rows.filter((row) => row.isOpenNow).length;
  const submittedCount = history.length;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="الاستبيانات"
        subtitle="الاستبيانات الموجهة إليك من إدارة التطوير المهني والإشراف التربوي"
      />

      <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatTile label="استبيانات متاحة" value={rows.length} tone="brand" />
        <StatTile label="مفتوحة للاستجابة" value={openCount} tone="success" />
        <StatTile label="ردودي المرسلة (معرّفة الهوية)" value={submittedCount} />
        <StatTile
          label="استبيانات مجهولة الهوية"
          value={rows.filter((row) => row.anonymous).length}
          tone="warning"
        />
      </div>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title="لا توجد استبيانات موجهة إليك حاليًا"
          hint="ستظهر هنا استبيانات قياس الأثر ومتابعة التطبيق عند نشرها وتوجيهها إليك."
        />

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">{row.titleAr}</h3>
                    <SurveyStageBadge stage={row.stage} />

                      <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
                        مجهول الهوية
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                    {!row.isOpenNow ? (
                      <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-700">

                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  {row.descriptionAr ? (
                    <p className="mb-1 line-clamp-2 text-xs text-slate-500">{row.descriptionAr}</p>
                  ) : null}
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                    {row.closesAt ? `يُغلق: ${formatDate(row.closesAt)}` : "مفتوح حتى الإغلاق اليدوي"}
                    {row.anonymous ? " — لا يُسجَّل حالة رد شخصية حفاظًا على الخصوصية" : ""}
                  </p>
                  {row.myResponseStatus === "SUBMITTED" ? (
                    <p className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                      تم إرسال ردك — {formatDate(row.myResponseSubmittedAt)}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <Link
                  href={`/my-surveys/${row.id}`}
                  className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
                >
                  {row.myResponseStatus === "SUBMITTED" ? "عرض الرد" : row.anonymous ? "استجابة" : "بدء الاستجابة"}
                </Link>
              </div>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 11 — notification bell with dropdown (client component).
 *
 * - Polls the unread count every 60 seconds and on window focus.
 * - Fetches the latest items when opened; mark-read on click then
 *   navigates to the notification's validated internal destination.
 * - Mark-all-as-read available in the dropdown header.
 * - Explicit loading / empty / error states (never a fake list).
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";

interface BellItem {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  bodyAr: string;
  destinationUrl: string | null;
  readAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

function timeAgo(iso: string): string {
  const then = new Date(iso).getTime();
  if (Number.isNaN(then)) return "";
  const diffSeconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - then) / 1000);
  if (diffSeconds < 60) return "الآن";
  if (diffSeconds < 3600) return `قبل ${Math.floor(diffSeconds / 60)} دقيقة`;
  if (diffSeconds < 86400) return `قبل ${Math.floor(diffSeconds / 3600)} ساعة`;
  return `قبل ${Math.floor(diffSeconds / 86400)} يوم`;
}

export function NotificationBell({ initialUnread }: { initialUnread: number }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [unread, setUnread] = useState(initialUnread);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<BellItem[] | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const refreshUnread = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/notifications/unread-count", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!response.ok) return;
      const payload = (await response.json()) as { ok: boolean; data?: { count: number } };
      if (payload.ok && payload.data) setUnread(payload.data.count);
    } catch {
      // Silent for background polling — the UI keeps the last honest value.
    }
  }, []);

  const loadItems = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/notifications?limit=8", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (response.status === 401) {
        setError("الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد");
        setItems(null);
        return;
      }
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("failed");
      const payload = (await response.json()) as { ok: boolean; data?: { items: BellItem[] } };
      if (payload.ok && payload.data) {
        setItems(payload.data.items);
      } else {
        throw new Error("failed");
      }
    } catch {
      setError("تعذّر تحميل الإشعارات — تحقق من الاتصال وأعد المحاولة");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(refreshUnread, 60_000);
    const onFocus = () => refreshUnread();
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    };
  }, [refreshUnread]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (containerRef.current && !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const toggle = () => {
    const next = !open;
    setOpen(next);
    if (next) {
      setItems(null);
      loadItems();
      refreshUnread();
    }
  };

  const markReadAndNavigate = async (item: BellItem) => {
    setBusyId(item.id);
    try {
      if (!item.readAt) {
        await fetch(`/api/notifications/${item.id}/read`, { method: "POST" });
        setUnread((value) => Math.max(0, value - 1));
      }
      setOpen(false);
      if (item.destinationUrl) {
        router.push(item.destinationUrl);
      } else {
        router.push("/notifications");
      }
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const markAll = async () => {
    setBusyId("*");
    try {
      await fetch("/api/notifications/read-all", { method: "POST" });
      setUnread(0);
      await loadItems();
      router.refresh();
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={containerRef}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={toggle}
        aria-label={`الإشعارات — ${unread} غير مقروءة`}
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="relative flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 transition hover:border-[#1D5BD6] hover:text-[#1D5BD6]"
      >
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M6 8a6 6 0 0 1 12 0c0 7 3 9 3 9H3s3-2 3-9" />
          <path d="M10.3 21a1.94 1.94 0 0 0 3.4 0" />
        </svg>
        {unread > 0 && (
          <span className="absolute -top-1 -left-1 flex h-5 min-w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#1D5BD6] px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white" dir="ltr">
            {unread > 99 ? "99+" : unread}
          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 z-50 mt-2 w-80 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-lg sm:w-96">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 px-4 py-3">
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">الإشعارات</div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={markAll}
                disabled={busyId !== null || unread === 0}
                className="font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline disabled:text-slate-400 disabled:no-underline"
              >
                تحديد الكل كمقروء
              </button>
              <Link href="/notifications" className="font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-[#1D5BD6]">
                جميع الإشعارات
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
            {loading && (
              <div className="space-y-2 p-4">
                {[0, 1, 2].map((index) => (
                  <div key={index} className="animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-slate-100 p-3">
                    <div className="h-3 w-2/3 rounded bg-slate-200" />
                    <div className="mt-2 h-3 w-full rounded bg-slate-100" />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {!loading && error && (
              <div className="p-4">
                <p className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">{error}</p>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={loadItems}
                  className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline"
                >
                  إعادة المحاولة
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {!loading && !error && items !== null && items.length === 0 && (
              <div className="p-6 text-center">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">لا توجد إشعارات بعد</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">ستظهر هنا تحديثات الواجبات والاختبارات والشهادات والمتابعات</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {!loading && !error && items !== null && items.length > 0 && (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                {items.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.id}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => markReadAndNavigate(item)}
                      disabled={busyId !== null}
                      className={`flex w-full items-start gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-right transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60 ${
                        item.readAt ? "" : "bg-blue-50/40"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        className={`mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${item.readAt ? "bg-slate-200" : "bg-[#1D5BD6]"}`}
                      />
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">{item.titleAr}</span>
                        <span className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 block text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-500">{item.bodyAr}</span>
                        <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-slate-400">{timeAgo(item.createdAt)}</span>
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="border-t border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 px-4 py-2 text-center">
            <Link href="/notifications/preferences" className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-[#1D5BD6]">
              تفضيلات الإشعارات
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useTransition } from "react";
import { CheckCheck } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Batch 1 — client helper for the notifications page: triggers the
 * server mark-all action and refreshes the server-rendered list.
 */
export function NotificationsActions({
  markAllAction,
}: {
  markAllAction: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      disabled={pending}
      onClick={() => startTransition(() => void markAllAction())}
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      <CheckCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
      {pending ? "جارٍ التحديث…" : "تحديد الكل كمقروء"}
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * Batch 1 — صفحة الإشعارات (all in-app notifications).
 * Server-rendered from the owner's rows — survives refreshes and
 * sessions. Each row deep-links to its real resource (course links
 * carry the actual courseId).
 */
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function relativeTime(date: Date): string {
  const seconds = Math.max(1, Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 1000));
  if (seconds < 60) return "الآن";
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `قبل ${minutes} دقيقة`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `قبل ${hours} ساعة`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  if (days < 30) return `قبل ${days} يوم`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("ar-SA");
}

export default async function NotificationsPage() {
  const user = await requireUser();

  const [items, unread] = await Promise.all([
    listNotifications(user.id, 100),
    unreadCount(user.id),
  ]);

  async function markAll() {
    "use server";
    const current = await requireUser();
    await markAllNotificationsRead(current.id);
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl">
      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">الإشعارات</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
            {unread > 0
              ? `لديك ${unread} إشعارًا غير مقروء`
              : "كل الإشعارات مقروءة"}
          </p>
        </div>
        {unread > 0 && <NotificationsActions markAllAction={markAll} />}
      </div>

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-10 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">لا توجد إشعارات بعد</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            ستظهر هنا تنبيهات الدورات المنشورة وإتمام المتطلبات والشهادات وقياس الأثر.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">
          {items.map((notification) => {
            const content = (
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3.5">
                <span
                  className={
                    notification.readAt
                      ? "mt-1.5 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-slate-300"
                      : "mt-1.5 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[#1D5BD6]"
                  }
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold leading-snug text-slate-900">
                    {notification.titleAr}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-500">
                    {notification.bodyAr}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                    {relativeTime(notification.createdAt)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
            return (
              <li key={notification.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-b-0">
                {notification.destinationUrl ? (
                  <Link
                    href={notification.destinationUrl}
                    className="block transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50"
                  >
                    {content}
                  </Link>
                ) : (
                  content
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 11 — notification preferences form (client).
 * Checkbox toggles with the hidden-false input pattern so the server
 * action receives explicit on/off values for every key.
 */

import { useActionState } from "react";
import {
  updateNotificationPreferencesAction,
  type NotificationActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/notifications";
import type { NotificationPreferenceView } from "@/lib/notifications/service";

const initialState: NotificationActionState = { ok: false };

const CATEGORY_ROWS: { key: keyof NotificationPreferenceView; label: string; hint: string }[] = [
  { key: "assignments", label: "الواجبات", hint: "نشر الواجبات، تذكير المواعيد، استلام التسليمات، الإرجاع والتقييم" },
  { key: "assessments", label: "الاختبارات", hint: "إتاحة الاختبارات وإعلان النتائج" },
  { key: "courses", label: "المقررات التدريبية", hint: "إكمال المقررات وتحديثات التقدم" },
  { key: "surveys", label: "الاستبيانات", hint: "دعوات الاستبيانات الصادرة لك" },
  { key: "followups", label: "المتابعات الميدانية", hint: "جدولة الزيارات وتحديثاتها ومشاركتها" },
  { key: "certificates", label: "الشهادات", hint: "إصدار الشهادات وإلغاؤها" },
  { key: "platform", label: "إشعارات المنصة", hint: "الأخبار والإعلانات على مستوى المنصة" },
];

function Toggle({
  name,
  checked,
  label,
  hint,
  locked,
}: {
  name: string;
  checked: boolean;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  locked?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <label
      className={`flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3 transition ${
        locked ? "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50" : "border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-[#1D5BD6]/40"
      }`}
    >
      <span className="min-w-0">
        <span className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">{label}</span>
        {hint && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-500">{hint}</span>}
      </span>
      <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
        {locked ? (
          <span className="rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
            مُفعّل دائمًا
          </span>
        ) : (
          <>
            <input type="hidden" name={name} value="false" />
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              name={name}
              defaultChecked={checked}
              className="h-5 w-5 rounded border-slate-300 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
            />
          </>
        )}
      </span>
    </label>
  );
}

export function PreferencesForm({ preferences }: { preferences: NotificationPreferenceView }) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(
    async (prev: NotificationActionState, formData: FormData) =>
      updateNotificationPreferencesAction(prev, formData),
    initialState,
  );

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Toggle
          name="inAppEnabled"
          checked={preferences.inAppEnabled}
          label="الإشعارات داخل التطبيق"
          hint="إيقاف أي فئة أدناه يوقف إشعاراتها داخل التطبيق وبريدها معًا"
        />
        <Toggle
          name="emailEnabled"
          checked={preferences.emailEnabled}
          label="الإشعارات بالبريد الإلكتروني"
          hint="رسائل بريد اختيارية مرفقة بالإشعارات المفعّلة — رسائل الأمان تصل دائمًا"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
        <div className="border-b border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/70 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">
          الفئات
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-3 p-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {CATEGORY_ROWS.map((row) => (
            <Toggle
              key={row.key}
              name={row.key}
              checked={Boolean(preferences[row.key])}
              label={row.label}
              hint={row.hint}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/60 p-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-800">رسائل الحساب والأمان</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-emerald-700">
          تأكيد البريد، إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور، وتنبيه تغيّر كلمة المرور — تُرسل دائمًا ولا يمكن تعطيلها
          لأنها مطلوبة لعمل الحساب بأمان.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : "حفظ التفضيلات"}
        </button>
        {state.ok && state.message && (
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600">{state.message}</p>
        )}
        {!state.ok && state.message && (
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-600">{state.message}</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — site header (server component) with the notification bell.
 *
 * Rendered from the root layout for every route. Fail-soft: when no
 * session exists (public pages like certificate verification) the header
 * degrades to the brand bar only — it never blocks rendering.
 */

import Link from "next/link";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { getUnreadCount } from "@/lib/notifications/service";
import { NotificationBell } from "@/app/notifications/bell";

const ROLE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  SUPER_ADMIN: "مدير المنصة",
  DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: "مدير مكتب التطوير",
  EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY: "الوكيل التعليمي",
  EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR: "المشرف التربوي",
  TEACHER: "معلم",
};

export async function SiteHeader() {
  let user: { id: string; name: string; role: string } | null = null;
  let unread = 0;
  try {
    const sessionUser = await getCurrentUser();
    if (sessionUser) {
      user = { id: sessionUser.id, name: sessionUser.name, role: sessionUser.role };
      unread = await getUnreadCount(sessionUser.id);
    }
  } catch {
    user = null;
  }

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur">
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-6xl items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link href={user ? "/dashboard" : "/"} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] text-sm font-bold text-white"
            >
              م
            </span>
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
              منارة قرطبة
              <span className="mr-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400">— تطوير المعلمين</span>
            </span>
          </Link>
        </div>

        {user && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
            <NotificationBell initialUnread={unread} />
            <div className="hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1.5 sm:flex">
              <span className="max-w-40 truncate text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">{user.name}</span>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-[#1D5BD6]/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                {ROLE_LABELS[user.role] ?? user.role}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — notification UI primitives (server-safe presentational).
 * Follows the project design system: slate neutrals + brand blue #1D5BD6,
 * RTL-first Arabic labels.
 */

import { NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_CLASSES, NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_LABELS, type NotificationCategory } from "@/config/notifications";

export function formatNotificationDate(date: Date | string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!date) return "—";
  const value = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date);
  if (Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(value);
}

export function CategoryChip({ category }: { category: string }) {
  const key = (Object.keys(NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_LABELS) as NotificationCategory[]).includes(
    category as NotificationCategory,
  )
    ? (category as NotificationCategory)
    : null;
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
        key ? NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_CLASSES[key] : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200"
      }`}
    >
      {key ? NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_LABELS[key] : "إشعار"}
    </span>
  );
}

const EMAIL_CHIP_CLASSES: Record<string, string> = {
  QUEUED: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200",
  SENT: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200",
  FAILED: "bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200",
  DISABLED: "bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 border-slate-200",
};

const EMAIL_CHIP_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  QUEUED: "البريد: في الانتظار",
  SENT: "البريد: تم الإرسال",
  FAILED: "البريد: فشل الإرسال",
  DISABLED: "البريد: غير مطلوب",
};

/** Honest per-notification email status chip (null = no email involved). */
export function EmailStatusChip({ status }: { status: string | null }) {
  if (!status) return null;
  const classes = EMAIL_CHIP_CLASSES[status] ?? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200";
  const label = EMAIL_CHIP_LABELS[status] ?? "البريد";
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${classes}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

import { SchoolsMetricsSection } from "@/components/dashboard/schools-metrics";
import { UsersMetricsSection } from "@/components/dashboard/users-metrics";
import { RegistrationMetricsSection } from "@/components/dashboard/registration-metrics";
import { AcademyMetricsSection } from "@/components/dashboard/academy-metrics";
import { AssessmentMetricsSection } from "@/components/dashboard/assessment-metrics";
import { DashboardView } from "@/components/dashboard/dashboard-view";
import { RoleDashboard } from "@/components/dashboard/role-dashboard";
import { ItCoordinatorDashboard } from "@/components/dashboard/it-coordinator-dashboard";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { SupervisorDashboardSection } from "@/app/supervision/dashboard/section";

export const metadata = {
  title: "لوحة المعلومات",
};

/**
 * Role-aware dashboard (server component). The session user comes from
 * the DB — never from the client:
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                -> platform dashboard + schools + users + academy metrics
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER -> same shell + THEIR school's metrics
 *                                 (schoolId from the session only)
 *   SCHOOL_MANAGER             -> office-manager-equivalent dashboard,
 *                                 pinned to THEIR school's metrics
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     -> the merged supervisor dashboard
 *                                 (SupervisorDashboardSection): the
 *                                 former "لوحة المشرف" widgets — live
 *                                 DB KPIs, assigned teachers & branches,
 *                                 pending follow-ups, completions and
 *                                 notifications — now live HERE, and
 *                                 /supervision/dashboard redirects here.
 *   IT_COORDINATOR             -> the coordinator dashboard (real
 *                                 school-scoped counters + the two
 *                                 server-enforced capabilities)
 *   every other role           -> scoped role dashboard (RoleDashboard)
 *
 * Phase 1 mock sections keep their honest "بيانات تجريبية" labels.
 */
export default async function HomePage() {
  const user = await requireUser();

  if (user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return (
      <DashboardView
        schoolsSlot={
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <SchoolsMetricsSection />
            <RegistrationMetricsSection />
            <UsersMetricsSection />
            <AcademyMetricsSection />
            <AssessmentMetricsSection />
          </div>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  if (
    (user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
      user.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER") &&
    user.schoolId
  ) {
    return (
      <DashboardView
        schoolsSlot={
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <RegistrationMetricsSection schoolId={user.schoolId} />
            <SchoolsMetricsSection schoolId={user.schoolId} />
            <UsersMetricsSection schoolId={user.schoolId} />
            <AcademyMetricsSection schoolId={user.schoolId} />
            <AssessmentMetricsSection schoolId={user.schoolId} />
          </div>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  if (user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return <SupervisorDashboardSection />;
  }

  // IT coordinator — the coordinator's own dashboard (previously this
  // role fell through to the teacher-style RoleDashboard and the only
  // way to reach /it/* was typing the URL manually).
  if (user.role === "IT_COORDINATOR" && user.schoolId) {
    return <ItCoordinatorDashboard name={user.name} schoolId={user.schoolId} />;
  }

  return <RoleDashboard user={user} />;
}
