"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import {
  BadgeCheck,
  Ban,
  CheckCircle2,
  Copy,
  History,
  Link2,
  Loader2,
  Plus,
  ShieldAlert,
  UserCheck,
  UserRoundCheck,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  createRegistrationLinkAction,
  revokeRegistrationLinkAction,
  type RegistrationLinkActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/registration-links";
import type {
  RegistrationLinksView,
  RegistrationStats,
} from "@/lib/registration-links/service";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/platform/status-badge";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Registration-link manager (client presentation only).                */
/* The raw link URL exists ONLY in the creation response — shown in a   */
/* copy-once panel; the DB stores its SHA-256 hash exclusively.         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function CreateButton({ label }: { label: string }) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return (
    <button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending}
      className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
    >
      {pending ? (
        <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
      ) : (
        <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
      )}
      {pending ? "جارٍ التوليد…" : label}
    </button>
  );
}

function CopyPanel({ linkUrl }: { linkUrl: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);

  const copy = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(linkUrl);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard API can be unavailable (permissions / non-secure
      // contexts) — fall back to the classic selection method.
      const el = document.createElement("textarea");
      el.value = linkUrl;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.select();
      document.execCommand("copy");
      document.body.removeChild(el);
    }
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-brand-300 bg-brand-50/70 p-4">
      <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-extrabold text-brand-800">
        <CheckCircle2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        تم توليد رابط التسجيل — انسخه الآن
      </p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-brand-700">
        لأسباب أمنية يُعرض الرابط مرة واحدة فقط ولا يُخزن إلا مشفّرًا. إذا
        فقدته، ولّد رابطًا جديدًا (سيُلغى الرابط الحالي تلقائيًا).
      </p>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <code
          dir="ltr"
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg border bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-700"
        >
          {linkUrl}
        </code>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={copy}
          className="inline-flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          {copied ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <Copy className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          {copied ? "تم النسخ" : "نسخ"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  tone = "default",
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  tone?: "default" | "warn" | "good" | "info";
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "warn"
      ? "text-amber-600"
      : tone === "good"
        ? "text-emerald-600"
        : tone === "info"
          ? "text-brand-700"
          : "";
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
        {icon && <span className="text-brand-600">{icon}</span>}
        {label}
      </div>
      <p className={`mt-1.5 text-2xl font-extrabold tabular-nums ${toneClass}`}>
        {value}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function linkStateLabel(row: {
  isActive: boolean;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
}): { label: string; tone: "success" | "neutral" | "warning" } {
  const expired =
    row.expiresAt !== null && row.expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now();
  if (row.isActive && !expired) return { label: "نشط", tone: "success" };
  if (row.isActive && expired) return { label: "منتهي الصلاحية", tone: "warning" };
  return { label: "ملغى", tone: "neutral" };
}

const formatDate = (d: Date | null | undefined) =>
  d
    ? d.toLocaleDateString("ar-EG", {
        year: "numeric",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
      })
    : "—";

export function LinkManager({
  view,
  stats,
}: {
  view: RegistrationLinksView;
  stats: RegistrationStats;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [createState, createAction] = React.useActionState<
    RegistrationLinkActionState | null,
    FormData
  >(createRegistrationLinkAction, null);
  const [revokeState, revokeAction] = React.useActionState<
    RegistrationLinkActionState | null,
    FormData
  >(revokeRegistrationLinkAction, null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (createState?.ok || revokeState?.ok) router.refresh();
  }, [createState?.ok, revokeState?.ok, router]);

  const activeLink = view.links.find((l) => l.isActive) ?? null;
  const activeExpired =
    activeLink?.expiresAt !== undefined &&
    activeLink?.expiresAt !== null &&
    (activeLink?.expiresAt?.getTime() ?? 0) <= Date.now();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Registration stats — Phase 6 school-level visibility */}
      <div
        className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-5"
        aria-label="إحصائيات تسجيل المعلمين"
      >
        <StatCard
          label="إجمالي المعلمين"
          value={stats.totalTeachers}
          icon={<UserRoundCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="عبر روابط التسجيل"
          value={stats.viaLinks}
          tone="info"
          icon={<Link2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="بانتظار توثيق البريد"
          value={stats.awaitingVerification}
          tone="warn"
          icon={<ShieldAlert className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="بانتظار إسناد المشرف"
          value={stats.verifiedUnassigned}
          tone="warn"
          icon={<UserCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="مُسنَدون لمشرف"
          value={stats.assigned}
          tone="good"
          icon={<BadgeCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
      </div>

      {!view.schoolIsActive && (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-amber-300/60 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-amber-800">
          المدرسة غير مفعّلة حاليًا — التفعيل شرط لقبول أي تسجيلات جديدة حتى
          مع وجود رابط نشط.
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Active link card */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-extrabold">
              <Link2 className="size-4 text-brand-600" aria-hidden="true" />
              رابط التسجيل الحالي — {view.schoolName}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              رابط واحد نشط لكل مدرسة. توليد رابط جديد يُلغي الرابط السابق
              تلقائيًا دون أي تأثير على المعلمين المسجلين سابقًا.
            </p>
          </div>
          {activeLink && (
            <StatusBadge tone={activeExpired ? "warning" : "success"}>
              {activeExpired ? "منتهي الصلاحية" : "نشط — يقبل التسجيلات"}
            </StatusBadge>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4">
          {activeLink ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sm">
              <p>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">أنشئ في: </span>
                <span className="font-bold">{formatDate(activeLink.createdAt)}</span>
              </p>
              <p>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">الصلاحية: </span>

                  {activeLink.expiresAt
                    ? `حتى ${formatDate(activeLink.expiresAt)}`
                    : "ساري حتى الإلغاء"}

              </p>
              <p>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">مسجلون عبره: </span>
                <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">
                  {activeLink.registrationsCount}
                </span>
              </p>
              <form action={revokeAction}>
                <input type="hidden" name="linkId" value={activeLink.id} />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-error/40 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-error transition-colors hover:bg-error-soft disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  <Ban className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  إلغاء الرابط
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/40 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">

        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t pt-4">

        {revokeState?.ok && (

        {createState?.ok && createState.linkUrl ? (

            role="alert"

            {createState.message}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* Link history */}

        {view.links.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="px-4 py-10 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            لم تُنشأ روابط تسجيل لهذه المدرسة بعد.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[680px] text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-start font-semibold">الحالة</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-start font-semibold">تاريخ الإنشاء</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-start font-semibold">الصلاحية</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-start font-semibold">مسجلون عبره</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-start font-semibold">آخر تسجيل</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-start font-semibold">بواسطة</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {view.links.map((row) => {
                  const state = linkStateLabel(row);
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.id} className="border-b last:border-0">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <StatusBadge tone={state.tone}>{state.label}</StatusBadge>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs">{formatDate(row.createdAt)}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs">
                        {row.expiresAt ? formatDate(row.expiresAt) : "حتى الإلغاء"}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs font-bold tabular-nums">
                        {row.registrationsCount}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs">
                        {formatDate(row.lastRegistrationAt)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {row.createdByName ?? "—"}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
        تدفق العمل: ولّد الرابط ← شاركه مع المعلمين الجدد ← يسجّل المعلم عبره
        ويُربط بمدرستك تلقائيًا ← يؤكد بريده ← يُسند إليه المشرف التربوي من
        تقنية المعلومات ← يصبح مؤهلًا لاستخدام المنصة وفق قواعد الإسناد.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import {
  getSchoolRegistrationStats,
  listRegistrationLinks,
} from "@/lib/registration-links/service";
import { LinkManager } from "./link-manager";

export const metadata = {
  title: "إدارة روابط تسجيل المعلمين | منارة قرطبة",
};

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function first(v: string | string[] | undefined): string {
  return Array.isArray(v) ? (v[0] ?? "") : (v ?? "");
}

/**
 * Registration-link management for the Development Office Manager
 * (school managers share the identical page through the admin-trio
 * context; SUPER_ADMIN picks the target school explicitly — the service
 * re-checks the tenant scope server-side either way).
 */
export default async function RegistrationLinksPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();
  const params = await searchParams;

  // School-scoped managers are pinned to their own school; the platform
  // owner picks a target explicitly (validated again by the service).
  const targetSchoolId = ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? first(params.school) : ctx.schoolId;

  const schools =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? await db.school.findMany({
          where: { isActive: true },
          select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
          orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
        })
      : [];

  if (!targetSchoolId) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title="إدارة روابط تسجيل المعلمين"
          description="اختر المدرسة التي تدير روابط تسجيل معلميها."
          breadcrumbs={[
            { label: "الرئيسية" },
            { label: "روابط التسجيل" },
          ]}
        />
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {schools.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">لا توجد مدارس مفعّلة.</p>
          )}
          {schools.map((school) => (
            <a
              key={school.id}
              href={`/registration-links?school=${encodeURIComponent(school.id)}`}
              className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4 font-bold transition-colors hover:border-brand-300 hover:bg-brand-50/50"
            >
              {school.nameAr}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const [view, stats] = await Promise.all([
    listRegistrationLinks(ctx, targetSchoolId),
    getSchoolRegistrationStats(targetSchoolId),
  ]);

  if (!view.ok) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title="إدارة روابط تسجيل المعلمين"
          breadcrumbs={[{ label: "الرئيسية" }, { label: "روابط التسجيل" }]}
        />
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-error/30 bg-error-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-error">
          {view.message}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="إدارة روابط تسجيل المعلمين"
        description="ولّد رابطًا مخصصًا لمدرستك وشاركه مع المعلمين الجدد — التسجيل عبره يربط كل معلم بمدرستك تلقائيًا، ويُوثَّق بريده، ثم يُسند إليه المشرف التربوي من تقنية المعلومات."
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "الرئيسية" }, { label: "روابط التسجيل" }]}
      />
      <LinkManager view={view.data} stats={stats} />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — report preview page: server-validated filters, the same
 * dataset used by exports, pagination, export links (CSV / Excel) and
 * the print view. Any out-of-scope filter value is rejected here —
 * never silently clamped — so the user always knows what was applied.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { toAnalyticsActor, visibleTeacherIds } from "@/lib/analytics/access";
import { REPORT_CATALOG, buildReport, isReportId, parseReportFilters } from "@/lib/reports/service";
import { REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE } from "@/config/analytics";
import { AccessDenied, Card, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { ReportDocument } from "@/app/reports/report-table";
import { ReportFilterForm, type FilterField, type FilterOption } from "@/app/reports/filter-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const STATUS_OPTIONS: Record<string, FilterOption[]> = {
  "assignment-status": [
    { value: "PUBLISHED", label: "منشور" },
    { value: "CLOSED", label: "مغلق" },
    { value: "ARCHIVED", label: "مؤرشف" },
  ],
  "certificates-growth": [
    { value: "ISSUED", label: "صادرة" },
    { value: "REVOKED", label: "ملغاة" },
  ],
  "survey-results": [
    { value: "DRAFT", label: "مسودة" },
    { value: "PUBLISHED", label: "منشور" },
    { value: "CLOSED", label: "مغلق" },
    { value: "ARCHIVED", label: "مؤرشف" },
  ],
  "followup-activity": [
    { value: "PLANNED", label: "مجدولة" },
    { value: "IN_PROGRESS", label: "قيد التنفيذ" },
    { value: "COMPLETED", label: "مكتملة" },
    { value: "CANCELLED", label: "ملغاة" },
  ],
};

function optionLabel(name: string | null | undefined, fallbackTitle: string): string {
  return name ?? fallbackTitle;
}

export default async function ReportPreviewPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ reportId: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { reportId } = await params;
  const rawQuery = await searchParams;
  const flatQuery: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(rawQuery)) {
    const first = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
    if (typeof first === "string") flatQuery[key] = first;
  }
  const page = Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(flatQuery.page ?? "1", 10) || 1);

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  const actor = toAnalyticsActor(user);
  if (!actor) return <AccessDenied hint="دور الحساب غير معروف — راجع مدير المنصة." />;
  if (!isReportId(reportId)) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="التقرير المطلوب غير موجود." />;
  }
  const definition = REPORT_CATALOG.find((report) => report.id === reportId);
  if (!definition) return <AccessDenied hint="التقرير المطلوب غير موجود." />;

  const filtersResult = await parseReportFilters(actor, flatQuery);
  if (!filtersResult.ok) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title={definition.titleAr} subtitle="تعذر توليد التقرير" />
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-6 text-sm text-amber-800">
          {filtersResult.message}
        </div>
        <Link href="/reports" className="mt-4 inline-block text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
          ← رجوع إلى مركز التقارير
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const filters = filtersResult.data;

  /* ----------------------- Filter options (scope-aware, capped) ------ */
  const schoolId = filters.schoolId;
  const [branches, programs, courses, teachers] = await Promise.all([
    dbBranches(schoolId),
    dbProgramOptions(schoolId),
    dbCourseOptions(schoolId),
    dbTeacherOptions(actor, schoolId),
  ]);
  const supervisors =
    actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
      ? []
      : await dbSupervisorOptions(schoolId);
  const schools = actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? await dbSchoolOptions() : [];

  const fields: FilterField[] = [];
  if (actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    fields.push({
      key: "schoolId",
      label: "المدرسة",
      type: "select",
      options: schools,
      placeholder: "اختر مدرسة",
    });
  }
  if (branches.length > 0) {
    fields.push({ key: "branchId", label: "الفرع", type: "select", options: branches });
  }
  fields.push(
    { key: "dateFrom", label: "من تاريخ", type: "date" },
    { key: "dateTo", label: "إلى تاريخ", type: "date" }
  );
  if (programs.length > 0 && (reportId === "training-completion" || reportId === "development-summary")) {
    fields.push({ key: "programId", label: "البرنامج", type: "select", options: programs });
  }
  if (courses.length > 0 && ["training-completion", "assessment-performance"].includes(reportId)) {
    fields.push({ key: "courseId", label: "الدورة", type: "select", options: courses });
  }
  if (teachers.length > 0 && ["teacher-directory", "certificates-growth", "followup-activity", "assignment-status"].includes(reportId)) {
    fields.push({ key: "teacherId", label: "المعلم", type: "select", options: teachers });
  }
  if (supervisors.length > 0 && reportId === "followup-activity") {
    fields.push({ key: "supervisorId", label: "المشرف", type: "select", options: supervisors });
  }
  const statusOptions = STATUS_OPTIONS[reportId];
  if (statusOptions) {
    fields.push({ key: "status", label: "الحالة", type: "select", options: statusOptions });
  }

  /* --------------------------------------- Build + paginate dataset -- */
  const report = await buildReport(actor, reportId, filters);
  if (!report.ok) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title={definition.titleAr} subtitle="تعذر توليد التقرير" />
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-6 text-sm text-amber-800">
          {report.message}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const data = report.data;
  const totalRows = data.rows.length;
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalRows / REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE));
  const safePage = Math.min(page, pageCount);
  const pageRows = data.rows.slice((safePage - 1) * REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE, safePage * REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE);

  const exportParams = new URLSearchParams();
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(flatQuery)) {
    if (key !== "page" && value && value.trim() !== "") exportParams.set(key, value.trim());
  }
  const exportQs = exportParams.toString();
  const printHref = `/reports/${reportId}/print${exportQs ? `?${exportQs}` : ""}`;
  const csvHref = `/api/reports/${reportId}/export?format=csv${exportQs ? `&${exportQs}` : ""}`;
  const xlsHref = `/api/reports/${reportId}/export?format=xls${exportQs ? `&${exportQs}` : ""}`;

  function pageLink(targetPage: number): string {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(exportParams);
    params.set("page", String(targetPage));
    return `/reports/${reportId}?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={definition.titleAr}
        subtitle={definition.dateColumnHintAr ? `فترة الزمن تنطبق على: ${definition.dateColumnHintAr}` : undefined}
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Link href="/reports" className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50">
              ← مركز التقارير
            </Link>
            <Link href={printHref} className="rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-blue-50">
              عرض الطباعة / PDF
            </Link>
            <a href={csvHref} className="rounded-lg border border-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-blue-50">
              تصدير CSV
            </a>
            <a href={xlsHref} className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#174bb3]">
              تصدير Excel
            </a>
          </div>
        }
      />

      <ReportFilterForm
        reportId={reportId}
        fields={fields}
        current={Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(flatQuery).filter(([key]) => key !== "page"))}
      />

      <div className="mt-4">
        <ReportDocument report={data} rows={pageRows} />
      </div>

      {pageCount > 1 ? (
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500" dir="ltr">
            {totalRows} صفًا — صفحة {safePage} / {pageCount}
          </p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {safePage > 1 ? (
              <Link href={pageLink(safePage - 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50">
                السابق
              </Link>
            ) : null}
            {safePage < pageCount ? (
              <Link href={pageLink(safePage + 1)} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50">
                التالي
              </Link>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <Card>
        <p className="text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-500">
          يعمل التصدير على نفس المرشحات المعروضة ويخضع لنفس التحقق المدرسي — لا يمكن لرابط معدّل أن يوسّع البيانات.
          ملف CSV يُفتح في Excel بترميز عربي سليم، وملف Excel (xls) يدعم الاتجاه من اليمين لليسار، وعرض الطباعة يستخدم
          محرك المتصفح لإنتاج PDF بخط عربي متصل.
        </p>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------- Option loaders (server-side scope) -- */

async function dbBranches(schoolId: string): Promise<FilterOption[]> {
  const rows = await db.branch.findMany({
    where: { schoolId, isActive: true },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
    orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
  });
  return rows.map((row) => ({ value: row.id, label: row.nameAr }));
}

async function dbSchoolOptions(): Promise<FilterOption[]> {
  const rows = await db.school.findMany({
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
    orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
    take: 200,
  });
  return rows.map((row) => ({ value: row.id, label: optionLabel(row.nameAr, "مدرسة") }));
}

async function dbProgramOptions(schoolId: string): Promise<FilterOption[]> {
  const rows = await db.trainingProgram.findMany({
    where: { OR: [{ schoolId }, { schoolId: null }], status: { not: "DRAFT" } },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true, schoolId: true },
    orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
    take: 200,
  });
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    value: row.id,
    label: `${row.nameAr}${row.schoolId === null ? " (عام)" : ""}`,
  }));
}

async function dbCourseOptions(schoolId: string): Promise<FilterOption[]> {
  const rows = await db.course.findMany({
    where: { OR: [{ schoolId }, { schoolId: null }], status: { not: "DRAFT" } },
    select: { id: true, titleAr: true, schoolId: true },
    orderBy: { titleAr: "asc" },
    take: 300,
  });
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    value: row.id,
    label: `${row.titleAr}${row.schoolId === null ? " (عامة)" : ""}`,
  }));
}

async function dbTeacherOptions(
  actor: ReturnType<typeof toAnalyticsActor>,
  schoolId: string
): Promise<FilterOption[]> {
  if (!actor) return [];
  const visible = await visibleTeacherIds(actor, schoolId);
  if (!visible.ok || visible.data.length === 0) return [];
  const rows = await db.user.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: visible.data.slice(0, 300) } },
    select: { id: true, name: true },
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
  });
  return rows.map((row) => ({ value: row.id, label: row.name }));
}

async function dbSupervisorOptions(schoolId: string): Promise<FilterOption[]> {
  const rows = await db.user.findMany({
    where: { schoolId, role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", isActive: true },
    select: { id: true, name: true },
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
  });
  return rows.map((row) => ({ value: row.id, label: row.name }));
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — print-friendly report view. Minimal chrome, @page A4 with
 * Arabic RTL, and a print trigger. The printed/PDF artifact carries the
 * school name, date range, generation timestamp and the SAME filtered
 * dataset as the on-screen report.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { toAnalyticsActor } from "@/lib/analytics/access";
import { buildReport, isReportId, parseReportFilters } from "@/lib/reports/service";
import { AccessDenied } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { ReportDocument } from "@/app/reports/report-table";
import { PrintButton } from "@/app/reports/print-button";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function ReportPrintPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ reportId: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { reportId } = await params;
  const rawQuery = await searchParams;
  const flatQuery: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(rawQuery)) {
    const first = Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
    if (typeof first === "string") flatQuery[key] = first;
  }

  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  const actor = toAnalyticsActor(user);
  if (!actor || !isReportId(reportId)) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="التقرير المطلوب غير موجود." />;
  }

  const filtersResult = await parseReportFilters(actor, flatQuery);
  if (!filtersResult.ok) {
    return <AccessDenied hint={filtersResult.message} />;
  }
  const report = await buildReport(actor, reportId, filtersResult.data);
  if (!report.ok) {
    return <AccessDenied hint={report.message} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl p-6 print:p-0">
      <style>{`
        @page { size: A4; margin: 14mm; }
        @media print {
          .no-print { display: none !important; }
          body { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div className="no-print mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Link href={`/reports/${reportId}`} className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
          ← رجوع إلى عرض التقرير
        </Link>
        <PrintButton />
      </div>

      <ReportDocument report={report.data} rows={report.data.rows} />

      <p className="mt-6 border-t border-slate-200 pt-3 text-center text-[10px] text-slate-400">
        منارة قرطبة — منصة التطوير المهني للمعلمين — تقرير مولّد آليًا من بيانات المنصة
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 10 — report filter form (client). Builds a URL query from the
 * selects and lets the server page re-validate everything — the form
 * can never grant access to out-of-scope data, it can only ask.
 */
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";

export interface FilterOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface FilterField {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  type: "select" | "date";
  options?: FilterOption[];
  placeholder?: string;
}

export function ReportFilterForm({
  reportId,
  fields,
  current,
}: {
  reportId: string;
  fields: FilterField[];
  current: Record<string, string>;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>(current);

  function submit() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
      if (value && value.trim() !== "") params.set(key, value.trim());
    }
    startTransition(() => {
      router.push(`/reports/${reportId}?${params.toString()}`);
    });
  }

  function reset() {
    setValues({});
    startTransition(() => {
      router.push(`/reports/${reportId}`);
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {fields.map((field) => (
          <label key={field.key} className="block text-xs">
            <span className="mb-1 block font-semibold text-slate-600">{field.label}</span>
            {field.type === "select" ? (
              <select
                value={values[field.key] ?? ""}
                onChange={(event) => setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field.key]: event.target.value }))}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-700 focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:outline-none"
              >
                <option value="">{field.placeholder ?? "الكل"}</option>
                {(field.options ?? []).map((option) => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            ) : (
              <input
                type="date"
                value={values[field.key] ?? ""}
                onChange={(event) => setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field.key]: event.target.value }))}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-700 focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:outline-none"
              />
            )}
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={submit}
          disabled={pending}
          className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#174bb3] disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? "جارٍ التحديث…" : "تطبيق المرشحات"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={reset}
          disabled={pending}
          className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          إعادة تعيين
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**

 *   - TEACHER: annual hours vs the 35-hour target, growth journey

 *   - EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR: the assigned-teachers analytics (v13) with

 *     via the session schoolId; a school-scoped admin without a school

function Stat({
  label,
  value,
  tone = "neutral",
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  tone?: "neutral" | "success" | "warning";
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4">
      <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">{value}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
      {tone !== "neutral" && (
        <div className="mt-2">
          <StatusBadge tone={tone} withDot={false}>
            {tone === "success" ? "مستهدف محقق" : "قيد التقدم"}
          </StatusBadge>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 10 — print trigger: opens the browser print dialog for the
 * print-optimized report view (the browser's PDF engine preserves
 * Arabic shaping natively — "حفظ كـ PDF" produces the PDF report).
 */
export function PrintButton({ label = "طباعة / حفظ PDF" }: { label?: string }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => window.print()}
      className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#174bb3]"
    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — shared server-safe report renderer: meta block, summary
 * tiles, the data table, and (for the development summary) the labeled
 * sections. Used by BOTH the preview page and the print view so the
 * screen and the printed/exported artifact are structurally identical.
 */
import type { ReportData } from "@/lib/reports/service";

function formatMetaDate(date: Date): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(date);
}

export function ReportMetaBlock({ report }: { report: ReportData }) {
  const meta = report.meta;
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">{meta.titleAr}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{meta.descriptionAr}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-left text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-400" dir="rtl">
          {meta.schoolName ? <p>المدرسة: {meta.schoolName}</p> : null}
          {meta.branchName ? <p>الفرع: {meta.branchName}</p> : null}
          {meta.dateRangeLabel ? <p>الفترة: {meta.dateRangeLabel}</p> : null}
          <p>وُلِّد في: {formatMetaDate(meta.generatedAt)}</p>
          <p>{meta.scopeNote}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ReportSummaryTiles({ report }: { report: ReportData }) {
  if (report.summary.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
      {report.summary.map((item) => (
        <div
          key={item.label}
          className={`rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-sm ${
            item.kind === "metric" ? "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50" : "border-slate-200 bg-white"
          }`}
        >
          <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500">{item.label}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900" dir="ltr">
            {item.value}
          </p>
          {item.note ? <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-400">{item.note}</p> : null}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ReportTable({ report, rows }: { report: ReportData; rows: ReportData["rows"] }) {
  if (report.columns.length === 0) return null;
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 p-8 text-center">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">لا توجد سجلات مطابقة للمرشحات الحالية</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
          جرّب توسيع الفترة الزمنية أو إزالة بعض المرشحات — التقرير يعرض البيانات الفعلية فقط ولا يملأ الفراغ ببيانات وهمية.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
      <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {report.columns.map((column) => (
              <th key={column.key} className="px-3 py-2.5 font-semibold">
                {column.label}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row, index) => (
            <tr key={index} className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0">
              {report.columns.map((column) => {
                const value = row.values[column.key] ?? null;
                return (
                  <td key={column.key} className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600" dir={column.type === "text" ? undefined : "ltr"}>
                    {value === null ? "—" : String(value)}
                  </td>
                );
              })}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ReportSections({ report }: { report: ReportData }) {
  if (!report.sections) return null;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {report.sections.map((section) => (
        <section key={section.titleAr} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">{section.titleAr}</h2>
          <dl className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
            {section.items.map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item.label}
                className={`rounded-lg border p-3 ${
                  item.kind === "fact"
                    ? "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/60"
                    : item.kind === "metric"
                      ? "border-blue-200 bg-blue-50"
                      : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50"
                }`}
              >
                <dt className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">{item.label}</dt>
                <dd className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">{item.value}</dd>
                {item.note ? <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-500">{item.note}</p> : null}
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
          {section.note ? (
            <p className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3 text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-500">{section.note}</p>
          ) : null}
        </section>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Complete report document (meta + summary + table + sections). */
export function ReportDocument({ report, rows }: { report: ReportData; rows: ReportData["rows"] }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <ReportMetaBlock report={report} />
      <ReportSummaryTiles report={report} />
      <ReportTable report={report} rows={rows} />
      <ReportSections report={report} />
      {report.truncated ? (
        <p className="rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs text-amber-700">
          تم اقتصار التقرير على الحد الأقصى للصفوف ({report.rows.length} صفًا) — قلّص نطاق المرشحات لرؤية الباقي.
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { Printer } from "lucide-react";

/** One-tap print + auto-print on first render (after paint). */
export function PrintTrigger() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => window.print(), 400);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="mb-6 flex justify-start print:hidden">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => window.print()}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700"
      >
        <Printer className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        طباعة التقرير
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { CircleOff, Clock, Link2Off } from "lucide-react";

import { AuthCard } from "@/components/auth/auth-card";
import { resolvePublicBranding } from "@/lib/branding";
import { peekPasswordResetToken } from "@/lib/auth/one-time-tokens";
import { ResetPasswordForm } from "./reset-password-form";

export const metadata = {
  title: "إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور | منارة قرطبة",
};

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Public "reset password" gate — the target of the single-use expiring
 * reset link emailed by the public forgot-password flow AND by the IT
 * coordinator's recovery action (both build /reset-password?token=…).
 * This page was previously missing, so emailed recovery links landed on
 * a 404 — the token is now peeked SERVER-SIDE (never consumed by this
 * render) and the form only renders for a valid, unused, unexpired link.
 */
export default async function ResetPasswordPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ token?: string; school?: string }>;
}) {
  const { token: rawToken, school } = await searchParams;
  const resolved = await resolvePublicBranding(school);
  const wrapperStyle = resolved.cssVars as CSSProperties;

  const forgotHref = resolved.school
    ? `/forgot-password?school=${encodeURIComponent(resolved.school.slug)}`
    : "/forgot-password";

  const status = rawToken ? await peekPasswordResetToken(rawToken) : "invalid";

  if (status !== "ok") {
    const headline =
      status === "expired"
        ? "انتهت صلاحية رابط إعادة التعيين"
        : status === "used"
          ? "تم استخدام رابط إعادة التعيين من قبل"
          : "رابط إعادة التعيين غير صالح";
    const hint =
      status === "expired"
        ? "روابط إعادة التعيين صالحة لمدة ساعة واحدة فقط من لحظة الإرسال — اطلب رابطًا جديدًا ثم أكمل الإعادة خلال مدته."
        : status === "used"
          ? "كل رابط يُستخدم مرة واحدة فقط لأمان حسابك — إذا كنت تحتاج لتغيير كلمة المرور مرة أخرى فاطلب رابطًا جديدًا."
          : "تأكد من فتح الرابط الكامل كما وصلك في الرسالة، دون تعديل أو حذف أي جزء منه.";

    return (
      <div style={wrapperStyle}>
        <AuthCard
          branding={resolved.branding}
          className="max-w-md"
          title="إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور"
          description="روابط إعادة التعيين آمنة ومؤقتة: استعمال واحد، وانتهاء بعد ساعة."
          compact
        >
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-300/60 bg-amber-50 p-5 text-center">
            <span className="mx-auto flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-700">
              {status === "expired" ? (
                <Clock className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : status === "used" ? (
                <CircleOff className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <Link2Off className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
            </span>
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-extrabold text-amber-800">{headline}</p>
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-700">{hint}</p>
          </div>
          <Link
            href={forgotHref}
            className="mt-4 block rounded-xl border border-brand-200 bg-brand-50 px-4 py-2.5 text-center text-sm font-bold text-brand-700 transition-colors hover:bg-brand-100"
          >
            اطلب رابطًا جديدًا
          </Link>
        </AuthCard>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={wrapperStyle}>
      <AuthCard
        branding={resolved.branding}
        className="max-w-md"
        title="إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور"
        description="اختر كلمة مرور جديدة لحسابك — 8 أحرف على الأقل مع رقم واحد. بعد التغيير ستُغلق كل الجلسات المفتوحة تلقائيًا."
      >
        {/* peek() above validated the link WITHOUT consuming it — the
        atomic single-use consume happens inside the server action. */}
        <ResetPasswordForm token={rawToken!} />
      </AuthCard>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { resetPasswordAction, type AuthFormState } from "@/app/actions/auth";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

function SubmitButton() {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return (
    <Button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending}
      className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-l from-brand-600 to-brand-500 text-[15px] font-bold shadow-lg shadow-brand-600/25 transition-all hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-brand-600/30 hover:brightness-105 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
    >
      {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
      {pending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : "تعيين كلمة المرور الجديدة"}
    </Button>
  );
}

/**
 * Reset-password form. On success the server action redirects to
 * /login?reset=1 (which renders the Arabic success banner) — the client
 * only adds presentation and field-level errors.
 */
export function ResetPasswordForm({ token }: { token: string }) {
  const [state, formAction] = React.useActionState<AuthFormState | null, FormData>(
    resetPasswordAction,
    null
  );
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = React.useState(false);

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-5" noValidate>
      <input type="hidden" name="token" value={token} />

      {state && !state.ok && state.message && (
        <p
          role="alert"
          className="rounded-xl border border-error/30 bg-error-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-error"
        >
          {state.message}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label htmlFor="reset-password" className="text-[13px] font-semibold">
          كلمة المرور الجديدة
        </label>
        <div className="relative">
          <Input
            id="reset-password"
            name="password"
            type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
            dir="ltr"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            placeholder="8 أحرف على الأقل مع رقم واحد"
            required
            aria-invalid={Boolean(state?.fieldErrors?.password)}
            aria-describedby={
              state?.fieldErrors?.password ? "reset-password-error" : undefined
            }
            className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-background pe-10 text-[15px] aria-[invalid=true]:border-destructive"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowPassword((v) => !v)}
            aria-label={showPassword ? "إخفاء كلمة المرور" : "إظهار كلمة المرور"}
            aria-pressed={showPassword}
            className="absolute right-1.5 top-1/2 inline-flex size-8 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
          >
            {showPassword ? (
              <EyeOff className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            ) : (
              <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
        {state?.fieldErrors?.password && (
          <p id="reset-password-error" className="text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
            {state.fieldErrors.password}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label htmlFor="reset-confirm" className="text-[13px] font-semibold">
          تأكيد كلمة المرور
        </label>
        <div className="relative">
          <Input
            id="reset-confirm"
            name="confirmPassword"
            type={showConfirm ? "text" : "password"}
            dir="ltr"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            placeholder="أعد كتابة كلمة المرور"
            required
            aria-invalid={Boolean(state?.fieldErrors?.confirmPassword)}
            aria-describedby={
              state?.fieldErrors?.confirmPassword ? "reset-confirm-error" : undefined
            }
            className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-background pe-10 text-[15px] aria-[invalid=true]:border-destructive"
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowConfirm((v) => !v)}
            aria-label={showConfirm ? "إخفاء التأكيد" : "إظهار التأكيد"}
            aria-pressed={showConfirm}
            className="absolute right-1.5 top-1/2 inline-flex size-8 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
          >
            {showConfirm ? (
              <EyeOff className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            ) : (
              <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
        {state?.fieldErrors?.confirmPassword && (
          <p id="reset-confirm-error" className="text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
            {state.fieldErrors.confirmPassword}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <SubmitButton />

      <p className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <ShieldCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        بعد التعيين تُغلق كل الجلسات المفتوحة على أجهزتك حفاظًا على حسابك.
      </p>
    </form>
  );
}

      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Edit form */}
        <div className="xl:col-span-2">
          <SectionCard
            title="بيانات المدرسة"
            description="تعديل الاسم والهوية والرابط المختصر — تُطبَّق فوراً بعد الحفظ."
          >
            <SchoolForm mode="edit" initial={schoolDto} />
          </SectionCard>
        </div>

        {/* Info side card */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <SectionCard title="معلومات سريعة">
            <ul className="space-y-3.5" role="list">
              {infoRows.map((row) => {
                const Icon = row.icon;
                return (
                  <li key={row.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                      <Icon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                      {row.label}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
                      {row.value}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </SectionCard>

          <SectionCard title="ملاحظة حول الحذف النهائي">
            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              الحذف النهائي للمدارس غير متاح عمداً: كل مدرسة مرتبطة بفروع
              وبسجلات ستتوسع في المراحل القادمة (معلمون، برامج، شهادات).
              إيقاف المدرسة يخفيها من التشغيل مع الحفاظ على سلامة السجلات
              وإمكانية استرجاعها في أي وقت.
            </p>
          </SectionCard>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Branches */}
      <div className="mt-6">
        <BranchesManager schoolId={schoolDto.id} branches={branchDtos} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ImageUp, RotateCcw, Save, Trash2, Wand2 } from "lucide-react";

import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  saveSchoolBrandingAction,
  removeSchoolLogoAction,
  resetSchoolBrandingAction,
  uploadSchoolLogoAction,
  requestSchoolLogoUploadAction,
  commitSchoolLogoUploadAction,
  type BrandingActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/school-branding";
import {
  normalizeHex,
  rankColors,
  suggestPalette,
  type RgbPixel,
} from "@/lib/branding/colors";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* School branding manager (client).                                    */
/*                                                                      */
/* Logo upload with live preview + client-side dominant-color analysis  */
/* (canvas, zero dependencies) suggesting a harmonious palette the      */
/* admin can apply with ONE click or override per color. Colors are     */
/* editable with native pickers + HEX inputs, and a live preview        */
/* renders the identity BEFORE saving. Nothing touches the saved        */
/* school colors until an explicit save.                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface BrandingManagerProps {
  initialBranding: {
    scope: "platform" | "school";
    schoolId: string | null;
    schoolName: string;
    slug: string;
    logoUrl: string | null;
    nameAr: string;
    colors: { primary: string; secondary: string; accent: string; neutral: string };
    tagline: string | null;
  };
  /** All active schools — SUPER_ADMIN picker only (empty otherwise). */
  schools: Array<{ id: string; nameAr: string }>;
  isSuperAdmin: boolean;
  /** False when an office manager account is not bound to a school. */
  hasOwnSchool: boolean;
}

type Palette = BrandingManagerProps["initialBranding"]["colors"];

const COLOR_FIELDS: Array<{
  key: keyof Palette;
  label: string;
  hint: string;
}> = [
  { key: "primary", label: "اللون الأساسي", hint: "الأزرار والروابط والنشاط — يولّد درجات العلامة كاملة" },
  { key: "secondary", label: "اللون الثانوي", hint: "لمسة التمييز الثانوية (البرامج والمخططات)" },
  { key: "accent", label: "لون التمييز", hint: "شارات وتحديدات ثانوية" },
  { key: "neutral", label: "اللون المساند", hint: "الشريط الجانبي والأسطح الداكنة — يُفضّل داكنًا لضمان التباين" },
];

function ColorField({
  label,
  hint,
  value,
  onChange,
  error,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (hex: string) => void;
  error?: string;
}) {
  const normalized = normalizeHex(value) ?? "#000000";
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold">{label}</p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>
        </div>
        <div
          className="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg border shadow-xs"
          style={{ backgroundColor: normalized }}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <input
          type="color"
          value={normalized}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
          className="size-9 cursor-pointer rounded-lg border bg-card p-1"
          aria-label={`${label} — منتقي الألوان`}
        />
        <Input
          dir="ltr"
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="#1D5BD6"
          className="max-w-32 font-mono text-sm"
          aria-label={`${label} — قيمة HEX`}
          aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
        />
      </div>
      {error && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">{error}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function BrandingManager({
  initialBranding,
  schools,
  isSuperAdmin,
  hasOwnSchool,
}: BrandingManagerProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [schoolId, setSchoolId] = React.useState(initialBranding.schoolId ?? "");
  const [nameAr, setNameAr] = React.useState(initialBranding.nameAr);
  const [tagline, setTagline] = React.useState(initialBranding.tagline ?? "");
  const [colors, setColors] = React.useState<Palette>(initialBranding.colors);
  const [logoUrl, setLogoUrl] = React.useState<string | null>(initialBranding.logoUrl);

  const [logoPreview, setLogoPreview] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [suggested, setSuggested] = React.useState<Palette | null>(null);
  const [analysisNote, setAnalysisNote] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const [saveState, setSaveState] = React.useState<BrandingActionState | null>(null);
  const [uploadState, setUploadState] = React.useState<BrandingActionState | null>(null);
  const [resetState, setResetState] = React.useState<BrandingActionState | null>(null);
  const [removeState, setRemoveState] = React.useState<BrandingActionState | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = React.useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = React.useState(0);

  const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = saveState?.fieldErrors ?? {};
  const activeLogo = logoPreview ?? logoUrl;

  /* ---------------- logo analysis (client canvas, no deps) --------- */

  async function analyzeLogoFile(file: File): Promise<void> {
    setSuggested(null);
    setAnalysisNote(null);
    try {
      const bitmapUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      const image = new Image();
      image.src = bitmapUrl;
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        image.onload = () => resolve();
        image.onerror = () => reject(new Error("image decode failed"));
      });

      const size = 64;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = size;
      canvas.height = size;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
      if (!ctx) throw new Error("canvas unavailable");
      ctx.drawImage(image, 0, 0, size, size);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(bitmapUrl);

      const { data } = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, size, size);
      const pixels: RgbPixel[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
        const alpha = data[i + 3];
        if (alpha < 24) continue; // transparent
        pixels.push({ r: data[i], g: data[i + 1], b: data[i + 2] });
      }
      if (pixels.length === 0) throw new Error("no opaque pixels");

      const palette = suggestPalette(rankColors(pixels));
      setSuggested(palette);
      setAnalysisNote("حلّلنا ألوان الشعار واقترحنا لوحة متناسقة — راجعها وعدّل ما تشاء قبل التطبيق.");
    } catch {
      setSuggested(null);
      setAnalysisNote("تعذر تحليل ألوان الشعار تلقائيًا — اختر الألوان يدويًا من المنتقيات بالأسفل.");
    }
  }

  function handleLogoSelected(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const okType = ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/webp"].includes(file.type);
    if (!okType) {
      setUploadState({ ok: false, message: "الصيغ المدعومة: PNG أو JPG أو WEBP." });
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setUploadState({ ok: false, message: "الحد الأقصى لحجم الشعار 2 ميجابايت." });
      return;
    }
    setUploadState(null);
    setLogoPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    void analyzeLogoFile(file);
  }

  /** Direct browser → R2 PUT with real progress events (same pattern
   * as the media input). */
  function putWithProgress(
    uploadUrl: string,
    contentType: string,
    target: File
  ): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open("PUT", uploadUrl);
      xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", contentType);
      xhr.upload.onprogress = (event) => {
        if (event.lengthComputable) setProgress(event.loaded / event.total);
      };
      xhr.onload = () => {
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) resolve();
        else reject(new Error(`R2_REJECTED_${xhr.status}`));
      };
      xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error("NETWORK"));
      xhr.onabort = () => reject(new Error("ABORTED"));
      xhr.send(target);
    });
  }

  function markLogoUploaded(newLogoUrl: string | null) {
    if (logoPreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(logoPreview);
    setLogoPreview(null);
    setLogoUrl(newLogoUrl);
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function handleLogoUpload() {
    if (!logoPreview || uploading) return;
    const input = document.getElementById("branding-logo-input") as HTMLInputElement | null;
    const file = input?.files?.[0];
    if (!file) {
      setUploadState({ ok: false, message: "اختر ملف الشعار أولًا." });
      return;
    }
    setUploadState(null);
    setProgress(0);
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const request = await requestSchoolLogoUploadAction(schoolId, file.type, file.size);
      if (!request.ok) {
        setUploadState({ ok: false, message: request.message });
        return;
      }

      if (request.mode === "local") {
        // R2 not configured (local dev) — legacy local-disk path.
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.set("schoolId", schoolId);
        formData.set("logo", file);
        const state = await uploadSchoolLogoAction(null, formData);
        setUploadState(state);
        if (state.ok) markLogoUploaded(state.logoUrl ?? null);
        return;
      }

      await putWithProgress(request.uploadUrl, file.type, file);
      const state = await commitSchoolLogoUploadAction({
        schoolIdHint: schoolId,
        key: request.key,
        mimeType: file.type,
      });
      setUploadState(state);
      if (state.ok) markLogoUploaded(state.logoUrl ?? null);
    } catch (error) {
      const raw = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "";
      setUploadState({
        ok: false,
        message: raw.startsWith("R2_REJECTED_")
          ? "رفض التخزين السحابي الملف — تحقق من الصيغة والحجم ثم أعد المحاولة."
          : raw === "NETWORK" || raw === "ABORTED"
            ? "تعذّر الوصول للتخزين السحابي من المتصفح — تحقق من سياسة CORS على bucket في Cloudflare (أضف نطاق الموقع مع الطريقة PUT)."
            : "انقطع الاتصال أثناء رفع الشعار — حاول مرة أخرى.",
      });
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      setProgress(0);
    }
  }

  async function handleRemoveLogo() {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set("schoolId", schoolId);
    const state = await removeSchoolLogoAction(null, formData);
    setRemoveState(state);
    if (state.ok) {
      if (logoPreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(logoPreview);
      setLogoPreview(null);
      setLogoUrl(null);
      router.refresh();
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- palette + save --------------------------------- */

  function applySuggested() {
    if (!suggested) return;
    setColors(suggested);
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set("schoolId", schoolId);
    formData.set("nameAr", nameAr);
    formData.set("tagline", tagline);
    formData.set("primary", colors.primary);
    formData.set("secondary", colors.secondary);
    formData.set("accent", colors.accent);
    formData.set("neutral", colors.neutral);
    const state = await saveSchoolBrandingAction(null, formData);
    setSaveState(state);
    if (state.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  async function handleReset() {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set("schoolId", schoolId);
    const state = await resetSchoolBrandingAction(null, formData);
    setResetState(state);
    if (state.ok) {
      setColors({
        primary: "#1D5BD6",
        secondary: "#2AA5C0",
        accent: "#E8A13A",
        neutral: "#1E2A4A",
      });
      router.refresh();
    }
  }

  function handleSchoolChange(nextId: string) {
    setSchoolId(nextId);
    router.replace(`/schools/branding?school=${encodeURIComponent(nextId)}`);
  }

  /* ---------------- render ----------------------------------------- */

  if (isSuperAdmin && !schoolId) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <header>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold">هوية المدرسة</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            اختر المدرسة المراد إدارة هويتها البصرية.
          </p>
        </header>
        <div className="max-w-md space-y-3 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-6">
          <Label htmlFor="school-picker">المدرسة</Label>
          <select
            id="school-picker"
            value={schoolId}
            onChange={(e) => handleSchoolChange(e.target.value)}
            className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm"
          >
            <option value="">— اختر مدرسة —</option>
            {schools.map((school) => (
              <option key={school.id} value={school.id}>
                {school.nameAr}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const previewSubtitle = tagline.trim() || "منصة التنمية المهنية للمعلمين";
  const previewName = nameAr.trim() ? `منارة ${nameAr.trim()}` : "منارة";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold">هوية المدرسة</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            الشعار والاسم المعروض والألوان التي تظهر بها {previewName} على كل
            المنصة: تسجيل الدخول، لوحة المعلومات، الشهادات والتقارير — وتُطبق
            فورًا بعد الحفظ.
          </p>
        </div>
        {isSuperAdmin && schools.length > 0 && (
          <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
            <Label htmlFor="school-picker-top">المدرسة</Label>
            <select
              id="school-picker-top"
              value={schoolId}
              onChange={(e) => handleSchoolChange(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1.5 h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm"
            >
              {schools.map((school) => (
                <option key={school.id} value={school.id}>
                  {school.nameAr}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}
      </header>

      {!hasOwnSchool && !isSuperAdmin && (
        <Alert>
          <AlertDescription>
            حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة — تواصل مع مدير المنصة لربط حسابك بمدرسة
            قبل إدارة الهوية.
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {saveState && !saveState.ok && saveState.message && (
        <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert">
          <AlertDescription>{saveState.message}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      {saveState?.ok && saveState.message && (
        <div
          className="rounded-lg border border-success/30 bg-success-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-success"
          role="status"
        >
          {saveState.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-5">
        {/* ---------------- identity form ---------------- */}
        <div className="space-y-6 lg:col-span-3">
          {/* Logo */}
          <section className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-6">
            <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold">شعار المدرسة</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              PNG أو JPG أو WEBP — بحد أقصى 2 ميجابايت. يظهر في الشريط الجانبي
              وصفحات الدخول والشهادات.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              <div className="flex size-20 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border bg-muted/50">
                {activeLogo ? (
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  <img
                    src={activeLogo}
                    alt="معاينة شعار المدرسة"
                    className="size-full object-contain p-1.5"
                    draggable={false}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">لا شعار</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <label
                  htmlFor="branding-logo-input"
                  className="inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
                >
                  <ImageUp className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  اختر شعارًا
                </label>
                <input
                  id="branding-logo-input"
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp"
                  className="sr-only"
                  onChange={handleLogoSelected}
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => void handleLogoUpload()}
                  disabled={!logoPreview || uploading}
                >
                  {uploading
                    ? `جارٍ الرفع… ${Math.round(progress * 100)}%`
                    : "حفظ الشعار"}
                </Button>
                {logoUrl && (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
                    onClick={() => void handleRemoveLogo()}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    حذف الشعار
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {uploadState && !uploadState.ok && uploadState.message && (
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">{uploadState.message}</p>
            )}
            {uploadState?.ok && (
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold text-success">{uploadState.message}</p>
            )}
            {removeState?.ok && (
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold text-success">{removeState.message}</p>
            )}
          </section>

          {/* Suggested palette */}
          {suggested && (
            <section className="rounded-2xl border border-brand-200 bg-brand-50/60 p-6">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-base font-extrabold">
                    <Wand2 className="size-4 text-brand-600" aria-hidden="true" />
                    لوحة مقترحة من الشعار
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {analysisNote}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={applySuggested}>
                  تطبيق المقترح
                </Button>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
                {(Object.keys(suggested) as Array<keyof Palette>).map((key) => (
                  <div key={key} className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-2 text-center">
                    <div
                      className="h-12 w-full rounded-lg border"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: suggested[key] }}
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <p className="mt-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                      {suggested[key]}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                التطبيق لا يحفظ تلقائيًا — راجع الألوان في المعاينة ثم اضغط
                «حفظ الهوية».
              </p>
            </section>
          )}
          {!suggested && analysisNote && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-muted/40 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {analysisNote}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Colors */}
          <section className="space-y-4">
            <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold">ألوان الهوية</h2>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {COLOR_FIELDS.map((field) => (
                <ColorField
                  key={field.key}
                  label={field.label}
                  hint={field.hint}
                  value={colors[field.key]}
                  error={fieldErrors[field.key]}
                  onChange={(hex) =>
                    setColors((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field.key]: hex }))
                  }
                />
              ))}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              درجات العلامة (الفاتحة للداكنة) تُشتق تلقائيًا من اللون الأساسي
              لضمان تباين مقروء في كل الواجهات.
            </p>
          </section>

          {/* Text identity */}
          <section className="grid gap-4 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="branding-name">اسم المدرسة المعروض</Label>
              <Input
                id="branding-name"
                value={nameAr}
                onChange={(e) => setNameAr(e.target.value)}
                maxLength={80}
                required
                aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.nameAr)}
              />
              {fieldErrors.nameAr && (
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">{fieldErrors.nameAr}</p>
              )}
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                يظهر باسم «منارة {nameAr.trim() || "…"}» في كل الواجهات.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { canManageSchoolBranding } from "@/lib/auth/roles";
import {
  getActiveSchoolBrandingById,
  resolveManageableSchoolId,
} from "@/lib/branding";
import { BrandingManager } from "./branding-manager";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "هوية المدرسة" };
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

interface BrandingPageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{ school?: string }>;
}

/**
 * School branding manager (multi-school identity).
 *
 * Authorization (server-side, fail-closed):
 *  - SUPER_ADMIN: manages any school — a picker lists all schools and
 *    ?school={id} selects the target;
 *  - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: locked to their OWN school — a client
 *    hint for another tenant is rejected before any read/write.
 */
export default async function SchoolBrandingPage({
  searchParams,
}: BrandingPageProps) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) redirect("/login?next=%2Fschools%2Fbranding");
  if (!canManageSchoolBranding(user.role)) redirect("/forbidden");

  const { school: schoolParam } = await searchParams;
  const target = resolveManageableSchoolId(
    { role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId },
    schoolParam ?? null
  );
  if (!target.ok) redirect("/forbidden");

  // Super admin without a selected school yet → load their default (or
  // none) and show the picker; office managers are already locked.
  const resolved = await getActiveSchoolBrandingById(target.schoolId);

  const schools =
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? await db.school.findMany({
          where: { isActive: true },
          select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
          orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
        })
      : [];

  return (
    <BrandingManager
      initialBranding={{
        scope: resolved.scope,
        schoolId: resolved.school?.id ?? null,
        schoolName: resolved.school?.name ?? "",
        slug: resolved.school?.slug ?? "",
        logoUrl: resolved.branding.logoUrl ?? null,
        nameAr: resolved.school?.name ?? "",
        colors: resolved.colors,
        tagline: resolved.tagline,
      }}
      schools={schools}
      isSuperAdmin={user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"}
      hasOwnSchool={Boolean(user.schoolId)}
    />
  );
}
