import { Suspense } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Building2, Plus } from "lucide-react";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { SchoolsDirectory } from "@/components/schools/schools-directory";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { listSchools } from "@/lib/schools/service";
import { toSchoolListItem } from "@/lib/schools/dto";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";

export const metadata = {
  title: "المدارس والفروع",
};

/** Table skeleton used while the schools list loads. */
function DirectorySkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Skeleton className="h-10 flex-1" />
        <Skeleton className="h-10 w-36" />
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
        {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, index) => (
          <div key={index} className="flex items-center gap-4 border-b p-4 last:border-b-0">
            <Skeleton className="size-10 rounded-full" />
            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-48" />
            <Skeleton className="ms-auto h-4 w-20" />
            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-16" />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Data-loading wrapper — isolated so Suspense covers only the query. */
async function DirectoryContent() {
  let schools: ReturnType<typeof toSchoolListItem>[] | null = null;

  try {
    schools = (await listSchools()).map(toSchoolListItem);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[schools] failed to load the schools directory", error);
  }

  if (!schools) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs">
        <EmptyState
          icon={Building2}
          title="تعذر تحميل قائمة المدارس"
          description="حدث خطأ أثناء الاتصال بقاعدة البيانات. تحقق من تشغيل قاعدة البيانات ثم أعد تحميل الصفحة."
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <SchoolsDirectory schools={schools} />;
}

export default function SchoolsPage() {
  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="المدارس والفروع"
        description="دليل المدارس المسجلة في المنصة: الهوية، الفروع، المراحل التعليمية، وحالة التفعيل."
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "المدارس" }]}
        actions={
          <Button asChild>
            <Link href="/schools/new">
              <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              إضافة مدرسة
            </Link>
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Suspense fallback={<DirectorySkeleton />}>
        <DirectoryContent />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Batch 3 — "مستخدمو المدرسة" (EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY, read-only).
 *
 * The deputy browses the users of the schools granted to them via
 * DeputyGrant (school-wide grant → all users; branch grant → that
 * branch's users only). Strictly read-only: this page renders NO
 * creation or editing UI, and the underlying server actions keep
 * rejecting deputies independently — the missing button is not the
 * security boundary, the role checks in the actions are.
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { roleLabel } from "@/lib/auth/roles";
import {
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata = {
  title: "مستخدمو المدرسة",
};

const DIRECTORY_ROLES = [
  "TEACHER",
  "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
  "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY",
  "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER",
  "SCHOOL_MANAGER",
  "IT_COORDINATOR",
] as const;

const PAGE_SIZE = 30;

export default async function SchoolUsersPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ q?: string; role?: string; page?: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await requireUser();
  if (user.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    return (
      <Card>
        <EmptyState
          title="غير مصرح"
          hint="هذه الصفحة متاحة للوكيل التعليمي فقط."
        />
      </Card>
    );
  }

  // The deputy's visibility scope comes from persisted DeputyGrant rows.
  const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
    where: { userId: user.id },
    select: { schoolId: true, branchId: true },
  });

  if (grants.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader
          title="مستخدمو المدرسة"
          subtitle="عرض للقراءة فقط داخل نطاق الاطلاع الممنوح لك"
        />
        <Card>
          <EmptyState
            title="لا يوجد نطاق اطلاع ممنوح لك بعد"
            hint="تواصل مع إدارة المنصة لمنحك صلاحية الاطلاع على مدرسة أو فرع محدد."
          />
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const schoolIds = Array.from(new Set(grants.map((grant) => grant.schoolId)));
  const wholeSchoolGrants = new Set(
    grants.filter((grant) => grant.branchId === null).map((grant) => grant.schoolId)
  );

  const params = await searchParams;
  const q = params.q?.trim();
  const roleFilter =
    params.role && (DIRECTORY_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(params.role)
      ? params.role
      : null;
  const page = Number(params.page ?? "1") || 1;

  // Load candidates from the granted schools, then apply branch-level
  // grants in memory (a branch grant narrows the school-wide list).
  const candidates = await db.user.findMany({
    where: {
      schoolId: { in: schoolIds },
      role: { in: [...DIRECTORY_ROLES] },
      ...(q
        ? {
            OR: [
              { name: { contains: q } },
              { email: { contains: q } },
            ],
          }
        : {}),
    },
    include: {
      branch: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
    },
    orderBy: [{ name: "asc" }],
  });

  const visible = candidates.filter((candidate) => {
    if (!candidate.schoolId) return false;
    if (wholeSchoolGrants.has(candidate.schoolId)) return true;
    return grants.some(
      (grant) =>
        grant.schoolId === candidate.schoolId &&
        grant.branchId !== null &&
        grant.branchId === candidate.branchId
    );
  });

  const filtered = roleFilter
    ? visible.filter((candidate) => candidate.role === roleFilter)
    : visible;

  const total = filtered.length;
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE));
  const currentPage = Math.min(Math.max(1, page), pageCount);
  const rows = filtered.slice((currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, currentPage * PAGE_SIZE);

  // Current supervisor per visible teacher (from persisted assignments).
  const teacherIds = rows
    .filter((row) => row.role === "TEACHER")
    .map((row) => row.id);
  const supervisorLinks =
    teacherIds.length > 0
      ? await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
          where: { teacherId: { in: teacherIds } },
          select: { teacherId: true, supervisor: { select: { name: true } } },
        })
      : [];
  const supervisorByTeacher = new Map(
    supervisorLinks.map((link) => [link.teacherId, link.supervisor.name])
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="مستخدمو المدرسة"
        subtitle="عرض للقراءة فقط — المعلمون والمشرفون وأصحاب الأدوار داخل نطاق اطلاعك"
      />

      <Card>
        <form className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3" method="get">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="q">
              بحث بالاسم أو البريد
            </label>
            <input
              id="q"
              name="q"
              defaultValue={q ?? ""}
              placeholder="اكتب جزءًا من الاسم أو البريد…"
              className="w-64 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="role">
              الدور
            </label>
            <select
              id="role"
              name="role"
              defaultValue={roleFilter ?? ""}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
            >
              <option value="">كل الأدوار</option>
              {DIRECTORY_ROLES.map((role) => (
                <option key={role} value={role}>
                  {roleLabel(role)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
          >
            تصفية
          </button>
        </form>

        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="لا توجد حسابات مطابقة"
            hint="جرّب تعديل البحث أو التصفية داخل نطاق اطلاعك الممنوح."
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الاسم</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الدور</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المدرسة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الفرع</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المشرف المسؤول</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الحالة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">تاريخ الإضافة</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/60">
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      <p className="font-medium text-slate-800">{row.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400" dir="ltr">{row.email}</p>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{roleLabel(row.role)}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.school?.nameAr ?? "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.branch?.nameAr ?? "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">
                      {row.role === "TEACHER"
                        ? supervisorByTeacher.get(row.id) ?? "—"
                        : "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      {row.isActive ? (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 ring-1 ring-emerald-200">
                          نشط
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 ring-1 ring-slate-200">
                          موقوف
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-500">{formatDate(row.createdAt)}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {pageCount > 1 ? (
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
            <span>
              الصفحة {currentPage} من {pageCount} — {total} حسابًا
            </span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {currentPage > 1 ? (
                <Link
                  href={`/school-users?page=${currentPage - 1}${q ? `&q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}` : ""}${roleFilter ? `&role=${roleFilter}` : ""}`}
                  className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  السابق
                </Link>
              ) : null}
              {currentPage < pageCount ? (
                <Link
                  href={`/school-users?page=${currentPage + 1}${q ? `&q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}` : ""}${roleFilter ? `&role=${roleFilter}` : ""}`}
                  className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50"
                >
                  التالي
                </Link>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useActionState } from "react";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";

import {
  updatePlatformSettings,
  type PlatformSettingsState,
} from "@/app/actions/platform-settings";
import type { PlatformSettings } from "@/lib/platform-settings";

const INITIAL_STATE: PlatformSettingsState = { ok: false };

function SubmitButton() {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return (
    <button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending}
      className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
    >
      {pending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : "حفظ الإعدادات"}
    </button>
  );
}

function FieldError({ message }: { message?: string }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-red-600">{message}</p>;
}

/**
 * Platform identity + global controls form (SUPER_ADMIN). Values persist
 * in the SystemSetting table and apply immediately after saving.
 */
export function PlatformSettingsForm({
  initial,
}: {
  initial: PlatformSettings;
}) {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState(
    updatePlatformSettings,
    INITIAL_STATE
  );

  const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-5">
      <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
        <div>
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700" htmlFor="platformName">
            اسم المنصة
          </label>
          <input
            id="platformName"
            name="platformName"
            defaultValue={initial.platformName}
            maxLength={60}
            required
            className={inputClass}
          />
          <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.platformName} />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700" htmlFor="platformTagline">
            العنوان الوصفي
          </label>
          <input
            id="platformTagline"
            name="platformTagline"
            defaultValue={initial.platformTagline}
            maxLength={120}
            placeholder="مكتب التطوير التربوي"
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700" htmlFor="supportEmail">
            بريد الدعم (اختياري)
          </label>
          <input
            id="supportEmail"
            name="supportEmail"
            type="email"
            dir="ltr"
            defaultValue={initial.supportEmail}
            placeholder="support@example.com"
            className={inputClass}
          />
          <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.supportEmail} />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700" htmlFor="activeAcademicYear">
            العام الدراسي النشط
          </label>
          <input
            id="activeAcademicYear"
            name="activeAcademicYear"
            defaultValue={initial.activeAcademicYear}
            maxLength={20}
            placeholder="مثال: 1448هـ"
            className={inputClass}
          />
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
            يستخدمه السجل التدريبي السنوي والأرشفة السنوية في كل المدارس.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
        <SubmitButton />
        {state.message ? (
          <span
            className={
              state.ok
                ? "text-sm font-medium text-emerald-600"
                : "text-sm font-medium text-red-600"
            }
            role="status"
          >
            {state.ok ? "✓ " : "✕ "}
            {state.message}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

"use client";
import { confirmDialog } from "@/components/platform/confirm-dialog";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import * as React from "react";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowDown,
  ArrowUp,
  CheckCircle2,
  Loader2,
  Plus,
  Save,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  addSupervisorQuestionAction,
  deleteSupervisorQuestionAction,
  editSupervisorQuestionAction,
  moveSupervisorQuestionAction,
  setSupervisorAssessmentStatusAction,
  updateSupervisorAssessmentAction,
} from "@/app/actions/supervision-training";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor question editor — settings, question CRUD (4 platform     */
/* types), publish workflow. The answer key never renders for teachers; */
/* here it is the supervisor's own authoring surface.                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

interface QuestionRow {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  textAr: string;
  points: number;
  isRequired: boolean;
  orderIndex: number;
  options: Array<{ id: string; textAr: string }>;
  explanation: string | null;
}

const QUESTION_TYPES = [
  { value: "SINGLE_CHOICE", label: "اختيار مفرد" },
  { value: "MULTIPLE_CHOICE", label: "اختيار متعدد" },
  { value: "TRUE_FALSE", label: "صح وخطأ" },
  { value: "SHORT_ANSWER", label: "إجابة قصيرة (تصحيح يدوي)" },
];

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  DRAFT: "مسودة",
  PUBLISHED: "منشور",
  CLOSED: "مغلق",
  ARCHIVED: "مؤرشف",
};

const inputClass =
  "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

export function AssessmentsEditor({
  assessment,
  questions,
  courses,
}: {
  assessment: {
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    instructionsAr: string;
    status: string;
    courseId: string | null;
    passingScore: number;
    timeLimitMinutes: number | null;
    attemptLimit: number | null;
    maxScore: number;
  };
  questions: QuestionRow[];
  courses: Array<{ id: string; titleAr: string }>;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);

  async function run(action: () => Promise<ActionResult>, successText?: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = await action();
    setBusy(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذرت العملية." });
      return false;
    }
    if (successText) setFeedback({ bad: false, text: successText });
    router.refresh();
    return true;
  }

  async function changeStatus(next: string, confirmText: string) {
    const approved = await confirmDialog({
      title:
        next === "PUBLISHED"
          ? "نشر الاختبار"
          : next === "CLOSED"
            ? "إغلاق الاختبار"
            : "تأكيد العملية",
      description: confirmText,
      tone: "brand",
    });
    if (!approved) return;
    await run(
      () => setSupervisorAssessmentStatusAction({ assessmentId: assessment.id, status: next }),
      "تم تحديث حالة الاختبار."
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <Link href="/supervision/assessments" className="text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 hover:underline">
            ← الاختبارات
          </Link>
          <h1 className="mt-1 truncate text-xl font-black text-foreground">{assessment.titleAr}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {STATUS_LABEL[assessment.status] ?? assessment.status} · مجموع الدرجات{" "}
            <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{assessment.maxScore}</span> · درجة
            النجاح <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{assessment.passingScore}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {assessment.status !== "PUBLISHED" && assessment.status !== "ARCHIVED" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() =>
                changeStatus(
                  "PUBLISHED",
                  `نشر الاختبار يجعله متاحًا لمعلمي المدرسة (مجموع ${assessment.maxScore} نقطة) — متابعة؟`
                )
              }
              className="rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              نشر الاختبار
            </button>
          )}
          {assessment.status === "PUBLISHED" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => changeStatus("CLOSED", "إغلاق الاختبار يمنع محاولات جديدة — متابعة؟")}
              className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              إغلاق
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      {feedback && (
        <p
          className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
            feedback.bad ? "text-destructive" : "text-success"
          }`}
          role={feedback.bad ? "alert" : "status"}
        >
          {feedback.bad ? (
            <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          {feedback.text}
        </p>
      )}

      <SettingsEditor
        assessment={assessment}
        courses={courses}
        onSaved={() => router.refresh()}
      />

      <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
        <div className="border-b px-4 py-3">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">الأسئلة ({questions.length})</h2>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-3 p-4">
          {questions.length === 0 && (
            <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              لا أسئلة بعد — أضف أول سؤال من النموذج أدناه.
            </p>
          )}
          {questions.map((question, index) => (
            <div key={question.id} className="rounded-xl border p-3">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                    {index + 1}. {question.textAr}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {QUESTION_TYPES.find((type) => type.value === question.type)?.label ??
                      question.type}{" "}
                    · {question.points} نقطة/نقاط {question.isRequired ? "· إجباري" : ""}
                  </p>
                  {question.options.length > 0 && (
                    <ul className="mt-1.5 space-y-0.5">
                      {question.options.map((option) => (
                        <li key={option.id} className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          • {option.textAr}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    title="تحريك لأعلى"
                    disabled={busy || index === 0}
                    onClick={() =>
                      run(() =>
                        moveSupervisorQuestionAction({
                          assessmentId: assessment.id,
                          questionId: question.id,
                          direction: "up",
                        })
                      )
                    }
                    className="inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-40"
                  >
                    <ArrowUp className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    title="تحريك لأسفل"
                    disabled={busy || index === questions.length - 1}
                    onClick={() =>
                      run(() =>
                        moveSupervisorQuestionAction({
                          assessmentId: assessment.id,
                          questionId: question.id,
                          direction: "down",
                        })
                      )
                    }
                    className="inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-40"
                  >
                    <ArrowDown className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    title="حذف السؤال"
                    disabled={busy}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: "حذف السؤال؟", description: "سيتم حذف هذا السؤال نهائيًا من الاختبار.", tone: "danger" }))) return;
                      await run(() =>
                        deleteSupervisorQuestionAction({
                          assessmentId: assessment.id,
                          questionId: question.id,
                        })
                      );
                    }}
                    className="inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-card text-destructive hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-40"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}

          {assessment.status !== "PUBLISHED" ? (
            <QuestionAddForm
              assessmentId={assessment.id}
              onAdded={() => run(async () => ({ ok: true }))}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-700">
              الاختبار منشور — أغلقه أولًا لتتمكن من تعديل الأسئلة.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

/* --------------------------- Settings ------------------------------ */

function SettingsEditor({
  assessment,
  courses,
  onSaved,
}: {
  assessment: AssessmentsEditorProps["assessment"];
  courses: AssessmentsEditorProps["courses"];
  onSaved: () => void;
}) {
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await updateSupervisorAssessmentAction({
      assessmentId: assessment.id,
      titleAr: String(data.get("titleAr") ?? ""),
      instructionsAr: String(data.get("instructionsAr") ?? ""),
      courseId: String(data.get("courseId") ?? "") || undefined,
      passingScore: Number(data.get("passingScore") ?? 1),
      timeLimitMinutes: data.get("timeLimitMinutes")
        ? Number(data.get("timeLimitMinutes"))
        : undefined,
      attemptLimit: data.get("attemptLimit") ? Number(data.get("attemptLimit")) : undefined,
    })) as ActionResult;
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر حفظ الإعدادات." });
      return;
    }
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم حفظ إعدادات الاختبار." });
    onSaved();
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4" noValidate>
      <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">إعدادات الاختبار</h2>
      <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">العنوان *</span>
          <input name="titleAr" defaultValue={assessment.titleAr} className={inputClass} required />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الدورة المرتبطة</span>
          <select name="courseId" defaultValue={assessment.courseId ?? ""} className={inputClass}>
            <option value="">— بدون ربط —</option>
            {courses.map((course) => (
              <option key={course.id} value={course.id}>
                {course.titleAr}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="block md:col-span-2">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">تعليمات الأداء *</span>
          <textarea
            name="instructionsAr"
            defaultValue={assessment.instructionsAr}
            rows={2}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-600"
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">درجة النجاح *</span>
          <input
            name="passingScore"
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={1000}
            defaultValue={assessment.passingScore}
            className={inputClass}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الحد الزمني (دقائق)</span>
          <input
            name="timeLimitMinutes"
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={300}
            defaultValue={assessment.timeLimitMinutes ?? ""}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عدد المحاولات المسموح</span>
          <input
            name="attemptLimit"
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={10}
            defaultValue={assessment.attemptLimit ?? ""}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? (
            <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <Save className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          حفظ الإعدادات
        </button>
        {feedback && (
          <p
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
              feedback.bad ? "text-destructive" : "text-success"
            }`}
          >
            {feedback.text}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

interface AssessmentsEditorProps {
  assessment: {
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    instructionsAr: string;
    status: string;
    courseId: string | null;
    passingScore: number;
    timeLimitMinutes: number | null;
    attemptLimit: number | null;
    maxScore: number;
  };
  questions: QuestionRow[];
  courses: Array<{ id: string; titleAr: string }>;
}

/* --------------------------- Add question -------------------------- */

function QuestionAddForm({
  assessmentId,
  onAdded,
}: {
  assessmentId: string;
  onAdded: () => void;
}) {
  const [type, setType] = React.useState("SINGLE_CHOICE");
  const [text, setText] = React.useState("");
  const [points, setPoints] = React.useState(1);
  const [required, setRequired] = React.useState(true);
  const [explanation, setExplanation] = React.useState("");
  const [options, setOptions] = React.useState<string[]>(["", ""]);
  const [correctIndexes, setCorrectIndexes] = React.useState<number[]>([0]);
  const [trueFalse, setTrueFalse] = React.useState("true");
  const [modelAnswer, setModelAnswer] = React.useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  const isChoice = type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE";

  async function submit() {
    if (pending) return;
    if (text.trim().length < 3) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "نص السؤال مطلوب (3 أحرف على الأقل)." });
      return;
    }
    if (isChoice && options.filter((option) => option.trim()).length < 2) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "أضف خيارين على الأقل." });
      return;
    }
    if (isChoice && correctIndexes.length === 0) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "حدد الإجابة/الإجابات الصحيحة." });
      return;
    }
    if (type === "SHORT_ANSWER" && modelAnswer.trim().length === 0) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "الإجابة النموذجية مطلوبة للتصحيح اليدوي." });
      return;
    }

    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      assessmentId,
      type,
      textAr: text.trim(),
      points,
      isRequired: required,
      explanation: explanation.trim() || undefined,
    };
    if (isChoice) {
      payload.options = options
        .filter((option) => option.trim())
        .map((option, index) => ({ id: `opt-${index + 1}`, textAr: option.trim() }));
      payload.correctOptionIndexes = correctIndexes;
    }
    if (type === "TRUE_FALSE") {
      payload.correctValue = trueFalse === "true";
    }
    if (type === "SHORT_ANSWER") {
      payload.modelAnswer = modelAnswer.trim();
    }

    const result = (await addSupervisorQuestionAction(payload)) as ActionResult;
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر إضافة السؤال." });
      return;
    }
    setText("");
    setExplanation("");
    setModelAnswer("");
    setOptions(["", ""]);
    setCorrectIndexes([0]);
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تمت إضافة السؤال." });
    onAdded();
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed p-3">
      <h3 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-black text-foreground">
        <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        سؤال جديد
      </h3>
      <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
        <label className="block md:col-span-2">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">نص السؤال *</span>
          <textarea
            value={text}
            onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)}
            rows={2}
            maxLength={1000}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-600"
          />
        </label>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block">
            <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">نوع السؤال *</span>
            <select
              value={type}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setType(event.target.value);
                setCorrectIndexes([0]);
              }}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              {QUESTION_TYPES.map((option) => (
                <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                  {option.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block">
            <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الدرجة *</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={100}
              value={points}
              onChange={(event) => setPoints(Number(event.target.value))}
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>

      {isChoice && (
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
          <span className="block text-xs font-bold">الخيارات *</span>
          {options.map((option, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type={type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? "radio" : "checkbox"}
                checked={correctIndexes.includes(index)}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setCorrectIndexes((current) =>
                    type === "SINGLE_CHOICE"
                      ? [index]
                      : event.target.checked
                        ? [...current, index]
                        : current.filter((value) => value !== index)
                  )
                }
                className="size-3.5 shrink-0 accent-[var(--brand-600)]"
                aria-label={`الإجابة الصحيحة رقم ${index + 1}`}
              />
              <input
                value={option}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setOptions((current) =>
                    current.map((value, position) =>
                      position === index ? event.target.value : value
                    )
                  )
                }
                placeholder={`الخيار ${index + 1}`}
                className={inputClass}
                maxLength={300}
              />
              {options.length > 2 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setOptions((current) => current.filter((_, position) => position !== index))
                  }
                  className="text-destructive"
                  aria-label="حذف الخيار"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
          {options.length < 10 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setOptions((current) => [...current, ""])}
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 hover:underline"
            >
              + إضافة خيار
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {type === "TRUE_FALSE" && (
        <label className="mt-3 block max-w-48">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الإجابة الصحيحة *</span>
          <select value={trueFalse} onChange={(event) => setTrueFalse(event.target.value)} className={inputClass}>
            <option value="true">صح</option>
            <option value="false">خطأ</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      )}

      {type === "SHORT_ANSWER" && (
        <label className="mt-3 block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الإجابة النموذجية (للتصحيح اليدوي) *</span>
          <textarea
            value={modelAnswer}
            onChange={(event) => setModelAnswer(event.target.value)}
            rows={2}
            maxLength={1000}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-600"
          />
        </label>
      )}

      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={required}
            onChange={(event) => setRequired(event.target.checked)}
            className="size-3.5 accent-[var(--brand-600)]"
          />
          سؤال إجباري
        </label>
        <label className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <input
            value={explanation}
            onChange={(event) => setExplanation(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="تفسير الإجابة الصحيحة (اختياري)"
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={500}
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={submit}
          disabled={pending}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? (
            <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          إضافة السؤال
        </button>
        {feedback && (
          <p
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
              feedback.bad ? "text-destructive" : "text-success"
            }`}
          >
            {feedback.text}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { AssessmentsEditor } from "@/app/supervision/assessments/[assessmentId]/assessments-editor";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  listSupervisorImpactCourseOptions,
  requireSupervisorContext,
} from "@/lib/supervision/training";

export const metadata = { title: "إدارة أسئلة الاختبار" };

interface QuestionRow {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  textAr: string;
  points: number;
  isRequired: boolean;
  orderIndex: number;
  options: Array<{ id: string; textAr: string }>;
  explanation: string | null;
}

/**
 * Supervisor question editor. Scope: the assessment must belong to the
 * supervisor's school — verified here BEFORE anything renders, and
 * again inside every mutation service call.
 */
export default async function SupervisorAssessmentEditorPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ assessmentId: string }>;
}) {
  const { assessmentId } = await params;
  const ctx = await requireSupervisorContext();

  const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assessmentId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      instructionsAr: true,
      status: true,
      schoolId: true,
      courseId: true,
      passingScore: true,
      timeLimitMinutes: true,
      attemptLimit: true,
      maxScore: true,
      questions: {
        orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
        select: {
          id: true,
          type: true,
          textAr: true,
          points: true,
          isRequired: true,
          orderIndex: true,
          optionsJson: true,
          explanation: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  const notAllowed =
    !assessment ||
    assessment.schoolId === null ||
    assessment.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId;

  if (notAllowed) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-lg rounded-xl border bg-card p-8 text-center">
        <TriangleAlert className="mx-auto size-8 text-destructive" aria-hidden="true" />
        <h1 className="mt-3 text-lg font-black text-foreground">الاختبار غير متاح</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          الاختبار غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك.
        </p>
        <Link
          href="/supervision/assessments"
          className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          العودة إلى الاختبارات
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const courseOptions = await listSupervisorImpactCourseOptions(ctx);

  const questions: QuestionRow[] = assessment.questions.map((question) => {
    let options: Array<{ id: string; textAr: string }> = [];
    if (question.optionsJson) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(question.optionsJson) as Array<{
          id?: unknown;
          textAr?: unknown;
        }>;
        options = Array.isArray(parsed)
          ? parsed.filter(
              (item): item is { id: string; textAr: string } =>
                typeof item?.id === "string" && typeof item?.textAr === "string"
            )
          : [];
      } catch {
        options = [];
      }
    }
    return {
      id: question.id,
      type: question.type,
      textAr: question.textAr,
      points: question.points,
      isRequired: question.isRequired,
      orderIndex: question.orderIndex,
      options,
      explanation: question.explanation,
    };
  });

  return (
    <AssessmentsEditor
      assessment={{
        id: assessment.id,
        titleAr: assessment.titleAr,
        instructionsAr: assessment.instructionsAr,
        status: assessment.status,
        courseId: assessment.courseId,
        passingScore: assessment.passingScore,
        timeLimitMinutes: assessment.timeLimitMinutes,
        attemptLimit: assessment.attemptLimit,
        maxScore: assessment.maxScore,
      }}
      questions={questions}
      courses={courseOptions.map((course) => ({ id: course.id, titleAr: course.titleAr }))}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import * as React from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, ClipboardCheck, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { createSupervisorAssessmentAction } from "@/app/actions/supervision-training";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor assessment creation (school scope hard-bound on server).  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

export function AssessmentsCreateForm({
  courses,
}: {
  courses: Array<{ id: string; titleAr: string }>;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = React.useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const data = new FormData(form);
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    setFieldErrors({});

    const result = (await createSupervisorAssessmentAction({
      titleAr: String(data.get("titleAr") ?? ""),
      instructionsAr: String(data.get("instructionsAr") ?? ""),
      courseId: String(data.get("courseId") ?? "") || undefined,
      passingScore: Number(data.get("passingScore") ?? 1),
      timeLimitMinutes: data.get("timeLimitMinutes")
        ? Number(data.get("timeLimitMinutes"))
        : undefined,
      attemptLimit: data.get("attemptLimit") ? Number(data.get("attemptLimit")) : undefined,
    })) as ActionResult;

    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFieldErrors(result.fieldErrors ?? {});
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر إنشاء الاختبار." });
      return;
    }
    form.reset();
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم إنشاء الاختبار كمسودة — أضف أسئلته الآن." });
    if (result.data?.id) {
      router.push(`/supervision/assessments/${result.data.id}`);
    }
    router.refresh();
  }

  const inputClass =
    "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4" noValidate>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-600/10 text-brand-600">
          <ClipboardCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">اختبار جديد</h2>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            يُنشأ داخل مدرستك كمسودة — الربط بدورة اختياري، والنشر بعد إضافة الأسئلة.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عنوان الاختبار *</span>
          <input name="titleAr" className={inputClass} maxLength={150} required />
          {fieldErrors.titleAr && (
            <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-destructive">
              {fieldErrors.titleAr}
            </span>
          )}
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الدورة المرتبطة (اختياري)</span>
          <select name="courseId" className={inputClass} defaultValue="">
            <option value="">— بدون ربط —</option>
            {courses.map((course) => (
              <option key={course.id} value={course.id}>
                {course.titleAr}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="block md:col-span-2">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">تعليمات الأداء *</span>
          <textarea
            name="instructionsAr"
            rows={2}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-600"
            maxLength={2000}
            required
            placeholder="مثال: اختر الإجابة الصحيحة لكل سؤال — لديك محاولة واحدة."
          />
          {fieldErrors.instructionsAr && (
            <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-destructive">
              {fieldErrors.instructionsAr}
            </span>
          )}
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">درجة النجاح (من مجموع الدرجات) *</span>
          <input name="passingScore" type="number" min={1} max={1000} defaultValue={10} className={inputClass} required />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الحد الزمني بالدقائق (اختياري)</span>
          <input name="timeLimitMinutes" type="number" min={1} max={300} className={inputClass} />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عدد المحاولات المسموح (اختياري)</span>
          <input name="attemptLimit" type="number" min={1} max={10} className={inputClass} />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? (
            <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <ClipboardCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          إنشاء الاختبار
        </button>
        {feedback && (
          <p
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
              feedback.bad ? "text-destructive" : "text-success"
            }`}
            role={feedback.bad ? "alert" : "status"}
          >
            {feedback.bad ? (
              <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
            ) : (
              <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
            )}
            {feedback.text}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <Pill tone={statusTone(row.status)}>{statusLabel(row.status)}</Pill>
                </div>
                <Link
                  href={`/supervision/assessments/${row.id}`}
                  className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"

          <EmptyHint
            title="لا محاولات بعد"

                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-bold text-foreground">{row.teacherName}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">{row.assessmentTitle}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 tabular-nums">
                      {row.earnedScore !== null && row.maxScore !== null
                        ? `${row.earnedScore}/${row.maxScore} (${row.percentage ?? 0}%)`
                        : "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">
                      <Pill
                        tone={
                          row.status === "PASSED"
                            ? "success"
                            : row.status === "FAILED"
                              ? "error"
                              : row.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW"
                                ? "warning"
                                : "neutral"
                        }

                        {ATTEMPT_STATUS_LABEL[row.status] ?? row.status}
                      </Pill>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-muted-foreground">
                      {row.submittedAt ? formatDate(row.submittedAt) : "—"}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </Panel>

      <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
        <ClipboardCheck className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
        النشر يتطلب سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل ودرجة نجاح ضمن مجموع الدرجات.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Loader2, MessageSquare, TrendingUp } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";
import {
  GROWTH_LEVELS,
  PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT,
  growthLevelLabel,
} from "@/config/growth";
import type { GrowthTeacherRow } from "@/lib/growth/service";
import {
  approvePromotionAction,
  setTeacherLevelAction,
  type GrowthActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/growth";

const initialState: GrowthActionState = { ok: false };

/**
 * Batch 2 — the v48 board (client): current level, the 60% progress,
 * eligibility, one-tap approval, direct classification select, and the
 * message link — everything the original page had, on real data.
 */
export function GrowthBoard({ rows }: { rows: GrowthTeacherRow[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-brand-200 bg-brand-50/60 p-4 text-sm leading-relaxed">
        <b>آلية التصنيف:</b> يحدد المشرف المستوى الحالي لكل معلم من T0 إلى T5. وعند إكمال المعلم{" "}
        <b>{PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT}%</b> من الدورات المنشورة المتاحة له، يصبح مستحقًا للانتقال{" "}
        <b>مستوى واحد فقط</b> إلى التصنيف الأعلى. بعد الاعتماد ينتقل المستوى ويبدأ احتساب المرحلة
        التالية.
      </div>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={TrendingUp}
          title="لا يوجد معلمون مسندون لهذا المشرف"
          description="سيظهر المعلمون هنا بعد إسنادهم من إدارة المعلمين أو استيراد الإسنادات."
        />
      ) : (
        rows.map((row) => (
          <GrowthCard key={row.teacher.id} row={row} />
        ))
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function GrowthCard({ row }: { row: GrowthTeacherRow }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [levelState, levelAction, levelPending] = React.useActionState(
    setTeacherLevelAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [promoteState, promoteAction, promotePending] = React.useActionState(
    approvePromotionAction,
    initialState
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (levelState.message) {
      toast({ title: levelState.ok ? "تم" : "تنبيه", description: levelState.message });
    }
  }, [levelState, toast]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (promoteState.message) {
      toast({ title: promoteState.ok ? "تم" : "تنبيه", description: promoteState.message });
    }
  }, [promoteState, toast]);

  const status = (() => {
    if (row.currentLevel === "T5") return "🏅 أعلى مستوى";
    if (row.eligible) return "✅ مستحق للانتقال";
    if (row.stats.assigned > 0)
      return `المكتمل ${row.stats.completed} من ${row.stats.assigned} — ${row.stats.percent}%`;
    return "لا توجد دورات منشورة كافية";
  })();

  return (
    <article className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-4 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-base font-black">{row.teacher.name}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {row.teacher.schoolName ?? "—"} · {row.teacher.stage ?? "—"} ·{" "}
            {row.teacher.subject ?? "—"}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link
          href={`/messages?to=${row.teacher.id}`}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <MessageSquare className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          رسالة للمعلم
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
        <MiniKpi label="التصنيف الحالي" value={growthLevelLabel(row.currentLevel)} />
        <MiniKpi label="الدورات المكتملة" value={String(row.stats.completed)} />
        <MiniKpi
          label="التصنيف التالي"
          value={row.nextLevel ? growthLevelLabel(row.nextLevel) : "—"}
        />
        <MiniKpi label="نسبة الإنجاز" value={`${row.stats.percent}%`} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <span>{status}</span>
          <span>شرط الانتقال: {PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT}%</span>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1.5 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand-600 transition-all"
            style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, row.stats.percent)}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          المستوى المقترح من بياناتك: {growthLevelLabel(row.suggestedLevel)} · الساعات:{" "}
          {row.stats.hours} · الشهادات: {row.stats.certificates}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
        <form action={levelAction} className="min-w-56 flex-1">
          <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={row.teacher.id} />
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold" htmlFor={`level-${row.teacher.id}`}>
            تصنيف المعلم بواسطة المشرف
          </label>
          <select
            id={`level-${row.teacher.id}`}
            name="level"
            defaultValue={row.currentLevel}
            className="mt-1.5 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
          >
            {GROWTH_LEVELS.map((level) => (
              <option key={level.id} value={level.id}>
                {level.id} — {level.nameAr}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </form>

        <form action={promoteAction}>
          <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={row.teacher.id} />
          <Button type="submit" disabled={promotePending} className="rounded-xl">
            {promotePending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
            {row.eligible ? "اعتماد الانتقال" : "فحص الانتقال"}
          </Button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

function MiniKpi({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-2.5">
      <p className="truncate text-sm font-black">{value}</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { supervisorGrowthBoard } from "@/lib/growth/service";
import { GrowthBoard } from "@/app/supervision/growth/growth-board";

export const metadata = {
  title: "النمو المهني | منارة قرطبة",
};

/**
 * Batch 2 — the supervisor's growth board (HTML v48Page parity):
 * per-teacher classification T0..T5, the 60% promotion gate with
 * one-level approved transitions, and the message entry point.
 */
export default async function SupervisionGrowthPage() {

  if (user.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") redirect("/forbidden");

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="متابعة المعلمين — النمو المهني"
        description={`تصنيف المعلمين ومسار الانتقال المهني — ${user.name}`}
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الرئيسية" },
          { label: "النمو المهني" },
        ]}
        meta={
          <span className="rounded-xl border bg-brand-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700">
            مستحقون للانتقال: {eligible}
          </span>
        }
      />
      <GrowthBoard rows={board.data} />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\app\supervision\impact\impact-manager.tsx

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import * as React from "react";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  ClipboardList,
  Loader2,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  createSupervisorImpactSurveyAction,
  setSupervisorImpactSurveyStatusAction,
} from "@/app/actions/supervision-training";
import { confirmDialog, alertDialog } from "@/components/platform/confirm-dialog";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Impact authoring UI — survey creation with a dynamic question        */
/* builder, plus publish/close actions per survey row.                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

const QUESTION_TYPES = [
  { value: "RATING", label: "تقييم من 1 إلى 5" },
  { value: "YES_NO", label: "نعم / لا" },
  { value: "SINGLE_CHOICE", label: "اختيار مفرد" },
  { value: "MULTI_CHOICE", label: "اختيار متعدد" },
  { value: "SHORT_TEXT", label: "إجابة قصيرة" },
  { value: "LONG_TEXT", label: "إجابة مطولة" },
];

interface DraftQuestion {
  textAr: string;
  type: string;
  required: boolean;
  options: string[];
}

function emptyQuestion(): DraftQuestion {
  return { textAr: "", type: "RATING", required: true, options: ["", ""] };
}

export function ImpactCreateForm({
  courses,
}: {
  courses: Array<{ id: string; titleAr: string }>;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = React.useState(courses[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState("");
  const [purpose, setPurpose] = React.useState("");
  const [questions, setQuestions] = React.useState<DraftQuestion[]>([emptyQuestion()]);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  const inputClass =
    "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

  function updateQuestion(index: number, patch: Partial<DraftQuestion>) {
    setQuestions((current) =>
      current.map((question, position) =>
        position === index ? { ...question, ...patch } : question
      )
    );
  }

  async function submit() {
    if (pending) return;
    if (!courseId) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "اختر الدورة أولًا." });
      return;
    }
    if (title.trim().length < 3) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "عنوان الأداة مطلوب." });
      return;
    }
    if (questions.length === 0) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "أضف سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل." });
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await createSupervisorImpactSurveyAction({
      courseId,
      titleAr: title.trim(),
      purposeAr: purpose.trim() || undefined,
      questions: questions.map((question) => ({
        textAr: question.textAr.trim(),
        type: question.type,
        required: question.required,
        options:
          question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || question.type === "MULTI_CHOICE"
            ? question.options.map((option) => option.trim()).filter(Boolean)
            : undefined,
      })),
    })) as ActionResult;
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر إنشاء أداة القياس." });
      return;
    }
    setTitle("");
    setPurpose("");
    setQuestions([emptyQuestion()]);
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم إنشاء الأداة كمسودة — انشرها من القائمة أدناه." });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        void submit();
      }}
      className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4"
      noValidate
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-600/10 text-brand-600">
          <ClipboardList className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">أداة قياس أثر جديدة</h2>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            تُربط بدورة واحدة وتُنشأ داخل مدرستك — يجيب عنها المعلمون بعد إتمام الدورة.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الدورة *</span>
          <select
            value={courseId}
            onChange={(event) => setCourseId(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          >
            {courses.map((course) => (
              <option key={course.id} value={course.id}>
                {course.titleAr}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عنوان الأداة *</span>
          <input
            value={title}
            onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={150}
            placeholder="مثال: أثر تدريب الاستراتيجيات الحديثة"
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block md:col-span-2">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الغرض (يظهر للمعلم)</span>
          <input
            value={purpose}
            onChange={(event) => setPurpose(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={500}
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
        <span className="block text-xs font-bold">الأسئلة *</span>
        {questions.map((question, index) => (
          <div key={index} className="rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-[1fr_180px_auto]">
              <input
                value={question.textAr}
                onChange={(event) => updateQuestion(index, { textAr: event.target.value })}
                placeholder={`نص السؤال ${index + 1}`}
                className={inputClass}
                maxLength={300}
              />
              <select
                value={question.type}
                onChange={(event) => updateQuestion(index, { type: event.target.value })}
                className={inputClass}
              >
                {QUESTION_TYPES.map((option) => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={question.required}
                    onChange={(event) => updateQuestion(index, { required: event.target.checked })}
                    className="size-3.5 accent-[var(--brand-600)]"
                  />
                  إجباري
                </label>
                {questions.length > 1 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setQuestions((current) => current.filter((_, position) => position !== index))
                    }
                    className="text-destructive"
                    aria-label="حذف السؤال"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {(question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || question.type === "MULTI_CHOICE") && (
              <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                {question.options.map((option, optionIndex) => (
                  <input
                    key={optionIndex}
                    value={option}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      updateQuestion(index, {
                        options: question.options.map((value, position) =>
                          position === optionIndex ? event.target.value : value
                        ),
                      })
                    }
                    placeholder={`الخيار ${optionIndex + 1}`}
                    className={inputClass}
                    maxLength={120}
                  />
                ))}
                {question.options.length < 10 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      updateQuestion(index, { options: [...question.options, ""] })
                    }
                    className="text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 hover:underline"
                  >
                    + إضافة خيار
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setQuestions((current) => [...current, emptyQuestion()])}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          إضافة سؤال
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? (
            <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <ClipboardList className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          إنشاء الأداة
        </button>
        {feedback && (
          <p
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
              feedback.bad ? "text-destructive" : "text-success"
            }`}
            role={feedback.bad ? "alert" : "status"}
          >
            {feedback.bad ? (
              <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
            ) : (
              <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
            )}
            {feedback.text}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

export function ImpactSurveyActions({
  surveyId,
  status,
}: {
  surveyId: string;
  status: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);

  async function run(action: "PUBLISH" | "CLOSE" | "ARCHIVE", confirmText: string) {
    const approved = await confirmDialog({
      title:
        action === "PUBLISH"
          ? "نشر أداة قياس الأثر"
          : action === "CLOSE"
            ? "إغلاق أداة قياس الأثر"
            : "أرشفة أداة قياس الأثر",
      description: confirmText,
      tone: "brand",
    });
    if (!approved) return;
    setPending(true);
    const result = await setSupervisorImpactSurveyStatusAction({ surveyId, action });
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      await alertDialog({
        title: "تعذّر تحديث حالة الأداة",
        description: result.message ?? "حدث خطأ غير متوقع — حاول مرة أخرى.",
        tone: "danger",
      });
      return;
    }
    router.refresh();
  }

  if (status === "DRAFT") {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={pending}
        onClick={() => run("PUBLISH", "نشر الأداة يفتحها لمعلمي الدورة — متابعة؟")}
        className="rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        نشر
      </button>
    );
  }
  if (status === "PUBLISHED") {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={pending}
        onClick={() => run("CLOSE", "إغلاق الأداة يمنع استجابات جديدة — متابعة؟")}
        className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        إغلاق
      </button>
    );
  }
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      disabled={pending}
      onClick={() => run("ARCHIVE", "أرشفة الأداة؟ تُخفى من القائمة نهائيًا.")}
      className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-destructive hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
    >
      أرشفة
    </button>
  );
}

                                />
                              </span>
                              <span className="w-10 shrink-0 text-end text-[10px] tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                                {bucket.count}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {question.texts && question.texts.length > 0 && (
                      <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                        {question.texts.slice(0, 5).map((item, index) => (
                          <li
                            key={index}
                            className="rounded-lg bg-muted/30 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground"

                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </Panel>
      )}

      <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
        <ClipboardList className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
        يجيب المعلمون عن أدوات الأثر من صفحة الدورة نفسها — نفس مسار قياس الأثر
        الموجود، دون أي تغيير على تدفق المعلمين.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { ClipboardList, MapPin, UserCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/platform/status-badge";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { roleLabel } from "@/lib/auth/roles";
import { getSupervisorWorkspace } from "@/lib/users/directory";
import { branchStageLabel } from "@/lib/validation/schools";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

export const metadata = {
  title: "مساحة المشرف",
};

/**
 * Supervisor workspace (Phase 4). Shows ONLY the supervisor's authorized
 * branch scope and the teachers they may see (explicit assignments +
 * branch coverage, computed server-side). Follow-up entry points link to
 * the (honest) upcoming follow-up module — no operational writes here.
 */
export default async function SupervisionPage() {
  const user = await requireUser();
  if (user.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") redirect("/forbidden");

  const workspace = await getSupervisorWorkspace(user.id);
  if (!workspace) redirect("/forbidden");

  const explicitCount = workspace.teachers.filter((t) => t.source === "explicit").length;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="معلموّي"
        description={`المعلمون داخل نطاقك المصرّح به فقط — ${roleLabel(user.role)}${user.schoolId ? "" : ""}`}
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "معلموّي" }]}
        meta={
          <>
            <StatusBadge tone="info" withDot={false}>
              {workspace.branches.length} فرع مسند
            </StatusBadge>
            <StatusBadge tone="success" withDot={false}>
              {workspace.teachers.length} معلم في نطاقك
            </StatusBadge>
            {explicitCount > 0 && (
              <StatusBadge tone="neutral" withDot={false}>
                {explicitCount} إسناد مباشر
              </StatusBadge>
            )}
          </>
        }
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <SectionCard
          title="الفروع المسندة إليك"
          description="الإسناد يتم من إدارة مكتب التطوير في مدرستك — أنت ترى معلمي هذه الفروع تلقائيًا."
        >

            />
          ) : (
