              {workspace.branches.map((branch) => (
                <li
                  key={branch.id}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4"
                >
                  <span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-100 text-brand-700">
                    <MapPin className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
                    <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold">
                      {branch.nameAr}
                    </span>
                    <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {branchStageLabel(branch.stage)}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </SectionCard>

        <SectionCard
          title={`المعلمون في نطاقك (${workspace.teachers.length})`}
          description="قائمة حقيقية من قاعدة البيانات — إسناد مباشر أو عبر تغطية الفرع، ومحصورة دائمًا داخل مدرستك."
        >
          {workspace.teachers.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={UserCheck}
              title="لا يوجد معلمون في نطاقك حتى الآن"
              description="سيظهر هنا كل معلم يُسند إليك مباشرةً أو يُسجل في فروعك المسندة."
            />
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y rounded-xl border" role="list">
              {workspace.teachers.map((teacher) => (
                <li
                  key={teacher.id}
                  className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold">{teacher.name}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                      {teacher.email}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {teacher.branchName ?? "بدون فرع"}
                    </span>
                    <StatusBadge
                      tone={teacher.source === "explicit" ? "info" : "neutral"}
                      withDot={false}
                    >
                      {teacher.source === "explicit" ? "إسناد مباشر" : "عبر الفرع"}
                    </StatusBadge>
                    <StatusBadge
                      tone={teacher.isVerified ? "success" : "warning"}
                      withDot={false}
                    >
                      {teacher.isVerified ? "موثّق" : "بانتظار التأكيد"}
                    </StatusBadge>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </SectionCard>

        <SectionCard
          title="نقاط المتابعة"
          description="بوابات المتابعة التربوية والتكليفات — تُفتح مع وحدة التكليفات في مرحلة لاحقة."
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-muted/40 p-4">
            <span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-100 text-brand-700">
              <ClipboardList className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
            </span>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              لا توجد متابعات نشطة بعد — وحدة «التكليفات والمتابعة» قيد التطوير وستربط
              بمعلمي نطاقك تلقائيًا.
            </p>
          </div>
        </SectionCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Shared presentational primitives for the supervisor workspace.       */
/* Pure server-safe components — no session, no DB, no client hooks.    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const TONE_CLASSES = {
  brand: "bg-brand-600 text-white",
  success: "bg-success-soft text-success",
  info: "bg-brand-600/10 text-brand-600",
  warning: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700",
  neutral: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
} as const;

export function StatCard({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  value,
  hint,
  tone = "brand",
}: {
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  hint?: string;
  tone?: keyof typeof TONE_CLASSES;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
        {Icon && (
          <span
            className={`inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${TONE_CLASSES[tone]}`}
          >
            <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black tabular-nums text-foreground">{value}</p>
      {hint && <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Panel({
  title,
  description,
  action,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b px-4 py-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">{title}</h2>
          {description && (
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        {action}
      </div>
      <div className="p-4">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

export function Pill({
  tone = "neutral",
  children,
}: {
  tone?: "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning" | "neutral";
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const map = {
    success: "bg-success-soft text-success",
    error: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive",
    info: "bg-brand-600/10 text-brand-600",
    warning: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700",
    neutral: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
  } as const;
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${map[tone]}`}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

export function EmptyHint({ title, description }: { title: string; description?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-4 py-8 text-center">
      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">{title}</p>
      {description && (
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function statusTone(status: string): "success" | "info" | "warning" | "neutral" {
  if (status === "PUBLISHED") return "success";
  if (status === "DRAFT") return "warning";
  if (status === "CLOSED" || status === "ARCHIVED") return "neutral";
  return "info";
}

export function statusLabel(status: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    DRAFT: "مسودة",
    PUBLISHED: "منشور",
    ARCHIVED: "مؤرشف",
    CLOSED: "مغلق",
    PLANNED: "مخطط",
    IN_PROGRESS: "قيد المتابعة",
    COMPLETED: "مكتمل",
    CANCELLED: "ملغى",
  };
  return map[status] ?? status;
}

export function formatDate(date: Date): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar", { dateStyle: "medium" }).format(date);
}

/**
 * Read the real duration of a video URL in the instructor's browser
 * (metadata only, 8s timeout). The value is stored on the lesson and
 * becomes the server-side basis of the mandatory watch threshold —
 * students can never influence it.
 */
async function probeVideoDuration(url: string): Promise<number | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || !url) {
      resolve(null);
      return;
    }
    const video = document.createElement("video");
    video.preload = "metadata";
    video.muted = true;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      cleanup();
      resolve(null);
    }, 8000);
    function cleanup() {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      video.onloadedmetadata = null;
      video.onerror = null;
      video.removeAttribute("src");
      try {
        video.load();
      } catch {
        // Ignore — element is detached.
      }
    }
    video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
      const value = video.duration;
      cleanup();
      resolve(Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.round(value) : null);
    };
    video.onerror = () => {
      cleanup();
      resolve(null);
    };
    video.src = url;
  });
}

/* ------------------------------ Publish ---------------------------- */

function PublishControls({ courseId, status }: { courseId: string; status: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  async function run(next: "PUBLISHED" | "DRAFT" | "ARCHIVED", confirmText: string) {
    if (!window.confirm(confirmText)) return;
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await setStatusAction({ courseId, status: next }));
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر تغيير الحالة." });
      return;
    }
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم تحديث حالة الدورة." });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 text-start">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {status !== "PUBLISHED" && status !== "ARCHIVED" && (
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={() => run("PUBLISHED", "نشر الدورة يجعلها متاحة لمعلمي المدرسة — متابعة؟")}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {pending && <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
            نشر الدورة
          </button>
        )}
        {status === "PUBLISHED" && (
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={() => run("DRAFT", "إلغاء النشر يخفي الدورة عن المعلمين — متابعة؟")}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            إلغاء النشر
          </button>
        )}
        {status !== "ARCHIVED" && (
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={() => run("ARCHIVED", "أرشفة الدورة؟ يمكن إعادتها من الأرشيف لاحقًا.")}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-destructive hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            أرشفة
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {feedback && <Feedback {...feedback} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function CourseMetaEditor(props: CourseBuilderProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { course } = props;
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = React.useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    setFieldErrors({});
    const result = (await updateSupervisorCourseAction({
      courseId: course.id,
      titleAr: String(data.get("titleAr") ?? ""),
      titleEn: String(data.get("titleEn") ?? "") || undefined,
      descriptionAr: String(data.get("descriptionAr") ?? ""),
      descriptionEn: String(data.get("descriptionEn") ?? "") || undefined,
      category: String(data.get("category") ?? ""),
      level: String(data.get("level") ?? "") || undefined,
      estimatedHours: data.get("estimatedHours") ? Number(data.get("estimatedHours")) : undefined,
      programId: String(data.get("programId") ?? "") || undefined,
    }));
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFieldErrors(result.fieldErrors ?? {});
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر حفظ بيانات الدورة." });
      return;
    }
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم حفظ بيانات الدورة." });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-start"
      >
        <span className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">
          بيانات الدورة وصورة الغلاف

      {open && (
        <div className="space-y-4 border-t p-4">

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">العنوان بالعربية *</span>
              <input name="titleAr" defaultValue={course.titleAr} className={inputClass} required />
              {fieldErrors.titleAr && (
                <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-destructive">
                  {fieldErrors.titleAr}
                </span>
              )}
            </label>
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">العنوان بالإنجليزية</span>
              <input name="titleEn" defaultValue={course.titleEn ?? ""} className={inputClass} dir="ltr" />
            </label>
            <label className="block md:col-span-2">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الوصف بالعربية *</span>

  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  async function addSection(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending || title.trim().length < 2) return;
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await saveSupervisorSectionAction({
      courseId,
      titleAr: title.trim(),
    }));
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر إضافة القسم." });
      return;
    }
    setTitle("");
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function act(action: () => ActionResult | Promise<ActionResult>) {
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = await action();
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذرت العملية." });
      return false;
    }
    router.refresh();
    return true;
  }

  return (
    <Panel title="الأقسام والدروس">
      <form onSubmit={addSection} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <input
          value={title}
          onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
          placeholder="اسم القسم الجديد — مثال: الوحدة الأولى"
          className={`${inputClass} min-w-0 flex-1`}
          maxLength={120}
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending || title.trim().length < 2}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? (
            <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          إضافة قسم
        </button>
      </form>
      {feedback && (
        <div className="mt-2">
          <Feedback {...feedback} />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
        {sections.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            لا أقسام بعد — أضف أول قسم ثم ابدأ بإضافة الدروس داخله.
          </p>
        ) : (
          sections.map((section, index) => (
            <div key={section.id} className="rounded-xl border">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b px-3 py-2">
                {renaming === section.id ? (
                  <SectionRename
                    section={section}
                    onDone={async (newTitle) => {
                      setRenaming(null);
                      if (!newTitle) return;
                      await act(() =>
                        saveSupervisorSectionAction({
                          courseId,
                          sectionId: section.id,
                          titleAr: newTitle,
                        })
                      );
                    }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
                    {index + 1}. {section.titleAr}
                  </p>
                )}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <IconButton
                    label="تحريك لأعلى"
                    disabled={index === 0}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() => moveSupervisorSectionAction(section.id, "up"))
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowUp className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                  <IconButton
                    label="تحريك لأسفل"
                    disabled={index === sections.length - 1}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() => moveSupervisorSectionAction(section.id, "down"))
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowDown className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                  <IconButton label="إعادة تسمية" onClick={() => setRenaming(section.id)}>
                    <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                  <IconButton
                    label="حذف القسم ودروسه"
                    destructive
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (
                        !window.confirm(
                          "حذف القسم سيحذف كل دروسه ومقاطع الفيديو المرتبطة به — متابعة؟"
                        )
                      ) {
                        return;
                      }
                      await act(() => deleteSupervisorSectionAction(section.id));
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                </div>
              </div>
              <LessonsList section={section} />
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}

function Panel({
  title,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
      <div className="border-b px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">{title}</h2>
      </div>
      <div className="p-4">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

function IconButton({
  label,
  children,
  onClick,
  disabled,
  destructive,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  onClick?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  destructive?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      title={label}
      aria-label={label}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-card transition-colors hover:bg-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${
        destructive ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground"
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function SectionRename({
  section,
  onDone,
}: {
  section: BuilderSection;
  onDone: (newTitle: string | null) => void;
}) {
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState(section.titleAr);
  return (
    <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5">
      <input
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => setValue(event.target.value)}
        className={`${inputClass} h-8 min-w-0 flex-1`}
        maxLength={120}
        autoFocus
      />
      <IconButton label="حفظ" onClick={() => onDone(value.trim())}>
        <Save className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
      </IconButton>
      <IconButton label="إلغاء" onClick={() => onDone(null)}>
        <X className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
      </IconButton>
    </span>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------ Lessons ---------------------------- */

function LessonsList({ section }: { section: BuilderSection }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [adding, setAdding] = React.useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  async function act(action: () => ActionResult | Promise<ActionResult>) {
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = await action();
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذرت العملية." });
      return false;
    }
    router.refresh();
    return true;
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-3">
      {feedback && (
        <div className="mb-2">
          <Feedback {...feedback} />
        </div>
      )}
      {section.lessons.length === 0 && !adding && (
        <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-3 py-4 text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          لا دروس في هذا القسم بعد.
        </p>
      )}
      <ul className="space-y-2">
        {section.lessons.map((lesson, index) =>
          editingId === lesson.id ? (
            <li key={lesson.id}>
              <LessonForm
                sectionId={section.id}
                lesson={lesson}
                onDone={async (payload) => {
                  setEditingId(null);
                  if (!payload) return;
                  await act(() => saveSupervisorLessonAction(payload));
                }}
              />
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li
              key={lesson.id}
              className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 px-3 py-2"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                    {index + 1}. {lesson.titleAr}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {lesson.type === "TEXT"
                      ? "درس نصي"
                      : lesson.type === "VIDEO"
                        ? "فيديو مرفوع أو مُدار"
                        : "فيديو خارجي"}
                    {lesson.videoUrl ? " · فيه فيديو" : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() =>
                        setSupervisorLessonPublishedAction(lesson.id, !lesson.isPublished)
                      )
                    }
                    className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                      lesson.isPublished
                        ? "bg-success-soft text-success"
                        : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {lesson.isPublished ? "منشور للمعلمين" : "مسودة"}
                  </button>
                  <IconButton
                    label="تحريك لأعلى"
                    disabled={index === 0}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() => moveSupervisorLessonAction(lesson.id, "up"))
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowUp className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                  <IconButton
                    label="تحريك لأسفل"
                    disabled={index === section.lessons.length - 1}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() => moveSupervisorLessonAction(lesson.id, "down"))
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowDown className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                  <IconButton label="تعديل الدرس" onClick={() => setEditingId(lesson.id)}>
                    <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                  <IconButton
                    label="حذف الدرس"
                    destructive
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (!window.confirm("حذف هذا الدرس نهائيًا — متابعة؟")) return;
                      await act(() => deleteSupervisorLessonAction(lesson.id));
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </IconButton>
                </div>
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        )}
      </ul>

      {adding ? (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <LessonForm
            sectionId={section.id}
            lesson={null}
            onDone={async (payload) => {
              setAdding(false);
              if (!payload) return;
              await act(() => saveSupervisorLessonAction(payload));
            }}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setAdding(true)}
          className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          إضافة درس
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

interface LessonFormPayload {
  sectionId: string;
  lessonId?: string;
  titleAr: string;
  description?: string;
  type: "TEXT" | "VIDEO" | "EXTERNAL_VIDEO";
  content?: string;
  videoUrl?: string;
  isPublished?: boolean;
  /** Media length in seconds (instructor-browser metadata). */
  durationSeconds?: number;
}

function LessonForm({
  sectionId,
  lesson,
  onDone,
}: {
  sectionId: string;
  lesson: BuilderSection["lessons"][number] | null;
  onDone: (payload: LessonFormPayload | null) => void;
}) {
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState(lesson?.titleAr ?? "");
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState(lesson?.description ?? "");
  const [type, setType] = React.useState<"TEXT" | "VIDEO" | "EXTERNAL_VIDEO">(
    (lesson?.type as "TEXT" | "VIDEO" | "EXTERNAL_VIDEO") ?? "VIDEO"
  );
  const [content, setContent] = React.useState(lesson?.content ?? "");
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = React.useState(lesson?.videoUrl ?? "");
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [durationSeconds, setDurationSeconds] = React.useState<number | null>(null);
  const [probing, setProbing] = React.useState(false);

  // Probe the video duration whenever the URL is set — the value is
  // stored with the lesson and powers the server-side completion check.
  // YouTube links are exempt: a native metadata probe cannot read a
  // watch page, so we skip it honestly — the governed IFrame player
  // reads the real duration itself and reports it to the SAME server
  // ledger (no re-save needed by the trainer).
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (type === "TEXT" || !videoUrl.trim()) {
      setDurationSeconds(null);
      setProbing(false);
      return;
    }
    if (parseYouTubeUrl(videoUrl.trim())) {
      setDurationSeconds(null);
      setProbing(false);
      return;
    }
    setProbing(true);
    void probeVideoDuration(videoUrl.trim()).then((value) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      setDurationSeconds(value);
      setProbing(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [type, videoUrl]);

  async function submit() {
    if (title.trim().length < 2) {
      setError("عنوان الدرس مطلوب (حرفان على الأقل).");
      return;
    }
    if (type === "TEXT" && content.trim().length === 0) {
      setError("محتوى الدرس النصي مطلوب.");
      return;
    }
    if (type !== "TEXT" && videoUrl.trim().length === 0) {
      setError("أضف الفيديو أولًا — ارفع ملفًا أو أدخل رابطًا خارجيًا ثم اضغط تعيين الرابط.");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    onDone({
      sectionId,
      lessonId: lesson?.id,
      titleAr: title.trim(),
      description: description.trim() || undefined,
      type,
      content: type === "TEXT" ? content.trim() : undefined,
      videoUrl: type === "TEXT" ? undefined : videoUrl.trim(),
      isPublished: lesson?.isPublished ?? false,
      durationSeconds: type === "TEXT" ? undefined : (durationSeconds ?? undefined),
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-3">
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عنوان الدرس *</span>
          <input
            value={title}
            onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={150}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">وصف مختصر</span>
          <input
            value={description}
            onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={500}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">نوع الدرس *</span>
          <select
            value={type}
            onChange={(event) => setType(event.target.value as typeof type)}
            className={inputClass}
          >
            {LESSON_TYPES.map((option) => (
              <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                {option.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      {type === "TEXT" ? (
        <label className="mt-3 block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">محتوى الدرس *</span>
          <textarea
            value={content}
            onChange={(event) => setContent(event.target.value)}
            rows={5}
            maxLength={20000}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-600"
          />
        </label>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <VideoInput
            value={videoUrl}
            onChange={(url) => setVideoUrl(url ?? "")}
            label="فيديو الدرس"
            hint={
              type === "EXTERNAL_VIDEO"
                ? "ألصق رابطًا خارجيًا يبدأ بـ https:// — روابط يوتيوب (watch / youtu.be / shorts / embed) تعمل مباشرة"
                : "رابط يوتيوب (watch / youtu.be / shorts / embed) أو رفع مباشر — MP4/WEBM حتى 512MB"
            }
            attachTo={lesson?.id ? { type: "lesson-media", lessonId: lesson.id } : undefined}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {type !== "TEXT" && videoUrl.trim() && (
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
          {parseYouTubeUrl(videoUrl.trim())
            ? "رابط يوتيوب صحيح — يُشغَّل الفيديو داخل صفحة الدرس مباشرة، وتُقرأ مدته تلقائيًا من المشغّل لحساب نسبة الإتمام على الخادم (لا تحتاج لإعادة الحفظ)."
            : probing
              ? "جارٍ قراءة مدة الفيديو…"
              : durationSeconds
                ? `مدة الفيديو: ${Math.floor(durationSeconds / 60)} دقيقة و${durationSeconds % 60} ثانية — تُستخدم لحساب نسبة الإتمام على الخادم.`
                : "لم تُقرأ مدة الفيديو — سيُعتمد التقدير من مشغّل الطالب (الأفضل إعادة حفظ الفيديو لالتقاط المدة)."}
        </p>
      )}

      {error && (
        <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
          <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={submit}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          <Save className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          {lesson ? "حفظ التعديلات" : "إضافة الدرس"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onDone(null)}
          className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
        >
          إلغاء
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* --------------------------- Enrollments --------------------------- */

function EnrollmentPanel({
  course,
  teachers,
  enrollments,
}: CourseBuilderProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<string[]>([]);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  const enrolledIds = new Set(enrollments.map((row) => row.userId));
  const available = teachers.filter((teacher) => !enrolledIds.has(teacher.id));

  async function assign() {
    if (pending || selected.length === 0) return;
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await enrollSupervisorTeachersAction(
      course.id,
      selected
    ));
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر الإسناد." });
      return;
    }
    setSelected([]);
    setFeedback({
      bad: false,
      text: `تم إسناد الدورة إلى ${result.data?.enrolled ?? selected.length} معلمًا.`,
    });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
      <div className="border-b px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">
          الإسناد والتسجيل ({enrollments.length})
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          {course.status === "PUBLISHED"
            ? "أسند الدورة لمعلميك المسندَين إليك — أو سجلوا بأنفسهم من الأكاديمية."
            : "انشر الدورة أولًا لتتمكن من إسنادها."}
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="p-4">
        {feedback && (
          <div className="mb-2">
            <Feedback {...feedback} />
          </div>
        )}

        {enrollments.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="mb-3 max-h-40 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto">
            {enrollments.map((row) => (
              <li
                key={row.userId}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/30 px-2.5 py-1.5"
              >
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-xs font-bold">{row.name}</span>
                {row.completedAt ? (
                  <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-bold text-success">أتمها ✓</span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">مسجل</span>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}

        {available.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            كل معلميك المسندون مسجلون في هذه الدورة — أو لا يوجد معلمون مسندون بعد.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="max-h-40 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border p-2">
              {available.map((teacher) => (
                <label
                  key={teacher.id}
                  className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded px-1.5 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-muted/40"
                >
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={selected.includes(teacher.id)}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setSelected((current) =>
                        event.target.checked
                          ? [...current, teacher.id]
                          : current.filter((id) => id !== teacher.id)
                      )
                    }
                    className="size-3.5 accent-[var(--brand-600)]"
                  />
                  {teacher.name}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={assign}
              disabled={pending || selected.length === 0}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {pending && <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
              إسناد ({selected.length})
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/* --------------------------- Assessments --------------------------- */

function AssessmentsPanel({
  assessments,
}: {
  assessments: CourseBuilderProps["assessments"];
}) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
      <div className="border-b px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">اختبارات الدورة</h2>
      </div>
      <div className="p-4">
        {assessments.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            لا اختبارات مرتبطة بهذه الدورة — أنشئ اختبارًا من صفحة «الأسئلة
            والاختبارات» واربطه بهذه الدورة.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-2">
            {assessments.map((assessment) => (
              <li
                key={assessment.id}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/30 px-2.5 py-2"
              >
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold">{assessment.titleAr}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {assessment.questionsCount} سؤالًا
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span
                  className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                    assessment.status === "PUBLISHED"
                      ? "bg-success-soft text-success"
                      : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700"
                  }`}
                >
                  {assessment.status === "PUBLISHED" ? "منشور" : "مسودة"}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <Link
          href="/supervision/assessments"
          className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:bg-accent"
        >
          إدارة الاختبارات
        </Link>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/* ------------------- Mandatory learning policy --------------------- */

function LearningPolicyEditor({
  courseId,
  policy,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  policy: { requireSequentialLessons: boolean; lessonCompletionThreshold: number };
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [sequential, setSequential] = React.useState(policy.requireSequentialLessons);
  const [threshold, setThreshold] = React.useState(policy.lessonCompletionThreshold);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  async function handleSave() {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await saveSupervisorCoursePolicyAction({
      courseId,
      requireSequentialLessons: sequential,
      lessonCompletionThreshold: threshold,
    }));
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({
        bad: true,
        text: result.message ?? "تعذر حفظ إعدادات التعلم الإلزامي.",
      });
      return;
    }
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم حفظ إعدادات التعلم الإلزامي." });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border bg-card">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-start"
      >
        <span className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">
          إعدادات التعلم الإلزامي — التسلسل ونسبة المشاهدة
        </span>
        {open ? (
          <ChevronUp className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
        ) : (
          <ChevronDown className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
        )}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="space-y-3 border-t p-4">
          <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={sequential}
              onChange={(event) => setSequential(event.target.checked)}
              className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
            />
            <span>
              <span className="font-bold">فتح الدروس بالترتيب:</span> يُفتح كل
              درس فقط بعد إكمال ما قبله (التقييمات تبقى مقفلة حتى إكمال كل
              الدروس). الإيقاف يتيح للمعلمين فتح أي درس بحرية.
            </span>
          </label>
          <label className="block max-w-64">
            <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">
              نسبة المشاهدة المطلوبة لإتمام درس الفيديو (%)
            </span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={50}
              max={100}
              value={threshold}
              onChange={(event) => setThreshold(Number(event.target.value))}
              className={inputClass}
            />
            <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              من 50 إلى 100 — الافتراضي 95%. يُحتسب الإتمام على الخادم من وقت
              المشاهدة الفعلي، ولا يمكن للطالب تعديله أو تخطيه.
            </span>
          </label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={pending}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {pending ? (
                <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <Save className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              حفظ الإعدادات
            </button>

}

import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { UnifiedTrainingEditor } from "@/app/supervision/training/unified/unified-editor";
import {
  getSupervisorTrainingProgress,
  getSupervisorTrainingWorkspace,
  requireSupervisorContext,
} from "@/lib/supervision/training";

export const metadata = { title: "بناء ونشر التدريب — الصفحة الموحدة" };

/**
 * Unified training workspace — the ONE management page per training
 * (draft AND published). Everything the editor renders comes from
 * getSupervisorTrainingWorkspace (tenant-fenced); the progress read
 * model adds teacher participation, exam results, essay-review needs,
 * certificates and impact responses — all from the existing models.
 * Every mutation re-verifies scope server-side.
 */
export default async function SupervisorTrainingEditorPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ courseId: string }>;
}) {
  const { courseId } = await params;
  const ctx = await requireSupervisorContext();
  const workspace = await getSupervisorTrainingWorkspace(ctx, courseId);

  if (!workspace.ok) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-lg rounded-xl border bg-card p-8 text-center">
        <TriangleAlert className="mx-auto size-8 text-destructive" aria-hidden="true" />
        <h1 className="mt-3 text-lg font-black text-foreground">
          التدريب غير متاح
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{workspace.message}</p>
        <Link
          href="/supervision/training"
          className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          <ArrowRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          العودة إلى إدارة التدريب
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Read-only participation/results aggregation — a failure here must
  // never block editing, so the editor simply renders without it.
  const progress = await getSupervisorTrainingProgress(ctx, courseId);

  return (
    <UnifiedTrainingEditor
      workspace={workspace.data}
      progress={progress.ok ? progress.data : null}
    />
  );
}

import { createSupervisorCourseAction } from "@/app/actions/supervision-training";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor course creation form (school scope hard-bound server-side */
/* — the form never sends a schoolId).                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

const LEVELS = [
  { value: "BEGINNER", label: "مبتدئ" },
  { value: "INTERMEDIATE", label: "متوسط" },
  { value: "ADVANCED", label: "متقدم" },
];

export function SupervisorCourseForm({
  categories,
  programs,
}: {
  categories: string[];
  programs: Array<{ id: string; nameAr: string; platformWide: boolean }>;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<
    { bad: boolean; text: string } | null
  >(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = React.useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const data = new FormData(form);
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    setFieldErrors({});

    const result = (await createSupervisorCourseAction({
      titleAr: String(data.get("titleAr") ?? ""),
      titleEn: String(data.get("titleEn") ?? "") || undefined,
      descriptionAr: String(data.get("descriptionAr") ?? ""),
      descriptionEn: String(data.get("descriptionEn") ?? "") || undefined,
      category: String(data.get("category") ?? ""),
      level: String(data.get("level") ?? "") || undefined,
      estimatedHours: data.get("estimatedHours")
        ? Number(data.get("estimatedHours"))
        : undefined,
      programId: String(data.get("programId") ?? "") || undefined,
    })) as ActionResult;

    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFieldErrors(result.fieldErrors ?? {});
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر إنشاء الدورة." });
      return;
    }
    form.reset();
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم إنشاء الدورة كمسودة — أكمل بناء محتواها الآن." });
    if (result.data?.id) {
      router.push(`/supervision/training/${result.data.id}`);
    }
    router.refresh();
  }

  const inputClass =
    "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4"
      noValidate
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-600/10 text-brand-600">
          <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">دورة تدريبية جديدة</h2>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            تُنشأ داخل مدرستك كمسودة — النشر من شاشة البناء بعد إضافة المحتوى.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
            عنوان الدورة بالعربية *
          </span>
          <input name="titleAr" className={inputClass} maxLength={150} required />
          {fieldErrors.titleAr && (
            <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-destructive">
              {fieldErrors.titleAr}
            </span>
          )}
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
            العنوان بالإنجليزية (اختياري)
          </span>
          <input name="titleEn" className={inputClass} maxLength={150} dir="ltr" />
        </label>
        <label className="block md:col-span-2">

          <datalist id="supervisor-course-categories">

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import {
  ensureSupervisorTrainingDraft,
  requireSupervisorContext,
} from "@/lib/supervision/training";

export const metadata = { title: "إنشاء تدريب احترافي جديد" };

/**
 * Unified training creation — ONE page for the complete professional
 * training.
 *
 * DRAFT-FIRST (no sequential gates): opening this page GET-OR-CREATES
 * the supervisor's scratch DRAFT course server-side and redirects to its
 * unified workspace, where EVERY section (basic info, videos, PDF
 * attachments, exam, impact measurement, publish) is editable
 * immediately and independently — no section requires saving another
 * first. Repeatedly opening the creation page reuses the same untouched
 * scratch draft instead of piling up empty rows; a draft that already
 * carries content is never merged or overwritten.
 */
export default async function NewSupervisorTrainingPage() {
  const ctx = await requireSupervisorContext();
  const draft = await ensureSupervisorTrainingDraft(ctx);

  if (!draft.ok) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-lg rounded-xl border bg-card p-8 text-center">
        <TriangleAlert className="mx-auto size-8 text-destructive" aria-hidden="true" />
        <h1 className="mt-3 text-lg font-black text-foreground">
          تعذر بدء إنشاء التدريب
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{draft.message}</p>
        <Link
          href="/supervision/training"
          className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          العودة إلى إدارة التدريب
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // The workspace page IS the creation page: the draft is persisted, all
  // sections unlocked, and the URL is now the training's canonical
  // management address (survives refresh/share/bookmark).
  redirect(`/supervision/training/${draft.data.id}`);
}

"use client";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Destructive Delete control for ONE training — trigger + secure       */
/* confirmation dialog.                                                 */
/*                                                                      */
/* Deliberately SEPARATE from every Edit affordance:                    */
/*   • the trigger is a red outlined button that sits NEXT TO the blue  */
/*     Edit/open actions (never inside them),                           */
/*   • clicking it deletes NOTHING — it only opens this dialog,         */
/*   • the dialog states plainly that deletion is permanent, lists what */
/*     is removed with it, and demands the exact case-sensitive word    */
/*     DELETE typed by hand; the permanent-delete button stays DISABLED */
/*     until the input matches exactly (any other value is rejected),   */
/*   • while the request runs the dialog is locked (no Escape/backdrop  */
/*     close, buttons disabled) with a spinner, then it reports success */
/*     or error feedback before navigating back to the list —           */
/*     redirectTo decides WHICH list (Training Management by default,   */
/*     /academy when the trigger lives on a Training Academy card, so   */
/*     the SAME dialog serves BOTH listings identically).               */
/* Accessible: role=dialog + aria-modal + labelled/described-by ids,    */
/* focus moves to the confirmation input on open and returns to the     */
/* trigger on close, live validation feedback, Escape cancels when idle.*/
/* Responsive: bottom-sheet on phones, centered card on desktop.        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import * as React from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Loader2, ShieldAlert, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

import { deleteSupervisorTrainingAction } from "@/app/actions/supervision-training";

/** The ONLY accepted confirmation value — exact, case-sensitive. */
const CONFIRM_WORD = "DELETE";

interface DeleteResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  data?: { id: string; mediaCleanupFailures?: number };
}

const deletedItems: string[] = [
  "فيديوهات الدروس والمرفقات — وملفاتها المرفوعة من التخزين السحابي",
  "الأقسام والدروس وكل محتواها",
  "الاختبار النهائي: الأسئلة والخيارات والإجابات الصحيحة",
  "محاولات المعلمين ودرجاتهم وتصحيح الأسئلة المقالية",
  "أداة قياس الأثر: أسئلتها وردود المعلمين ونتائجها",
  "الشهادات وسجلات الإكمال الصادرة لهذا التدريب",
  "تسجيلات المعلمين وتقدمهم وسجلات المشاهدة وتعليقات التدريب",
];

export function DeleteTrainingButton({
  courseId,
  courseTitle,
  lessonsCount = 0,
  size = "card",
  redirectTo = "/supervision/training",
}: {
  courseId: string;
  courseTitle: string;
  lessonsCount?: number;
  /** "card" = small row button in the list, "page" = larger editor header button. */
  size?: "card" | "page";
  /** Where to return after the deletion commits — Training Management
   *  by default; "/academy" keeps supervisors on the Academy listing
   *  their card lives in. Same action, same dialog, same service. */
  redirectTo?: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [confirmText, setConfirmText] = React.useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const triggerRef = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const redirectTimer = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (redirectTimer.current) clearTimeout(redirectTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const exactMatch = confirmText === CONFIRM_WORD;
  const mismatch = confirmText.length > 0 && !exactMatch;

  function openDialog() {
    setConfirmText("");
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setOpen(true);
  }

  function closeDialog() {
    if (pending) return; // locked while the request runs
    setOpen(false);
    setConfirmText("");
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
  }

  // Focus the input on open, lock page scroll, Escape cancels when idle.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    const focusTimer = setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 30);
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") closeDialog();
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
      clearTimeout(focusTimer);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, pending]);

  // Return focus to the trigger when the dialog closes.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) triggerRef.current?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  function backToList() {
    router.push(redirectTo);
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function confirmDelete() {
    if (pending || success) return;
    if (confirmText !== CONFIRM_WORD) {
      setError("النص غير مطابق — اكتب DELETE بالأحرف اللاتينية الكبيرة بالضبط (حساسة لحالة الأحرف).");
      inputRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = (await deleteSupervisorTrainingAction(courseId)) as DeleteResult;
      setPending(false);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setError(result.message ?? "تعذر حذف التدريب — تأكد من حالة الاتصال وأعد المحاولة.");
        return;
      }
      const failures = result.data?.mediaCleanupFailures ?? 0;
      setSuccess(
        failures > 0
          ? `تم حذف التدريب نهائيًا — تعذر إزالة ${failures} ملفًا من التخزين وستتولى الصيانة الدورية إزالتها.`
          : "تم حذف التدريب نهائيًا مع كل محتوياته."
      );
      redirectTimer.current = setTimeout(backToList, failures > 0 ? 3500 : 1200);
    } catch {
      setPending(false);
      setError("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — لم يتم الحذف. أعد المحاولة.");
    }
  }

  const triggerClasses =
    size === "page"
      ? "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-destructive/40 bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-destructive transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
      : "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-destructive transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50";

  return (
    <>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        onClick={openDialog}
        className={triggerClasses}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
      >
        <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        {size === "page" ? "حذف التدريب" : "حذف"}
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-center bg-black/50 p-3 backdrop-blur-[2px] sm:items-center sm:p-6"
          onClick={closeDialog}
          role="presentation"
        >
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="delete-training-title"
            aria-describedby="delete-training-desc"
            className="max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-md overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xl"
            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="border-b px-4 py-3.5">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive">
                  <ShieldAlert className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </span>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <h2 id="delete-training-title" className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">
                    حذف التدريب نهائيًا
                  </h2>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="auto">
                    {courseTitle}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 px-4 py-4">
              <p
                id="delete-training-desc"
                className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground"
              >
                هذه العملية <strong className="font-black">نهائية ولا يمكن التراجع عنها</strong>.
                سيُحذف التدريب من مدرستك مع
                {lessonsCount > 0 ? ` ${lessonsCount} عنصر محتوى و` : " "}
                كل ما يرتبط به:
              </p>

              <ul className="space-y-1.5 rounded-lg border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/5 px-3 py-2.5">
                {deletedItems.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item} className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-foreground">
                    <Trash2 className="mt-0.5 size-3 shrink-0 text-destructive" aria-hidden="true" />
                    <span className="min-w-0">{item}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>

              <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0 text-amber-500" aria-hidden="true" />
                بعد التأكيد تُحذف البيانات نهائيًا ولا يمكن استرجاعها بأي شكل — التدريبات الأخرى
                وبيانات المعلمين في باقي التدريبات لن تتأثر.
              </p>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="delete-confirm-input" className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                  للتأكيد اكتب{" "}
                  <span className="font-mono font-black text-destructive" dir="ltr">
                    DELETE
                  </span>{" "}
                  بالأحرف اللاتينية الكبيرة (حساسة لحالة الأحرف)
                </label>
                <input
                  id="delete-confirm-input"
                  ref={inputRef}
                  value={confirmText}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setConfirmText(event.target.value);
                    setError(null);
                  }}
                  disabled={pending || success !== null}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  autoCorrect="off"
                  spellCheck={false}
                  dir="ltr"
                  placeholder="DELETE"
                  aria-invalid={mismatch}
                  aria-describedby="delete-confirm-hint"
                  className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 font-mono text-sm tracking-widest outline-none transition-colors focus:border-destructive disabled:opacity-60"
                />
                <p
                  id="delete-confirm-hint"
                  role={mismatch ? "alert" : "status"}
                  className={`mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                    exactMatch
                      ? "text-success"
                      : mismatch
                        ? "text-destructive"
                        : "text-muted-foreground"
                  }`}
                >
                  {exactMatch ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                  ) : (
                    <AlertTriangle
                      className={`size-3.5 shrink-0 ${mismatch ? "" : "opacity-0"}`}
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                  )}
                  {exactMatch
                    ? "مطابق — يمكنك المتابعة بالحذف النهائي."
                    : mismatch
                      ? "غير مطابق — يجب كتابة DELETE بالأحرف الكبيرة بالضبط."
                      : "زر الحذف يبقى معطلًا حتى يطابق النص بالضبط."}
                </p>
              </div>

              {error && (
                <p
                  role="alert"
                  className="flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold leading-relaxed text-destructive"
                >
                  <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="min-w-0">{error}</span>
                </p>
              )}
              {success && (
                <p
                  role="status"
                  className="flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold leading-relaxed text-success"
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="min-w-0">{success}</span>
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 border-t px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeDialog}
                disabled={pending}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 sm:w-auto"
              >
                إلغاء
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={confirmDelete}
                disabled={pending || !exactMatch || success !== null}
                className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-destructive px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 sm:w-auto"
              >
                {pending ? (
                  <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <Trash2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
                {pending ? "جارٍ الحذف…" : "حذف نهائي"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Final assessment — the EXISTING assessment engine embedded in the    */
/* unified page: same Assessment/AssessmentQuestion models, same        */
/* question types, same automatic + manual grading. Passing score is    */
/* configured as a PERCENTAGE (default 60%) and recomputed into points  */

interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

/**
 * Server validation failures carry per-field Arabic messages (e.g.
 * «حدّد الإجابة الصحيحة»، «أضف خيارين على الأقل»). Surfacing them verbatim
 * replaces the old generic-only "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة" experience.
 */
function describeFailure(result: ActionResult, fallback: string): string {
  const details = Object.values(result.fieldErrors ?? {}).filter(Boolean);
  const base = result.message ?? fallback;
  return details.length > 0 ? `${base} — ${details.join(" · ")}` : base;
}

const inputClass =
  "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

const QUESTION_TYPES = [
  { value: "SINGLE_CHOICE", label: "اختيار مفرد" },
  { value: "MULTIPLE_CHOICE", label: "اختيار متعدد" },
  { value: "TRUE_FALSE", label: "صح وخطأ" },
  { value: "SHORT_ANSWER", label: "إجابة مقالية (تصحيح يدوي)" },
];

type QuestionType = (typeof QUESTION_TYPES)[number]["value"];

export function TrainingAssessmentSection({
  courseId,

  courseId: string;

    >
      {assessment ? (
        <AssessmentEditor courseId={courseId} assessment={assessment} />
      ) : (
        <AssessmentCreateForm courseId={courseId} courseTitle={workspace.course.titleAr} />
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

/* ------------------------- create form ----------------------------- */

function AssessmentCreateForm({
  courseId,
  courseTitle,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  courseTitle: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  async function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const attemptLimit = Number(data.get("attemptLimit") ?? 1);
    const timeLimitRaw = String(data.get("timeLimitMinutes") ?? "").trim();
    const result = (await createSupervisorAssessmentAction({
      courseId,
      titleAr: String(data.get("titleAr") ?? "").trim() || `الاختبار النهائي — ${courseTitle}`.slice(0, 150),
      instructionsAr:
        String(data.get("instructionsAr") ?? "").trim() ||
        "أجب عن جميع الأسئلة ثم سلّم إجاباتك — النجاح في الاختبار شرط لإصدار الشهادة.",
      passingScore: 1,
      attemptLimit: Number.isFinite(attemptLimit) && attemptLimit >= 1 ? Math.min(10, attemptLimit) : 1,
      timeLimitMinutes:
        timeLimitRaw && Number.isFinite(Number(timeLimitRaw)) && Number(timeLimitRaw) >= 1
          ? Math.min(300, Number(timeLimitRaw))
          : undefined,
    })) as ActionResult;
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: describeFailure(result, "تعذر إنشاء الاختبار.") });
      return;
    }
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم إنشاء الاختبار — أضف أسئلته الآن." });
    router.refresh();
  }

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
      >
        <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        إنشاء الاختبار النهائي
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-3" noValidate>
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block md:col-span-2">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عنوان الاختبار</span>
          <input
            name="titleAr"
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={150}
            placeholder={`الاختبار النهائي — ${courseTitle}`}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block md:col-span-2">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">تعليمات الاختبار</span>
          <textarea
            name="instructionsAr"
            rows={2}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-600"
            placeholder="أجب عن جميع الأسئلة ثم سلّم إجاباتك — النجاح شرط لإصدار الشهادة."
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عدد المحاولات المسموح</span>
          <input name="attemptLimit" type="number" min={1} max={10} defaultValue={1} className={inputClass} />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">مدة الاختبار بالدقائق (اختياري)</span>
          <input name="timeLimitMinutes" type="number" min={1} max={300} className={inputClass} />
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending && <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
          إنشاء الاختبار
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
          className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
        >
          إلغاء
        </button>
        {feedback && <Feedback {...feedback} />}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
