type WorkspaceQuestion = NonNullable<
  TrainingWorkspace["assessment"]
>["questions"][number];

function AssessmentEditor({
  courseId,
  assessment,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  assessment: {
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    instructionsAr: string;
    status: string;
    passingScore: number;
    maxScore: number;
    passingPercent: number | null;
    attemptLimit: number | null;
    timeLimitMinutes: number | null;
    questions: WorkspaceQuestion[];
  };
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [addingQuestion, setAddingQuestion] = React.useState(false);
  const [editingQuestionId, setEditingQuestionId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);

  const displayPercent =
    assessment.passingPercent ??
    (assessment.maxScore > 0
      ? Math.round((assessment.passingScore / assessment.maxScore) * 100)
      : DEFAULT_PASSING_PERCENT);

  async function act(action: () => Promise<ActionResult>, successText?: string): Promise<boolean> {
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = await action();
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: describeFailure(result, "تعذرت العملية.") });
      return false;
    }
    setFeedback(successText ? { bad: false, text: successText } : null);
    router.refresh();
    return true;
  }

  async function changePercent(percent: number) {
    await act(
      () =>
        setSupervisorAssessmentPassingPercentAction({
          assessmentId: assessment.id,
          passingPercent: percent,
        }),
      `تم ضبط درجة النجاح على ${percent}%.`
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {feedback && <Feedback {...feedback} />}

      {/* Settings summary + passing percent */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 p-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 text-xs">
          <p className="font-bold text-foreground">{assessment.titleAr}</p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {assessment.questions.length} سؤالًا · مجموع النقاط {assessment.maxScore} ·
            درجة النجاح {assessment.passingScore}/{assessment.maxScore || "—"} نقطة
            {assessment.attemptLimit ? ` · ${assessment.attemptLimit} محاولات` : " · محاولات غير محدودة"}
            {assessment.timeLimitMinutes ? ` · ${assessment.timeLimitMinutes} دقيقة` : ""}
          </p>
        </div>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold">
          <span className="whitespace-nowrap">نسبة النجاح %</span>
          <select
            value={displayPercent}
            disabled={pending || assessment.status === "ARCHIVED"}
            onChange={(event) => void changePercent(Number(event.target.value))}
            className={`${inputClass} h-8 w-20`}
          >
            {[40, 50, 60, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90].map((percent) => (
              <option key={percent} value={percent}>
                {percent}%
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      {/* Questions */}
      <ul className="space-y-2">
        {assessment.questions.map((question, index) =>
          editingQuestionId === question.id ? (
            <li key={question.id}>
              <QuestionForm
                assessmentId={assessment.id}
                question={question}
                onDone={async (payload) => {
                  setEditingQuestionId(null);
                  if (!payload) return;
                  await act(() =>
                    payload.kind === "add"
                      ? addSupervisorQuestionAction(payload.body)
                      : editSupervisorQuestionAction(payload.body)
                  );
                }}
              />
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li key={question.id} className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 px-3 py-2">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                    {index + 1}. {question.textAr}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {QUESTION_TYPES.find((option) => option.value === question.type)?.label ??
                      question.type}{" "}
                    · {question.points} نقطة {question.isRequired ? "· إجباري" : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <SmallIconButton
                    label="تحريك لأعلى"
                    disabled={pending || index === 0}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() =>
                        moveSupervisorQuestionAction({
                          assessmentId: assessment.id,
                          questionId: question.id,
                          direction: "up",
                        })
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowUp className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                  <SmallIconButton
                    label="تحريك لأسفل"
                    disabled={pending || index === assessment.questions.length - 1}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() =>
                        moveSupervisorQuestionAction({
                          assessmentId: assessment.id,
                          questionId: question.id,
                          direction: "down",
                        })
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowDown className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                  <SmallIconButton label="تعديل السؤال" onClick={() => setEditingQuestionId(question.id)}>
                    <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                  <SmallIconButton
                    label="حذف السؤال"
                    destructive
                    disabled={pending}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: "حذف السؤال؟", description: "سيتم حذف هذا السؤال نهائيًا من الاختبار.", tone: "danger" }))) return;
                      await act(() =>
                        deleteSupervisorQuestionAction({ questionId: question.id })
                      );
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                </div>
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        )}
      </ul>

      {addingQuestion ? (
        <QuestionForm
          assessmentId={assessment.id}
          question={null}
          onDone={async (payload) => {
            setAddingQuestion(false);
            if (!payload) return;
            await act(() =>
              payload.kind === "add"
                ? addSupervisorQuestionAction(payload.body)
                : editSupervisorQuestionAction(payload.body)
            );
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={assessment.status === "ARCHIVED"}
          onClick={() => setAddingQuestion(true)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          إضافة سؤال
        </button>
      )}

      <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
        أسئلة الاختيار تُصحَّح آليًا فور التسليم، وأسئلة المقال تنتظر تقييمك من
        شاشة «الأسئلة والاختبارات» — لا تُصدر الشهادة قبل اجتياز الاختبار.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------ question form ---------------------------- */

type QuestionPayload =
  | { kind: "add"; body: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { kind: "edit"; body: Record<string, unknown> };

function QuestionForm({
  assessmentId,
  question,
  onDone,
}: {
  assessmentId: string;
  question: WorkspaceQuestion | null;
  onDone: (payload: QuestionPayload | null) => void;
}) {
  const [type, setType] = React.useState<QuestionType>(
    (question?.type as QuestionType) ?? "SINGLE_CHOICE"
  );
  const [text, setText] = React.useState(question?.textAr ?? "");
  const [points, setPoints] = React.useState(question?.points ?? 1);
  const [required, setRequired] = React.useState(question?.isRequired ?? true);
  const [options, setOptions] = React.useState<string[]>(
    question && question.options.length > 0
      ? question.options.map((option) => option.textAr)
      : ["", "", "", ""]
  );
  const [correctIndex, setCorrectIndex] = React.useState<number>(() => {
    if (!question) return 0;
    const firstId = question.correctOptionIds[0] ?? "";
    const index = question.options.findIndex((option) => option.id === firstId);
    return index >= 0 ? index : 0;
  });
  const [correctIndexes, setCorrectIndexes] = React.useState<number[]>(() => {
    if (!question) return [];
    return question.correctOptionIds
      .map((id) => question.options.findIndex((option) => option.id === id))
      .filter((index) => index >= 0);
  });
  const [correctBool, setCorrectBool] = React.useState<boolean>(
    question?.correctBool ?? true
  );
  const [modelAnswer, setModelAnswer] = React.useState(question?.modelAnswer ?? "");
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  function submit() {
    if (text.trim().length < 3) {
      setError("نص السؤال مطلوب (3 أحرف على الأقل).");
      return;
    }
    if (points < 1 || points > 100) {
      setError("درجة السؤال بين 1 و100.");
      return;
    }

    const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
      assessmentId,
      type,
      textAr: text.trim(),
      points,
      isRequired: required,
    };
    if (question?.id) body.questionId = question.id;

    if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE") {
      const cleaned = options.map((option) => option.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (cleaned.length < 2) {
        setError("أضف خيارين على الأقل للسؤال.");
        return;
      }
      if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" && correctIndex >= cleaned.length) {
        setError("اختر الإجابة الصحيحة.");
        return;
      }
      if (type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE" && correctIndexes.length === 0) {
        setError("اختر إجابة صحيحة واحدة على الأقل.");
        return;
      }
      body.options = cleaned.map((option) => ({ textAr: option }));
      body.correctOptionIndexes =
        type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? [Math.min(correctIndex, cleaned.length - 1)] : correctIndexes.filter((index) => index < cleaned.length);
    } else if (type === "TRUE_FALSE") {
      body.correctValue = correctBool;
    } else {
      if (modelAnswer.trim().length === 0) {
        setError("أضف إجابة نموذجية تساعدك عند التصحيح اليدوي.");
        return;
      }
      body.modelAnswer = modelAnswer.trim();
    }

    onDone(question?.id ? { kind: "edit", body } : { kind: "add", body });
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-3">
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-[1fr_170px_90px]">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">نص السؤال *</span>
          <input
            value={text}
            onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={1000}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">نوع السؤال</span>
          <select
            value={type}
            onChange={(event) => setType(event.target.value as QuestionType)}
            className={inputClass}
          >
            {QUESTION_TYPES.map((option) => (
              <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                {option.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الدرجة</span>
          <input
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={100}
            value={points}
            onChange={(event) => setPoints(Number(event.target.value))}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      {(type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE") && (
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          <span className="block text-xs font-bold">
            الخيارات {type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? "— حدّد الصحيحة" : "— حدّد كل الصحيحة"}
          </span>
          {options.map((option, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type={type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? "radio" : "checkbox"}
                name="correct-option"
                checked={type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? correctIndex === index : correctIndexes.includes(index)}
                onChange={() => {
                  if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE") {
                    setCorrectIndex(index);
                  } else {
                    setCorrectIndexes((current) =>
                      current.includes(index)
                        ? current.filter((value) => value !== index)
                        : [...current, index]
                    );
                  }
                }}
                className="size-3.5 shrink-0 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
                aria-label={`الإجابة الصحيحة ${index + 1}`}
              />
              <input
                value={option}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setOptions((current) =>
                    current.map((value, position) =>
                      position === index ? event.target.value : value
                    )
                  )
                }
                placeholder={`الخيار ${index + 1}`}
                className={inputClass}
                maxLength={200}
              />
              {options.length > 2 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setOptions((current) => current.filter((_, position) => position !== index))
                  }
                  className="text-destructive"
                  aria-label="حذف الخيار"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
          {options.length < 6 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setOptions((current) => [...current, ""])}
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 hover:underline"
            >
              + إضافة خيار
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {type === "TRUE_FALSE" && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3 text-xs font-bold">
          <span>الإجابة الصحيحة:</span>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="correct-bool"
              checked={correctBool === true}
              onChange={() => setCorrectBool(true)}
              className="accent-[#1D5BD6]"
            />
            صحيح
          </label>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="correct-bool"
              checked={correctBool === false}
              onChange={() => setCorrectBool(false)}
              className="accent-[#1D5BD6]"
            />
            خطأ
          </label>
        </div>
      )}

      {type === "SHORT_ANSWER" && (
        <label className="mt-3 block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الإجابة النموذجية (للتصحيح اليدوي)</span>
          <textarea
            value={modelAnswer}
            onChange={(event) => setModelAnswer(event.target.value)}
            rows={2}
            maxLength={2000}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-600"
          />
        </label>
      )}

      <label className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={required}
          onChange={(event) => setRequired(event.target.checked)}
          className="size-3.5 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
        />
        سؤال إجباري
      </label>

      {error && (
        <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
          <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={submit}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          {question ? "حفظ السؤال" : "إضافة السؤال"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onDone(null)}
          className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
        >
          إلغاء
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

  Trash2,

  deleteSupervisorLessonAction,
  moveSupervisorLessonAction,
  saveSupervisorLessonAction,
  saveSupervisorSectionAction,

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Training Videos section — upload from the device, multiple videos,   */
/* ordered list, remove/reorder, title + upload status + progress.      */
/*                                                                      */
/* Reuses the existing lesson architecture: every video is a            */
/* CourseLesson(type VIDEO) inside the course's content section, with   */
/* the R2 presigned upload pipeline and the server-side watch-duration  */
/* capture. Nothing new is stored.                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

const inputClass =
  "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

/**
 * Read the real duration of a video URL in the supervisor's browser
 * (metadata only, 8s timeout) — stored on the lesson and powers the
 * server-side mandatory-watch threshold. YouTube links are exempt: the
 * governed IFrame player reports their duration to the same ledger.
 */
async function probeVideoDuration(url: string): Promise<number | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || !url) {
      resolve(null);
      return;
    }
    const video = document.createElement("video");
    video.preload = "metadata";
    video.muted = true;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      cleanup();
      resolve(null);
    }, 8000);
    function cleanup() {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      video.onloadedmetadata = null;
      video.onerror = null;
      video.removeAttribute("src");
      try {
        video.load();
      } catch {
        // Ignore — element is detached.
      }
    }
    video.onloadedmetadata = () => {
      const value = video.duration;
      cleanup();
      resolve(Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.round(value) : null);
    };
    video.onerror = () => {
      cleanup();
      resolve(null);
    };
    video.src = url;
  });
}

export interface VideoRow {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  description: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  durationSeconds: number | null;
  isPublished: boolean;
}

export function TrainingVideosSection({
  courseId,
  workspace,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  workspace: TrainingWorkspace;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [adding, setAdding] = React.useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);

  // Videos live in the FIRST content section (created lazily on the
  // first video of a new training; existing courses keep their section).
  const contentSection = workspace.sections[0] ?? null;
  const videoRows: VideoRow[] = (workspace.sections ?? [])
    .flatMap((section) => section.lessons)
    .filter((lesson) => lesson.type === "VIDEO" || lesson.type === "EXTERNAL_VIDEO")
    .map((lesson) => ({
      id: lesson.id,
      titleAr: lesson.titleAr,
      description: lesson.description,
      videoUrl: lesson.videoUrl,
      durationSeconds: lesson.durationSeconds,
      isPublished: lesson.isPublished,
    }));

  async function ensureSection(): Promise<string | null> {
    if (contentSection) return contentSection.id;
    const created = (await saveSupervisorSectionAction({
      courseId,
      titleAr: "محتوى التدريب",
    })) as ActionResult;
    if (!created.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: created.message ?? "تعذر إنشاء قسم المحتوى." });
      return null;
    }
    return created.data?.id ?? null;
  }

  async function act(action: () => Promise<ActionResult>): Promise<boolean> {
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = await action();
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذرت العملية." });
      return false;
    }
    router.refresh();
    return true;
  }

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon={<Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
      title="فيديوهات التدريب"
      description="ارفع الفيديوهات من جهازك مباشرة أو ألصق رابط يوتيوب — تُعرض للمعلمين بالترتيب مع مشغّل إلزامي يحتسب المشاهدة على الخادم."
    >
      {feedback && (
        <div className="mb-3">
          <Feedback {...feedback} />
        </div>
      )}

      {videoRows.length === 0 && !adding && (
        <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-4 py-5 text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          لا فيديوهات بعد — أضف أول فيديو من الأسفل.
        </p>
      )}

      <ul className="space-y-2">
        {videoRows.map((video, index) =>
          editingId === video.id ? (
            <li key={video.id}>
              <VideoForm
                video={video}
                onDone={async (payload) => {
                  setEditingId(null);
                  if (!payload) return;
                  await act(() => saveSupervisorLessonAction(payload));
                }}
              />
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li key={video.id} className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 px-3 py-2">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                    {index + 1}. {video.titleAr}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {video.videoUrl
                      ? parseYouTubeUrl(video.videoUrl)
                        ? "رابط يوتيوب"
                        : "فيديو مرفوع"
                      : "بدون فيديو"}
                    {video.durationSeconds
                      ? ` · ${Math.floor(video.durationSeconds / 60)}:${String(
                          video.durationSeconds % 60
                        ).padStart(2, "0")} دقيقة`
                      : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span
                    className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                      video.isPublished
                        ? "bg-success-soft text-success"
                        : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {video.isPublished ? "جاهز" : "مسودة"}
                  </span>
                  <SmallIconButton
                    label="تحريك لأعلى"
                    disabled={pending || index === 0}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() => moveSupervisorLessonAction(video.id, "up"))
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowUp className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                  <SmallIconButton
                    label="تحريك لأسفل"
                    disabled={pending || index === videoRows.length - 1}
                    onClick={() =>
                      act(() => moveSupervisorLessonAction(video.id, "down"))
                    }
                  >
                    <ArrowDown className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                  <SmallIconButton label="تعديل" onClick={() => setEditingId(video.id)}>
                    <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                  <SmallIconButton
                    label="حذف الفيديو"
                    destructive
                    disabled={pending}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: "حذف الفيديو؟", description: "سيتم حذف هذا الفيديو نهائيًا من الدرس.", tone: "danger" }))) return;
                      await act(() => deleteSupervisorLessonAction(video.id));
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </SmallIconButton>
                </div>
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        )}
      </ul>

      {adding ? (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <VideoForm
            video={null}
            onDone={async (payload) => {
              setAdding(false);
              if (!payload) return;
              const sectionId = await ensureSection();
              if (!sectionId) return;
              await act(() => saveSupervisorLessonAction({ ...payload, sectionId }));
            }}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setAdding(true)}
          className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          إضافة فيديو
        </button>
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

export function SmallIconButton({
  label,
  children,
  onClick,
  disabled,
  destructive,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  onClick?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  destructive?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      title={label}
      aria-label={label}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-card transition-colors hover:bg-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${
        destructive ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground"
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

interface VideoFormPayload {
  lessonId?: string;
  titleAr: string;
  description?: string;
  type: "VIDEO" | "EXTERNAL_VIDEO";
  videoUrl: string;
  isPublished?: boolean;
  durationSeconds?: number;
}

function VideoForm({
  video,
  onDone,
}: {
  video: VideoRow | null;
  onDone: (payload: VideoFormPayload | null) => void;
}) {
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState(video?.titleAr ?? "");
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState(video?.description ?? "");
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = React.useState(video?.videoUrl ?? "");
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [durationSeconds, setDurationSeconds] = React.useState<number | null>(
    video?.durationSeconds ?? null
  );
  const [probing, setProbing] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (!videoUrl.trim()) {
      setDurationSeconds(null);
      setProbing(false);
      return;
    }
    if (parseYouTubeUrl(videoUrl.trim())) {
      setDurationSeconds(null);
      setProbing(false);
      return;
    }
    setProbing(true);
    void probeVideoDuration(videoUrl.trim()).then((value) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      setDurationSeconds(value);
      setProbing(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [videoUrl]);

  function submit() {
    if (title.trim().length < 2) {
      setError("عنوان الفيديو مطلوب (حرفان على الأقل).");
      return;
    }
    if (videoUrl.trim().length === 0) {
      setError("أضف الفيديو أولًا — ارفع ملفًا أو أدخل رابطًا ثم اضغط تعيين الرابط.");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    onDone({
      lessonId: video?.id,
      titleAr: title.trim(),
      description: description.trim() || undefined,
      type: parseYouTubeUrl(videoUrl.trim()) ? "EXTERNAL_VIDEO" : "VIDEO",
      videoUrl: videoUrl.trim(),
      isPublished: video?.isPublished ?? true,
      durationSeconds: durationSeconds ?? undefined,
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-3">
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عنوان الفيديو *</span>
          <input
            value={title}
            onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={150}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">وصف مختصر</span>
          <input
            value={description}
            onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={500}
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3">
        <VideoInput
          value={videoUrl}
          onChange={(url) => setVideoUrl(url ?? "")}
          label="الفيديو — رفع مباشر أو رابط يوتيوب"
          hint="رابط يوتيوب (watch / youtu.be / shorts / embed) أو رفع مباشر — MP4/WEBM حتى 512MB"
          attachTo={video?.id ? { type: "lesson-media", lessonId: video.id } : undefined}
        />
      </div>

      {videoUrl.trim() && (
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
          {parseYouTubeUrl(videoUrl.trim())
            ? "رابط يوتيوب صحيح — تُقرأ مدته تلقائيًا من المشغّل لحساب نسبة الإتمام على الخادم."
            : probing
              ? "جارٍ قراءة مدة الفيديو…"
              : durationSeconds
                ? `مدة الفيديو: ${Math.floor(durationSeconds / 60)} دقيقة و${durationSeconds % 60} ثانية — تُحتسب على الخادم.`
                : "لم تُقرأ مدة الفيديو — سيُعتمد التقدير من مشغّل المعلم."}
        </p>
      )}

      {error && (
        <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
          <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={submit}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          {video ? "حفظ التعديلات" : "إضافة الفيديو"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onDone(null)}
          className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
        >
          إلغاء
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Unified training editor — ONE page for creating/editing a complete   */
/* professional training and publishing it.                             */
/*                                                                      */
/* NO SEQUENTIAL GATES: the page always renders on top of a persisted   */
/* DRAFT course (auto-created the moment the creation page opens), so   */
/* every section below is editable IMMEDIATELY and independently:       */
/*                                                                      */
/*   1. معلومات التدريب (العنوان، النوع، المجال، التصنيف، الوصف…)        */
/*   2. المدرب والمدرسة (مشتقة من الجلسة — للعرض فقط)                    */
/*   3. الجدول والروابط (التاريخ، المدة، رابط الاجتماع، يوتيوب)          */
/*   4. فيديوهات التدريب (رفع مباشر + ترتيب + حذف)                       */
/*   5. مرفقات التدريب (PDF/Word/صوت/صور…)                               */
/*   6. الاختبار النهائي (بناة الأسئلة المدمج + نسبة النجاح)             */
/*   7. قياس أثر التدريب (+ إضافة أداة قياس)                             */
/*   8. إسناد المعلمين                                                   */
/*   9. متابعة المعلمين والنتائج (التقدم + الاختبار + التصحيح + الشهادات) */
/*  10. شريط النشر (نشر التدريب) في أسفل الصفحة                          */
/*                                                                      */
/* Each section saves ITSELF through its own action and never touches    */
/* another section's fields — saving one never overwrites unsaved        */
/* edits elsewhere.                                                      */
/*                                                                      */
/* Every mutation re-verified server-side (requireSupervisorContext +   */
/* tenant fence); the form never sends a schoolId.                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: {
    id?: string;
    created?: boolean;
    enrolled?: number;
    courseId?: string;
    lessonsPublished?: number;
    assessmentPublished?: boolean;
    surveyPublished?: boolean;
  };
}

export const inputClass =
  "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

export function Feedback({ bad, text }: { bad: boolean; text: string }) {
  return (
    <p
      className={`flex items-start gap-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
        bad ? "text-destructive" : "text-success"
      }`}
      role={bad ? "alert" : "status"}
    >
      {bad ? (
        <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
      ) : (
        <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
      )}
      <span className="min-w-0">{text}</span>
    </p>
  );
}

export function FieldError({ message }: { message?: string }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return (
    <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-destructive">
      {message}
    </span>
  );
}

export function SectionCard({
  icon,
  title,
  description,
  optional,
  anchorId,
  children,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  optional?: boolean;
  /** Optional DOM id so OTHER pages can deep-link straight into this
   *  section (Academy cards link #training-info to jump directly to
   *  the editable info form). scroll-mt keeps the anchored heading
   *  clear of the sticky viewport top on arrival. */
  anchorId?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <section
      id={anchorId}
      className="scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border bg-card"
    >
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b px-4 py-3">
        <span className="mt-0.5 flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-600/10 text-brand-600">
          {icon}
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2 className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm font-black text-foreground">
            {title}
            {optional && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                اختياري
              </span>
            )}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            {description}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="p-4">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

function statusMeta(status: string): { label: string; className: string } {
  if (status === "PUBLISHED") {
    return { label: "منشور لمعلمي المدرسة", className: "text-success" };
  }
  if (status === "ARCHIVED") {
    return { label: "مؤرشف", className: "text-muted-foreground" };
  }
  return { label: "مسودة", className: "text-amber-600" };
}

/* ----------------------------- Editor ------------------------------ */

export function UnifiedTrainingEditor({
  workspace,
  progress,
}: {
  /** Always backed by a persisted DRAFT course — no locked state. */
  workspace: TrainingWorkspace;
  /** Per-teacher participation/results read model (loaded server-side). */
  progress?: SupervisorTrainingProgress | null;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const courseId = workspace.course.id;
  const status = workspace.course.status;

  const [metaPending, setMetaPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [metaFeedback, setMetaFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [metaErrors, setMetaErrors] = React.useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  const course = workspace.course;

  async function handleMetaSave(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (metaPending) return;
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const data = new FormData(form);
    setMetaPending(true);
    setMetaFeedback(null);
    setMetaErrors({});

    const scheduledRaw = String(data.get("scheduledAt") ?? "").trim();
    const result = (await saveSupervisorTrainingAction({
      courseId,
      titleAr: String(data.get("titleAr") ?? ""),
      titleEn: String(data.get("titleEn") ?? "") || undefined,
      descriptionAr: String(data.get("descriptionAr") ?? ""),
      descriptionEn: String(data.get("descriptionEn") ?? "") || undefined,
      category: String(data.get("category") ?? ""),
      subcategory: String(data.get("subcategory") ?? "") || undefined,
      trainingType: String(data.get("trainingType") ?? "") || undefined,
      level: String(data.get("level") ?? "") || undefined,
      estimatedHours: data.get("estimatedHours")
        ? Number(data.get("estimatedHours"))
        : undefined,
      scheduledAt: scheduledRaw || undefined,
      meetingUrl: String(data.get("meetingUrl") ?? "").trim() || undefined,
      youtubeUrl: String(data.get("youtubeUrl") ?? "").trim() || undefined,
      supervisorInstructionsAr:
        String(data.get("supervisorInstructionsAr") ?? "").trim() || undefined,
    })) as ActionResult;

    setMetaPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setMetaErrors(result.fieldErrors ?? {});
      setMetaFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر حفظ بيانات التدريب." });
      return;
    }

    // The course already exists (draft-first) — this is a pure update of
    // the meta section only; no other section is touched by this action.
    setMetaFeedback({
      bad: false,
      text: result.data?.created
        ? "تم إنشاء التدريب كمسودة — أكمل باقي الأقسام ثم انشره."
        : "تم حفظ بيانات التدريب.",
    });
    router.refresh();
  }

  const trainingType = course.trainingType ?? "";
  const isLiveType = trainingType === "" || trainingType === "VIRTUAL_LIVE";
  // Must match SUPERVISOR_DRAFT_TITLE in lib/supervision/training.ts
  // (kept as a literal here — server modules cannot cross the RSC
  // boundary into this client component).
  const isPlaceholderTitle = course.titleAr === "تدريب بدون عنوان";

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl space-y-5">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-4">
        <Link
          href="/supervision/training"
          className="text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 hover:underline"
        >
          ← إدارة التدريب
        </Link>
        <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="text-xl font-black text-foreground">
              {isPlaceholderTitle ? "إنشاء تدريب احترافي جديد" : course.titleAr}
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              كل الأقسام متاحة فورًا وفي أي ترتيب — لكل قسم زر حفظ خاص به،
              وحفظ قسم لا يمس تعديلات قسم آخر. عند الجاهزية اضغط «نشر
              التدريب» في أسفل الصفحة.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            <span className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold ${statusMeta(status).className}`}>
              {statusMeta(status).label}
            </span>
            {/* Destructive delete — separate from the edit page itself;
                opens the DELETE-word confirmation dialog first. */}
            <DeleteTrainingButton
              courseId={courseId}
              courseTitle={isPlaceholderTitle ? "تدريب بدون عنوان" : course.titleAr}
              lessonsCount={countLessons(workspace)}
              size="page"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* 1+2+3 — training info, trainer/school, schedule & links */}
      <SectionCard
        anchorId="training-info"
        icon={<Save className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        title="معلومات التدريب"
        description="البيانات الأساسية والتصنيف والجدول والروابط ورسالتك للمعلمين — تُحفظ معًا."
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleMetaSave} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
          <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                عنوان التدريب *
              </span>
              <input
                name="titleAr"
                defaultValue={course?.titleAr ?? ""}
                className={inputClass}
                maxLength={150}
                required
              />
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.titleAr} />
            </label>
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                العنوان بالإنجليزية (اختياري)
              </span>
              <input
                name="titleEn"
                defaultValue={course?.titleEn ?? ""}
                className={inputClass}
                maxLength={150}
                dir="ltr"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                نوع التدريب *
              </span>
              <select
                name="trainingType"
                defaultValue={course?.trainingType ?? "VIRTUAL_LIVE"}
                className={inputClass}
              >
                {TRAINING_TYPES.map((option) => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                «افتراضي مباشر» يُظهر رابط الاجتماع للمعلمين؛ المسجّل والحضوري لا
                يتطلبان رابط اجتماع.
              </span>
            </label>
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                المجال الرئيسي *
              </span>
              <select name="category" defaultValue={course?.category ?? ""} className={inputClass} required>
                <option value="" disabled>
                  — اختر المجال —
                </option>
                {course?.category &&
                  !(TRAINING_DOMAINS as readonly string[]).includes(course.category) && (
                    <option value={course.category}>{course.category} (تصنيف حالي)</option>
                  )}
                {TRAINING_DOMAINS.map((domain) => (
                  <option key={domain} value={domain}>
                    {domain}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.category} />
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                التصنيف الفرعي
              </span>
              <select
                name="subcategory"
                defaultValue={course?.subcategory ?? "عام"}
                className={inputClass}
              >
                {TRAINING_SUBCATEGORIES.map((subcategory) => (
                  <option key={subcategory} value={subcategory}>
                    {subcategory}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.subcategory} />
            </label>
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                المستوى
              </span>
              <select name="level" defaultValue={course?.level ?? ""} className={inputClass}>
                <option value="">— بدون —</option>
                <option value="BEGINNER">مبتدئ</option>
                <option value="INTERMEDIATE">متوسط</option>
                <option value="ADVANCED">متقدم</option>
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                الساعات التدريبية
              </span>
              <input
                name="estimatedHours"
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={200}
                defaultValue={course?.estimatedHours ?? ""}
                className={inputClass}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                تاريخ التدريب
              </span>
              <input
                name="scheduledAt"
                type="date"
                defaultValue={course?.scheduledAt ? course.scheduledAt.slice(0, 10) : ""}
                className={inputClass}
              />
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.scheduledAt} />
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                رابط الاجتماع (Zoom / Google Meet)
              </span>
              <input
                name="meetingUrl"
                type="url"
                dir="ltr"
                defaultValue={course?.meetingUrl ?? ""}
                placeholder="https://zoom.us/j/…"
                className={inputClass}
              />
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.meetingUrl} />
            </label>
            <label className="block">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                رابط يوتيوب (اختياري)
              </span>
              <input
                name="youtubeUrl"
                type="url"
                dir="ltr"
                defaultValue={course?.youtubeUrl ?? ""}
                placeholder="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…"
                className={inputClass}
              />
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.youtubeUrl} />
            </label>

            <label className="block md:col-span-2">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                وصف التدريب *
              </span>
              <textarea
                name="descriptionAr"
                rows={3}
                defaultValue={course?.descriptionAr ?? ""}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600"
                maxLength={4000}
                required
              />
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.descriptionAr} />
            </label>
            <label className="block md:col-span-2">
              <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                رسالة المشرف وتعليماته للمعلمين
              </span>
              <textarea
                name="supervisorInstructionsAr"
                rows={2}
                defaultValue={course?.supervisorInstructionsAr ?? ""}
                placeholder="مثال: يرجى مشاهدة جميع الفيديوهات بالكامل قبل الاختبار، وتحميل المرفقات ومراجعتها."
                className="w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600"
                maxLength={4000}
              />
              <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                تظهر للمعلمين في أعلى صفحة التدريب.
              </span>
              <FieldError message={metaErrors.supervisorInstructionsAr} />
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Trainer + school — derived from the session, read-only */}
          <div className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/20 p-3 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <UserRound className="size-4 shrink-0 text-brand-600" aria-hidden="true" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">المدرب / المشرف</p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                  {course?.instructorName ?? "حسابك الحالي (تُضبط تلقائيًا بعد الحفظ)"}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Building2 className="size-4 shrink-0 text-brand-600" aria-hidden="true" />
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">المدرسة</p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                  {course?.schoolName ?? "مدرستك (تُشتق من حسابك تلقائيًا)"}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={metaPending}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {metaPending ? (
                <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <Save className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              حفظ بيانات التدريب
            </button>
            {metaFeedback && <Feedback {...metaFeedback} />}
          </div>
        </form>
      </SectionCard>

      {/* 4 — training videos (available immediately — draft-first) */}
      <TrainingVideosSection courseId={courseId} workspace={workspace} />

      {/* 5 — training attachments (available immediately) */}
      <TrainingAttachmentsSection courseId={courseId} workspace={workspace} />

      {/* 6 — final assessment (available immediately) */}
      <TrainingAssessmentSection courseId={courseId} workspace={workspace} />

      {/* 7 — impact measurement (available immediately) */}
      <TrainingImpactSection courseId={courseId} workspace={workspace} />

      {/* 8 — teacher assignment */}
      <TrainingEnrollmentSection workspace={workspace} />

      {/* 9 — teacher participation, exam results, essay grading,
           certificates and impact responses — all in one place. */}
      <TrainingProgressSection courseId={courseId} workspace={workspace} progress={progress ?? null} />

      {/* 10 — publish bar */}
      <PublishBar courseId={courseId} status={status} lessonsCount={countLessons(workspace)} />

      {isLiveType && course?.meetingUrl === null && status === "PUBLISHED" && (
        <p className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-amber-800">
          <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          التدريب من نوع «افتراضي مباشر» ولم تُضف رابط اجتماع بعد — أضف رابط
          Zoom أو Google Meet أعلاه ليصل المعلمون إلى الاجتماع.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function countLessons(workspace: TrainingWorkspace): number {
  return workspace.sections.reduce(
    (sum, section) => sum + section.lessons.length,
    0
  );
}

/* -------------------------- Attachments ---------------------------- */

function TrainingAttachmentsSection({
  courseId,
  workspace,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  workspace: TrainingWorkspace;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pendingId, setPendingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  async function removeAttachment(attachmentId: string) {
    if (!(await confirmDialog({ title: "حذف المرفق؟", description: "سيتم حذف هذا المرفق نهائيًا.", tone: "danger" }))) return;
    setPendingId(attachmentId);
    const result = await deleteSupervisorTrainingAttachmentAction(attachmentId);
    setPendingId(null);
    if (!result.ok) {
      window.alert(result.message);
      return;
    }
    router.refresh();
  }

  function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes >= 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
    return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} KB`;
  }

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon={<FileUp className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
      title="مرفقات التدريب"
      description="ملفات PDF وWord وExcel وPowerPoint وصوت وصور — يراها المعلمون قابلة للتنزيل بعد النشر."
      optional
    >
      {workspace.attachments.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-4 py-4 text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          لا مرفقات بعد — أضف أول ملف من أداة الرفع أدناه.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="mb-4 space-y-2">
          {workspace.attachments.map((attachment) => (
            <li
              key={attachment.id}
              className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 px-3 py-2"
            >
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                  {attachment.originalName}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                  {attachment.mimeType} · {formatBytes(attachment.sizeBytes)}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={pendingId === attachment.id}
                onClick={() => removeAttachment(attachment.id)}
                className="inline-flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-card text-destructive transition-colors hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-40"
                aria-label="حذف المرفق"
                title="حذف المرفق"
              >
                {pendingId === attachment.id ? (
                  <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <FileInput
        onChange={() => router.refresh()}
        attachTo={{ type: "course-attachment", courseId }}
        label="إضافة مرفق من جهازك"
        hint="PDF / Word / Excel / PowerPoint / MP3 وWAV / صور / نص — حتى 25 ميجابايت"
      />
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

/* -------------------------- Enrollment ----------------------------- */

function TrainingEnrollmentSection({ workspace }: { workspace: TrainingWorkspace }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<string[]>([]);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  const enrolledIds = new Set(workspace.enrollments.map((row) => row.userId));
  const available = workspace.teachers.filter((teacher) => !enrolledIds.has(teacher.id));
  const published = workspace.course.status === "PUBLISHED";

  async function assign() {
    if (pending || selected.length === 0) return;
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await enrollSupervisorTeachersAction(
      workspace.course.id,
      selected
    )) as ActionResult;
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر الإسناد." });
      return;
    }
    setSelected([]);
    setFeedback({
      bad: false,
      text: `تم إسناد التدريب إلى ${result.data?.enrolled ?? selected.length} معلمًا.`,
    });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon={<GraduationCap className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
      title="إسناد المعلمين"
      description={
        published
          ? "أسند التدريب لمعلميك المسندَين إليك — أو يسجلون بأنفسهم من الأكاديمية."
          : "انشر التدريب أولًا لتتمكن من إسناده إلى معلميك."
      }
    >
      {feedback && (
        <div className="mb-3">
          <Feedback {...feedback} />
        </div>
      )}

      {workspace.enrollments.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mb-3 max-h-40 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto">
          {workspace.enrollments.map((row) => (
            <li
              key={row.userId}
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/30 px-2.5 py-1.5"
            >
              <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-xs font-bold">{row.name}</span>
              {row.completedAt ? (
                <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-bold text-success">أتم التدريب ✓</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">مسجل</span>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {!published ? (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          الإسناد متاح بعد النشر — أكمل بناء التدريب ثم اضغط «نشر التدريب».
        </p>
      ) : available.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          كل معلميك المسندون مسجلون في هذا التدريب — أو لا يوجد معلمون مسندون بعد.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="max-h-40 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border p-2">
            {available.map((teacher) => (
              <label
                key={teacher.id}
                className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded px-1.5 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-muted/40"
              >
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={selected.includes(teacher.id)}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setSelected((current) =>
                      event.target.checked
                        ? [...current, teacher.id]
                        : current.filter((id) => id !== teacher.id)
                    )
                  }
                  className="size-3.5 accent-[var(--brand-600)]"
                />
                {teacher.name}
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={assign}
            disabled={pending || selected.length === 0}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {pending && <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
            إسناد ({selected.length})
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

/* -------------------------- Publish bar ---------------------------- */

function PublishBar({
  courseId,
  status,
  lessonsCount,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  status: string;
  lessonsCount: number;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  async function run(
    action: () => Promise<ActionResult>,
    confirmText: string | null,
    successText: string
  ) {
    if (
      confirmText &&
      !(await confirmDialog({ description: confirmText, tone: "brand" }))
    ) {
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = await action();
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذرت العملية." });
      return;
    }
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: successText });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <section
      id="publish"
      className="rounded-xl border-2 border-brand-600/40 bg-brand-600/5 px-4 py-4"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-foreground">
            <ClipboardCheck className="me-1.5 inline size-4 text-brand-600" aria-hidden="true" />
            نشر التدريب
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            يتحقق الخادم من المحتوى والاختبار وأداة القياس ثم ينشرها جميعًا معًا
            داخل معاملة واحدة — {lessonsCount} عنصر محتوى جاهز.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {status !== "PUBLISHED" && status !== "ARCHIVED" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending || lessonsCount === 0}
              onClick={() =>
                run(
                  () => publishSupervisorTrainingAction({ courseId }),
                  "النشر يجعل التدريب متاحًا لمعلمي المدرسة ويفتح الرحلة الإلزامية — متابعة؟",
                  "تم نشر التدريب بنجاح — أصبح متاحًا في قائمة معلمي المدرسة."
                )
              }
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {pending ? (
                <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <CloudUpload className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              نشر التدريب
            </button>
          )}
          {status === "PUBLISHED" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() =>
                run(
                  () => setSupervisorCourseStatusAction({ courseId, status: "DRAFT" }),
                  "إلغاء النشر يخفي التدريب عن المعلمين — متابعة؟",
                  "تم إلغاء النشر — التدريب عاد إلى مسودة."
                )
              }
              className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              إلغاء النشر
            </button>
          )}
          {status !== "ARCHIVED" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() =>
                run(
                  () => setSupervisorCourseStatusAction({ courseId, status: "ARCHIVED" }),
                  "أرشفة التدريب؟ يمكن إعادته من الأرشيف لاحقًا.",
                  "تم أرشفة التدريب."
                )
              }
              className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-destructive hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              أرشفة
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      {feedback && (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <Feedback {...feedback} />
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import * as React from "react";
import { ClipboardList, Loader2, Plus, TrendingUp, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

import {
  createSupervisorImpactSurveyAction,
  setSupervisorImpactSurveyStatusAction,
} from "@/app/actions/supervision-training";
import { confirmDialog, alertDialog } from "@/components/platform/confirm-dialog";import type { TrainingWorkspace } from "@/lib/supervision/training";

import { Feedback, SectionCard } from "./unified-editor";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Training Impact Measurement — the EXISTING survey system embedded in */
/* the unified page (Survey stage AFTER_TRAINING + SurveyQuestion).     */
/* Response types: Rating Scale (1–5), Yes/No, Multiple Choice, Text.   */
/* Teachers answer it ONLY after completing the journey (the server     */
/* unlocks it post-certificate) — same models, same results screens.    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface ActionResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  data?: { id?: string };
}

const inputClass =
  "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus:border-brand-600";

/** The four spec'd response types (the service supports more). */
const IMPACT_TYPES = [
  { value: "RATING", label: "مقياس تقييم (1–5)" },
  { value: "YES_NO", label: "نعم / لا" },
  { value: "SINGLE_CHOICE", label: "اختيار من متعدد" },
  { value: "LONG_TEXT", label: "إجابة نصية" },
];

interface DraftQuestion {
  textAr: string;
  type: string;
  required: boolean;
  options: string[];
}

function emptyQuestion(): DraftQuestion {
  return { textAr: "", type: "RATING", required: true, options: ["", ""] };
}

export function TrainingImpactSection({
  courseId,
  workspace,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  workspace: TrainingWorkspace;
}) {
  const survey = workspace.survey;
  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon={<TrendingUp className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
      title="قياس أثر التدريب"
      description="أداة قياس تُفتح للمعلم بعد اجتياز الاختبار والحصول على الشهادة — استجاباتها تُحفظ على مستوى المعلم والتدريب والمدرسة."
    >
      {survey ? (
        <ImpactSummary courseId={courseId} survey={survey} />
      ) : (
        <ImpactCreateForm courseId={courseId} />
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

function ImpactSummary({
  survey,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  survey: NonNullable<TrainingWorkspace["survey"]>;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);

  async function run(action: "PUBLISH" | "CLOSE" | "ARCHIVE", confirmText: string) {
    const approved = await confirmDialog({
      title:
        action === "PUBLISH"
          ? "نشر أداة قياس الأثر"
          : action === "CLOSE"
            ? "إغلاق أداة قياس الأثر"
            : "أرشفة أداة قياس الأثر",
      description: confirmText,
      tone: "brand",
    });
    if (!approved) return;
    setPending(true);
    const result = await setSupervisorImpactSurveyStatusAction({
      surveyId: survey.id,
      action,
    });
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      await alertDialog({
        title: "تعذّر تحديث حالة الأداة",
        description: result.message ?? "حدث خطأ غير متوقع — حاول مرة أخرى.",
        tone: "danger",
      });
      return;
    }
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-muted/20 px-3 py-2.5">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-foreground">{survey.titleAr}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            {survey.questionsCount} سؤالًا ·{" "}
            {survey.status === "PUBLISHED"
              ? "منشورة — تظهر للمعلمين بعد إتمام الرحلة"
              : survey.status === "DRAFT"
                ? "مسودة — تُنشر تلقائيًا مع «نشر التدريب»"
                : survey.status === "CLOSED"
                  ? "مغلقة للاستجابات الجديدة"
                  : survey.status}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {survey.status === "DRAFT" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => run("PUBLISH", "نشر الأداة يفتحها لمعلمي التدريب — متابعة؟")}
              className="rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              نشر
            </button>
          )}
          {survey.status === "PUBLISHED" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => run("CLOSE", "إغلاق الأداة يمنع استجابات جديدة — متابعة؟")}
              className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              إغلاق
            </button>
          )}
          {survey.status !== "PUBLISHED" && survey.status !== "DRAFT" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => run("ARCHIVE", "أرشفة الأداة؟ تُخفى نهائيًا.")}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border bg-card px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-destructive hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              <Trash2 className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
              أرشفة
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <Link
        href="/supervision/impact"
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:bg-accent"
      >
        <ClipboardList className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        عرض نتائج قياس الأثر
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

function ImpactCreateForm({ courseId }: { courseId: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState("");
  const [purpose, setPurpose] = React.useState("");
  const [questions, setQuestions] = React.useState<DraftQuestion[]>([emptyQuestion()]);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);

  function updateQuestion(index: number, patch: Partial<DraftQuestion>) {
    setQuestions((current) =>
      current.map((question, position) =>
        position === index ? { ...question, ...patch } : question
      )
    );
  }

  async function submit() {
    if (pending) return;
    if (title.trim().length < 3) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "عنوان أداة القياس مطلوب." });
      return;
    }
    const cleanedQuestions = questions.map((question) => ({
      textAr: question.textAr.trim(),
      type: question.type,
      required: question.required,
      options:
        question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE"
          ? question.options.map((option) => option.trim()).filter(Boolean)
          : undefined,
    }));
    if (cleanedQuestions.some((question) => question.textAr.length < 3)) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: "أكمل نص كل سؤال (3 أحرف على الأقل)." });
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = (await createSupervisorImpactSurveyAction({
      courseId,
      titleAr: title.trim(),
      purposeAr: purpose.trim() || undefined,
      questions: cleanedQuestions,
    })) as ActionResult;
    setPending(false);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setFeedback({ bad: true, text: result.message ?? "تعذر إنشاء أداة القياس." });
      return;
    }
    setOpen(false);
    setFeedback({ bad: false, text: "تم إنشاء أداة قياس الأثر — تُنشر مع «نشر التدريب»." });
    router.refresh();
  }

  if (!open) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700"
      >
        <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        إضافة أداة قياس أثر
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {feedback && <Feedback {...feedback} />}

      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">عنوان الأداة *</span>
          <input
            value={title}
            onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={150}
            placeholder="مثال: أثر التدريب على الممارسات الصفية"
          />
        </label>
        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-xs font-bold">الغرض (يظهر للمعلم)</span>
          <input
            value={purpose}
            onChange={(event) => setPurpose(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
            maxLength={500}
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2">
        <span className="block text-xs font-bold">الأسئلة *</span>
        {questions.map((question, index) => (
          <div key={index} className="rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-[1fr_180px_auto]">
              <input
                value={question.textAr}
                onChange={(event) => updateQuestion(index, { textAr: event.target.value })}
                placeholder={`نص السؤال ${index + 1}`}
                className={inputClass}
                maxLength={300}
              />
              <select
                value={question.type}
                onChange={(event) => updateQuestion(index, { type: event.target.value })}
                className={inputClass}
              >
                {IMPACT_TYPES.map((option) => (
                  <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                    {option.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={question.required}
                    onChange={(event) => updateQuestion(index, { required: event.target.checked })}
                    className="size-3.5 accent-[var(--brand-600)]"
                  />
                  إجباري
                </label>
                {questions.length > 1 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setQuestions((current) => current.filter((_, position) => position !== index))
                    }
                    className="text-destructive"
                    aria-label="حذف السؤال"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" && (
              <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                {question.options.map((option, optionIndex) => (
                  <input
                    key={optionIndex}
                    value={option}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      updateQuestion(index, {
                        options: question.options.map((value, position) =>
                          position === optionIndex ? event.target.value : value
                        ),
                      })
                    }
                    placeholder={`الخيار ${optionIndex + 1}`}
                    className={inputClass}
                    maxLength={120}
                  />
                ))}
                {question.options.length < 10 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => updateQuestion(index, { options: [...question.options, ""] })}
                    className="text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 hover:underline"
                  >
                    + إضافة خيار
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setQuestions((current) => [...current, emptyQuestion()])}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <Plus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          إضافة سؤال
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => void submit()}
          disabled={pending}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
          حفظ الأداة
        </button>
        <button

          className="rounded-lg border bg-card px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
        >
          إلغاء
