"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { BarChart3, ClipboardCheck, GraduationCap, TrendingUp } from "lucide-react";

import type {
  SupervisorTrainingProgress,
  TrainingWorkspace,
} from "@/lib/supervision/training";

import { SectionCard } from "./unified-editor";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Teacher participation & results — ONE section inside the training    */
/* workspace. Read-only aggregation over EXISTING models:               */
/*   • lesson progress  → CourseLessonProgress                          */
/*   • exam results     → AssessmentAttempt (best finalized + reviews)  */
/*   • essay grading    → NEEDS_REVIEW attempts → the existing review   */
/*     UI at /assessments/manage/[assessmentId]                         */
/*   • certificates     → Certificate (auto or manually issued)         */
/*   • impact           → SurveyResponse (identifiable submissions)     */
/* Nothing here mutates data — every row links to the existing page     */
/* that owns the mutation, so grading/issuing flows stay untouched.     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar", {
  day: "numeric",
  month: "short",
  year: "numeric",
});

function shortDate(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  const value = new Date(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? "—" : dateFormatter.format(value);
}

function Chip({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | number }) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-foreground">
      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{label}:</span>
      {value}
    </span>
  );
}

function ExamCell({
  row,
}: {
  row: SupervisorTrainingProgress["rows"][number];
}) {
  if (!row.exam) {
    return <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>;
  }
  const { bestPercentage, bestPassed, attemptsCount, needsReviewCount } = row.exam;
  if (bestPercentage === null && attemptsCount === 0 && needsReviewCount === 0) {
    return <span className="text-muted-foreground">لم يتقدم بعد</span>;
  }
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
      {bestPercentage !== null ? (
        <span
          className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
            bestPassed
              ? "bg-success-soft text-success"
              : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
          }`}
        >
          {bestPercentage}%
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {attemptsCount > 0 && (
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
          {attemptsCount} {attemptsCount === 1 ? "محاولة" : "محاولات"}
        </span>
      )}
      {needsReviewCount > 0 && (
        <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700">
          مقالي بانتظار التصحيح
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

export function TrainingProgressSection({
  courseId,
  workspace,
  progress,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  workspace: TrainingWorkspace;
  progress: SupervisorTrainingProgress | null;
}) {
  const rows = progress?.rows ?? [];
  const enrolledCount = workspace.enrollments.length;
  const completedCount = rows.filter((row) => row.completedAt).length;
  const pendingReviews = rows.reduce(
    (sum, row) => sum + (row.exam?.needsReviewCount ?? 0),
    0
  );
  const certificatesCount = rows.filter(
    (row) => row.certificate && row.certificate.status === "ISSUED"
  ).length;
  const impactCount = progress?.surveyResponsesCount ?? 0;

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon={<BarChart3 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
      title="متابعة المعلمين والنتائج"
      description="مشاركة المعلمين وتقدمهم، نتائج الاختبار والدرجات، التصحيح اليدوي للمقالي، الشهادات، واستجابات قياس الأثر — كل ذلك من مكان واحد."
    >
      {enrolledCount === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-muted/30 px-4 py-4 text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          لا يوجد معلمون مسجلون بعد — أسند التدريب من القسم أعلاه أو سيجدونه
          في الأكاديمية بعد النشر.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Chip label="مسجلون" value={enrolledCount} />
            <Chip label="أتمّوا" value={completedCount} />
            {progress?.assessmentId && (
              <Chip label="بانتظار تصحيح مقالي" value={pendingReviews} />
            )}
            <Chip label="شهادات صادرة" value={certificatesCount} />
            {progress?.surveyId && (
              <Chip label="استجابات قياس الأثر" value={impactCount} />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] text-right text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold">المعلم</th>
                  <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold">إنجاز الدروس</th>
                  <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold">الإكمال</th>
                  {progress?.assessmentId && (
                    <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold">الاختبار</th>
                  )}
                  <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold">الشهادة</th>
                  {progress?.surveyId && (
                    <th className="px-2 py-2 font-bold">قياس الأثر</th>
                  )}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((row) => {
                  const done = row.lessonsDone;
                  const total = progress?.lessonsTotal ?? 0;
                  const percent =
                    total > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((done / total) * 100)) : 0;
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.userId} className="border-b last:border-b-0">
                      <td className="px-2 py-2.5">
                        <p className="font-bold text-foreground">{row.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                          مسجل {shortDate(row.enrolledAt)}
                        </p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-2 py-2.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="h-1.5 w-16 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                            <div
                              className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand-600"
                              style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                            {done}/{total}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-2 py-2.5">
                        {row.completedAt ? (
                          <span className="rounded-full bg-success-soft px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-success">
                            أتمّ التدريب
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                            جارٍ التعلّم
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      {progress?.assessmentId && (
                        <td className="px-2 py-2.5">
                          <ExamCell row={row} />
                        </td>
                      )}
                      <td className="px-2 py-2.5">
                        {row.certificate ? (
                          <Link
                            href={`/certificates/${row.certificate.id}`}
                            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${
                              row.certificate.status === "ISSUED"
                                ? "bg-success-soft text-success hover:underline"
                                : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:underline"
                            }`}
                            title={row.certificate.certificateNumber}
                          >
                            <GraduationCap className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
                            {row.certificate.status === "ISSUED"
                              ? "صادرة"
                              : "ملغاة"}
                          </Link>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      {progress?.surveyId && (
                        <td className="px-2 py-2.5">
                          {row.impactSubmittedAt ? (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-success">
                              استجاب ✓ {shortDate(row.impactSubmittedAt)}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      )}
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Actionable links to the EXISTING management screens */}
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {progress?.assessmentId && (
              <Link
                href={`/assessments/manage/${progress.assessmentId}`}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
              >
                <ClipboardCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                نتائج الاختبار وتصحيح المقالي
              </Link>
            )}
            {progress?.surveyId && (
              <Link
                href={`/surveys/${progress.surveyId}/results`}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-brand-600 transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
              >
                <TrendingUp className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                نتائج قياس الأثر
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>

          {progress?.surveyId && progress.surveyAnonymous && (
            <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              أداة قياس الأثر مجهولة الهوية — لا يمكن ربط كل استجابة بمعلم
              بعينه؛ العدد الإجمالي ({progress.surveyResponsesCount}) والنتائج
              المجمعة متاحة من زر «نتائج قياس الأثر» أعلاه.
            </p>

    </SectionCard>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — survey edit page (DRAFT only, author or office manager).
 * Pre-fills the question builder from the persisted definition.
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { getSurveyManageView, listSurveyFormOptions } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import { AccessDenied, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import SurveyForm, { type BuilderQuestion, type SurveyFormDefinition } from "@/app/surveys/survey-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null }): SurveyActor | null {
  if (user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

export default async function EditSurveyPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="تعديل الاستبيانات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير والمشرفين التربويين فقط." />;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const [viewResult, options] = await Promise.all([
    getSurveyManageView(ctx, id),
    listSurveyFormOptions(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!viewResult.ok) {
    if (viewResult.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return <AccessDenied hint={viewResult.message} />;
  }
  if (!options.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={options.message} />;

  const { survey, questions, permissions } = viewResult.data;
  if (!permissions.canEdit) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="لا يمكن تعديل الاستبيان — التعديل متاح للمسودات فقط." />;
  }

  const initial: SurveyFormDefinition = {
    titleAr: survey.titleAr,
    titleEn: survey.titleEn,
    descriptionAr: survey.descriptionAr,
    descriptionEn: null,
    purposeAr: survey.purposeAr,
    instructionsAr: survey.instructionsAr,
    stage: survey.stage,
    linkPairCode: survey.linkPairCode,
    programId: survey.programId,
    courseId: survey.courseId,
    lessonId: survey.lessonId,
    assignmentId: survey.assignmentId,
    certificateId: survey.certificateId,
    audienceMode: survey.audienceModeRaw,
    targetBranchIds: survey.targetBranchIds,
    targetTeacherIds: survey.targetTeacherIds,
    anonymous: survey.anonymous,
    allowMultipleResponses: survey.allowMultipleResponses,
    linkResponsesEnabled: survey.linkResponsesEnabled,
    opensAt: survey.opensAtISO,
    closesAt: survey.closesAtISO,
    questions: questions.map<BuilderQuestion>((question) => ({
      clientId: `q-${question.id.slice(-8)}`,
      textAr: question.textAr,
      helpTextAr: question.helpTextAr ?? "",
      type: question.type,
      required: question.required,
      options: question.options.length > 0 ? question.options : ["", ""],
      minScore: question.minScore === null ? "1" : String(question.minScore),
      maxScore: question.maxScore === null ? "5" : String(question.maxScore),
    })),
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="تعديل الاستبيان"
        subtitle="التعديل متاح قبل النشر فقط — حمايةً لسلامة الردود بعد النشر"
        actions={
          <Link href={`/surveys/${id}`} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
            رجوع للتفاصيل
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <SurveyForm mode="edit" surveyId={id} initial={initial} options={options.data} />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — "تحليل النتائج": aggregates computed from persisted
 * responses with explicit denominators, per-question distributions,

 * response list. Anonymous small groups are privacy-suppressed.
 */
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { getStageComparison, getSurveyResults } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  StatTile,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { DistributionBar, SurveyStageBadge, SurveyStatusBadge } from "@/app/surveys/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null }): SurveyActor | null {
  if (
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"

export default async function SurveyResultsPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="تحليل النتائج متاح للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية فقط." />;
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const [results, comparison] = await Promise.all([
    getSurveyResults(ctx, id),
    getStageComparison(ctx, id),
  ]);
  if (!results.ok) {
    if (results.code === "NOT_FOUND") notFound();
    return <AccessDenied hint={results.message} />;
  }
  const { survey, eligibleCount, submittedCount, draftCount, responseRatePercent, privacySuppressed, distributions, responses, canSeeIndividualResponses } = results.data;
  const stageComparison = comparison.ok ? comparison.data : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="تحليل النتائج"
        subtitle={survey.titleAr}
        actions={
          <Link href={`/surveys/${id}`} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
            رجوع للاستبيان
          </Link>
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <SurveyStatusBadge status={survey.status} />
        <SurveyStageBadge stage={survey.stage} />
        {survey.anonymous ? (
          <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600">مجهول الهوية</span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatTile
          label="نسبة الاستجابة"
          value={responseRatePercent === null ? "—" : `${responseRatePercent}%`}
          tone="brand"
        />
        <StatTile label="الردود المرسلة" value={submittedCount} tone="success" />
        <StatTile label="المستجيبون المؤهلون (المقام)" value={eligibleCount} tone="warning" />
        <StatTile label="حفظ مؤقت غير مُرسل" value={draftCount} />
      </div>
      <p className="mb-6 text-xs text-slate-500">
        المقام: عدد المعلمين المؤهلين فعليًا (الجمهور المستهدف بعد تطبيق نطاق المؤلف). النسبة = الردود المرسلة ÷ المستجيبون المؤهلون. الحقول غير المُجابة تُستثنى من متوسطاتها فقط ولا تُحسب رفضًا.
      </p>

      {privacySuppressed ? (
        <div className="mb-6 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-800">
          عدد الردود ({submittedCount}) أقل من الحد المطلوب للعرض ({3}) في استبيان مجهول الهوية — إخفاء التوزيعات والنصوص حمايةً لخصوصية المستجيبين.
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* --------------------------------------------- Stage comparison */}
      {stageComparison ? (
        <Card>
          <h2 className="mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">مقارنة قبل/بعد التدريب</h2>
          <p className="mb-4 text-xs text-slate-500">
            {stageComparison.note} — المتوسطات لمقياس (التقييم/ليكرت) للمستجيبين الذين أجابوا على الاستبيانين. «التغير المُلاحظ» = فرق متوسطين فقط، ولا يُعد إثباتًا لعلاقة سببية.
          </p>
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <StatTile label="مستجيبون مزدوجون (المقام)" value={stageComparison.pairedCount} tone="brand" />
            <StatTile label="متوسط ما قبل التدريب" value={stageComparison.preAverage ?? "—"} />
            <StatTile label="متوسط ما بعد التدريب" value={stageComparison.afterAverage ?? "—"} />
            <StatTile
              label="التغير المُلاحظ"
              value={stageComparison.observedDelta === null ? "—" : `${stageComparison.observedDelta > 0 ? "+" : ""}${stageComparison.observedDelta}`}
              tone={stageComparison.observedDelta !== null && stageComparison.observedDelta > 0 ? "success" : "warning"}
            />
          </div>
          {stageComparison.privacySuppressed ? (
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-800">
              عدد الأزواج المجهولة أقل من الحد الآمن — تم إخفاء المتوسطات حمايةً للخصوصية.
            </div>
          ) : stageComparison.perQuestion.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {stageComparison.perQuestion.map((question) => (
                <div key={question.textAr} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 p-3 text-sm">
                  <p className="font-medium text-slate-700">{question.textAr}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500" dir="ltr">
                    {question.preAverage} → {question.afterAverage} (Δ {question.delta !== null && question.delta > 0 ? "+" : ""}{question.delta})
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">لا توجد أسئلة مقياس متطابقة النص بين الاستبيانين بعد.</p>
          )}
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      {/* --------------------------------------------- Per-question */}
      <div className="mt-6 space-y-6">
        {distributions.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState title="لا توجد أسئلة في هذا الاستبيان" />
        ) : null}
        {distributions.map((question, index) => (
          <Card key={question.questionId}>
            <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
                {index + 1}. {question.textAr}
              </h3>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                أجاب {question.answeredCount} من {submittedCount}
                {question.skippedCount > 0 ? ` — تجاوز ${question.skippedCount}` : ""}
              </span>
            </div>

            {privacySuppressed ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">العرض مُخفي لحماية الخصوصية (عدد ردود قليل).</p>
            ) : question.numericDistribution.length > 0 ? (
              <>
                {question.average !== null ? (
                  <p className="mb-3 text-xs font-semibold text-[#1D5BD6]">
                    المتوسط: {question.average} {question.type === "LIKERT" ? "من 5" : ""}
                  </p>
                ) : null}
                {question.numericDistribution.map((item) => (
                  <DistributionBar
                    key={item.value}
                    label={item.label ?? String(item.value)}
                    count={item.count}
                    total={question.answeredCount}
                    highlight
                  />
                ))}
              </>
            ) : question.optionCounts.length > 0 ? (
              question.optionCounts.map((item) => (
                <DistributionBar key={item.option} label={item.option} count={item.count} total={question.answeredCount} highlight />

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 9 — publish/close/archive buttons for a survey (author or
 * office manager; the server re-checks role + transition validity).
 */
import { useActionState } from "react";

import { transitionSurveyAction, type SurveyActionState } from "@/app/actions/surveys";

export default function SurveyStatusActions({
  surveyId,
  status,
}: {
  surveyId: string;
  status: string;
}) {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<SurveyActionState, FormData>(
    transitionSurveyAction,
    { ok: false }
  );

  if (state.ok) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-emerald-700">
        تم تنفيذ الإجراء بنجاح — حدّث الصفحة لرؤية الحالة الجديدة.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-3">
      <input type="hidden" name="surveyId" value={surveyId} />
      {state.message ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">
          {state.message}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {status === "DRAFT" ? (
          <>
            <button
              type="submit"
              name="action"
              value="PUBLISH"
              disabled={pending}
              className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              نشر الاستبيان
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              name="action"
              value="ARCHIVE"
              disabled={pending}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              أرشفة
            </button>
          </>
        ) : null}
        {status === "PUBLISHED" ? (
          <button
            type="submit"
            name="action"
            value="CLOSE"
            disabled={pending}
            className="rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-100 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            إغلاق الاستجابة
          </button>
        ) : null}
        {status === "CLOSED" ? (
          <button
            type="submit"
            name="action"
            value="ARCHIVE"
            disabled={pending}
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            أرشفة
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { listSurveyFormOptions } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import { AccessDenied, PageHeader } from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import SurveyForm, { type SurveyFormDefinition } from "@/app/surveys/survey-form";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null }): SurveyActor | null {
  if (user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

const EMPTY_DEFINITION: SurveyFormDefinition = {
  titleAr: "",
  titleEn: null,
  descriptionAr: null,
  descriptionEn: null,
  purposeAr: null,
  instructionsAr: null,
  stage: null,
  linkPairCode: null,
  programId: null,
  courseId: null,
  lessonId: null,
  assignmentId: null,
  certificateId: null,
  audienceMode: "ALL_TEACHERS",
  targetBranchIds: [],
  targetTeacherIds: [],
  anonymous: false,
  allowMultipleResponses: false,
  linkResponsesEnabled: false,
  opensAt: null,
  closesAt: null,
  questions: [],
};

export default async function NewSurveyPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="إنشاء الاستبيانات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير والمشرفين التربويين فقط." />;
  }
  const options = await listSurveyFormOptions(ctx);
  if (!options.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={options.message} />;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="استبيان جديد"
        subtitle="صمّم أسئلة الاستبيان وحدد جمهوره وإعدادات الردود — يُحفظ أولًا كمسودة"
        actions={
          <Link href="/surveys" className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">
            رجوع للقائمة
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <SurveyForm mode="create" initial={EMPTY_DEFINITION} options={options.data} />
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — "إدارة الاستبيانات": filterable list with real metrics.
 * Server component; every row is tenant-scoped by the service (managers
 * see their school, supervisors see their OWN surveys, deputies get a
 * read-only view of their granted school).
 */
import Link from "next/link";

import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import type { SurveyActor } from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { getSurveyMetrics, listSurveysForManage } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import {
  AccessDenied,
  Card,
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  StatTile,
  formatDate,
} from "@/app/assignments/ui";
import { AnonymousBadge, SurveyStageBadge, SurveyStatusBadge } from "@/app/surveys/ui";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function actorFrom(user: {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}): SurveyActor | null {
  if (
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
  ) {
    return { id: user.id, role: user.role, schoolId: user.schoolId };
  }
  return null;
}

export default async function SurveysManagePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ q?: string; status?: string; page?: string }>;
}) {
  const user = await getCurrentUser();
  if (!user) {
    return <AccessDenied hint="الجلسة منتهية — سجّل الدخول من جديد." />;
  }
  const ctx = actorFrom(user);
  if (!ctx || ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return (
      <AccessDenied hint="إدارة الاستبيانات متاحة للأدوار المدرسية — حساب المنصة يطلع على الإحصاءات العامة من لوحة قياس الأثر." />
    );
  }

  const params = await searchParams;
  const page = Number(params.page ?? "1") || 1;
  const [listResult, metricsResult] = await Promise.all([
    listSurveysForManage(ctx, { q: params.q, status: params.status, page }),
    getSurveyMetrics(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!listResult.ok) return <AccessDenied hint={listResult.message} />;
  const { rows, total, pageCount, page: currentPage } = listResult.data;
  const metrics = metricsResult.ok ? metricsResult.data : null;

  const isDeputy = ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY";

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="إدارة الاستبيانات"
        subtitle={
          isDeputy
            ? "عرض للقراءة فقط — استبيانات المدرسة ضمن نطاق التفويض"
            : ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
              ? "استبياناتك الخاصة ضمن نطاق إشرافك"
              : "إنشاء استبيانات الأثر ومتابعة التطبيق وإدارة دورة حياتها"
        }
        actions={
          isDeputy ? null : (
            <Link
              href="/surveys/new"
              className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
            >
              + استبيان جديد
            </Link>
          )
        }
      />

      {metrics ? (
        <div className="mb-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <StatTile label="إجمالي الاستبيانات" value={metrics.totalSurveys} tone="brand" />
          <StatTile label="منشورة حاليًا" value={metrics.openSurveys} tone="success" />
          <StatTile label="ردود مستلمة" value={metrics.submittedResponses} />
          <StatTile
            label="متوسط نسبة الاستجابة"
            value={metrics.averageResponseRatePercent === null ? "—" : `${metrics.averageResponseRatePercent}%`}
            tone="warning"
          />
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <Card>
        <form className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3" method="get">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="q">بحث</label>
            <input
              id="q"
              name="q"
              defaultValue={params.q ?? ""}
              placeholder="عنوان الاستبيان…"
              className="w-72 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500" htmlFor="status">الحالة</label>
            <select
              id="status"
              name="status"
              defaultValue={params.status ?? ""}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6]"
            >
              <option value="">الكل</option>
              <option value="DRAFT">مسودة</option>
              <option value="PUBLISHED">منشور</option>
              <option value="CLOSED">مغلق</option>
              <option value="ARCHIVED">مؤرشف</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"
          >
            تصفية
          </button>
        </form>

        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="لا توجد استبيانات مطابقة"
            hint="ابدأ بإنشاء استبيان جديد لقياس أثر البرامج التدريبية أو متابعة التطبيق الصفي."
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-right text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">العنوان</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المرحلة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الجمهور</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الأسئلة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الردود</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">الحالة</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">المؤلف</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium">النشر</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 font-medium"></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/60">
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      <p className="max-w-64 font-medium text-slate-800">{row.titleAr}</p>
                      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        <AnonymousBadge anonymous={row.anonymous} />
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3"><SurveyStageBadge stage={row.stage} /></td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-600">{row.audienceLabel}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.questionsCount}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.submittedCount}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3"><SurveyStatusBadge status={row.status} /></td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{row.ownerName}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{formatDate(row.publishedAt)}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-3">
                      <Link
                        href={`/surveys/${row.id}`}
                        className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline"
                      >
                        {isDeputy ? "النتائج" : "التفاصيل"}
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {pageCount > 1 ? (
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
            <span>الصفحة {currentPage} من {pageCount} — {total} استبيان</span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {currentPage > 1 ? (
                <Link href={`/surveys?page=${currentPage - 1}`} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50">السابق</Link>
              ) : null}
              {currentPage < pageCount ? (
                <Link href={`/surveys?page=${currentPage + 1}`} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 hover:bg-slate-50">التالي</Link>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * Phase 9 — survey create/edit form with an inline question builder.
 *
 * The builder is a pure client component; the ENTIRE definition is
 * serialized to a single `definitionJson` field and re-validated by the
 * server (surveyDefinitionSchema + DB checks) before persistence —
 * client state is never trusted. Dates come from datetime-local inputs
 * and audience ids from server-provided option lists only.
 */
import { useActionState, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import {
  MAX_SURVEY_QUESTIONS,
  SURVEY_AUDIENCE_LABELS,
  SURVEY_QUESTION_TYPE_LABELS,
  SURVEY_STAGES,
  SURVEY_STAGE_LABELS,
} from "@/config/surveys";
import {
  createSurveyAction,
  updateSurveyAction,
  type SurveyActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/surveys";
import { FieldError } from "@/app/assignments/ui";

export interface SurveyFormOptions {
  programs: { id: string; nameAr: string }[];
  courses: { id: string; titleAr: string }[];
  lessons: { id: string; titleAr: string; courseId: string | null }[];
  assignments: { id: string; titleAr: string }[];
  certificates: { id: string; titleAr: string }[];
  branches: { id: string; nameAr: string }[];
  teachers: { id: string; name: string; branchName: string | null }[];
}

export interface SurveyFormDefinition {
  titleAr: string;
  titleEn: string | null;
  descriptionAr: string | null;
  descriptionEn: string | null;
  purposeAr: string | null;
  instructionsAr: string | null;
  stage: string | null;
  linkPairCode: string | null;
  programId: string | null;
  courseId: string | null;
  lessonId: string | null;
  assignmentId: string | null;
  certificateId: string | null;
  audienceMode: string;
  targetBranchIds: string[];
  targetTeacherIds: string[];
  anonymous: boolean;
  allowMultipleResponses: boolean;
  linkResponsesEnabled: boolean;
  opensAt: string | null;
  closesAt: string | null;
  questions: BuilderQuestion[];
}

export interface BuilderQuestion {
  clientId: string;
  textAr: string;
  helpTextAr: string;
  type: string;
  required: boolean;
  options: string[];
  minScore: string;
  maxScore: string;
}

const CHOICE_TYPES = new Set(["SINGLE_CHOICE", "MULTI_CHOICE"]);

function newQuestion(): BuilderQuestion {
  return {
    clientId: `q-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`,
    textAr: "",
    helpTextAr: "",
    type: "SINGLE_CHOICE",
    required: true,
    options: ["", ""],
    minScore: "1",
    maxScore: "5",
  };
}

function toDateInput(value: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  const pad = (num: number) => String(num).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

export default function SurveyForm({
  mode,
  surveyId,
  initial,
  options,
}: {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  surveyId?: string;
  initial: SurveyFormDefinition;
  options: SurveyFormOptions;
}) {
  const action = mode === "create" ? createSurveyAction : updateSurveyAction;
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState<SurveyActionState, FormData>(action, { ok: false });

  const [titleAr, setTitleAr] = useState(initial.titleAr);
  const [titleEn, setTitleEn] = useState(initial.titleEn ?? "");
  const [descriptionAr, setDescriptionAr] = useState(initial.descriptionAr ?? "");
  const [purposeAr, setPurposeAr] = useState(initial.purposeAr ?? "");
  const [instructionsAr, setInstructionsAr] = useState(initial.instructionsAr ?? "");
  const [stage, setStage] = useState(initial.stage ?? "");
  const [linkPairCode, setLinkPairCode] = useState(initial.linkPairCode ?? "");
  const [programId, setProgramId] = useState(initial.programId ?? "");
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState(initial.courseId ?? "");
  const [lessonId, setLessonId] = useState(initial.lessonId ?? "");
  const [assignmentId, setAssignmentId] = useState(initial.assignmentId ?? "");
  const [certificateId, setCertificateId] = useState(initial.certificateId ?? "");
  const [audienceMode, setAudienceMode] = useState(initial.audienceMode);
  const [targetBranchIds, setTargetBranchIds] = useState<string[]>(initial.targetBranchIds);
  const [targetTeacherIds, setTargetTeacherIds] = useState<string[]>(initial.targetTeacherIds);
  const [anonymous, setAnonymous] = useState(initial.anonymous);
  const [allowMultipleResponses, setAllowMultipleResponses] = useState(initial.allowMultipleResponses);
  const [linkResponsesEnabled, setLinkResponsesEnabled] = useState(initial.linkResponsesEnabled);
  const [opensAt, setOpensAt] = useState(toDateInput(initial.opensAt));
  const [closesAt, setClosesAt] = useState(toDateInput(initial.closesAt));
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<BuilderQuestion[]>(
    initial.questions.length > 0 ? initial.questions : [newQuestion()]
  );

  const filteredLessons = useMemo(
    () => (courseId ? options.lessons.filter((lesson) => lesson.courseId === courseId) : []),
    [courseId, options.lessons]
  );

  function patchQuestion(clientId: string, patch: Partial<BuilderQuestion>): void {
    setQuestions((prev) =>
      prev.map((question) => (question.clientId === clientId ? { ...question, ...patch } : question))
    );
  }

  function moveQuestion(index: number, direction: -1 | 1): void {
    setQuestions((prev) => {
      const next = [...prev];
      const target = index + direction;
      if (target < 0 || target >= next.length) return prev;
      const [item] = next.splice(index, 1);
      next.splice(target, 0, item);
      return next;
    });
  }

  function buildDefinitionJson(): string {
    return JSON.stringify({
      titleAr,
      titleEn,
      descriptionAr,
      descriptionEn: null,
      purposeAr,
      instructionsAr,
      stage: stage === "" ? null : stage,
      linkPairCode,
      programId: programId === "" ? null : programId,
      courseId: courseId === "" ? null : courseId,
      lessonId: lessonId === "" ? null : lessonId,
      assignmentId: assignmentId === "" ? null : assignmentId,
      certificateId: certificateId === "" ? null : certificateId,
      audienceMode,
      targetBranchIds: JSON.stringify(targetBranchIds),
      targetTeacherIds: JSON.stringify(targetTeacherIds),
      anonymous,
      allowMultipleResponses,
      linkResponsesEnabled: linkResponsesEnabled && anonymous && linkPairCode.trim() !== "",
      opensAt: opensAt === "" ? null : new Date(opensAt).toISOString(),
      closesAt: closesAt === "" ? null : new Date(closesAt).toISOString(),
      questions: questions.map((question) => ({
        textAr: question.textAr,
        helpTextAr: question.helpTextAr,
        type: question.type,
        required: question.required,
        options:
          CHOICE_TYPES.has(question.type)
            ? question.options.filter((option) => option.trim() !== "")
            : [],
        minScore: question.type === "RATING" ? question.minScore : null,
        maxScore: question.type === "RATING" ? question.maxScore : null,
      })),
    });
  }

  const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100";
  const labelClass = "mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500";

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-6">
      <input type="hidden" name="definitionJson" value={buildDefinitionJson()} />
      {mode === "edit" ? <input type="hidden" name="surveyId" value={surveyId ?? ""} /> : null}

      {state.ok ? null : state.message ? (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">
          {state.message}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- Content */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="mb-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">بيانات الاستبيان</h2>
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>عنوان الاستبيان (بالعربية) *</label>
            <input className={inputClass} value={titleAr} onChange={(event) => setTitleAr(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.titleAr} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>العنوان بالإنجليزية (اختياري)</label>
            <input className={inputClass} dir="ltr" value={titleEn} onChange={(event) => setTitleEn(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.titleEn} />
          </div>
          <div className="md:col-span-2">
            <label className={labelClass}>وصف الاستبيان</label>
            <textarea className={inputClass} rows={2} value={descriptionAr} onChange={(event) => setDescriptionAr(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.descriptionAr} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>الغرض (يظهر للمستجيب)</label>
            <input className={inputClass} value={purposeAr} onChange={(event) => setPurposeAr(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.purposeAr} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>تعليمات المستجيب</label>
            <input className={inputClass} value={instructionsAr} onChange={(event) => setInstructionsAr(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.instructionsAr} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- Impact config */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">ربط القياس والتأثير (اختياري)</h2>
        <p className="mb-4 text-xs text-slate-500">
          اربط الاستبيان بمحتوى تدريبي وحدد مرحلة التقييم لقياس الأثر. مقارنة «قبل/بعد» تتطلب رمز ربط مشتركًا بين الاستبيانين ورابطًا ببرنامج أو دورة.
        </p>
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>البرنامج التدريبي</label>
            <select className={inputClass} value={programId} onChange={(event) => setProgramId(event.target.value)}>
              <option value="">— بدون —</option>
              {options.programs.map((program) => (
                <option key={program.id} value={program.id}>{program.nameAr}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.programId} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>الدورة التدريبية</label>
            <select className={inputClass} value={courseId} onChange={(event) => { setCourseId(event.target.value); setLessonId(""); }}>
              <option value="">— بدون —</option>
              {options.courses.map((course) => (
                <option key={course.id} value={course.id}>{course.titleAr}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.courseId} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>الدرس (داخل الدورة المحددة)</label>
            <select className={inputClass} value={lessonId} onChange={(event) => setLessonId(event.target.value)} disabled={courseId === ""}>
              <option value="">— بدون —</option>
              {filteredLessons.map((lesson) => (
                <option key={lesson.id} value={lesson.id}>{lesson.titleAr}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.lessonId} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>الواجب التدريبي</label>
            <select className={inputClass} value={assignmentId} onChange={(event) => setAssignmentId(event.target.value)}>
              <option value="">— بدون —</option>
              {options.assignments.map((assignment) => (
                <option key={assignment.id} value={assignment.id}>{assignment.titleAr}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.assignmentId} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>الشهادة</label>
            <select className={inputClass} value={certificateId} onChange={(event) => setCertificateId(event.target.value)}>
              <option value="">— بدون —</option>
              {options.certificates.map((certificate) => (
                <option key={certificate.id} value={certificate.id}>{certificate.titleAr}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.certificateId} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>مرحلة التقييم</label>
            <select className={inputClass} value={stage} onChange={(event) => setStage(event.target.value)}>
              <option value="">استبيان عام (بلا مرحلة)</option>
              {SURVEY_STAGES.map((value) => (
                <option key={value} value={value}>{SURVEY_STAGE_LABELS[value]}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.stage} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className={labelClass}>رمز الربط (قبل/بعد)</label>
            <input className={inputClass} dir="ltr" placeholder="P9-PAIR-001" value={linkPairCode} onChange={(event) => setLinkPairCode(event.target.value)} />
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.linkPairCode} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- Audience */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="mb-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">الجمهور المستهدف</h2>
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {(["ALL_TEACHERS", "BRANCHES", "TEACHERS"] as const).map((modeValue) => (
            <button
              key={modeValue}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setAudienceMode(modeValue)}
              className={`rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                audienceMode === modeValue
                  ? "border-[#1D5BD6] bg-[#1D5BD6] text-white"
                  : "border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
              }`}
            >
              {SURVEY_AUDIENCE_LABELS[modeValue]}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {audienceMode === "BRANCHES" ? (
          <div>
            <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {options.branches.map((branch) => (
                <label key={branch.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-slate-700">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={targetBranchIds.includes(branch.id)}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setTargetBranchIds((prev) =>
                        event.target.checked ? [...prev, branch.id] : prev.filter((id) => id !== branch.id)
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  {branch.nameAr}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.targetBranchIds} />
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {audienceMode === "TEACHERS" ? (
          <div className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-3">
            <div className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2">
              {options.teachers.map((teacher) => (
                <label key={teacher.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-slate-700">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={targetTeacherIds.includes(teacher.id)}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setTargetTeacherIds((prev) =>
                        event.target.checked ? [...prev, teacher.id] : prev.filter((id) => id !== teacher.id)
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  {teacher.name}
                  {teacher.branchName ? <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">({teacher.branchName})</span> : null}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
            <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.targetTeacherIds} />
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </section>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- Response policy */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h2 className="mb-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">إعدادات الردود</h2>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={anonymous} onChange={(event) => setAnonymous(event.target.checked)} className="mt-1" />
            <span>
              <strong>استبيان مجهول الهوية</strong>
              <span className="block text-xs text-slate-500">
                لا يُخزَّن أي ربط بين الرد وهوية المعلم إطلاقًا: لا حفظ مؤقت، لا عرض ردود فردية، ولا سجل شخصي للرد. ولا يمكن تقنيًا منع تكرار الردود ما لم يُفعّل الربط المجهول برمز ربط.
              </span>
            </span>
          </label>
          <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={allowMultipleResponses} onChange={(event) => setAllowMultipleResponses(event.target.checked)} className="mt-1" />
            <span>
              <strong>السماح بأكثر من رد لنفس المستجيب</strong>
            </span>
          </label>
          {anonymous ? (
            <label className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3 text-sm text-slate-700">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={linkResponsesEnabled} onChange={(event) => setLinkResponsesEnabled(event.target.checked)} className="mt-1" />
              <span>
                <strong>ربط ردود ما قبل/بعد التدريب بمفاتيح مجهولة</strong>
                <span className="block text-xs text-slate-500">
                  يُخزَّن مفتاح مجهول (SHA-256) مشتق من رمز الربط وهوية الجلسة — لا يمكن عكسه لكشف الهوية من قاعدة البيانات وحدها، ويُستخدم فقط لمطابقة النتائج المجمعة.
                </span>
              </span>
            </label>
          ) : null}
          <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.linkResponsesEnabled} />
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>يفتح في (اختياري)</label>
              <input type="datetime-local" className={inputClass} value={opensAt} onChange={(event) => setOpensAt(event.target.value)} />
              <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.opensAt} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>يُغلق في (اختياري)</label>
              <input type="datetime-local" className={inputClass} value={closesAt} onChange={(event) => setClosesAt(event.target.value)} />
              <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.closesAt} />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- Questions builder */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">أسئلة الاستبيان ({questions.length}/{MAX_SURVEY_QUESTIONS})</h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setQuestions((prev) => (prev.length < MAX_SURVEY_QUESTIONS ? [...prev, newQuestion()] : prev))}
            className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
          >
            + إضافة سؤال
          </button>
        </div>
        <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.questions} />

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {questions.map((question, index) => (
            <div key={question.clientId} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 p-4">
              <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">سؤال {index + 1}</span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => moveQuestion(index, -1)} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-slate-50">↑</button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => moveQuestion(index, 1)} className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-slate-50">↓</button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setQuestions((prev) => (prev.length > 1 ? prev.filter((item) => item.clientId !== question.clientId) : prev))}
                    className="rounded border border-red-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                  >
                    حذف
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="md:col-span-2">
                  <label className={labelClass}>نص السؤال *</label>
                  <input
                    className={inputClass}
                    value={question.textAr}
                    onChange={(event) => patchQuestion(question.clientId, { textAr: event.target.value })}
                  />
                  <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.[`questions.${index}.textAr`]} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>نوع السؤال</label>
                  <select
                    className={inputClass}
                    value={question.type}
                    onChange={(event) => patchQuestion(question.clientId, { type: event.target.value })}
                  >
                    {Object.entries(SURVEY_QUESTION_TYPE_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => (
                      <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-end pb-2">
                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={question.required}
                      onChange={(event) => patchQuestion(question.clientId, { required: event.target.checked })}
                    />
                    سؤال إلزامي
                  </label>
                </div>
                <div className="md:col-span-2">
                  <label className={labelClass}>سؤال مساعد (اختياري)</label>
                  <input
                    className={inputClass}
                    value={question.helpTextAr}
                    onChange={(event) => patchQuestion(question.clientId, { helpTextAr: event.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>
                {CHOICE_TYPES.has(question.type) ? (
                  <div className="md:col-span-2">
                    <label className={labelClass}>الخيارات (خياران على الأقل)</label>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {question.options.map((option, optionIndex) => (
                        <div key={optionIndex} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <input
                            className={inputClass}
                            value={option}
                            placeholder={`الخيار ${optionIndex + 1}`}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              patchQuestion(question.clientId, {
                                options: question.options.map((item, itemIndex) =>
                                  itemIndex === optionIndex ? event.target.value : item
                                ),
                              })
                            }
                          />
                          {question.options.length > 2 ? (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() =>
                                patchQuestion(question.clientId, {
                                  options: question.options.filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== optionIndex),
                                })
                              }
                              className="rounded border border-slate-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50"
                            >
                              ×
                            </button>
                          ) : null}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                      {question.options.length < 10 ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => patchQuestion(question.clientId, { options: [...question.options, ""] })}
                          className="text-xs font-medium text-[#1D5BD6] hover:underline"
                        >
                          + خيار
                        </button>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.[`questions.${index}.options`]} />
                  </div>
                ) : null}
                {question.type === "RATING" ? (
                  <>
                    <div>
                      <label className={labelClass}>أدنى درجة (1-10)</label>
                      <input
                        type="number" min={1} max={10}
                        className={inputClass}
                        value={question.minScore}
                        onChange={(event) => patchQuestion(question.clientId, { minScore: event.target.value })}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className={labelClass}>أقصى درجة (1-10)</label>
                      <input
                        type="number" min={1} max={10}
                        className={inputClass}
                        value={question.maxScore}
                        onChange={(event) => patchQuestion(question.clientId, { maxScore: event.target.value })}
                      />
                      <FieldError message={state.fieldErrors?.[`questions.${index}.maxScore`]} />
                    </div>
                  </>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={pending}
          className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {pending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : mode === "create" ? "إنشاء الاستبيان" : "حفظ التعديلات"}
        </button>
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">يُحفظ الاستبيان كمسودة — يمكن نشره من صفحته بعد المراجعة.</span>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — shared survey UI atoms: status/stage badges, question-type
 * labels and small renderers reused by management and respondent pages.
 */
import {
  LIKERT_OPTIONS,
  LIKERT_POINTS,
  SURVEY_QUESTION_TYPE_LABELS,
  SURVEY_STAGE_LABELS,
  SURVEY_STATUS_LABELS,
  type SurveyQuestionType,
  type SurveyStage,
  type SurveyStatus,
} from "@/config/surveys";

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<SurveyStatus, string> = {
  DRAFT: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200",
  PUBLISHED: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200",
  CLOSED: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200",
  ARCHIVED: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 border-slate-200",
};

export function SurveyStatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const label = SURVEY_STATUS_LABELS[status as SurveyStatus] ?? status;
  const style = STATUS_STYLES[status as SurveyStatus] ?? STATUS_STYLES.DRAFT;
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${style}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

const STAGE_STYLES: Record<SurveyStage, string> = {
  PRE_TRAINING: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border-sky-200",
  AFTER_TRAINING: "bg-blue-50 text-[#1D5BD6] border-blue-200",
  APPLICATION_FOLLOWUP: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200",
};

export function SurveyStageBadge({ stage }: { stage: string | null }) {
  if (!stage) return null;
  const label = SURVEY_STAGE_LABELS[stage as SurveyStage] ?? stage;
  const style = STAGE_STYLES[stage as SurveyStage] ?? STAGE_STYLES.PRE_TRAINING;
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${style}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function AnonymousBadge({ anonymous }: { anonymous: boolean }) {
  if (!anonymous) return null;
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600">
      مجهول الهوية
    </span>
  );
}

export function questionTypeLabel(type: string): string {
  return SURVEY_QUESTION_TYPE_LABELS[type as SurveyQuestionType] ?? type;
}

/** Likert ordinal label (5 = strongest agreement). */
export function likertLabelForValue(value: number): string {
  const index = LIKERT_POINTS - value;
  return LIKERT_OPTIONS[index] ?? String(value);
}

/** Horizontal distribution bar (brand blue, RTL-safe). */
export function DistributionBar({
  label,
  count,
  total,
  highlight,
}: {
  label: string;
  count: number;
  total: number;
  highlight?: boolean;
}) {
  const percent = total > 0 ? Math.round((count / total) * 100) : 0;
  return (
    <div className="mb-2">
      <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-600">
        <span className="font-medium">{label}</span>
        <span dir="ltr" className="text-slate-500">
          {count} ({percent}%)
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-100">
        <div
          className={`h-full rounded-full ${highlight ? "bg-[#1D5BD6]" : "bg-[#1D5BD6]/70"}`}
          style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { headers } from "next/headers";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/platform/status-badge";
import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { growthLevelLabel } from "@/config/growth";
import { TeacherAdminPanels } from "@/app/teachers/[id]/teacher-admin-panels";

export const metadata = {
  title: "الملف الإداري للمعلم | منارة قرطبة",
};

/**
 * Batch 2 — the administrative teacher profile: professional data edit
 * (name/stage/subject/school/supervisor/deputy), the growth controls
 * (v48 classification + promotion), the secure account panel
 * (one-time temporary password + email change) and the professional
 * stats. School scope is enforced server-side.
 */
export default async function TeacherAdminPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const actor = await requireAdminContext();

  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      isActive: true,
      stage: true,
      subject: true,
      growthLevel: true,
      emailVerifiedAt: true,
      lastLoginAt: true,
      passwordUpdatedAt: true,
      createdAt: true,
      schoolId: true,
      school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      branch: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      teacherSupervision: {
        select: {
          supervisor: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
          deputy: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
        },
      },
      courseCompletions: { select: { hours: true } },
      certificates: { where: { status: "ISSUED" }, select: { id: true } },
    },
  });

  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER") notFound();
  if (
    actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    teacher.schoolId !== actor.schoolId
  ) {
    redirect("/forbidden");
  }

  const [supervisors, deputies, growthHistory] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findMany({
      where: {
        role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
        isActive: true,
        ...(teacher.schoolId ? { schoolId: teacher.schoolId } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      take: 300,
    }),
    db.user.findMany({
      where: {
        role: "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY",
        isActive: true,
        ...(teacher.schoolId ? { schoolId: teacher.schoolId } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      take: 300,
    }),
    db.growthEvent.findMany({
      where: { userId: teacher.id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 10,
      select: {
        id: true,
        fromLevel: true,
        toLevel: true,
        reason: true,
        actor: { select: { name: true } },
        createdAt: true,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const hours =
    Math.round(
      teacher.courseCompletions.reduce(
        (sum, completion) => sum + Number(completion.hours ?? 0),
        0
      ) * 10
    ) / 10;

  const headerList = await headers();
  void headerList;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={`الملف الإداري — ${teacher.name}`}
        description="البيانات المهنية والإسناد وتصنيف النمو وأمان الحساب — كل التعديلات تتحقق خادميًا."
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الرئيسية" },
          { label: "إدارة المعلمين" },
          { label: teacher.name },
        ]}
        meta={
          <>
            <StatusBadge tone={teacher.isActive ? "success" : "warning"} withDot={false}>
              {teacher.isActive ? "نشط" : "موقوف"}
            </StatusBadge>
            <StatusBadge tone="info" withDot={false}>
              {growthLevelLabel(teacher.growthLevel)}
            </StatusBadge>
            <StatusBadge tone={teacher.emailVerifiedAt ? "success" : "warning"} withDot={false}>
              {teacher.emailVerifiedAt ? "بريد موثق" : "بريد غير موثق"}
            </StatusBadge>
          </>
        }
      />

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4">
          <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">{teacher.courseCompletions.length}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">دورات مكتملة</p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4">
          <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">{hours}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">ساعات تدريب متراكمة</p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4">
          <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">{teacher.certificates.length}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">شهادات صادرة</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-6 grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <SectionCard
          title="البيانات المهنية والإسناد"
          description="الاسم، المرحلة، التخصص، المشرف التربوي والوكيل التعليمي — بنفس بيانات المنصة الأصلية."
        >
          <TeacherAdminPanels
            mode="profile"
            teacherId={teacher.id}
            initial={{
              name: teacher.name,
              stage: teacher.stage ?? "",
              subject: teacher.subject ?? "",
              supervisorId: teacher.teacherSupervision?.supervisor.id ?? "",
              deputyId: teacher.teacherSupervision?.deputy?.id ?? "",
            }}
            supervisors={supervisors}
            deputies={deputies}
          />
        </SectionCard>

        <SectionCard
          title="أمان الحساب"
          description="إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور مؤقتة (تُعرض مرة واحدة وتُنهي كل الجلسات) وتحديث البريد الإلكتروني."
        >
          <TeacherAdminPanels
            mode="security"
            teacherId={teacher.id}
            initial={{
              email: teacher.email,
              lastLoginAt: teacher.lastLoginAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
              passwordUpdatedAt: teacher.passwordUpdatedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
            }}
          />
        </SectionCard>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-6">
        <SectionCard
          title="سجل النمو المهني"
          description="آخر أحداث التصنيف والانتقال — السجل كامل ولا يُحذف."
        >
          {growthHistory.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              لا توجد أحداث نمو بعد — استخدم لوحة النمو لتصنيف المعلم.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y rounded-xl border" role="list">
              {growthHistory.map((event) => (
                <li key={event.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 p-3 text-sm">
                  <span className="font-semibold">
                    {event.fromLevel ? `${event.fromLevel} ← ` : ""}
                    {event.toLevel}
                    <span className="ms-2 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                      {event.reason === "PROMOTION_APPROVED"
                        ? "اعتماد انتقال (60%)"
                        : event.reason === "MANUAL_SUPERVISOR"
                          ? "تصنيف المشرف"
                          : event.reason}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {event.actor?.name ?? "—"} ·{" "}
                    {event.createdAt.toLocaleDateString("ar-EG")}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </SectionCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
