"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { KeyRound, Loader2, Mail } from "lucide-react";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  adminResetPasswordAction,
  adminUpdateEmailAction,
  updateTeacherProfileAction,
  type TeacherAdminActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/teacher-profile";

const initialState: TeacherAdminActionState = { ok: false };

interface SupervisorOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
}

/**
 * Batch 2 — the admin teacher forms. `mode="profile"` renders the
 * professional-data form; `mode="security"` renders the temporary-
 * password reset (the generated secret is displayed ONCE in local
 * state — it is never stored in the DOM history or persisted) and the
 * email-change form.
 */
export function TeacherAdminPanels({
  mode,
  teacherId,
  initial,
  supervisors = [],
  deputies = [],
}: {
  mode: "profile" | "security";
  teacherId: string;
  initial:
    | {
        name: string;
        stage: string;
        subject: string;
        supervisorId: string;
        deputyId: string;
      }
    | {
        email: string;
        lastLoginAt: string | null;
        passwordUpdatedAt: string | null;
      };
  supervisors?: SupervisorOption[];
  deputies?: SupervisorOption[];
}) {
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const [profileState, profileAction, profilePending] = React.useActionState(
    updateTeacherProfileAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [resetState, resetAction, resetPending] = React.useActionState(
    adminResetPasswordAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [emailState, emailAction, emailPending] = React.useActionState(
    adminUpdateEmailAction,
    initialState
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (profileState.ok && profileState.message) {
      toast({ title: "تم الحفظ", description: profileState.message });
    }
  }, [profileState, toast]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (emailState.ok && emailState.message) {
      toast({ title: "تم التحديث", description: emailState.message });
    }
  }, [emailState, toast]);

  if (mode === "profile") {
    const data = initial as {
      name: string;
      stage: string;
      subject: string;
      supervisorId: string;
      deputyId: string;
    };
    return (
      <form action={profileAction} className="space-y-4">
        <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={teacherId} />

        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="name">الاسم</Label>
            <Input id="name" name="name" defaultValue={data.name} required />
            {profileState.fieldErrors?.name && (
              <p className="text-xs text-error">{profileState.fieldErrors.name}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="stage">المرحلة</Label>
            <Input id="stage" name="stage" defaultValue={data.stage} placeholder="مثال: متوسط" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="subject">التخصص</Label>
            <Input
              id="subject"
              name="subject"
              defaultValue={data.subject}
              placeholder="مثال: اللغة العربية"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="supervisorId">المشرف التربوي</Label>
            <select
              id="supervisorId"
              name="supervisorId"
              defaultValue={data.supervisorId}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="">— بدون تغيير/بدون مشرف —</option>
              {supervisors.map((supervisor) => (
                <option key={supervisor.id} value={supervisor.id}>
                  {supervisor.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            {profileState.fieldErrors?.supervisorId && (
              <p className="text-xs text-error">
                {profileState.fieldErrors.supervisorId}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="deputyId">الوكيل التعليمي</Label>
            <select
              id="deputyId"
              name="deputyId"
              defaultValue={data.deputyId}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border bg-background px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="">— بدون —</option>
              {deputies.map((deputy) => (
                <option key={deputy.id} value={deputy.id}>
                  {deputy.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            {profileState.fieldErrors?.deputyId && (
              <p className="text-xs text-error">{profileState.fieldErrors.deputyId}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {profileState.message && !profileState.ok && (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-error-soft px-3 py-2 text-sm text-error">
            {profileState.message}
          </p>
        )}

        <Button type="submit" disabled={profilePending} className="rounded-xl">
          {profilePending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
          حفظ البيانات
        </Button>
      </form>
    );
  }

  const security = initial as {
    email: string;
    lastLoginAt: string | null;
    passwordUpdatedAt: string | null;
  };
  const temporaryPassword =
    resetState.ok && resetState.data?.temporaryPassword
      ? resetState.data.temporaryPassword
      : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <p>
          البريد الحالي: <span className="font-semibold" dir="ltr">{security.email}</span>
        </p>
        <p>آخر دخول: {security.lastLoginAt ? new Date(security.lastLoginAt).toLocaleString("ar-EG") : "لم يسجل الدخول"}</p>
        <p>
          آخر تحديث لكلمة المرور:{" "}
          {security.passwordUpdatedAt
            ? new Date(security.passwordUpdatedAt).toLocaleString("ar-EG")
            : "غير مسجل"}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Temporary password reset */}
      <form action={resetAction} className="space-y-2">
        <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={teacherId} />
        <p className="text-sm font-bold">🔑 إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          يولّد النظام كلمة مرور مؤقتة قوية، تُعرض لك مرة واحدة فقط، وتُنهي كل جلسات الحساب.
          لا تُرسل كلمة المرور عبر الإشعارات أو البريد.
        </p>
        <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={resetPending} className="rounded-xl">
          {resetPending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
          <KeyRound className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          توليد كلمة مرور مؤقتة
        </Button>
        {temporaryPassword && (
          <div className="rounded-xl border-2 border-brand-300 bg-brand-50 p-3">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-800">
              انسخها الآن — لن تُعرض مرة أخرى:
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 select-all font-mono text-lg font-black tracking-wider text-brand-900" dir="ltr">
              {temporaryPassword}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
        {resetState.message && !resetState.ok && (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-error-soft px-3 py-2 text-sm text-error">
            {resetState.message}
          </p>
        )}
      </form>

      {/* Email change */}
      <form action={emailAction} className="space-y-2">
        <input type="hidden" name="teacherId" value={teacherId} />
        <p className="text-sm font-bold">✉ تحديث البريد الإلكتروني</p>
        <Input
          name="newEmail"
          type="email"
          dir="ltr"
          placeholder="new@qurtuba.edu.sa"
          required
        />
        {emailState.fieldErrors?.newEmail && (
          <p className="text-xs text-error">{emailState.fieldErrors.newEmail}</p>
        )}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          البريد الجديد يبدأ غير موثق ويُعاد إرسال رسالة التوثيق عبر الخطوة الموجودة.
        </p>
        <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={emailPending} className="rounded-xl">
          {emailPending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
          <Mail className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          حفظ البريد الجديد
        </Button>
        {emailState.message && !emailState.ok && (
          <p className="rounded-lg bg-error-soft px-3 py-2 text-sm text-error">

  );

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, Download, FileSpreadsheet, Loader2, TriangleAlert, XCircle } from "lucide-react";

import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  commitImportAction,
  previewImportAction,
  type ImportActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/staffing";
import type { ImportPreview } from "@/lib/staffing/import";

const initialState: ImportActionState = { ok: false };

/**
 * The import wizard: choose file -> server preview (readiness counts +
 * per-row status) -> options -> approve. The approve step re-posts the
 * SAME file text and the server re-validates everything.
 */
export function ImportClient() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [previewState, previewAction, previewPending] = React.useActionState(
    previewImportAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [commitState, commitAction, commitPending] = React.useActionState(
    commitImportAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [csvText, setCsvText] = React.useState("");

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (previewState.ok && previewState.preview) {
      setCsvText(JSON.stringify(previewState.preview.rows));
    }
  }, [previewState]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (commitState.ok && commitState.commit) {
      toast({
        title: "تم الاعتماد",
        description: commitState.message,
      });
    }
  }, [commitState, toast]);

  const preview = previewState.ok ? previewState.preview : undefined;
  const commit = commitState.ok ? commitState.commit : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Step 1 — template + file */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <a
          href="/api/import/template"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          تحميل قالب Excel (CSV)
        </a>
        <form action={previewAction} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <label className="inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700">
            <FileSpreadsheet className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            اختيار ملف Excel/CSV
            <input
              type="file"
              name="file"
              accept=".csv,text/csv"
              className="sr-only"
              required
            />
          </label>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={previewPending}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {previewPending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
            عرض المطابقة
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>

      {previewState.message && !previewState.ok && (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-error/30 bg-error-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm text-error">
          {previewState.message}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Step 2 — counts + preview table */}
      {preview && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
            <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3">
              <p className="text-xl font-black tabular-nums">{preview.total}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي السجلات</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3">
              <p className="text-xl font-black tabular-nums text-brand-700">{preview.ready}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">مطابقة جاهزة</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3">
              <p className="text-xl font-black tabular-nums text-amber-600">
                {preview.needsReview}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">تحتاج مراجعة</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3">
              <p className="text-xl font-black tabular-nums text-error">
                {preview.missingTeacher}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">غير موجودة</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="max-h-80 overflow-auto rounded-xl border">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[680px] text-sm">
              <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-muted/80">
                <tr className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-start font-semibold">#</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-start font-semibold">اسم المعلم</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-start font-semibold">المشرف المسند إليه</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-start font-semibold">الوكيل</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-start font-semibold">المجمع التعليمي</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2 text-start font-semibold">الحالة</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {preview.rows.map((row) => (
                  <tr key={row.index} className="border-t">
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 tabular-nums">{row.index + 1}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">{row.name}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">{row.supervisor || "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">{row.deputy || "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">{row.school || "—"}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">
                      <span
                        className={
                          row.status === "ready"
                            ? "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700"
                            : row.status === "needs_review"
                              ? "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-amber-600"
                              : "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-error"
                        }
                      >
                        {row.status === "ready" ? (
                          <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                        ) : row.status === "needs_review" ? (
                          <TriangleAlert className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                        ) : (
                          <XCircle className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                        )}
                        {row.statusLabel}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Step 3 — approve */}
          <form action={commitAction} className="space-y-3">
            <input type="hidden" name="csvText" value={csvText} />
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  name="createMissingAccounts"
                  defaultChecked
                  className="size-4 accent-brand-600"
                />
                إنشاء حسابات غير مفعّلة للمعلمين غير الموجودين (بريد مؤقت @manarat.local —
                التفعيل خطوة يدوية)
              </label>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  name="updateSchool"
                  defaultChecked
                  className="size-4 accent-brand-600"
                />
                تحديث المجمع التعليمي للمعلمين عند مطابقة الاسم
              </label>
            </div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={commitPending || preview.ready === 0}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {commitPending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
              ✓ اعتماد الإسناد
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Commit result */}
      {commit && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-brand-200 bg-brand-50/60 p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-brand-800">{commitState.message}</p>
          <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground" role="list">
            <li>تم اعتماد: {commit.applied}</li>
            <li>تم تخطي/مراجعة: {commit.skipped}</li>
            <li>حسابات جديدة غير مفعّلة: {commit.createdAccounts}</li>
            {commit.notes.slice(0, 8).map((note, index) => (
              <li key={index} className="text-amber-700">
                • {note}
              </li>
            ))}
            {commit.notes.length > 8 && <li>… و{commit.notes.length - 8} ملاحظات أخرى</li>}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { Download, FileSpreadsheet, UserRound } from "lucide-react";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/platform/status-badge";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";
import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { growthLevelLabel } from "@/config/growth";
import { adminGrowthBoard } from "@/lib/growth/service";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export const metadata = {
  title: "إدارة المعلمين | منارة قرطبة",
};

/**
 * Batch 2 — the administrative teachers hub (the original "إدارة
 * المعلمين" module, now real): the professional roster with growth
 * levels, hours and certificates, the administrative profile editing
 * entry point, the Excel/CSV assignment import and the accounts export.
 */
export default async function TeachersPage() {
  const actor = await requireAdminContext();
  const board = await adminGrowthBoard({
    id: actor.id,
    role: actor.role,
    schoolId: actor.schoolId,
  });
  if (!board.ok) {
    return (
      <div>
        <PageHeader title="إدارة المعلمين" description={board.message} />
        <EmptyState icon={UserRound} title="غير متاح" description={board.message} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const teacherIds = board.data.map((row) => row.teacher.id);
  const assignments = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { teacherId: { in: teacherIds } },
    select: {
      teacherId: true,
      supervisor: { select: { name: true } },
      deputy: { select: { name: true } },
    },
  });
  const assignmentByTeacher = new Map(assignments.map((row) => [row.teacherId, row]));

  const eligibleCount = board.data.filter((row) => row.eligible).length;
  const activeCount = board.data.filter((row) => row.teacher.isActive).length;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="إدارة المعلمين"
        description="السجل المهني المركزي: التصنيف T0–T5، الساعات، الشهادات، الإسناد — مع التعديل الإداري والاستيراد من Excel."
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "الرئيسية" }, { label: "إدارة المعلمين" }]}
        meta={
          <>
            <StatusBadge tone="info" withDot={false}>
              {board.data.length} معلمًا
            </StatusBadge>
            <StatusBadge tone="success" withDot={false}>
              {activeCount} نشط
            </StatusBadge>
            {eligibleCount > 0 && (
              <StatusBadge tone="warning" withDot={false}>
                {eligibleCount} مستحق للانتقال
              </StatusBadge>
            )}
          </>
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Link
          href="/teachers/import"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-700"
        >
          <FileSpreadsheet className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          استيراد الإسنادات من Excel/CSV
        </Link>
        <a
          href="/api/reports/export?type=teachers"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          تصدير المعلمين CSV
        </a>
        <a
          href="/api/reports/export?type=accounts"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
        >
          <Download className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          تصدير الحسابات CSV
        </a>
      </div>

      <SectionCard
        title="السجل المهني للمعلمين"
        description="اضغط «الملف الإداري» لتعديل البيانات المهنية والإسناد وإعادة تعيين كلمة المرور."
      >
        {board.data.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={UserRound}
            title="لا يوجد معلمون في نطاقك بعد"

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Archive, Loader2, PlusCircle } from "lucide-react";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import {
  archiveYearAction,
  startAcademicYearAction,
  type ArchiveActionState,
} from "@/app/actions/reports";

const initialState: ArchiveActionState = { ok: false };

/**
 * Batch 2 — the archive page controls (HTML v26ArchiveYear /
 * v26StartYear): archive the current year in place, or adopt a new
 * academic year (1449هـ style) so future completions count in it.
 */
export function ArchiveActions({ activeYear }: { activeYear: string }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [archiveState, archiveFormAction, archivePending] = React.useActionState(
    archiveYearAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [startState, startFormAction, startPending] = React.useActionState(
    startAcademicYearAction,
    initialState
  );
  const [newYear, setNewYear] = React.useState("");

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (archiveState.ok && archiveState.message) {
      toast({ title: "تمت الأرشفة 📦", description: archiveState.message });
    }
  }, [archiveState, toast]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (startState.ok && startState.message) {
      toast({ title: "تم الاعتماد ✅", description: startState.message });
      setNewYear("");
    }
  }, [startState, toast]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-4">
      <form action={archiveFormAction}>
        <input type="hidden" name="year" value={activeYear} />
        <Button type="submit" disabled={archivePending} className="rounded-xl">
          {archivePending ? (
            <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <Archive className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          أرشفة {activeYear}
        </Button>
      </form>

      <form action={startFormAction} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Input
          name="year"
          value={newYear}
          onChange={(event) => setNewYear(event.target.value)}
          placeholder="أدخل العام الدراسي، مثال 1449هـ"
          className="w-64"
          required
        />
        <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={startPending || !newYear.trim()} className="rounded-xl">
          {startPending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
          <PlusCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          عام دراسي جديد
        </Button>
      </form>

      {(archiveState.message || startState.message) && (
        <p
          className={`w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm ${
            archiveState.ok || startState.ok
              ? "bg-brand-50 text-brand-800"
              : "bg-error-soft text-error"
          }`}
        >
          {archiveState.ok || startState.ok
            ? archiveState.ok
              ? archiveState.message
              : startState.message
            : archiveState.message || startState.message}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";

  currentYearTable,
  getArchive,
  listArchives,
} from "@/lib/training/archive";
import { ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET, annualHoursPercent } from "@/config/growth";
import { ArchiveActions } from "@/app/training-archive/archive-actions";

export const metadata = {
  title: "السجل التدريبي السنوي | منارة قرطبة",
};

/**
 * Batch 2 — the yearly training record (HTML v26TrainingArchivePage
 * parity): the active academic year's per-teacher hours vs the 35-hour
 * target, one-tap yearly archive, "عام دراسي جديد", and the archived
 * years with their frozen snapshots.
 */
export default async function TrainingArchivePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ year?: string }>;
}) {
  const actor = await requireAdminContext();
  const { year: detailYear } = await searchParams;

  const archiveActor = { id: actor.id, role: actor.role, schoolId: actor.schoolId };
  const [{ year: activeYear, rows }, archivesResult] = await Promise.all([
    currentYearTable(archiveActor),
    listArchives(archiveActor),
  ]);
  const archives = archivesResult.ok ? archivesResult.data : [];
  const settingYear = await getActiveAcademicYear();
  void settingYear;

  const detailResult = detailYear ? await getArchive(archiveActor, detailYear) : null;
  const detail = detailResult && detailResult.ok ? detailResult.data : null;

  const totalHours = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.hours, 0);
  const reachedTarget = rows.filter((row) => row.hours >= ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET).length;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="السجل التدريبي السنوي"
        description={`بيانات التدريب للعام الدراسي الحالي مع إمكانية الأرشفة السنوية — كل دورة وإكمال يُسجل بعام الدراسي دون فقد البيانات.`}
        breadcrumbs={[
          { label: "الرئيسية" },
          { label: "السجل التدريبي السنوي" },
        ]}
        meta={
          <StatusBadge tone="info" withDot={false}>
            العام الحالي: {activeYear}
          </StatusBadge>
        }
      />

      <div className="mb-6 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4">
          <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">{rows.length}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">معلمون لديهم ساعات هذا العام</p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4">
          <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">
            {Math.round(totalHours * 10) / 10}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي الساعات ({activeYear})</p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4">
          <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">
            {reachedTarget} / {rows.length}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            أكملوا هدف {ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET} ساعة
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ArchiveActions activeYear={activeYear} />

      <div className="mt-6 space-y-6">
        <SectionCard
          title={`ساعات المعلمين — ${activeYear}`}
          description="جدول السنوي الحقيقي: الدورات المكتملة والساعات لكل معلم (بيانات العام الحالي قبل الأرشفة)."
        >
          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Archive}
              title="لا توجد ساعات مسجلة هذا العام بعد"
              description="أكملت الدورات تُحتسب تلقائيًا هنا بعامها الدراسي."
            />
          ) : (

              <table className="w-full min-w-[560px] text-sm">

                    <th className="py-2 text-start font-semibold">المجمع</th>
                    <th className="py-2 text-start font-semibold">الدورات المكتملة</th>
                    <th className="py-2 text-start font-semibold">الساعات</th>
                    <th className="py-2 text-start font-semibold">من الهدف</th>
                    <th className="py-2 text-start font-semibold">العام</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {rows.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.teacherId} className="border-b last:border-b-0">
                      <td className="py-2.5 font-semibold">{row.teacherName}</td>
                      <td className="py-2.5">{row.schoolName ?? "—"}</td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 tabular-nums">{row.completions}</td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 tabular-nums">{row.hours}</td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 tabular-nums">
                        {annualHoursPercent(row.hours)}%
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5">{row.academicYear}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </SectionCard>

        <SectionCard
          title="الأعوام المؤرشفة"
          description="كل أرشفة تحفظ نسخة ثابتة من دورات وإكمالات وشهادات العام — الاعتماد مرة جديدة يستبدل نسخة نفس العام فقط."

/**
 * User details + authorized management actions. The viewer is an

export default async function UserDetailPage({
  params,

}) {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();

  const result = await getUserDetailForAdmin(ctx, id);

    if (result.code === "FORBIDDEN") redirect("/forbidden");
    notFound();
  }
  const user = result.data;

  const targetSchoolId = user.school?.id ?? null;
  const [branches, supervisors] = targetSchoolId
    ? await Promise.all([
        db.branch.findMany({
          where: { schoolId: targetSchoolId },
          select: { id: true, nameAr: true, stage: true },
          orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
        }),
        listSupervisorsOfSchool(targetSchoolId),
      ])
    : [[], []];

  const isSelf = user.id === ctx.id;
  const isSuperAdminTarget = user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN";
  const canToggle = !isSelf && !isSuperAdminTarget;
  const canEditProfile = !isSuperAdminTarget;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={user.name}
        description={`${roleLabel(user.role)}${user.school ? ` — ${user.school.nameAr}` : " — حساب منصة"}`}

          { label: "دليل المستخدمين", href: "/users" },
          { label: user.name },
        ]}

          action={
            <UserStatusToggle
              userId={user.id}
              userName={user.name}
              isActive={user.isActive}
              disabled={!canToggle}
              disabledReason={
                isSelf
                  ? "لا يمكنك تغيير حالة حسابك الحالي"
                  : "حسابات مدير المنصة محمية"
              }
            />
          }
        >
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
            <InfoRow icon={UserRound} label="الاسم" value={user.name} />
            <InfoRow icon={Mail} label="البريد الإلكتروني" value={user.email} ltr />
            <InfoRow icon={KeyRound} label="الدور" value={roleLabel(user.role)} />

          <SectionCard

            description="المشرف يرى معلمي هذه الفروع تلقائيًا، إضافة إلى المعلمين المسندين إليه صراحةً — داخل مدرسته فقط."
          >
            <SupervisorBranchesForm
              supervisorId={user.id}
              assignedBranchIds={user.supervisorBranches.map((branch) => branch.id)}
              branches={branches}
            />
          </SectionCard>
        )}

        {user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" && targetSchoolId && (
          <SectionCard
            title="نطاق اطلاع الوكيل (قراءة فقط)"
            description="المنح يحدد ما يراه الوكيل في مساحته — لا يمنحه أي صلاحية إنشاء أو تعديل أو حذف إطلاقًا."
          >
            <DeputyScopeForm
              deputyId={user.id}
              grants={user.deputyGrants}
              branches={branches}
            />
          </SectionCard>
        )}

        {user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" && (
          <SectionCard
            title="المعلمون في نطاق هذا المشرف"
            description="اتحاد الإسناد الصريح وتغطية الفروع — المحسوبة من قاعدة البيانات."
          >
            {user.supervisorBranches.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                لا توجد فروع مسندة لهذا المشرف بعد — أسند فروعًا لتظهر معلموها.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2" role="list">
                {user.supervisorBranches.map((branch) => (
                  <li
                    key={branch.id}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3.5"
                  >
                    <span className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-100 text-brand-700">
                      <Users className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
                      <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold">
                        {branch.nameAr}
                      </span>
                      <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {branchStageLabel(branch.stage)}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              لعرض القائمة الكاملة بمنظور المشرف نفسه:{" "}
              <Link href="/supervision" className="font-bold text-brand-600 hover:underline">
                مساحة المشرف
              </Link>{" "}
              (تتطلب الدخول بحساب المشرف).
            </p>
          </SectionCard>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  );
}

import { DirectoryFilters } from "@/components/users/directory-filters";

import { requireAdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { roleLabel } from "@/lib/auth/roles";
import { listUsersForDirectory } from "@/lib/users/directory";
import { listSchools } from "@/lib/schools/service";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { DIRECTORY_ROLE_FILTER, USERS_PAGE_SIZE } from "@/lib/validation/users";

export const metadata = {
  title: "دليل المستخدمين",
};

/**
 * Phase 4 — user directory. SUPER_ADMIN browses the whole platform
 * (with an optional school filter); DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER is
 * structurally scoped to their own school by the service layer. All
 * rows and counts come from persisted data.
 */
export default async function UsersPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const ctx = await requireAdminContext();

  const params = await searchParams;
  const flat = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(params).map(([key, value]) => [
      key,
      Array.isArray(value) ? (value[0] ?? "") : (value ?? ""),
    ])
  );

  const result = await listUsersForDirectory(ctx, flat);

  // Filter dropdown data — office managers only ever see their school.
  const schools =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? await listSchools() : [];
  const effectiveSchoolId =
    ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || ctx.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
      ? ctx.schoolId
      : (flat.schoolId as string | undefined) || undefined;
  const branchOptions = effectiveSchoolId
    ? await db.branch.findMany({
        where: { schoolId: effectiveSchoolId },
        select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      })
    : [];

  // Staff-creation dropdown data (compact: platform schools).
  const schoolsForCreate =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? (await listSchools()).map((school) => ({
          id: school.id,
          nameAr: school.nameAr,
          isActive: school.isActive,
        }))
      : [];

  const roleOptions = DIRECTORY_ROLE_FILTER.map((role) => ({
    value: role,
    label: roleLabel(role),
  }));

  function pageHref(page: number): string {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams(
      Object.entries(flat).filter(([, v]) => v !== "")
    );
    sp.set("page", String(page));
    return `/users?${sp.toString()}`;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="دليل المستخدمين"
        description={
          ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
            ? "جميع حسابات المنصة عبر المدارس: الأدوار والحالات والإسنادات — إدارة مديري مكاتب التطوير من صفحة إدارة الحسابات."
            : "حسابات مدرستك: المعلمون والمشرفون والوكلاء — الأدوار والحالات والإسنادات."
        }
        breadcrumbs={[{ label: "دليل المستخدمين" }]}
      />

      <div className="space-y-6">
        <StaffCreateForm
          actorRole={ctx.role}
          schools={schoolsForCreate}
          schoolId={
            ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || ctx.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
              ? ctx.schoolId
              : undefined
          }
          branches={branchOptions}
        />

        <DirectoryFilters
          roleOptions={roleOptions}
          schools={schools.map((school) => ({ id: school.id, nameAr: school.nameAr }))}
          branches={branchOptions}
          showSchoolFilter={ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"}
        />

        {result.ok ? (
          <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card">
            {result.data.rows.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                icon={UserRound}
                title="لا توجد حسابات مطابقة"
                description="جرّب تعديل كلمات البحث أو الفلاتر — أو أنشئ حسابًا جديدًا من النموذج أعلاه."
                className="rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent"
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>المستخدم</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>الدور</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>المدرسة</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>الفرع</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>الحالة</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>آخر دخول</TableHead>
                        <TableHead aria-label="تفاصيل" />
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {result.data.rows.map((user) => (
                        <TableRow key={user.id}>
                          <TableCell>
                            <p className="text-sm font-bold">{user.name}</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                              {user.email}
                            </p>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-sm">{roleLabel(user.role)}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-sm">
                            {user.schoolName ?? (
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">— منصة</span>
                            )}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-sm">
                            {user.branchName ?? (
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">— بدون فرع</span>
                            )}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
                              <StatusBadge tone={user.isActive ? "success" : "error"}>
                                {user.isActive ? "نشط" : "موقوف"}
                              </StatusBadge>
                              <StatusBadge
                                tone={user.isVerified ? "info" : "warning"}
                                withDot={false}
                              >
                                {user.isVerified ? "بريد موثّق" : "بانتظار التأكيد"}
                              </StatusBadge>
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {user.lastLoginLabel ?? "لم يسجّل بعد"}

                            <Link

                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 transition-colors hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700"
                            >
                              التفاصيل
                              <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                            </Link>
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                </div>

                {/* Pagination — real server-computed pages, params preserved */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t px-4 py-3">
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    الإجمالي: {result.data.total} حساب — صفحة {result.data.page} من{" "}
                    {result.data.pageCount} ({USERS_PAGE_SIZE} لكل صفحة)
                  </p>

                    {result.data.page > 1 ? (
                      <Link
                        href={pageHref(result.data.page - 1)}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
                        aria-label="الصفحة السابقة"
                      >
                        <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                        السابقة
                      </Link>
                    ) : (
                      <span
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground/50"
                        aria-disabled="true"
                      >
                        <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                        السابقة
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {result.data.page < result.data.pageCount ? (
                      <Link
                        href={pageHref(result.data.page + 1)}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent"

                      >

import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";

import { PLATFORM_NAME_AR } from "@/config/certificates";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { VerifyForm } from "./verify-form";

/**
 * Batch 1 — صفحة التحقق العام من الشهادات (public certificate
 * verification).
 *
 * The QR code printed on every certificate points here
 * (/verify?code=...). Public, no session required — the page exposes
 * ONLY the printed-on-the-sheet facts (holder name, title, school,
 * issue date, effective status, signatory), the same information the
 * original HTML verifyCertificate showed, and nothing else. Lookup
 * accepts either the 16-char verification code or the MQ-YYYY-XXXXXX
 * serial, dash/space-insensitive, case-insensitive.
 */
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function normalizeQuery(raw: string): string {
  return raw.replace(/[\s-]+/g, "").toUpperCase();
}

interface VerifiedCertificate {
  certificateNumber: string;
  titleAr: string;
  teacherName: string;
  schoolName: string;
  contentTitle: string | null;
  issuedAt: Date;
  status: string;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
  signatoryName: string | null;
  signatoryTitle: string | null;
}

async function lookup(query: string): Promise<VerifiedCertificate | null> {
  const normalized = normalizeQuery(query);
  if (!normalized) return null;
  const row = await db.certificate.findFirst({
    where: {
      OR: [{ verificationCode: normalized }, { certificateNumber: normalized }],
    },
    select: {
      certificateNumber: true,
      titleAr: true,
      status: true,
      issuedAt: true,
      expiresAt: true,
      schoolSignatoryName: true,
      schoolSignatoryTitle: true,
      teacher: { select: { name: true } },
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    certificateNumber: row.certificateNumber,
    titleAr: row.titleAr,
    teacherName: row.teacher.name,
    schoolName: row.school.nameAr,
    contentTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
    issuedAt: row.issuedAt,
    status: row.status,
    expiresAt: row.expiresAt,
    signatoryName: row.schoolSignatoryName,
    signatoryTitle: row.schoolSignatoryTitle,
  };
}

export default async function VerifyPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ code?: string }>;
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const query = (params.code ?? "").trim();

  let result: VerifiedCertificate | null = null;
  let lookupError: string | null = null;
  if (query) {
    try {
      result = await lookup(query);
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientInitializationError ||
        error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError
      ) {
        lookupError = "تعذر الاتصال بسجل الشهادات — أعد المحاولة بعد قليل";
      } else {
        lookupError = "حدث خطأ غير متوقع أثناء التحقق";
      }
    }
  }

  const expired =
    result?.expiresAt !== null &&
    result?.expiresAt !== undefined &&
    result.expiresAt.getTime() < Date.now();
  const effectiveStatus = result
    ? result.status === "REVOKED"
      ? "REVOKED"
      : expired
        ? "EXPIRED"
        : "ISSUED"
    : null;

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-screen items-start justify-center bg-slate-100 px-4 py-10">
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl">
        <header className="text-center">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#1D5BD6]">
            {PLATFORM_NAME_AR}
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">
            التحقق من شهادة
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
            أدخل رقم الشهادة أو رمز التحقق المطبوع عليها للتأكد من صحتها في
            سجل المنصة.
          </p>
        </header>

        <VerifyForm initialQuery={query} />

        {query && (
          <section className="mt-6">
            {lookupError ? (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-5 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-red-700">
                {lookupError}
              </div>
            ) : result ? (
              <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">
                <div
                  className={
                    effectiveStatus === "ISSUED"
                      ? "bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-extrabold text-white"
                      : "bg-amber-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-extrabold text-white"
                  }
                >
                  {effectiveStatus === "ISSUED"
                    ? "✓ شهادة صحيحة ومسجلة في المنصة"
                    : effectiveStatus === "REVOKED"
                      ? "شهادة مُلغاة — لم تعد سارية"
                      : "شهادة منتهية الصلاحية"}
                </div>
                <dl className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 gap-y-3 p-5 text-sm sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">حامل الشهادة</dt>
                    <dd className="mt-0.5 font-bold text-slate-900">{result.teacherName}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">رقم الشهادة</dt>
                    <dd className="mt-0.5 font-mono font-bold text-slate-900" dir="ltr">
                      {result.certificateNumber}
                    </dd>
                  </div>
                  <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                    <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">عنوان الشهادة</dt>
                    <dd className="mt-0.5 font-bold text-slate-900">{result.titleAr}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">الجهة المانحة</dt>
                    <dd className="mt-0.5 font-semibold text-slate-800">{result.schoolName}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">تاريخ الإصدار</dt>
                    <dd className="mt-0.5 font-semibold text-slate-800">
                      {result.issuedAt.toLocaleDateString("ar-SA")}
                    </dd>
                  </div>
                  {result.signatoryName && (
                    <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                      <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">توقيع المدرسة</dt>
                      <dd className="mt-0.5 font-semibold text-slate-800">
                        {result.signatoryName}
                        {result.signatoryTitle ? ` — ${result.signatoryTitle}` : ""}
                      </dd>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </dl>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-5 text-center">
                <p className="text-sm font-extrabold text-red-700">
                  لم يتم العثور على شهادة بهذا الرقم في سجل المنصة
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-500">
                  تأكد من إدخال الرمز أو الرقم كما هو مطبوع على الشهادة.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        )}

        <footer className="mt-8 text-center text-[11px] text-slate-400">
          صفحة تحقق عامة — تعرض بيانات الشهادة المطبوعة فقط دون أي بيانات حساسة.
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Batch 1 — the public verification search box (GET form). The lookup
 * itself runs in the server component from the ?code= param, so the
 * result is shareable/bookmarkable — exactly what a printed QR needs.
 */
export function VerifyForm({ initialQuery }: { initialQuery: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialQuery);

  return (
    <form
      className="mt-6 flex gap-2"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const code = value.trim();
        router.push(code ? `/verify?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}` : "/verify");
      }}
    >
      <div className="relative flex-1">
        <Search
          className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
        <input
          value={value}
          onChange={(event) => setValue(event.target.value)}
          placeholder="مثال: MQ-2026-AB12CD أو رمز التحقق المكوّن من 16 خانة"
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white py-2.5 pe-3 ps-10 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1D5BD6] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
          aria-label="رقم الشهادة أو رمز التحقق"
        />
      </div>
      <button
        type="submit"
        className="rounded-lg bg-[#1D5BD6] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
      >
        تحقق الآن
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}

  lockedTenancy?: { scope: "platform" | "school"; schoolName: string | null };
}

/** Convert an ISO/Date string to the datetime-local input format. */
function toDatetimeLocal(value: string | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

  instructionsAr: "",
  instructionsEn: "",
  courseId: "",
  passingScore: "",
  timeLimitMinutes: "",
  attemptLimit: "",
  availableFrom: "",
  availableUntil: "",
};

interface AssessmentPublishControlsProps {

  status: string;
}

/**
 * Lifecycle controls for one assessment (DRAFT -> PUBLISHED ->
 * ARCHIVED). The publish guard (questions + passing score) lives in the
 * service layer; failures surface through the editor notice area.
 */
export function AssessmentPublishControls({
  assessmentId,
  status,
}: AssessmentPublishControlsProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">

          <input type="hidden" name="assessmentId" value={assessmentId} />

          <Button type="submit" size="sm">
            <Rocket className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            نشر الاختبار
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
      {status === "PUBLISHED" && (
        <>
          <form action={setAssessmentStatusAction}>
            <input type="hidden" name="assessmentId" value={assessmentId} />
            <input type="hidden" name="status" value="DRAFT" />
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" variant="outline">
              <Undo2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              إرجاع إلى مسودة
            </Button>
          </form>
          <form action={setAssessmentStatusAction}>
            <input type="hidden" name="assessmentId" value={assessmentId} />
            <input type="hidden" name="status" value="ARCHIVED" />
            <Button
              type="submit"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
            >
              <Archive className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              أرشفة
            </Button>

        </>
      )}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ClipboardCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { reviewAttemptAction, type AssessmentFormState } from "@/app/actions/assessment";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

export interface ReviewShortAnswer {
  questionId: string;
  questionText: string;
  points: number;
  answerText: string;
  modelAnswer: string | null;
}

interface AttemptReviewFormProps {
  attemptId: string;
  shortAnswers: ReviewShortAnswer[];
}

/**
 * Manual grading panel for a NEEDS_REVIEW attempt: shows the teacher's
 * short answers plus the optional model answer, collects per-question
 * points (0..question max) and submits the review — the service layer
 * finalizes the attempt atomically and keeps finalized rows immutable.
 */
export function AttemptReviewForm({
  attemptId,
  shortAnswers,
}: AttemptReviewFormProps) {
  const [state, formAction] = React.useActionState<
    AssessmentFormState | null,
    FormData
  >(reviewAttemptAction, null);

  const [scores, setScores] = React.useState<Record<string, string>>(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(shortAnswers.map((answer) => [answer.questionId, "0"]))
  );

  const scoresJson = JSON.stringify(
    shortAnswers.map((answer) => ({
      questionId: answer.questionId,
      points: Number(scores[answer.questionId] ?? "0"),
    }))
  );

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-3" noValidate>
      <input type="hidden" name="attemptId" value={attemptId} />
      <input type="hidden" name="scoresJson" value={scoresJson} />

      {state?.message && (
        <Alert
          variant={state.ok ? "default" : "destructive"}
          role={state.ok ? "status" : "alert"}
        >
          <AlertDescription>{state.message}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      <ul className="space-y-3" role="list">
        {shortAnswers.map((answer, index) => (
          <li key={answer.questionId} className="rounded-lg border bg-background/60 p-3">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
              {index + 1}. {answer.questionText}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1.5 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-md bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed">
              {answer.answerText || <span className="text-muted-foreground">— بدون إجابة نصية —</span>}
            </p>
            {answer.modelAnswer && (
              <p className="mt-1.5 rounded-md bg-info-soft px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-info">
                إرشاد المراجع: {answer.modelAnswer}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <label
                htmlFor={`score-${attemptId}-${answer.questionId}`}
                className="text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground"
              >
                الدرجة الممنوحة (0–{answer.points}):
              </label>
              <Input
                id={`score-${attemptId}-${answer.questionId}`}
                type="number"
                min={0}
                max={answer.points}
                dir="ltr"
                value={scores[answer.questionId] ?? "0"}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setScores((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    [answer.questionId]: event.target.value,
                  }))
                }
                className="h-8 w-24"
              />
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="submit" size="sm">
          <ClipboardCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          اعتماد المراجعة وحساب النتيجة
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

              onClick={onEdit}
            >
              <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
              تعديل
            </Button>
            <form action={deleteQuestionAction}>
              <input type="hidden" name="assessmentId" value={assessmentId} />
              <input type="hidden" name="questionId" value={question.id} />
              <Button
                type="submit"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
              >
                <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                حذف
              </Button>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {question.type === "TRUE_FALSE" ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          الإجابة الصحيحة:{" "}
          <span className="font-bold text-success">
            {question.answerKey && "value" in question.answerKey
              ? question.answerKey.value
                ? TRUE_FALSE_LABELS.true
                : TRUE_FALSE_LABELS.false
              : "—"}
          </span>
        </p>
      ) : question.type === "SHORT_ANSWER" ? (
        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <p className="font-bold text-info">تدرج يدويًا بعد التسليم</p>
          {question.answerKey && "modelAnswer" in question.answerKey && question.answerKey.modelAnswer && (
            <p className="mt-1">
              الإجابة النموذجية: {question.answerKey.modelAnswer}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-1.5" role="list">
          {question.options.map((option) => {
            const isCorrect = correctIds.includes(option.id);
            return (
              <li
                key={option.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs"
              >
                {isCorrect ? (
                  <CheckCircle2
                    className="size-4 shrink-0 text-success"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <Circle
                    className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground/40"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                )}
                <span className={isCorrect ? "font-bold text-success" : ""}>
                  {option.textAr}
                </span>
                {isCorrect && (
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-success-soft px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-success">
                    الإجابة الصحيحة
                  </span>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}

      {question.explanation && (
        <p className="rounded-lg bg-info-soft px-3 py-2 text-xs text-info">
          تغذية راجعة: {question.explanation}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function correctOptionIds(question: ManageQuestionRow): string[] {
  const key = question.answerKey;
  if (!key) return [];
  if ("optionId" in key) return [key.optionId];
  if ("optionIds" in key) return key.optionIds;
  return [];
}

/* ------------------------------ Form ------------------------------- */

interface QuestionFormProps {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  assessmentId: string;
  question?: ManageQuestionRow;
  onDone: () => void;
}

function QuestionForm({ mode, assessmentId, question, onDone }: QuestionFormProps) {
  const [addState, addFormAction] = React.useActionState<
    AssessmentFormState | null,
    FormData
  >(addQuestionAction, null);
  const [editState, editFormAction] = React.useActionState<
    AssessmentFormState | null,
    FormData
  >(updateQuestionAction, null);
  const state = mode === "create" ? addState : editState;

  const [type, setType] = React.useState<QuestionType>(
    (question?.type as QuestionType) ?? "SINGLE_CHOICE"
  );
  const [optionTexts, setOptionTexts] = React.useState<string[]>(() => {
    if (question && question.options.length > 0) {
      return question.options.map((option) => option.textAr);
    }
    return ["", ""];
  });
  const [correctIndexes, setCorrectIndexes] = React.useState<number[]>(() =>
    question ? correctOptionIds(question).map((id) =>
      Math.max(0, question.options.findIndex((option) => option.id === id))
    ) : []
  );
  const [correctValue, setCorrectValue] = React.useState<string>(() => {
    if (question?.answerKey && "value" in question.answerKey) {
      return question.answerKey.value ? "true" : "false";
    }
    return "true";
  });

  const isChoice = type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE";

  // Close on success (and reset for the next add).
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (state?.ok) {
      if (mode === "create") {
        setType("SINGLE_CHOICE");
        setOptionTexts(["", ""]);
        setCorrectIndexes([]);
        setCorrectValue("true");
      }
      onDone();
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [state?.ok]);

  function handleTypeChange(next: QuestionType) {
    setType(next);
    if (!question) {
      setOptionTexts(next === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || next === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE" ? ["", ""] : []);
      setCorrectIndexes([]);
    }
  }

  function toggleCorrectIndex(index: number, checked: boolean) {
    if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE") {
      setCorrectIndexes([index]);
      return;
    }
    setCorrectIndexes((current) =>
      checked
        ? [...current, index].sort()
        : current.filter((value) => value !== index)
    );
  }

  return (
    <form
      action={mode === "create" ? addFormAction : editFormAction}
      className="space-y-4"
      noValidate
    >
      <input type="hidden" name="assessmentId" value={assessmentId} />
      {mode === "edit" && question && (
        <input type="hidden" name="questionId" value={question.id} />
      )}
      <input type="hidden" name="type" value={type} />
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="optionsJson"
        value={JSON.stringify(
          optionTexts.map((textAr) => ({ textAr: textAr.trim() }))
        )}
      />
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="correctOptionIndexesJson"
        value={JSON.stringify(correctIndexes)}
      />
      <input type="hidden" name="correctValue" value={correctValue} />

      {state?.message && (
        <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert">
          <AlertDescription>{state.message}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label>نوع السؤال *</Label>
          <Select value={type} onValueChange={(value) => handleTypeChange(value as QuestionType)}>
            <SelectTrigger>
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {QUESTION_TYPES.map((value) => (
                <SelectItem key={value} value={value}>
                  {QUESTION_TYPE_LABELS[value]}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor={`points-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}>درجة السؤال *</Label>
          <Input
            id={`points-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}
            name="points"
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={100}
            dir="ltr"
            defaultValue={question?.points ?? 1}
            required
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-end gap-2 pb-2">
          <input
            id={`required-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}
            name="isRequired"
            type="checkbox"
            defaultChecked={question?.isRequired ?? true}
            className="size-4 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
          />
          <Label htmlFor={`required-${question?.id ?? "new"}`} className="text-xs">
            إجابته إلزامية
          </Label>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor={`textAr-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}>نص السؤال (بالعربية) *</Label>
        <Textarea
          id={`textAr-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}
          name="textAr"
          rows={2}
          defaultValue={question?.textAr ?? ""}
          required
        />
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor={`textEn-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}>
          نص السؤال بالإنجليزية (اختياري)
        </Label>
        <Input
          id={`textEn-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}
          name="textEn"
          dir="ltr"
          defaultValue={question?.textEn ?? ""}
        />
      </div>

      {isChoice && (
        <div className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border bg-background/60 p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <Label className="text-xs">
              الخيارات * — حدّد {type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? "الإجابة الصحيحة الواحدة" : "كل الإجابات الصحيحة"}
            </Label>
            {optionTexts.length < OPTIONS_MAX && (
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setOptionTexts((current) => [...current, ""])}
              >
                <ListPlus className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                خيار إضافي
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          {optionTexts.map((text, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type={type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? "radio" : "checkbox"}
                name={type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" ? "correct-radio" : undefined}
                checked={correctIndexes.includes(index)}
                onChange={(event) => toggleCorrectIndex(index, event.target.checked)}
                aria-label={`الإجابة الصحيحة للخيار ${index + 1}`}
                className="size-4 shrink-0 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
              />
              <Input
                value={text}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setOptionTexts((current) =>
                    current.map((value, i) => (i === index ? event.target.value : value))
                  )
                }
                placeholder={`نص الخيار ${index + 1}`}
                required
                className="flex-1"
              />
              {optionTexts.length > 2 && (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="icon"
                  className="size-8 shrink-0"
                  aria-label={`حذف الخيار ${index + 1}`}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setOptionTexts((current) => current.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
                    setCorrectIndexes((current) =>
                      current
                        .filter((value) => value !== index)
                        .map((value) => (value > index ? value - 1 : value))
                    );
                  }}
                >
                  <X className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {type === "TRUE_FALSE" && (
        <div className="space-y-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-background/60 p-3">
          <Label className="text-xs">الإجابة الصحيحة *</Label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            {(["true", "false"] as const).map((value) => (
              <label key={value} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="correct-value-radio"
                  checked={correctValue === value}
                  onChange={() => setCorrectValue(value)}
                  className="size-4 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
                />
                {TRUE_FALSE_LABELS[value]}
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {type === "SHORT_ANSWER" && (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor={`model-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}>
            الإجابة النموذجية (مساعدة للمراجع — اختيارية)
          </Label>
          <Textarea
            id={`model-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}
            name="modelAnswer"
            rows={2}
            defaultValue={
              question?.answerKey && "modelAnswer" in question.answerKey
                ? question.answerKey.modelAnswer ?? ""
                : ""
            }
          />
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            أسئلة الإجابة القصيرة تُدرّج يدويًا بعد التسليم — تظهر المحاولة بحالة &quot;بانتظار المراجعة&quot;.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor={`explanation-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}>
          تغذية راجعة تظهر بعد التسليم (اختياري)
        </Label>
        <Textarea
          id={`explanation-${question?.id ?? "new"}`}
          name="explanation"
          rows={2}
          defaultValue={question?.explanation ?? ""}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="submit">
          <Save className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          {mode === "create" ? "إضافة السؤال" : "حفظ التعديلات"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/** Exported for the editor preview (maps option rows safely). */
export function questionOptionTexts(options: QuestionOption[]): string[] {
  return options.map((option) => option.textAr);
}
