"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Clock,
  ListChecks,
  Save,
  Send,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  saveDraftAction,
  submitAttemptAction,
  type AssessmentFormState,
} from "@/app/actions/assessment";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { TRUE_FALSE_LABELS } from "@/config/assessment";
import type { TakeAttemptView } from "@/lib/assessment/service";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Teacher attempt UI: one question per screen, numbered navigation,    */
/* per-type inputs (RTL, keyboard accessible), debounced server-side    */
/* draft autosave, and a countdown for timed assessments.               */
/*                                                                      */
/* SECURITY: the deadline is enforced by the SERVER on submit — this    */
/* timer is a courtesy display only. No answer keys exist in this       */
/* component (they never cross the RSC boundary before submission).     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

type AnswerEntry = { choice?: string[]; bool?: boolean; text?: string };

interface TakeAssessmentProps {
  view: TakeAttemptView;
}

export function TakeAssessment({ view }: TakeAssessmentProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { attempt, assessment, questions } = view;

  const [answers, setAnswers] = React.useState<Record<string, AnswerEntry>>(
    () => {
      const initial: Record<string, AnswerEntry> = {};
      for (const answer of view.savedAnswers) {
        initial[answer.questionId] = {
          choice: answer.choice,
          bool: answer.bool,
          text: answer.text,
        };
      }
      return initial;
    }
  );
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = React.useState(0);
  const [showReview, setShowReview] = React.useState(false);
  const [draftSavedAt, setDraftSavedAt] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = React.useState<number | null>(null);
  const autoSubmittedRef = React.useRef(false);

  const [submitState, submitFormAction] = React.useActionState<
    AssessmentFormState | null,
    FormData
  >(submitAttemptAction, null);
  const [, saveFormAction] = React.useActionState<
    AssessmentFormState | null,
    FormData
  >(saveDraftAction, null);
  const [isSaving, startSaving] = React.useTransition();

  const answersJson = React.useMemo(
    () =>
      JSON.stringify(
        questions.map((question) => ({
          questionId: question.id,
          ...(answers[question.id] ?? {}),
        }))
      ),
    [answers, questions]
  );
  const answersJsonRef = React.useRef(answersJson);
  answersJsonRef.current = answersJson;

  /* Countdown (cosmetic — the server enforces the real deadline). */
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!attempt.deadlineAt) return;
    const deadline = new Date(attempt.deadlineAt).getTime();
    function tick() {
      const left = Math.max(0, Math.round((deadline - Date.now()) / 1000));
      setRemaining(left);
    }
    tick();
    const interval = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [attempt.deadlineAt]);

  /* Debounced server-side draft autosave. */
  const firstRenderRef = React.useRef(true);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (firstRenderRef.current) {
      firstRenderRef.current = false;
      return;
    }
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.set("attemptId", attempt.id);
      formData.set("answersJson", answersJsonRef.current);
      startSaving(async () => {
        await saveFormAction(formData);
        setDraftSavedAt(
          new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar", {
            hour: "2-digit",
            minute: "2-digit",
            second: "2-digit",
          }).format(new Date())
        );
      });
    }, 2500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [answers]);

  /* Auto-submit exactly once when the countdown reaches zero. */
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (remaining === null || remaining > 0 || autoSubmittedRef.current) return;
    autoSubmittedRef.current = true;
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set("attemptId", attempt.id);
    formData.set("answersJson", answersJsonRef.current);
    startSaving(async () => {
      await submitFormAction(formData);
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [remaining]);

  const current = questions[currentIndex];
  const unansweredRequired = questions.filter((question) => {
    const answer = answers[question.id];
    if (!question.isRequired) return false;
    if (!answer) return true;
    if (question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE") return !answer.choice?.length;
    if (question.type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE") return !answer.choice?.length;
    if (question.type === "TRUE_FALSE") return answer.bool === undefined;
    return !(answer.text ?? "").trim();
  });

  function setAnswer(questionId: string, entry: AnswerEntry) {
    setAnswers((current) => ({ ...current, [questionId]: entry }));
  }

  const minutes = remaining === null ? null : Math.floor(remaining / 60);
  const seconds = remaining === null ? null : remaining % 60;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Header card: timer + progress + draft indicator */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-card px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
          <ListChecks className="size-4 text-brand-600" aria-hidden="true" />
          السؤال {currentIndex + 1} من {questions.length}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {isSaving ? (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
              <Save className="size-3.5 animate-pulse" aria-hidden="true" />
              جارٍ حفظ المسودة…
            </span>
          ) : draftSavedAt ? (
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-success">
              حُفظت المسودة {draftSavedAt}
            </span>
          ) : null}
          {remaining !== null && (
            <span
              className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-extrabold tabular-nums ${
                remaining <= 60
                  ? "bg-error-soft text-error"
                  : "bg-brand-50 text-brand-700"
              }`}
              role="timer"
              aria-label="الوقت المتبقي"
            >
              <Clock className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              {minutes}:{String(seconds).padStart(2, "0")}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {submitState?.message && (
        <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert">
          <AlertTriangle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          <AlertDescription>
            {submitState.message}
            {submitState.message.includes("وقت") && (
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="link"
                className="h-auto p-0 ps-2 text-xs"
                onClick={() => router.push(`/assessments/${assessment.id}`)}
              >
                العودة إلى الاختبار
              </Button>
            )}
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Question navigation grid */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" role="tablist" aria-label="التنقل بين الأسئلة">
        {questions.map((question, index) => {
          const answered =
            question.type === "TRUE_FALSE"
              ? answers[question.id]?.bool !== undefined
              : question.type === "SHORT_ANSWER"
                ? Boolean(answers[question.id]?.text?.trim())
                : Boolean(answers[question.id]?.choice?.length);
          return (
            <button
              key={question.id}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={index === currentIndex}
              onClick={() => setCurrentIndex(index)}
              className={`size-9 rounded-lg text-xs font-extrabold tabular-nums transition-colors ${
                index === currentIndex
                  ? "bg-brand-600 text-white"
                  : answered
                    ? "bg-success-soft text-success"
                    : "border bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
              }`}
            >
              {index + 1}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Current question */}
      {current && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-5" role="tabpanel">
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-brand-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-brand-700">
              {current.points} نقاط
            </span>
            {current.isRequired && <span>إجابة إلزامية</span>}
          </div>
          <p className="text-base font-bold leading-relaxed text-foreground">
            {current.textAr}
          </p>
          {current.textEn && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
              {current.textEn}
            </p>
          )}

          <div className="mt-5">
            <QuestionInput
              question={current}
              value={answers[current.id] ?? {}}
              onChange={(entry) => setAnswer(current.id, entry)}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Navigation + submit */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          disabled={currentIndex === 0}
          onClick={() => setCurrentIndex((value) => Math.max(0, value - 1))}
        >
          <ChevronRight className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          السابق
        </Button>

        {currentIndex < questions.length - 1 ? (
          <Button
            type="button"
            onClick={() =>
              setCurrentIndex((value) => Math.min(questions.length - 1, value + 1))
            }
          >
            التالي
            <ChevronLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button type="button" onClick={() => setShowReview(true)}>
            <Send className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            مراجعة وتسليم
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Review-before-submit modal */}
      {showReview && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="مراجعة الإجابات قبل التسليم"
        >
          <div className="max-h-[85vh] w-full max-w-lg overflow-y-auto rounded-xl bg-card p-5 shadow-lg">
            <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-foreground">
              مراجعة نهائية قبل التسليم
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              بعد التسليم لا يمكن تعديل الإجابات أو إعادة هذه المحاولة.
            </p>

            {unansweredRequired.length > 0 && (
              <Alert variant="destructive" className="mt-3">
                <AlertTriangle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                <AlertDescription>
                  لديك {unansweredRequired.length}{" "}
                  {unansweredRequired.length === 1 ? "سؤال إلزامي" : "أسئلة إلزامية"}{" "}
                  بدون إجابة:{" "}
                  {unansweredRequired.map((question, index) => (
                    <button
                      key={question.id}
                      type="button"
                      className="font-bold underline"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setCurrentIndex(questions.indexOf(question));
                        setShowReview(false);
                      }}
                    >
                      رقم {questions.indexOf(question) + 1}
                      {index < unansweredRequired.length - 1 ? "، " : ""}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* The real submission form — hidden payload updated at submit. */}
            <form action={submitFormAction} className="mt-4 space-y-3">
              <input type="hidden" name="attemptId" value={attempt.id} />
              <input
                type="hidden"
                name="answersJson"
                value={answersJson}
                ref={(node) => {
                  if (node) node.value = answersJsonRef.current;
                }}
              />
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => setShowReview(false)}
                >
                  متابعة الحل
                </Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={isSaving}>
                  <Send className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  {isSaving ? "جارٍ التسليم…" : "تسليم المحاولة نهائيًا"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------- Per-type input -------------------------- */

function QuestionInput({
  question,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  question: TakeAttemptView["questions"][number];
  value: AnswerEntry;
  onChange: (entry: AnswerEntry) => void;
}) {
  if (question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE") {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-2" role="radiogroup" aria-label="خيارات السؤال">
        {question.options.map((option, index) => (
          <label
            key={option.id}
            className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent has-[input:checked]:border-brand-600 has-[input:checked]:bg-brand-50"
          >
            <input
              type="radio"
              name={`q-${question.id}`}
              checked={value.choice?.[0] === option.id}
              onChange={() => onChange({ choice: [option.id] })}
              className="size-4 shrink-0 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
            />
            <span className="font-semibold">{option.textAr}</span>
            <span className="ms-auto text-[10px] text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true">
              {index + 1}
            </span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (question.type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE") {
    const selected = new Set(value.choice ?? []);
    function toggle(optionId: string, checked: boolean) {
      const next = new Set(selected);
      if (checked) next.add(optionId);
      else next.delete(optionId);
      onChange({ choice: [...next] });
    }
    return (
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {question.options.map((option) => (
          <label
            key={option.id}
            className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent has-[input:checked]:border-brand-600 has-[input:checked]:bg-brand-50"
          >
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={selected.has(option.id)}
              onChange={(event) => toggle(option.id, event.target.checked)}
              className="size-4 shrink-0 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
            />
            <span className="font-semibold">{option.textAr}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          اختر كل الإجابات الصحيحة — تُحتسب الدرجة عند تطابق الاختيارات تمامًا.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (question.type === "TRUE_FALSE") {
    return (
      <div className="flex gap-3" role="radiogroup" aria-label="صح أو خطأ">
        {(["true", "false"] as const).map((key) => {
          const boolValue = key === "true";
          return (
            <label
              key={key}
              className="flex flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-3 text-sm font-bold transition-colors hover:bg-accent has-[input:checked]:border-brand-600 has-[input:checked]:bg-brand-50"
            >
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={`q-${question.id}`}
                checked={value.bool === boolValue}
                onChange={() => onChange({ bool: boolValue })}
                className="size-4 accent-[#1D5BD6]"
              />
              {TRUE_FALSE_LABELS[key]}
            </label>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // SHORT_ANSWER
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Label htmlFor={`answer-${question.id}`} className="text-xs">
        اكتب إجابتك — تُراجع يدويًا بعد التسليم
      </Label>
      <Textarea
        id={`answer-${question.id}`}
        rows={4}
        value={value.text ?? ""}
        onChange={(event) => onChange({ text: event.target.value })}
        maxLength={2000}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

interface AuthCardProps {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Narrower card for verification result screens. */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Resolved identity (school or platform). Defaults to the platform
   * identity so unseen callers keep working unchanged. */
  branding?: PlatformBranding;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Shared shell for the gate screens (login, registration, verification,
 * password recovery) — a premium, school-branded portal experience.
 *
 * Design notes:
 *  - the identity header (logo + school/platform name) renders DIRECTLY
 *    on the page — no white box around the logo — and sits directly on
 *    top of the card so the two read as one composition;
 *  - the background carries restrained brand-tinted decoration (soft
 *    blurred shapes and a hairline ring) driven by the runtime CSS
 *    variables, so every school gets its own palette with zero assets;
 *  - the card itself is a single elevated surface with a brand gradient
 *    accent line, generous padding and a quiet security footnote.
 *
 * Colors follow the runtime CSS variables set by the caller, so the
 * same shell renders any school's identity without hardcoding it.
 */
export function AuthCard({
  title,
  description,
  children,
  footer,
  compact,
  branding,
  className,
}: AuthCardProps) {
  const resolved = branding ?? defaultBranding;
  const year = new Date().getFullYear();

  return (
    <div className="relative flex min-h-dvh flex-col overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-brand-50/80 via-background to-background">
      {/* Restrained brand decoration — pure CSS, follows the palette */}
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
        <div className="absolute -top-40 start-[-12%] size-[30rem] rounded-full bg-brand-200/40 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-[-14rem] end-[-10%] size-[28rem] rounded-full bg-brand-100/70 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="absolute top-[22%] end-[8%] hidden size-64 rounded-full border border-brand-200/60 md:block" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-[18%] start-[6%] hidden size-40 rounded-full border border-brand-200/40 lg:block" />
      </div>

      <main className="relative flex flex-1 items-center justify-center px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 sm:py-8">
        <div
          className={cn(
            "w-full animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 duration-500 motion-reduce:animate-none",
            compact ? "max-w-md" : "max-w-lg",
            className
          )}
        >
          {/* Identity header — visually connected to the card above it */}
          <div className="mb-4 flex justify-center sm:mb-5">
            <BrandLogo
              branding={resolved}
              variant="light"
              size="lg"
              orientation="vertical"
            />
          </div>

          {/* The card — one elevated surface, brand accent on top */}
          <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-border/60 bg-card/95 shadow-xl shadow-brand-900/10 backdrop-blur-sm">
            <div
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="h-1 w-full bg-gradient-to-l from-brand-600 via-brand-300 to-brand-600"
            />
            <div className="p-6 sm:p-8">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                {title}
              </h1>
              {description && (
                <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                  {description}
                </p>
              )}
              <div className="mt-5">{children}</div>

              <p className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border-t border-border/60 pt-3 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground/80">

                جلسة آمنة — جميع التحققات تتم على الخادم
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {footer && (
            <div className="mt-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">

          )}

const todayLabel = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
  weekday: "long",
  day: "numeric",
  month: "long",
  year: "numeric",
}).format(new Date());

/**

      {/* Real schools & branches metrics (persisted data) */}

}

              <KeyRound className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />

import Link from "next/link";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  BadgeCheck,
  Link2,
  ShieldAlert,
  UserCheck,
  UserRoundCheck,
} from "lucide-react";

import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/platform/status-badge";
import {
  getSchoolRegistrationStats,
  type RegistrationStats,
} from "@/lib/registration-links/service";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/**
 * Registration workflow visibility for the school administration
 * dashboard (Phase 6): registered / awaiting-verification /
 * awaiting-supervisor / assigned counts + the active link state.
 *   - schoolId present -> that school's numbers (office/school manager);
 *   - schoolId null    -> platform-wide aggregate (SUPER_ADMIN).
 */
export async function RegistrationMetricsSection({
  schoolId,
}: {
  schoolId?: string;
}) {
  const stats: RegistrationStats = schoolId
    ? await getSchoolRegistrationStats(schoolId)
    : {
        totalTeachers: await db.user.count({ where: { role: "TEACHER" } }),
        viaLinks: await db.user.count({
          where: { role: "TEACHER", registrationLinkId: { not: null } },
        }),
        awaitingVerification: await db.user.count({
          where: { role: "TEACHER", isActive: true, emailVerifiedAt: null },
        }),
        verifiedUnassigned: await db.user.count({
          where: {
            role: "TEACHER",
            isActive: true,
            emailVerifiedAt: { not: null },
            teacherSupervision: { is: null },
          },
        }),
        assigned: await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.count({
          where: { teacher: { isActive: true } },
        }),
      };

  // Active registration link status — the first card the manager checks.
  const activeLinkRow = schoolId
    ? await db.registrationLink.findFirst({
        where: { schoolId, isActive: true },
        select: { expiresAt: true },
      })
    : null;
  const activeLinkCount = schoolId
    ? null
    : await db.registrationLink.count({ where: { isActive: true } });

  const activeLinkExpired = activeLinkRow?.expiresAt
    ? activeLinkRow.expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now()
    : false;
  const activeLinkLabel = schoolId
    ? activeLinkRow
      ? activeLinkExpired
        ? "نشط لكن منتهي الصلاحية"
        : "نشط — يقبل التسجيلات"
      : "لا يوجد رابط نشط"
    : `${activeLinkCount ?? 0} رابط نشط على المنصة`;

  const unassigned = stats.verifiedUnassigned;

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="تسجيل المعلمين عبر الروابط"
      description="تسجيل معلم جديد ثم توثيق بريده ثم إسناده لمشرف تربوي — كل خطوة ظاهرة هنا بأرقامها الحقيقية."
      action={
        <Link
          href="/registration-links"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 transition-colors hover:bg-brand-50 hover:text-brand-700"
        >
          إدارة الروابط
          <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
        </Link>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-5">
        <RegStat
          label="إجمالي المعلمين"
          value={stats.totalTeachers}
          icon={<UserRoundCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <RegStat
          label="عبر روابط التسجيل"
          value={stats.viaLinks}
          icon={<Link2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <RegStat
          label="بانتظار التوثيق"
          value={stats.awaitingVerification}
          icon={<ShieldAlert className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <RegStat
          label="بانتظار الإسناد"
          value={stats.verifiedUnassigned}
          icon={<UserCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
        <RegStat
          label="مُسنَدون لمشرف"
          value={stats.assigned}
          icon={<BadgeCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3.5">
        <span className="text-sm font-bold">رابط التسجيل:</span>
        <StatusBadge
          tone={
            schoolId
              ? activeLinkRow && !activeLinkExpired
                ? "success"
                : "warning"
              : "info"
          }
        >
          {activeLinkLabel}
        </StatusBadge>
        {unassigned > 0 && (
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {unassigned} معلم موثّق بانتظار إسناد المشرف التربوي من تقنية المعلومات.
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

function RegStat({
  label,
  value,
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3.5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="text-brand-600">{icon}</span>
        {label}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-extrabold tabular-nums">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/**

 * ONLY the data its server-side boundary allows:
 *   - supervisor: branches assigned to them + teachers inside them;
 *   - deputy: explicitly granted schools/branches, read-only notice;
 *   - teacher: own real profile (school/branch/supervisor) + honest
 *     placeholders for the future professional modules.
 */
export async function RoleDashboard({ user }: { user: SafeUser }) {
  if (user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const [workspace, assignments] = await Promise.all([
      getSupervisorWorkspace(user.id),
      listSupervisorAssignments(user.id),
    ]);
    const teachers = workspace?.teachers ?? [];

    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <WelcomeHeader user={user} />
        <SectionCard
          title="الفروع المسندة إليك"
          description="يمكنك متابعة معلمي هذه الفروع فقط — الإسناد يتم من إدارة مكتب التطوير في مدرستك."
          action={

            >
              مساحة المشرف الكاملة
              <ArrowLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
            </Link>
          }
        >
          {assignments.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              لا توجد فروع مسندة إليك بعد — تواصل مع إدارة مكتب التطوير.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2" role="list">
              {assignments.map((assignment) => (
                <li
                  key={assignment.id}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-4"
                >
                  <span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-100 text-brand-700">
                    <MapPin className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold">
                      {assignment.branch.nameAr}
                    </span>
                    <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {branchStageLabel(assignment.branch.stage)}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </SectionCard>

        <SectionCard
          title={`المعلمون داخل نطاقك (${teachers.length})`}
          description="إسناد مباشر أو عبر تغطية الفروع — محصور دائمًا داخل مدرستك وبفروقك المصرّح بها."
        >
          {teachers.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              لا يوجد معلمون في نطاقك حتى الآن.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y rounded-xl border" role="list">
              {teachers.map((teacher) => (
                <li
                  key={teacher.id}
                  className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold">{teacher.name}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                      {teacher.email}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {teacher.branchName ?? "بدون فرع"}
                    </span>
                    <StatusBadge
                      tone={teacher.source === "explicit" ? "info" : "neutral"}
                      withDot={false}
                    >
                      {teacher.source === "explicit" ? "إسناد مباشر" : "عبر الفرع"}
                    </StatusBadge>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </SectionCard>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    const grants = await listDeputyGrants(user.id);

    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <WelcomeHeader user={user} />
        <SectionCard
          title="صلاحيات الاطلاع الممنوحة لك"

          action={

            <span className="min-w-0 leading-tight">

          </p>
        </div>
      </SectionCard>
    </div>
  );
}

function WelcomeHeader({ user }: { user: SafeUser }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border bg-card p-5 shadow-xs">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">أهلًا بك في منارة قرطبة</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-extrabold">
        {user.name}{" "}
        <span className="ms-1 rounded-full bg-brand-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700">
          {roleLabel(user.role)}
        </span>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProfileRow({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  value,
  ltr,
}: {
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  ltr?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3.5">
      <span className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-100 text-brand-700">
        <Icon className="size-5" aria-hidden="true" />
      </span>
      <span className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
        <span className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
        <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-sm font-bold" dir={ltr ? "ltr" : undefined}>
          {value}
        </span>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Cell, Pie, PieChart, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip } from "recharts";

import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { mockTeachersByStage } from "@/lib/mock-data";
import type { StageDistributionPoint } from "@/lib/types";

const chartColors = ["var(--chart-1)", "var(--chart-2)", "var(--chart-3)"];

function DonutTooltip({
  active,
  payload,
}: {
  active?: boolean;
  payload?: { name?: string | number; value?: number | string }[];
}) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  const entry = payload[0];
  return (
    <div dir="rtl" className="rounded-lg border bg-popover px-3 py-2 shadow-lg">
      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">{entry.name}</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="font-bold text-foreground tabular-nums">{entry.value}</span> معلم
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Teacher distribution across educational stages — donut chart fed
 * directly from the centralized mock dataset.
 */
export function StageDistributionChart() {
  const total = mockTeachersByStage.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.count, 0);

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="توزيع المعلمين على المراحل"
      description="عدد المعلمين في كل مرحلة دراسية"
    >
      <div className="relative mx-auto h-52 w-full max-w-60">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          <PieChart>
            <Tooltip content={<DonutTooltip />} />
            <Pie
              data={mockTeachersByStage as StageDistributionPoint[]}
              dataKey="count"
              nameKey="stage"
              innerRadius="68%"
              outerRadius="94%"
              paddingAngle={3}
              strokeWidth={0}
              cornerRadius={6}
            >
              {mockTeachersByStage.map((entry, index) => (
                <Cell key={entry.stage} fill={chartColors[index % chartColors.length]} />
              ))}
            </Pie>
          </PieChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
          <p className="text-3xl font-extrabold tabular-nums text-foreground">{total}</p>
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">إجمالي المعلمين</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ul className="mt-4 space-y-2.5" role="list" aria-label="تفاصيل توزيع المعلمين">
        {mockTeachersByStage.map((entry, index) => {
          const percent = Math.round((entry.count / total) * 100);
          return (
            <li key={entry.stage} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm">
              <span
                className="size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full"
                style={{ backgroundColor: chartColors[index % chartColors.length] }}
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <span className="flex-1 font-semibold text-foreground/85">{entry.stage}</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{percent}%</span>
              <span className="w-9 text-end text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-foreground">
                {entry.count}
              </span>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

"use client";

import {
  Bar,

  ComposedChart,

  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";

import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";
import { mockTrainingProgress } from "@/lib/mock-data";

interface TooltipPayloadItem {
  name?: string | number;
  value?: number | string;
  color?: string;
}

function ChartTooltip({
  active,
  payload,
  label,
}: {
  active?: boolean;
  payload?: TooltipPayloadItem[];
  label?: string | number;
}) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  return (
    <div dir="rtl" className="rounded-lg border bg-popover px-3 py-2 shadow-lg">
      <p className="mb-1 text-xs font-bold text-foreground">{label}</p>
      {payload.map((entry) => (
        <p key={entry.name} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span
            className="size-2 rounded-full"
            style={{ backgroundColor: entry.color }}
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          {entry.name === "completed" ? "ساعات منجزة" : "الهدف"}:{" "}
          <span className="font-bold text-foreground tabular-nums">{entry.value}</span> ساعة
        </p>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Monthly training progress: completed hours (bars) against the
 * monthly target (line). Rendered RTL: months flow right-to-left and
 * the value axis sits on the right. Data comes exclusively from the
 * centralized mock dataset.
 */
export function TrainingProgressChart() {
  const totalCompleted = mockTrainingProgress.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.completed, 0);
  const totalTarget = mockTrainingProgress.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.target, 0);
  const progressPercent = Math.round((totalCompleted / totalTarget) * 100);

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="تقدم التدريب الشهري"
      description="الساعات التدريبية المنجزة مقابل الهدف الشهري"
      action={
        <span className="rounded-full bg-brand-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700 ring-1 ring-brand-100">
          الإنجاز الكلي {progressPercent}%
        </span>
      }
    >
      <div dir="ltr" className="h-72 w-full">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          <ComposedChart data={mockTrainingProgress} margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, left: 8, bottom: 0 }}>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} stroke="var(--border)" />
            <XAxis
              dataKey="month"
              reversed
              tick={{ fill: "var(--muted-foreground)", fontSize: 12, fontFamily: "var(--font-cairo)" }}
              axisLine={{ stroke: "var(--border)" }}
              tickLine={false}
              dy={8}
            />
            <YAxis
              orientation="right"
              tick={{ fill: "var(--muted-foreground)", fontSize: 11 }}
              axisLine={false}
              tickLine={false}
              width={36}
            />
            <Tooltip content={<ChartTooltip />} cursor={{ fill: "var(--accent)", opacity: 0.5 }} />
            <Bar
              dataKey="completed"
              name="completed"
              fill="var(--chart-1)"
              radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]}
              maxBarSize={36}
            />
            <Line
              type="monotone"
              dataKey="target"
              name="target"
              stroke="var(--chart-4)"
              strokeWidth={2}
              strokeDasharray="6 4"
              dot={{ r: 3, fill: "var(--chart-4)", strokeWidth: 0 }}
            />
          </ComposedChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 border-t pt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="size-2.5 rounded-sm bg-[var(--chart-1)]" aria-hidden="true" />
          ساعات منجزة
        </span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">

  /** Resolved identity (platform or the signed-in user's school) —
   * computed on the SERVER from the session. Defaults to the platform
   * identity when not provided (gate screens). */
  branding?: PlatformBranding;
}

const PUBLIC_PREFIXES = [
  "/login",
  "/register",
  "/verify-email",
  "/forgot-password",
  "/reset-password",
  "/forbidden",
];

/**
 * Application shell: RTL sidebar (desktop), sticky topbar with
 * search/notifications/user menu (with real logout), mobile navigation
 * drawer and a sticky footer.
 *
 * Gate screens (login, registration, verification, recovery) render in
 * a minimal bare layout — this is presentation only; every security
 * decision is enforced on the server (middleware + per-page guards).
 */
export function AppShell({ children, user, allowedModuleIds, branding }: AppShellProps) {
  const resolvedBranding = branding ?? defaultBranding;
  const [mobileNavOpen, setMobileNavOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const items: NavItem[] = React.useMemo(
    () => navItems.filter((item) => allowedModuleIds.includes(item.id)),
    [allowedModuleIds]
  );

  const canManageBranding = items.some((item) => item.id === "school-branding");

  const isPublicRoute =
    !user || PUBLIC_PREFIXES.some((p) => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`));

  if (isPublicRoute) {
    return <div className="min-h-screen">{children}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen">
      <Sidebar
        branding={resolvedBranding}
        items={items}
        canManageBranding={canManageBranding}
      />

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
        <Topbar
          user={user}
          items={items}
          onOpenMobileNav={() => setMobileNavOpen(true)}
        />

        <main className="flex-1 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 sm:py-8 lg:px-8">
          <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl">{children}</div>
        </main>

        {/* Sticky footer: mt-auto keeps it at the bottom on short pages */}
        <footer className="mt-auto border-t border-border/70 bg-card/70 px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
          <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-7xl flex-col items-center justify-between gap-1.5 text-center sm:flex-row sm:text-start">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {resolvedBranding.productName} — {resolvedBranding.subtitle}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">
              منارة — مكتب التطوير التربوي © 2025
            </p>
          </div>
        </footer>
      </div>

      <MobileNav
        open={mobileNavOpen}
        onOpenChange={setMobileNavOpen}
        branding={resolvedBranding}
        user={user}
        items={items}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { GraduationCap } from "lucide-react";

import { FitText } from "@/components/layout/fit-text";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PlatformBranding } from "@/lib/types";

interface BrandLogoProps {
  branding: PlatformBranding;
  /** "sidebar" renders on the navy sidebar, "light" on light surfaces. */
  variant?: "sidebar" | "light";
  /** sm: rails and cards — lg: gate screens (login, register, recovery). */
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  /** horizontal: rails — vertical: centered gate-screen headers. */
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  withSubtitle?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Name sizes are EXPLICIT pixel ranges handed to <FitText>, which
 * measures the real rendered width of the school name and shrinks the
 * font so it ALWAYS stays on ONE line (min readable floor, ellipsis +
 * tooltip only beyond that floor). Previously these were fixed text-*
 * classes — long Arabic school names overflowed the rail.
 */
const SIZE_STYLES = {
  sm: {
    box: "size-10 rounded-xl",
    icon: "size-5.5",
    nameMaxPx: 16,
    nameMinPx: 9,
    subtitle: "text-xs",
  },
  md: {
    box: "size-12 rounded-xl",
    icon: "size-6.5",
    nameMaxPx: 18,
    nameMinPx: 10,
    subtitle: "text-xs",
  },
  lg: {
    box: "size-16 rounded-2xl sm:size-20",
    icon: "size-8 sm:size-9",
    nameMaxPx: 30,
    nameMinPx: 13,
    subtitle: "text-sm",
  },
} as const;

/**
 * Dynamic identity wordmark — platform or school.
 *
 * ROOT-CAUSE NOTE (sidebar overflow fix): this component renders as a
 * flex child inside rails and headers. A flex item's default
 * `min-width: auto` makes it refuse to shrink below its content width,
 * which let a long nowrap wordmark inflate this box past the sidebar
 * edge and disconnect the inner <FitText> measurement from the real
 * available width. The root is therefore pinned with min-w-0 /
 * max-w-full / overflow-hidden so the available width is ALWAYS the
 * parent's content box minus the fixed-size logo.
 *
 * The logo itself is FIXED-SIZE (shrink-0) — text never pushes it out
 * of the sidebar.
 */
export function BrandLogo({
  branding,
  variant = "sidebar",
  size = "sm",
  orientation = "horizontal",
  withSubtitle = true,
  className,
}: BrandLogoProps) {
  const light = variant === "light";
  const s = SIZE_STYLES[size];
  const stacked = orientation === "vertical";

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex min-w-0 max-w-full overflow-hidden",
        stacked
          ? "flex-col items-center gap-3 text-center"
          : "flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-start",
        className
      )}
    >
      {branding.logoUrl ? (
        // School logo (uploaded through the authorized branding manager).
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img
          src={branding.logoUrl}
          alt=""
          draggable={false}
          className={cn(
            "shrink-0 object-contain",
            light
              ? size === "lg"
                ? // Gate screens: height-driven, keeps the natural aspect
                  // ratio of any uploaded logo — no plate, no cropping.
                  "h-16 w-auto max-w-48 sm:h-20 sm:max-w-56"
                : s.box
              : cn(s.box, "bg-white p-0.5 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-black/5")
          )}
        />
      ) : (
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center",
            s.box,
            light
              ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-600 to-brand-800 text-white shadow-lg shadow-brand-600/25 ring-1 ring-brand-700/20"
              : "bg-white/10 text-white ring-1 ring-white/15"
          )}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <GraduationCap className={s.icon} strokeWidth={1.8} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        className={cn(
          "min-w-0 leading-tight",
          stacked ? "w-full space-y-1" : "flex-1"
        )}
      >
        <FitText
          maxPx={s.nameMaxPx}
          minPx={s.nameMinPx}
          className={cn(
            "font-extrabold tracking-tight",
            light ? "text-foreground" : "text-white"
          )}
          title={branding.productName}
        >
          {branding.productName}
        </FitText>
        {withSubtitle && (
          <p
            className={cn(
              "truncate font-medium",
              s.subtitle,
              light ? "text-muted-foreground" : "text-sidebar-foreground/70"
            )}
          >
            {branding.subtitle}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\components\layout\fit-text.tsx

"use client";

import * as React from "react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * FitText — single-line label that ALWAYS fits its container.
 *
 * Contract: the text is rendered on ONE line (white-space: nowrap),
 * sized to the actual available width of its container — never wider.
 * The font shrinks proportionally down to a readable floor; only a
 * name too long for the floor falls back to ellipsis + full-name
 * tooltip (never the primary mechanism).
 *
 * Why the previous attempt could still overflow:
 * the measurement trusted `offsetWidth` (integer-rounded) and the
 * container chain relied on flex intrinsic sizing. This version:
 *  1. Measures with getBoundingClientRect() (sub-pixel precision).
 *  2. Pins the box with inline minWidth:0 / maxWidth:100% so NO parent
 *     flex context can inflate it beyond the real available width.
 *  3. Re-measures on: mount (pre-paint), text change, container resize
 *     (ResizeObserver), window resize, web-font load, and a double
 *     requestAnimationFrame follow-up that catches late layout shifts
 *     (scrollbars, font swap, drawer open transitions).
 *
 * The hidden probe span renders the same text with the same font
 * classes at a fixed 100px reference size; required font size is
 * simply availableWidth / (probeWidth / 100), clamped to
 * [minPx, maxPx]. RTL-safe (pure width math) and SSR-safe (first
 * render matches the server output; the first adjustment happens in a
 * layout effect before paint, so no flash of overflowing text).
 */

const MEASURE_PX = 100;
/** 0.5% slack so sub-pixel rounding never triggers the ellipsis. */
const FIT_SAFETY = 0.995;

/** useLayoutEffect that silently no-ops during server rendering. */
const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect =
  typeof window !== "undefined" ? React.useLayoutEffect : React.useEffect;

interface FitTextProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {
  /** Largest allowed size in px — short names keep this size. */
  maxPx: number;
  /** Readable floor in px — below this the label truncates instead. */
  minPx?: number;
  /** The label text itself — a single string by design. */
  children: string;
}

export function FitText({
  maxPx,
  minPx = 9,
  children,
  className,
  title,
  ...rest
}: FitTextProps) {
  const boxRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const probeRef = React.useRef<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);
  const [fontPx, setFontPx] = React.useState(maxPx);

  const recompute = React.useCallback(() => {
    const box = boxRef.current;
    const probe = probeRef.current;
    if (!box || !probe) return;

    // Sub-pixel precise available width (clientWidth is rounded).
    const available = box.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    if (available <= 0) return;

    // The probe is absolutely positioned: its rect width is the full
    // single-line width of the text at the reference size.
    const natural = probe.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    if (natural <= 0) return;

    const exact = ((available * FIT_SAFETY) / natural) * MEASURE_PX;
    const next = Math.min(maxPx, Math.max(minPx, exact));
    setFontPx((current) => (Math.abs(current - next) > 0.1 ? next : current));
  }, [maxPx, minPx]);

  // 1) Measure BEFORE paint on mount and whenever the text changes.
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    recompute();
    // 2) Follow-up one frame later: fonts may have swapped and the
    // flex layout may have settled only after the first pass.
    const raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      recompute();
      requestAnimationFrame(recompute);
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [recompute, children]);

  // 3) Track the CONTAINER (sidebar resize, drawer opening, zoom).
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const box = boxRef.current;
    if (!box || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => recompute());
    observer.observe(box);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [recompute]);

  // 4) Window resize fallback (covers embedded webviews without RO).
  React.useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener("resize", recompute);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", recompute);
  }, [recompute]);

  // 5) Re-measure once the real web font replaces the fallback face.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const fonts = (
      document as Document & { fonts?: { ready: Promise<unknown> } }
    ).fonts;
    if (!fonts) return;
    fonts.ready
      .then(() => recompute())
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, [recompute]);

  // Only at the readable floor may the ellipsis appear.
  const clamped = fontPx <= minPx + 0.05;

  return (
    <div
      ref={boxRef}
      title={title}
      className="relative min-w-0 max-w-full overflow-hidden"
      style={{ minWidth: 0, maxWidth: "100%" }}
    >
      {/* Hidden single-line probe at the reference size — removed from
          flow, invisible, ignored by assistive tech and pointers. */}
      <span
        ref={probeRef}
        aria-hidden="true"
        className={cn(
          className,
          "invisible absolute start-0 top-0 whitespace-pre"
        )}
        style={{
          fontSize: `${MEASURE_PX}px`,
          pointerEvents: "none",
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </span>
      {/* Visible label — always one line; ellipsis only at the floor. */}
      <span
        className={cn(className, "block overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap")}
        style={{
          fontSize: `${fontPx}px`,
          ...(clamped ? { textOverflow: "ellipsis" } : {}),
        }}
        {...rest}
      >
        {children}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

interface MobileNavProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  branding: PlatformBranding;
  user: CurrentUser;
  items: NavItem[];
}

/**
 * Mobile navigation drawer. Slides from the inline-start edge (right
 * side in RTL) and mirrors the desktop sidebar navigation, including
 * its visual grouping — both read the SAME shared navGroupsForItems,
 * so the two can never drift apart: supervisors get the approved
 * 4-group architecture, every other role keeps the classic grouping.
 *
 * Active state uses the longest-href match — identical behavior to the
 * desktop sidebar. The drawer closes itself when a link is clicked and
 * the active state follows the current URL.
 */
export function MobileNav({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  branding,
  user,
  items,
}: MobileNavProps) {

  const activeId = activeNavItemId(pathname, items);
  const groups = navGroupsForItems(items);

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>

        side="right"
        className="flex w-80 flex-col bg-sidebar p-0 text-sidebar-foreground [&>button]:text-white/70"

              className={cn(groupIndex > 0 && "mt-5")}
            >
              {group.label && (

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Bell, CheckCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * Batch 1 — real, persisted notification bell.
 *
 * Replaces the demo topbar data: reads the session-scoped notifications
 * API (GET /api/notifications), polls while mounted, marks rows read
 * through the same owner-scoped API, and navigates each notification to
 * its server-built internal destination (course deep links carry the
 * REAL course id — the original HTML passed unrelated values).
 */

interface BellNotification {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  time: string;
  read: boolean;
  url: string | null;
}

export function NotificationBell() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<BellNotification[]>([]);
  const [unread, setUnread] = React.useState(0);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = React.useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);

  const load = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/notifications", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!response.ok) return;
      const payload = (await response.json()) as {
        unread: number;
        items: BellNotification[];
      };
      setItems(payload.items ?? []);
      setUnread(payload.unread ?? 0);
      setLoaded(true);
    } catch {
      // Network hiccup — keep the previous list; the poll retries.
    }
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => void load(), 60_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [load]);

  async function post(action: "markAll" | "markRead", id?: string) {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await fetch("/api/notifications", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action, id }),
      });
      await load();
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      // ignore — the next poll re-syncs
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function openNotification(notification: BellNotification) {
    if (!notification.read) {
      void post("markRead", notification.id);
    }
    setOpen(false);
    if (notification.url && notification.url.startsWith("/")) {
      router.push(notification.url);
    } else {
      router.push("/notifications");
    }
  }

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="icon"
          className="relative"
          aria-label={`الإشعارات${unread > 0 ? ` (${unread} غير مقروءة)` : ""}`}
          onClick={() => void load()}
        >
          <Bell className="size-5" />
          {unread > 0 && (
            <span
              className="absolute end-1.5 top-1.5 flex size-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-error text-[10px] font-bold text-white"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              {unread > 9 ? "٩+" : unread}
            </span>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent align="end" className="w-[min(22rem,92vw)] p-0">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-3">
          <p className="text-sm font-bold">الإشعارات</p>
          {unread > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void post("markAll")}
              disabled={busy}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-700 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <CheckCheck className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
              تحديد الكل كمقروء
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <ul className="scrollbar-thin max-h-80 overflow-y-auto" role="list">
          {!loaded ? (
            <li className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              جارٍ تحميل الإشعارات…
            </li>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <li className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              لا توجد إشعارات حالياً
            </li>
          ) : (
            items.map((notification) => (
              <li key={notification.id}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => openNotification(notification)}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 border-b px-4 py-3 text-start transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-accent",
                    !notification.read && "bg-brand-50/70"
                  )}
                >
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      "mt-1.5 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full",
                      notification.read ? "bg-muted" : "bg-brand-600"
                    )}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="block text-sm font-semibold leading-snug">
                      {notification.title}
                    </span>
                    {notification.description && (
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                        {notification.description}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70">
                      {notification.time}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))
          )}
        </ul>
        <div className="border-t px-4 py-2.5 text-center">
          <Link
            href="/notifications"
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-700"
            onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
          >
            عرض جميع الإشعارات
          </Link>
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { NavItem } from "@/lib/types";

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  label: string;
  /** When omitted the crumb renders as the current page (no link). */
  href?: string;
}

interface PageHeaderProps {
  /** Active module for the default trail (legacy Phase-1 usage). */
  module?: NavItem;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Optional contextual chips/meta rendered under the description. */
  meta?: React.ReactNode;
  actions?: React.ReactNode;
  /**
   * Phase 2: explicit breadcrumb trail rendered after the "الرئيسية"
   * root, which always links to "/". The last crumb is the current page.
   */
  breadcrumbs?: BreadcrumbItem[];
  /** Legacy home-crumb click handler (Phase 1 dashboard). */
  onNavigateHome?: () => void;
}

const crumbLinkClass =
  "rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-semibold transition-colors hover:text-brand-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring";

/**
 * Consistent page header: breadcrumb trail, page title, contextual
 * description and an optional actions slot.
 */
export function PageHeader({
  module,
  title,
  description,
  meta,
  actions,
  breadcrumbs,
  onNavigateHome,
}: PageHeaderProps) {
  const legacyIsHome = module?.id === "home";

  return (
    <div className="mb-6">
      {/* Breadcrumb */}
      <nav aria-label="مسار التنقل" className="mb-2">
        <ol className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground" role="list">
          {/* Root crumb */}
          <li>
            {breadcrumbs || !onNavigateHome ? (
              <Link href="/" className={cn(crumbLinkClass, legacyIsHome && "text-foreground")} aria-current={legacyIsHome ? "page" : undefined}>
                الرئيسية
              </Link>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onNavigateHome}
                className={cn(crumbLinkClass, legacyIsHome && "text-foreground")}
                aria-current={legacyIsHome ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                الرئيسية
              </button>
            )}
          </li>

          {/* Legacy module crumb (Phase 1 usage) */}
          {!breadcrumbs && module && !legacyIsHome && (
            <>
              <li aria-hidden="true">
                <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60" />
              </li>
              <li>
                <span className="rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-semibold text-foreground" aria-current="page">
                  {module.label}
                </span>
              </li>
            </>
          )}

          {/* Explicit Phase-2 trail */}
          {breadcrumbs?.map((crumb, index) => {
            const isLast = index === breadcrumbs.length - 1;
            return (
              <li key={`${crumb.label}-${index}`} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60" aria-hidden="true" />
                {crumb.href && !isLast ? (
                  <Link href={crumb.href} className={crumbLinkClass}>
                    {crumb.label}
                  </Link>
                ) : (
                  <span
                    className="rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-semibold text-foreground"
                    aria-current={isLast ? "page" : undefined}
                  >
                    {crumb.label}
                  </span>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      </nav>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h1 className="truncate text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground">
            {title}
          </h1>
          {description && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              {description}
            </p>
          )}
          {meta && <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{meta}</div>}
        </div>
        {actions && <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">{actions}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { NavItem, PlatformBranding } from "@/lib/types";

interface SidebarProps {
  branding: PlatformBranding;
  items: NavItem[];
  /** True when the role may manage school branding — upgrades the
   * identity card into a link to the branding manager. Computed on the
   * server (nav ids) — the sidebar never decides authorization. */
  canManageBranding?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Desktop application sidebar — premium navy rail on the inline-start
 * side, which in the RTL layout is the right edge of the screen.
 * Hidden on mobile (the mobile navigation Sheet takes over below lg).
 *
 * Active state uses the longest-href match, so nested routes highlight
 * exactly one item (e.g. /academy/manage/12 highlights "إدارة الدورات"
 * without also highlighting "الأكاديمية التدريبية").
 *
 * Grouping comes from the shared navGroupsForItems (same source as the
 * mobile drawer): supervisors get the approved 4-group information
 * architecture, every other role keeps the classic grouping. Grouping
 * is presentation only — it never adds, removes or re-orders modules.
 *
 * Overflow contract (verified in a real browser with 44-character
 * Arabic school names): the rail is a fixed 18rem; the school wordmark
 * and the identity-card name use <FitText>, which MEASURES the real
 * available width and scales the font down so the full name stays on
 * ONE line — never wrapping, never leaving the rail. The logo keeps a
 * fixed size; the operator signature line is a constant string (the
 * school name is already fully rendered twice above it).
 */
export function Sidebar({ branding, items, canManageBranding, className }: SidebarProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const activeId = activeNavItemId(pathname, items);
  const groups = navGroupsForItems(items);

  const schoolName = branding.currentSchool?.name ?? null;

  return (
    <aside
      className={cn(
        "hidden lg:flex lg:w-72 lg:max-w-full lg:shrink-0 lg:flex-col",
        "sticky top-0 h-screen overflow-hidden bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground",
        "border-e border-sidebar-border/70",
        className
      )}
    >
      {/* Brand — school wordmark auto-fits on one line. px-4 (not px-5)
          buys extra width for the name; the logo stays size-10 fixed. */}
      <div className="flex h-16 w-full min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center overflow-hidden border-b border-sidebar-border/70 px-4">
        <BrandLogo branding={branding} variant="sidebar" />
      </div>

      {/* Navigation */}
      <nav
        aria-label="التنقل الرئيسي"
        className="scrollbar-thin min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden px-3 pb-4 pt-2"
      >
        {groups.map((group, groupIndex) => (
          <div
            key={group.label || `extra-${groupIndex}`}
            className={cn(groupIndex > 0 && "mt-5")}
          >
            {group.label && (
              <p className="px-3 pb-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-sidebar-foreground/40">
                {group.label}
              </p>

import * as React from "react";

  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";

  PopoverAnchor,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { logoutAction } from "@/app/actions/auth";
import { NotificationBell } from "@/components/layout/notification-bell";
import type {
  CurrentUser,
  NavItem,
} from "@/lib/types";

interface TopbarProps {
  user: CurrentUser;
  items: NavItem[];
  onOpenMobileNav: () => void;
}

/**
 * Top application bar: clean white surface with the module search,
 * notifications, and the user identity + menu. Every visible control
 * performs a real action (navigation or a persisted state change) —
 * no dead buttons, no demo data.
 *
 * Notifications are REAL (Batch 1): the bell is the persisted
 * `NotificationBell` component — it reads the session-scoped
 * `/api/notifications` API, marks rows read through the same
 * owner-scoped API (the write is enforced server-side), and tapping a
 * notification navigates to the internal destination the server built
 * for it (course deep links carry the REAL course id).
 *
 * The user-menu "الإعدادات" entry renders only for roles whose
 * role-filtered `items` actually include the settings module — the
 * sidebar and the user menu can never disagree again.
 */
export function Topbar({
  user,
  items,
  onOpenMobileNav,
}: TopbarProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const canSeeSettings = items.some((item) => item.id === "settings");

  const normalizedQuery = query.trim();
  const searchResults =
    normalizedQuery.length > 0
      ? items.filter(
          (item) =>
            item.label.includes(normalizedQuery) ||
            item.description.includes(normalizedQuery)
        )
      : items;

  function handleNavigate(href: string) {
    setSearchOpen(false);
    setQuery("");
    router.push(href);
  }

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 items-center gap-2 border-b border-border/70 bg-card/90 px-4 backdrop-blur-md sm:gap-3 sm:px-6">
      {/* Mobile menu */}
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="icon"
        className="lg:hidden"
        onClick={onOpenMobileNav}
        aria-label="فتح قائمة التنقل"
      >
        <Menu className="size-5" />
      </Button>

      {/* Module search */}
      <Popover open={searchOpen} onOpenChange={setSearchOpen}>
        <PopoverAnchor asChild>
          <div className="relative hidden flex-1 md:block md:max-w-md">
            <Search
              className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3.5 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            <Input
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              onFocus={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
              placeholder="ابحث عن صفحة أو ميزة…"
              className="h-10 rounded-xl border-transparent bg-muted/60 ps-10 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-muted/80 focus-visible:bg-card"
              aria-label="البحث في المنصة"
            />
          </div>
        </PopoverAnchor>
        <PopoverContent
          align="start"
          className="w-[min(26rem,92vw)] rounded-xl p-2"
          onOpenAutoFocus={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
          <ul className="scrollbar-thin max-h-72 overflow-y-auto" role="listbox">
            {searchResults.length === 0 ? (
              <li className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                لا توجد نتائج مطابقة لـ «{normalizedQuery}»
              </li>
            ) : (
              searchResults.map((item) => {
                const Icon = item.icon;
                return (
                  <li key={item.id}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      role="option"
                      aria-selected="false"
                      onClick={() => handleNavigate(item.href)}
                      className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-start transition-colors hover:bg-accent focus-visible:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-none"
                    >
                      <span className="flex size-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-brand-50 text-brand-700">
                        <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold">
                          {item.label}
                        </span>
                        <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {item.description}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                      {item.badge && (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                          {item.badge}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })
            )}
          </ul>
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>

      {/* Notifications — real and persisted (Batch 1).

          /api/notifications, supports "تحديد الكل كمقروء" through the
          same owner-scoped API, navigates each row to its server-built
          internal destination, and polls every minute. */}
      <NotificationBell />

      {/* Flank (end side): pushes the user profile to the extreme left edge of the topbar (logical end in RTL). */}
      <div className="flex-1" aria-hidden="true" />

      <Separator orientation="vertical" className="hidden h-8 sm:block" />

      {/* User identity + menu */}
      <DropdownMenu>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl p-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            aria-label="قائمة المستخدم"
          >
            <Avatar className="size-9">
              <AvatarFallback className="bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-600 to-brand-800 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                {user.initials}
              </AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
            <span className="hidden min-w-0 text-start leading-tight sm:block">
              <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold">{user.name}</span>
              <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                {user.role}
              </span>
            </span>
            <ChevronDown className="hidden size-4 text-muted-foreground sm:block" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>
        <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-64 rounded-xl">
          <DropdownMenuLabel className="px-3 py-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Avatar className="size-10">
                <AvatarFallback className="bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-600 to-brand-800 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  {user.initials}
                </AvatarFallback>
              </Avatar>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold">{user.name}</p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                  {user.email}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </DropdownMenuLabel>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
            <Link href="/my-profile" className="cursor-pointer">
              <UserRound className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              الملف الشخصي
            </Link>
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          {canSeeSettings && (
            <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => handleNavigate("/settings")}>
              <Settings className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              الإعدادات
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          )}
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          {/* Real logout: the server action clears the session cookie. */}
          <form action={logoutAction}>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-error outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-error-soft focus:bg-error-soft"
            >
              <LogOut className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              تسجيل الخروج
            </button>
          </form>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
    </header>
  );
}

/**

  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Course attachment registration target. */
  attachTo?: AttachTarget;
  deleteOnRemove?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export type { MediaKind };

  value,
  onChange,
  label,
  hint,
  maxBytes,
  disabled,
  attachTo,
  deleteOnRemove,
  className,

    <MediaInput
      kind="document"

      maxBytes={maxBytes}
