"use client";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* MediaInput — the unified image/video field used across the platform. */
/*                                                                      */
/* TWO input modes behind a segmented control (Arabic RTL):             */
/*   • «رابط خارجي» — paste an existing https URL (zero configuration,  */
/*     validated + previewed, saved as-is, never copied into R2).       */
/*   • «رفع ملف» — direct device upload to Cloudflare R2 through a      */
/*     presigned PUT (progress bar via XHR), then server-side HEAD      */
/*     verification + optional Attachment registration.                 */
/*                                                                      */
/* Honest state: when the server lacks the R2 environment variables,    */
/* the upload attempt returns a clear Arabic notice and this component  */
/* renders it — it never fakes success. URL mode always works.          */
/*                                                                      */
/* Reusable everywhere: school logos, course/program covers, lesson     */
/* videos — via the thin <ImageInput> / <VideoInput> wrappers.          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

import * as React from "react";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  CloudUpload,
  Link2,
  Loader2,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { EmbeddedVideoFrame } from "@/components/training/embedded-video-frame";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { parseEmbeddableVideoUrl } from "@/lib/media/video-url";
import {
  confirmMediaUploadAction,
  removeMediaAction,
  requestMediaUploadAction,
  type AttachTarget,
} from "@/app/actions/media";

export type MediaKind = "image" | "video" | "document";

const ACCEPT_FOR_KIND: Record<MediaKind, string> = {
  image: "image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp,.gif",
  video: "video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime,.mp4,.webm,.mov",
  document:
    "application/pdf,.pdf,.doc,.docx,.ppt,.pptx,.xls,.xlsx,audio/mpeg,audio/mp4,audio/wav,audio/ogg,.mp3,.m4a,.wav,.ogg,.txt,.doc,.docx,.ppt,.pptx,.xls,.xlsx,image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp",
};

const MIME_BY_EXTENSION: Record<string, string> = {
  png: "image/png",
  jpg: "image/jpeg",
  jpeg: "image/jpeg",
  webp: "image/webp",
  gif: "image/gif",
  mp4: "video/mp4",
  webm: "video/webm",
  mov: "video/quicktime",
  pdf: "application/pdf",
  doc: "application/msword",
  docx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
  ppt: "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint",
  pptx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation",
  xls: "application/vnd.ms-excel",
  xlsx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
  mp3: "audio/mpeg",
  m4a: "audio/mp4",
  wav: "audio/wav",
  ogg: "audio/ogg",
  txt: "text/plain",
};

/** Client-side ceilings (the server re-validates authoritatively). */
const DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES: Record<MediaKind, number> = {
  image: 5 * 1024 * 1024,
  video: 512 * 1024 * 1024,
  document: 25 * 1024 * 1024,
};

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes >= 1024 * 1024) {
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} ميجابايت`;
  }
  return `${Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1024))} كيلوبايت`;
}

function mimeForFile(file: File): string {
  if (file.type) return file.type;
  const ext = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
  return MIME_BY_EXTENSION[ext] ?? "";
}

function isManagedUrl(url: string): boolean {
  // R2_PUBLIC_URL-hosted URLs are also managed, but the client cannot
  // see the configured base — the /api/media proxy path is the reliable
  // client-side signal; the badge is cosmetic either way.
  return url.startsWith("/api/media/");
}

export interface MediaInputProps {
  kind: MediaKind;
  /** Current stored value — an external URL, a managed URL, or empty. */
  value?: string | null | undefined;
  onChange: (url: string | null) => void;
  label?: string;
  hint?: string;
  /** Client-side size ceiling override (server limits still apply). */
  maxBytes?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Fires when a file is chosen (before upload) — palette analysis etc. */
  onFileSelected?: (file: File | null) => void;
  /** Also delete the stored R2 object when removing (reference-safe). */
  deleteOnRemove?: boolean;
  /** Course-builder registration target (cover / lesson primary media). */
  attachTo?: AttachTarget;
  className?: string;
}

type Phase = "idle" | "requesting" | "uploading" | "confirming";

export function MediaInput({
  kind,
  value,
  onChange,
  label,
  hint,
  maxBytes,
  disabled = false,
  onFileSelected,
  deleteOnRemove = false,
  attachTo,
  className,
}: MediaInputProps) {
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<"url" | "upload">(() =>
    value && isManagedUrl(value) ? "upload" : "url"
  );
  const [urlDraft, setUrlDraft] = React.useState(value ?? "");
  const [urlError, setUrlError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [file, setFile] = React.useState<File | null>(null);
  const [phase, setPhase] = React.useState<Phase>("idle");
  const [progress, setProgress] = React.useState(0);
  const [notice, setNotice] = React.useState<{ bad: boolean; text: string } | null>(
    null
  );

  const inputId = React.useId();
  const busy = phase !== "idle";
  const effectiveMax = maxBytes ?? DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES[kind];
  const kindLabel =
    kind === "image" ? "صورة" : kind === "document" ? "مرفق" : "فيديو";

  // Keep the draft in sync when the value changes from the outside.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setUrlDraft(value ?? "");
  }, [value]);

  function switchMode(next: "url" | "upload") {
    if (busy) return;
    setMode(next);
    setNotice(null);
    setUrlError(null);
  }

  /* ---------------- URL mode ---------------- */

  function applyExternalUrl() {
    const draft = urlDraft.trim();
    if (!draft) {
      setUrlError("أدخل رابطًا أولًا.");
      return;
    }
    let parsed: URL;
    try {
      parsed = new URL(draft);
    } catch {
      setUrlError("الرابط غير صالح — مثال صحيح: https://example.com/file");
      return;
    }
    if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" && parsed.protocol !== "http:") {
      setUrlError("الرابط يجب أن يبدأ بـ https:// أو http://");
      return;
    }
    setUrlError(null);
    setNotice({ bad: false, text: "تم تعيين الرابط — يُحفظ مع النموذج." });
    onChange(draft);
  }

  /* ---------------- Upload mode ---------------- */

  function handleFileChosen(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const chosen = event.target.files?.[0] ?? null;
    setNotice(null);
    setFile(null);
    if (!chosen) {
      onFileSelected?.(null);
      return;
    }
    const mime = mimeForFile(chosen);
    const validMime =
      kind === "image"
        ? mime.startsWith("image/")
        : kind === "video"
          ? mime.startsWith("video/")
          : mime.startsWith("application/") ||
            mime.startsWith("audio/") ||
            mime.startsWith("text/") ||
            mime.startsWith("image/");
    if (!validMime) {
      setNotice({
        bad: true,
        text:
          kind === "image"
            ? "صيغة الصورة غير مدعومة — المسموح: PNG أو JPG أو WEBP أو GIF."
            : kind === "document"
              ? "صيغة المرفق غير مدعومة — المسموح: PDF أو Word أو Excel أو PowerPoint أو صوت أو صورة أو نص."
              : "صيغة الفيديو غير مدعومة — المسموح: MP4 أو WEBM أو MOV.",
      });
      onFileSelected?.(null);
      return;
    }
    if (chosen.size > effectiveMax) {
      setNotice({
        bad: true,
        text: `حجم الملف ${formatBytes(chosen.size)} ويتجاوز الحد الأقصى ${formatBytes(effectiveMax)}.`,
      });
      onFileSelected?.(null);
      return;
    }
    setFile(chosen);
    onFileSelected?.(chosen);
  }

  /** Direct browser → R2 PUT with real progress events. */
  function putWithProgress(
    uploadUrl: string,
    contentType: string,
    target: File
  ): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open("PUT", uploadUrl);
      xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", contentType);
      xhr.upload.onprogress = (event) => {
        if (event.lengthComputable) {
          setProgress(event.loaded / event.total);
        }
      };
      xhr.onload = () => {
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) resolve();
        else reject(new Error(`R2_REJECTED_${xhr.status}`));
      };
      xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error("NETWORK"));
      xhr.onabort = () => reject(new Error("ABORTED"));
      xhr.send(target);
    });
  }

  async function handleUpload() {
    if (!file || busy) return;
    const mimeType = mimeForFile(file);
    // Images ride the dedicated "image" pipeline even from the document
    // field — the server allow-lists are kind-specific, so request and
    // confirmation must both carry the matching kind.
    const serverKind: MediaKind =
      kind === "document" && mimeType.startsWith("image/") ? "image" : kind;
    setNotice(null);
    setProgress(0);
    try {
      setPhase("requesting");
      const request = await requestMediaUploadAction({
        kind: serverKind,
        fileName: file.name,
        mimeType,
        sizeBytes: file.size,
      });
      if (!request.ok) {
        setNotice({ bad: true, text: request.message });
        setPhase("idle");
        return;
      }

      setPhase("uploading");
      await putWithProgress(request.uploadUrl, mimeType, file);

      setPhase("confirming");
      const confirmed = await confirmMediaUploadAction({
        key: request.key,
        publicUrl: request.publicUrl,
        originalName: file.name,
        mimeType,
        kind: serverKind,
        attachTo,
      });
      if (!confirmed.ok) {
        setNotice({ bad: true, text: confirmed.message });
        setPhase("idle");
        return;
      }

      onChange(confirmed.url);
      setFile(null);
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId) as HTMLInputElement | null;
      if (input) input.value = "";
      setNotice({ bad: false, text: "تم الرفع بنجاح واحتساب الرابط النهائي." });
    } catch (error) {
      const raw = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "";
      setNotice({
        bad: true,
        text: raw.startsWith("R2_REJECTED_")
          ? "رفض التخزين السحابي الملف — تحقق من إعدادات الـ bucket والصيغة."
          : raw === "NETWORK"
            ? "تعذّر الوصول للتخزين السحابي من المتصفح — الأغلب أن سياسة CORS غير مضبوطة على bucket في Cloudflare (bucket ← Settings ← CORS policy: أضف نطاق الموقع مع الطريقة PUT). جرّب مرة أخرى بعد ضبطها."
            : "انقطع الاتصال أثناء الرفع — حاول مرة أخرى.",
      });
    } finally {
      setPhase("idle");
      setProgress(0);
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- Remove ---------------- */

  function handleRemove() {
    if (busy) return;
    const previous = value;
    onChange(null);
    setUrlDraft("");
    setFile(null);
    setNotice(null);
    onFileSelected?.(null);
    if (previous && deleteOnRemove && isManagedUrl(previous)) {
      void removeMediaAction(previous).catch(() => undefined);
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- Render ---------------- */

  const showPreview = Boolean(value);
  /** YouTube/Vimeo links preview through the provider embed, not <video>. */
  const embeddable = kind === "video" && typeof value === "string" && parseEmbeddableVideoUrl(value) !== null;
  const phaseText =
    phase === "requesting"
      ? "تجهيز الرفع…"
      : phase === "uploading"
        ? `جارٍ الرفع… ${Math.round(progress * 100)}%`
        : "تأكيد الملف على التخزين…";

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {(label || hint) && (
        <div className="mb-2">
          {label && (
            <span className="block text-sm font-bold">{label}</span>
          )}
          {hint && (
            <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              {hint}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Segmented control — the two input modes */}
      <div
        role="tablist"
        aria-label={`مصدر ${kindLabel}`}
        className="inline-flex max-w-full rounded-xl bg-muted p-1"
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={mode === "url"}
          disabled={disabled || busy}
          onClick={() => switchMode("url")}
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors",
            "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60",
            mode === "url"
              ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm"
              : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
          )}
        >
          <Link2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          رابط خارجي
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={mode === "upload"}
          disabled={disabled || busy}
          onClick={() => switchMode("upload")}
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors",
            "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60",
            mode === "upload"
              ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-sm"
              : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
          )}
        >
          <CloudUpload className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          رفع ملف
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3">
        {mode === "url" ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Input
                dir="ltr"
                value={urlDraft}
                onChange={(event) => setUrlDraft(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Enter") {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    applyExternalUrl();
                  }
                }}
                placeholder={
                  kind === "image"
                    ? "https://example.com/image.png"
                    : kind === "document"
                      ? "https://example.com/file.pdf"
                      : "https://example.com/video.mp4 أو رابط يوتيوب"
                }
                disabled={disabled || busy}
                aria-invalid={Boolean(urlError)}
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 font-mono text-xs"
                aria-label={`رابط ${kindLabel} خارجي`}
              />
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={applyExternalUrl}
                disabled={disabled || busy}
              >
                تعيين الرابط
              </Button>
            </div>
            {urlError && (
              <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
                <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                {urlError}
              </p>
            )}
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              الروابط الخارجية تُحفظ كما هي — لا تُنسخ إلى التخزين السحابي، وروابط
              يوتيوب (watch و youtu.be و shorts و embed) تُشغَّل مدمجةً داخل صفحة الدرس.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <label
                htmlFor={inputId}
                className="inline-flex h-9 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border bg-card px-3 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors hover:bg-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                <CloudUpload className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                {file ? "تغيير الملف" : `اختر ملف ${kindLabel}`}
              </label>
              <input
                id={inputId}
                type="file"
                accept={ACCEPT_FOR_KIND[kind]}
                className="sr-only"
                onChange={handleFileChosen}
                disabled={disabled || busy}
              />
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => void handleUpload()}
                disabled={disabled || !file || busy}
              >
                {busy ? (
                  <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <CloudUpload className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
                {busy ? phaseText : "رفع وحفظ"}
              </Button>
              {file && !busy && (
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {file.name} — {formatBytes(file.size)}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Upload progress */}
            {phase === "uploading" && (
              <div
                className="h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted"
                role="progressbar"
                aria-valuenow={Math.round(progress * 100)}
                aria-valuemin={0}
                aria-valuemax={100}
              >
                <div
                  className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand-600 transition-[width] duration-200"
                  style={{ width: `${Math.max(4, progress * 100)}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            )}
            {phase === "requesting" && (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{phaseText}</p>
            )}
            <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
              الرفع المباشر يتطلب تهيئة التخزين السحابي (Cloudflare R2) على
              الخادم — بدون التهيئة سيظهر تنبيه عند محاولة الرفع، وإدخال
              الروابط الخارجية يعمل دائمًا. الحد الأقصى:{" "}
              {formatBytes(effectiveMax)}.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Status notices */}
      {notice && (
        <p
          className={cn(
            "mt-2 flex items-start gap-1 text-xs font-semibold",
            notice.bad ? "text-destructive" : "text-success"
          )}
          role={notice.bad ? "alert" : "status"}
        >
          {notice.bad ? (
            <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          <span className="min-w-0">{notice.text}</span>
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Preview + remove */}
      {showPreview && value && (
        <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-card px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground ring-1 ring-border">
              {isManagedUrl(value)
                ? "مخزَّن سحابيًا (R2)"
                : kind === "video" && embeddable
                  ? "فيديو مدمج (YouTube/Vimeo)"
                  : "رابط خارجي"}
            </span>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="h-7 gap-1 text-xs text-destructive hover:text-destructive"
              onClick={handleRemove}
              disabled={disabled || busy}
            >
              <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
              إزالة
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2">
            {kind === "document" ? (
              <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-background px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                <span className="block truncate font-mono text-[11px]" dir="ltr">
                  {value}
                </span>
                <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] font-normal">
                  سيظهر هذا المرفق للمعلمين كملف قابل للتنزيل في صفحة التدريب.
                </span>
              </p>
            ) : kind === "image" ? (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
              <img
                src={value}
                alt="معاينة الصورة"
                className="mx-auto max-h-44 w-auto max-w-full rounded-lg border bg-white object-contain p-1"
                draggable={false}
                onError={() =>
                  setNotice({ bad: true, text: "تعذر تحميل الصورة من الرابط المحفوظ." })
                }
              />
            ) : embeddable ? (
              /* YouTube/Vimeo — the provider iframe previews the saved
                 link (a native <video> tag cannot read a watch page). */
              <>
                <EmbeddedVideoFrame
                  src={value}
                  title="معاينة الفيديو المدمج"
                  className="aspect-video max-h-60 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-black"
                />
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                  معاينة مدمجة داخل المنصة — سيُشغَّل الفيديو داخل صفحة الدرس مباشرة دون إعادة توجيه.
                </p>
              </>
            ) : (
              <video
                src={value}
                controls
                preload="metadata"
                className="max-h-60 w-full rounded-lg border bg-black"
                onError={() =>
                  setNotice({
                    bad: true,
                    text:
                      "تعذر تحميل الفيديو من الرابط المحفوظ — تأكد أنه ملف فيديو مباشر (MP4/WEBM) أو رابط يوتيوب صحيح.",
                  })
                }
              />
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 truncate font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
            {value}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { MediaInput, type MediaKind } from "@/components/media/media-input";
import type { AttachTarget } from "@/app/actions/media";

/**
 * VideoInput — <MediaInput kind="video"> preset for video fields:
 * lesson videos, course trailers, … Large files upload DIRECTLY from
 * the browser to R2 via a presigned PUT (progress bar) — they never
 * stream through the Next.js server.
 * Both «رابط خارجي» and «رفع ملف» modes with inline playback preview.
 */
export interface VideoInputProps {
  value?: string | null | undefined;
  onChange: (url: string | null) => void;
  label?: string;
  hint?: string;
  /** Client-side size ceiling override (default 512MB, server-verified). */
  maxBytes?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Lesson/cover registration target (course-builder integration). */
  attachTo?: AttachTarget;
  deleteOnRemove?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export type { MediaKind };

export function VideoInput({
  value,
  onChange,
  label,
  hint,
  maxBytes,
  disabled,
  attachTo,
  deleteOnRemove,
  className,
}: VideoInputProps) {
  return (
    <MediaInput
      kind="video"
      value={value}
      onChange={onChange}
      label={label}
      hint={hint}
      maxBytes={maxBytes}
      disabled={disabled}
      attachTo={attachTo}
      deleteOnRemove={deleteOnRemove}
      className={className}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { createRoot, type Root } from "react-dom/client";
import { AlertTriangle, BellRing, Rocket, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Styled dialogs — replace the browser's native confirm() / alert().   */
/*                                                                      */
/* Imperative one-liners (no JSX wiring — the dialog mounts itself      */
/* on document.body):                                                   */
/*                                                                      */
/*    if (!(await confirmDialog({ description: "…", tone: "danger" }))) return; */
/*    await alertDialog({ description: result.message, tone: "danger" });       */
/*                                                                      */
/* And the hook API (when a component wants the dialog in its own JSX): */
/*                                                                      */
/*    const { confirm, host } = useConfirmDialog();                     */
/*    render {host} once, then: if (!(await confirm({ … }))) return;    */
/*                                                                      */
/* confirmDialog resolves true only on the confirm button;              */
/* alertDialog is informational and always resolves true.               */
/* Escape / backdrop click / cancel resolve false.                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type ConfirmTone = "brand" | "danger";

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  /** Headline — tone-dependent default. */
  title?: string;
  /** Main sentence under the headline. */
  description: string;
  /** Confirm button label — tone-dependent default. */
  confirmLabel?: string;
  /** Cancel button label — default "إلغاء". */
  cancelLabel?: string;
  /** "brand" = blue publish-style, "danger" = red delete-style. */
  tone?: ConfirmTone;
}

export interface AlertOptions {
  /** Headline — tone-dependent default. */
  title?: string;
  /** Main sentence under the headline. */
  description: string;
  /** Single button label — default "حسناً". */
  buttonLabel?: string;
  /** "danger" = red warning, "brand" = blue notice. */
  tone?: ConfirmTone;
}

const TONE_DEFAULTS: Record<
  ConfirmTone,
  { title: string; confirmLabel: string }
> = {
  brand: { title: "تأكيد العملية", confirmLabel: "تأكيد" },
  danger: { title: "تأكيد الحذف", confirmLabel: "حذف نهائي" },
};

const ALERT_DEFAULTS: Record<ConfirmTone, { title: string; buttonLabel: string }> =
  {
    brand: { title: "تنبيه", buttonLabel: "حسناً" },
    danger: { title: "تعذّر إتمام العملية", buttonLabel: "حسناً" },
  };

/* ------------------------- Shared chrome --------------------------- */

function useDialogChrome(onFinish: (value: boolean) => void) {
  const [shown, setShown] = React.useState(false);
  const settledRef = React.useRef(false);

  const finish = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean) => {
      if (settledRef.current) return;
      settledRef.current = true;
      onFinish(value);
    },
    [onFinish]
  );

  /* Transition-in + body scroll lock while the dialog is open. */
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => setShown(true));
    const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
    };
  }, []);

  /* Escape dismisses. */
  React.useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") finish(false);
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [finish]);

  return { shown, finish };
}

function DialogFrame({
  shown,
  onBackdrop,
  children,
}: {
  shown: boolean;
  onBackdrop: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 transition-opacity duration-200 ${
        shown ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
      }`}
    >
      {/* Backdrop — click to dismiss. */}
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-[2px]"
        aria-hidden="true"
        onMouseDown={onBackdrop}
      />

      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        className={`relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-slate-200 transition-all duration-200 ${
          shown
            ? "translate-y-0 scale-100 opacity-100"
            : "translate-y-3 scale-95 opacity-0"
        }`}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* -------------------------- Confirm modal -------------------------- */

function ConfirmDialogModal({
  options,
  onFinish,
}: {
  options: ConfirmOptions;
  onFinish: (value: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const { shown, finish } = useDialogChrome(onFinish);
  const danger = options.tone === "danger";

  return (
    <DialogFrame shown={shown} onBackdrop={() => finish(false)}>
      {/* Headline */}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 pb-4 pt-8 text-center">
        <div
          className={`flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl text-white shadow-lg ring-4 ${
            danger
              ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500 to-rose-600 shadow-red-600/25 ring-red-100"
              : "bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1D5BD6] to-[#4F46E5] shadow-blue-600/25 ring-blue-100"
          }`}
        >
          {danger ? (
            <Trash2 className="size-7" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <Rocket className="size-7" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
        </div>
        <h2
          id="confirm-dialog-title"
          className="mt-4 text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900"
        >
          {options.title ?? TONE_DEFAULTS[options.tone ?? "brand"].title}
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
          {options.description}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 px-6 pb-6">
        <button
          type="button"
          autoFocus
          onClick={() => finish(false)}
          className="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
        >
          {options.cancelLabel ?? "إلغاء"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => finish(true)}
          className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition ${
            danger
              ? "bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90"
              : "bg-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
          }`}
        >
          {options.confirmLabel ??
            TONE_DEFAULTS[options.tone ?? "brand"].confirmLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </DialogFrame>
  );
}

/* --------------------------- Alert modal --------------------------- */

function AlertDialogModal({
  options,
  onFinish,
}: {
  options: AlertOptions;
  onFinish: (value: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const { shown, finish } = useDialogChrome(onFinish);
  const danger = options.tone === "danger";
  const defaults = ALERT_DEFAULTS[options.tone ?? "danger"];

  return (
    <DialogFrame shown={shown} onBackdrop={() => finish(false)}>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 pb-4 pt-8 text-center">
        <div
          className={`flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl text-white shadow-lg ring-4 ${
            danger
              ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500 to-rose-600 shadow-red-600/25 ring-red-100"
              : "bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1D5BD6] to-[#4F46E5] shadow-blue-600/25 ring-blue-100"
          }`}
        >
          {danger ? (
            <AlertTriangle className="size-7" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <BellRing className="size-7" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
        </div>
        <h2
          id="alert-dialog-title"
          className="mt-4 text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900"
        >
          {options.title ?? defaults.title}
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
          {options.description}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Single dismiss button. */}
      <div className="px-6 pb-6 pt-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          autoFocus
          onClick={() => finish(true)}
          className={`w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition ${
            danger
              ? "bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90"
              : "bg-[#1D5BD6] hover:bg-[#174aa8]"
          }`}
        >
          {options.buttonLabel ?? defaults.buttonLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </DialogFrame>
  );
}

/* ------------------------- Hook-based API -------------------------- */

export function useConfirmDialog() {
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const resolverRef = React.useRef<((value: boolean) => void) | null>(null);

  const confirm = React.useCallback((options: ConfirmOptions) => {
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      resolverRef.current = resolve;
      setPending(options);
    });
  }, []);

  const finish = React.useCallback((value: boolean) => {
    const resolve = resolverRef.current;
    resolverRef.current = null;
    resolve?.(value);
    setPending(null);
  }, []);

  const host = pending ? (
    <ConfirmDialogModal options={pending} onFinish={finish} />
  ) : null;

  return { confirm, host };
}

/* ---------------------- Imperative singleton ----------------------- */

let dialogContainer: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
let dialogRoot: Root | null = null;
let activeFinish: ((value: boolean) => void) | null = null;

function presentDialog(
  render: (finish: (value: boolean) => void) => React.ReactNode
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return Promise.resolve(false);

  // A second call while a dialog is open auto-cancels the first one
  // (mirrors how the browser shows only one native dialog at a time).
  if (activeFinish) activeFinish(false);

  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    dialogContainer = document.createElement("div");
    dialogContainer.setAttribute("data-confirm-dialog-root", "true");
    document.body.appendChild(dialogContainer);
    dialogRoot = createRoot(dialogContainer);

    activeFinish = (value) => {
      activeFinish = null;
      resolve(value);
      dialogRoot?.unmount();
      dialogRoot = null;
      dialogContainer?.remove();
      dialogContainer = null;
    };

    dialogRoot.render(render(activeFinish));
  });
}

/**
 * Promise-based styled confirm — drop-in replacement for window.confirm
 * inside async handlers:
 *
 * if (!(await confirmDialog({ description: "…", tone: "danger" }))) return;
 */
export function confirmDialog(options: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean> {
  return presentDialog((finish) => (
    <ConfirmDialogModal options={options} onFinish={finish} />
  ));
}

/**
 * Promise-based styled alert — drop-in replacement for window.alert
 * inside async handlers:
 *
 * await alertDialog({ title: "تعذّر الحفظ", description: message, tone: "danger" });
 */
export function alertDialog(options: AlertOptions): Promise<boolean> {
  return presentDialog((finish) => (
    <AlertDialogModal options={options} onFinish={finish} />
  ));
}

"use client";

import { ModulePlaceholder } from "@/components/platform/module-placeholder";
import { getNavItemId } from "@/config/navigation";

interface ModulePlaceholderRouteProps {
  moduleId: string;
}

/**
 * Client bridge for placeholder module routes. Server pages resolve the
 * serializable moduleId; the icon-bearing NavItem is resolved here on
 * the client (icons are component references and cannot cross the
 * server/client serialization boundary).
 */
export function ModulePlaceholderRoute({ moduleId }: ModulePlaceholderRouteProps) {
  const navItem = getNavItemId(moduleId);
  if (!navItem) return null;
  return <ModulePlaceholder module={navItem} />;
}

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type StatusTone = "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error" | "neutral";

interface StatusBadgeProps extends React.ComponentProps<"span"> {
  tone: StatusTone;
  /** Optional leading dot rendered before the label. */
  withDot?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Semantic status badge built on the platform's status tokens
 * (success / info / warning / error / neutral) instead of scattered
 * hardcoded color classes.
 */
export function StatusBadge({
  tone,
  withDot = true,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: StatusBadgeProps) {
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold whitespace-nowrap",
        tone === "success" && "bg-success-soft text-success",
        tone === "info" && "bg-info-soft text-info",
        tone === "warning" && "bg-warning-soft text-warning",
        tone === "error" && "bg-error-soft text-error",
        tone === "neutral" && "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {withDot && (
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            "size-1.5 rounded-full",
            tone === "success" && "bg-success",
            tone === "info" && "bg-info",
            tone === "warning" && "bg-warning",
            tone === "error" && "bg-error",
            tone === "neutral" && "bg-muted-foreground"
          )}
        />
      )}
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

  nameAr: string;
  nameEn: string;
  stage: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

const emptyForm: BranchFormValues = {
  nameAr: "",
  nameEn: "",
  stage: "primary",
  isActive: true,
};

/**
 * Branch management inside the school details view: list, create, edit,
 * change stage and activate/deactivate. Every mutation runs through the
 * server actions, which re-validate the branch↔school relationship on
 * the server — a branch can never be attached to a different school.
 */
export function BranchesManager({ schoolId, branches }: BranchesManagerProps) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [dialog, setDialog] = React.useState<BranchDialogState>({
    open: false,
    editing: null,
  });
  const [form, setForm] = React.useState<BranchFormValues>(emptyForm);
  const [formError, setFormError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = React.useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [saving, setSaving] = React.useState(false);
  const [togglingId, setTogglingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  function openCreate() {
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setFormError(null);
    setFieldErrors({});
    setDialog({ open: true, editing: null });
  }

  function openEdit(branch: BranchListItem) {
    setForm({
      nameAr: branch.nameAr,
      nameEn: branch.nameEn ?? "",
      stage: branch.stage,
      isActive: branch.isActive,
    });
    setFormError(null);
    setFieldErrors({});
    setDialog({ open: true, editing: branch });
  }

  function closeDialog() {
    setDialog({ open: false, editing: null });
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setFormError(null);
    setFieldErrors({});

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.set("nameAr", form.nameAr);
    formData.set("nameEn", form.nameEn);
    formData.set("stage", form.stage);
    if (!dialog.editing) formData.set("isActive", form.isActive ? "on" : "off");
    if (dialog.editing) formData.set("branchId", dialog.editing.id);

    const result = dialog.editing
      ? await updateBranchAction(schoolId, formData)
      : await createBranchAction(schoolId, formData);

    setSaving(false);

    if (result?.ok) {
      toast({
        title: dialog.editing ? "تم تحديث الفرع" : "تم إضافة الفرع",
        description: `«${form.nameAr}» — ${branchStageLabel(form.stage)}`,
      });
      closeDialog();
    } else {
      setFormError(result?.message ?? "حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة");
      if (result?.fieldErrors) setFieldErrors(result.fieldErrors);
    }
  }

  function handleToggle(branch: BranchListItem) {
    setTogglingId(branch.id);
    const next = !branch.isActive;
    // Optimistic-free approach: wait for the server result, then let
    // revalidation refresh the row state.
    (async () => {
      const result = await setBranchActiveAction(schoolId, branch.id, next);
      setTogglingId(null);
      if (result?.ok) {
        toast({
          title: next ? "تم تفعيل الفرع" : "تم إيقاف الفرع",
          description: `«${branch.nameAr}»`,
        });
      } else {
        toast({
          title: "تعذر تغيير حالة الفرع",
          description: result?.message ?? "حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة",
          variant: "destructive",
        });
      }
    })();
  }

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="فروع المدرسة"
      description="الفروع التعليمية التابعة لهذه المدرسة ومراحلها — أسماء الفروع فريدة داخل المدرسة."
      action={
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openCreate}>
          <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          إضافة فرع
        </Button>
      }
    >
      {branches.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={SchoolIcon}
          title="لا توجد فروع بعد"
          description="أضف أول فرع لهذه المدرسة وحدّد مرحلته التعليمية: ابتدائية أو إعدادية أو ثانوية."
          action={
            <Button size="sm" onClick={openCreate}>
              <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              إضافة فرع
            </Button>
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Desktop table */}
          <div className="hidden rounded-xl border md:block">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="hover:bg-transparent">
                  <TableHead className="py-3 ps-4">الفرع</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3">المرحلة التعليمية</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3">الحالة</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3">أُضيف في</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 pe-4 text-end">إجراءات</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {branches.map((branch) => (
                  <TableRow key={branch.id}>
                    <TableCell className="py-3 ps-4">
                      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">{branch.nameAr}</p>
                      {branch.nameEn && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                          {branch.nameEn}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-brand-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700">
                        {branchStageLabel(branch.stage)}
                      </span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3">
                      {branch.isActive ? (
                        <StatusBadge tone="success">نشط</StatusBadge>
                      ) : (
                        <StatusBadge tone="neutral">موقوف</StatusBadge>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3">
                      <span className="text-sm tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                        {branch.createdAtLabel}
                      </span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3 pe-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                        <Switch
                          checked={branch.isActive}
                          onCheckedChange={() => handleToggle(branch)}
                          disabled={togglingId === branch.id}
                          aria-label={
                            branch.isActive
                              ? `إيقاف فرع ${branch.nameAr}`
                              : `تفعيل فرع ${branch.nameAr}`
                          }
                        />
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          onClick={() => openEdit(branch)}
                        >
                          <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                          تعديل
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>

          {/* Mobile cards */}
          <ul className="space-y-3 md:hidden" role="list" aria-label="قائمة الفروع">
            {branches.map((branch) => (
              <li key={branch.id} className="rounded-xl border p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
                    <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
                      {branch.nameAr}
                    </p>
                    {branch.nameEn && (
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                        {branch.nameEn}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {branch.isActive ? (
                    <StatusBadge tone="success">نشط</StatusBadge>
                  ) : (
                    <StatusBadge tone="neutral">موقوف</StatusBadge>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t pt-3">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-brand-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-brand-700">
                    {branchStageLabel(branch.stage)}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Switch
                      checked={branch.isActive}
                      onCheckedChange={() => handleToggle(branch)}
                      disabled={togglingId === branch.id}
                      aria-label={branch.isActive ? `إيقاف فرع ${branch.nameAr}` : `تفعيل فرع ${branch.nameAr}`}
                    />
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => openEdit(branch)}>
                      <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                      تعديل
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </>
      )}

      {/* Create / edit dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialog.open} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && closeDialog()}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader className="text-start">
            <DialogTitle>
              {dialog.editing ? `تعديل فرع «${dialog.editing.nameAr}»` : "إضافة فرع جديد"}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              الفروع تابعة دائماً للمدرسة الحالية — لا يمكن نقل فرع إلى مدرسة أخرى من هذه الواجهة.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            {formError && (
              <p
                className="rounded-lg border border-error/30 bg-error-soft px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-error"
                role="alert"
              >
                {formError}
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="branch-nameAr">
                اسم الفرع بالعربية <span className="text-error">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="branch-nameAr"
                value={form.nameAr}
                onChange={(event) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, nameAr: event.target.value }))}
                placeholder="مثال: فرع المنطقة الأولى"
                required
                aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.nameAr)}
              />
              {fieldErrors.nameAr && (
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-error" role="alert">
                  {fieldErrors.nameAr}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="branch-nameEn">
                  الاسم بالإنجليزية
                  <span className="ms-1 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">(اختياري)</span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="branch-nameEn"
                  value={form.nameEn}
                  onChange={(event) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, nameEn: event.target.value }))}
                  placeholder="First District Branch"
                  dir="ltr"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="branch-stage">المرحلة التعليمية</Label>
                <Select
                  value={form.stage}
                  onValueChange={(value) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, stage: value }))}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id="branch-stage" aria-label="المرحلة التعليمية">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="اختر المرحلة" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {BRANCH_STAGES.map((stage) => (
                      <SelectItem key={stage} value={stage}>
                        {branchStageLabel(stage)}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {!dialog.editing && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border bg-muted/40 p-3.5">
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="branch-active" className="text-sm font-bold">
                    تفعيل الفرع بعد الإضافة
                  </Label>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    الفروع الموقوفة تظهر في القائمة لكنها غير جاهزة للتشغيل.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Switch
                  id="branch-active"
                  checked={form.isActive}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, isActive: checked }))}
                  aria-label="تفعيل الفرع بعد الإضافة"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            <DialogFooter className="gap-2 sm:justify-start">
              <Button type="submit" disabled={saving}>
                {saving && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
                {dialog.editing ? "حفظ التعديلات" : "إضافة الفرع"}
              </Button>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={closeDialog}>
                إلغاء
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Back to directory */}
      <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Link
          href="/schools"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-brand-600 transition-colors hover:text-brand-700"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          العودة إلى دليل المدارس
        </Link>
      </p>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useFormStatus } from "react-dom";
import { useActionState } from "react";
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, ImageIcon, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { createSchoolAction, updateSchoolAction } from "@/app/actions/schools";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { slugify } from "@/lib/validation/schools";
import { schoolInitials, type SchoolListItem } from "@/lib/schools/dto";

interface SchoolFormProps {
  mode: "create" | "edit";
  initial?: SchoolListItem;
}

const PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLOR = "#1D5BD6";

function SubmitButton({ mode }: { mode: SchoolFormProps["mode"] }) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();
  return (
    <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
      {pending && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />}
      {mode === "create" ? "إنشاء المدرسة" : "حفظ التعديلات"}
    </Button>
  );
}

function FieldError({ message }: { message?: string }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return (
    <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-error" role="alert">
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}

/**
 * Create/edit school form. All validation runs again on the server
 * (server action + Zod); field errors below mirror the server result.
 */
export function SchoolForm({ mode, initial }: SchoolFormProps) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const action = mode === "create" ? createSchoolAction : updateSchoolAction;
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState(action, null);

  const [nameEn, setNameEn] = React.useState(initial?.nameEn ?? "");
  const [slug, setSlug] = React.useState(initial?.slug ?? "");
  const [slugEdited, setSlugEdited] = React.useState(mode === "edit");
  const [logoUrl, setLogoUrl] = React.useState(initial?.logoUrl ?? "");
  const [logoBroken, setLogoBroken] = React.useState(false);
  const [brandColor, setBrandColor] = React.useState(
    initial?.brandColor ?? PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLOR
  );
  const [isActive, setIsActive] = React.useState(initial?.isActive ?? true);

  // Edit mode: surface the success feedback (create mode redirects).
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (state?.ok) {
      toast({
        title: "تم حفظ التعديلات",
        description: "تم تحديث بيانات المدرسة بنجاح.",
      });
    }
  }, [state, toast]);

  const fieldErrors = state && "fieldErrors" in state ? state.fieldErrors : undefined;
  const formMessage = state && "message" in state && !state.ok ? state.message : undefined;

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-6">
      {mode === "edit" && <input type="hidden" name="id" value={initial?.id} />}

      {formMessage && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          <AlertDescription>{formMessage}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Names */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="nameAr">
            اسم المدرسة بالعربية <span className="text-error">*</span>
          </Label>
          <Input
            id="nameAr"
            name="nameAr"
            defaultValue={initial?.nameAr}
            placeholder="مثال: مدرسة قرطبة النموذجية"
            required
            aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.nameAr)}
            className={cn(fieldErrors?.nameAr && "border-error focus-visible:ring-error/30")}
          />
          <FieldError message={fieldErrors?.nameAr} />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="nameEn">
            اسم المدرسة بالإنجليزية
            <span className="ms-1 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">(اختياري)</span>
          </Label>
          <Input
            id="nameEn"
            name="nameEn"
            value={nameEn}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setNameEn(event.target.value);
              if (!slugEdited) setSlug(slugify(event.target.value));
            }}
            placeholder="Qurtuba Model School"
            dir="ltr"
            aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.nameEn)}
            className={cn(fieldErrors?.nameEn && "border-error focus-visible:ring-error/30")}
          />
          <FieldError message={fieldErrors?.nameEn} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Slug */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label htmlFor="slug">
          الرابط المختصر (Slug)
          <span className="ms-1 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
            — يُولَّد تلقائياً من الاسم الإنجليزي ويمكن تعديله
          </span>
        </Label>
        <Input
          id="slug"
          name="slug"
          value={slug}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setSlugEdited(true);
            setSlug(event.target.value);
          }}
          placeholder="qurtuba-school"
          dir="ltr"
          aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.slug)}
          className={cn(
            "font-mono text-sm",
            fieldErrors?.slug && "border-error focus-visible:ring-error/30"
          )}
        />
        <FieldError message={fieldErrors?.slug} />
      </div>

      {/* Logo + brand color */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="logoUrl">
            رابط شعار المدرسة
            <span className="ms-1 text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">(اختياري)</span>
          </Label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* Preview + fallback */}
            {logoUrl && !logoBroken ? (
              <img
                src={logoUrl}
                alt="معاينة الشعار"
                className="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-xl border bg-card object-contain p-1"
                onError={() => setLogoBroken(true)}
              />
            ) : (
              <span
                className="flex size-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-sm font-bold text-white"
                style={{ backgroundColor: brandColor }}
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                {initial?.nameAr ? (
                  schoolInitials(initial.nameAr)
                ) : (
                  <ImageIcon className="size-5" />
                )}
              </span>
            )}
            <Input
              id="logoUrl"
              name="logoUrl"
              value={logoUrl}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setLogoUrl(event.target.value);
                setLogoBroken(false);
              }}
              placeholder="https://example.com/logo.png"
              dir="ltr"
              aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.logoUrl)}
              className={cn(
                "flex-1 text-sm",
                fieldErrors?.logoUrl && "border-error focus-visible:ring-error/30"
              )}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            الصق رابط صورة الشعار (PNG/SVG). رفع الملفات مباشرة متاح في مرحلة لاحقة عند ربط نظام تخزين الملفات.
          </p>
          <FieldError message={fieldErrors?.logoUrl} />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="brandColor">لون الهوية الأساسي</Label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <input
              type="color"
              value={/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(brandColor) ? brandColor : PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLOR}
              onChange={(event) => setBrandColor(event.target.value)}
              className="size-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-lg border bg-card p-1"
              aria-label="اختيار لون الهوية"
            />
            <Input
              id="brandColor"
              name="brandColor"
              value={brandColor}
              onChange={(event) => setBrandColor(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="#1D5BD6"
              dir="ltr"
              aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors?.brandColor)}
              className={cn(
                "font-mono text-sm",
                fieldErrors?.brandColor && "border-error focus-visible:ring-error/30"
              )}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            الافتراضي أزرق المنصة ({PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLOR}). يُستخدم للشعار البديل وعناصر هوية المدرسة.
          </p>
          <FieldError message={fieldErrors?.brandColor} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Initial status (create mode only; editing uses the status toggle) */}
      {mode === "create" && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border bg-card p-4">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <Label htmlFor="isActive" className="text-sm font-bold">
              تفعيل المدرسة بعد الإنشاء
            </Label>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              المدارس الموقوفة تظهر في الدليل لكنها غير جاهزة للتشغيل.
            </p>
          </div>
          {/* Hidden input feeds the server action (Radix Switch renders a button, not a checkbox) */}
          <input type="hidden" name="isActive" value={isActive ? "on" : "off"} />
          <Switch
            id="isActive"
            checked={isActive}
            onCheckedChange={setIsActive}
            aria-label="تفعيل المدرسة بعد الإنشاء"
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t pt-5">
        <SubmitButton mode={mode} />
        <Button variant="outline" asChild>
          <Link href={mode === "edit" ? `/schools/${initial?.id}` : "/schools"}>إلغاء</Link>
        </Button>
        {state?.ok && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-success">
            <CheckCircle2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            تم الحفظ بنجاح
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft, Plus, Search, School as SchoolIcon } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/platform/empty-state";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/platform/status-badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { schoolInitials, type SchoolListItem } from "@/lib/schools/dto";

type StatusFilter = "all" | "active" | "inactive";

const statusFilters: { value: StatusFilter; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "all", label: "الكل" },
  { value: "active", label: "النشطة" },
  { value: "inactive", label: "الموقوفة" },
];

/** Fallback avatar: initials on a brand-colored tile. */
function SchoolAvatar({ school }: { school: SchoolListItem }) {
  return school.logoUrl ? (
    <img
      src={school.logoUrl}
      alt={`شعار ${school.nameAr}`}
      className="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full border bg-card object-cover"
      onError={(event) => {
        event.currentTarget.style.display = "none";
      }}
    />
  ) : (
    <span
      className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-white"
      style={{ backgroundColor: school.brandColor }}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {schoolInitials(school.nameAr)}
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Schools directory: real-time client-side search (Arabic/English/slug)
 * and status filtering over the persisted list. Desktop renders a
 * table; small screens render stacked cards.
 */
export function SchoolsDirectory({ schools }: { schools: SchoolListItem[] }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState<StatusFilter>("all");

  const normalizedQuery = query.trim();
  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
    const q = normalizedQuery.toLowerCase();
    return schools.filter((school) => {
      const matchesStatus =
        status === "all" ||
        (status === "active" && school.isActive) ||
        (status === "inactive" && !school.isActive);
      if (!matchesStatus) return false;
      if (q.length === 0) return true;
      return (
        school.nameAr.includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        (school.nameEn?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ?? false) ||
        school.slug.includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [schools, normalizedQuery, status]);

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search
            className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <Input
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="ابحث باسم المدرسة أو الرابط المختصر…"
            className="ps-9"
            aria-label="البحث في المدارس"
          />
        </div>
        <div
          className="flex w-fit items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border bg-card p-1"
          role="group"
          aria-label="تصفية حسب الحالة"
        >
          {statusFilters.map((filter) => (
            <button
              key={filter.value}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatus(filter.value)}
              aria-pressed={status === filter.value}
              className={cn(
                "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors",
                "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring",
                status === filter.value
                  ? "bg-brand-600 text-white shadow-xs"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {filter.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      {schools.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs">
          <EmptyState
            icon={SchoolIcon}
            title="لا توجد مدارس مسجلة بعد"
            description="ابدأ بإضافة أول مدرسة لتبني عليها الفروع والمراحل التعليمية وباقي وحدات المنصة."
            action={
              <Button asChild>
                <Link href="/schools/new">
                  <Plus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  إضافة أول مدرسة
                </Link>
              </Button>
            }
          />
        </div>
      ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs">
          <EmptyState
            icon={Search}
            title="لا توجد نتائج مطابقة"
            description="جرّب تعديل كلمة البحث أو تغيير فلتر الحالة."
            action={
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setQuery("");
                  setStatus("all");
                }}
              >
                إعادة ضبط البحث
              </Button>
            }
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Desktop table */}
          <div className="hidden rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs md:block">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="hover:bg-transparent">
                  <TableHead className="py-3.5 ps-5">المدرسة</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3.5">الرابط المختصر</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3.5 text-center">الفروع</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3.5">الحالة</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3.5">تاريخ الإضافة</TableHead>

                    <span className="sr-only">فتح التفاصيل</span>
                  </TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {filtered.map((school) => (
                  <TableRow key={school.id}>
                    <TableCell className="py-3.5 ps-5">
                      <Link
                        href={`/schools/${school.id}`}
                        className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                      >
                        <SchoolAvatar school={school} />
                        <span className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
                          <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold text-foreground transition-colors group-hover:text-brand-700">
                            {school.nameAr}
                          </span>
                          {school.nameEn && (
                            <span className="block truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                              {school.nameEn}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </span>

                    <TableCell className="py-3.5">
                      <code
                        className="rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground"
                        dir="ltr"
                      >
                        {school.slug}
                      </code>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3.5 text-center">
                      <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-foreground">
                        {school.branchesCount}

                      ) : (

                      >
                        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                      </Link>

                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>

          {/* Mobile cards */}
          <ul className="space-y-3 md:hidden" role="list" aria-label="قائمة المدارس">
            {filtered.map((school) => (
              <li key={school.id}>
                <Link

                  className="block rounded-xl border bg-card p-4 shadow-xs outline-none transition-colors hover:border-brand-200 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Loader2, Power } from "lucide-react";

import { setSchoolActiveAction } from "@/app/actions/schools";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";

interface SchoolStatusToggleProps {
  schoolId: string;
  schoolName: string;
  isActive: boolean;
}

/**
 * Activate/deactivate a school. Permanent deletion is deliberately not
 * offered — schools may own branches (and future teacher/program
 * records), so deactivation preserves history and referential integrity.
 */
export function SchoolStatusToggle({
  schoolId,
  schoolName,
  isActive,
}: SchoolStatusToggleProps) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [pending, startTransition] = React.useTransition();

  function handleToggle() {
    const next = !isActive;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setSchoolActiveAction(schoolId, next);
      if (result?.ok) {
        toast({
          title: next ? "تم تفعيل المدرسة" : "تم إيقاف المدرسة",
          description: next
            ? `«${schoolName}» نشطة الآن ويمكن التشغيل عليها.`
            : `«${schoolName}» موقوفة مؤقتاً — لم يتم حذف أي بيانات.`,
        });
      } else {
        toast({
          title: "تعذر تغيير الحالة",
          description: result?.message ?? "حدث خطأ غير متوقع — أعد المحاولة.",
          variant: "destructive",
        });
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <Button
      variant={isActive ? "outline" : "default"}
      onClick={handleToggle}
      disabled={pending}
      className={isActive ? "border-warning/40 text-warning hover:bg-warning-soft hover:text-warning" : ""}
    >
      {pending ? (
        <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
      ) : (
        <Power className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
      )}
      {isActive ? "إيقاف المدرسة" : "إعادة تفعيل المدرسة"}
    </Button>
  );
}
