"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Award,
  ClipboardCheck,
  Loader2,
  MonitorPlay,
  Rocket,
  Undo2,
} from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* PublishConfirmButton — a styled in-page confirmation modal that      */
/* replaces the browser's native confirm() bar on the publish action.   */
/*                                                                      */
/* Self-contained: overlay + centered card, RTL, fade/scale-in,         */
/* Escape / backdrop-click to cancel (blocked while pending), body      */
/* scroll lock, error surface that keeps the dialog open, and a         */
/* pending state on the confirm button. No new dependencies.            */
/*                                                                      */
/* The component never touches the server action itself — the caller    */
/* passes onConfirm (an async callback or a form requestSubmit) so it   */
/* plugs into the course builder, the unified editor and any other      */
/* publisher without coupling to a specific action module.              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface PublishConfirmButtonProps {
  /** Trigger label — default "نشر". */
  label?: string;
  /** Modal headline — default "تأكيد نشر التدريب". */
  title?: string;
  /** Main sentence under the headline. */
  description?: string;
  /** Confirm button label — default "تأكيد النشر". */
  confirmLabel?: string;
  /** Confirm label while the action runs — default "جارٍ النشر…". */
  pendingLabel?: string;
  /** Show the "you can undo this" strip — default true. */
  reversible?: boolean;
  /** Hide the trigger's rocket icon (e.g. unpublish variant). */
  hideIcon?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /**
   * The real publish work. Return { ok: false, message } to keep the
   * modal open and surface the error, anything else closes it.
   */
  onConfirm:
    | (() => Promise<{ ok: boolean; message?: string } | void> | void)
    | (() => Promise<{ ok: boolean; message?: string } | void> | void);
}

const defaultTrigger =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-70";

export function PublishConfirmButton({
  label = "نشر",
  title = "تأكيد نشر التدريب",
  description = "سيصبح التدريب متاحًا فورًا لمعلمي المدرسة، وستُفتح لهم الرحلة الإلزامية.",
  confirmLabel = "تأكيد النشر",
  pendingLabel = "جارٍ النشر…",
  reversible = true,
  hideIcon = false,
  className,
  disabled = false,
  onConfirm,
}: PublishConfirmButtonProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /* Transition-in + body scroll lock while the modal is open. */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) {
      setShown(false);
      return;
    }
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => setShown(true));
    const previousOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
    };
  }, [open]);

  /* Escape cancels — but never while the action is running. */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && !pending) setOpen(false);
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [open, pending]);

  async function handleConfirm() {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await onConfirm();
      if (result && result.ok === false) {
        setError(result.message ?? "تعذر إتمام العملية — حاول مرة أخرى");
        return;
      }
      setOpen(false);
    } catch {
      setError("حدث خطأ غير متوقع — حاول مرة أخرى");
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => {
          setError(null);
          setOpen(true);
        }}
        className={cn(defaultTrigger, className)}
      >
        {!hideIcon && <Rocket className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />}
        {label}
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div
          className={cn(
            "fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 transition-opacity duration-200",
            shown ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
          )}
        >
          {/* Backdrop — click to cancel (ignored while pending). */}
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-[2px]"
            aria-hidden="true"
            onMouseDown={() => {
              if (!pending) setOpen(false);
            }}
          />

          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="publish-confirm-title"
            className={cn(
              "relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-slate-200 transition-all duration-200",
              shown
                ? "translate-y-0 scale-100 opacity-100"
                : "translate-y-3 scale-95 opacity-0"
            )}
          >
            {/* Headline */}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center px-6 pb-4 pt-8 text-center">
              <div className="flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1D5BD6] to-[#4F46E5] text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/25 ring-4 ring-blue-100">
                <Rocket className="size-7" aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <h2
                id="publish-confirm-title"
                className="mt-4 text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900"
              >
                {title}
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600">
                {description}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* What publishing turns on — mirrors the real platform rules */}
            <ul className="mx-6 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3">
              <li className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                <span className="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1D5BD6]">
                  <MonitorPlay className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </span>
                الدروس تُشاهد بالترتيب — الإتمام بالمشاهدة الفعلية فقط
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                <span className="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1D5BD6]">
                  <ClipboardCheck className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </span>
                اختبار الدورة يُفتح للمعلم بعد إتمام كل الدروس
              </li>
              <li className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">
                <span className="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-[#1D5BD6]">
                  <Award className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                </span>
                شهادة إتمام تلقائية بعد النجاح في الاختبار
              </li>
            </ul>

            {reversible && (
              <p className="mx-6 mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-800">
                <Undo2 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                يمكنك التراجع في أي وقت بإعادة الحالة إلى مسودة من نفس الأزرار.
              </p>
            )}

            {error && (
              <p
                role="alert"
                className="mx-6 mt-3 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-red-700"
              >
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            {/* Actions */}
            <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 px-6 pb-6">
              <button
                type="button"
                autoFocus
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                className="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                إلغاء
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={handleConfirm}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1D5BD6] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#174aa8] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-70"
              >
                {pending ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
                    {pendingLabel}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Rocket className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                    {confirmLabel}
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import * as React from "react";
import { Archive, Eye, Undo2 } from "lucide-react";

import {
  setCourseStatusAction,
  type TrainingFormState,
} from "@/app/actions/training";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Publish / unpublish / archive controls. The service validates the    */
/* course content before publishing and rejects unauthorized roles —    */
/* these buttons only carry the intent.                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface PublishControlsProps {
  courseId: string;
  status: string;
}

export function PublishControls({ courseId, status }: PublishControlsProps) {
  const [state, formAction] = React.useActionState<
    TrainingFormState | null,
    FormData
  >(setCourseStatusAction, null);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {state?.message && (
        <Alert variant={state.ok ? "default" : "destructive"} role={state.ok ? "status" : "alert"}>
          <AlertDescription>{state.message}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      <form action={formAction} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <input type="hidden" name="courseId" value={courseId} />

        {status !== "PUBLISHED" && (
          <AlertDialog>
            <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button type="submit" name="status" value="PUBLISHED" size="sm">
                <Eye className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                نشر الدورة
              </Button>
            </AlertDialogTrigger>
            <AlertDialogContent>
              <AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogTitle>نشر الدورة</AlertDialogTitle>
                <AlertDialogDescription>
                  ستُنشر الدورة لجمهورها المصرح له (معلمو مدرستك أو جميع
                  المدارس إن كانت مشتركة). يتحقق النظام من اكتمال المحتوى
                  قبل النشر.
                </AlertDialogDescription>
              </AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogFooter>
                <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
                <AlertDialogAction>تأكيد النشر</AlertDialogAction>
              </AlertDialogFooter>
            </AlertDialogContent>
          </AlertDialog>
        )}

        {status === "PUBLISHED" && (
          <Button
            type="submit"
            name="status"
            value="DRAFT"
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
          >
            <Undo2 className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            إرجاع إلى مسودة
          </Button>
        )}

        {status !== "ARCHIVED" && (
          <AlertDialog>
            <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                name="status"
                value="ARCHIVED"
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                className="text-warning hover:text-warning"
              >
                <Archive className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                أرشفة
              </Button>
            </AlertDialogTrigger>
            <AlertDialogContent>
              <AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogTitle>أرشفة الدورة</AlertDialogTitle>
                <AlertDialogDescription>

              </AlertDialogFooter>

  );

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const alertVariants = cva(
  "relative w-full rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm grid has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] grid-cols-[0_1fr] has-[>svg]:gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 items-start [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&>svg]:text-current",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-card text-card-foreground",
        destructive:
          "text-destructive bg-card [&>svg]:text-current *:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Alert({
  className,
  variant,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert"
      role="alert"
      className={cn(alertVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-title"
      className={cn(
        "col-start-2 line-clamp-1 min-h-4 font-medium tracking-tight",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-muted-foreground col-start-2 grid justify-items-start gap-1 text-sm [&_p]:leading-relaxed",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription }

      {...props}

  )

import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 shrink-0 [&_svg]:shrink-0 outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default:
          "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-primary/90",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-destructive/90 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 dark:bg-destructive/60",
        outline:
          "border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:bg-input/30 dark:border-input dark:hover:bg-input/50",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-secondary/80",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-9 px-4 py-2 has-[>svg]:px-3",
        sm: "h-8 rounded-md gap-1.5 px-3 has-[>svg]:px-2.5",
        lg: "h-10 rounded-md px-6 has-[>svg]:px-4",
        icon: "size-9",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Button({
  className,
  variant,
  size,
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
    asChild?: boolean
  }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="button"
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Button, buttonVariants }

import * as React from "react"

  ...props

  ...props

  ...props

      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogContent({
  className,

          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close
            data-slot="dialog-close"
            className="ring-offset-background focus:ring-ring data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-muted-foreground absolute top-4 right-4 rounded-xs opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-hidden disabled:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
          >
            <XIcon />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Content>
    </DialogPortal>
  )
}

import * as React from "react"
import * as ToastPrimitives from "@radix-ui/react-toast"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { X } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const ToastProvider = ToastPrimitives.Provider

const ToastViewport = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Viewport>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Viewport>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Viewport
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "fixed top-0 z-[100] flex max-h-screen w-full flex-col-reverse p-4 sm:bottom-0 sm:right-0 sm:top-auto sm:flex-col md:max-w-[420px]",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
))
ToastViewport.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Viewport.displayName

const toastVariants = cva(
  "group pointer-events-auto relative flex w-full items-center justify-between space-x-2 overflow-hidden rounded-md border p-4 pr-6 shadow-lg transition-all data-[swipe=cancel]:translate-x-0 data-[swipe=end]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-end-x)] data-[swipe=move]:translate-x-[var(--radix-toast-swipe-move-x)] data-[swipe=move]:transition-none data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[swipe=end]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-80 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-right-full data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top-full data-[state=open]:sm:slide-in-from-bottom-full",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "border bg-background text-foreground",
        destructive:
          "destructive group border-destructive bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

const Toast = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof ToastPrimitives.Root> &
  VariantProps<typeof toastVariants>
>(({ className, variant, ...props }, ref) => {
  return (
    <ToastPrimitives.Root
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(toastVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}

  )
})
Toast.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Root.displayName

>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Action
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      "inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-secondary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 group-[.destructive]:border-muted/40 group-[.destructive]:hover:border-destructive/30 group-[.destructive]:hover:bg-destructive group-[.destructive]:hover:text-destructive-foreground group-[.destructive]:focus:ring-destructive",
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
))
ToastAction.displayName = ToastPrimitives.Action.displayName

const ToastClose = React.forwardRef<

>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <ToastPrimitives.Close

      "absolute right-1 top-1 rounded-md p-1 text-foreground/50 opacity-0 transition-opacity hover:text-foreground focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 group-hover:opacity-100 group-[.destructive]:text-red-300 group-[.destructive]:hover:text-red-50 group-[.destructive]:focus:ring-red-400 group-[.destructive]:focus:ring-offset-red-600",

"use client"

import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast"
import {
  Toast,
  ToastClose,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastProvider,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastViewport,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

export function Toaster() {
  const { toasts } = useToast()

  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      {toasts.map(function ({ id, title, description, action, ...props }) {
        return (
          <Toast key={id} {...props}>
            <div className="grid gap-1">
              {title && <ToastTitle>{title}</ToastTitle>}
              {description && (
                <ToastDescription>{description}</ToastDescription>
              )}
            </div>
            {action}
            <ToastClose />
          </Toast>
        )
      })}
      <ToastViewport />
    </ToastProvider>
  )
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\components\users\directory-filters.tsx
========================================

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Filter, RotateCcw, Search } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { SectionCard } from "@/components/platform/section-card";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Directory filter bar. A real GET-style navigation: the current       */
/* filters become URL search params, so every view is shareable and    */
/* the SERVER re-queries with the new filters (never client filtering  */
/* of sensitive data).                                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface DirectoryFiltersProps {
  roleOptions: { value: string; label: string }[];
  schools: { id: string; nameAr: string }[];
  branches: { id: string; nameAr: string }[];
  showSchoolFilter: boolean;
}

export function DirectoryFilters({
  roleOptions,
  schools,
  branches,
  showSchoolFilter,
}: DirectoryFiltersProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const current = {
    q: searchParams.get("q") ?? "",
    role: searchParams.get("role") ?? "ALL",
    schoolId: searchParams.get("schoolId") ?? "ALL",
    branchId: searchParams.get("branchId") ?? "ALL",
    status: searchParams.get("status") ?? "ALL",
  };

  const [q, setQ] = React.useState(current.q);

  function applyParam(key: string, value: string) {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
    if (value === "ALL" || value === "") sp.delete(key);
    else sp.set(key, value);
    sp.delete("page"); // any filter change resets pagination
    router.push(`/users${sp.toString() ? `?${sp.toString()}` : ""}`);
  }

  function submitSearch(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    applyParam("q", q.trim());
  }

  function resetFilters() {
    setQ("");
    router.push("/users");
  }

  const selectClass = "w-full bg-background";

  return (
    <SectionCard
      title="تصفية النتائج"
      description="البحث والفلاتر تُنفَّذ على الخادم ضمن نطاق صلاحيتك — النتائج دائمًا من قاعدة البيانات."
    >
      <form onSubmit={submitSearch} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">
          <div className="space-y-1.5 xl:col-span-2">
            <Label htmlFor="users-q">بحث بالاسم أو البريد</Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Search
                className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <Input
                id="users-q"
                value={q}
                onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="اكتب اسمًا أو بريدًا…"
                className="ps-10"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="users-role">الدور</Label>
            <Select
              value={current.role}
              onValueChange={(value) => applyParam("role", value)}
            >
              <SelectTrigger id="users-role" className={selectClass}>
                <SelectValue placeholder="جميع الأدوار" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="ALL">جميع الأدوار</SelectItem>
                {roleOptions.map((role) => (
                  <SelectItem key={role.value} value={role.value}>
                    {role.label}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          {showSchoolFilter && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="users-school">المدرسة</Label>
              <Select
                value={current.schoolId}
                onValueChange={(value) => applyParam("schoolId", value)}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="users-school" className={selectClass}>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="جميع المدارس" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="ALL">جميع المدارس</SelectItem>
                  {schools.map((school) => (
                    <SelectItem key={school.id} value={school.id}>
                      {school.nameAr}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="users-branch">الفرع</Label>
            {branches.length > 0 ? (
              <Select
                value={current.branchId}
                onValueChange={(value) => applyParam("branchId", value)}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="users-branch" className={selectClass}>
                  <SelectValue placeholder="جميع الفروع" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="ALL">جميع الفروع</SelectItem>
                  {branches.map((branch) => (
                    <SelectItem key={branch.id} value={branch.id}>
                      {branch.nameAr}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            ) : (
              <Input
                id="users-branch"
                value="اختر مدرسة أولًا لعرض فروعها"
                disabled
                aria-describedby="users-branch-hint"
              />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="users-status">حالة الحساب</Label>
            <Select
              value={current.status}
              onValueChange={(value) => applyParam("status", value)}
            >
              <SelectTrigger id="users-status" className={selectClass}>
                <SelectValue placeholder="جميع الحالات" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="ALL">جميع الحالات</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="ACTIVE">نشط</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="INACTIVE">موقوف</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" size="sm">
            <Filter className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            تطبيق البحث
          </Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={resetFilters}>
            <RotateCcw className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            إعادة التعيين
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

import {

import * as React from "react";

  setDeputyScopeAction,
  setSupervisorBranchesAction,
  updateUserProfileByAdminAction,
  type UserFormState,
} from "@/app/actions/users";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";

  id: string;
  nameAr: string;
  stage?: string;

function SubmitButton({ label, pendingLabel }: { label: string; pendingLabel: string }) {

  return (
    <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={pending}>
      <Save className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />

function FormFeedback({ state }: { state: UserFormState | null }) {
  if (!state?.message) return null;
  return (
    <Alert
      variant={state.ok ? "default" : "destructive"}
      role={state.ok ? "status" : "alert"}
    >
      <AlertDescription>{state.message}</AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  );
}

/* --------------------- Supervisor branch scope --------------------- */

export function SupervisorBranchesForm({
  supervisorId,
  assignedBranchIds,
  branches,
}: {
  supervisorId: string;
  assignedBranchIds: string[];
  branches: BranchOption[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<string[]>(assignedBranchIds);
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<UserFormState | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);

  async function handleSave() {
    setPending(true);
    const result = await setSupervisorBranchesAction(supervisorId, selected);
    setState(result);
    setPending(false);
    router.refresh();
  }

  function toggleBranch(branchId: string) {
    setSelected((prev) =>
      prev.includes(branchId)
        ? prev.filter((id) => id !== branchId)
        : [...prev, branchId]
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <FormFeedback state={state} />
      {branches.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-4 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          لا توجد فروع في هذه المدرسة بعد — أنشئ فروعًا أولًا من صفحة المدارس.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2" role="list">
          {branches.map((branch) => (
            <li
              key={branch.id}
              className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3"
            >
              <Checkbox
                id={`branch-${branch.id}`}
                checked={selected.includes(branch.id)}
                onCheckedChange={() => toggleBranch(branch.id)}
                aria-label={`إسناد فرع ${branch.nameAr}`}
              />
              <Label
                htmlFor={`branch-${branch.id}`}
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 cursor-pointer leading-tight"
              >
                <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold">{branch.nameAr}</span>
                {branch.stage && (
                  <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {branchStageLabel(branch.stage)}
                  </span>
                )}
              </Label>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={handleSave} disabled={pending || branches.length === 0}>
        <Save className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        {pending ? "جارٍ الحفظ…" : "حفظ نطاق الفروع"}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

/* -------------------------- Deputy scope --------------------------- */

export function DeputyScopeForm({
  deputyId,
  grants,
  branches,
}: {
  deputyId: string;
  /** branchId === null means a school-wide grant. */
  grants: { id: string; branchId: string | null }[];
  branches: BranchOption[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const schoolWide = grants.some((grant) => grant.branchId === null);
  const grantedBranchIds = grants
    .map((grant) => grant.branchId)
    .filter((id): id is string => id !== null);

  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<"school" | "branches">(
    schoolWide ? "school" : "branches"
  );
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<string[]>(grantedBranchIds);
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<UserFormState | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);

  async function handleSave() {
    setPending(true);
    const result = await setDeputyScopeAction(
      deputyId,
      mode,
      mode === "school" ? [] : selected
    );
    setState(result);
    setPending(false);
    router.refresh();
  }

  function toggleBranch(branchId: string) {
    setSelected((prev) =>
      prev.includes(branchId)
        ? prev.filter((id) => id !== branchId)
        : [...prev, branchId]
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <FormFeedback state={state} />

      <RadioGroup
        value={mode}
        onValueChange={(value) => setMode(value as "school" | "branches")}
        className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2"
      >
        <Label
          htmlFor="deputy-mode-school"

          htmlFor="deputy-mode-branches"
          className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-background/60 p-3 leading-tight"
        >
          <RadioGroupItem id="deputy-mode-branches" value="branches" className="mt-0.5" />
          <span>
            <span className="block text-sm font-bold">فروع محددة</span>
            <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ShieldOff } from "lucide-react";

import { setUserActiveAction } from "@/app/actions/users";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Account activation switch (management views). Presentation only —   */
/* the server re-validates scope, self-toggle and SUPER_ADMIN rows.    */
/* Deactivation revokes live sessions immediately (tokenVersion).      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface UserStatusToggleProps {
  userId: string;
  userName: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  disabledReason?: string;
}

export function UserStatusToggle({
  userId,
  userName,
  isActive,
  disabled,
  disabledReason,
}: UserStatusToggleProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState(false);

  async function handleToggle(checked: boolean) {
    setPending(true);
    const result = await setUserActiveAction(userId, checked);
    setPending(false);
    toast({
      title: result.ok ? "تم تحديث الحالة" : "تعذر تحديث الحالة",
      description: result.message,
      variant: result.ok ? "default" : "destructive",
    });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
      <Switch
        checked={isActive}
        disabled={disabled || pending}
        onCheckedChange={handleToggle}
        aria-label={`حالة حساب ${userName}`}
      />
      {disabled && (
        <ShieldOff
          className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}
      {disabled && disabledReason && (
        <span className="sr-only">{disabledReason}</span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

  EXPIRED: "انتهى الوقت دون تسليم",
  NEEDS_REVIEW: "مُسلَّم — بانتظار المراجعة",
  PASSED: "ناجح",
  FAILED: "غير مجتاز",
};

export function attemptStatusLabel(status: string): string {
  return ATTEMPT_STATUS_LABELS[status as AttemptStatus] ?? status;
}

/** Semantic tone for badges (maps to StatusBadge tones). */
export function attemptStatusTone(
  status: string
): "success" | "info" | "warning" | "error" | "neutral" {
  if (status === "PASSED") return "success";
  if (status === "FAILED") return "error";
  if (status === "NEEDS_REVIEW") return "warning";
  if (status === "IN_PROGRESS") return "info";
  return "neutral";
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — the professional growth ladder (HTML v48 + v13 parity).    */
/*                                                                      */
/* Two rules from the ORIGINAL platform live here and nowhere else:      */
/*   1. v48 — the supervisor classifies each teacher T0..T5 and may      */
/*      approve ONE-level promotions when the teacher completed at       */
/*      least PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT of the published courses       */
/*      assigned to them ("شرط الانتقال: 60%").                          */
/*   2. v13 — a SUGGESTED level computed from real training stats        */
/*      (hours + completion percentage). The suggestion is advisory;     */
/*      the persisted level only changes through the v48 controls.       */
/*                                                                      */
/* The annual target (35 hours) is also defined here — it appears in     */
/* the teacher home stats, the hours report and the yearly archive.      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface GrowthLevel {
  id: "T0" | "T1" | "T2" | "T3" | "T4" | "T5";
  nameAr: string;
  descriptionAr: string;
}

/** The exact original ladder: T0 معلم جديد → T5 باحث تربوي. */
export const GROWTH_LEVELS: readonly GrowthLevel[] = [
  { id: "T0", nameAr: "معلم جديد", descriptionAr: "بداية المسار المهني" },
  { id: "T1", nameAr: "متمكن", descriptionAr: "إتقان الأساسيات وتطبيقها" },
  { id: "T2", nameAr: "ممارس متميز", descriptionAr: "ممارسة صفية مؤثرة" },
  { id: "T3", nameAr: "معلم قائد", descriptionAr: "قيادة وتأثير داخل المدرسة" },
  { id: "T4", nameAr: "مدرب معلم", descriptionAr: "تدريب الزملاء ونقل الخبرة" },
  { id: "T5", nameAr: "باحث تربوي", descriptionAr: "أعلى مستوى — بحث وممارسة تجريبية" },
] as const;

export const GROWTH_LEVEL_IDS = GROWTH_LEVELS.map((level) => level.id);

export type GrowthLevelId = (typeof GROWTH_LEVELS)[number]["id"];

export function isGrowthLevelId(value: string): value is GrowthLevelId {
  return (GROWTH_LEVEL_IDS as string[]).includes(value);
}

/** "T2" -> "T2 — ممارس متميز" (the label format the HTML used). */
export function growthLevelLabel(id: string): string {
  const level = GROWTH_LEVELS.find((item) => item.id === id);
  return level ? `${level.id} — ${level.nameAr}` : id;
}

export function growthLevelName(id: string): string {
  return GROWTH_LEVELS.find((item) => item.id === id)?.nameAr ?? id;
}

/** The one-level-up step (null already at the top). */
export function nextGrowthLevel(id: string): GrowthLevelId | null {
  const index = GROWTH_LEVELS.findIndex((level) => level.id === id);
  if (index < 0 || index >= GROWTH_LEVELS.length - 1) return null;
  return GROWTH_LEVELS[index + 1].id;
}

/**
 * v48 — a teacher becomes eligible to move exactly ONE level up when
 * they complete at least this percentage of the published courses
 * assigned to them ("وعند إكمال المعلم 60% من الدورات المنشورة
 * المتاحة له، يصبح مستحقًا للانتقال مستوى واحد فقط").
 */
export const PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT = 60;

/** The annual professional-learning target ("هدف الساعات السنوي"). */
export const ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET = 35;

/** Percent progress toward the 35-hour target, capped at 100. */
export function annualHoursPercent(hours: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(hours) || hours <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.min(100, Math.round((hours / ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET) * 100));
}

export interface GrowthStatsInput {
  /** Accumulated completed-course hours (the HTML suggestion used the
   * teacher's totals, independent of the academic year). */
  hours: number;
  /** Completion percentage over the teacher's assigned published courses. */
  assignedPercent: number;
}

/**
 * v13 — the SUGGESTED level from real stats. Exact original thresholds:
 *   hours>=35 && pct>=80 -> T5; 30/70 -> T4; 25/60 -> T3; 15/45 -> T2;
 *   hours>=5 || pct>=20 -> T1; else T0.
 */
export function suggestedGrowthLevel(stats: GrowthStatsInput): GrowthLevelId {
  const { hours, assignedPercent } = stats;
  if (hours >= 35 && assignedPercent >= 80) return "T5";
  if (hours >= 30 && assignedPercent >= 70) return "T4";
  if (hours >= 25 && assignedPercent >= 60) return "T3";
  if (hours >= 15 && assignedPercent >= 45) return "T2";
  if (hours >= 5 || assignedPercent >= 20) return "T1";
  return "T0";
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor -> teacher message types (HTML v38 modal — same six).     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const MESSAGE_TYPES = [
  "FOLLOW_UP",
  "PRAISE",
  "GUIDANCE",
  "ALERT",
  "TASK",
  "EVALUATION",
] as const;

export type MessageType = (typeof MESSAGE_TYPES)[number];

export const MESSAGE_TYPE_LABELS: Record<MessageType, string> = {
  FOLLOW_UP: "ملاحظة متابعة",
  PRAISE: "إشادة",
  GUIDANCE: "توجيه مهني",
  ALERT: "تنبيه",
  TASK: "تكليف تدريبي",
  EVALUATION: "تقييم",
};

export function isMessageType(value: string): value is MessageType {
  return (MESSAGE_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

/** Find a nav item by its stable id. */
export function getNavItemId(id: string): NavItem | undefined {
  return navItems.find((item) => item.id === id);
}

/**
 * Route-aware active state for the sidebar/mobile navigation.
 * The dashboard matches exactly; module roots also match their
 * sub-routes (e.g. /schools matches /schools/new and /schools/{id}).
 */
export function isNavItemActive(pathname: string, href: string): boolean {
  if (href === "/") return pathname === "/";
  return pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`);
}

/**
 * Resolves the ONE active nav item for a pathname (longest href wins).
 * Prevents double highlighting on nested routes — e.g. inside
 * /academy/manage/12 only "course-management" is active, not its
 * parent "academy" too. Returns null when nothing matches.
 */
export function activeNavItemId(pathname: string, items: NavItem[]): string | null {
  let bestId: string | null = null;
  let bestLength = -1;
  for (const item of items) {
    if (!isNavItemActive(pathname, item.href)) continue;
    if (item.href.length > bestLength) {
      bestId = item.id;
      bestLength = item.href.length;
    }
  }
  return bestId;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Sidebar grouping — presentation only, shared by the desktop rail     */
/* and the mobile drawer so the two can never drift apart.              */
/*                                                                      */
/* Grouping NEVER adds, removes or re-orders modules: items still       */
/* arrive role-filtered from the server (navIdsForRole), and any id     */
/* that is not listed in the active profile falls back to an unlabeled  */
/* trailing group, so a future module can never disappear from the UI   */
/* by accident.                                                         */
/*                                                                      */
/* Two profiles:                                                        */
/*   • SUPERVISOR — the approved supervisor information architecture    */
/*     (الرئيسية / التدريب والتطوير / المتابعة والنتائج / التواصل       */
/*     والحساب). Selected whenever the role-filtered set contains a     */
/*     supervisor-only module ("supervisor-training") — deterministic,  */
/*     data-driven, and invisible to every other role.                  */
/*   • DEFAULT — the classic grouping, byte-for-byte identical output   */
/*     to the previous sidebar for all non-supervisor roles.            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface NavGroupDef {
  label: string;
  members: string[];
}

export interface RenderedNavGroup {
  label: string;
  items: NavItem[];
}

const DEFAULT_NAV_GROUPS: NavGroupDef[] = [
  {
    label: "القائمة الرئيسية",
    members: [
      "home",
      "academy",
      "schools",
      "school-branding",
      "users",
      "school-users",
      "supervision",
      "deputy-overview",
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "التدريب والتقييم",
    members: [
      "programs",
      "course-management",
      "assessments",
      "assignments",
      "certificates",
      "reports",
    ],
  },
  {
    label: "حسابي",
    members: ["my-profile", "settings"],
  },
];

/** Supervisor profile — the approved 4-group information architecture. */
const SUPERVISOR_NAV_GROUPS: NavGroupDef[] = [
  {
    label: "الرئيسية",
    members: ["home", "supervision"],
  },
  {
    label: "التدريب والتطوير",
    members: ["academy", "supervisor-training"],
  },
  {
    label: "المتابعة والنتائج",
    members: ["assignments", "certificates", "reports", "growth"],
  },
  {
    label: "التواصل والحساب",
    members: ["messages", "my-profile", "account-security"],
  },
];

/**
 * Group the role-filtered items following the active profile. Items are
 * emitted in the profile's member order (so "الرسائل" precedes "ملفي
 * الشخصي" for the supervisor as designed), unknown ids fall back to an
 * unlabeled trailing group in config order, and empty groups are
 * dropped — other roles keep exactly the groups they see today.
 */
export function navGroupsForItems(items: NavItem[]): RenderedNavGroup[] {
  const profile = items.some((item) => item.id === "supervisor-training")
    ? SUPERVISOR_NAV_GROUPS
    : DEFAULT_NAV_GROUPS;

  const byId = new Map(items.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
  const known = new Set(profile.flatMap((group) => group.members));

  const groups: RenderedNavGroup[] = profile.map((group) => ({
    label: group.label,
    items: group.members
      .map((id) => byId.get(id))
      .filter((item): item is NavItem => item !== undefined),
  }));

  const leftovers = items.filter((item) => !known.has(item.id));
  if (leftovers.length > 0) groups.push({ label: "", items: leftovers });

  return groups.filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
}

/* ---- Public app origin (email links) ------------------------------- */

/**
 * Base URL used inside outbound emails. Required in production so links
 * point at the real deployment; falls back to a relative marker in dev.
 */
export function appPublicOrigin(): string | null {
  const raw = (process.env.APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN ?? "").trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  // Must be a plain https(s) origin — never a path, never user input.
  if (!/^https:\/\/[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+(:\d{2,5})?$/.test(raw)) return null;
  return raw.replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

"use client"

// Inspired by react-hot-toast library
import * as React from "react"

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string
  title?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  action?: ToastActionElement
}

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const

let count = 0

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  return count.toString()
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes

type Action =
  | {
    type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]
    toast: ToasterToast
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]
    toast: Partial<ToasterToast>
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]
    toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]
    toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
  }

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[]
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    })
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY)

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout)
}

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      }

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      }

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId)
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id)
        })
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
              ...t,
              open: false,
            }
            : t
        ),
      }
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        }
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      }
  }
}

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = []

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] }

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState)
  })
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId()

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    })
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id })

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss()
      },
    },
  })

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  }
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState)
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1)
      }
    }
  }, [state])

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  }
}

export { useToast, toast }

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\instrumentation.ts
========================================

/**
 * Phase 11 — optional in-process scheduler (FALLBACK ONLY).
 *
 * Production deployments should drive background work through an EXTERNAL
 * scheduler calling the secured POST /api/cron/dispatch endpoint with the
 * CRON_SECRET header — an in-memory timer cannot be relied upon for
 * production scheduling (process restarts, multi-instance deployments).
 *
 * This instrumentation only runs when ENABLE_INTERNAL_SCHEDULER=true,
 * never registers twice, and unrefs its timer so it never keeps the
 * process alive. Every tick is the same idempotent code path the cron
 * endpoint uses.
 */

export async function register(): Promise<void> {
  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME !== "nodejs") return;
  if ((process.env.ENABLE_INTERNAL_SCHEDULER ?? "").trim() !== "true") return;

  const globalRef = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
    __mqPhase11SchedulerTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  };
  if (globalRef.__mqPhase11SchedulerTimer) return;

  const { INTERNAL_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS } = await import("@/config/notifications");
  const { scanAssignmentDeadlineReminders, scanCourseCompletions } = await import(
    "@/lib/notifications/reminders"
  );
  const { processEmailOutbox } = await import("@/lib/notifications/dispatcher");

  const tick = async (): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await scanAssignmentDeadlineReminders();
    } catch (error) {
      // Logged but never fatal — the next tick retries idempotently.
      console.error(
        "[scheduler] deadline scan failed:",
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
    }
    try {
      await scanCourseCompletions();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "[scheduler] course-completion scan failed:",
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
    }
    try {
      await processEmailOutbox();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "[scheduler] email dispatch failed:",
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
    }
  };

  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    void tick();
  }, Math.max(30, INTERNAL_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS) * 1000);
  timer.unref?.();
  globalRef.__mqPhase11SchedulerTimer = timer;
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — academic year handling (HTML v26 parity).                  */
/*                                                                      */
/* The ORIGINAL platform tagged every course/completion/certificate     */
/* with an academic year ("1448هـ") and allowed the office to start a   */
/* new year and archive the old one. The active year lives in the       */
/* SystemSetting table (key "academicYear.active") — created on demand  */
/* so existing databases keep working without a seed step.              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const ACADEMIC_YEAR_SETTING_KEY = "academicYear.active";

/** The original platform's year — the default until the office changes it. */
export const DEFAULT_ACADEMIC_YEAR = "1448هـ";

/** Loose validation: digits + the هـ suffix (e.g. 1448هـ, 1449هـ). */
export function normalizeAcademicYear(raw: string): string | null {
  const value = raw.trim();
  if (!/^\d{4}هـ$/.test(value)) return null;
  const number = Number(value.slice(0, 4));
  if (number < 1400 || number > 1500) return null;
  return value;
}

/** Read the active academic year, creating the setting row on demand. */
export async function getActiveAcademicYear(): Promise<string> {
  const setting = await db.systemSetting.findUnique({
    where: { key: ACADEMIC_YEAR_SETTING_KEY },
  });
  return setting?.value ?? DEFAULT_ACADEMIC_YEAR;
}

/**
 * Start a new academic year (HTML v26StartYear). Returns the normalized
 * value or null when the input is not a valid year string.
 */
export async function setActiveAcademicYear(
  raw: string
): Promise<{ ok: true; year: string } | { ok: false; message: string }> {
  const year = normalizeAcademicYear(raw);
  if (!year) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "صيغة العام الدراسي غير صحيحة — مثال صحيح: 1449هـ",
    };
  }
  await db.systemSetting.upsert({
    where: { key: ACADEMIC_YEAR_SETTING_KEY },
    create: { key: ACADEMIC_YEAR_SETTING_KEY, value: year },
    update: { value: year },
  });
  return { ok: true, year };
}

import {
  hashPassword,
  verifyPassword,
  verifyDummyPassword,
} from "@/lib/auth/password";
import { revokeAllSessions } from "@/lib/users/service";
import { notifyPasswordResetByAdmin } from "@/lib/notifications/center";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — account security (HTML v23/v27 parity, hardened).          */
/*                                                                      */
/* 1. Self-service password change (v27): the CURRENT password is       */
/*    verified server-side, the new one follows the platform's Zod      */
/*    rules (>= 8 chars, letter + digit), every OTHER session dies      */
/*    (tokenVersion bump) and the current session is transparently      */
/*    re-issued by the caller.                                          */
/* 2. Self-service email change (v23/v27): password re-authentication   */
/*    + uniqueness; the address restarts UNVERIFIED and the existing    */
/*    verification pipeline is re-used (resend attempt reported).       */
/* 3. Administrative temporary password (v23AdminReset): a cryptographically */
/*    random 12-char secret is hashed and stored; it is returned ONCE   */
/*    to the admin UI and is NEVER emailed, logged or persisted in      */
/*    plaintext. All sessions of the target are revoked and the owner   */
/*    is notified (without the secret).                                 */
/* 4. Administrative email update (v23UpdateAccountEmail): uniqueness   */
/*    + unverified restart + resend attempt.                            */
/*                                                                      */
/* Unknown accounts go through verifyDummyPassword so response timing   */
/* never reveals whether an account exists.                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type SecurityServiceResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      message: string;
      code?: "VALIDATION_ERROR" | "FORBIDDEN" | "NOT_FOUND" | "DUPLICATE_EMAIL";
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
    };

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 1) Self-service password change                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ChangePasswordOutcome {
  /** New tokenVersion — the caller re-issues the current session cookie. */
  tokenVersion: number;
}

export async function changeOwnPassword(
  userId: string,
  currentPassword: string,
  newPassword: string
): Promise<SecurityServiceResult<ChangePasswordOutcome>> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { id: true, passwordHash: true, tokenVersion: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!user || !user.isActive) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الحساب غير متاح", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }

  const currentOk = await verifyPassword(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
  if (!currentOk) {
    const timing = await verifyDummyPassword(currentPassword);
    void timing;
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { currentPassword: "كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة" },
    };
  }

  const parsed = passwordFieldRules().safeParse(newPassword);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "كلمة المرور غير صالحة",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { newPassword: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "كلمة المرور غير صالحة" },
    };
  }
  if (await verifyPassword(newPassword, user.passwordHash)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "كلمة المرور الجديدة مطابقة للحالية — اختر كلمة مرور مختلفة",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { newPassword: "كلمة المرور الجديدة مطابقة للحالية" },
    };
  }

  const passwordHash = await hashPassword(parsed.data);
  const updated = await db.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: {
      passwordHash,
      passwordUpdatedAt: new Date(),
      tokenVersion: { increment: 1 },
    },
    select: { tokenVersion: true },
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { tokenVersion: updated.tokenVersion } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 2) Self-service email change                                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ChangeEmailOutcome {
  email: string;
  /** Whether a verification email was dispatched through the existing
   * pipeline (honest report — the pipeline's response is generic). */
  verificationEmailSent: boolean;
}

export async function changeOwnEmail(
  userId: string,
  currentPassword: string,
  newEmail: string
): Promise<SecurityServiceResult<ChangeEmailOutcome>> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { id: true, passwordHash: true, email: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!user || !user.isActive) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الحساب غير متاح", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }

  const currentOk = await verifyPassword(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
  if (!currentOk) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { currentPassword: "كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة" },
    };
  }

  const parsed = emailFieldRules().safeParse(newEmail);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "البريد الإلكتروني غير صالح",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { newEmail: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "البريد الإلكتروني غير صالح" },
    };
  }
  if (parsed.data === user.email) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "هذا بريدك الحالي بالفعل",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { newEmail: "هذا بريدك الحالي" },
    };
  }

  const taken = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: parsed.data },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (taken && taken.id !== userId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "هذا البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم لحساب آخر",
      code: "DUPLICATE_EMAIL",
      fieldErrors: { newEmail: "البريد مستخدم لحساب آخر" },
    };
  }

  // The new address restarts UNVERIFIED — teachers must re-verify before
  // their next sign-in (the platform's existing rule, preserved).
  await db.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: { email: parsed.data, emailVerifiedAt: null },
  });

  // Best-effort verification email through the EXISTING pipeline.
  let verificationEmailSent = false;
  try {
    const { resendVerificationEmail } = await import("@/lib/users/service");
    await resendVerificationEmail(parsed.data, appBaseUrl());
    verificationEmailSent = true;
  } catch {
    verificationEmailSent = false;
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: { email: parsed.data, verificationEmailSent },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 3) Administrative temporary password                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const TEMP_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789";

function generateTemporaryPassword(): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(12);
  let password = "";
  for (const byte of bytes) password += TEMP_ALPHABET[byte % TEMP_ALPHABET.length];
  // Guarantee the platform's letter+digit rule.
  if (!/\d/.test(password)) password = `${password.slice(0, 11)}7`;
  return password;
}

export interface AdminResetOutcome {
  /** The plaintext temporary password — shown ONCE in the admin UI. */
  temporaryPassword: string;
}

export async function adminSetTemporaryPassword(
  actor: { id: string; name: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null },
  targetUserId: string
): Promise<SecurityServiceResult<AdminResetOutcome>> {
  if (actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return { ok: false, message: "إعادة التعيين متاحة للإدارة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const target = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: targetUserId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!target) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الحساب غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (
    actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    target.schoolId !== actor.schoolId
  ) {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذا الحساب خارج نطاق مدرستك", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const temporaryPassword = generateTemporaryPassword();
  await db.user.update({
    where: { id: targetUserId },
    data: {
      passwordHash: await hashPassword(temporaryPassword),
      passwordUpdatedAt: new Date(),
      tokenVersion: { increment: 1 },
    },
  });

  // Notify the owner WITHOUT the secret (best effort — never fails the reset).
  try {
    await notifyPasswordResetByAdmin({ userId: targetUserId, actorName: actor.name });
  } catch {
    // notification center failures are non-fatal by contract
  }

  return { ok: true, data: { temporaryPassword } };
}

export async function adminUpdateEmail(
  actor: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null },
  targetUserId: string,
  newEmail: string
): Promise<SecurityServiceResult<ChangeEmailOutcome>> {
  if (actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return { ok: false, message: "تحديث البريد متاح للإدارة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const target = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: targetUserId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true, email: true },
  });
  if (!target) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الحساب غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (
    actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    target.schoolId !== actor.schoolId
  ) {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذا الحساب خارج نطاق مدرستك", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const parsed = emailFieldRules().safeParse(newEmail);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "البريد الإلكتروني غير صالح",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { newEmail: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "البريد الإلكتروني غير صالح" },
    };
  }
  if (parsed.data === target.email) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "هذا بريد الحساب الحالي بالفعل",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { newEmail: "هذا البريد الحالي" },
    };
  }
  const taken = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: parsed.data },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (taken && taken.id !== targetUserId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "هذا البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم لحساب آخر",
      code: "DUPLICATE_EMAIL",
      fieldErrors: { newEmail: "البريد مستخدم لحساب آخر" },
    };
  }

  await db.user.update({
    where: { id: targetUserId },
    data: { email: parsed.data, emailVerifiedAt: null },
  });

  let verificationEmailSent = false;
  try {
    const { resendVerificationEmail } = await import("@/lib/users/service");
    await resendVerificationEmail(parsed.data, appBaseUrl());
    verificationEmailSent = true;
  } catch {
    verificationEmailSent = false;
  }

  return { ok: true, data: { email: parsed.data, verificationEmailSent } };
}

/** The app base URL used by the existing verification emails. */
function appBaseUrl(): string {
  return (
    process.env.APP_BASE_URL ??
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ??
    "http://localhost:3000"
  );
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — pure access predicates and tenant scoping for role-based
 * dashboards, analytics, the report center and the archive center.
 *
 * No DB access lives here — every rule is unit-testable and the service
 * layer composes these helpers. The actor is ALWAYS built server-side
 * from the session user; client payloads can never widen it.
 *
 * Role capability matrix (fixed by the product, enforced server-side):
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                — platform-wide aggregates + read-only
 *                                school reports (school must be chosen
 *                                explicitly). Never operational writes
 *                                on school-owned records; archive/
 *                                restore are school roles' work.
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER — full school dashboard, reports, exports,
 *                                archive/restore inside OWN school.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY         — READ-ONLY dashboards/reports/archives
 *                                for granted schools/branches.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     — dashboards/reports restricted to
 *                                assigned teachers + granted branches.
 *   TEACHER                    — personal dashboard only; never other
 *                                teachers' records or school-wide data.
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { DEPUTY_SCHOOLS_LIMIT } from "@/config/analytics";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Result contract (mirrors the assignment/certificate/survey layers)   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type AnalyticsErrorCode = "VALIDATION_ERROR" | "FORBIDDEN" | "NOT_FOUND";

export type AnalyticsResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code: AnalyticsErrorCode };

export function analyticsFail(
  message: string,
  code: AnalyticsErrorCode
): { ok: false; message: string; code: AnalyticsErrorCode } {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Actor identity                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type AnalyticsRole =
  | "SUPER_ADMIN"
  | "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
  | "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
  | "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
  | "TEACHER";

export interface AnalyticsActor {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  role: AnalyticsRole;
  schoolId: string | null;
  branchId: string | null;
}

/** Server-side projection of the session user (never client-built). */
export function toAnalyticsActor(user: {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
  branchId: string | null;
}): AnalyticsActor | null {
  if (
    user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ||
    user.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    user.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    user.role === "TEACHER"
  ) {
    return {
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      role: user.role,
      schoolId: user.schoolId,
      branchId: user.branchId,
    };
  }
  return null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Capability predicates                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export function canViewPlatformDashboard(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "SUPER_ADMIN";
}

/** School-scoped dashboards/reports: the three school back-office roles. */
export function canViewSchoolDashboard(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
  );
}

/** Archive center visibility (view lists): school roles + platform. */
export function canViewArchive(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
  );
}

/** Archive/restore mutations are school-operational: manager + supervisor
 * (supervisor only for follow-ups of covered teachers). SUPER_ADMIN and
 * deputies never archive or restore school records. */
export function canOperateArchive(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR";
}

/** Export endpoints reuse the report permission — explicit for clarity. */
export function canExportReports(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Failure guards                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export function platformGuard(actor: AnalyticsActor): AnalyticsResult<never> | null {
  if (actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return analyticsFail("لوحة المنصة متاحة لمدير النظام فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Resolves the schools an actor may read school-scoped data for.
 * SUPER_ADMIN is intentionally rejected here — platform roles use the
 * platform dashboard, and school reports require an explicit school
 * filter validated separately.
 */
export async function resolveReadableSchoolIds(
  actor: AnalyticsActor
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<string[]>> {
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    if (!actor.schoolId) {
      return analyticsFail("حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    return { ok: true, data: [actor.schoolId] };
  }
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
      where: { userId: actor.id },
      select: { schoolId: true },
    });
    const schoolIds = Array.from(new Set(grants.map((grant) => grant.schoolId)));
    if (schoolIds.length === 0) {
      return analyticsFail("لا توجد مدارس ضمن نطاق تفويضك", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    return { ok: true, data: schoolIds };
  }
  return analyticsFail("غير مصرح بالوصول إلى بيانات المدارس", "FORBIDDEN");
}

/**
 * Supervisor coverage inside one school: explicit teacher assignments
 * UNION branch grants — the same union the growth service uses.
 * Returns teacher ids (empty = no coverage) plus branch ids.
 */
export async function supervisorCoverage(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  schoolId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<{ teacherIds: string[]; branchIds: string[] }>> {
  if (actor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return analyticsFail("هذا النطاق متاح للمشرفين التربويين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (!actor.schoolId || actor.schoolId !== schoolId) {
    return analyticsFail("النطاق المدرسي مختلف", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const [assigned, branchGrants] = await Promise.all([
    db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
      where: { supervisorId: actor.id, schoolId },
      select: { teacherId: true },
    }),
    db.supervisorAssignment.findMany({
      where: { supervisorId: actor.id, schoolId },
      select: { branchId: true },
    }),
  ]);
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      teacherIds: Array.from(new Set(assigned.map((row) => row.teacherId))),
      branchIds: Array.from(new Set(branchGrants.map((row) => row.branchId))),
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Teachers visible to an actor inside one school (the denominator of
 * every "teacher participation" metric):
 *   manager → all active school teachers
 *   deputy  → active teachers covered by grants (school-wide or branch)
 *   supervisor → assigned teachers + teachers of granted branches
 */
export async function visibleTeacherIds(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  schoolId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<string[]>> {
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    if (!actor.schoolId || actor.schoolId !== schoolId) {
      return analyticsFail("النطاق المدرسي مختلف", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
      where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.id) };
  }
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const coverage = await supervisorCoverage(actor, schoolId);
    if (!coverage.ok) return coverage;
    const { teacherIds, branchIds } = coverage.data;
    const branchTeachers =
      branchIds.length > 0
        ? await db.user.findMany({
            where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true, branchId: { in: branchIds } },
            select: { id: true },
          })
        : [];
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: Array.from(new Set([...teacherIds, ...branchTeachers.map((row) => row.id)])),
    };
  }
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
      where: { userId: actor.id, schoolId },
      select: { branchId: true },
    });
    if (grants.length === 0) {
      return analyticsFail("لا يوجد تفويض على هذه المدرسة", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    if (grants.some((grant) => grant.branchId === null)) {
      const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
        where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      return { ok: true, data: teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.id) };
    }
    const branchIds = grants
      .map((grant) => grant.branchId)
      .filter((branchId): branchId is string => branchId !== null);
    const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
      where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true, branchId: { in: branchIds } },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.id) };
  }
  if (actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    // Read-only platform role: school reports may enumerate the school's
    // active teachers (the same read-only allowance as Phase 8 records).
    const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
      where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.id) };
  }
  return analyticsFail("غير مصرح بالوصول إلى قوائم المعلمين", "FORBIDDEN");
}

/** Deputy school list for the grants dashboard (capped, stable order). */
export async function deputySchoolIds(actor: AnalyticsActor): Promise<string[]> {
  if (actor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") return [];
  const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
    where: { userId: actor.id },
    select: { schoolId: true },
  });
  return Array.from(new Set(grants.map((grant) => grant.schoolId))).slice(
    0,
    DEPUTY_SCHOOLS_LIMIT
  );
}
