/**
 * Phase 10 — role-based dashboard & analytics service.
 *
 * Every figure is computed from persisted rows with an explicit
 * denominator, aggregated in the database (groupBy/count) whenever
 * possible. Empty datasets produce zeros/nulls — never fabricated
 * numbers, never NaN. Trend buckets use a fixed 6-month window and are
 * built from date-only column scans (capped), not guesses.
 *
 * Authorization (enforced here, server-side):
 *   getPlatformDashboard  — SUPER_ADMIN only (read-only aggregates).
 *   getSchoolDashboard    — manager (own school) / deputy (granted).
 *   getSupervisorDashboard— supervisor (assigned teachers + branches).
 *   getTeacherDashboard   — TEACHER (own records only).
 *
 * School-wide survey/follow-up metric functions from Phase 9 are reused
 * with a synthetic MANAGER-role actor ONLY after this module's own
 * authorization pass (manager own-school or deputy grant). Supervisors
 * always go through their real actor so scoping stays theirs.
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  MONTH_LABELS_AR,
  PERCENTAGE_SAMPLE_LIMIT,
  PLATFORM_SCHOOLS_LIMIT,
  TREND_MONTHS,
  TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
} from "@/config/analytics";
import {
  analyticsFail,
  resolveReadableSchoolIds,
  supervisorCoverage,
  visibleTeacherIds,
  type AnalyticsActor,
  type AnalyticsResult,
} from "@/lib/analytics/access";
import { getSurveyMetrics, type SurveyMetrics } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import { getFollowUpMetrics, listFollowUps, listSharedFollowUpsForTeacher, type FollowUpMetrics } from "@/lib/followups/service";
import { getAssignmentMetrics, listReviewQueue } from "@/lib/assignments/service";
import { listGrowthRoster, type GrowthRosterRow } from "@/lib/growth/service";
import { listSurveysForTeacher } from "@/lib/surveys/service";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Trend helpers (shared)                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface TrendBucket {
  /** "2026-05" — UTC month key. */
  key: string;
  /** Arabic month label, e.g. "مايو". */
  label: string;
  start: Date;
  end: Date;
}

/** Fixed UTC month window, oldest first (deterministic for tests). */
export function monthBuckets(count = TREND_MONTHS, now = new Date()): TrendBucket[] {
  const buckets: TrendBucket[] = [];
  const cursor = new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), 1));
  for (let index = count - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const start = new Date(cursor);
    start.setUTCMonth(cursor.getUTCMonth() - index);
    const end = new Date(start);
    end.setUTCMonth(start.getUTCMonth() + 1);
    buckets.push({
      key: `${start.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(start.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      label: MONTH_LABELS_AR[start.getUTCMonth()],
      start,
      end,
    });
  }
  return buckets;
}

function bucketize(dates: Date[], buckets: TrendBucket[]): number[] {
  const counts = buckets.map(() => 0);
  for (const date of dates) {
    const index = buckets.findIndex(
      (bucket) => date >= bucket.start && date < bucket.end
    );
    if (index >= 0) counts[index] += 1;
  }
  return counts;
}

function percentOf(numerator: number, denominator: number): number | null {
  if (denominator <= 0) return null;
  return Math.round((numerator / denominator) * 100);
}

export interface TrendSeries {
  labels: string[];
  enrollments: number[];
  certificates: number[];
  surveyResponses: number[];
  submissions: number[];
}

async function schoolTrends(teacherIds: string[]): Promise<TrendSeries> {
  const buckets = monthBuckets();
  const since = buckets[0].start;
  if (teacherIds.length === 0) {
    return {
      labels: buckets.map((bucket) => bucket.label),
      enrollments: buckets.map(() => 0),
      certificates: buckets.map(() => 0),
      surveyResponses: buckets.map(() => 0),
      submissions: buckets.map(() => 0),
    };
  }
  const [enrollments, certificates, responses, submissions] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
      where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, enrolledAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { enrolledAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where: { teacherId: { in: teacherIds }, issuedAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { issuedAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.surveyResponse.findMany({
      where: {
        respondentId: { in: teacherIds },
        status: "SUBMITTED",
        submittedAt: { gte: since },
      },
      select: { submittedAt: true, createdAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.findMany({
      where: {
        teacherId: { in: teacherIds },
        status: { not: "DRAFT" },
        createdAt: { gte: since },
      },
      select: { createdAt: true, lastSubmittedAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
  ]);
  return {
    labels: buckets.map((bucket) => bucket.label),
    enrollments: bucketize(
      enrollments.map((row) => row.enrolledAt),
      buckets
    ),
    certificates: bucketize(
      certificates.map((row) => row.issuedAt),
      buckets
    ),
    surveyResponses: bucketize(
      responses.map((row) => row.submittedAt ?? row.createdAt),
      buckets
    ),
    submissions: bucketize(
      submissions.map((row) => row.lastSubmittedAt ?? row.createdAt),
      buckets
    ),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Course completion — SAME rule as certificate eligibility             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CourseCompletionSummary {
  /** Distinct (teacher, course) pairs satisfying the completion rule. */
  completedPairs: number;
  /** Courses the covered teachers are enrolled in (distinct). */
  distinctCourses: number;
}

/**
 * "Completed" reuses the Phase 8 certificate eligibility rule: for each
 * (teacher, course) enrollment, every PUBLISHED assessment bound to the
 * course must have a PASSED attempt (vacuously met when the course has
 * none). One batched pass — no N+1.
 */
export async function summarizeCourseCompletions(
  teacherIds: string[]
): Promise<CourseCompletionSummary> {
  if (teacherIds.length === 0) return { completedPairs: 0, distinctCourses: 0 };
  const enrollments = await db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
    where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, status: "ACTIVE" },
    select: { userId: true, courseId: true },
  });
  if (enrollments.length === 0) return { completedPairs: 0, distinctCourses: 0 };
  const courseIds = Array.from(new Set(enrollments.map((row) => row.courseId)));
  const assessments = await db.assessment.findMany({
    where: { courseId: { in: courseIds }, status: "PUBLISHED" },
    select: { id: true, courseId: true },
  });
  const boundAssessments = assessments.filter(
    (assessment): assessment is { id: string; courseId: string } =>
      assessment.courseId !== null
  );
  const assessmentsByCourse = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const assessment of boundAssessments) {
    const list = assessmentsByCourse.get(assessment.courseId);
    if (list) list.push(assessment.id);
    else assessmentsByCourse.set(assessment.courseId, [assessment.id]);
  }
  const passedPairs = new Set<string>();
  if (boundAssessments.length > 0) {
    const passedAttempts = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: {
        userId: { in: teacherIds },
        assessmentId: { in: boundAssessments.map((assessment) => assessment.id) },
        status: "PASSED",
      },
      select: { userId: true, assessmentId: true },
    });
    for (const attempt of passedAttempts) {
      passedPairs.add(`${attempt.userId}:${attempt.assessmentId}`);
    }
  }
  let completedPairs = 0;
  for (const enrollment of enrollments) {
    const required = assessmentsByCourse.get(enrollment.courseId) ?? [];
    const met = required.every((assessmentId) =>
      passedPairs.has(`${enrollment.userId}:${assessmentId}`)
    );
    if (met) completedPairs += 1;
  }
  return { completedPairs, distinctCourses: courseIds.length };
}

export interface SchoolStats {

/**
 * School-wide aggregate. Callers MUST have authorized actor→schoolId
 * first (manager own-school or deputy grant) — the synthetic MANAGER
 * actor used for Phase 9 metric reuse is safe only inside this function.
 */
export async function computeSchoolStats(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  schoolId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<SchoolStats>> {
  const readable = await resolveReadableSchoolIds(actor);
  if (!readable.ok) return readable;
  if (!readable.data.includes(schoolId)) {
    return analyticsFail("لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى بيانات هذه المدرسة", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const school = await db.school.findUnique({
    where: { id: schoolId },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
  });
  if (!school) return analyticsFail("المدرسة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");

  const teachers = await visibleTeacherIds(actor, schoolId);
  if (!teachers.ok) return teachers;
  const teacherIds = teachers.data;

  // Phase 9 metric functions under a synthetic MANAGER actor — this is
  // safe here because the school has just been authorized above.
  const metricsActor = {
    id: actor.id,
    name: actor.name,
    role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" as const,
    schoolId,
  };

  const now = new Date();
  const startOfToday = new Date(
    Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate())
  );

  const [
    branches,
    programsPublished,
    coursesPublished,
    assessmentsPublished,
    completion,
    attemptsByStatus,
    percentageRows,
    assignmentMetrics,
    assignmentsArchived,
    certificatesIssued,
    certificatesRevoked,
    certificatesExpired,
    surveyMetricsResult,
    followUpMetricsResult,
    followUpsOverdue,
    trends,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    db.branch.findMany({
      where: { schoolId, isActive: true },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
      orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
    }),
    db.trainingProgram.count({ where: { schoolId, status: "PUBLISHED" } }),
    db.course.count({
      where: { OR: [{ schoolId }, { schoolId: null }], status: "PUBLISHED" },
    }),
    db.assessment.count({
      where: { OR: [{ schoolId }, { schoolId: null }], status: "PUBLISHED" },
    }),
    summarizeCourseCompletions(teacherIds),
    db.assessmentAttempt.groupBy({
      by: ["status"],
      where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED", "NEEDS_REVIEW"] } },
      _count: true,
    }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
      select: { percentage: true },
      take: PERCENTAGE_SAMPLE_LIMIT,
    }),
    getAssignmentMetrics(schoolId),
    db.assignment.count({ where: { schoolId, status: "ARCHIVED" } }),
    db.certificate.count({ where: { schoolId, status: "ISSUED" } }),
    db.certificate.count({ where: { schoolId, status: "REVOKED" } }),
    db.certificate.count({
      where: { schoolId, status: "ISSUED", expiresAt: { lt: now } },
    }),
    getSurveyMetrics(metricsActor),
    getFollowUpMetrics(metricsActor),
    db.followUp.count({
      where: {
        schoolId,
        archivedAt: null,
        status: { in: ["PLANNED", "IN_PROGRESS"] },
        followUpDate: { lt: startOfToday },
      },
    }),
    schoolTrends(teacherIds),
  ]);

  if (!surveyMetricsResult.ok) {
    return analyticsFail(surveyMetricsResult.message, "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (!followUpMetricsResult.ok) {
    return analyticsFail(followUpMetricsResult.message, "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const statusCount = (status: string) =>
    attemptsByStatus.find((row) => row.status === status)?._count ?? 0;
  const attemptsPassed = statusCount("PASSED");
  const attemptsFinalized = attemptsPassed + statusCount("FAILED");
  const percentages = percentageRows
    .map((row) => row.percentage)
    .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");

  const enrollmentsTotal = await db.courseEnrollment.count({
    where: { status: "ACTIVE", user: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true } },
  });
  const enrolledTeachersRows = await db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
    where: { status: "ACTIVE", user: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true } },
    select: { userId: true },
    distinct: ["userId"],
  });

  const branchRows: BranchRow[] = [];
  for (const branch of branches.slice(0, 20)) {
    const [teachersInBranch, enrollmentsInBranch] = await Promise.all([
      db.user.count({
        where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true, branchId: branch.id },
      }),
      db.courseEnrollment.count({
        where: { status: "ACTIVE", user: { branchId: branch.id, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true } },
      }),
    ]);
    branchRows.push({
      branchId: branch.id,
      branchName: branch.nameAr,
      teachers: teachersInBranch,
      enrollments: enrollmentsInBranch,
    });
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      schoolId,
      schoolName: school.nameAr,
      branchesCount: branches.length,
      teachersActive: teacherIds.length,
      teachersByBranch: branchRows,
      programsPublished,
      coursesPublished,
      enrollmentsTotal,
      enrolledTeachers: enrolledTeachersRows.length,
      enrollmentRatePercent: percentOf(enrolledTeachersRows.length, teacherIds.length),
      coursesCompletedPairs: completion.completedPairs,
      assessmentsPublished,
      attemptsFinalized,
      attemptsPassed,
      passRatePercent: percentOf(attemptsPassed, attemptsFinalized),
      avgPercentage:
        percentages.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              percentages.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / percentages.length
            )
          : null,
      attemptsNeedingReview: statusCount("NEEDS_REVIEW"),
      assignmentsPublished: assignmentMetrics.assignmentsPublished,
      assignmentsArchived,
      submissionsActive: assignmentMetrics.submissionsActive,
      submissionsPendingReview: assignmentMetrics.pendingReview,
      submissionsGraded: assignmentMetrics.gradedCount,
      submissionsLate: assignmentMetrics.lateCount,
      submissionCompletionPercent: percentOf(
        assignmentMetrics.gradedCount,
        assignmentMetrics.submissionsActive
      ),
      certificatesIssued,
      certificatesRevoked,
      certificatesExpired,
      surveys: surveyMetricsResult.data,
      followUps: followUpMetricsResult.data,
      followUpsOverdue,
      trends,
    },
  };
}

export interface PlatformSchoolRow {
  schoolId: string;
  schoolName: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  teachers: number;
  enrollments: number;
  submissions: number;
  certificates: number;
  surveys: number;
  followUpsCompleted: number;
}

export interface PlatformDashboard {
  generatedAt: Date;
  schoolsTotal: number;
  schoolsActive: number;
  schoolsInactive: number;
  branchesTotal: number;
  usersByRole: { role: string; count: number }[];
  teachersActive: number;
  programsPublished: number;
  coursesPublished: number;
  assessmentsPublished: number;
  enrollmentsTotal: number;
  attemptsFinalized: number;
  attemptsPassed: number;
  passRatePercent: number | null;
  assignmentsPublished: number;
  submissionsActive: number;
  submissionsGraded: number;
  certificatesIssued: number;
  certificatesRevoked: number;
  surveysTotal: number;
  surveyResponsesSubmitted: number;
  followUpsTotal: number;
  followUpsCompleted: number;
  perSchool: PlatformSchoolRow[];
  trends: TrendSeries;
}

export async function getPlatformDashboard(
  actor: AnalyticsActor
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<PlatformDashboard>> {
  if (actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return analyticsFail("لوحة المنصة متاحة لمدير النظام فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const [schools, branchesTotal, usersByRole, trends] = await Promise.all([
    db.school.findMany({
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true, isActive: true },
      orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
      take: PLATFORM_SCHOOLS_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.branch.count(),
    db.user.groupBy({ by: ["role"], _count: true }),
    platformTrends(),
  ]);

  const roleCount = (role: string) =>
    usersByRole.find((row) => row.role === role)?._count ?? 0;

  const schoolIds = schools.map((school) => school.id);
  const teachersActive = await db.user.count({
    where: { role: "TEACHER", isActive: true, schoolId: { in: schoolIds } },
  });

  const [
    programsPublished,
    coursesPublished,
    assessmentsPublished,
    enrollmentsTotal,
    attemptsByStatus,
    percentageRows,
    assignmentsPublished,
    submissionsActive,
    submissionsGraded,
    certificatesIssued,
    certificatesRevoked,
    surveysTotal,
    surveyResponsesSubmitted,
    followUpsTotal,
    followUpsCompleted,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    db.trainingProgram.count({ where: { status: "PUBLISHED" } }),
    db.course.count({ where: { status: "PUBLISHED" } }),
    db.assessment.count({ where: { status: "PUBLISHED" } }),
    db.courseEnrollment.count({ where: { status: "ACTIVE" } }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.groupBy({
      by: ["status"],
      where: { status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
      _count: true,
    }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: { status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
      select: { percentage: true },
      take: PERCENTAGE_SAMPLE_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.assignment.count({ where: { status: "PUBLISHED" } }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.count({ where: { status: { not: "DRAFT" } } }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.count({ where: { status: "GRADED" } }),
    db.certificate.count({ where: { status: "ISSUED" } }),
    db.certificate.count({ where: { status: "REVOKED" } }),
    db.survey.count(),
    db.surveyResponse.count({ where: { status: "SUBMITTED" } }),
    db.followUp.count({ where: { archivedAt: null } }),
    db.followUp.count({ where: { archivedAt: null, status: "COMPLETED" } }),
  ]);

  const attemptsPassed =
    attemptsByStatus.find((row) => row.status === "PASSED")?._count ?? 0;
  const attemptsFinalized =
    attemptsPassed + (attemptsByStatus.find((row) => row.status === "FAILED")?._count ?? 0);
  const percentages = percentageRows
    .map((row) => row.percentage)
    .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");

  const perSchool: PlatformSchoolRow[] = [];
  for (const school of schools) {
    const [teachers, enrollments, submissions, certificates, surveys, followUpsCompletedFor] =
      await Promise.all([
        db.user.count({
          where: { schoolId: school.id, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
        }),
        db.courseEnrollment.count({
          where: { status: "ACTIVE", user: { schoolId: school.id } },
        }),
        db.assignmentSubmission.count({ where: { schoolId: school.id, status: { not: "DRAFT" } } }),
        db.certificate.count({ where: { schoolId: school.id } }),
        db.survey.count({ where: { schoolId: school.id } }),
        db.followUp.count({
          where: { schoolId: school.id, archivedAt: null, status: "COMPLETED" },
        }),
      ]);
    perSchool.push({
      schoolId: school.id,
      schoolName: school.nameAr,
      isActive: school.isActive,
      teachers,
      enrollments,
      submissions,
      certificates,
      surveys,
      followUpsCompleted: followUpsCompletedFor,
    });
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      generatedAt: new Date(),
      schoolsTotal: schools.length,
      schoolsActive: schools.filter((school) => school.isActive).length,
      schoolsInactive: schools.filter((school) => !school.isActive).length,
      branchesTotal,
      usersByRole: [
        { role: "SUPER_ADMIN", count: roleCount("SUPER_ADMIN") },
        { role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", count: roleCount("DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") },
        { role: "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY", count: roleCount("EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") },
        { role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", count: roleCount("EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") },
        { role: "TEACHER", count: roleCount("TEACHER") },
      ],
      teachersActive,
      programsPublished,
      coursesPublished,
      assessmentsPublished,
      enrollmentsTotal,
      attemptsFinalized,
      attemptsPassed,
      passRatePercent: percentOf(attemptsPassed, attemptsFinalized),
      assignmentsPublished,
      submissionsActive,
      submissionsGraded,
      certificatesIssued,
      certificatesRevoked,
      surveysTotal,
      surveyResponsesSubmitted,
      followUpsTotal,
      followUpsCompleted,
      perSchool,
      trends,
    },
  };
}

async function platformTrends(): Promise<TrendSeries> {
  const buckets = monthBuckets();
  const since = buckets[0].start;
  const [enrollments, certificates, responses, submissions] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
      where: { enrolledAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { enrolledAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where: { issuedAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { issuedAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.surveyResponse.findMany({
      where: { status: "SUBMITTED", submittedAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { submittedAt: true, createdAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.findMany({
      where: { status: { not: "DRAFT" }, createdAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { createdAt: true, lastSubmittedAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
  ]);
  return {
    labels: buckets.map((bucket) => bucket.label),
    enrollments: bucketize(
      enrollments.map((row) => row.enrolledAt),
      buckets
    ),
    certificates: bucketize(
      certificates.map((row) => row.issuedAt),
      buckets
    ),
    surveyResponses: bucketize(
      responses.map((row) => row.submittedAt ?? row.createdAt),
      buckets
    ),
    submissions: bucketize(
      submissions.map((row) => row.lastSubmittedAt ?? row.createdAt),
      buckets
    ),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function getSchoolDashboard(
  actor: AnalyticsActor
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<SchoolStats>> {
  if (actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" && actor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    return analyticsFail(
      "لوحة المدرسة متاحة لمدير مكتب التطوير والوكيل التعليمي فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  const readable = await resolveReadableSchoolIds(actor);
  if (!readable.ok) return readable;
  return computeSchoolStats(actor, readable.data[0]);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface PendingReviewRow {
  submissionId: string;
  assignmentTitle: string;
  teacherName: string;
  lastSubmittedAt: Date | null;
}

  id: string;
  titleAr: string;

  status: string;

export interface SupervisorDashboard {
  scopeLabel: string;
  coverageTeacherCount: number;
  coverageBranchCount: number;
  roster: GrowthRosterRow[];
  submissionsPendingReview: number;
  attemptsNeedingReview: number;
  pendingReviewSample: PendingReviewRow[];
  followUps: FollowUpMetrics;
  followUpsOverdue: number;
  upcomingFollowUps: UpcomingFollowUpRow[];
  surveysOpen: number;
  surveysResponsesSubmitted: number;
  certificatesActive: number;
  avgPercentage: number | null;
}

export async function getSupervisorDashboard(
  actor: AnalyticsActor
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<SupervisorDashboard>> {
  if (actor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !actor.schoolId) {
    return analyticsFail("لوحة المشرف متاحة للمشرفين التربويين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const schoolId = actor.schoolId;
  const coverage = await supervisorCoverage(actor, schoolId);
  if (!coverage.ok) return coverage;
  const { teacherIds, branchIds } = coverage.data;

  const scopeTeacherIds = await visibleTeacherIds(actor, schoolId);
  if (!scopeTeacherIds.ok) return scopeTeacherIds;

  const now = new Date();
  const startOfToday = new Date(
    Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate())
  );
  const inFourteenDays = new Date(startOfToday);
  inFourteenDays.setUTCDate(startOfToday.getUTCDate() + 14);

  const surveyActor = {
    id: actor.id,
    name: actor.name,
    role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" as const,
    schoolId,
  };

  const [roster, reviewQueue, attemptsNeedingReview, followUpMetrics, followUpsOverdue] =
    await Promise.all([
      listGrowthRoster({
        id: actor.id,
        name: actor.name,
        role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
        schoolId,
      }),
      listReviewQueue(
        { id: actor.id, name: actor.name, role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", schoolId },
        { status: "SUBMITTED" }
      ),
      db.assessmentAttempt.count({
        where: { userId: { in: scopeTeacherIds.data }, status: "NEEDS_REVIEW" },
      }),
      getFollowUpMetrics(surveyActor),
      db.followUp.count({
        where: {
          schoolId,
          archivedAt: null,
          status: { in: ["PLANNED", "IN_PROGRESS"] },
          followUpDate: { lt: startOfToday },
          OR: [{ supervisorId: actor.id }, { createdById: actor.id }],
        },
      }),
    ]);

  if (!reviewQueue.ok) return analyticsFail(reviewQueue.message, "FORBIDDEN");
  if (!followUpMetrics.ok) return analyticsFail(followUpMetrics.message, "FORBIDDEN");

  const [upcomingRows, surveysOpen, responsesSubmitted, certificatesActive, percentageRows] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.followUp.findMany({
        where: {
          schoolId,
          archivedAt: null,
          status: { in: ["PLANNED", "IN_PROGRESS"] },
          AND: [
            {
              OR: [
                { nextFollowUpAt: { gte: startOfToday, lte: inFourteenDays } },
                { followUpDate: { gte: startOfToday, lte: inFourteenDays } },
              ],
            },
            { OR: [{ supervisorId: actor.id }, { createdById: actor.id }] },
          ],
        },
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          followUpDate: true,
          status: true,
          teacher: { select: { name: true } },
        },
        orderBy: { followUpDate: "asc" },
        take: 5,
      }),
      db.survey.count({
        where: { schoolId, ownerUserId: actor.id, status: "PUBLISHED", archivedAt: null },
      }),
      db.surveyResponse.count({
        where: { status: "SUBMITTED", survey: { ownerUserId: actor.id } },
      }),
      db.certificate.count({
        where: { teacherId: { in: scopeTeacherIds.data }, status: "ISSUED" },
      }),
      db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
        where: { userId: { in: scopeTeacherIds.data }, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
        select: { percentage: true },
        take: PERCENTAGE_SAMPLE_LIMIT,
      }),
    ]);

  const percentages = percentageRows
    .map((row) => row.percentage)
    .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");

  const upcomingFollowUps = upcomingRows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    titleAr: row.titleAr,
    teacherName: row.teacher.name,
    followUpDate: row.followUpDate,
    status: row.status,
  }));

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      scopeLabel: "المعلمون ضمن نطاق إشرافك",
      coverageTeacherCount: scopeTeacherIds.data.length,
      coverageBranchCount: branchIds.length,
      roster: roster.ok ? roster.data.rows : [],
      submissionsPendingReview: reviewQueue.data.length,
      attemptsNeedingReview,
      pendingReviewSample: reviewQueue.data.slice(0, 5).map((row) => ({
        submissionId: row.submissionId,
        assignmentTitle: row.assignmentTitle,
        teacherName: row.teacherName,
        lastSubmittedAt: row.lastSubmittedAt,
      })),
      followUps: followUpMetrics.data,
      followUpsOverdue,
      upcomingFollowUps,
      surveysOpen,
      surveysResponsesSubmitted: responsesSubmitted,
      certificatesActive,
      avgPercentage:
        percentages.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              percentages.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / percentages.length
            )
          : null,
    },
  };
}

export interface TeacherCourseRow {
  courseId: string;
  titleAr: string;
  programName: string | null;
  instructorName: string | null;
  completed: boolean;
}

export interface TeacherAttemptRow {
  assessmentTitle: string;
  percentage: number | null;
  passed: boolean | null;
  submittedAt: Date | null;
}

export interface TeacherFeedbackRow {
  assignmentTitle: string;
  scoreTotal: number | null;
  totalPoints: number;
  feedbackText: string | null;
  reviewedAt: Date | null;
}

export interface TeacherDashboard {
  courses: TeacherCourseRow[];
  coursesCompleted: number;
  availableAssessments: number;
  attemptsFinalized: number;
  attemptsPassed: number;
  avgPercentage: number | null;
  recentAttempts: TeacherAttemptRow[];
  assignmentsPending: number;
  assignmentsAwaitingReview: number;
  assignmentsGraded: number;
  recentFeedback: TeacherFeedbackRow[];
  certificatesActive: number;
  surveysAwaiting: number;
  sharedFollowUpsCount: number;
  trends: TrendSeries;
}

export async function getTeacherDashboard(viewer: {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}): Promise<AnalyticsResult<TeacherDashboard>> {
  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return analyticsFail("لوحة المعلم متاحة للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const teacherId = viewer.id;
  const now = new Date();

  const enrollments = await db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
    where: { userId: teacherId, status: "ACTIVE" },
    select: { courseId: true, course: { select: { titleAr: true, program: { select: { nameAr: true } }, instructor: { select: { name: true } }, status: true } } },
    orderBy: { enrolledAt: "desc" },
    take: 20,
  });
  const courseIds = enrollments.map((row) => row.courseId);

  // Completion rule — same as the certificate eligibility engine.
  const assessments =
    courseIds.length > 0
      ? await db.assessment.findMany({
          where: { courseId: { in: courseIds }, status: "PUBLISHED" },
          select: { id: true, courseId: true },
        })
      : [];
  const boundAssessments = assessments.filter(
    (assessment): assessment is { id: string; courseId: string } =>
      assessment.courseId !== null
  );
  const assessmentsByCourse = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const assessment of boundAssessments) {
    const list = assessmentsByCourse.get(assessment.courseId);
    if (list) list.push(assessment.id);
    else assessmentsByCourse.set(assessment.courseId, [assessment.id]);
  }
  const myAttempts =
    boundAssessments.length > 0
      ? await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
          where: { userId: teacherId, assessmentId: { in: boundAssessments.map((a) => a.id) } },
          select: { assessmentId: true, status: true },
        })
      : [];
  const passedIds = new Set(
    myAttempts.filter((attempt) => attempt.status === "PASSED").map((attempt) => attempt.assessmentId)
  );
  const attemptedIds = new Set(myAttempts.map((attempt) => attempt.assessmentId));
  const availableAssessments = boundAssessments.filter(
    (assessment) => !attemptedIds.has(assessment.id)
  ).length;

  const courses: TeacherCourseRow[] = enrollments.map((row) => {
    const required = assessmentsByCourse.get(row.courseId) ?? [];
    return {
      courseId: row.courseId,
      titleAr: row.course.titleAr,
      programName: row.course.program?.nameAr ?? null,
      instructorName: row.course.instructor?.name ?? null,
      completed: required.every((assessmentId) => passedIds.has(assessmentId)),
    };
  });

  const buckets = monthBuckets();
  const since = buckets[0].start;
  const [
    recentAttemptRows,
    submissionCounts,
    gradedRows,
    certificatesActive,
    surveysAwaitingResult,
    sharedFollowUpsResult,
    attemptsFinalized,
    attemptsPassed,
    percentageRows,
    myEnrollmentTrend,
    myCertificateTrend,
    mySubmissionTrend,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: { userId: teacherId, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
      select: { percentage: true, passed: true, submittedAt: true, assessment: { select: { titleAr: true } } },
      orderBy: { submittedAt: "desc" },
      take: 5,
    }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.groupBy({
      by: ["status"],
      where: { teacherId },
      _count: true,
    }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.findMany({
      where: { teacherId, status: "GRADED" },
      select: {
        scoreTotal: true,
        feedbackText: true,
        reviewedAt: true,
        assignment: { select: { titleAr: true, totalPoints: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { reviewedAt: "desc" },
      take: 3,
    }),
    db.certificate.count({ where: { teacherId, status: "ISSUED" } }),
    listSurveysForTeacher({ id: viewer.id, role: "TEACHER", schoolId: viewer.schoolId }),
    listSharedFollowUpsForTeacher({ id: viewer.id, role: "TEACHER", schoolId: viewer.schoolId }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.count({
      where: { userId: teacherId, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
    }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.count({ where: { userId: teacherId, status: "PASSED" } }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: { userId: teacherId, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
      select: { percentage: true },
      take: PERCENTAGE_SAMPLE_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
      where: { userId: teacherId, enrolledAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { enrolledAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where: { teacherId, issuedAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { issuedAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.findMany({
      where: { teacherId, status: { not: "DRAFT" }, createdAt: { gte: since } },
      select: { createdAt: true, lastSubmittedAt: true },
      take: TREND_SCAN_LIMIT,
    }),
  ]);

  const count = (status: string) =>
    submissionCounts.find((row) => row.status === status)?._count ?? 0;
  const percentages = percentageRows
    .map((row) => row.percentage)
    .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");

  const surveysAwaiting = surveysAwaitingResult.ok
    ? surveysAwaitingResult.data.filter(
        (row) => row.isOpenNow && row.myResponseSubmittedAt === null
      ).length
    : 0;
  const sharedFollowUpsCount = sharedFollowUpsResult.ok
    ? sharedFollowUpsResult.data.length
    : 0;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      courses,
      coursesCompleted: courses.filter((course) => course.completed).length,
      availableAssessments,
      attemptsFinalized,
      attemptsPassed,
      avgPercentage:
        percentages.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              percentages.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / percentages.length
            )
          : null,
      recentAttempts: recentAttemptRows.map((row) => ({
        assessmentTitle: row.assessment.titleAr,
        percentage: row.percentage,
        passed: row.passed,
        submittedAt: row.submittedAt,
      })),
      assignmentsPending: count("RETURNED") + count("DRAFT"),
      assignmentsAwaitingReview: count("SUBMITTED") + count("UNDER_REVIEW"),
      assignmentsGraded: count("GRADED"),
      recentFeedback: gradedRows.map((row) => ({
        assignmentTitle: row.assignment.titleAr,
        scoreTotal: row.scoreTotal,
        totalPoints: row.assignment.totalPoints,
        feedbackText: row.feedbackText,
        reviewedAt: row.reviewedAt,
      })),
      certificatesActive,
      surveysAwaiting,
      sharedFollowUpsCount,
      trends: {
        labels: buckets.map((bucket) => bucket.label),
        enrollments: bucketize(
          myEnrollmentTrend.map((row) => row.enrolledAt),
          buckets
        ),
        certificates: bucketize(
          myCertificateTrend.map((row) => row.issuedAt),
          buckets
        ),
        surveyResponses: buckets.map(() => 0),
        submissions: bucketize(
          mySubmissionTrend.map((row) => row.lastSubmittedAt ?? row.createdAt),
          buckets
        ),
      },
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — safe archiving & restoration service.
 *
 * Principles (per the Phase 10 brief):
 *   • Status-based archival / soft deletion ONLY — nothing is ever
 *     physically deleted and no historical record is destroyed.
 *   • Entities that ALREADY carry a safe archive lifecycle reuse it:
 *       TrainingProgram / Course / Assessment → status = "ARCHIVED"
 *       Assignment                            → status = "ARCHIVED"
 *       Survey                                → status = "ARCHIVED" (+ archivedAt)
 *     This module does NOT duplicate their archive paths — it adds the
 *     missing RESTORE paths (guarded + audited) and the unified view.
 *   • FollowUp had NO archive mechanism — this module adds a soft
 *     archive (archivedAt / archivedById) that never alters its status.
 *   • Every archive/restore writes an append-only ArchiveEvent (and a
 *     FollowUpEvent for follow-ups, keeping that module's own trail).
 *   • Archived records disappear from active workflows (lists filter on
 *     archivedAt / ARCHIVED status) but stay viewable here, scoped by
 *     role and school.
 *
 * Authorization:
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER — archive/restore inside OWN school.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     — archive/restore follow-up records of
 *                                their operational scope only.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY         — read-only archive views (grants).
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                — read-only views; may restore PLATFORM-
 *                                WIDE (schoolId null) content only —
 *                                never touches school-owned records.
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  ARCHIVE_ENTITY_LABELS,
  ARCHIVE_PAGE_SIZE,
  ARCHIVE_EVENTS_LIMIT,
  type ArchiveEntityType,
} from "@/config/analytics";
import {
  analyticsFail,
  canOperateArchive,
  resolveReadableSchoolIds,
  supervisorCoverage,
  visibleTeacherIds,
  type AnalyticsActor,
  type AnalyticsResult,
} from "@/lib/analytics/access";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Scoped event writer                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function recordArchiveEvent(input: {
  schoolId: string | null;
  entityType: ArchiveEntityType;
  entityId: string;
  entityTitle: string | null;
  action: "ARCHIVED" | "RESTORED";
  actorId: string;
  actorRole: string;
  note?: string;
}) {
  await db.archiveEvent.create({
    data: {
      schoolId: input.schoolId,
      entityType: input.entityType,
      entityId: input.entityId,
      action: input.action,
      actorId: input.actorId,
      actorRole: input.actorRole,
      entityTitle: input.entityTitle,
      note: input.note,
    },
  });
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Follow-up archive / restore (soft, status-preserving)                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function followUpOperationalScope(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  followUpId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<{ schoolId: string; titleAr: string; teacherId: string }>> {
  if (!canOperateArchive(actor.role) || !actor.schoolId) {
    return analyticsFail(
      "أرشفة سجلات المتابعة متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير والمشرفين التربويين فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  const followUp = await db.followUp.findUnique({
    where: { id: followUpId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      schoolId: true,
      titleAr: true,
      teacherId: true,
      supervisorId: true,
      createdById: true,
      teacher: { select: { id: true, schoolId: true, branchId: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!followUp) return analyticsFail("سجل المتابعة غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  if (followUp.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return analyticsFail("سجل المتابعة خارج نطاقك المدرسي", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const isResponsible = followUp.supervisorId === actor.id;
    const isCreator = followUp.createdById === actor.id;
    let covered = false;
    if (!isResponsible && !isCreator) {
      const coverage = await supervisorCoverage(actor, actor.schoolId);
      if (!coverage.ok) return coverage;
      covered =
        coverage.data.teacherIds.includes(followUp.teacherId) ||
        (followUp.teacher.branchId !== null &&
          coverage.data.branchIds.includes(followUp.teacher.branchId));
    }
    if (!isResponsible && !isCreator && !covered) {
      return analyticsFail("سجل المتابعة خارج نطاق إشرافك", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
  }
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: { schoolId: followUp.schoolId, titleAr: followUp.titleAr, teacherId: followUp.teacherId },
  };
}

export async function archiveFollowUp(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  followUpId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const scope = await followUpOperationalScope(actor, followUpId);
  if (!scope.ok) return scope;

  const result = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Conditional flip — a concurrent archive cannot double-fire.
    const updated = await tx.followUp.updateMany({
      where: { id: followUpId, schoolId: scope.data.schoolId, archivedAt: null },
      data: { archivedAt: new Date(), archivedById: actor.id },
    });
    if (updated.count !== 1) return null;
    await tx.followUpEvent.create({
      data: {
        followUpId,
        type: "ARCHIVED",
        actorId: actor.id,
        actorRole: actor.role,
        note: "تمت أرشفة السجل — تاريخ الحالة محفوظ كما هو",
      },
    });
    return { ok: true as const };
  });
  if (!result) {
    return analyticsFail("سجل المتابعة مؤرشف بالفعل", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }
  await recordArchiveEvent({
    schoolId: scope.data.schoolId,
    entityType: "FOLLOW_UP",
    entityId: followUpId,
    entityTitle: scope.data.titleAr,
    action: "ARCHIVED",
    actorId: actor.id,
    actorRole: actor.role,
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: followUpId } };
}

export async function restoreFollowUp(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  followUpId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const scope = await followUpOperationalScope(actor, followUpId);
  if (!scope.ok) return scope;

  const result = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const updated = await tx.followUp.updateMany({
      where: { id: followUpId, schoolId: scope.data.schoolId, archivedAt: { not: null } },
      data: { archivedAt: null, archivedById: null },
    });
    if (updated.count !== 1) return null;
    await tx.followUpEvent.create({
      data: {
        followUpId,
        type: "RESTORED",
        actorId: actor.id,
        actorRole: actor.role,
        note: "تمت استعادة السجل من الأرشيف",
      },
    });
    return { ok: true as const };
  });
  if (!result) {
    return analyticsFail("سجل المتابعة ليس في الأرشيف", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }
  await recordArchiveEvent({
    schoolId: scope.data.schoolId,
    entityType: "FOLLOW_UP",
    entityId: followUpId,
    entityTitle: scope.data.titleAr,
    action: "RESTORED",
    actorId: actor.id,
    actorRole: actor.role,
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: followUpId } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Restore of already-archived lifecycle content                        */

/**
 * Assignment: ARCHIVED is terminal in the Phase 7 service, so restore
 * lands on CLOSED (out of active workflows; republishing goes through
 * the assignment page with all its server validations).
 */
export async function restoreAssignment(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  assignmentId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<{ id: string }>> {
  if (actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || !actor.schoolId) {
    return analyticsFail("استعادة التكليفات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const assignment = await db.assignment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assignmentId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true, titleAr: true, status: true },
  });
  if (!assignment) return analyticsFail("التكليف غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  if (assignment.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return analyticsFail("التكليف خارج نطاقك المدرسي", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const updated = await db.assignment.updateMany({
    where: { id: assignmentId, schoolId: actor.schoolId, status: "ARCHIVED" },
    data: { status: "CLOSED" },
  });
  if (updated.count !== 1) {
    return analyticsFail("التكليف ليس في الأرشيف", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }
  await recordArchiveEvent({
    schoolId: actor.schoolId,
    entityType: "ASSIGNMENT",
    entityId: assignmentId,
    entityTitle: assignment.titleAr,
    action: "RESTORED",
    actorId: actor.id,
    actorRole: actor.role,
    note: "أُعيد إلى حالة مغلق — إعادة النشر من صفحة التكليف",
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: assignmentId } };
}

/**
 * Course: restore to PUBLISHED when it was published before (publishedAt
 * is kept while archived), otherwise to DRAFT so the normal publish
 * workflow re-validates content.
 */
export async function restoreCourse(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  courseId: string
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = await platformContentRestoreGuard(actor, courseId, "COURSE");
  if (!guard.ok) return guard;
  const { schoolId, title, publishedAt } = guard.data;
  const targetStatus = publishedAt ? "PUBLISHED" : "DRAFT";
  const updated = await db.course.updateMany({
    where: { id: courseId, status: "ARCHIVED" },
    data: { status: targetStatus },
  });
  if (updated.count !== 1) {
    return analyticsFail("الدورة ليست في الأرشيف", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }
  await recordArchiveEvent({
    schoolId,
    entityType: "COURSE",
    entityId: courseId,
    entityTitle: title,
    action: "RESTORED",
    actorId: actor.id,
    actorRole: actor.role,
    note:
      targetStatus === "PUBLISHED"
        ? "أُعيدت إلى حالة منشور"
        : "أُعيدت إلى حالة مسودة — انشرها بعد المراجعة",
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: courseId } };
}

/**
 * Shared guard for content restores. School managers restore their own
 * school's content; SUPER_ADMIN may restore PLATFORM-WIDE (schoolId
 * null) content only. Deputies/supervisors never restore content.
 */
async function platformContentRestoreGuard(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
  entityId: string,
  entityType: "PROGRAM" | "COURSE" | "ASSESSMENT"
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<{ schoolId: string | null; title: string; publishedAt: Date | null }>> {
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    if (!actor.schoolId) {
      return analyticsFail("حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const row = await loadContentRow(entityId, entityType);
    if (!row) return analyticsFail("السجل غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
    if (row.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
      return analyticsFail("السجل خارج نطاقك المدرسي", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: { schoolId: row.schoolId, title: row.title, publishedAt: row.publishedAt },
    };
  }
  if (actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    const row = await loadContentRow(entityId, entityType);
    if (!row) return analyticsFail("السجل غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
    if (row.schoolId !== null) {
      return analyticsFail(
        "محتوى المدارس تديره أدوار المدرسة — حساب المنصة يستعيد المحتوى العام فقط",
        "FORBIDDEN"
      );
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: { schoolId: null, title: row.title, publishedAt: row.publishedAt },
    };
  }
  return analyticsFail("استعادة المحتوى متاحة لمديري المكاتب والإدارة العامة فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
}

async function loadContentRow(
  entityId: string,
  entityType: "PROGRAM" | "COURSE" | "ASSESSMENT"
): Promise<{ schoolId: string | null; title: string; publishedAt: Date | null } | null> {
  if (entityType === "PROGRAM") {
    const row = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
      where: { id: entityId },
      select: { schoolId: true, nameAr: true },
    });
    return row ? { schoolId: row.schoolId, title: row.nameAr, publishedAt: null } : null;
  }
  if (entityType === "COURSE") {
    const row = await db.course.findUnique({
      where: { id: entityId },
      select: { schoolId: true, titleAr: true, publishedAt: true },
    });
    return row ? { schoolId: row.schoolId, title: row.titleAr, publishedAt: row.publishedAt } : null;
  }
  const row = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: entityId },
    select: { schoolId: true, titleAr: true },
  });
  return row ? { schoolId: row.schoolId, title: row.titleAr, publishedAt: null } : null;
}

        title: row.nameAr,
        schoolId: null,

        entityId: row.id,
        title: row.titleAr,
        schoolId: null,
        schoolName: "عام (المنصة)",
        status: "ARCHIVED",
        archivedAt: null,
        workflowStatus: null,
        detail: row.publishedAt ? "دورة عامة — الاستعادة إلى منشور" : "دورة عامة — الاستعادة إلى مسودة",
      });

      rows.push({
        entityType: "ASSESSMENT",
        entityId: row.id,
        title: row.titleAr,
        schoolId: null,
        schoolName: "عام (المنصة)",
        status: "ARCHIVED",
        archivedAt: null,
        workflowStatus: null,
        detail: "تقييم عام — الاستعادة إلى مسودة",
      });

    return { ok: true, data: { rows, total: rows.length, pageCount: 1, page: 1 } };
  }

  // School-scoped view (manager / deputy / supervisor).
  const readable = await resolveReadableSchoolIds(actor);
  if (!readable.ok) return readable;
  const schoolIds = readable.data;
  const isSupervisor = actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR";

  // Supervisors: only follow-ups in their operational scope and surveys
  // they own. Manager/deputy: all six entity types of their scope.
  const types: ArchiveEntityType[] =
    entityType === null
      ? isSupervisor
        ? ["FOLLOW_UP", "SURVEY"]
        : ["PROGRAM", "COURSE", "ASSESSMENT", "ASSIGNMENT", "SURVEY", "FOLLOW_UP"]
      : isSupervisor && entityType !== "FOLLOW_UP" && entityType !== "SURVEY"

        status: "ARCHIVED",

        workflowStatus: null,
        detail: "الاستعادة إلى مسودة",
      });
    }
  }
  if (types.includes("COURSE")) {
    const courses = await db.course.findMany({
      where: { schoolId: { in: schoolIds }, status: "ARCHIVED" },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true, schoolId: true, publishedAt: true },
      take: ARCHIVE_PAGE_SIZE,
    });
    for (const row of courses) {
      rows.push({
        entityType: "COURSE",
        entityId: row.id,
        title: row.titleAr,
        schoolId: row.schoolId,
        schoolName: null,
        status: "ARCHIVED",
        archivedAt: null,
        workflowStatus: null,
        detail: row.publishedAt ? "الاستعادة إلى منشور" : "الاستعادة إلى مسودة",
      });
    }
  }
  if (types.includes("ASSESSMENT")) {
    const assessments = await db.assessment.findMany({
      where: { schoolId: { in: schoolIds }, status: "ARCHIVED" },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true, schoolId: true },
      take: ARCHIVE_PAGE_SIZE,
    });
    for (const row of assessments) {
      rows.push({
        entityType: "ASSESSMENT",
        entityId: row.id,
        title: row.titleAr,
        schoolId: row.schoolId,
        schoolName: null,
        status: "ARCHIVED",
        archivedAt: null,
        workflowStatus: null,
        detail: "الاستعادة إلى مسودة",
      });
    }
  }
  if (types.includes("ASSIGNMENT")) {
    const assignments = await db.assignment.findMany({
      where: { schoolId: { in: schoolIds }, status: "ARCHIVED" },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true, schoolId: true, dueAt: true },
      take: ARCHIVE_PAGE_SIZE,
    });
    for (const row of assignments) {
      rows.push({
        entityType: "ASSIGNMENT",
        entityId: row.id,
        title: row.titleAr,
        schoolId: row.schoolId,
        schoolName: null,
        status: "ARCHIVED",
        archivedAt: null,
        workflowStatus: null,
        detail: "الاستعادة إلى مغلق",
      });
    }
  }
  if (types.includes("SURVEY")) {
    const surveys = await db.survey.findMany({
      where: {
        schoolId: { in: schoolIds },
        status: "ARCHIVED",
        ...(isSupervisor ? { ownerUserId: actor.id } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true, schoolId: true, archivedAt: true },
      take: ARCHIVE_PAGE_SIZE,
    });
    for (const row of surveys) {
      rows.push({
        entityType: "SURVEY",
        entityId: row.id,
        title: row.titleAr,
        schoolId: row.schoolId,
        schoolName: null,
        status: "ARCHIVED",
        archivedAt: row.archivedAt,
        workflowStatus: null,
        detail: "حالة نهائية — الأرشفة يحفظ النتائج والتاريخ",
      });
    }
  }
  if (types.includes("FOLLOW_UP")) {
    let teacherIds: string[] | null = null;
    if (isSupervisor) {
      const scope = await visibleTeacherIds(actor, actor.schoolId ?? "__none__");
      teacherIds = scope.ok ? scope.data : [];
    }
    const followUps = await db.followUp.findMany({
      where: {
        schoolId: { in: schoolIds },
        archivedAt: { not: null },
        ...(isSupervisor
          ? {
              OR: [
                { supervisorId: actor.id },
                { createdById: actor.id },
                ...(teacherIds && teacherIds.length > 0
                  ? [{ teacherId: { in: teacherIds } }]
                  : []),
              ],
            }
          : {}),
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        titleAr: true,
        schoolId: true,
        status: true,
        archivedAt: true,
        teacher: { select: { name: true } },

      take: ARCHIVE_PAGE_SIZE,

    for (const row of followUps) {

      });
    }
  }

  const total = rows.length;
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / ARCHIVE_PAGE_SIZE));
  const safePage = Math.min(Math.max(1, page), pageCount);
  return { ok: true, data: { rows, total, pageCount, page: safePage } };
}

/** Unified audit trail: manager/deputy see their schools; supervisor
 * sees school events (read-only); SUPER_ADMIN sees platform events. */
export async function listArchiveEvents(
  actor: AnalyticsActor
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<ArchiveEventRow[]>> {
  let where: Record<string, unknown>;
  if (actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    where = { schoolId: null };
  } else {
    const readable = await resolveReadableSchoolIds(actor);
    if (!readable.ok) return readable;
    where = { schoolId: { in: readable.data } };
  }
  const events = await db.archiveEvent.findMany({
    where,
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: ARCHIVE_EVENTS_LIMIT,
    include: { actor: { select: { name: true } } },
  });
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: events.map((event) => ({
      id: event.id,
      entityType: event.entityType as ArchiveEntityType,
      entityLabel: ARCHIVE_ENTITY_LABELS[event.entityType as ArchiveEntityType] ?? event.entityType,
      entityId: event.entityId,
      entityTitle: event.entityTitle,
      action: event.action,
      actorName: event.actor?.name ?? null,
      actorRole: event.actorRole,
      createdAt: event.createdAt,
      note: event.note,
    })),
  };
}

import type { AdminContext, SupervisorTrainingContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import type { AssessmentErrorCode, AssessmentResult } from "@/lib/validation/assessment";

/**
 * Any context allowed into the assessment management service layer:
 * the administrative trio PLUS the educational supervisor (whose
 * tenant fence is identical — own school only, never platform-wide).
 */
export type AssessmentManageContext = AdminContext | SupervisorTrainingContext;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Assessments — authorization & visibility predicates.                 */
/*                                                                      */
/* Pure functions (no DB, no session) so the rules are unit-testable.   */
/* Tenancy rule mirrors the training academy: schoolId === null means   */
/* PLATFORM-WIDE shared content; only SUPER_ADMIN may create or manage  */
/* platform-wide records.                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Session-safe viewer identity used for read-side checks. */
export interface ViewerIdentity {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/** Minimal projection of an assessment row for visibility checks. */
export interface ScopedAssessment {
  status: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/**
 * Roles allowed to manage assessments. The educational supervisor
 * manages assessments for their OWN school only — the fence is
 * structural in `assessmentScopeError` below (platform-wide records
 * stay SUPER_ADMIN-only).
 */
export function canManageAssessments(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ||
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
  );
}

/**
 * Can this viewer SEE a PUBLISHED assessment in ordinary browsing?
 *   - platform-wide (schoolId null) -> every authenticated viewer
 *   - school-owned                  -> viewers of the same school only
 * Non-published records are NEVER visible through this predicate —
 * managers reach drafts through the manage-scope path below.
 */
export function canViewPublishedAssessment(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  record: ScopedAssessment
): boolean {
  if (record.status !== "PUBLISHED") return false;
  if (record.schoolId === null) return true;
  return viewer.schoolId !== null && viewer.schoolId === record.schoolId;
}

/**
 * Prisma `where` fragment for teacher catalog listings. SUPER_ADMIN
 * browses every published assessment; everyone else is confined to
 * platform-wide + their own school's published assessments.
 */
export function publishedAssessmentWhere(viewer: ViewerIdentity): {
  status: string;
  OR?: Array<{ schoolId: string | null }>;
} {
  if (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return { status: "PUBLISHED" };
  }
  const scopes: Array<{ schoolId: string | null }> = [{ schoolId: null }];
  if (viewer.schoolId) scopes.push({ schoolId: viewer.schoolId });
  return { status: "PUBLISHED", OR: scopes };
}

export type ScopeRejection = {
  ok: false;
  message: string;
  code: Extract<AssessmentErrorCode, "FORBIDDEN">;
};

/**
 * Manage-scope enforcement (mirror of the schools/training semantics,
 * extended for nullable school scope):
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                -> any record (incl. platform-wide)
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER -> only records owned by their school
 *   SCHOOL_MANAGER             -> only records owned by their school
 *   anything else              -> always rejected (defense in depth)
 * Platform-wide records (schoolId null) can never be managed by a
 * school-scoped role — no exceptions.
 */
export function assessmentScopeError(
  ctx: AssessmentManageContext,
  recordSchoolId: string | null
): ScopeRejection | null {
  if (ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") return null;
  if (
    (ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
      ctx.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
      ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") &&
    recordSchoolId !== null &&
    recordSchoolId === ctx.schoolId
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "ليس لديك صلاحية إدارة هذا الاختبار — العملية مرفوضة",
    code: "FORBIDDEN",
  };
}

/** Uniform failure helper shared with the service layer. */
export function assessmentFail<T>(
  message: string,
  code?: AssessmentErrorCode
): AssessmentResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

/**
 * Availability state of a PUBLISHED assessment at a moment in time.
 * Returned to teachers so the UI can show honest, specific states.
 */
export type AvailabilityState =
  | "available"
  | "scheduled"
  | "closed";

export function availabilityState(
  record: { availableFrom: Date | null; availableUntil: Date | null },
  now: Date = new Date()
): AvailabilityState {
  if (record.availableFrom && now.getTime() < record.availableFrom.getTime()) {
    return "scheduled";
  }
  if (record.availableUntil && now.getTime() > record.availableUntil.getTime()) {
    return "closed";
  }
  return "available";
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Internal helpers                                                     */

function validationFail<T>(error: { issues: unknown[] }): AssessmentResult<T> {
  const fieldErrors = zodFieldErrors(error as never);
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
    fieldErrors,
    code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  };
}

/** Defense-in-depth guard: assessment mutations are manager-only. */
function managerGuard(ctx: AdminContext): AssessmentResult<never> | null {
  if (!canManageAssessments(ctx.role)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        "إدارة الاختبارات متاحة لمدير المنصة ومديري مكاتب التطوير فقط",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }
  return null;
}

/** Resolve the owning school for a new assessment from the actor. */
function resolveScope(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  scope: "platform" | "school",
  schoolId: string | undefined
): { ok: true; schoolId: string | null } | { ok: false; message: string; code: AssessmentErrorCode } {
  if (ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    if (scope === "platform") {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "الاختبارات المشتركة على مستوى المنصة متاحة لمدير المنصة فقط",
        code: "FORBIDDEN",
      };
    }
    return { ok: true, schoolId: ctx.schoolId };
  }
  // SUPER_ADMIN
  if (scope === "platform") return { ok: true, schoolId: null };
  if (!schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "اختر المدرسة المالكة للاختبار",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  return { ok: true, schoolId };
}

function parseJson<T>(raw: string | null | undefined): T | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function parseOptions(raw: string | null | undefined): QuestionOption[] {
  const parsed = parseJson<{ id?: unknown; textAr?: unknown }[]>(raw);
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
  return parsed
    .filter(
      (item): item is { id: string; textAr: string } =>
        typeof item?.id === "string" && typeof item?.textAr === "string"
    )
    .map((item) => ({ id: item.id, textAr: item.textAr }));
}

function parseAnswerKey(type: string, raw: string | null | undefined): AnswerKey | null {
  const parsed = parseJson<Record<string, unknown>>(raw);
  if (!parsed) return null;
  if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" && typeof parsed.optionId === "string") {
    return { optionId: parsed.optionId };
  }
  if (
    type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE" &&
    Array.isArray(parsed.optionIds) &&
    parsed.optionIds.every((v) => typeof v === "string")
  ) {
    return { optionIds: parsed.optionIds as string[] };
  }
  if (type === "TRUE_FALSE" && typeof parsed.value === "boolean") {
    return { value: parsed.value };
  }
  if (type === "SHORT_ANSWER") {
    return {
      modelAnswer:
        typeof parsed.modelAnswer === "string" ? parsed.modelAnswer : undefined,
    };
  }
  return null;
}

function parseAnswers(raw: string | null | undefined): SubmittedAnswer[] {
  const parsed = parseJson<SubmittedAnswer[]>(raw);
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
  return parsed.filter((item) => item && typeof item.questionId === "string");
}

function parseReviewScores(raw: string | null | undefined): ReviewScore[] {
  const parsed = parseJson<ReviewScore[]>(raw);
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
  return parsed.filter(
    (item) => item && typeof item.questionId === "string" && typeof item.points === "number"
  );
}

/** Fresh server-generated option id (never client-supplied). */
function newOptionId(): string {
  return globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
}

/** Build persisted option rows + the server-only answer key from input. */
function buildOptionsAndKey(
  type: QuestionType,
  options: QuestionOptionInput[],
  correctOptionIndexes: number[],
  correctValue: boolean | undefined,
  modelAnswer: string | undefined,
  existingOptions: QuestionOption[]
): { options: QuestionOption[]; answerKey: AnswerKey } {
  if (type === "TRUE_FALSE") {
    return { options: [], answerKey: { value: Boolean(correctValue) } };
  }
  if (type === "SHORT_ANSWER") {
    return { options: [], answerKey: modelAnswer ? { modelAnswer } : {} };
  }
  // Choice types: keep stable option ids when the count matches so
  // in-flight attempts' saved drafts stay addressable across edits.
  const stable =
    existingOptions.length === options.length
      ? existingOptions.map((o) => o.id)
      : options.map(() => newOptionId());
  const built = options.map((option, index) => ({
    id: stable[index],
    textAr: option.textAr,
  }));
  if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE") {
    return { options: built, answerKey: { optionId: built[correctOptionIndexes[0]].id } };
  }
  return {
    options: built,
    answerKey: { optionIds: correctOptionIndexes.map((index) => built[index].id) },
  };
}

async function recomputeMaxScore(
  tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  assessmentId: string
): Promise<number> {
  const agg = await tx.assessmentQuestion.aggregate({
    where: { assessmentId },
    _sum: { points: true },
  });
  const maxScore = agg._sum.points ?? 0;
  await tx.assessment.update({
    where: { id: assessmentId },
    data: { maxScore },
  });
  return maxScore;
}

async function requireAdmin(): Promise<AdminContext> {
  // Services are called from server actions that already resolved the
  // context; this fallback exists for tests and keeps the signature
  // symmetric with the other services.
  const { requireAdminContext } = await import("@/lib/auth/dev-admin");
  return requireAdminContext();
}

export interface ManageAssessmentFilters {
  q?: string;
  status?: string;
  page?: number;
}

export async function listAssessmentsForManage(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  filters: ManageAssessmentFilters
): Promise<AssessmentResult<Paginated<ManageAssessmentRow>>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const where: Prisma.AssessmentWhereInput = {};
  if (ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    where.schoolId = ctx.schoolId;
  }
  if (filters.status && filters.status.trim().length > 0) {
    where.status = filters.status.trim();
  }
  if (filters.q && filters.q.trim().length > 0) {
    where.titleAr = { contains: filters.q.trim() };
  }

  const total = await db.assessment.count({ where });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / ASSESSMENTS_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  const rows = await db.assessment.findMany({
    where,
    include: {
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      _count: { select: { questions: true, attempts: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    skip: (page - 1) * ASSESSMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
    take: ASSESSMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        titleEn: row.titleEn,
        status: row.status,
        schoolId: row.schoolId,
        schoolName: row.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        courseId: row.courseId,
        courseTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? null,
        questionsCount: row._count.questions,
        attemptsCount: row._count.attempts,
        maxScore: row.maxScore,
        passingScore: row.passingScore,
        timeLimitMinutes: row.timeLimitMinutes,
        attemptLimit: row.attemptLimit,
        availableFrom: row.availableFrom,
        availableUntil: row.availableUntil,
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
      })),
      total,
      page,
      pageCount,
    },
  };
}

async function buildAssessmentStats(
  tx: Prisma.TransactionClient | typeof db,
  assessmentId: string
): Promise<AssessmentStats> {
  const [attemptsTotal, needsReviewCount, passedCount, failedCount, expiredCount, graded] =
    await Promise.all([
      tx.assessmentAttempt.count({ where: { assessmentId } }),
      tx.assessmentAttempt.count({ where: { assessmentId, status: "NEEDS_REVIEW" } }),
      tx.assessmentAttempt.count({ where: { assessmentId, status: "PASSED" } }),
      tx.assessmentAttempt.count({ where: { assessmentId, status: "FAILED" } }),
      tx.assessmentAttempt.count({ where: { assessmentId, status: "EXPIRED" } }),
      tx.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
        where: { assessmentId, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
        select: { percentage: true },
      }),
    ]);

  const percentages = graded
    .map((row) => row.percentage)
    .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");
  const avgPercentage =
    percentages.length > 0
      ? Math.round(percentages.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / percentages.length)
      : null;
  const passRate =
    passedCount + failedCount > 0
      ? Math.round((passedCount / (passedCount + failedCount)) * 100)
      : null;

  return {
    attemptsTotal,
    needsReviewCount,
    passedCount,
    failedCount,
    expiredCount,
    avgPercentage,
    passRate,
  };
}

export async function getAssessmentForManage(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  assessmentId: string
): Promise<AssessmentResult<ManageAssessmentDetail>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const row = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assessmentId },
    include: {
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!row) return assessmentFail("الاختبار غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = assessmentScopeError(ctx, row.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  const questions = await db.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId: row.id },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
  });

  const stats = await buildAssessmentStats(db, row.id);

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      assessment: {
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        titleEn: row.titleEn,
        status: row.status,
        schoolId: row.schoolId,
        schoolName: row.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        courseId: row.courseId,
        courseTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? null,
        maxScore: row.maxScore,
        passingScore: row.passingScore,
        timeLimitMinutes: row.timeLimitMinutes,
        attemptLimit: row.attemptLimit,
        availableFrom: row.availableFrom,
        availableUntil: row.availableUntil,
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
        instructionsAr: row.instructionsAr,
        instructionsEn: row.instructionsEn,
      },
      questions: questions.map((question) => ({
        id: question.id,
        type: question.type,
        textAr: question.textAr,
        textEn: question.textEn,
        points: question.points,
        isRequired: question.isRequired,
        orderIndex: question.orderIndex,
        options: parseOptions(question.optionsJson),
        answerKey: parseAnswerKey(question.type, question.answerKeyJson),
        explanation: question.explanation,
      })),
      stats,
    },
  };
}

export async function listAttemptsForManage(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  assessmentId: string
): Promise<AssessmentResult<ManageAttemptRow[]>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assessmentId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!assessment) return assessmentFail("الاختبار غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = assessmentScopeError(ctx, assessment.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  const shortQuestions = await db.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId, type: "SHORT_ANSWER" },
    select: { id: true, textAr: true, points: true, answerKeyJson: true },
  });
  const shortById = new Map(shortQuestions.map((q) => [q.id, q]));

  const rows = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId },
    include: { user: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } },
    orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
    take: ATTEMPTS_PREVIEW_LIMIT,
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: rows.map((row) => {
      const answers = parseAnswers(row.answersJson);
      const shortAnswers =
        row.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW"
          ? answers
              .filter((answer) => shortById.has(answer.questionId))
              .map((answer) => {
                const question = shortById.get(answer.questionId);
                const key = parseAnswerKey("SHORT_ANSWER", question?.answerKeyJson);
                return {
                  questionId: answer.questionId,
                  questionText: question?.textAr ?? "",
                  points: question?.points ?? 0,
                  answerText: answer.text ?? "",
                  modelAnswer: key && "modelAnswer" in key ? key.modelAnswer ?? null : null,
                };
              })
          : [];
      return {
        id: row.id,
        status: row.status,
        userId: row.user.id,
        userName: row.user.name,
        userEmail: row.user.email,
        startedAt: row.startedAt,
        submittedAt: row.submittedAt,
        deadlineAt: row.deadlineAt,
        objectiveScore: row.objectiveScore,
        earnedScore: row.earnedScore,
        maxScore: row.maxScore,
        percentage: row.percentage,
        passed: row.passed,
        shortAnswers,
      };
    }),
  };
}
