/** Course binding must share the assessment's tenant and stay active. */
async function validateCourseBinding(
  schoolId: string | null,
  courseId: string | undefined
): Promise<AssessmentResult<never> | null> {
  if (!courseId) return null;
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: { schoolId: true, status: true },
  });
  if (!course) {
    return assessmentFail("الدورة المحددة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  }
  if ((course.schoolId ?? null) !== schoolId) {
    return assessmentFail(
      "الدورة المحددة لا تنتمي إلى نطاق هذا الاختبار",
      "RELATION_ERROR"
    );
  }
  if (course.status === "ARCHIVED") {
    return assessmentFail("لا يمكن ربط اختبار بدورة مؤرشفة", "RELATION_ERROR");
  }
  return null;
}

export async function createAssessment(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = createAssessmentSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const scope = resolveScope(ctx, input.scope, input.schoolId);
  if (!scope.ok) return scope;

  const relationError = await validateCourseBinding(scope.schoolId, input.courseId);
  if (relationError) return relationError;

  const assessment = await db.assessment.create({
    data: {
      schoolId: scope.schoolId,
      courseId: input.courseId ?? null,
      titleAr: input.titleAr,
      titleEn: input.titleEn ?? null,
      instructionsAr: input.instructionsAr,
      instructionsEn: input.instructionsEn ?? null,
      status: "DRAFT",
      passingScore: input.passingScore,
      timeLimitMinutes: input.timeLimitMinutes ?? null,
      attemptLimit: input.attemptLimit ?? null,
      availableFrom: input.availableFrom ?? null,
      availableUntil: input.availableUntil ?? null,
      createdById: ctx.id,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: assessment };
}

/**
 * Settings update. Tenancy (schoolId) is intentionally IMMUTABLE after
 * creation — moving records between tenants would invalidate every
 * existing attempt's scoping.
 */
export async function updateAssessment(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = updateAssessmentSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.assessmentId },
  });
  if (!assessment) return assessmentFail("الاختبار غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = assessmentScopeError(ctx, assessment.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  if (assessment.status === "ARCHIVED") {
    return assessmentFail(
      "الاختبار مؤرشف — لا يمكن تعديله. أنشئ اختبارًا جديدًا أو أعد الحالة أولًا",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }

  const relationError = await validateCourseBinding(
    assessment.schoolId,
    input.courseId
  );
  if (relationError) return relationError;

  if (
    assessment.status === "PUBLISHED" &&
    input.passingScore > assessment.maxScore
  ) {
    return assessmentFail(
      `درجة النجاح أكبر من مجموع درجات الأسئلة الحالي (${assessment.maxScore} نقطة)`,
      "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
    );
  }

  const updated = await db.assessment.update({
    where: { id: assessment.id },
    data: {
      courseId: input.courseId ?? null,
      titleAr: input.titleAr,
      titleEn: input.titleEn ?? null,
      instructionsAr: input.instructionsAr,
      instructionsEn: input.instructionsEn ?? null,
      passingScore: input.passingScore,
      timeLimitMinutes: input.timeLimitMinutes ?? null,
      attemptLimit: input.attemptLimit ?? null,
      availableFrom: input.availableFrom ?? null,
      availableUntil: input.availableUntil ?? null,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

/**
 * Publish guard: at least one question and a passing score that fits
 * the total points. Archive / unpublish are always allowed.
 */
export async function setAssessmentStatus(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string; status: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = setAssessmentStatusSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.assessmentId },
  });
  if (!assessment) return assessmentFail("الاختبار غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = assessmentScopeError(ctx, assessment.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  if (input.status === "PUBLISHED") {
    const questionsCount = await db.assessmentQuestion.count({
      where: { assessmentId: assessment.id },
    });
    if (questionsCount < MIN_QUESTIONS_TO_PUBLISH) {
      return assessmentFail(
        "لا يمكن النشر — أضف سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل قبل النشر",
        "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
      );
    }
    if (assessment.passingScore > assessment.maxScore) {
      return assessmentFail(
        `لا يمكن النشر — درجة النجاح (${assessment.passingScore}) أكبر من مجموع درجات الأسئلة (${assessment.maxScore})`,
        "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
      );
    }
  }
  if (input.status === "DRAFT" && assessment.status === "ARCHIVED") {
    return assessmentFail(
      "الاختبار مؤرشف — لا يمكن إرجاعه إلى مسودة في هذه المرحلة",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }

  const updated = await db.assessment.update({
    where: { id: assessment.id },
    data: { status: input.status },
    select: { id: true, status: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Manage — questions                                                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function loadQuestionContext(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  assessmentId: string
): Promise<
  | { ok: true; assessment: { id: string; schoolId: string | null; status: string; maxScore: number } }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code: AssessmentErrorCode }
> {
  const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assessmentId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true, status: true, maxScore: true },
  });
  if (!assessment) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الاختبار غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  const scopeCheck = assessmentScopeError(ctx, assessment.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) {
    return { ok: false, message: scopeCheck.message, code: scopeCheck.code };
  }
  return { ok: true, assessment };
}

function questionEditBlocked(
  status: string
): AssessmentResult<never> | null {
  if (status === "ARCHIVED") {
    return assessmentFail("الاختبار مؤرشف — لا يمكن تعديل أسئلته", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  return null;
}

export async function addQuestion(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = createQuestionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const loaded = await loadQuestionContext(ctx, input.assessmentId);
  if (!loaded.ok) return loaded;
  const blocked = questionEditBlocked(loaded.assessment.status);
  if (blocked) return blocked;

  const count = await db.assessmentQuestion.count({
    where: { assessmentId: input.assessmentId },
  });
  if (count >= MAX_QUESTIONS) {
    return assessmentFail(
      `لا يمكن إضافة المزيد من الأسئلة — الحد الأقصى ${MAX_QUESTIONS} سؤالًا`,
      "VALIDATION_ERROR"
    );
  }
  if (loaded.assessment.maxScore + input.points > MAX_ASSESSMENT_POINTS) {
    return assessmentFail(
      `مجموع درجات الأسئلة يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${MAX_ASSESSMENT_POINTS} نقطة)`,
      "VALIDATION_ERROR"
    );
  }

  const { options, answerKey } = buildOptionsAndKey(
    input.type,
    input.options,
    input.correctOptionIndexes,
    input.correctValue,
    input.modelAnswer,
    []
  );

  const question = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const created = await tx.assessmentQuestion.create({
      data: {
        assessmentId: input.assessmentId,
        type: input.type,
        textAr: input.textAr,
        textEn: input.textEn ?? null,
        orderIndex: count,
        points: input.points,
        isRequired: input.isRequired,
        optionsJson: options.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(options) : null,
        answerKeyJson: JSON.stringify(answerKey),
        explanation: input.explanation ?? null,
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    await recomputeMaxScore(tx, input.assessmentId);
    return created;
  });

  return { ok: true, data: question };
}

export async function updateQuestion(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = updateQuestionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const loaded = await loadQuestionContext(ctx, input.assessmentId);
  if (!loaded.ok) return loaded;
  const blocked = questionEditBlocked(loaded.assessment.status);
  if (blocked) return blocked;

  const existing = await db.assessmentQuestion.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.questionId },
  });
  if (!existing || existing.assessmentId !== input.assessmentId) {
    return assessmentFail("السؤال غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  }

  const { options, answerKey } = buildOptionsAndKey(
    input.type,
    input.options,
    input.correctOptionIndexes,
    input.correctValue,
    input.modelAnswer,
    parseOptions(existing.optionsJson)
  );

  const question = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const updated = await tx.assessmentQuestion.update({
      where: { id: existing.id },
      data: {
        type: input.type,
        textAr: input.textAr,
        textEn: input.textEn ?? null,
        points: input.points,
        isRequired: input.isRequired,
        optionsJson: options.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(options) : null,
        answerKeyJson: JSON.stringify(answerKey),
        explanation: input.explanation ?? null,
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    await recomputeMaxScore(tx, input.assessmentId);
    return updated;
  });

  return { ok: true, data: question };
}

export async function deleteQuestion(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = deleteQuestionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);

  const existing = await db.assessmentQuestion.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.questionId },
    include: {
      assessment: {
        select: { id: true, schoolId: true, status: true, maxScore: true },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!existing) return assessmentFail("السؤال غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = assessmentScopeError(ctx, existing.assessment.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;
  const blocked = questionEditBlocked(existing.assessment.status);
  if (blocked) return blocked;

  const remainingCount = await db.assessmentQuestion.count({
    where: { assessmentId: existing.assessmentId, NOT: { id: existing.id } },
  });
  if (existing.assessment.status === "PUBLISHED" && remainingCount < 1) {
    return assessmentFail(
      "لا يمكن حذف آخر سؤال في اختبار منشور — أرشف الاختبار أو أضف سؤالًا آخر أولًا",
      "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
    );
  }

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.assessmentQuestion.delete({ where: { id: existing.id } });
    await recomputeMaxScore(tx, existing.assessmentId);
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { id: existing.id } };
}

export async function moveQuestion(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = moveQuestionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const loaded = await loadQuestionContext(ctx, input.assessmentId);
  if (!loaded.ok) return loaded;
  const blocked = questionEditBlocked(loaded.assessment.status);
  if (blocked) return blocked;

  const ordered = await db.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId: input.assessmentId },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
    select: { id: true, orderIndex: true },
  });
  const index = ordered.findIndex((q) => q.id === input.questionId);
  if (index === -1) {
    return assessmentFail("السؤال غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  }
  const targetIndex = input.direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
  if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= ordered.length) {
    return { ok: true, data: { id: input.questionId } };
  }

  // Swap-based move — mirrors the training content ordering contract.
  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.assessmentQuestion.update({
      where: { id: ordered[index].id },
      data: { orderIndex: ordered[targetIndex].orderIndex },
    });
    await tx.assessmentQuestion.update({
      where: { id: ordered[targetIndex].id },
      data: { orderIndex: ordered[index].orderIndex },
    });
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { id: input.questionId } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Teacher side — catalog                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface TeacherAssessmentFilters {
  q?: string;
  page?: number;
}

export async function listPublishedAssessments(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  filters: TeacherAssessmentFilters
): Promise<AssessmentResult<Paginated<TeacherAssessmentRow>>> {
  const where: Prisma.AssessmentWhereInput = {
    ...publishedAssessmentWhere(viewer),
  };
  if (filters.q && filters.q.trim().length > 0) {
    where.titleAr = { contains: filters.q.trim() };
  }

  const total = await db.assessment.count({ where });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / ASSESSMENTS_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  const rows = await db.assessment.findMany({
    where,
    include: {
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      _count: { select: { questions: true } },
      attempts: {
        where: { userId: viewer.id },
        select: { status: true, startedAt: true },
        orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
      },
    },
    orderBy: [{ status: "asc" }, { updatedAt: "desc" }],
    skip: (page - 1) * ASSESSMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
    take: ASSESSMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows.map((row) => {
        const attemptsUsed = row.attempts.length;
        const latest = row.attempts[0];
        return {
          id: row.id,
          titleAr: row.titleAr,
          titleEn: row.titleEn,
          courseTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? null,
          schoolName: row.school?.nameAr ?? null,
          questionsCount: row._count.questions,
          maxScore: row.maxScore,
          passingScore: row.passingScore,
          timeLimitMinutes: row.timeLimitMinutes,
          attemptLimit: row.attemptLimit,
          availableFrom: row.availableFrom,
          availableUntil: row.availableUntil,
          availability: availabilityState(row),
          attemptsUsed,
          latestStatus: (latest?.status as AttemptStatus | undefined) ?? null,
        };
      }),
      total,
      page,
      pageCount,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Instructions & eligibility detail for the teacher. Questions are
 * deliberately NOT included — they are only served inside an active
 * attempt and after submission (answer-key protection).
 */
export async function getAssessmentForTaking(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  assessmentId: string
): Promise<AssessmentResult<TeacherAssessmentDetail>> {
  const row = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assessmentId },
    include: {
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { id: true, titleAr: true } },
      _count: { select: { questions: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!row) return assessmentFail("الاختبار غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  if (!canViewPublishedAssessment(viewer, row)) {
    return assessmentFail("هذا الاختبار غير متاح لك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const [attempts, enrollment] = await Promise.all([
    db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: { assessmentId: row.id, userId: viewer.id },
      select: { id: true, status: true, startedAt: true, deadlineAt: true },
      orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
    }),
    row.courseId
      ? db.courseEnrollment.findUnique({
          where: {
            courseId_userId: { courseId: row.courseId, userId: viewer.id },
          },
          select: { id: true },
        })
      : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);

  const active = attempts.find((attempt) => attempt.status === "IN_PROGRESS");
  const attemptsUsed = attempts.length;
  const remainingAttempts =
    row.attemptLimit === null ? null : Math.max(0, row.attemptLimit - attemptsUsed);

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      assessment: {
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        titleEn: row.titleEn,
        instructionsAr: row.instructionsAr,
        instructionsEn: row.instructionsEn,
        courseTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? null,
        schoolName: row.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        questionsCount: row._count.questions,
        maxScore: row.maxScore,
        passingScore: row.passingScore,
        timeLimitMinutes: row.timeLimitMinutes,
        attemptLimit: row.attemptLimit,
        availableFrom: row.availableFrom,
        availableUntil: row.availableUntil,
        availability: availabilityState(row),
      },
      enrollmentRequired: row.courseId !== null,
      enrolled: enrollment !== null,
      attemptsUsed,
      remainingAttempts,
      activeAttempt: active
        ? { id: active.id, startedAt: active.startedAt, deadlineAt: active.deadlineAt }
        : null,
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Teacher side — attempts                                              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface StartAttemptOutcome {
  attemptId: string;
  resumed: boolean;
  deadlineAt: Date | null;
}

/**
 * Start (or resume) an attempt. All eligibility rules run SERVER-SIDE:
 * role, visibility, availability window, enrollment (course-bound),
 * attempt limit (counted inside the transaction) and timer deadline.
 */
export async function startAttempt(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  assessmentId: string
): Promise<AssessmentResult<StartAttemptOutcome>> {
  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return assessmentFail("بدء المحاولات متاح للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assessmentId },
  });
  if (!assessment) return assessmentFail("الاختبار غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  if (!canViewPublishedAssessment(viewer, assessment)) {
    return assessmentFail("هذا الاختبار غير متاح لك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (availabilityState(assessment) === "scheduled") {
    return assessmentFail(
      "لم يبدأ توافر هذا الاختبار بعد — راجع موعد البدء",
      "NOT_AVAILABLE"
    );
  }
  if (availabilityState(assessment) === "closed") {
    return assessmentFail("انتهت فترة توافر هذا الاختبار", "NOT_AVAILABLE");
  }

  if (assessment.courseId) {
    const enrollment = await db.courseEnrollment.findUnique({
      where: {
        courseId_userId: { courseId: assessment.courseId, userId: viewer.id },
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (!enrollment) {
      return assessmentFail(
        "هذا الاختبار مرتبط بدورة تدريبية — سجّل في الدورة أولًا",
        "ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED"
      );
    }

    // Batch 1 — exam gate (the original HTML rule): every published
    // lesson of the course must be completed before an attempt starts.
    // Server-side only — the locked chip in the UI is informational.
    const gate = await lessonGateStatus(viewer, assessment.courseId);
    if (!gate.unlocked) {
      return assessmentFail(lessonGateMessage(gate), "ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED");
    }
  }

  return db.$transaction(
    async (tx): Promise<AssessmentResult<StartAttemptOutcome>> => {
      const attempts = await tx.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: { assessmentId: assessment.id, userId: viewer.id },
      select: { id: true, status: true, deadlineAt: true, startedAt: true },
      orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
    });

    // Resume the live attempt instead of starting a new one.
    const live = attempts.find(
      (attempt) =>
        attempt.status === "IN_PROGRESS" &&
        (attempt.deadlineAt === null || attempt.deadlineAt.getTime() > Date.now())
    );
    if (live) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        data: {
          attemptId: live.id,
          resumed: true,
          deadlineAt: live.deadlineAt,
        },
      };
    }

    // Expire stale IN_PROGRESS attempts (deadline passed, never submitted).
    const stale = attempts.filter(
      (attempt) =>
        attempt.status === "IN_PROGRESS" &&
        attempt.deadlineAt !== null &&
        attempt.deadlineAt.getTime() <= Date.now()
    );
    for (const attempt of stale) {
      await tx.assessmentAttempt.update({
        where: { id: attempt.id },
        data: { status: "EXPIRED" },
      });
    }

    const attemptsUsed = attempts.length;
    if (assessment.attemptLimit !== null && attemptsUsed >= assessment.attemptLimit) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: `استهلكت كل المحاولات المسموحة (${assessment.attemptLimit}) لهذا الاختبار`,
        code: "ATTEMPT_LIMIT_REACHED" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }

    const deadlineAt =
      assessment.timeLimitMinutes !== null
        ? new Date(Date.now() + assessment.timeLimitMinutes * 60 * 1000)
        : null;

    const created = await tx.assessmentAttempt.create({
      data: {
        assessmentId: assessment.id,
        userId: viewer.id,
        status: "IN_PROGRESS",
        deadlineAt,
      },
      select: { id: true, deadlineAt: true },
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        attemptId: created.id,
        resumed: false,
        deadlineAt: created.deadlineAt,
      },
    };
  });
}

/** Shared validation of draft/submitted answers against THIS assessment. */
async function validateAnswerBelonging(
  tx: Prisma.TransactionClient | typeof db,
  assessmentId: string,
  answers: SubmittedAnswer[]
): Promise<AssessmentResult<Map<string, ParsedQuestion>>> {
  const questions = await tx.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
  });
  const byId = new Map<string, ParsedQuestion>(
    questions.map((question) => [
      question.id,
      {
        id: question.id,
        type: question.type as QuestionType,
        points: question.points,
        isRequired: question.isRequired,
        orderIndex: question.orderIndex,
        textAr: question.textAr,
        textEn: question.textEn,
        explanation: question.explanation,
        options: parseOptions(question.optionsJson),
        answerKey: parseAnswerKey(question.type, question.answerKeyJson),
      },
    ])
  );

  for (const answer of answers) {
    const question = byId.get(answer.questionId);
    if (!question) {
      // Distinguish "foreign question" (reject) from "question deleted
      // mid-attempt by the manager" (drop silently — not the teacher's
      // fault and not another assessment's data).
      const stray = await tx.assessmentQuestion.findUnique({
        where: { id: answer.questionId },
        select: { assessmentId: true },
      });
      if (!stray || stray.assessmentId !== assessmentId) {
        return assessmentFail(
          "إجابة تشير إلى سؤال لا يخص هذا الاختبار — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة",
          "INVALID_ANSWER"
        );
      }
      continue;
    }

    const isChoice = (CHOICE_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(question.type);
    if (answer.choice !== undefined) {
      if (!isChoice) {
        return assessmentFail(
          "صيغة إجابة غير مطابقة لنوع أحد الأسئلة",
          "INVALID_ANSWER"
        );
      }
      const validIds = new Set(question.options.map((option) => option.id));
      if (answer.choice.some((optionId) => !validIds.has(optionId))) {
        return assessmentFail(
          "إجابة تشير إلى خيار غير موجود — حدّث الصفحة وأعد المحاولة",
          "INVALID_ANSWER"
        );
      }
    }
    if (answer.bool !== undefined && question.type !== "TRUE_FALSE") {
      return assessmentFail(
        "صيغة إجابة غير مطابقة لنوع أحد الأسئلة",
        "INVALID_ANSWER"
      );
    }
    if (answer.text !== undefined && question.type !== "SHORT_ANSWER") {
      return assessmentFail(
        "صيغة إجابة غير مطابقة لنوع أحد الأسئلة",
        "INVALID_ANSWER"
      );
    }
  }

  return { ok: true, data: byId };
}

/** Autosave the teacher's draft answers on their own IN_PROGRESS attempt. */
export async function saveAttemptDraft(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = saveDraftSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const attempt = await db.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.attemptId },
  });
  if (!attempt) return assessmentFail("المحاولة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  if (attempt.userId !== viewer.id) {
    return assessmentFail("لا يمكن تعديل محاولة معلم آخر", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (attempt.status !== "IN_PROGRESS") {
    return assessmentFail("هذه المحاولة لم تعد قيد التنفيذ", "ALREADY_SUBMITTED");
  }
  if (attempt.deadlineAt && attempt.deadlineAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
    return assessmentFail("انتهى وقت المحاولة — لا يمكن حفظ المسودة", "DEADLINE_PASSED");
  }

  const answersResult = await validateAnswerBelonging(
    db,
    attempt.assessmentId,
    input.answers
  );
  if (!answersResult.ok) return answersResult;

  await db.assessmentAttempt.update({
    where: { id: attempt.id },
    data: { answersJson: JSON.stringify(input.answers) },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: attempt.id } };
}

/**
 * Submit + grade inside ONE transaction:
 *   1. reload the attempt and re-check ownership/status/deadline,
 *   2. validate every answer against this assessment's questions,
 *   3. grade objective questions server-side (never trusting the
 *      browser's score), short answers defer to NEEDS_REVIEW,
 *   4. flip the row with a conditional updateMany(status =
 *      IN_PROGRESS) so concurrent double-submissions cannot double-grade.
 */
export async function submitAttempt(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ attemptId: string; status: AttemptStatus }>> {
  const parsed = submitAttemptSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const existing = await db.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.attemptId },
    include: {
      assessment: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          status: true,
          schoolId: true,
          courseId: true,
          passingScore: true,
          availableUntil: true,
          attemptLimit: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!existing) return assessmentFail("المحاولة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  if (existing.userId !== viewer.id) {
    return assessmentFail("لا يمكن تسليم محاولة معلم آخر", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const transactionResult = await db.$transaction(
    async (tx): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ attemptId: string; status: AttemptStatus }>> => {
      const attempt = await tx.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.attemptId },
      include: {
        assessment: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            status: true,
            schoolId: true,
            courseId: true,
            passingScore: true,
            availableUntil: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    if (!attempt) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "المحاولة غير موجودة",
        code: "NOT_FOUND" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }
    if (attempt.userId !== viewer.id) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "لا يمكن تسليم محاولة معلم آخر",
        code: "FORBIDDEN" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }
    if (attempt.status !== "IN_PROGRESS") {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "تم تسليم هذه المحاولة من قبل",
        code: "ALREADY_SUBMITTED" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }
    if (attempt.deadlineAt && attempt.deadlineAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
      // Server-enforced deadline — the browser timer is only cosmetic.
      await tx.assessmentAttempt.update({
        where: { id: attempt.id },
        data: { status: "EXPIRED" },
      });
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "انتهى وقت المحاولة — لم يُقبل التسليم بعد المهلة",
        code: "DEADLINE_PASSED" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }
    if (attempt.assessment.status !== "PUBLISHED") {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "هذا الاختبار غير متاح للتسليم الآن",
        code: "NOT_AVAILABLE" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }
    if (
      attempt.assessment.availableUntil &&
      Date.now() > attempt.assessment.availableUntil.getTime()
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "انتهت فترة توافر هذا الاختبار",
        code: "NOT_AVAILABLE" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }

    const gradedQuestions = await validateAnswerBelonging(
      tx,
      attempt.assessmentId,
      input.answers
    );
    if (!gradedQuestions.ok) return gradedQuestions;
    const questionsById = gradedQuestions.data;
    const orderedQuestions = [...questionsById.values()].sort(
      (a, b) => a.orderIndex - b.orderIndex
    );

    // Server-side scoring — the browser never supplies a score.
    let objectiveScore = 0;
    let hasShort = false;
    for (const answer of input.answers) {
      const question = questionsById.get(answer.questionId);
      if (!question) continue; // dropped: deleted mid-attempt
      if (question.type === "SHORT_ANSWER") {
        hasShort = true;
        continue;
      }
      const key = question.answerKey;
      if (!key) continue;

      let correct = false;
      if (question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" && "optionId" in key) {
        correct =
          Array.isArray(answer.choice) &&
          answer.choice.length === 1 &&
          answer.choice[0] === key.optionId;
      } else if (question.type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE" && "optionIds" in key) {
        const submitted = [...(answer.choice ?? [])].sort();
        const expected = [...key.optionIds].sort();
        correct =
          submitted.length === expected.length &&
          submitted.every((optionId, index) => optionId === expected[index]);
      } else if (question.type === "TRUE_FALSE" && "value" in key) {
        correct = answer.bool === key.value;
      }
      if (correct) objectiveScore += question.points;
    }

    const maxScoreNow = orderedQuestions.reduce(
      (sum, question) => sum + question.points,
      0
    );
    if (maxScoreNow <= 0) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "لا يمكن تسليم هذا الاختبار — لا توجد أسئلة صالحة",
        code: "NOT_AVAILABLE" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }

    const submittedAt = new Date();
    const status: AttemptStatus = hasShort
      ? "NEEDS_REVIEW"
      : objectiveScore >= attempt.assessment.passingScore
        ? "PASSED"
        : "FAILED";
    const percentage = hasShort
      ? null
      : Math.round((objectiveScore / maxScoreNow) * 100);
    const passed = hasShort ? null : objectiveScore >= attempt.assessment.passingScore;

    // Conditional flip: only an IN_PROGRESS row can be graded, so two
    // concurrent submissions can never both apply their scores.
    const flipped = await tx.assessmentAttempt.updateMany({
      where: { id: attempt.id, status: "IN_PROGRESS" },
      data: {
        status,
        submittedAt,
        answersJson: JSON.stringify(input.answers),
        objectiveScore,
        maxScore: maxScoreNow,
        percentage,
        passed,
      },
    });
    if (flipped.count !== 1) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "تم تسليم هذه المحاولة من قبل",
        code: "ALREADY_SUBMITTED" as AssessmentErrorCode,
      };
    }

    return { ok: true, data: { attemptId: attempt.id, status } };
  });

  // Batch 1 — a PASSED attempt is one of the two completion keys.
  // Post-commit (never inside the grading transaction): the completion
  // engine re-checks the lessons + all published assessments and, when
  // everything is met, creates the CourseCompletion and auto-issues
  // the certificate (best-effort, signatory-gated).
  if (
    transactionResult.ok &&
    transactionResult.data.status === "PASSED" &&
    existing.assessment.courseId
  ) {
    try {
      await maybeCompleteCourse(viewer.id, existing.assessment.courseId);
    } catch (completionError) {
      console.error("completion-after-submit failed", completionError);
    }
  }

  return transactionResult;
}

/* Results & review                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Per-question result for the attempt OWNER. Correct answers are
 * revealed only after submission; unscored (EXPIRED) attempts show the
 * saved answers without keys; NEEDS_REVIEW shows objective results and
 * marks short answers as awaiting review.
 */
export async function getAttemptResult(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  attemptId: string
): Promise<AssessmentResult<AttemptResultView>> {
  const attempt = await db.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
    where: { id: attemptId },
    include: {
      assessment: { select: { id: true, titleAr: true, passingScore: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!attempt) return assessmentFail("المحاولة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  if (attempt.userId !== viewer.id) {
    return assessmentFail("لا يمكنك الاطلاع على نتائج محاولة معلم آخر", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (attempt.status === "IN_PROGRESS") {
    return assessmentFail(
      "هذه المحاولة لم تُسلَّم بعد — أكملها من صفحة الاختبار",
      "NOT_AVAILABLE"
    );
  }

  const questions = await db.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId: attempt.assessmentId },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
  });
  const answers = new Map(
    parseAnswers(attempt.answersJson).map((answer) => [answer.questionId, answer])
  );
  const reviewScores = new Map(
    parseReviewScores(attempt.reviewScoresJson).map((score) => [score.questionId, score.points])
  );
  const revealed = attempt.status !== "EXPIRED";

  const breakdown: ResultQuestionBreakdown[] = questions.map((question) => {
    const parsed = {
      id: question.id,
      type: question.type as QuestionType,
      options: parseOptions(question.optionsJson),
      answerKey: parseAnswerKey(question.type, question.answerKeyJson),
    };
    const answer = answers.get(question.id);

    let yourAnswer: ResultQuestionBreakdown["yourAnswer"] = null;
    if (answer) {
      yourAnswer = {
        optionTexts: (answer.choice ?? [])
          .map((optionId) => parsed.options.find((option) => option.id === optionId)?.textAr ?? "")
          .filter((text) => text.length > 0),
        bool: answer.bool ?? null,
        text: answer.text ?? null,
      };
    }

    let correct: ResultQuestionBreakdown["correct"] = null;
    let earnedPoints: number | null = null;
    let isCorrect: boolean | null = null;

    if (revealed && parsed.answerKey) {
      const key = parsed.answerKey;
      if (parsed.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" && "optionId" in key) {
        const correctText =
          parsed.options.find((option) => option.id === key.optionId)?.textAr ?? "";
        correct = {
          optionTexts: correctText.length > 0 ? [correctText] : [],
          bool: null,
          modelAnswer: null,
        };
        earnedPoints = answer?.choice?.[0] === key.optionId ? question.points : 0;
        isCorrect = earnedPoints === question.points;
      } else if (parsed.type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE" && "optionIds" in key) {
        const expectedTexts = key.optionIds
          .map((optionId) => parsed.options.find((option) => option.id === optionId)?.textAr ?? "")
          .filter((text) => text.length > 0);
        correct = { optionTexts: expectedTexts, bool: null, modelAnswer: null };
        const submitted = [...(answer?.choice ?? [])].sort();
        const expected = [...key.optionIds].sort();
        const matches =
          submitted.length === expected.length &&
          submitted.every((optionId, index) => optionId === expected[index]);
        earnedPoints = matches ? question.points : 0;
        isCorrect = matches;
      } else if (parsed.type === "TRUE_FALSE" && "value" in parsed.answerKey) {
        correct = {
          optionTexts: [],
          bool: parsed.answerKey.value,
          modelAnswer: null,
        };
        earnedPoints = answer?.bool === parsed.answerKey.value ? question.points : 0;
        isCorrect = earnedPoints === question.points;
      } else if (parsed.type === "SHORT_ANSWER") {
        correct = {
          optionTexts: [],
          bool: null,
          modelAnswer:
            "modelAnswer" in parsed.answerKey ? parsed.answerKey.modelAnswer ?? null : null,
        };
        // Manual review state — never invent a grade.
        earnedPoints = reviewScores.has(question.id)
          ? reviewScores.get(question.id) ?? null
          : null;
        isCorrect = null;
      }
    }

    return {
      questionId: question.id,
      orderIndex: question.orderIndex,
      type: question.type,
      textAr: question.textAr,
      points: question.points,
      yourAnswer,
      correct,
      explanation: revealed ? question.explanation : null,
      earnedPoints,
      isCorrect,
    };
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      attempt: {
        id: attempt.id,
        status: attempt.status as AttemptStatus,
        startedAt: attempt.startedAt,
        submittedAt: attempt.submittedAt,
        deadlineAt: attempt.deadlineAt,
        objectiveScore: attempt.objectiveScore,
        earnedScore: attempt.earnedScore,
        maxScore: attempt.maxScore,
        percentage: attempt.percentage,
        passed: attempt.passed,
        reviewedAt: attempt.reviewedAt,
      },
      assessment: {
        id: attempt.assessment.id,
        titleAr: attempt.assessment.titleAr,
        passingScore: attempt.assessment.passingScore,
      },
      breakdown,
    },
  };
}

/** The teacher's own attempt history across all assessments. */
export async function listMyAttempts(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity
): Promise<AssessmentResult<MyAttemptRow[]>> {
  const rows = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
    where: { userId: viewer.id },
    include: { assessment: { select: { id: true, titleAr: true } } },
    orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
    take: 100,
  });
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      assessmentId: row.assessment.id,
      assessmentTitle: row.assessment.titleAr,
      status: row.status as AttemptStatus,
      startedAt: row.startedAt,
      submittedAt: row.submittedAt,
      earnedScore: row.earnedScore,
      maxScore: row.maxScore,
      percentage: row.percentage,
      passed: row.passed,
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * Manual review of a NEEDS_REVIEW attempt (short-answer grading).
 * Finalized attempts (PASSED/FAILED) are immutable — review is rejected.
 */
export async function reviewAttempt(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<AssessmentResult<{ id: string; status: AttemptStatus; percentage: number }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = reviewAttemptSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const attempt = await db.assessmentAttempt.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.attemptId },
    include: {
      assessment: {
        select: { id: true, schoolId: true, courseId: true, passingScore: true },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!attempt) return assessmentFail("المحاولة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = assessmentScopeError(ctx, attempt.assessment.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  if (attempt.status !== "NEEDS_REVIEW") {
    return assessmentFail(
      "لا يمكن تعديل نتيجة نهائية — المراجعة متاحة للمحاولات المنتظرة فقط",
      "ALREADY_SUBMITTED"
    );
  }

  const shortQuestions = await db.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
    where: { assessmentId: attempt.assessmentId, type: "SHORT_ANSWER" },
    select: { id: true, points: true },
  });
  const shortById = new Map(shortQuestions.map((question) => [question.id, question]));

  for (const score of input.scores) {
    const question = shortById.get(score.questionId);
    if (!question) {
      return assessmentFail(
        "درجة مراجعة تشير إلى سؤال ليس من أسئلة الإجابة القصيرة في هذا الاختبار",
        "INVALID_ANSWER"
      );
    }
    if (score.points > question.points) {
      return assessmentFail(
        `الدرجة الممنوحة أكبر من الدرجة القصوى للسؤال (${question.points} نقاط)`,
        "INVALID_ANSWER"
      );
    }
  }

  const earnedScore = attempt.objectiveScore + input.scores.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.points, 0);
  const maxScore = attempt.maxScore ?? 0;
  if (maxScore <= 0) {
    return assessmentFail("تعذر احتساب الدرجة الكلية لهذه المحاولة", "INVALID_ANSWER");
  }
  const percentage = Math.round((earnedScore / maxScore) * 100);
  const passed = earnedScore >= attempt.assessment.passingScore;
  const status: AttemptStatus = passed ? "PASSED" : "FAILED";

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const flipped = await tx.assessmentAttempt.updateMany({
      where: { id: attempt.id, status: "NEEDS_REVIEW" },
      data: {
        status,
        earnedScore,
        percentage,
        passed,
        reviewScoresJson: JSON.stringify(input.scores),
        reviewedById: ctx.id,
        reviewedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
    if (flipped.count !== 1) {
      throw new Error("ATTEMPT_REVIEW_RACE");
    }
  });

  // Batch 1 — a reviewed PASSED attempt can be the final completion
  // key; run the same idempotent completion engine post-commit.
  if (status === "PASSED" && attempt.assessment.courseId) {
    try {
      await maybeCompleteCourse(
        attempt.userId,
        attempt.assessment.courseId,
        ctx.id
      );
    } catch (completionError) {
      console.error("completion-after-review failed", completionError);
    }
  }

  return { ok: true, data: { id: attempt.id, status, percentage } };
}

/**
 * Supervisor view: attempts of teachers explicitly assigned to them,
 * confined to the supervisor's own school.
 */
export async function listSupervisorResults(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity
): Promise<AssessmentResult<ReadOnlyAttemptRow[]>> {
  if (viewer.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return assessmentFail("هذه الشاشة مخصصة للمشرفين التربويين", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const assignments = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId: viewer.id, schoolId: viewer.schoolId ?? undefined },
    select: { teacherId: true },
  });
  const teacherIds = assignments.map((assignment) => assignment.teacherId);
  if (teacherIds.length === 0) return { ok: true, data: [] };

  const rows = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
    where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, status: { not: "IN_PROGRESS" } },
    include: {
      assessment: { select: { id: true, titleAr: true, status: true } },
      user: { select: { id: true, name: true, school: { select: { nameAr: true } } } },
    },
    orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
    take: 100,
  });
  return { ok: true, data: rows.map(toReadOnlyRow) };
}

/**
 * Deputy read-only view: attempts inside the granted schools/branches
 * only — the grant rows are the single source of this boundary.
 */
export async function listDeputyResults(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity
): Promise<AssessmentResult<ReadOnlyAttemptRow[]>> {
  if (viewer.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    return assessmentFail("هذه الشاشة مخصصة للوكلاء التعليميين", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
    where: { userId: viewer.id },
    select: { schoolId: true, branchId: true },
  });
  if (grants.length === 0) return { ok: true, data: [] };

  const userFilters = grants.map((grant) => ({
    user: {
      schoolId: grant.schoolId,
      ...(grant.branchId ? { branchId: grant.branchId } : {}),
    },
  }));

  const rows = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
    where: { OR: userFilters, status: { not: "IN_PROGRESS" } },
    include: {
      assessment: { select: { id: true, titleAr: true, status: true } },
      user: { select: { id: true, name: true, school: { select: { nameAr: true } } } },
    },
    orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
    take: 100,
  });
  return { ok: true, data: rows.map(toReadOnlyRow) };
}

function toReadOnlyRow(
  row: Prisma.AssessmentAttemptGetPayload<{
    include: {
      assessment: { select: { id: true; titleAr: true; status: true } };
      user: { select: { id: true; name: true; school: { select: { nameAr: true } } } };
    };
  }>
): ReadOnlyAttemptRow {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    assessmentId: row.assessment.id,
    assessmentTitle: row.assessment.titleAr,
    assessmentStatus: row.assessment.status,
    teacherId: row.user.id,
    teacherName: row.user.name,
    schoolName: row.user.school?.nameAr ?? null,
    status: row.status as AttemptStatus,
    submittedAt: row.submittedAt,
    earnedScore: row.earnedScore,
    maxScore: row.maxScore,
    percentage: row.percentage,
    passed: row.passed,
  };
}

/* Dashboard metrics                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Real persisted assessment metrics scoped by school (null = platform). */
export async function getAssessmentMetrics(
  schoolId: string | null
): Promise<AssessmentMetrics> {
  const assessmentWhere: Prisma.AssessmentWhereInput = schoolId
    ? { schoolId }
    : {};
  const attemptWhere: Prisma.AssessmentAttemptWhereInput = schoolId
    ? { user: { schoolId } }
    : {};

  const [assessmentsTotal, assessmentsPublished, finalized, needsReviewCount, graded] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.assessment.count({ where: assessmentWhere }),
      db.assessment.count({ where: { ...assessmentWhere, status: "PUBLISHED" } }),
      db.assessmentAttempt.count({
        where: { ...attemptWhere, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
      }),
      db.assessmentAttempt.count({
        where: { ...attemptWhere, status: "NEEDS_REVIEW" },
      }),
      db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
        where: { ...attemptWhere, status: { in: ["PASSED", "FAILED"] } },
        select: { percentage: true, passed: true },
      }),
    ]);

  const avgPercentage =
    finalized > 0
      ? Math.round(
          graded.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.percentage ?? 0), 0) / finalized
        )
      : null;
  const passedCount = graded.filter((row) => row.passed === true).length;
  const passRate = finalized > 0 ? Math.round((passedCount / finalized) * 100) : null;

  return {
    assessmentsTotal,
    assessmentsPublished,
    attemptsFinalized: finalized,
    needsReviewCount,
    avgPercentage,
    passRate,
  };
}

/** Course options for the assessment form: same tenant, non-archived. */
export async function listCourseOptions(
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<{ id: string; titleAr: string; schoolId: string | null }[]> {
  const where: Prisma.CourseWhereInput =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } }
      : {
          status: { not: "ARCHIVED" },
          OR: [
            { schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
            { schoolId: null, status: "PUBLISHED" },
          ],
        };
  const rows = await db.course.findMany({
    where,
    select: { id: true, titleAr: true, schoolId: true },
    orderBy: { titleAr: "asc" },
  });
  return rows;
}

/**
 * Phase 7 — pure access predicates and tenant scoping for assignments.
 *
 * No DB access lives here (except none — this module is intentionally
 * side-effect free) so every rule is unit-testable. The service layer
 * composes these helpers and NEVER trusts client-provided scope:
 * the actor's school/branch/role always come from the session-backed
 * context, and supervisor reach comes from persisted assignments.
 */
import type { AudienceMode } from "@/config/assignments";
import {
  assignmentFail,
  type AssignmentErrorCode,
  type AssignmentResult,
} from "@/lib/validation/assignments";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Viewer identity (teacher-side; same shape as the assessment layer)   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ViewerIdentity {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/**
 * Phase 7 actor (write-capable back-office roles). Defined LOCALLY on
 * purpose: assignments must also accept EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR (review)
 * and EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY (read-only overview) beyond the platform's own
 * AdminContext union. SCHOOL_MANAGER is admitted with the same powers as
 * the office manager — structurally confined to its own school by
 * `assignmentScopeError` (its schoolId comes from the DB session, never
 * from the client). Every value is built server-side from the session
 * user after an explicit role check — never from the payload.
 * `name` is optional so callers may pass a bare identity projection.
 */
export interface AssignmentActor {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  role:
    | "SUPER_ADMIN"
    | "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
    | "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
    | "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
    | "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY";
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Role capabilities                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Assignment management is school-office work — SUPER_ADMIN is
 * stats-only. SCHOOL_MANAGER runs the same office inside its own school.
 */
export function canManageAssignments(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER";
}

/**
 * Reviewing/grading: office manager or school manager (whole school) or
 * supervisor (own assigned teachers only).
 */
export function canReviewSubmissions(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
  );
}

/** Read-only summary roles (deputy) and platform stats (super admin). */
export function isReadOnlyOverviewRole(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" || role === "SUPER_ADMIN";
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Failure helpers                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export function assignmentScopeError(
  ctx: AssignmentActor,
  schoolId: string | null
): AssignmentResult<never> | null {
  // Assignments are always school-owned; a null/missing school context
  // can never match (this blocks SUPER_ADMIN operational access too,
  // and structurally confines SCHOOL_MANAGER to its own school).
  if (!schoolId || ctx.schoolId !== schoolId) {
    return assignmentFail(
      "لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى هذا التكليف — النطاق المدرسي مختلف",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export function manageGuard(ctx: AssignmentActor): AssignmentResult<never> | null {
  if (!canManageAssignments(ctx.role)) {
    return assignmentFail(
      "إدارة التكليفات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export function reviewGuard(ctx: AssignmentActor): AssignmentResult<never> | null {
  if (!canReviewSubmissions(ctx.role)) {
    return assignmentFail(
      "مراجعة التسليمات متاحة للمشرفين التربويين ومديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Audience targeting (pure)                                            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface TargetingSnapshot {
  audienceMode: string;
  targetTeacherIds: string[];
  targetBranchIds: string[];
}

export function parseJsonIds(raw: string | null | undefined): string[] {
  if (!raw) return [];
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string" && id.length > 0);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/** Pure eligibility rule — the service feeds it DB-verified teacher rows. */
export function isTeacherTargeted(
  targeting: TargetingSnapshot,
  teacher: { id: string; branchId: string | null }
): boolean {
  if (targeting.audienceMode === "ALL_TEACHERS") return true;
  if (targeting.audienceMode === "BRANCHES") {
    return teacher.branchId !== null && targeting.targetBranchIds.includes(teacher.branchId);
  }
  return targeting.targetTeacherIds.includes(teacher.id);
}

/** Arabic explanation of who an assignment targets (detail pages). */
export function targetingSummary(targeting: TargetingSnapshot, labels: Record<AudienceMode, string>): string {
  const base = labels[targeting.audienceMode as AudienceMode] ?? "فئة غير معروفة";
  if (targeting.audienceMode === "BRANCHES") {
    return `${base} (${targeting.targetBranchIds.length})`;
  }
  if (targeting.audienceMode === "TEACHERS") {
    return `${base} (${targeting.targetTeacherIds.length})`;
  }
  return base;
}

export type { AssignmentErrorCode };

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\lib\assignments\read-scope.ts

/**
 * Batch 3 — READ-ONLY assignment listings for roles that never manage:
 *
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR — published/closed assignments whose audience
 *     targets at least one of THEIR assigned teachers. The teacher set
 *     comes from persisted TeacherSupervisorAssignment rows (plus the
 *     teachers' current branches), never from the client.
 *   SUPER_ADMIN — a platform-wide read-only register with the school
 *     name on every row. SUPER_ADMIN can look, never touch: no create,
 *     edit, publish or grade path is exposed through this module.
 *
 * This module intentionally contains ZERO mutations — the write-capable
 * service (listAssignmentsForManage and friends) stays untouched.
 */
import { isTeacherTargeted, parseJsonIds } from "@/lib/assignments/access";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/** Matches the management page density. */
const PLATFORM_PAGE_SIZE = 15;

/** Serializable row shared by both read paths (RSC-safe). */
export interface AssignmentReadRow {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  titleEn: string | null;
  status: string;
  audienceMode: string;
  dueAt: Date;
  totalPoints: number;
  submissionsTotal: number;
  schoolName?: string;
}

type AssignmentWithCounts = {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  titleEn: string | null;
  status: string;
  audienceMode: string;
  targetTeacherIdsJson: string | null;
  targetBranchIdsJson: string | null;
  dueAt: Date;
  totalPoints: number;
  _count: { submissions: number };
};

function targetingOf(assignment: {
  audienceMode: string;
  targetTeacherIdsJson: string | null;
  targetBranchIdsJson: string | null;
}) {
  return {
    audienceMode: assignment.audienceMode,
    targetTeacherIds: parseJsonIds(assignment.targetTeacherIdsJson),
    targetBranchIds: parseJsonIds(assignment.targetBranchIdsJson),
  };
}

function toRow(
  assignment: AssignmentWithCounts,
  schoolName?: string
): AssignmentReadRow {
  return {
    id: assignment.id,
    titleAr: assignment.titleAr,
    titleEn: assignment.titleEn,
    status: assignment.status,
    audienceMode: assignment.audienceMode,
    dueAt: assignment.dueAt,
    totalPoints: assignment.totalPoints,
    submissionsTotal: assignment._count.submissions,
    schoolName,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor — read-only register for assigned teachers                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface SupervisorReadResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  rows: AssignmentReadRow[];
}

export async function listAssignmentsForSupervisor(ctx: {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}): Promise<SupervisorReadResult> {
  if (ctx.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذه القائمة متاحة للمشرفين التربويين فقط", rows: [] };
  }
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "حساب المشرف غير مرتبط بمدرسة — تواصل مع إدارة المنصة",
      rows: [],
    };
  }

  // Scope = persisted supervisor assignments inside the supervisor's
  // own school. No client input participates in this query.
  const links = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId: ctx.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
    select: { teacherId: true },
  });
  const teacherIds = links.map((link) => link.teacherId);
  if (teacherIds.length === 0) {
    return { ok: true, rows: [] };
  }

  const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: teacherIds } },
    select: { id: true, branchId: true },
  });

  const assignments = await db.assignment.findMany({
    where: {
      schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
      status: { in: ["PUBLISHED", "CLOSED"] },
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      titleEn: true,
      status: true,
      audienceMode: true,
      targetTeacherIdsJson: true,
      targetBranchIdsJson: true,
      dueAt: true,
      totalPoints: true,
      _count: { select: { submissions: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { dueAt: "asc" },
  });

  const rows = assignments
    .filter((assignment) =>
      teachers.some((teacher) => isTeacherTargeted(targetingOf(assignment), teacher))
    )
    .map((assignment) => toRow(assignment));

  return { ok: true, rows };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Platform — read-only cross-school register (SUPER_ADMIN)             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface PlatformListResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  rows: AssignmentReadRow[];
  total: number;
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
}

export async function listAssignmentsPlatform(filters: {
  q?: string;
  status?: string;
  page?: number;
}): Promise<PlatformListResult> {
  const where: {
    OR?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    status?: string;
  } = {};
  const q = filters.q?.trim();
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [{ titleAr: { contains: q } }, { titleEn: { contains: q } }];
  }
  if (
    filters.status === "DRAFT" ||
    filters.status === "PUBLISHED" ||
    filters.status === "CLOSED" ||
    filters.status === "ARCHIVED"
  ) {
    where.status = filters.status;
  }

  const [total, rows] = await Promise.all([
    db.assignment.count({ where }),
    db.assignment.findMany({
      where,
      select: {
        id: true,
        titleAr: true,
        titleEn: true,
        status: true,
        audienceMode: true,
        targetTeacherIdsJson: true,
        targetBranchIdsJson: true,
        dueAt: true,
        totalPoints: true,
        _count: { select: { submissions: true } },
        school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip: (Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1) - 1) * PLATFORM_PAGE_SIZE,
      take: PLATFORM_PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
  ]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PLATFORM_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  return {
    ok: true,
    rows: rows.map((row) => toRow(row, row.school.nameAr)),
    total,
    page,
    pageCount,
  };
}

async function requireAdmin(): Promise<AdminContext> {
  // Services are called from server actions that already resolved the
  // context; this fallback exists for tests and keeps the signature
  // symmetric with the other services.
  const { requireAdminContext } = await import("@/lib/auth/dev-admin");

function parseJson<T>(raw: string | null | undefined): T | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function targetingOf(row: {
  audienceMode: string;
  targetTeacherIdsJson: string | null;
  targetBranchIdsJson: string | null;
}): TargetingSnapshot {
  return {
    audienceMode: row.audienceMode,
    targetTeacherIds: parseJsonIds(row.targetTeacherIdsJson),
    targetBranchIds: parseJsonIds(row.targetBranchIdsJson),
  };
}

/** Server-side window decision — the browser clock is never consulted. */
function submissionWindow(
  assignment: { dueAt: Date; allowLate: boolean; lateUntil: Date | null },
  now: Date = new Date()
): { open: boolean; late: boolean } {
  if (now.getTime() <= assignment.dueAt.getTime()) return { open: true, late: false };
  if (
    assignment.allowLate &&
    (!assignment.lateUntil || now.getTime() <= assignment.lateUntil.getTime())
  ) {
    return { open: true, late: true };
  }
  return { open: false, late: false };
}

function windowStateOf(
  assignment: { status: string; dueAt: Date; allowLate: boolean; lateUntil: Date | null },
  now: Date = new Date()
): "open" | "late" | "closed" {
  if (assignment.status !== "PUBLISHED") return "closed";
  const window = submissionWindow(assignment, now);
  return window.open ? (window.late ? "late" : "open") : "closed";
}

/**
 * DB-verified eligible teachers for one assignment. `scope` narrows the
 * school's teachers for deputy views (branch grants) — null/undefined
 * scope fields mean "no extra narrowing".
 */
async function eligibleTeacherRows(
  schoolId: string,
  targeting: TargetingSnapshot,
  scope?: { allowedBranchIds?: string[] | null }
): Promise<{ id: string; name: string; branchId: string | null }[]> {
  const rows = await db.user.findMany({
    where: { role: "TEACHER", schoolId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, branchId: true },
  });
  const allowed = scope?.allowedBranchIds ?? null;
  return rows.filter((teacher) => {
    if (!isTeacherTargeted(targeting, teacher)) return false;
    if (allowed) {
      if (teacher.branchId === null || !allowed.includes(teacher.branchId)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
}

interface DeputyScope {
  schoolId: string;
  /** null = the whole school is granted */
  allowedBranchIds: string[] | null;
}

async function resolveDeputyScopes(viewer: ViewerIdentity): Promise<DeputyScope[]> {
  const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
    where: { userId: viewer.id },
    select: { schoolId: true, branchId: true },
  });
  const bySchool = new Map<string, string[] | null>();
  for (const grant of grants) {
    const current = bySchool.get(grant.schoolId);
    if (grant.branchId === null) {
      bySchool.set(grant.schoolId, null);
    } else if (current !== null) {
      bySchool.set(grant.schoolId, [...(current ?? []), grant.branchId]);
    }
  }
  return [...bySchool.entries()].map(([schoolId, allowedBranchIds]) => ({
    schoolId,
    allowedBranchIds,
  }));
}

/** Teacher identity + eligibility resolved from the DB, never the client. */
async function loadTeacherEligibility(
  assignment: {
    schoolId: string;
    audienceMode: string;
    targetTeacherIdsJson: string | null;
    targetBranchIdsJson: string | null;
  },
  viewer: ViewerIdentity
): Promise<AssignmentResult<{ id: string; branchId: string | null }>> {
  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return assignmentFail("التسليم متاح للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: viewer.id },
    select: { id: true, role: true, schoolId: true, branchId: true },
  });
  if (!user || user.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return assignmentFail("التسليم متاح للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (user.schoolId !== assignment.schoolId) {
    return assignmentFail("هذا التكليف لا ينتمي إلى مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (!isTeacherTargeted(targetingOf(assignment), user)) {
    return assignmentFail("هذا التكليف غير موجَّه إليك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  return { ok: true, data: { id: user.id, branchId: user.branchId } };
}

/** Supervisor reach: persisted teacher assignments inside own school. */
async function supervisorTeacherIds(
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<AssignmentResult<string[]>> {
  const rows = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId: ctx.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId ?? undefined },

  });

}

/**
 * Shared load-and-scope for review functions. Office managers reach the
 * whole school; supervisors only submissions of THEIR assigned teachers
 * (URL/payload manipulation cannot widen this — the set comes from
 * persisted TeacherSupervisorAssignment rows).
 */
async function loadSubmissionForReview(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  submissionId: string
): Promise<
  AssignmentResult<
    Prisma.AssignmentSubmissionGetPayload<{
      include: {
        assignment: {
          select: {
            id: true;
            titleAr: true;
            status: true;
            schoolId: true;
            dueAt: true;
            allowLate: true;
            lateUntil: true;
            totalPoints: true;
          };
        };
        teacher: {
          select: { id: true; name: true; email: true; branch: { select: { nameAr: true } } };
        };
      };
    }>
  >
> {
  const guard = reviewGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const row = await db.assignmentSubmission.findUnique({
    where: { id: submissionId },
    include: {
      assignment: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          status: true,
          schoolId: true,
          dueAt: true,
          allowLate: true,
          lateUntil: true,
          totalPoints: true,
        },
      },
      teacher: {
        select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, branch: { select: { nameAr: true } } },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!row) return assignmentFail("التسليم غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");

  const scopeCheck = assignmentScopeError(ctx, row.assignment.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const teachers = await supervisorTeacherIds(ctx);
    if (!teachers.ok) return teachers;
    if (!teachers.data.includes(row.teacherId)) {
      return assignmentFail(
        "هذا المعلم ليس ضمن المعلمين المشرف عليهم",
        "FORBIDDEN"
      );
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, data: row };
}

/**
 * Phase 12 — content sniffing (defense in depth).
 *
 * The browser-reported MIME type is client-controlled, so a renamed
 * binary can arrive declaring itself "application/pdf". For every
 * NON-text whitelisted type we verify the file starts with the format's
 * real magic bytes before accepting it. text/plain is intentionally NOT
 * sniffed (plain text has no magic; UTF-8/UTF-16 BOMs and Arabic content
 * would create false rejections) — it is additionally safe because
 * downloads are always served with `Content-Disposition: attachment`
 * and a strict Content-Security-Policy.
 */
const FILE_MAGIC: Record<string, number[][]> = {
  "application/pdf": [[0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46]], // %PDF
  "image/png": [[0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]], // PNG signature
  "image/jpeg": [[0xff, 0xd8, 0xff]], // JPEG SOI
  // Legacy Office binary formats are OLE2 compound documents.
  "application/msword": [[0xd0, 0xcf, 0x11, 0xe0, 0xa1, 0xb1, 0x1a, 0xe1]],
  "application/vnd.ms-excel": [[0xd0, 0xcf, 0x11, 0xe0, 0xa1, 0xb1, 0x1a, 0xe1]],
  "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint": [[0xd0, 0xcf, 0x11, 0xe0, 0xa1, 0xb1, 0x1a, 0xe1]],
  // OpenXML formats are ZIP containers (PK\x03\x04, empty-zip, spanned).
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04],
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06],
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x07, 0x08],
  ],
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet": [
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04],
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06],
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x07, 0x08],
  ],
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation": [
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04],
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06],
    [0x50, 0x4b, 0x07, 0x08],
  ],
};

async function fileMagicMatches(
  file: File,
  mime: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const signatures = FILE_MAGIC[mime];
  if (!signatures) return true; // text/plain (and any unlisted type) passes
  const header = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, 8).arrayBuffer());
  return signatures.some((signature) =>
    signature.every((byte, index) => header[index] === byte)
  );
}

async function validateUploadFile(
  file: unknown
): Promise<AssignmentResult<{ name: string; mime: string }>> {
  if (typeof File === "undefined" || !(file instanceof File)) {
    return assignmentFail("لم يُرفق ملف صالح", "FILE_INVALID");
  }
  if (file.size <= 0) {
    return assignmentFail("الملف فارغ", "FILE_INVALID");
  }
  if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
    return assignmentFail(
      `حجم الملف يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${Math.round(MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES / (1024 * 1024))} ميغابايت)`,
      "FILE_INVALID"
    );
  }
  // Normalize the declared type before the whitelist lookup: browsers
  // (and runtimes) may append parameters — "text/plain;charset=utf-8" —
  // and the comparison must not fail on formatting, only on substance.
  const mime = (file.type || "application/octet-stream").split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES[mime]) {
    return assignmentFail(
      "نوع الملف غير مدعوم — الأنواع المسموحة: PDF، صور، Word، Excel، PowerPoint، نص",
      "FILE_INVALID"
    );
  }
  // Declared type must match the actual bytes (client MIME is not trusted).
  if (!(await fileMagicMatches(file, mime))) {
    return assignmentFail(
      "محتوى الملف لا يطابق نوعه المعلن — أعد رفع الملف الأصلي",
      "FILE_INVALID"
    );
  }
  // The stored name is display-only metadata — strip separators/newlines.
  const name = (file.name ?? "ملف")
    .replace(/[\\/\r\n\t]/g, "_")
    .slice(0, 200) || "ملف";
  return { ok: true, data: { name, mime } };
}

function validationFailWrap<T>(error: { issues: unknown[] }): AssignmentResult<T> {
  return validationFail(error as never);
}

/* Manage — listing, detail, options                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ManageAssignmentFilters {
  q?: string;
  status?: string;
  page?: number;
}

export async function listAssignmentsForManage(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  filters: ManageAssignmentFilters
): Promise<AssignmentResult<Paginated<ManageAssignmentRow>>> {
  const guard = manageGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return assignmentFail("حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const where: Prisma.AssignmentWhereInput = { schoolId: ctx.schoolId };
  if (filters.status && filters.status.trim().length > 0) {
    where.status = filters.status.trim();
  }
  if (filters.q && filters.q.trim().length > 0) {
    where.titleAr = { contains: filters.q.trim() };
  }

  const total = await db.assignment.count({ where });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / ASSIGNMENTS_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  const rows = await db.assignment.findMany({
    where,
    include: { _count: { select: { submissions: true } } },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    skip: (page - 1) * ASSIGNMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
    take: ASSIGNMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
  });

  const pageIds = rows.map((row) => row.id);
  const buckets = pageIds.length
    ? await db.assignmentSubmission.groupBy({
        by: ["assignmentId", "status"],
        where: { assignmentId: { in: pageIds }, status: { not: "DRAFT" } },
        _count: { _all: true },
      })
    : [];
  const pendingByAssignment = new Map<string, number>();
  const gradedByAssignment = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const bucket of buckets) {
    if (bucket.status === "SUBMITTED" || bucket.status === "UNDER_REVIEW") {
      pendingByAssignment.set(
        bucket.assignmentId,
        (pendingByAssignment.get(bucket.assignmentId) ?? 0) + bucket._count._all
      );
    }
    if (bucket.status === "GRADED") {
      gradedByAssignment.set(
        bucket.assignmentId,
        (gradedByAssignment.get(bucket.assignmentId) ?? 0) + bucket._count._all
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        titleEn: row.titleEn,
        status: row.status,
        audienceMode: row.audienceMode,
        dueAt: row.dueAt,
        publishedAt: row.publishedAt,
        totalPoints: row.totalPoints,
        submissionsTotal: row._count.submissions,
        pendingCount: pendingByAssignment.get(row.id) ?? 0,
        gradedCount: gradedByAssignment.get(row.id) ?? 0,
        createdAt: row.createdAt,
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
      })),
      total,
      page,
      pageCount,
    },
  };
}

export async function getAssignmentForManage(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  assignmentId: string
): Promise<AssignmentResult<ManageAssignmentDetail>> {
  const guard = manageGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const row = await db.assignment.findUnique({
    where: { id: assignmentId },
    include: { _count: { select: { submissions: true } } },
  });
  if (!row) return assignmentFail("التكليف غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = assignmentScopeError(ctx, row.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  const [criteria, statusBuckets] = await Promise.all([
    db.assignmentRubricCriterion.findMany({
      where: { assignmentId: row.id },
      orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
    }),
    db.assignmentSubmission.groupBy({
      by: ["status", "isLate"],
      where: { assignmentId: row.id },
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
  ]);

  const stats: AssignmentSubmissionStats = {
    drafts: 0,
    submitted: 0,
    underReview: 0,
    returned: 0,
    graded: 0,
    lateCount: 0,
    targeted: 0,
  };
  for (const bucket of statusBuckets) {
    const count = bucket._count._all;
    if (bucket.status === "DRAFT") stats.drafts += count;
    if (bucket.status === "SUBMITTED") stats.submitted += count;
    if (bucket.status === "UNDER_REVIEW") stats.underReview += count;
    if (bucket.status === "RETURNED") stats.returned += count;
    if (bucket.status === "GRADED") stats.graded += count;
    if (bucket.status !== "DRAFT" && bucket.isLate) stats.lateCount += count;
  }
  stats.targeted = (
    await eligibleTeacherRows(row.schoolId, targetingOf(row))
  ).length;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      assignment: {
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        titleEn: row.titleEn,
        status: row.status,
        audienceMode: row.audienceMode,
        dueAt: row.dueAt,
        publishedAt: row.publishedAt,
        totalPoints: row.totalPoints,
        createdAt: row.createdAt,
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
        descriptionAr: row.descriptionAr,
        descriptionEn: row.descriptionEn,
        allowLate: row.allowLate,
        lateUntil: row.lateUntil,
        programId: row.programId,
        courseId: row.courseId,
        sectionId: row.sectionId,
        lessonId: row.lessonId,
        targetTeacherIds: parseJsonIds(row.targetTeacherIdsJson),
        targetBranchIds: parseJsonIds(row.targetBranchIdsJson),
      },
      criteria: criteria.map((criterion) => ({
        id: criterion.id,
        orderIndex: criterion.orderIndex,
        titleAr: criterion.titleAr,
        maxPoints: criterion.maxPoints,
      })),
      stats,
    },
  };
}

/** Audience options for the form — own school only, never cross-tenant. */
export async function listAudienceOptions(
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<AssignmentResult<AudienceOptions>> {
  const guard = manageGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return assignmentFail("حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const [teachers, branches] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findMany({
      where: { role: "TEACHER", schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
      select: { id: true, name: true, branchId: true, branch: { select: { nameAr: true } } },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
    }),
    db.branch.findMany({
      where: { schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
      orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      teachers: teachers.map((teacher) => ({
        id: teacher.id,
        name: teacher.name,
        branchId: teacher.branchId,
        branchName: teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
      })),
      branches: branches.map((branch) => ({ id: branch.id, name: branch.nameAr })),
    },
  };
}

/** Content-binding options — same tenant, nothing archived. */
export async function listContentOptions(
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<AssignmentResult<ContentOptions>> {
  const guard = manageGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return assignmentFail("حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const programWhere: Prisma.TrainingProgramWhereInput = {
    status: { not: "ARCHIVED" },
    ...(ctx.schoolId ? { schoolId: ctx.schoolId } : {}),
  };
  const courseWhere: Prisma.CourseWhereInput = {
    status: { not: "ARCHIVED" },
    OR: [
      { schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
      { schoolId: null, status: "PUBLISHED" },
    ],
  };

  const [programs, courses] = await Promise.all([
    db.trainingProgram.findMany({
      where: programWhere,
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
      orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
    }),
    db.course.findMany({
      where: courseWhere,
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true },
      orderBy: { titleAr: "asc" },
    }),
  ]);

  const courseIds = courses.map((course) => course.id);
  const [sections, lessons] = courseIds.length
    ? await Promise.all([
        db.courseSection.findMany({
          where: { courseId: { in: courseIds } },
          select: { id: true, titleAr: true, courseId: true },
          orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
        }),
        db.courseLesson.findMany({
          where: { section: { courseId: { in: courseIds } } },
          select: { id: true, titleAr: true, sectionId: true },
          orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
        }),
      ])
    : [[], []];

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      programs: programs.map((program) => ({ id: program.id, name: program.nameAr })),
      courses,
      sections: sections.map((section) => ({
        id: section.id,
        titleAr: section.titleAr,
        courseId: section.courseId,
      })),
      lessons: lessons.map((lesson) => ({
        id: lesson.id,
        titleAr: lesson.titleAr,
        sectionId: lesson.sectionId,
      })),
    },
  };
}
