import { SignJWT, jwtVerify } from "jose";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Session token (stateless JWT in an httpOnly cookie).                 */
/*                                                                      */
/* The token carries ONLY the user id and the account's tokenVersion —  */
/* role, activation and verification state are ALWAYS re-read from the  */
/* database on every request (src/lib/auth/session.ts), so revoking or  */
/* deactivating an account takes effect immediately.                    */
/*                                                                      */
/* This module is edge-safe: it uses `jose` (WebCrypto) and touches no  */
/* Node-only or next/headers APIs, so the middleware can verify tokens  */
/* without pulling the database layer into the edge runtime.            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const SESSION_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7; // 7 days

/** Cookie name — defined here (edge-safe) so middleware and session.ts share it. */
export const SESSION_COOKIE = "mq_session";

export interface SessionClaims {
  /** User id. */
  sub: string;
  /** tokenVersion at sign time — mismatch invalidates the session. */
  tv: number;
}

function sessionSecret(): Uint8Array {
  const secret = process.env.AUTH_SECRET;
  if (!secret || secret.length < 32) {
    throw new Error(
      "AUTH_SECRET is missing or too short — set a 32+ char random value in .env"
    );
  }
  return new TextEncoder().encode(secret);
}

export async function createSessionToken(
  claims: SessionClaims,
  expiresAt: Date = new Date(Date.now() + SESSION_TTL_SECONDS * 1000)
): Promise<string> {
  return new SignJWT({ tv: claims.tv })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
    .setSubject(claims.sub)
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime(expiresAt)
    .sign(sessionSecret());
}

/**
 * Verify a session token and return its claims, or null for ANY failure
 * (missing token, bad signature, expiry, missing/short AUTH_SECRET).
 * Never throws — callers treat null as "not signed in".
 */
export async function verifySessionToken(
  token: string | undefined | null
): Promise<SessionClaims | null> {
  if (!token) return null;
  try {
    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, sessionSecret(), {
      algorithms: ["HS256"],
    });
    if (!payload.sub || typeof payload.tv !== "number") return null;
    return { sub: payload.sub, tv: payload.tv };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — account-security token flows.
 *
 * Contract (matches the schema comments, prisma/schema.prisma):
 *  - Raw tokens live ONLY inside the emailed URL. The database stores a
 *    SHA-256 hash (hash-at-rest), so a database leak cannot be replayed
 *    against the public endpoints.
 *  - Tokens are single-use (usedAt) and expiring (verification 24h,
 *    reset 1h).
 *  - Consuming a reset token bumps tokenVersion → every existing session
 *    JWT becomes invalid immediately.
 *  - Security emails are attempted IMMEDIATELY and never persisted with
 *    their token payload (see lib/notifications/emails.ts).
 *  - Password-reset requests NEVER reveal whether the email exists.
 */

import { createHash, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { hashPassword } from "@/lib/auth/password";
import { appPublicOrigin } from "@/config/notifications";
import { sendSecurityEmailNow } from "@/lib/notifications/emails";
import { formatEmailDate } from "@/lib/integrations/email/templates";
import { notify } from "@/lib/notifications/service";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/security/rate-limit";

const VERIFICATION_TOKEN_HOURS = 24;
const RESET_TOKEN_HOURS = 1;
const RAW_TOKEN_BYTES = 32;

function hashToken(raw: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(raw).digest("hex");
}

function generateRawToken(): string {
  return randomBytes(RAW_TOKEN_BYTES).toString("base64url");
}

/** Builds an absolute action URL or null when the deployment has no origin. */
export function absoluteActionUrl(path: string): string | null {
  const origin = appPublicOrigin();
  if (!origin) return null;
  if (!path.startsWith("/")) return null;
  return `${origin}${path}`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Email verification → account activation                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CreatedTokenResult {
  ok: boolean;
  /** Raw token (return value ONLY — never logged, never stored). */
  token?: string;
  expiresAt?: Date;
  /** null when APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN is unset — callers must report honestly. */
  actionUrl?: string | null;
}

export async function createEmailVerificationToken(userId: string): Promise<CreatedTokenResult> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId }, select: { id: true } });
  if (!user) return { ok: false };

  // Keep at most one live token per purpose — replacing the old one
  // prevents token pile-up and makes "the newest email wins".
  await db.emailVerificationToken.deleteMany({
    where: { userId, usedAt: null },
  });

  const token = generateRawToken();
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + VERIFICATION_TOKEN_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  await db.emailVerificationToken.create({
    data: { userId, tokenHash: hashToken(token), expiresAt },
  });
  return { ok: true, token, expiresAt, actionUrl: absoluteActionUrl(`/account/verify-email?token=${token}`) };
}

export type ConsumeTokenFailure = "INVALID" | "EXPIRED" | "USED";

export async function consumeEmailVerificationToken(
  rawToken: string,
): Promise<
  | { ok: true; user: { id: string; name: string; email: string; schoolId: string | null; role: string }; alreadyVerified: boolean }
  | { ok: false; reason: ConsumeTokenFailure }
> {
  if (!rawToken || rawToken.length < 20 || rawToken.length > 200) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID" };
  }
  const record = await db.emailVerificationToken.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash: hashToken(rawToken) },
    select: { id: true, userId: true, expiresAt: true, usedAt: true },
  });
  if (!record) return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID" };
  if (record.usedAt) return { ok: false, reason: "USED" };
  if (record.expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) return { ok: false, reason: "EXPIRED" };

  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: record.userId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, schoolId: true, role: true, isActive: true, emailVerifiedAt: true },
  });
  if (!user || !user.isActive) return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID" };

  const alreadyVerified = user.emailVerifiedAt !== null;

  // Mark used + set verification timestamp atomically.
  await db.$transaction([
    db.emailVerificationToken.update({
      where: { id: record.id },
      data: { usedAt: new Date() },
    }),
    ...(alreadyVerified
      ? []
      : [db.user.update({
          where: { id: user.id },
          data: { emailVerifiedAt: new Date() },
        })]),
  ]);

  // Activation event → in-app notification (+ queued welcome email for
  // the ACCOUNT category, which is never preference-gated).
  if (!alreadyVerified) {
    await notify({
      userId: user.id,
      type: "ACCOUNT_ACTIVATED",
      titleAr: "تم تفعيل حسابك بنجاح",
      bodyAr: "تم تأكيد بريدك الإلكتروني وتفعيل حسابك داخل المنصة. يمكنك الآن متابعة لوحتك التدريبية.",
      resourceType: "User",
      resourceId: user.id,
      destinationUrl: "/dashboard",
      eventId: `account-activated:${user.id}`,
      email: true,
    });
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    user: { id: user.id, name: user.name, email: user.email, schoolId: user.schoolId, role: user.role },
    alreadyVerified,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Password reset                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function createPasswordResetToken(userId: string): Promise<CreatedTokenResult> {
  await db.passwordResetToken.deleteMany({ where: { userId, usedAt: null } });
  const token = generateRawToken();
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + RESET_TOKEN_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  await db.passwordResetToken.create({
    data: { userId, tokenHash: hashToken(token), expiresAt },
  });
  return { ok: true, token, expiresAt, actionUrl: absoluteActionUrl(`/account/reset-password?token=${token}`) };
}

export interface PasswordResetRequestOutcome {
  /** Always true from the caller's perspective (anti-enumeration). */
  accepted: true;
  /** Global, non-sensitive deployment fact — safe to display. */
  emailConfigured: boolean;
  emailSent: boolean;
  /** True when this request was suppressed by the per-email limiter. */
  rateLimited?: boolean;
  note?: string;
}

/**
 * Phase 12 — per-email flood control for "forgot password".
 * An attacker must not be able to mail-bomb arbitrary addresses through
 * this public flow. Limits are deliberately low (3 / 15 min per email);
 * a blocked request returns the SAME anti-enumeration shape so the
 * response never becomes an account-existence oracle.
 */
const RESET_REQUEST_LIMIT = 3;
const RESET_REQUEST_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * Handles a "forgot password" request. The outcome is IDENTICAL for
 * existing and non-existing emails — no account enumeration.
 */
export async function requestPasswordReset(rawEmail: string): Promise<PasswordResetRequestOutcome> {
  const email = rawEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!email || !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) {
    return { accepted: true, emailConfigured: false, emailSent: false, note: "INVALID_INPUT" };
  }

  // Rate limit BEFORE any DB lookup so the limiter applies uniformly and
  // cannot be used to probe which emails exist (identical outcome either way).
  const limiter = checkRateLimit(
    "password-reset-request",
    email,
    RESET_REQUEST_LIMIT,
    RESET_REQUEST_WINDOW_MS
  );
  if (!limiter.allowed) {
    console.warn(
      `[security] password-reset request rate-limited for an address (retry in ${limiter.retryAfterSeconds}s)`
    );
    return {
      accepted: true,
      emailConfigured: false,
      emailSent: false,
      rateLimited: true,
      note: "RATE_LIMITED",
    };
  }

  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email },
    select: { id: true, name: true, isActive: true, schoolId: true },
  });

  if (!user || !user.isActive) {
    return { accepted: true, emailConfigured: false, emailSent: false };
  }

  const created = await createPasswordResetToken(user.id);
  if (!created.ok || !created.token) {
    return { accepted: true, emailConfigured: false, emailSent: false };
  }
  if (!created.actionUrl) {
    // Deployment without APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN — an absolute reset link cannot
    // be built, so no misleading email is sent. Recorded as NOT_CONFIGURED.
    return {
      accepted: true,
      emailConfigured: false,
      emailSent: false,
      note: "APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN_MISSING",
    };
  }

  const outcome = await sendSecurityEmailNow({
    toEmail: email,
    userId: user.id,
    schoolId: user.schoolId,
    templateKey: "password-reset",
    params: {
      recipientName: user.name,
      resetUrl: created.actionUrl,
    },
  });

  if (outcome.ok) return { accepted: true, emailConfigured: true, emailSent: true };
  if ("configured" in outcome) {
    return { accepted: true, emailConfigured: false, emailSent: false, note: "EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED" };
  }
  return {
    accepted: true,
    emailConfigured: true,
    emailSent: false,
    note: `EMAIL_ERROR:${outcome.errorCategory}`,
  };
}

export type ResetPasswordResult =
  | { ok: true; userId: string }
  | { ok: false; reason: ConsumeTokenFailure | "WEAK_PASSWORD" };

/** Minimum password policy (kept simple and identical everywhere). */
export function validateNewPassword(password: string): boolean {
  return typeof password === "string" && password.length >= 8 && password.length <= 72;
}

export async function consumePasswordResetToken(
  rawToken: string,
  newPassword: string,
): Promise<ResetPasswordResult> {
  if (!validateNewPassword(newPassword)) return { ok: false, reason: "WEAK_PASSWORD" };

  const record = await db.passwordResetToken.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash: hashToken(rawToken) },
    select: { id: true, userId: true, expiresAt: true, usedAt: true },
  });
  if (!record) return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID" };
  if (record.usedAt) return { ok: false, reason: "USED" };
  if (record.expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) return { ok: false, reason: "EXPIRED" };

  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: record.userId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, isActive: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!user || !user.isActive) return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID" };

  const passwordHash = await hashPassword(newPassword);
  const now = new Date();

  // Atomic: consume token + rotate password + invalidate all sessions.
  await db.$transaction([
    db.passwordResetToken.update({ where: { id: record.id }, data: { usedAt: now } }),
    db.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { passwordHash, tokenVersion: { increment: 1 } },
    }),
  ]);

  // Security notice — in-app (always) + immediate email (never gated).
  await notify({
    userId: user.id,
    type: "PASSWORD_CHANGED",
    titleAr: "تم تغيير كلمة مرور حسابك",
    bodyAr: `تم تغيير كلمة مرور حسابك بتاريخ ${formatEmailDate(now)}، وتم إنهاء جميع الجلسات النشطة حفاظًا على الأمان. إن لم تقم أنت بهذا التغيير فتواصل مع إدارة المدرسة فورًا.`,
    resourceType: "User",
    resourceId: user.id,
    destinationUrl: "/notifications/preferences",
    eventId: `password-changed:${record.id}`,
    email: false, // email part is sent immediately below (token-free).
  }).catch(() => null);
  await sendSecurityEmailNow({
    toEmail: user.email,
    userId: user.id,
    schoolId: user.schoolId,
    templateKey: "password-changed",
    params: { recipientName: user.name, dateText: formatEmailDate(now) },
  }).catch(() => null);

  return { ok: true, userId: user.id };
}

/** Constant-time comparison helper (used by the cron endpoint). */
export function safeSecretEquals(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const bufA = createHash("sha256").update(a).digest();
  const bufB = createHash("sha256").update(b).digest();
  return timingSafeEqual(bufA, bufB);
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { canAdministerSchool } from "@/lib/auth/roles";
import { defaultBranding } from "@/config/branding";
import type { PlatformBranding } from "@/lib/types";
import {
  adjustLightness,
  buildBrandRamp,
  hexToHsl,
  hslToHex,
  normalizeHex,
  readableForeground,
  softTint,
} from "@/lib/branding/colors";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Dynamic multi-school branding — server resolution layer.             */
/*                                                                      */
/* Identity is split in two:                                            */
/*   • Platform identity: «منارة — مكتب التطوير التربوي» (constant).    */
/*   • School identity:    «منارة {اسم المدرسة}» + logo + palette,      */
/*     loaded from the School row of the authenticated user, or from    */
/*     the school context of a public page (login ?school=, register    */
/*     /register/{slug}).                                               */
/*                                                                      */
/* Colors reach the UI as CSS variables on a wrapper element; the       */
/* design system already resolves every brand-* utility through those   */
/* variables, so shared components never hardcode a school color.       */
/* Server components under the app render this module ONLY — never      */
/* import it from a client component (db access).                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Display fallback for schools without a custom tagline. */
export const SCHOOL_DEFAULT_SUBTITLE = "منصة التنمية المهنية للمعلمين";

/** The palette used by «restore defaults» — the platform blue family. */
export const PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLORS = {
  primary: "#1D5BD6",
  secondary: "#2AA5C0",
  accent: "#E8A13A",
  neutral: "#1E2A4A",
} as const;

/** Branding fields of a school — the ONLY columns this feature reads. */
export interface SchoolBrandingRecord {
  id: string;
  nameAr: string;
  slug: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  logoUrl: string | null;
  brandColor: string;
  brandColorSecondary: string | null;
  brandColorAccent: string | null;
  brandColorNeutral: string | null;
  brandTagline: string | null;
}

export interface ResolvedBranding {
  /** "school" when a real school context was resolved, else platform. */
  scope: "platform" | "school";
  school: { id: string; name: string; slug: string } | null;
  /** Ready-to-pass branding for existing shell components. */
  branding: PlatformBranding;
  /** CSS variables for a wrapper element (empty for platform scope). */
  cssVars: Record<string, string>;
  /** Fully resolved palette (after derivation) — for settings UIs. */
  colors: { primary: string; secondary: string; accent: string; neutral: string };
  tagline: string | null;
}

/** Defensively keep the deep-surface (sidebar) color dark enough for
 * the light sidebar text that the design system renders on it. */
function ensureDarkSurface(hex: string): string {
  const { h, s, l } = hexToHsl(hex);
  if (l <= 38) return normalizeHex(hex) ?? PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLORS.neutral;
  return hslToHex(h, s, Math.min(l, 30));
}

/** Build the resolved branding from raw school columns (pure). */
export function resolveSchoolBranding(
  school: SchoolBrandingRecord | null
): ResolvedBranding {
  if (!school) {
    return {
      scope: "platform",
      school: null,
      branding: defaultBranding,
      cssVars: {},
      colors: { ...PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLORS },
      tagline: null,
    };
  }

  const primary = normalizeHex(school.brandColor) ?? PLATFORM_DEFAULT_COLORS.primary;
  const secondary =
    normalizeHex(school.brandColorSecondary) ?? adjustLightness(hslToHex(hexToHsl(primary).h + 32, 55, 52), 0);
  const accent =
    normalizeHex(school.brandColorAccent) ?? hslToHex(hexToHsl(primary).h + 180, 62, 55);
  const neutral = ensureDarkSurface(
    normalizeHex(school.brandColorNeutral) ?? hslToHex(hexToHsl(primary).h, hexToHsl(primary).s * 0.55, 22)
  );

  const ramp = buildBrandRamp(primary);
  const productName = `منارة ${school.nameAr}`.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const subtitle = school.brandTagline?.trim() || SCHOOL_DEFAULT_SUBTITLE;

  const branding: PlatformBranding = {
    productName,
    subtitle,
    shortName: "منارة",
    logoUrl: school.logoUrl ?? undefined,
    currentSchool: {
      id: school.id,
      name: school.nameAr,
      logoUrl: school.logoUrl ?? undefined,
      branches: [],
      stages: [],
    },
  };

  const cssVars: Record<string, string> = {
    "--brand-50": ramp["50"],
    "--brand-100": ramp["100"],
    "--brand-200": ramp["200"],
    "--brand-300": ramp["300"],
    "--brand-500": ramp["500"],
    "--brand-600": ramp["600"],
    "--brand-700": ramp["700"],
    "--brand-800": ramp["800"],
    "--brand-900": ramp["900"],
    "--brand-cyan": secondary,
    "--brand-cyan-soft": softTint(secondary),
    "--primary": primary,
    "--primary-foreground": readableForeground(primary),
    "--ring": ramp["500"],
    "--school-accent": accent,
    "--school-neutral": neutral,
    "--sidebar": neutral,
    "--sidebar-accent": adjustLightness(neutral, 8),
    "--sidebar-border": adjustLightness(neutral, 6),
    "--sidebar-primary": secondary,
    "--sidebar-ring": ramp["500"],
  };

  return {
    scope: "school",
    school: { id: school.id, name: school.nameAr, slug: school.slug },
    branding,
    cssVars,
    colors: { primary, secondary, accent, neutral },
    tagline: school.brandTagline,
  };
}

const BRANDING_SELECT = {
  id: true,
  nameAr: true,
  slug: true,
  isActive: true,
  logoUrl: true,
  brandColor: true,
  brandColorSecondary: true,
  brandColorAccent: true,
  brandColorNeutral: true,
  brandTagline: true,
} as const;

/** Active-school lookup by id — public branding fields only. */
export async function getActiveSchoolBrandingById(
  id: string | null | undefined
): Promise<ResolvedBranding> {
  if (!id) return resolveSchoolBranding(null);
  try {
    const school = await db.school.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: BRANDING_SELECT,
    });
    if (!school || !school.isActive) return resolveSchoolBranding(null);
    return resolveSchoolBranding(school);
  } catch {
    return resolveSchoolBranding(null);
  }
}

/** Active-school lookup by slug — used by /register/{slug}. */
export async function getActiveSchoolBrandingBySlug(
  slug: string | null | undefined
): Promise<ResolvedBranding> {
  if (!slug) return resolveSchoolBranding(null);
  try {
    const school = await db.school.findUnique({
      where: { slug },
      select: BRANDING_SELECT,
    });
    if (!school || !school.isActive) return resolveSchoolBranding(null);
    return resolveSchoolBranding(school);
  } catch {
    return resolveSchoolBranding(null);
  }
}

/**
 * Public-page resolution (login ?school=): accepts a slug OR an id.
 * Only public branding data is ever returned, so exposing it on a URL
 * cannot leak tenant data or bypass isolation.
 */
export async function resolvePublicBranding(
  schoolParam: string | null | undefined
): Promise<ResolvedBranding> {
  const value = (schoolParam ?? "").trim().slice(0, 120);
  if (!value) return resolveSchoolBranding(null);
  const bySlug = await getActiveSchoolBrandingBySlug(value);
  if (bySlug.scope === "school") return bySlug;
  return getActiveSchoolBrandingById(value);
}

/**
 * Branding for the whole app shell: the signed-in user's school wins;
 * anonymous or platform-level sessions get the platform identity.
 */
export async function resolveViewerBranding(user: {
  schoolId: string | null;
} | null): Promise<ResolvedBranding> {
  return getActiveSchoolBrandingById(user?.schoolId ?? null);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Authorization                                                        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type BrandingTargetResolution =
  | { ok: true; schoolId: string | null }
  | { ok: false; code: "FORBIDDEN" | "NO_SCHOOL" | "TENANT_MISMATCH" };

/**
 * Which school may the caller manage branding for?
 *  - SUPER_ADMIN: any school (requested id, or their own when set).
 *  - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: strictly their own school — a
 *    requested id for a different tenant is a hard rejection.
 *  - everyone else: rejected (fail-closed).
 * The result is resolved from the SESSION only; client input can never
 * widen the tenant scope.
 */
export function resolveManageableSchoolId(
  user: { role: string; schoolId: string | null } | null,
  requestedSchoolId?: string | null
): BrandingTargetResolution {
  if (!user || !canAdministerSchool(user.role)) {
    return { ok: false, code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const requested = (requestedSchoolId ?? "").trim() || null;

  if (user.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return { ok: true, schoolId: requested ?? user.schoolId ?? null };
  }
  if (!user.schoolId) return { ok: false, code: "NO_SCHOOL" };
  if (requested && requested !== user.schoolId) {
    return { ok: false, code: "TENANT_MISMATCH" };
  }
  return { ok: true, schoolId: user.schoolId };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Pure color utilities for dynamic school branding.                    */
/*                                                                      */
/* ZERO dependencies and ZERO server imports — this module is imported  */
/* by server code (src/lib/branding.ts) AND by client components        */
/* (the branding manager) so both sides produce identical ramps.        */
/*                                                                      */
/* The design system in globals.css resolves every `brand-*` Tailwind   */
/* utility through runtime CSS variables (--brand-50 … --brand-900,     */
/* --brand-cyan, --brand-cyan-soft). We generate those variables from   */
/* ONE primary hex color, following the lightness/saturation profile    */
/* of the hand-tuned platform palette.                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type BrandRampKey = "50" | "100" | "200" | "300" | "500" | "600" | "700" | "800" | "900";

export interface Hsl {
  h: number; // 0..360
  s: number; // 0..100
  l: number; // 0..100
}

/** Normalize "#abc" / "#aabbcc" / "aabbcc" to "#AABBCC", or null. */
export function normalizeHex(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  let v = value.trim().replace(/^#/, "");
  if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{3}$/.test(v)) {
    v = v
      .split("")
      .map((c) => c + c)
      .join("");
  }
  if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(v)) return null;
  return `#${v.toUpperCase()}`;
}

export function hexToHsl(hex: string): Hsl {
  const norm = normalizeHex(hex) ?? "#000000";
  const r = parseInt(norm.slice(1, 3), 16) / 255;
  const g = parseInt(norm.slice(3, 5), 16) / 255;
  const b = parseInt(norm.slice(5, 7), 16) / 255;

  const max = Math.max(r, g, b);
  const min = Math.min(r, g, b);
  const l = (max + min) / 2;
  let h = 0;
  let s = 0;

  if (max !== min) {
    const d = max - min;
    s = l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min);
    switch (max) {
      case r:
        h = ((g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0)) * 60;
        break;
      case g:
        h = ((b - r) / d + 2) * 60;
        break;
      default:
        h = ((r - g) / d + 4) * 60;
    }
  }
  return { h, s: s * 100, l: l * 100 };
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
}

function hueToRgb(p: number, q: number, t: number): number {
  let tt = t;
  if (tt < 0) tt += 1;
  if (tt > 1) tt -= 1;
  if (tt < 1 / 6) return p + (q - p) * 6 * tt;
  if (tt < 1 / 2) return q;
  if (tt < 2 / 3) return p + (q - p) * (2 / 3 - tt) * 6;
  return p;
}

export function hslToHex(h: number, s: number, l: number): string {
  const hh = ((h % 360) + 360) % 360;
  const ss = clamp(s, 0, 100) / 100;
  const ll = clamp(l, 0, 100) / 100;

  if (ss === 0) {
    const gray = Math.round(ll * 255);
    const channel = gray.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
    return `#${channel}${channel}${channel}`.toUpperCase();
  }

  const q = ll < 0.5 ? ll * (1 + ss) : ll + ss - ll * ss;
  const p = 2 * ll - q;
  const r = Math.round(hueToRgb(p, q, hh / 360 + 1 / 3) * 255);
  const g = Math.round(hueToRgb(p, q, hh / 360) * 255);
  const b = Math.round(hueToRgb(p, q, hh / 360 - 1 / 3) * 255);
  return (
    "#" +
    [r, g, b]
      .map((c) => clamp(c, 0, 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join("")
      .toUpperCase()
  );
}

/**
 * The full brand ramp from a single primary hex, following the
 * lightness profile of the hand-tuned platform tokens in globals.css
 * (50≈96.5%, 100≈92.5%, 200≈89.5%, 300≈83%, 500≈60%, 600=primary,
 * 700≈47%, 800≈39.5%, 900≈33%) with saturation tapering towards the
 * extremes exactly like the oklch chroma taper there.
 */
export function buildBrandRamp(primaryHex: string): Record<BrandRampKey, string> {
  const { h, s } = hexToHsl(primaryHex);
  const steps: Array<[BrandRampKey, number | null, number]> = [
    ["50", 96.5, 0.3],
    ["100", 92.5, 0.55],
    ["200", 89.5, 0.78],
    ["300", 83, 0.9],
    ["500", 60, 1.0],
    ["600", null, 1.0], // the primary itself
    ["700", 47, 0.97],
    ["800", 39.5, 0.85],
    ["900", 33, 0.62],
  ];
  const ramp = {} as Record<BrandRampKey, string>;
  for (const [key, lightness, satFactor] of steps) {
    ramp[key] =
      key === "600"
        ? normalizeHex(primaryHex) ?? hslToHex(h, s, 53.5)
        : hslToHex(h, clamp(s * satFactor, 0, 100), lightness ?? 53.5);
  }
  return ramp;
}

/** A soft surface tint for any supporting color (mirrors brand-cyan-soft). */
export function softTint(hex: string): string {
  const { h, s } = hexToHsl(hex);
  return hslToHex(h, clamp(s * 0.35, 0, 100), 95.5);
}

/** Lighten (positive) / darken (negative) by lightness percentage points. */
export function adjustLightness(hex: string, delta: number): string {
  const { h, s, l } = hexToHsl(hex);
  return hslToHex(h, s, clamp(l + delta, 0, 100));
}

/** Relative luminance (WCAG). */
export function relativeLuminance(hex: string): number {
  const norm = normalizeHex(hex) ?? "#000000";
  const channel = (v: number) => {
    const c = v / 255;
    return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
  };
  return (
    0.2126 * channel(parseInt(norm.slice(1, 3), 16)) +
    0.7152 * channel(parseInt(norm.slice(3, 5), 16)) +
    0.0722 * channel(parseInt(norm.slice(5, 7), 16))
  );
}

/** Contrast ratio (WCAG) between two hex colors. */
export function contrastRatio(a: string, b: string): number {
  const la = relativeLuminance(a);
  const lb = relativeLuminance(b);
  const lighter = Math.max(la, lb);
  const darker = Math.min(la, lb);
  return (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05);
}

/** Readable foreground (white or near-black ink) for a background hex. */
export function readableForeground(hex: string): string {
  return contrastRatio(hex, "#FFFFFF") >= 4.5 ? "#FFFFFF" : "#0F172A";
}

/** Hue distance (0..180) between two hex colors. */
export function hueDistance(a: string, b: string): number {
  const da = hexToHsl(a).h;
  const db = hexToHsl(b).h;
  const diff = Math.abs(da - db) % 360;
  return diff > 180 ? 360 - diff : diff;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Logo dominant-color extraction (client-side canvas helpers).         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface RgbPixel {
  r: number;
  g: number;
  b: number;
}

/** Quantize a pixel into a 4-bit-per-channel bucket key. */
export function quantizeKey({ r, g, b }: RgbPixel): string {
  const key = (v: number) => Math.round(v / 17); // 0..15
  return `${key(r)}-${key(g)}-${key(b)}`;
}

export interface ColorCandidate {
  hex: string;
  count: number;
  hsl: Hsl;
}

/**
 * Reduce sampled pixels into ranked color candidates. Transparent and
 * near-white/near-black background pixels are heavily down-weighted so
 * logo artwork dominates over its background.
 */
export function rankColors(pixels: RgbPixel[]): ColorCandidate[] {
  const buckets = new Map<string, { r: number; g: number; b: number; count: number }>();
  for (const p of pixels) {
    const key = quantizeKey(p);
    const bucket = buckets.get(key);
    if (bucket) {
      bucket.r += p.r;
      bucket.g += p.g;
      bucket.b += p.b;
      bucket.count += 1;
    } else {
      buckets.set(key, { r: p.r, g: p.g, b: p.b, count: 1 });
    }
  }

  const candidates: ColorCandidate[] = [];
  for (const bucket of buckets.values()) {
    const rgb = {
      r: Math.round(bucket.r / bucket.count),
      g: Math.round(bucket.g / bucket.count),
      b: Math.round(bucket.b / bucket.count),
    };
    const hex =
      "#" +
      [rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b]
        .map((c) => clamp(c, 0, 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join("")
        .toUpperCase();
    const hsl = hexToHsl(hex);
    // Down-weight near-white / near-black / fully gray background pixels.
    let weight = bucket.count;
    if (hsl.l >= 94 || hsl.l <= 6) weight = Math.round(weight * 0.05);
    else if (hsl.s <= 8) weight = Math.round(weight * 0.35);
    candidates.push({ hex, count: weight, hsl });
  }

  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
  return candidates;
}

/**
 * Derive a harmonious suggested palette (primary / secondary / accent /
 * neutral) from ranked logo colors. Deterministic, dependency-free.
 */
export function suggestPalette(candidates: ColorCandidate[]): {
  primary: string;
  secondary: string;
  accent: string;
  neutral: string;
} {
  const meaningful = candidates.filter((c) => c.count > 0);
  const pool = meaningful.length > 0 ? meaningful : candidates;

  // Primary: the most weighted color with real chroma (fallback: first).
  const primary =
    pool.find((c) => c.hsl.s >= 18 && c.hsl.l >= 20 && c.hsl.l <= 80)?.hex ??
    pool[0]?.hex ??
    "#1D5BD6";

  const primaryHue = hexToHsl(primary).h;

  // Secondary: a distinct hue from the primary (>= 45 degrees apart).
  const secondary =
    pool.find(
      (c) => c.hex !== primary && c.hsl.s >= 15 && hueDistance(c.hex, primary) >= 45
    )?.hex ?? hslToHex(primaryHue + 28, 55, 52);

  // Accent: the most vivid remaining hue (or a shifted derivation).
  const vivid = [...pool]
    .filter((c) => c.hex !== primary && c.hex !== secondary)
    .sort((a, b) => b.hsl.s * Math.log2(b.count + 2) - a.hsl.s * Math.log2(a.count + 2))[0];
  const accent =
    vivid && vivid.hsl.s >= 25 && hueDistance(vivid.hex, primary) >= 25
      ? vivid.hex
      : hslToHex(primaryHue + 180, 62, 55);

  // Neutral: the darkest weighted color (school "deep surface" tone).
  const dark = [...pool].sort((a, b) => a.hsl.l - b.hsl.l)[0];
  const neutral =
    dark && dark.hsl.l <= 45
      ? dark.hex
      : hslToHex(primaryHue, clamp(hexToHsl(primary).s * 0.55, 0, 100), 22);

  return {
    primary: normalizeHex(primary) ?? "#1D5BD6",
    secondary: normalizeHex(secondary) ?? "#2AA5C0",
    accent: normalizeHex(accent) ?? "#E8A13A",
    neutral: normalizeHex(neutral) ?? "#1E2A4A",
  };
}

/**
 * Phase 8 — pure access predicates and tenant scoping for certificates
 * and professional growth.
 *
 * No DB access lives here — every rule is unit-testable and the service
 * layer composes these helpers. The actor is ALWAYS built server-side
 * from the session user after an explicit role check; client payloads
 * can never widen it.
 *
 * Role capability matrix (fixed by the product, enforced server-side):
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER — issue/revoke/list within OWN school,
 *                                growth roster for the school.
 *   SCHOOL_MANAGER             — the same powers as the office manager,
 *                                inside OWN school only (structural
 *                                fence in certificateScopeError).
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     — view certificates + growth of ASSIGNED
 *                                teachers. Never issues/revokes.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY         — read-only certificates/growth within
 *                                granted school/branch scope.
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                — platform-wide READ-ONLY stats and
 *                                records. Never issues/revokes.
 *   TEACHER                    — own certificates (view/print) and own
 *                                growth only. NEVER verification.
 */
import { certificateFail, type CertificateErrorCode, type CertificateResult } from "@/lib/validation/certificates";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Actor identity (back-office; mirrors the Phase 7 AssignmentActor)    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CertificateActor {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  role:
    | "SUPER_ADMIN"
    | "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
    | "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
    | "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
    | "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY";
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/**
 * Any authenticated viewer projection used by read paths that also
 * serve teachers (own-certificate view, own growth). Built from the
 * session — never from a payload.
 */
export interface CertificateViewer {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Role capabilities                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Issuance is school-office work — SUPER_ADMIN is intentionally
 * excluded. SCHOOL_MANAGER signs its own school's certificates (the
 * signatory snapshot is resolved server-side at issuance time).
 */
export function canIssueCertificates(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER";
}

/** Revocation follows the same rule as issuance (audit preserved). */
export function canRevokeCertificates(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER";
}

/** Verification: authorized NON-teacher roles only (teachers never verify). */
export function canVerifyCertificates(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
  );
}

/** Certificate management list pages (office workspace). */
export function canManageCertificateWorkspace(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER";
}

/**
 * Read access to certificate RECORDS beyond ownership. Teachers are
 * handled separately (owner-only); SUPER_ADMIN may read records
 * platform-wide but never mutate.
 */
export function canReadCertificateRecords(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" ||
    role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
  );
}

/** Growth roster pages for back-office roles (Super Admin gets aggregates). */
export function canViewGrowthRoster(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Failure helpers                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Certificates are always school-owned; a null/missing school context
 * can never match (this blocks SUPER_ADMIN operational access too, and
 * structurally confines SCHOOL_MANAGER to its own school).
 */
export function certificateScopeError(
  ctx: CertificateActor,
  schoolId: string | null
): CertificateResult<never> | null {
  if (!schoolId || ctx.schoolId !== schoolId) {
    return certificateFail(
      "لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى هذه الشهادة — النطاق المدرسي مختلف",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export function issueGuard(ctx: CertificateActor): CertificateResult<never> | null {
  if (!canIssueCertificates(ctx.role)) {
    return certificateFail(
      "إصدار الشهادات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail(
      "إصدار الشهادات يتطلب نطاقًا مدرسيًا محددًا",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export function verifyGuard(ctx: CertificateActor): CertificateResult<never> | null {
  if (!canVerifyCertificates(ctx.role)) {
    return certificateFail(
      "التحقق من الشهادات متاح للأدوار الإدارية المعتمدة فقط — لا يشمل المعلمين",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export type { CertificateErrorCode };

import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

import {
  CERT_NUMBER_PREFIX,
  CERT_NUMBER_RANDOM_LENGTH,
  CERTIFICATE_CODE_ALPHABET,
  IDENTIFIER_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS,
  PLATFORM_NAME_AR,
} from "@/config/certificates";
import { resolveSchoolSignatory } from "@/lib/certificates/signatory";
import { notifyCertificateIssued } from "@/lib/notifications/hooks";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 1 — automatic course-completion certificate.                  */
/*                                                                     */
/* The original HTML platform issued the certificate the moment the    */
/* teacher passed the course test (submitTest -> showCertificate).     */
/* This module restores that behavior on real data WITHOUT weakening   */
/* any Phase 8 rule:                                                   */
/*                                                                     */
/*   - the learner identity is the SESSION user propagated by the      */
/*     completion engine — never a client payload;                     */
/*   - eligibility is re-verified here from persisted rows (active     */
/*     TEACHER of a school + real enrollment + every published course  */
/*     assessment passed) even though maybeCompleteCourse() has just   */
/*     checked the same rules — defense in depth;                      */
/*   - the school-signatory snapshot (batch 2-b) is honored: no active */
/*     SCHOOL_MANAGER -> NO certificate is fabricated; the completion  */
/*     stands and the certificate can be issued manually later;        */
/*   - identifiers use the same Crockford alphabet, the same MQ-YYYY   */
/*     serial and the same unique-collision retry budget;              */
/*   - the result is linked to the CourseCompletion row so the         */
/*     learning page and notifications can deep-link to the sheet.     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const CERT_TITLE_PREFIX = "شهادة إتمام دورة";
const CERT_DESCRIPTION =
  `أتمّ المعلم متطلبات الدورة التدريبية كاملة (الدروس والتقييمات) وفق ` +
  `سجلات التعلّم في منصة ${PLATFORM_NAME_AR} — إصدار آلي عند استيفاء المتطلبات.`;
/** Issuing-authority snapshot for system-issued certificates. */
const AUTO_ISSUER_LABEL = "إصدار آلي — استيفاء متطلبات الدورة";

export interface CompletionCertificateOutcome {
  /** The issued (or pre-existing) certificate id — null when blocked. */
  certificateId: string | null;
  created: boolean;
  /** Why nothing was issued (null when a certificate exists). */
  blockedReason: string | null;
}

function randomCode(length: number): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(length);
  let out = "";
  for (let index = 0; index < length; index += 1) {
    out += CERTIFICATE_CODE_ALPHABET[bytes[index] % CERTIFICATE_CODE_ALPHABET.length];
  }
  return out;
}

function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === "P2002"
  );
}

export interface AutoIssueInput {
  teacherId: string;
  courseId: string;
  /** The completion row that triggered this issuance (audit note). */
  completionId: string;
}

/**
 * Issue the completion certificate for a finished course enrollment.
 * NEVER throws for business reasons — a blocked issuance returns a
 * reason so the learning journey continues either way.
 */
export async function issueCourseCompletionCertificate(
  input: AutoIssueInput
): Promise<CompletionCertificateOutcome> {
  try {
    const [teacher, course] = await Promise.all([
      db.user.findUnique({
        where: { id: input.teacherId },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          role: true,
          isActive: true,
          schoolId: true,
        },
      }),
      db.course.findUnique({
        where: { id: input.courseId },
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          titleEn: true,
          status: true,
          schoolId: true,
          assessments: {
            where: { status: "PUBLISHED" },
            select: {
              id: true,
              titleAr: true,
              passingScore: true,
              maxScore: true,
            },
          },
        },
      }),
    ]);

    if (!teacher || !course) {
      return {
        certificateId: null,
        created: false,
        blockedReason: "CONTENT_MISSING",
      };
    }

    // Hard identity rules — exactly the manual issuance rules.
    if (teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || !teacher.isActive || !teacher.schoolId) {
      return {
        certificateId: null,
        created: false,
        blockedReason: "TEACHER_INVALID",
      };
    }

    const [enrollment, attempts] = await Promise.all([
      db.courseEnrollment.findFirst({
        where: { courseId: course.id, userId: teacher.id },
        select: { id: true },
      }),
      db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
        where: {
          userId: teacher.id,
          assessmentId: {
            in: course.assessments.map((assessment) => assessment.id),
          },
        },
        select: { assessmentId: true, status: true, passed: true, percentage: true },
      }),
    ]);
    if (!enrollment) {
      return {
        certificateId: null,
        created: false,
        blockedReason: "ENROLLMENT_MISSING",
      };
    }
    for (const assessment of course.assessments) {
      const passed = attempts.some(
        (attempt) =>
          attempt.assessmentId === assessment.id &&
          (attempt.status === "PASSED" || attempt.passed === true)
      );
      if (!passed) {
        return {
          certificateId: null,
          created: false,
          blockedReason: "ASSESSMENT_NOT_PASSED",
        };
      }
    }

    // Duplicate (per teacher per course) — return the existing row.
    const existing = await db.certificate.findFirst({
      where: { teacherId: teacher.id, courseId: course.id },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (existing) {
      return {
        certificateId: existing.id,
        created: false,
        blockedReason: null,
      };
    }

    // Signatory snapshot — batch 2-b rule, no fallback, no fabrication.
    const signatory = await resolveSchoolSignatory(teacher.schoolId);
    if (!signatory) {
      return {
        certificateId: null,
        created: false,
        blockedReason: "SIGNATORY_MISSING",
      };
    }

    const standings = course.assessments.map((assessment) => {
      const own = attempts.filter(
        (attempt) => attempt.assessmentId === assessment.id
      );
      const passedAttempts = own.filter(
        (attempt) => attempt.status === "PASSED" || attempt.passed === true
      );
      const best = passedAttempts.reduce<number | null>(
        (bestSoFar, attempt) =>
          attempt.percentage !== null &&
          (bestSoFar === null || attempt.percentage > bestSoFar)
            ? attempt.percentage
            : bestSoFar,
        null
      );
      return {
        assessmentId: assessment.id,
        titleAr: assessment.titleAr,
        passingScore: assessment.passingScore,
        maxScore: assessment.maxScore,
        bestPercentage: best,
        passed: true,
      };
    });

    const criteriaSnapshot = JSON.stringify({
      source: "COURSE_COMPLETION",
      completionId: input.completionId,
      content: { type: "COURSE", id: course.id, title: course.titleAr },
      rules: [
        { key: "ENROLLMENT", met: true },
        { key: "LESSONS", met: true },
        { key: "ASSESSMENTS", met: true },
      ],
      assessments: standings,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    const titleAr = `${CERT_TITLE_PREFIX} «${course.titleAr}»`;
    const titleEn = course.titleEn
      ? `Certificate of Completion — ${course.titleEn}`
      : null;
    const now = new Date();

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < IDENTIFIER_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1) {
      const certificateNumber = `${CERT_NUMBER_PREFIX}-${now.getFullYear()}-${randomCode(
        CERT_NUMBER_RANDOM_LENGTH
      )}`;
      const verificationCode = randomCode(16);

      const taken = await db.certificate.findFirst({
        where: { OR: [{ certificateNumber }, { verificationCode }] },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      if (taken) continue;

      try {
        const outcome = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          const certificate = await tx.certificate.create({
            data: {
              schoolId: teacher.schoolId as string,
              teacherId: teacher.id,
              certificateNumber,
              verificationCode,
              titleAr,
              titleEn,
              descriptionAr: CERT_DESCRIPTION,
              programId: null,
              courseId: course.id,
              status: "ISSUED",
              issuedAt: now,
              expiresAt: null,
              issuedById: teacher.id,
              issuerRoleLabel: AUTO_ISSUER_LABEL,
              criteriaSnapshotJson: criteriaSnapshot,
              schoolSignatoryName: signatory.name,
              schoolSignatoryTitle: signatory.title,
            },
            select: { id: true },
          });
          await tx.certificateEvent.create({
            data: {
              certificateId: certificate.id,
              type: "ISSUED",
              actorId: teacher.id,
              actorRole: "TEACHER",
              note: `إصدار آلي عند إتمام متطلبات الدورة «${course.titleAr}»`,
            },
          });
          return certificate.id;
        });

        // Reuse the existing Phase 11 hook (preferences + email audit).
        await notifyCertificateIssued({
          teacherId: teacher.id,
          certificateId: outcome,
          titleAr,
        });

        return { certificateId: outcome, created: true, blockedReason: null };
      } catch (error) {
        if (isUniqueViolation(error)) {
          // Either an identifier collision (regenerate) or the
          // (teacherId, courseId) unique — check which.
          const duplicate = await db.certificate.findFirst({
            where: { teacherId: teacher.id, courseId: course.id },
            select: { id: true },
          });
          if (duplicate) {
            return {
              certificateId: duplicate.id,
              created: false,
              blockedReason: null,
            };
          }
          continue;
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }
    return {
      certificateId: null,
      created: false,
      blockedReason: "IDENTIFIER_EXHAUSTED",
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      certificateId: null,
      created: false,
      blockedReason: "UNKNOWN",
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Phase 8 — server-side QR rendering for certificate sheets.
 *
 * `qrcode` is the only new dependency in this phase (pure JS,
 * maintained, no native bindings) — sanctioned by the Phase 8 brief
 * for QR generation. The helper degrades gracefully: on any failure
 * the certificate falls back to printing the verification URL text.
 */
import QRCode from "qrcode";

export async function qrDataUrl(text: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await QRCode.toDataURL(text, {
      width: 240,
      margin: 1,
      errorCorrectionLevel: "M",
      color: { dark: "#0F172A", light: "#FFFFFF" },
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Batch 3 — READ-ONLY certificate listings for roles that never issue:
 *
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR — certificates of THEIR assigned teachers
 *     inside their own school (scope from TeacherSupervisorAssignment).
 *   SUPER_ADMIN — platform-wide read-only register with the school name
 *     on every row. Issuance/revocation remain manager-only: the
 *     write-capable service is untouched and no mutation lives here.
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

import { effectiveStatusOf } from "@/lib/certificates/service";

/** Matches the management page density. */
const PAGE_SIZE = 15;

/** Serializable row shared by both read paths (RSC-safe). */
export interface CertificateReadRow {
  id: string;
  certificateNumber: string;
  titleAr: string;
  teacherName: string;
  contentTitle: string | null;
  issuedAt: Date;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
  status: string;
  effectiveStatus: ReturnType<typeof effectiveStatusOf>;
  issuerName: string | null;
  schoolName?: string;
}

interface ListFilters {
  q?: string;
  status?: string;
  page?: number;
}

function buildWhere(filters: ListFilters, extra: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const where: Record<string, unknown> = { ...extra };
  const q = filters.q?.trim();
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { certificateNumber: { contains: q } },
      { titleAr: { contains: q } },
      { teacher: { name: { contains: q } } },
    ];
  }
  if (filters.status === "ISSUED" || filters.status === "REVOKED") {
    where.status = filters.status;
  }
  return where;
}

function toRow(row: {
  id: string;
  certificateNumber: string;
  titleAr: string;
  issuedAt: Date;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
  status: string;
  courseId: string | null;
  programId: string | null;
  teacher: { name: string } | null;
  course: { titleAr: string } | null;
  program: { nameAr: string } | null;
  issuedBy: { name: string } | null;
  school?: { nameAr: string } | null;
}): CertificateReadRow {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    certificateNumber: row.certificateNumber,
    titleAr: row.titleAr,
    teacherName: row.teacher?.name ?? "—",
    contentTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
    issuedAt: row.issuedAt,
    expiresAt: row.expiresAt,
    status: row.status,
    effectiveStatus: effectiveStatusOf(row),
    issuerName: row.issuedBy?.name ?? null,
    schoolName: row.school?.nameAr,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor — read-only certificates of assigned teachers             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface SupervisorCertificateResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  rows: CertificateReadRow[];
  total: number;
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
}

export async function listCertificatesForSupervisor(
  ctx: { id: string; role: string; schoolId: string | null },
  filters: ListFilters = {}
): Promise<SupervisorCertificateResult> {
  if (ctx.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "هذه القائمة متاحة للمشرفين التربويين فقط",
      rows: [],
      total: 0,
      page: 1,
      pageCount: 1,
    };
  }
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "حساب المشرف غير مرتبط بمدرسة — تواصل مع إدارة المنصة",
      rows: [],
      total: 0,
      page: 1,
      pageCount: 1,
    };
  }

  const links = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId: ctx.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
    select: { teacherId: true },
  });
  const teacherIds = links.map((link) => link.teacherId);
  if (teacherIds.length === 0) {
    return { ok: true, rows: [], total: 0, page: 1, pageCount: 1 };
  }

  const where = buildWhere(filters, {
    schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
    teacherId: { in: teacherIds },
  });

  const [total, rows] = await Promise.all([
    db.certificate.count({ where }),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        teacher: { select: { name: true } },
        course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
        program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
        issuedBy: { select: { name: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" },
      skip: (Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1) - 1) * PAGE_SIZE,
      take: PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
  ]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  return { ok: true, rows: rows.map(toRow), total, page, pageCount };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Platform — read-only cross-school register (SUPER_ADMIN)             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface PlatformCertificateResult {
  ok: boolean;
  message?: string;
  rows: CertificateReadRow[];
  total: number;
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
}

export async function listCertificatesPlatform(
  filters: ListFilters = {}
): Promise<PlatformCertificateResult> {
  const where = buildWhere(filters, {});

  const [total, rows] = await Promise.all([
    db.certificate.count({ where }),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        teacher: { select: { name: true } },
        course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
        program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
        issuedBy: { select: { name: true } },
        school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" },
      skip: (Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1) - 1) * PAGE_SIZE,
      take: PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
  ]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  return { ok: true, rows: rows.map(toRow), total, page, pageCount };
}

/**
 * Phase 8 — certificate service: eligibility engine, issuance,
 * revocation, management lists, certificate view, verification and
 * dashboard metrics.
 *
 * Architecture mirrors the Phase 6/7 services:
 *   - every mutation re-validates role and tenant on the SERVER (the
 *     actor is always built from the session, never from the payload),
 *   - eligibility is RE-COMPUTED from real learning data at issuance
 *     time — the client can never assert eligibility, scores or scope,
 *   - issuance writes the certificate + its ISSUED audit event inside
 *     one transaction; revocation flips the row with a conditional
 *     updateMany (status = ISSUED) so concurrent double-revocations
 *     cannot corrupt state, then appends a REVOKED event,
 *   - identifiers (certificate number / verification code) are
 *     generated server-side from crypto randomness with unique-index
 *     collision retries.
 *
 * Eligibility rules (fixed, documented, derived ONLY from persisted
 * data — no invented completion signals):
 *   ENROLLMENT  — the teacher has an ACTIVE enrollment in the course
 *                 (course-bound) or in at least one course of the
 *                 program (program-bound).
 *   ASSESSMENTS — every PUBLISHED assessment bound to the course (or
 *                 to any course of the program) has at least one
 *                 passed attempt by the teacher. "Passed" = the
 *                 attempt row's passed flag (or PASSED status). The
 *                 minimum score is each assessment's own passingScore
 *                 — already enforced by the Phase 6 engine. When a
 *                 content has no published assessments the rule is
 *                 satisfied vacuously (enrollment remains required).
 *   Lesson-level completion tracking does not exist in the current
 *   data model (CourseEnrollment has no completion states yet), so
 *   NO lesson rule is invented here; adding one later only extends
 *   buildRequirements().
 */
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

  notifyCertificateRevoked,
} from "@/lib/notifications/hooks";

import {
  canIssueCertificates,
  certificateScopeError,
  issueGuard,

  type CertificateViewer,
} from "@/lib/certificates/access";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  CERT_NUMBER_PREFIX,
  CERT_NUMBER_RANDOM_LENGTH,
  CERTIFICATE_CODE_ALPHABET,
  CERTIFICATES_PAGE_SIZE,
  CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS,
  IDENTIFIER_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS,
  ISSUER_ROLE_LABELS,
  METRICS_COURSES_LIMIT,
  VERIFICATION_CODE_LENGTH,
  type CertContentType,
  type CertificateEffectiveStatus,

} from "@/config/certificates";
