/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Pure helpers (unit-testable)                                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function randomCode(length: number): string {
  const bytes = randomBytes(length);
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < length; i += 1) {
    out += CERTIFICATE_CODE_ALPHABET[bytes[i] % CERTIFICATE_CODE_ALPHABET.length];
  }
  return out;
}

/** MQ-YYYY-XXXXXX — the year guards accidental cross-year collisions. */
export function buildCertificateNumber(now = new Date()): string {
  return `${CERT_NUMBER_PREFIX}-${now.getFullYear()}-${randomCode(CERT_NUMBER_RANDOM_LENGTH)}`;
}

export function buildVerificationCode(): string {
  return randomCode(VERIFICATION_CODE_LENGTH);
}

/** "ABCD-EFGH-IJKL-MNOP" — grouped display form of the verification code. */
export function formatCodeGrouped(code: string): string {
  return (code.match(/.{1,4}/g) ?? [code]).join("-");
}

/**
 * Derived display status: REVOKED persists; EXPIRED is computed from
 * expiresAt (a certificate can never be both revoked and expired).
 */
export function effectiveStatusOf(
  row: { status: string; expiresAt: Date | null },
  now = new Date()
): CertificateEffectiveStatus {
  if (row.status === "REVOKED") return "REVOKED";
  if (row.expiresAt && row.expiresAt.getTime() < now.getTime()) return "EXPIRED";
  return "ISSUED";
}

function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === "P2002"
  );
}

/**
 * Aggregates attempts per (assessment): passed = any attempt with the
 * passed flag (or PASSED status — reviewed short-answer rows). Best
 * percentage = max over attempts reporting one. Exported for the
 * growth service so the completion rule has ONE implementation.
 */
export function summarizeAssessments(
  assessments: { id: string; titleAr: string }[],
  attempts: { assessmentId: string; status: string; passed: boolean | null; percentage: number | null }[]
): AssessmentStanding[] {
  return assessments.map((assessment) => {
    const own = attempts.filter((attempt) => attempt.assessmentId === assessment.id);
    const passed = own.some(
      (attempt) => attempt.passed === true || attempt.status === "PASSED"
    );
    const percentages = own
      .map((attempt) => attempt.percentage)
      .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");
    return {
      assessmentId: assessment.id,
      titleAr: assessment.titleAr,
      passed,
      bestPercentage: percentages.length > 0 ? Math.max(...percentages) : null,
      attemptsCount: own.length,
    };
  });
}

/** Stable Arabic requirement labels/details from the aggregated standings. */
export function buildRequirements(
  enrolled: boolean,
  standings: AssessmentStanding[]
): EligibilityRequirement[] {
  const enrollment: EligibilityRequirement = {
    key: "ENROLLMENT",
    label: "الالتحاق بالمحتوى التدريبي",
    met: enrolled,
    detail: enrolled
      ? "مُسجَّل في المحتوى التدريبي"
      : "غير مُسجَّل في المحتوى التدريبي",
  };

  let assessments: EligibilityRequirement;
  if (standings.length === 0) {
    assessments = {
      key: "ASSESSMENTS",
      label: "اجتياز التقييمات المرتبطة",
      met: true,
      detail: "لا توجد تقييمات منشورة مرتبطة بهذا المحتوى — يُستوفى الشرط تلقائيًا",
    };
  } else {
    const lines = standings.map((standing) =>
      standing.passed
        ? `«${standing.titleAr}» — مجتاز${standing.bestPercentage !== null ? ` (أفضل نتيجة ${standing.bestPercentage}%)` : ""}`
        : `«${standing.titleAr}» — غير مجتاز`
    );
    assessments = {
      key: "ASSESSMENTS",
      label: "اجتياز التقييمات المرتبطة",
      met: standings.every((standing) => standing.passed),
      detail: lines.join(" • "),
    };
  }

  return [enrollment, assessments];
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Content snapshot + data loading (tenant-validated)                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface ContentSnapshot {
  type: CertContentType;
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  titleEn: string | null;
  /** null = platform-wide content shared with every school. */
  schoolId: string | null;
  status: string;
  /** Program-bound: member course ids (enrollment + assessment scope). */
  memberCourseIds: string[];
}

async function loadContentSnapshot(
  ctx: CertificateActor,
  contentType: CertContentType,
  contentId: string
): Promise<CertificateResult<ContentSnapshot>> {
  if (contentType === "COURSE") {
    const course = await db.course.findUnique({
      where: { id: contentId },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true, titleEn: true, schoolId: true, status: true },
    });
    if (!course) {
      return certificateFail("الدورة التدريبية غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
    }
    // Platform-wide courses (schoolId null) are shared with every
    // school; school-owned courses must belong to the actor's school.
    if (course.schoolId !== null && course.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
      return certificateFail("هذه الدورة لا تنتمي إلى نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    if (course.status === "DRAFT") {
      return certificateFail("لا يمكن إصدار شهادات لمحتوى غير منشور", "CONTENT_INVALID");
    }
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        type: "COURSE",
        id: course.id,
        titleAr: course.titleAr,
        titleEn: course.titleEn,
        schoolId: course.schoolId,
        status: course.status,
        memberCourseIds: [course.id],
      },
    };
  }

  const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
    where: { id: contentId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      nameAr: true,
      nameEn: true,
      schoolId: true,
      status: true,
      courses: { select: { id: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!program) {
    return certificateFail("البرنامج التدريبي غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  }
  if (program.schoolId !== null && program.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail("هذا البرنامج لا ينتمي إلى نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (program.status === "DRAFT") {
    return certificateFail("لا يمكن إصدار شهادات لمحتوى غير منشور", "CONTENT_INVALID");
  }
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      type: "PROGRAM",
      id: program.id,
      titleAr: program.nameAr,
      titleEn: program.nameEn,
      schoolId: program.schoolId,
      status: program.status,
      memberCourseIds: program.courses.map((course) => course.id),
    },
  };
}

async function loadPublishedAssessments(
  content: ContentSnapshot
): Promise<{ id: string; titleAr: string }[]> {
  return db.assessment.findMany({
    where:
      content.type === "COURSE"
        ? { courseId: content.id, status: "PUBLISHED" }
        : { course: { programId: content.id }, status: "PUBLISHED" },
    select: { id: true, titleAr: true },
    orderBy: { titleAr: "asc" },
  });
}

type AttemptIndex = Map<
  string,
  { assessmentId: string; status: string; passed: boolean | null; percentage: number | null }[]
>;

async function loadAttemptIndex(
  teacherIds: string[],
  assessmentIds: string[]
): Promise<AttemptIndex> {
  const index: AttemptIndex = new Map();
  if (teacherIds.length === 0 || assessmentIds.length === 0) return index;
  const attempts = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
    where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, assessmentId: { in: assessmentIds } },
    select: {
      userId: true,
      assessmentId: true,
      status: true,
      passed: true,
      percentage: true,
    },
  });
  for (const attempt of attempts) {
    const key = `${attempt.userId}:${attempt.assessmentId}`;
    const list = index.get(key);
    if (list) list.push(attempt);
    else index.set(key, [attempt]);
  }
  return index;
}

/**
 * Eligibility rows for the selected content across the school's active
 * teachers (office-manager scope). All data is fetched in batched
 * queries; every row is computed server-side.
 */
export async function getIssueEligibility(
  ctx: CertificateActor,
  contentType: CertContentType,
  contentId: string
): Promise<CertificateResult<IssueEligibilityData>> {
  if (!canIssueCertificates(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail("إصدار الشهادات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (contentType !== "COURSE" && contentType !== "PROGRAM") {
    return certificateFail("نوع المحتوى غير مدعوم", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }

  const content = await loadContentSnapshot(ctx, contentType, contentId);
  if (!content.ok) return content;
  const snapshot = content.data;

  const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
    where: { schoolId: ctx.schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      branchId: true,
      branch: { select: { nameAr: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
    take: 500,
  });
  const teacherIds = teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.id);

  const assessments = await loadPublishedAssessments(snapshot);
  const [enrollments, attemptIndex, existingCertificates] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
      where: { courseId: { in: snapshot.memberCourseIds }, userId: { in: teacherIds } },
      select: { courseId: true, userId: true },
    }),
    loadAttemptIndex(teacherIds, assessments.map((assessment) => assessment.id)),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where: {
        schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
        teacherId: { in: teacherIds },
        ...(contentType === "COURSE"
          ? { courseId: snapshot.id }
          : { programId: snapshot.id }),
      },
      select: { id: true, teacherId: true, certificateNumber: true, status: true },
    }),
  ]);

  const enrolledTeacherIds = new Set(enrollments.map((enrollment) => enrollment.userId));
  const certificateByTeacher = new Map(
    existingCertificates.map((certificate) => [certificate.teacherId, certificate])
  );

  const rows: TeacherEligibility[] = teachers.map((teacher) => {
    // Gather this teacher's attempts across ALL content assessments.
    const ownAttempts = assessments.flatMap((assessment) => {
      const list = attemptIndex.get(`${teacher.id}:${assessment.id}`);
      return (list ?? []).map((attempt) => ({
        assessmentId: attempt.assessmentId,
        status: attempt.status,
        passed: attempt.passed,
        percentage: attempt.percentage,
      }));
    });
    const standings = summarizeAssessments(assessments, ownAttempts);
    const requirements = buildRequirements(enrolledTeacherIds.has(teacher.id), standings);
    const existing = certificateByTeacher.get(teacher.id) ?? null;
    return {
      teacherId: teacher.id,
      teacherName: teacher.name,
      branchName: teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
      eligible:
        requirements.every((requirement) => requirement.met) && !existing,
      alreadyIssued: existing
        ? {
            certificateId: existing.id,
            certificateNumber: existing.certificateNumber,
            status: existing.status,
          }
        : null,
      requirements,
      assessments: standings,
    };
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      content: {
        type: snapshot.type,
        id: snapshot.id,
        titleAr: snapshot.titleAr,
        titleEn: snapshot.titleEn,
        schoolId: snapshot.schoolId,
        status: snapshot.status,
      },
      teachersTotal: teachers.length,
      rows,
    },
  };
}

/** Selectable issuance targets: non-draft content in scope (or platform-wide). */
export async function listIssueContentOptions(
  ctx: CertificateActor
): Promise<CertificateResult<IssueContentOptions>> {
  if (!canIssueCertificates(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail("إصدار الشهادات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const [courses, programs] = await Promise.all([
    db.course.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: ["PUBLISHED", "ARCHIVED"] },
        OR: [{ schoolId: ctx.schoolId }, { schoolId: null }],
      },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true, schoolId: true },
      orderBy: { titleAr: "asc" },
      take: 200,
    }),
    db.trainingProgram.findMany({
      where: {
        status: { in: ["PUBLISHED", "ARCHIVED"] },
        OR: [{ schoolId: ctx.schoolId }, { schoolId: null }],
      },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true, schoolId: true },
      orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
      take: 100,
    }),
  ]);
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      courses: courses.map((course) => ({
        id: course.id,
        titleAr: course.titleAr,
        scope: course.schoolId ? ("school" as const) : ("platform" as const),
      })),
      programs: programs.map((program) => ({
        id: program.id,
        nameAr: program.nameAr,
        scope: program.schoolId ? ("school" as const) : ("platform" as const),
      })),
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Issuance                                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function issueCertificate(
  ctx: CertificateActor,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<CertificateResult<IssueOutcome>> {
  const guard = issueGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = issueCertificateSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail("إصدار الشهادات يتطلب نطاقًا مدرسيًا محددًا", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  // The teacher identity is validated SERVER-SIDE: role, activation and
  // school membership never come from the payload.
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.teacherId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, role: true, isActive: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || !teacher.isActive) {
    return certificateFail("المعلم غير موجود أو غير مفعّل", "TEACHER_INVALID");
  }
  if (teacher.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail("المعلم لا ينتمي إلى مدرستك", "TEACHER_INVALID");
  }

  const content = await loadContentSnapshot(ctx, input.contentType, input.contentId);
  if (!content.ok) return content;
  const snapshot = content.data;

  // Duplicate check (explicit message before the DB unique constraint).
  const existing = await db.certificate.findFirst({
    where: {
      teacherId: teacher.id,
      ...(input.contentType === "COURSE"
        ? { courseId: snapshot.id }
        : { programId: snapshot.id }),
    },
    select: { id: true, certificateNumber: true, status: true },
  });
  if (existing) {
    return certificateFail(
      `سبق إصدار شهادة لهذا المعلم عن هذا المحتوى (رقم: ${existing.certificateNumber})`,
      "ALREADY_ISSUED"
    );
  }

  // Re-compute eligibility from real data — never trust the client.
  const [assessments, enrollments] = await Promise.all([
    loadPublishedAssessments(snapshot),
    db.courseEnrollment.findFirst({
      where: { courseId: { in: snapshot.memberCourseIds }, userId: teacher.id },
      select: { id: true },
    }),
  ]);
  const attemptIndex = await loadAttemptIndex([teacher.id], assessments.map((a) => a.id));
  const ownAttempts = assessments.flatMap((assessment) => {
    const list = attemptIndex.get(`${teacher.id}:${assessment.id}`);
    return (list ?? []).map((attempt) => ({
      assessmentId: attempt.assessmentId,
      status: attempt.status,
      passed: attempt.passed,
      percentage: attempt.percentage,
    }));
  });
  const standings = summarizeAssessments(assessments, ownAttempts);
  const requirements = buildRequirements(enrollments !== null, standings);
  const unmet = requirements.filter((requirement) => !requirement.met);
  if (unmet.length > 0) {
    return certificateFail(
      `لا يمكن إصدار الشهادة — متطلبات غير مستوفاة: ${unmet
        .map((requirement) => `${requirement.label} (${requirement.detail})`)
        .join("؛ ")}`,
      "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
    );
  }

  // Sensible defaults; the issuer may override via validated input.
  const typeLabel = CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS[snapshot.type];
  const titleAr = input.titleAr ?? `شهادة إتمام ${typeLabel} «${snapshot.titleAr}»`;
  const titleEn =
    input.titleEn ??
    (snapshot.titleEn ? `Certificate of Completion — ${snapshot.titleEn}` : null);
  const descriptionAr =
    input.descriptionAr ??
    `تم استيفاء متطلبات ${typeLabel} وفق سجلات التدريب والتقييم في منصة منارة.`;

  const criteriaSnapshot = JSON.stringify({
    content: { type: snapshot.type, id: snapshot.id, title: snapshot.titleAr },
    rules: requirements,
    assessments: standings,
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* Signatory snapshot (SCHOOL_MANAGER of the issuing school).        */
  /* Captured at ISSUANCE time and stored on the row — historical      */
  /* certificates never change when the manager is renamed/replaced.   */
  /* No manager -> issuance is BLOCKED (no fabricated names, no silent */
  /* fallback, no hardcoded defaults). Existing certificates keep      */
  /* whatever snapshot was taken when THEY were issued.                */
  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const signatory = await resolveSchoolSignatory(ctx.schoolId as string);
  if (!signatory) {
    return certificateFail(
      "لا يمكن إصدار الشهادة — لا يوجد مدير مدرسة نشط لهذه المدرسة لإمضاء الشهادات. عيّن مدير مدرسة أولًا من صفحة إدارة الحسابات",
      "RELATION_ERROR"
    );
  }

  const now = new Date();
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < IDENTIFIER_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1) {
    const certificateNumber = buildCertificateNumber(now);
    const verificationCode = buildVerificationCode();
    const taken = await db.certificate.findFirst({
      where: { OR: [{ certificateNumber }, { verificationCode }] },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (taken) continue;

    try {
      const outcome = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        const certificate = await tx.certificate.create({
          data: {
            schoolId: ctx.schoolId as string,
            teacherId: teacher.id,
            certificateNumber,
            verificationCode,
            titleAr,
            titleEn,
            descriptionAr,
            descriptionEn: input.descriptionEn,
            programId: snapshot.type === "PROGRAM" ? snapshot.id : null,
            courseId: snapshot.type === "COURSE" ? snapshot.id : null,
            status: "ISSUED",
            issuedAt: now,
            expiresAt: input.expiresAt ?? null,
            issuedById: ctx.id,
            issuerRoleLabel:
              ISSUER_ROLE_LABELS[ctx.role] ??
              (ctx.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ? "مدير المدرسة" : null),
            schoolSignatoryName: signatory.name,
            schoolSignatoryTitle: signatory.title,
            criteriaSnapshotJson: criteriaSnapshot,
          },
        });
        await tx.certificateEvent.create({
          data: {
            certificateId: certificate.id,
            type: "ISSUED",
            actorId: ctx.id,
            actorRole: ctx.role,
            note: `إصدار شهادة إتمام ${typeLabel} «${snapshot.titleAr}»`,
          },
        });
        return {
          id: certificate.id,
          certificateNumber,
          verificationCode,
          status: certificate.status,
        };
      });
      // Phase 11 — event notification (best-effort, post-commit).
      await notifyCertificateIssued({
        teacherId: teacher.id,
        certificateId: outcome.id,
        titleAr,
      });
      return { ok: true, data: outcome };
    } catch (error) {
      if (isUniqueViolation(error)) continue; // regenerate + retry
      throw error;
    }
  }
  return certificateFail(
    "تعذر توليد معرّفات فريدة للشهادة — أعد المحاولة",
    "RELATION_ERROR"
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Revocation                                                           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function revokeCertificate(
  ctx: CertificateActor,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<CertificateResult<{ id: string; status: string }>> {
  const guard = issueGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = revokeCertificateSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail("إلغاء الشهادات يتطلب نطاقًا مدرسيًا محددًا", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  // Conditional flip: only an ISSUED certificate of THIS school can be
  // revoked — concurrent double-revocations cannot double-write.
  const now = new Date();
  const flipped = await db.certificate.updateMany({
    where: { id: input.certificateId, schoolId: ctx.schoolId, status: "ISSUED" },
    data: {
      status: "REVOKED",
      revokedById: ctx.id,
      revokedAt: now,
      revocationReason: input.reason,
    },
  });
  if (flipped.count === 0) {
    const row = await db.certificate.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.certificateId },
      select: { id: true, schoolId: true, status: true },
    });
    if (!row) return certificateFail("الشهادة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
    if (row.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
      return certificateFail(
        "لا تملك صلاحية إلغاء هذه الشهادة — النطاق المدرسي مختلف",
        "FORBIDDEN"
      );
    }
    return certificateFail("لا يمكن إلغاء شهادة ملغاة مسبقًا", "ALREADY_REVOKED");
  }

  await db.certificateEvent.create({
    data: {
      certificateId: input.certificateId,
      type: "REVOKED",
      actorId: ctx.id,
      actorRole: ctx.role,
      note: input.reason,
    },
  });

  // Phase 11 — event notification (best-effort, post-commit).
  const revokedRow = await db.certificate.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.certificateId },
    select: { teacherId: true, titleAr: true },
  });
  if (revokedRow) {
    await notifyCertificateRevoked({
      teacherId: revokedRow.teacherId,
      certificateId: input.certificateId,
      titleAr: revokedRow.titleAr,
      reason: input.reason,
    });
  }

  return { ok: true, data: { id: input.certificateId, status: "REVOKED" } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Management list                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CertificateListFilters {
  q?: string;
  status?: string;
  page?: number;
}

export async function listCertificatesForManage(
  ctx: CertificateActor,
  filters: CertificateListFilters
): Promise<CertificateResult<Paginated<CertificateManageRow>>> {
  if (!canIssueCertificates(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return certificateFail(
      "إدارة الشهادات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }

  const where: Prisma.CertificateWhereInput = { schoolId: ctx.schoolId };
  const q = filters.q?.trim();
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { certificateNumber: { contains: q } },
      { titleAr: { contains: q } },
      { teacher: { name: { contains: q } } },
    ];
  }
  if (filters.status === "ISSUED" || filters.status === "REVOKED") {
    where.status = filters.status;
  }

  const [total, rows] = await Promise.all([
    db.certificate.count({ where }),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        teacher: { select: { name: true } },
        course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
        program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
        issuedBy: { select: { name: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" },
      skip: (Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1) - 1) * CERTIFICATES_PAGE_SIZE,
      take: CERTIFICATES_PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
  ]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / CERTIFICATES_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        certificateNumber: row.certificateNumber,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        teacherName: row.teacher.name,
        contentTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
        contentType:
          row.courseId !== null
            ? ("COURSE" as const)
            : row.programId !== null
              ? ("PROGRAM" as const)
              : null,
        issuedAt: row.issuedAt,
        expiresAt: row.expiresAt,
        status: row.status,
        effectiveStatus: effectiveStatusOf(row),
        issuerName: row.issuedBy?.name ?? null,
      })),
      total,
      page,
      pageCount,
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Certificate view (owner-teacher OR authorized back-office roles)     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Teacher workspace list — strictly the viewer's OWN certificates
 * (ownership enforced server-side; no other teacher's rows can ever
 * be projected through this path).
 */
export async function listCertificatesForTeacher(
  viewer: CertificateViewer
): Promise<CertificateResult<CertificateManageRow[]>> {
  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return certificateFail("قائمة الشهادات متاحة للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const rows = await db.certificate.findMany({
    where: { teacherId: viewer.id },
    include: {
      teacher: { select: { name: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      issuedBy: { select: { name: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" },
  });
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      certificateNumber: row.certificateNumber,
      titleAr: row.titleAr,
      teacherName: row.teacher.name,
      contentTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
      contentType:
        row.courseId !== null
          ? ("COURSE" as const)
          : row.programId !== null
            ? ("PROGRAM" as const)
            : null,
      issuedAt: row.issuedAt,
      expiresAt: row.expiresAt,
      status: row.status,
      effectiveStatus: effectiveStatusOf(row),
      issuerName: row.issuedBy?.name ?? null,
    })),
  };
}

function parseSnapshot(raw: string | null): CertificateView["snapshot"] {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as {
      rules?: unknown;
      assessments?: unknown;
      generatedAt?: unknown;
    };
    const rules = Array.isArray(parsed.rules)
      ? parsed.rules.filter(
          (item): item is EligibilityRequirement =>
            typeof item === "object" &&
            item !== null &&
            typeof (item as EligibilityRequirement).key === "string" &&
            typeof (item as EligibilityRequirement).label === "string" &&
            typeof (item as EligibilityRequirement).met === "boolean"
        )
      : [];
    const assessments = Array.isArray(parsed.assessments)
      ? parsed.assessments.filter(
          (item): item is AssessmentStanding =>
            typeof item === "object" &&
            item !== null &&
            typeof (item as AssessmentStanding).assessmentId === "string"
        )
      : [];
    return {
      rules,
      assessments,
      generatedAt:
        typeof parsed.generatedAt === "string" ? parsed.generatedAt : null,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getCertificateView(
  viewer: CertificateViewer,
  certificateId: string
): Promise<CertificateResult<CertificateView>> {
  const row = await db.certificate.findUnique({
    where: { id: certificateId },
    include: {
      teacher: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      school: {
        select: { nameAr: true, logoUrl: true, brandColor: true },
      },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true, titleEn: true } },
      program: { select: { nameAr: true, nameEn: true } },
      issuedBy: { select: { name: true } },
      revokedBy: { select: { name: true } },
      events: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        include: { actor: { select: { name: true } } },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!row) return certificateFail("الشهادة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");

  // Ownership / scope enforcement (server-side, never UI-hidden-only):
  //   TEACHER   → owner only;
  //   SUPER_ADMIN → platform-wide read-only;
  //   other back-office roles → own school only.
  if (viewer.role === "TEACHER") {
    if (row.teacherId !== viewer.id) {
      return certificateFail(
        "لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى شهادة معلم آخر",
        "FORBIDDEN"
      );
    }
  } else if (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    // read-only platform-wide access — allowed
  } else if (
    viewer.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    viewer.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    viewer.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
  ) {
    const scopeError = certificateScopeError(
      { id: viewer.id, role: viewer.role, schoolId: viewer.schoolId },
      row.schoolId
    );
    if (scopeError) return scopeError;
  } else {
    return certificateFail("لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى هذه الصفحة", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const revocation =
    row.status === "REVOKED" && row.revokedAt
      ? {
          at: row.revokedAt,
          reason: row.revocationReason ?? "—",
          byName: row.revokedBy?.name ?? null,
        }
      : null;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      id: row.id,
      certificateNumber: row.certificateNumber,
      verificationCode: row.verificationCode,
      verificationCodeGrouped: formatCodeGrouped(row.verificationCode),
      titleAr: row.titleAr,
      titleEn: row.titleEn,
      descriptionAr: row.descriptionAr,
      descriptionEn: row.descriptionEn,
      status: row.status,
      effectiveStatus: effectiveStatusOf(row),
      issuedAt: row.issuedAt,
      expiresAt: row.expiresAt,
      teacherId: row.teacher.id,
      teacherName: row.teacher.name,
      school: {
        nameAr: row.school.nameAr,
        logoUrl: row.school.logoUrl,
        brandColor: row.school.brandColor,
      },
      contentTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
      contentSubtitle:
        row.courseId !== null
          ? CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS.COURSE
          : row.programId !== null
            ? CERT_CONTENT_TYPE_LABELS.PROGRAM
            : null,
      issuerName: row.issuedBy?.name ?? null,
      issuerRoleLabel: row.issuerRoleLabel,
      schoolSignatoryName: row.schoolSignatoryName,
      schoolSignatoryTitle: row.schoolSignatoryTitle,
      revocation,
      snapshot: parseSnapshot(row.criteriaSnapshotJson),
      events: row.events.map((event) => ({
        type: event.type,
        createdAt: event.createdAt,
        actorName: event.actor?.name ?? null,
        actorRole: event.actorRole,
        note: event.note,
      })),
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Verification (authorized non-teacher roles ONLY)                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Searches by certificate number OR verification code (both exact).
 * Tenant semantics: back-office school roles search within their own
 * school only — a foreign or unknown code returns "not found" without
 * leaking existence. SUPER_ADMIN searches platform-wide (read-only).
 *
 * The response carries the MINIMUM information needed to establish
 * validity: number, title, teacher name, school name, content title,
 * issue date and effective status. No emails, ids, scores, notes or
 * verification codes are ever returned.
 */
export async function verifyCertificate(
  ctx: CertificateActor,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<CertificateResult<VerificationResult>> {
  const guard = verifyGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;
  // Phase 12 — brute-force friction: certificate NUMBERS carry only
  // ~30 bits of entropy (the 16-char verification code is ~80 bits), so
  // an authenticated insider hammering the search could enumerate valid
  // numbers within their scope. 60 searches / minute per user is far
  // above any legitimate verification workflow.
  const limiter = checkRateLimit("certificate-verify", ctx.id, 60, 60_000);
  if (!limiter.allowed) {
    return certificateFail(
      "عدد كبير من عمليات التحقق — أعد المحاولة بعد قليل",
      "RATE_LIMITED"
    );
  }
  const parsed = verifyCertificateSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);

  const rawUpper = parsed.data.query.toUpperCase();
  const normalized = normalizeVerificationQuery(parsed.data.query);

  const scopeFilters: Prisma.CertificateWhereInput[] =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? [] : [{ schoolId: ctx.schoolId ?? "__none__" }];

  const row = await db.certificate.findFirst({
    where: {
      AND: [
        ...scopeFilters,
        {
          OR: [
            { verificationCode: rawUpper },
            { certificateNumber: rawUpper },
            { verificationCode: normalized },
            { certificateNumber: normalized },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
    include: {
      teacher: { select: { name: true } },
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!row) return { ok: true, data: { found: false } };

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      found: true,
      certificate: {
        certificateNumber: row.certificateNumber,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        teacherName: row.teacher.name,
        schoolName: row.school.nameAr,
        contentTitle: row.course?.titleAr ?? row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
        issuedAt: row.issuedAt,
        effectiveStatus: effectiveStatusOf(row),
        revokedAt: row.status === "REVOKED" ? row.revokedAt : null,
      },
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Dashboard metrics (manager = school scope, super admin = platform)   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function getCertificateMetrics(
  ctx: CertificateActor
): Promise<CertificateResult<CertificateMetrics>> {
  if (
    ctx.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    ctx.role !== "SCHOOL_MANAGER" &&
    ctx.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN"
  ) {
    return certificateFail(
      "إحصاءات الشهادات متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير ومديري المدارس والإدارة العامة فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  // SCHOOL_MANAGER mirrors DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: the metrics are
  // always confined to its OWN school (fail-closed without a binding);
  // SUPER_ADMIN alone sees platform-wide aggregates.
  const schoolScope =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? null : ctx.schoolId;
  if (ctx.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && !schoolScope) {
    return certificateFail("النطاق المدرسي غير محدد", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const where: Prisma.CertificateWhereInput = schoolScope ? { schoolId: schoolScope } : {};
  const now = new Date();
  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const [total, issuedTotal, revoked, expired, issuedLast30Days, holderGroups] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.certificate.count({ where }),
      db.certificate.count({ where: { ...where, status: "ISSUED" } }),
      db.certificate.count({ where: { ...where, status: "REVOKED" } }),
      db.certificate.count({
        where: { ...where, status: "ISSUED", expiresAt: { lt: now } },
      }),
      db.certificate.count({ where: { ...where, issuedAt: { gte: thirtyDaysAgo } } }),
      db.certificate.groupBy({
        by: ["teacherId"],
        where,
      }),
    ]);

  let eligibleAwaiting: number | null = null;
  if (schoolScope) {
    eligibleAwaiting = await countEligibleAwaiting(schoolScope);
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      total,
      active: issuedTotal - expired,
      revoked,
      expired,
      issuedLast30Days,
      teachersWithCertificates: holderGroups.length,
      eligibleAwaiting,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Counts (teacher, published course) pairs that satisfy the eligibility
 * rules but have no certificate yet — school-scope metric with a clear
 * denominator (published courses of the school + platform-wide, capped).
 */
async function countEligibleAwaiting(schoolId: string): Promise<number> {
  const [teachers, courses] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findMany({
      where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
      select: { id: true },
    }),
    db.course.findMany({
      where: {
        status: "PUBLISHED",
        OR: [{ schoolId }, { schoolId: null }],
      },
      select: { id: true },
      take: METRICS_COURSES_LIMIT,
    }),
  ]);
  const teacherIds = teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.id);
  if (teacherIds.length === 0 || courses.length === 0) return 0;
  const courseIds = courses.map((course) => course.id);

  const [enrollments, assessments, certificates] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
      where: { courseId: { in: courseIds }, userId: { in: teacherIds } },
      select: { courseId: true, userId: true },
    }),
    db.assessment.findMany({
      where: { courseId: { in: courseIds }, status: "PUBLISHED" },
      select: { id: true, courseId: true },
    }),
    db.certificate.findMany({
      where: { schoolId, courseId: { in: courseIds } },
      select: { teacherId: true, courseId: true },
    }),
  ]);
  // The where-clause guarantees a bound course; this is a type
  // refinement only (Assessment.courseId is nullable in the schema).
  const boundAssessments = assessments.filter(
    (assessment): assessment is typeof assessment & { courseId: string } =>
      assessment.courseId !== null
  );
  if (boundAssessments.length === 0) {
    // Vacuous assessment rule: every enrolled (teacher, course) pair
    // without a certificate counts as awaiting issuance.
    const certified = new Set(certificates.map((c) => `${c.teacherId}:${c.courseId}`));
    return enrollments.filter((e) => !certified.has(`${e.userId}:${e.courseId}`)).length;
  }

  const attempts = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
    where: {
      userId: { in: teacherIds },
      assessmentId: { in: boundAssessments.map((assessment) => assessment.id) },
    },
    select: { userId: true, assessmentId: true, passed: true, status: true },
  });

  const assessmentsByCourse = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const assessment of boundAssessments) {
    const list = assessmentsByCourse.get(assessment.courseId);
    if (list) list.push(assessment.id);
    else assessmentsByCourse.set(assessment.courseId, [assessment.id]);
  }
  const passedPairs = new Set<string>();
  for (const attempt of attempts) {
    if (attempt.passed === true || attempt.status === "PASSED") {
      passedPairs.add(`${attempt.userId}:${attempt.assessmentId}`);
    }
  }
  const certifiedPairs = new Set(
    certificates.map((certificate) => `${certificate.teacherId}:${certificate.courseId}`)
  );

  let awaiting = 0;
  for (const enrollment of enrollments) {
    const pairKey = `${enrollment.userId}:${enrollment.courseId}`;
    if (certifiedPairs.has(pairKey)) continue;
    const requiredIds = assessmentsByCourse.get(enrollment.courseId) ?? [];
    const allPassed = requiredIds.every((assessmentId) =>
      passedPairs.has(`${enrollment.userId}:${assessmentId}`)
    );
    if (allPassed) awaiting += 1;
  }
  return awaiting;
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Certificate signatory resolution (Part 3).                           */
/*                                                                      */
/* The responsible school signatory is the SCHOOL_MANAGER user of the   */
/* ISSUING school. Resolution is server-side and derived purely from    */
/* the school relationship — never from client input, never hardcoded,  */
/* and never a silent fallback to another role.                         */
/*                                                                      */
/* Callers (issue flow, certificate sheet) snapshot the returned name   */
/* onto the certificate at ISSUANCE time, so historical certificates    */
/* never change when the manager account is renamed or replaced.        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Official Arabic title printed beneath the signatory name. */
export const SCHOOL_SIGNATORY_TITLE = "مدير المدرسة";

export interface SchoolSignatory {
  /** The SCHOOL_MANAGER user the snapshot was taken from. */
  userId: string;
  /** Official display name at resolution time. */
  name: string;
  /** Always «مدير المدرسة». */
  title: string;
}

/**
 * Resolve the active School Manager of a school. Deterministic: when a
 * school ever has more than one active manager, the EARLIEST-CREATED
 * active account is the official signatory (stable ordering, no surprises).
 *
 * Returns null when the school has none — the issue flow must surface
 * an administrative warning and block issuance of certificates that
 * require the school signature (no fabricated names, no silent fallback).
 */
export async function resolveSchoolSignatory(
  schoolId: string
): Promise<SchoolSignatory | null> {
  if (!schoolId) return null;

  const manager = await db.user.findFirst({
    where: { role: "SCHOOL_MANAGER", schoolId, isActive: true },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    select: { id: true, name: true },
  });

  if (!manager) return null;
  return { userId: manager.id, name: manager.name, title: SCHOOL_SIGNATORY_TITLE };
}

import type { ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { canManageTraining } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 1 — course comments (the course wall).                        */
/*                                                                     */
/* Restores the original HTML platform's teacher/supervisor dialogue   */
/* (v14/v15 comment sections + v40 messages) as course-scoped comments */
/* bound to REAL user ids — no name-string matching, no fake           */
/* recipients. Visibility follows the learning-view fence: published   */
/* platform-wide or own-school courses for everyone; managers may      */
/* also comment on their school's draft previews.                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type CommentErrorCode =
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "VALIDATION";

export type CommentResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      message: string;
      code?: CommentErrorCode;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
    };

function commentFail<T>(
  message: string,
  code: CommentErrorCode,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): CommentResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

const MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH = 2000;
const COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE = 30;

export interface CourseCommentRow {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  authorId: string;
  authorName: string;
  authorRole: string;
}

/** Can this viewer read (and write on) the course wall? */
async function courseWallAccess(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string
): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; message: string; code: CommentErrorCode }> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: { id: true, status: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!course) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الدورة غير موجودة", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  const managerPreview =
    canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
    (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId);
  const allowed =
    managerPreview ||
    (course.status === "PUBLISHED" &&
      (course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId));
  if (!allowed) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "هذه الدورة غير متاحة لك",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

/** Latest comments of one course wall (oldest-last for chat reading). */
export async function listCourseComments(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string,
  page = 1
): Promise<CommentResult<{ rows: CourseCommentRow[]; total: number; page: number; pageCount: number }>> {
  const access = await courseWallAccess(viewer, courseId);
  if (!access.ok) return commentFail(access.message, access.code);

  const total = await db.courseComment.count({ where: { courseId } });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE));
  const current = Math.min(Math.max(1, page), pageCount);

  const rows = await db.courseComment.findMany({
    where: { courseId },
    include: { author: { select: { name: true, role: true } } },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    skip: (current - 1) * COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
    take: COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows
        .map((row) => ({
          id: row.id,
          body: row.body,
          createdAt: row.createdAt,
          authorId: row.authorId,
          authorName: row.author.name,
          authorRole: row.author.role,
        }))
        .reverse(),
      total,
      page: current,
      pageCount,
    },
  };
}

/** Add a comment to the course wall (author = session user). */
export async function addCourseComment(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string,
  body: string
): Promise<CommentResult<CourseCommentRow>> {
  const access = await courseWallAccess(viewer, courseId);
  if (!access.ok) return commentFail(access.message, access.code);

  const text = body.trim();
  if (!text) {
    return commentFail("اكتب تعليقًا قبل الإرسال", "VALIDATION", {
      body: "التعليق فارغ",
    });
  }
  if (text.length > MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH) {
    return commentFail(
      `التعليق أطول من الحد المسموح (${MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH} حرفًا)`,
      "VALIDATION",
      { body: "التعليق طويل جدًا" }
    );
  }

  const author = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: viewer.id },
    select: { name: true, role: true },
  });
  if (!author) return commentFail("الحساب غير متاح", "FORBIDDEN");

  const created = await db.courseComment.create({
    data: {
      courseId,
      schoolId: null,
      authorId: viewer.id,
      body: text,
    },
    include: { author: { select: { name: true, role: true } } },
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      id: created.id,
      body: created.body,
      createdAt: created.createdAt,
      authorId: created.authorId,
      authorName: created.author.name,
      authorRole: created.author.role,
    },
  };
}

import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

/**
 * Prisma singleton — PostgreSQL (Neon) in production.
 *
 * - The client is cached on globalThis in EVERY environment: in local
 *   development it survives HMR reloads, and on Vercel each warm
 *   serverless invocation reuses the instance instead of opening a new
 *   connection per request. Cold instances get their own.
 * - Connections: runtime always uses the POOLED DATABASE_URL
 *   (Neon "…-pooler…" host + pgbouncer=true). Migration commands
 *   (prisma migrate deploy / diff / studio) automatically use the
 *   DIRECT_DATABASE_URL declared in prisma/schema.prisma — DDL must
 *   never travel through PgBouncer transaction pooling.
 * - Query logging stays in development only: it would bloat serverless
 *   logs (and could leak row data) in production.
 */
const createPrismaClient = () =>
  new PrismaClient({
    log:
      process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"
        ? ["error"]
        : ["query", "error"],
  });

const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as {
  prisma: ReturnType<typeof createPrismaClient> | undefined;
};

export const db = globalForPrisma.prisma ?? createPrismaClient();

globalForPrisma.prisma = db;

/**
 * Phase 9 — follow-up records service: supervisor-led classroom
 * application follow-up workflow with school/branch scoping, status
 * history and a strictly limited teacher-shared projection.
 *
 * Authorization model (mirrors the survey service):
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER — school-wide create/edit/status.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     — records where they are the responsible
 *                                supervisor or the teacher is inside
 *                                their persisted coverage.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY         — read-only progress within grants.
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                — aggregates only (impact service);
 *                                no record-level access here.
 *   TEACHER                    — ONLY the explicitly shared subset of
 *                                records targeted at them; internal
 *                                supervisor notes are never projected.
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  canManageFollowUps,
  surveyScopeError,

} from "@/lib/surveys/access";

} from "@/config/surveys";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Scope resolution                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function supervisorCoversTeacher(
  supervisorId: string,
  schoolId: string,
  teacher: { id: string; schoolId: string | null; branchId: string | null }
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (teacher.schoolId !== schoolId) return false;
  const assigned = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findFirst({
    where: { supervisorId, teacherId: teacher.id },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (assigned) return true;
  if (!teacher.branchId) return false;
  const branchGrant = await db.supervisorAssignment.findFirst({
    where: { supervisorId, schoolId, branchId: teacher.branchId },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return branchGrant !== null;
}

async function deputySchoolIds(deputyId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
    where: { userId: deputyId },
    select: { schoolId: true },
  });
  return Array.from(new Set(grants.map((grant) => grant.schoolId)));
}

/** Which school(s) a follow-up actor may operate on. */
async function effectiveSchoolIds(ctx: SurveyActor): Promise<string[]> {
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") return deputySchoolIds(ctx.id);
  return ctx.schoolId ? [ctx.schoolId] : [];
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface FollowUpListFilters {

}

export interface FollowUpRow {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  status: FollowUpStatus;
  teacherName: string;
  teacherId: string;
  supervisorName: string;
  followUpDate: Date;
  nextFollowUpAt: Date | null;
  sharedWithTeacher: boolean;
  contentTitle: string | null;
  surveyTitle: string | null;
  hasChallenges: boolean;
  hasSupportNeeds: boolean;
}

export async function createFollowUp(
  ctx: SurveyActor,
  rawDefinition: unknown
): Promise<SurveyResult<{ id: string }>> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail(
      "إنشاء سجلات المتابعة متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير والمشرفين التربويين فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }

  const parsed = followUpDefinitionSchema.safeParse(rawDefinition);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  // The teacher must be an active TEACHER of the actor's school.
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.teacherId },
    select: { id: true, role: true, schoolId: true, branchId: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || !teacher.isActive || teacher.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("المعلم المحدد غير موجود في نطاق مدرستك", "RELATION_ERROR");
  }

  // Supervisors create follow-ups only for teachers inside their scope;
  // the responsible supervisor is themself. Office managers may assign
  // any active supervisor of the school.
  let supervisorId: string;
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const covered = await supervisorCoversTeacher(ctx.id, ctx.schoolId, teacher);
    if (!covered) {
      return surveyFail("المعلم المحدد خارج نطاق إشرافك", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    supervisorId = ctx.id;
  } else {
    if (!input.supervisorId) {
      return surveyFail("حدد المشرف المسؤول عن المتابعة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.supervisorId },
      select: { id: true, role: true, schoolId: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!supervisor || supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.isActive || supervisor.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
      return surveyFail("المشرف المحدد غير موجود في نطاق مدرستك", "RELATION_ERROR");
    }
    supervisorId = supervisor.id;
  }

  const links = await validateContentLinks(ctx.schoolId, {
    programId: input.programId,
    courseId: input.courseId,
    lessonId: null,
    assignmentId: input.assignmentId,
    certificateId: null,
  });
  if (!links.ok) return links;

  // Survey link must be a school survey.
  if (input.surveyId) {
    const survey = await db.survey.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.surveyId },
      select: { schoolId: true },
    });
    if (!survey || survey.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
      return surveyFail("الاستبيان المرتبط غير موجود في نطاق مدرستك", "RELATION_ERROR");
    }
  }

  const followUp = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const created = await tx.followUp.create({
      data: {
        schoolId: ctx.schoolId!,
        teacherId: teacher.id,
        supervisorId,
        createdById: ctx.id,
        titleAr: input.titleAr,
        purposeAr: input.purposeAr,
        followUpDate: input.followUpDate,
        nextFollowUpAt: input.nextFollowUpAt ?? null,
        status: "PLANNED",
        programId: input.programId,
        courseId: input.courseId,
        surveyId: input.surveyId,
        assignmentId: input.assignmentId,
        observationAr: input.observationAr,
        progressAr: input.progressAr,
        challengesAr: input.challengesAr,
        supportNeedsAr: input.supportNeedsAr,
        recommendationsAr: input.recommendationsAr,
        sharedWithTeacher: input.sharedWithTeacher,
      },
    });
    await tx.followUpEvent.create({
      data: {
        followUpId: created.id,
        type: "CREATED",
        actorId: ctx.id,
        actorRole: ctx.role,
      },
    });
    return created;
  });

  // Phase 11 — event notification (best-effort, post-commit; teacher-facing
  // content is gated by sharing — never notify a teacher about a record
  // they are not yet authorized to see).
  await notifyFollowUpCreated({
    followUpId: followUp.id,
    teacherId: teacher.id,
    titleAr: input.titleAr,
    followUpDate: input.followUpDate,
    sharedWithTeacher: input.sharedWithTeacher,
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { id: followUp.id } };
}

/** Loads a follow-up with scope guards for an operational actor. */
async function loadFollowUpForOperation(ctx: SurveyActor, followUpId: string) {
  const followUp = await db.followUp.findUnique({
    where: { id: followUpId },
    include: {
      teacher: { select: { id: true, schoolId: true, branchId: true } },
      supervisor: { select: { id: true } },
      createdBy: { select: { id: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!followUp) return { ok: false as const, error: surveyFail<never>("سجل المتابعة غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND") };
  // Phase 10 — archived records are outside every active workflow. Any
  // operational action (edit/status/share) must restore first.
  if (followUp.archivedAt) {
    return {
      ok: false as const,
      error: surveyFail<never>(
        "سجل المتابعة مؤرشف — استعده من مركز الأرشيف قبل تنفيذ أي إجراء",
        "ARCHIVED"
      ),
    };
  }

  const schoolIds = await effectiveSchoolIds(ctx);
  if (!schoolIds.includes(followUp.schoolId)) {
    return { ok: false as const, error: surveyFail<never>("سجل المتابعة خارج نطاقك المدرسي", "FORBIDDEN") };
  }
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const isResponsible = followUp.supervisorId === ctx.id;
    const isCreator = followUp.createdById === ctx.id;
    const covered = isResponsible
      ? true
      : await supervisorCoversTeacher(ctx.id, followUp.schoolId, followUp.teacher);
    if (!isResponsible && !isCreator && !covered) {
      return { ok: false as const, error: surveyFail<never>("سجل المتابعة خارج نطاق إشرافك", "FORBIDDEN") };
    }
  }
  return { ok: true as const, followUp };
}

export async function updateFollowUp(
  ctx: SurveyActor,
  followUpId: string,
  rawDefinition: unknown
): Promise<SurveyResult<{ id: string }>> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("تعديل سجلات المتابعة متاح للأدوار التشغيلية فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const loaded = await loadFollowUpForOperation(ctx, followUpId);
  if (!loaded.ok) return loaded.error;

  const parsed = followUpDefinitionSchema.safeParse(rawDefinition);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.teacherId },
    select: { id: true, role: true, schoolId: true, branchId: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || !teacher.isActive || teacher.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("المعلم المحدد غير موجود في نطاق مدرستك", "RELATION_ERROR");
  }

  let supervisorId: string;
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    // Delegation rule: only the responsible supervisor (assigned by the
    // office manager) or the creator may edit the record, and they may
    // re-target it ONLY to a teacher inside their own coverage — updates
    // never widen a supervisor's real scope.
    const isDelegated =
      loaded.followUp.supervisorId === ctx.id || loaded.followUp.createdById === ctx.id;
    if (!isDelegated) {
      return surveyFail("يمكن للمشرف تعديل السجلات المكلَّف بها فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
    }
    const sameTeacher = teacher.id === loaded.followUp.teacherId;
    if (!sameTeacher) {
      const covered = await supervisorCoversTeacher(ctx.id, ctx.schoolId, teacher);
      if (!covered) {
        return surveyFail("المعلم المحدد خارج نطاق إشرافك", "FORBIDDEN");
      }
    }
    supervisorId = loaded.followUp.supervisorId === ctx.id ? ctx.id : loaded.followUp.supervisorId;
  } else {
    if (!input.supervisorId) {
      return surveyFail("حدد المشرف المسؤول عن المتابعة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.supervisorId },
      select: { id: true, role: true, schoolId: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!supervisor || supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.isActive || supervisor.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
      return surveyFail("المشرف المحدد غير موجود في نطاق مدرستك", "RELATION_ERROR");
    }
    supervisorId = supervisor.id;
  }

  const links = await validateContentLinks(ctx.schoolId, {
    programId: input.programId,
    courseId: input.courseId,
    lessonId: null,
    assignmentId: input.assignmentId,
    certificateId: null,
  });
  if (!links.ok) return links;

  if (input.surveyId) {
    const survey = await db.survey.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.surveyId },
      select: { schoolId: true },
    });
    if (!survey || survey.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
      return surveyFail("الاستبيان المرتبط غير موجود في نطاق مدرستك", "RELATION_ERROR");
    }
  }

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.followUp.update({
      where: { id: followUpId },
      data: {
        teacherId: teacher.id,
        supervisorId,
        titleAr: input.titleAr,
        purposeAr: input.purposeAr,
        followUpDate: input.followUpDate,
        nextFollowUpAt: input.nextFollowUpAt ?? null,
        programId: input.programId,
        courseId: input.courseId,
        surveyId: input.surveyId,
        assignmentId: input.assignmentId,
        observationAr: input.observationAr,
        progressAr: input.progressAr,
        challengesAr: input.challengesAr,
        supportNeedsAr: input.supportNeedsAr,
        recommendationsAr: input.recommendationsAr,
      },
    });
    await tx.followUpEvent.create({
      data: { followUpId, type: "UPDATED", actorId: ctx.id, actorRole: ctx.role },
    });
  });
  // Phase 11 — event notification (best-effort, post-commit).
  await notifyFollowUpUpdated({
    followUpId,
    teacherId: teacher.id,
    titleAr: input.titleAr,
    followUpDate: input.followUpDate,
    sharedWithTeacher: loaded.followUp.sharedWithTeacher,
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: followUpId } };
}

export async function changeFollowUpStatus(
  ctx: SurveyActor,
  rawInput: unknown
): Promise<SurveyResult<{ id: string; status: FollowUpStatus }>> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("تغيير حالة المتابعة متاح للأدوار التشغيلية فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const parsed = followUpStatusSchema.safeParse(rawInput);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const loaded = await loadFollowUpForOperation(ctx, input.followUpId);
  if (!loaded.ok) return loaded.error;
  const followUp = loaded.followUp;

  // Status changes are delegated work: responsible supervisor or creator.
  if (
    ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" &&
    followUp.supervisorId !== ctx.id &&
    followUp.createdById !== ctx.id
  ) {
    return surveyFail("يمكن للمشرف تحديث حالة السجلات المكلَّف بها فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  if (followUp.status === "COMPLETED" || followUp.status === "CANCELLED") {
    return surveyFail(
      "لا يمكن تغيير حالة سجل مكتمل أو ملغى — أنشئ سجل متابعة جديدًا للحفاظ على سجل التاريخ",
      "VALIDATION_ERROR"
    );
  }

  const now = new Date();
  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.followUp.update({
      where: { id: input.followUpId },
      data: {
        status: input.status,
        completedAt: input.status === "COMPLETED" ? now : null,
      },
    });
    await tx.followUpEvent.create({
      data: {
        followUpId: input.followUpId,
        type: "STATUS_CHANGED",
        actorId: ctx.id,
        actorRole: ctx.role,
        note: input.note,
      },
    });
  });
  // Phase 11 — event notification (best-effort, post-commit).
  await notifyFollowUpStatusChanged({
    followUpId: input.followUpId,
    teacherId: followUp.teacherId,
    titleAr: followUp.titleAr,
    statusLabel: FOLLOW_UP_STATUS_LABELS[input.status] ?? input.status,
    statusKey: input.status,
    sharedWithTeacher: followUp.sharedWithTeacher,
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: input.followUpId, status: input.status as FollowUpStatus } };
}

export async function setFollowUpSharing(
  ctx: SurveyActor,
  rawInput: unknown
): Promise<SurveyResult<{ id: string; sharedWithTeacher: boolean }>> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("تغيير المشاركة متاح للأدوار التشغيلية فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const parsed = followUpSharingSchema.safeParse(rawInput);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const loaded = await loadFollowUpForOperation(ctx, input.followUpId);
  if (!loaded.ok) return loaded.error;

  // Sharing is delegated work: responsible supervisor or creator.
  if (
    ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" &&
    loaded.followUp.supervisorId !== ctx.id &&
    loaded.followUp.createdById !== ctx.id
  ) {
    return surveyFail("يمكن للمشرف التحكم بمشاركة سجلاته المكلَّف بها فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.followUp.update({
      where: { id: input.followUpId },
      data: { sharedWithTeacher: input.sharedWithTeacher },
    });
    await tx.followUpEvent.create({
      data: {
        followUpId: input.followUpId,
        type: "SHARING_CHANGED",
        actorId: ctx.id,
        actorRole: ctx.role,
        note: input.sharedWithTeacher ? "تمت المشاركة مع المعلم" : "أوقفت المشاركة مع المعلم",
      },
    });
  });
  // Phase 11 — event notification: the teacher gains visibility exactly
  // when sharing turns ON (best-effort, post-commit).
  if (input.sharedWithTeacher) {
    await notifyFollowUpShared({
      followUpId: input.followUpId,
      teacherId: loaded.followUp.teacherId,
      titleAr: loaded.followUp.titleAr,
    });
  }
  return { ok: true, data: { id: input.followUpId, sharedWithTeacher: input.sharedWithTeacher } };
}

/* Lists & single views                                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function listFollowUps(
  ctx: SurveyActor,
  filters: FollowUpListFilters = {}
): Promise<SurveyResult<{ rows: FollowUpRow[]; total: number; pageCount: number; page: number }>> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) && ctx.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    return surveyFail("سجلات المتابعة متاحة للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const schoolIds = await effectiveSchoolIds(ctx);
  if (schoolIds.length === 0) {
    return surveyFail("النطاق المدرسي غير محدد", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const where: Record<string, unknown> = { schoolId: { in: schoolIds }, archivedAt: null };
  // Supervisors see records they are responsible for or that fall inside
  // their coverage — the coverage set is resolved explicitly (never via
  // URL-supplied ids).
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const [assigned, branchGrants] = await Promise.all([
      db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
        where: { supervisorId: ctx.id },
        select: { teacherId: true },
      }),
      db.supervisorAssignment.findMany({
        where: { supervisorId: ctx.id },
        select: { branchId: true },
      }),
    ]);
    const branchIds = branchGrants.map((row) => row.branchId);
    where.OR = [
      { supervisorId: ctx.id },
      { createdById: ctx.id },
      { teacherId: { in: assigned.map((row) => row.teacherId) } },
      { teacher: { branchId: { in: branchIds } } },
    ];
  }
  if (filters.status && ["PLANNED", "IN_PROGRESS", "COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(filters.status)) {
    where.status = filters.status;
  }
  if (filters.teacherId && filters.teacherId.trim() !== "") {
    where.teacherId = filters.teacherId.trim();
  }
  if (filters.upcoming === "1") {
    where.nextFollowUpAt = { gte: new Date() };
    where.status = { in: ["PLANNED", "IN_PROGRESS"] };
  }

  const total = await db.followUp.count({ where });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / FOLLOW_UPS_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  const rows = await db.followUp.findMany({
    where,
    orderBy: [{ followUpDate: "desc" }],
    skip: (page - 1) * FOLLOW_UPS_PAGE_SIZE,
    take: FOLLOW_UPS_PAGE_SIZE,
    include: {
      teacher: { select: { name: true } },
      supervisor: { select: { name: true } },
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      survey: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      assignment: { select: { titleAr: true } },
    },
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows.map((followUp) => ({
        id: followUp.id,
        titleAr: followUp.titleAr,
        status: followUp.status as FollowUpStatus,
        teacherName: followUp.teacher.name,
        teacherId: followUp.teacherId,
        supervisorName: followUp.supervisor.name,
        followUpDate: followUp.followUpDate,
        nextFollowUpAt: followUp.nextFollowUpAt,
        sharedWithTeacher: followUp.sharedWithTeacher,
        contentTitle:
          followUp.program?.nameAr ??
          followUp.course?.titleAr ??
          followUp.assignment?.titleAr ??
          null,
        surveyTitle: followUp.survey?.titleAr ?? null,
        hasChallenges: (followUp.challengesAr ?? "").trim().length > 0,
        hasSupportNeeds: (followUp.supportNeedsAr ?? "").trim().length > 0,
      })),
      total,
      pageCount,
      page,
    },
  };
}

export interface FollowUpManageView {

  titleAr: string;
  status: FollowUpStatus;
  purposeAr: string | null;
  followUpDate: Date;
  nextFollowUpAt: Date | null;
  completedAt: Date | null;
  sharedWithTeacher: boolean;
  teacherId: string;
  teacherName: string;
  supervisorId: string;
  supervisorName: string;
  programId: string | null;
  courseId: string | null;
  surveyId: string | null;
  assignmentId: string | null;
  programTitle: string | null;
  courseTitle: string | null;
  surveyTitle: string | null;
  assignmentTitle: string | null;
  observationAr: string | null;
  progressAr: string | null;
  challengesAr: string | null;
  supportNeedsAr: string | null;
  recommendationsAr: string | null;
  events: {
    id: string;
    type: string;
    actorName: string | null;
    actorRole: string | null;
    note: string | null;
    createdAt: Date;
  }[];
  canEdit: boolean;
}

export async function getFollowUpManageView(
  ctx: SurveyActor,
  followUpId: string
): Promise<SurveyResult<FollowUpManageView>> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) && ctx.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    return surveyFail("عرض سجل المتابعة متاح للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const loaded = await loadFollowUpForOperation(ctx, followUpId);
  if (!loaded.ok) return loaded.error;
  const followUp = loaded.followUp;

  const detail = await db.followUp.findUnique({
    where: { id: followUpId },
    include: {
      teacher: { select: { name: true } },
      supervisor: { select: { name: true } },
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      survey: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      assignment: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      events: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 30,
        include: { actor: { select: { name: true } } },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!detail) return surveyFail("سجل المتابعة غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");

  const canEdit =
    canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) &&
    (ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
      followUp.supervisorId === ctx.id ||
      followUp.createdById === ctx.id);

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      id: detail.id,
      titleAr: detail.titleAr,
      status: detail.status as FollowUpStatus,
      purposeAr: detail.purposeAr,
      followUpDate: detail.followUpDate,
      nextFollowUpAt: detail.nextFollowUpAt,
      completedAt: detail.completedAt,
      sharedWithTeacher: detail.sharedWithTeacher,
      teacherId: detail.teacherId,
      teacherName: detail.teacher.name,
      supervisorId: detail.supervisorId,
      supervisorName: detail.supervisor.name,
      programId: detail.programId,
      courseId: detail.courseId,
      surveyId: detail.surveyId,
      assignmentId: detail.assignmentId,
      programTitle: detail.program?.nameAr ?? null,
      courseTitle: detail.course?.titleAr ?? null,
      surveyTitle: detail.survey?.titleAr ?? null,
      assignmentTitle: detail.assignment?.titleAr ?? null,
      observationAr: detail.observationAr,
      progressAr: detail.progressAr,
      challengesAr: detail.challengesAr,
      supportNeedsAr: detail.supportNeedsAr,
      recommendationsAr: detail.recommendationsAr,
      events: detail.events.map((event) => ({
        id: event.id,
        type: event.type,
        actorName: event.actor?.name ?? null,
        actorRole: event.actorRole,
        note: event.note,
        createdAt: event.createdAt,
      })),
      canEdit,
    },
  };
}

      supervisorName: followUp.supervisor.name,
      programTitle: followUp.program?.nameAr ?? null,
      courseTitle: followUp.course?.titleAr ?? null,
    })),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Metrics                                                              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface FollowUpMetrics {
  total: number;
  planned: number;
  inProgress: number;
  completed: number;
  cancelled: number;
  /** Denominator: total − cancelled. Null when there is nothing to count. */
  completionRatePercent: number | null;
  upcomingCount: number;
  /** Records where the supervisor reported challenges / support needs. */
  withChallenges: number;
  withSupportNeeds: number;
}

export async function getFollowUpMetrics(ctx: SurveyActor): Promise<SurveyResult<FollowUpMetrics>> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) && ctx.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    return surveyFail("مؤشرات المتابعة متاحة للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const schoolIds = await effectiveSchoolIds(ctx);
  if (schoolIds.length === 0) {
    return surveyFail("النطاق المدرسي غير محدد", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const scopeWhere: Record<string, unknown> = { schoolId: { in: schoolIds }, archivedAt: null };
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    scopeWhere.supervisorId = ctx.id;
  }

  const [total, planned, inProgress, completed, cancelled, upcoming, withChallenges, withSupportNeeds] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.followUp.count({ where: scopeWhere }),
      db.followUp.count({ where: { ...scopeWhere, status: "PLANNED" } }),
      db.followUp.count({ where: { ...scopeWhere, status: "IN_PROGRESS" } }),
      db.followUp.count({ where: { ...scopeWhere, status: "COMPLETED" } }),
      db.followUp.count({ where: { ...scopeWhere, status: "CANCELLED" } }),
      db.followUp.count({
        where: {
          ...scopeWhere,
          status: { in: ["PLANNED", "IN_PROGRESS"] },
          nextFollowUpAt: { gte: new Date() },
        },
      }),
      db.followUp.count({
        where: { ...scopeWhere, challengesAr: { not: null } },
      }),
      db.followUp.count({
        where: { ...scopeWhere, supportNeedsAr: { not: null } },
      }),
    ]);

  const denominator = total - cancelled;
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      total,
      planned,
      inProgress,
      completed,
      cancelled,
      completionRatePercent:
        denominator > 0 ? Math.round((completed / denominator) * 100) : null,
      upcomingCount: upcoming,
      withChallenges,
      withSupportNeeds,
    },
  };
}

/** Form options: active school teachers + supervisors (manager picks). */
export async function listFollowUpFormOptions(
  ctx: SurveyActor
): Promise<
  SurveyResult<{
    teachers: { id: string; name: string; branchName: string | null }[];
    supervisors: { id: string; name: string }[];
  }>
> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("غير مصرح", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  let teacherWhere: Record<string, unknown> = {
    schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
    role: "TEACHER",
    isActive: true,
  };
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    const [assigned, branchGrants] = await Promise.all([
      db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
        where: { supervisorId: ctx.id },
        select: { teacherId: true },
      }),
      db.supervisorAssignment.findMany({
        where: { supervisorId: ctx.id },
        select: { branchId: true },
      }),
    ]);
    teacherWhere = {
      ...teacherWhere,
      OR: [
        { id: { in: assigned.map((row) => row.teacherId) } },
        { branchId: { in: branchGrants.map((row) => row.branchId) } },
      ],
    };
  }

  const [teachers, supervisors] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findMany({
      where: teacherWhere,
      select: { id: true, name: true, branch: { select: { nameAr: true } } },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      take: 300,
    }),
    ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
      ? db.user.findMany({
          where: {
            schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
            role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
            isActive: true,
          },
          select: { id: true, name: true },
          orderBy: { name: "asc" },
          take: 100,
        })
      : Promise.resolve([]),
  ]);

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      teachers: teachers.map((teacher) => ({
        id: teacher.id,
        name: teacher.name,
        branchName: teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
      })),
      supervisors,
    },
  };
}

/** Content-link options for the follow-up form (school-scoped). */
export async function listFollowUpLinkOptions(
  ctx: SurveyActor
): Promise<
  SurveyResult<{
    programs: { id: string; nameAr: string }[];
    courses: { id: string; titleAr: string }[];
    assignments: { id: string; titleAr: string }[];
  }>
> {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role) || !ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("غير مصرح", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  const schoolId = ctx.schoolId;
  const [programs, courses, assignments] = await Promise.all([
    db.trainingProgram.findMany({
      where: { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" }, OR: [{ schoolId }, { schoolId: null }] },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
      orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
      take: 200,
    }),
    db.course.findMany({
      where: { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" }, OR: [{ schoolId }, { schoolId: null }] },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true },
      orderBy: { titleAr: "asc" },
      take: 200,
    }),
    db.assignment.findMany({
      where: { schoolId, status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 200,
    }),
  ]);
  return { ok: true, data: { programs, courses, assignments } };
}
