import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET,
  GROWTH_LEVELS,
  PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT,
  growthLevelLabel,
  isGrowthLevelId,
  nextGrowthLevel,
  suggestedGrowthLevel,
  type GrowthLevelId,
} from "@/config/growth";
import { notifyGrowthLevelChanged } from "@/lib/notifications/center";
import { getActiveAcademicYear } from "@/lib/academic-year";
import { teacherHoursSummary } from "@/lib/training/hours";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — professional growth engine (HTML v48 + v13 parity).        */
/*                                                                      */
/* The persisted level lives on User.growthLevel (default "T0"). Every  */
/* change writes ONE append-only GrowthEvent row (the full history is   */
/* never rewritten) and notifies the teacher through the notification   */
/* center. The SUGGESTED level (v13 thresholds) is advisory only.       */
/*                                                                      */
/* Permissions (fail-closed, server-side):                              */
/*   - EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR: only teachers inside their own scope        */
/*     (explicit assignment OR branch coverage) and own school.         */
/*   - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: only teachers of their own school.   */
/*   - SUPER_ADMIN: any teacher.                                        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type GrowthServiceResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code?: "FORBIDDEN" | "NOT_FOUND" | "VALIDATION_ERROR" };

/** The acting supervisor/admin resolved from the session (never client input). */
export interface GrowthActor {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Stats                                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface TeacherGrowthStats {
  /** Published courses assigned to this teacher (platform-wide + own school). */
  assigned: number;
  completed: number;
  /** Accumulated completed-course hours (all completions — HTML parity). */
  hours: number;
  /** Mean of the best passed-assessment percentages (null when no exams). */
  avgPercentage: number | null;
  certificates: number;
  /** Round(completed / assigned * 100) — 0 when nothing is assigned. */
  percent: number;
}

export interface GrowthTeacherRow {
  teacher: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    email: string;
    schoolId: string | null;
    schoolName: string | null;
    branchName: string | null;
    stage: string | null;
    subject: string | null;
    isActive: boolean;
  };
  currentLevel: GrowthLevelId;
  suggestedLevel: GrowthLevelId;
  stats: TeacherGrowthStats;
  eligible: boolean;
  nextLevel: GrowthLevelId | null;
}

interface TeacherRecord {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
  branchId?: string | null;
  growthLevel: string;
  stage: string | null;
  subject: string | null;
  isActive: boolean;
  school?: { nameAr: string } | null;
  branch?: { nameAr: string } | null;
}

/** Exported for the messaging recipients list (same scope, same shape). */
export type ScopedTeacherRecord = TeacherRecord;

/**
 * Build growth rows for a set of teachers with BATCHED queries (no
 * per-teacher round trips — a school roster can hold hundreds of
 * teachers). Assigned published courses are resolved per distinct
 * schoolId exactly like the HTML v13AssignedCourses: platform-wide
 * courses (schoolId null) reach everyone; school courses reach that
 * school's teachers only.
 */
export async function buildGrowthRows(
  teachers: TeacherRecord[]
): Promise<GrowthTeacherRow[]> {
  if (teachers.length === 0) return [];

  const teacherIds = teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.id);
  const schoolIds = [
    ...new Set(
      teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.schoolId).filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id))
    ),
  ];

  // Published courses per scope — platform-wide once, then one per school.
  const scopeCourses = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const platformCourses = await db.course.findMany({
    where: { status: "PUBLISHED", schoolId: null },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  const platformIds = new Set(platformCourses.map((course) => course.id));
  for (const schoolId of schoolIds) {
    const schoolCourses = await db.course.findMany({
      where: { status: "PUBLISHED", schoolId },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    scopeCourses.set(schoolId, new Set(schoolCourses.map((course) => course.id)));
  }

  const completions = await db.courseCompletion.findMany({
    where: { userId: { in: teacherIds } },
    select: {
      userId: true,
      courseId: true,
      hours: true,
      bestPercentage: true,
    },
  });
  const certificateCounts = await db.certificate.groupBy({
    by: ["teacherId"],
    where: { teacherId: { in: teacherIds }, status: "ISSUED" },
    _count: { _all: true },
  });
  const certCountByTeacher = new Map(
    certificateCounts.map((row) => [row.teacherId, row._count._all])
  );

  const completionsByTeacher = new Map<string, typeof completions>();
  for (const completion of completions) {
    const list = completionsByTeacher.get(completion.userId) ?? [];
    list.push(completion);
    completionsByTeacher.set(completion.userId, list);
  }

  return teachers.map((teacher) => {
    const assignedIds = new Set(platformIds);
    if (teacher.schoolId) {
      const schoolSet = scopeCourses.get(teacher.schoolId);
      if (schoolSet) {
        for (const id of schoolSet) assignedIds.add(id);
      }
    }
    const own = completionsByTeacher.get(teacher.id) ?? [];
    const done = own.filter((completion) => assignedIds.has(completion.courseId));
    const assigned = assignedIds.size;
    const percent =
      assigned === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((done.length / assigned) * 100);
    const hours = own.reduce((sum, completion) => sum + Number(completion.hours ?? 0), 0);
    const percentages = own
      .map((completion) => completion.bestPercentage)
      .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");
    const avgPercentage = percentages.length
      ? Math.round(
          (percentages.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / percentages.length) * 10
        ) / 10
      : null;

    const currentLevel: GrowthLevelId = isGrowthLevelId(teacher.growthLevel)
      ? teacher.growthLevel
      : "T0";
    const suggestedLevel = suggestedGrowthLevel({ hours, assignedPercent: percent });
    const nextLevel = nextGrowthLevel(currentLevel);
    const eligible =
      assigned > 0 &&
      percent >= PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT &&
      nextLevel !== null;

    return {
      teacher: {
        id: teacher.id,
        name: teacher.name,
        email: teacher.email,
        schoolId: teacher.schoolId,
        schoolName: teacher.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        branchName: teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
        stage: teacher.stage,
        subject: teacher.subject,
        isActive: teacher.isActive,
      },
      currentLevel,
      suggestedLevel,
      stats: {
        assigned,
        completed: done.length,
        hours,
        avgPercentage,
        certificates: certCountByTeacher.get(teacher.id) ?? 0,
        percent,
      },
      eligible,
      nextLevel,
    };
  });
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Scope resolution                                                     */

/** Supervisor scope = explicit assignments ∪ branch coverage, own school. */
async function supervisorOwnsTeacher(
  supervisorId: string,
  teacherId: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: supervisorId },
    select: { role: true, schoolId: true, supervisorAssignments: { select: { branchId: true } } },
  });
  if (!supervisor || supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.schoolId) {
    return false;
  }
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: teacherId },
    select: { role: true, schoolId: true, branchId: true },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || teacher.schoolId !== supervisor.schoolId) {
    return false;
  }
  const explicit = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findFirst({
    where: { teacherId, supervisorId, schoolId: supervisor.schoolId },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (explicit) return true;
  const branchIds = supervisor.supervisorAssignments.map((row) => row.branchId);
  return Boolean(teacher.branchId && branchIds.includes(teacher.branchId));
}

function adminOwnsTeacher(actor: GrowthActor, teacherSchoolId: string | null): boolean {
  if (actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") return true;
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return Boolean(actor.schoolId) && teacherSchoolId === actor.schoolId;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Fail-closed permission check for reading/writing one teacher's growth. */
export async function canManageTeacherGrowth(
  actor: GrowthActor,
  teacherId: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return supervisorOwnsTeacher(actor.id, teacherId);
  }
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: teacherId },
    select: { role: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER") return false;
  return adminOwnsTeacher(actor, teacher.schoolId);
}

/**
 * The supervisor's authorized teacher records (explicit assignments ∪
 * branch coverage, confined to the supervisor's school). Shared by the
 * growth board and the messaging recipients list — one scope, one query
 * path, everywhere.
 */
export async function supervisorScopedTeacherRecords(
  supervisorId: string
): Promise<GrowthServiceResult<TeacherRecord[]>> {
  const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: supervisorId },
    select: {
      role: true,
      schoolId: true,
      supervisorAssignments: { select: { branchId: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!supervisor || supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.schoolId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذه الصفحة متاحة للمشرفين التربويين فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const branchIds = supervisor.supervisorAssignments.map((row) => row.branchId);
  const branchDerived =
    branchIds.length > 0
      ? await db.user.findMany({
          where: {
            role: "TEACHER",
            schoolId: supervisor.schoolId,
            branchId: { in: branchIds },
          },
          select: growthTeacherSelect,
        })
      : [];
  const explicitRows = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId, schoolId: supervisor.schoolId },
    select: { teacher: { select: growthTeacherSelect } },
  });

  const byId = new Map<string, TeacherRecord>();
  for (const teacher of branchDerived) byId.set(teacher.id, teacher);
  for (const row of explicitRows) {
    if (row.teacher && row.teacher.schoolId === supervisor.schoolId) {
      byId.set(row.teacher.id, row.teacher);
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, data: [...byId.values()] };
}

/**
 * The supervisor's growth board (HTML v48Page): every teacher inside
 * the supervisor's authorized scope with stats + eligibility.
 */
export async function supervisorGrowthBoard(
  supervisorId: string
): Promise<GrowthServiceResult<GrowthTeacherRow[]>> {
  const scoped = await supervisorScopedTeacherRecords(supervisorId);
  if (!scoped.ok) return scoped;
  const rows = await buildGrowthRows(scoped.data);
  rows.sort((a, b) => a.teacher.name.localeCompare(b.teacher.name, "ar"));
  return { ok: true, data: rows };
}

/**
 * The administrative teachers board (/teachers): all teachers of the
 * actor's school (office) or the whole platform (super admin).
 */
export async function adminGrowthBoard(
  actor: GrowthActor
): Promise<GrowthServiceResult<GrowthTeacherRow[]>> {
  if (actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذه الصفحة متاحة للإدارة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
    where: {
      role: "TEACHER",
      ...(actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ? { schoolId: actor.schoolId } : {}),
    },
    select: growthTeacherSelect,
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
  });
  const rows = await buildGrowthRows(teachers);
  return { ok: true, data: rows };
}

export interface LevelChangeOutcome {
  changed: boolean;
  from: GrowthLevelId;
  to: GrowthLevelId;
}

/**
 * v48SetTeacherLevel — the supervisor classifies the teacher directly.
 * Idempotent: classifying the same level again changes nothing (and
 * writes no duplicate history row).
 */
export async function setTeacherLevel(
  actor: GrowthActor,
  teacherId: string,
  level: string,
  note?: string
): Promise<GrowthServiceResult<LevelChangeOutcome>> {
  if (!isGrowthLevelId(level)) {
    return { ok: false, message: "مستوى النمو غير صالح", code: "VALIDATION_ERROR" };
  }
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: teacherId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, role: true, schoolId: true, growthLevel: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return { ok: false, message: "المعلم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (!(await canManageTeacherGrowth(actor, teacherId))) {
    return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية تصنيف هذا المعلم", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const from: GrowthLevelId = isGrowthLevelId(teacher.growthLevel)
    ? teacher.growthLevel
    : "T0";
  if (from === level) {
    return { ok: true, data: { changed: false, from, to: level } };
  }

  await db.$transaction([
    db.user.update({ where: { id: teacherId }, data: { growthLevel: level } }),
    db.growthEvent.create({
      data: {
        userId: teacherId,
        fromLevel: from,
        toLevel: level,
        reason: "MANUAL_SUPERVISOR",
        note: note?.trim() ? note.trim().slice(0, 300) : null,
        actorId: actor.id,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  await notifyGrowthLevelChanged({
    teacherId,
    fromLevel: from,
    toLevel: level,
    kind: "MANUAL",
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { changed: true, from, to: level } };
}

/**
 * v48CheckPromotion + approve in one server-side step. The 60% gate is
 * re-checked HERE (never trusted from the client) and only ever moves
 * the teacher exactly ONE level up.
 */
export async function approvePromotion(
  actor: GrowthActor,
  teacherId: string
): Promise<
  GrowthServiceResult<
    | { promoted: true; from: GrowthLevelId; to: GrowthLevelId }
    | { promoted: false; message: string; completed: number; assigned: number; percent: number }
  >
> {
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: teacherId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, role: true, schoolId: true, growthLevel: true },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return { ok: false, message: "المعلم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (!(await canManageTeacherGrowth(actor, teacherId))) {
    return { ok: false, message: "لا تملك صلاحية اعتماد انتقال هذا المعلم", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const [row] = await buildGrowthRows([
    {
      id: teacher.id,
      name: teacher.name,
      email: "",
      schoolId: teacher.schoolId,
      branchId: null,
      role: teacher.role,
      growthLevel: teacher.growthLevel,
      stage: null,
      subject: null,
      isActive: teacher.role === "TEACHER",
      school: null,
      branch: null,
    },
  ]);

  if (!row.nextLevel) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        promoted: false,
        message: "المعلم على أعلى مستوى بالفعل (T5 — باحث تربوي)",
        completed: row.stats.completed,
        assigned: row.stats.assigned,
        percent: row.stats.percent,
      },
    };
  }
  if (!row.eligible) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        promoted: false,
        message: `لم يكتمل شرط ${PROMOTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT}% بعد. المكتمل: ${row.stats.completed} من ${row.stats.assigned} دورة (${row.stats.percent}%).`,
        completed: row.stats.completed,
        assigned: row.stats.assigned,
        percent: row.stats.percent,
      },
    };
  }

  const from = row.currentLevel;
  const to = row.nextLevel;
  await db.$transaction([
    db.user.update({ where: { id: teacherId }, data: { growthLevel: to } }),
    db.growthEvent.create({
      data: {
        userId: teacherId,
        fromLevel: from,
        toLevel: to,
        reason: "PROMOTION_APPROVED",
        actorId: actor.id,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  await notifyGrowthLevelChanged({ teacherId, fromLevel: from, toLevel: to, kind: "PROMOTION" });

  return { ok: true, data: { promoted: true, from, to } };
}

/** The teacher's own level + suggestion + last events (for /reports). */
export async function teacherGrowthSummary(teacherId: string): Promise<{
  currentLevel: GrowthLevelId;
  suggestedLevel: GrowthLevelId;
  history: GrowthHistoryRow[];
  stats: TeacherGrowthStats;
} | null> {
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: teacherId },
    select: growthTeacherSelect,
  });
  if (!teacher) return null;
  const [row] = await buildGrowthRows([teacher]);
  const history = await db.growthEvent.findMany({
    where: { userId: teacherId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 10,
    select: {
      id: true,
      fromLevel: true,
      toLevel: true,
      reason: true,
      note: true,
      actor: { select: { name: true } },
      createdAt: true,
    },
  });
  return {
    currentLevel: row.currentLevel,
    suggestedLevel: row.suggestedLevel,
    stats: row.stats,
    history: history.map((event) => ({
      id: event.id,
      fromLevel: event.fromLevel,
      toLevel: event.toLevel,
      reason: event.reason,
      note: event.note,
      actorName: event.actor?.name ?? null,
      createdAt: event.createdAt,
    })),
  };
}

  return GROWTH_LEVELS;
}

const REASON_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  MANUAL_SUPERVISOR: "تصنيف المشرف",
  PROMOTION_APPROVED: "اعتماد انتقال — شرط 60%",
  SEED: "تصنيف ابتدائي",
};

function reasonLabel(reason: string): string {
  return REASON_LABELS[reason] ?? reason;
}

/** One row of the append-only growth journey (HTML v48 GL-events parity). */
export interface GrowthHistoryEvent {
  id: string;
  teacherId: string;
  teacherName: string;
  fromLevel: GrowthLevelId | null;
  fromLabel: string | null;
  toLevel: GrowthLevelId;
  toLabel: string;
  /** Raw machine reason (MANUAL_SUPERVISOR | PROMOTION_APPROVED | SEED). */
  reason: string;
  /** Arabic label used directly in the timeline UI. */
  reasonLabel: string;
  note: string | null;
  actorName: string | null;
  createdAt: Date;
}

/**
 * The teacher's growth journey, newest first. Backed exclusively by
 * GrowthEvent rows (append-only — the history is never rewritten).
 */
export async function teacherGrowthHistory(
  teacherId: string,
  limit = 20
): Promise<GrowthHistoryEvent[]> {
  const events = await db.growthEvent.findMany({
    where: { userId: teacherId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: Math.min(Math.max(limit, 1), 100),
    select: {
      id: true,
      fromLevel: true,
      toLevel: true,
      reason: true,
      note: true,
      actor: { select: { name: true } },
      createdAt: true,
      user: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
    },
  });

  return events.map((event) => {
    const fromLevel = event.fromLevel && isGrowthLevelId(event.fromLevel) ? event.fromLevel : null;
    const toLevel = isGrowthLevelId(event.toLevel) ? event.toLevel : "T0";
    return {
      id: event.id,
      teacherId: event.user.id,
      teacherName: event.user.name,
      fromLevel,
      fromLabel: fromLevel ? growthLevelLabel(fromLevel) : null,
      toLevel,
      toLabel: growthLevelLabel(toLevel),
      reason: event.reason,
      reasonLabel: reasonLabel(event.reason),
      note: event.note,
      actorName: event.actor?.name ?? null,
      createdAt: event.createdAt,
    };
  });
}

  branchName: string | null;

  level: GrowthLevelId;
  levelLabel: string;
  suggestedLevel: GrowthLevelId;
  nextLevel: GrowthLevelId | null;

  /** Published courses assigned to this teacher (platform + own school). */
  coursesEnrolled: number;
  coursesCompleted: number;
  /** Round(completed/assigned*100) — the 60% promotion gate value. */
  completionPercentage: number;
  certificatesActive: number;
  hoursCompleted: number;
  hoursTarget: number;
  avgBestPercentage: number | null;
  eligible: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
}

/**
 * Tolerant scope so every caller compiles against one signature:
 *   - nothing          -> whole platform (callers already tenant-scoped)
 *   - "schoolId"       -> one school (bare string also accepted)
 *   - { id, schoolId, supervisorId, teacherIds } -> explicit scope object
 *
 * `id` (the acting user) is accepted for backward compatibility with the
 * analytics/dashboard callers: when `supervisorId` is not passed and the
 * id belongs to an EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR, the roster collapses to
 * exactly their teachers; for any other role it is safely ignored.
 */
export type GrowthRosterScope =
  | string
  | {
      [key: string]: unknown;
      id?: string | null;
      schoolId?: string | null;
      supervisorId?: string | null;
      teacherIds?: string[];
    }
  | null
  | undefined;

function normalizeRosterScope(scope: GrowthRosterScope): {
  actorId: string | null;
  schoolId: string | null;
  supervisorId: string | null;
  teacherIds: string[] | null;
} {
  if (typeof scope === "string") {
    return {
      actorId: null,
      schoolId: scope || null,
      supervisorId: null,
      teacherIds: null,
    };
  }
  if (!scope) {
    return { actorId: null, schoolId: null, supervisorId: null, teacherIds: null };
  }
  return {
    actorId: scope.id ?? null,
    schoolId: scope.schoolId ?? null,
    supervisorId: scope.supervisorId ?? null,
    teacherIds: Array.isArray(scope.teacherIds) ? scope.teacherIds.filter(Boolean) : null,
  };
}

/**
 * The roster result: the rows array itself, augmented with the
 * `{ ok: true, data: { rows } }` envelope so BOTH consumption styles
 * compile and behave identically:
 *   - array style   -> roster.length, roster.map(...)          (pages)
 *   - envelope style-> roster.ok ? roster.data.rows : []       (analytics)
 */
export type GrowthRosterCollection = GrowthRosterRow[] & {
  ok: true;
  data: { rows: GrowthRosterRow[] };
};

/**
 * The growth roster: every teacher of the requested scope with their
 * level, the 60% gate numbers, hours vs the 35-hour target, active
 * certificates and the mean of best assessment percentages.
 * Supervisors pass their own id — the scope then collapses to exactly
 * the teachers they are authorized to see (assignments ∪ branches).
 *
 * Returns a GrowthRosterCollection: the rows array augmented with the
 * `{ ok: true, data: { rows } }` envelope (see the type above), so
 * legacy ActionState-style callers keep compiling unchanged.
 */
export async function listGrowthRoster(
  scope?: GrowthRosterScope
): Promise<GrowthRosterCollection> {
  const { actorId, schoolId, supervisorId: explicitSupervisorId, teacherIds } =
    normalizeRosterScope(scope);

  // Backward-compatible actor scoping: a bare `id` only narrows the
  // roster when it really belongs to an educational supervisor —
  // admins and office managers keep the whole (school-scoped) roster.
  let supervisorId = explicitSupervisorId;
  if (!supervisorId && actorId) {
    const actor = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: actorId },
      select: { role: true },
    });
    if (actor?.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") supervisorId = actorId;
  }

  let teachers: TeacherRecord[];
  if (supervisorId) {
    const scoped = await supervisorScopedTeacherRecords(supervisorId);
    teachers = scoped.ok ? scoped.data : [];
    if (schoolId) {
      teachers = teachers.filter((teacher) => teacher.schoolId === schoolId);
    }
  } else if (teacherIds && teacherIds.length > 0) {
    teachers = await db.user.findMany({
      where: {
        role: "TEACHER",
        id: { in: teacherIds },
        ...(schoolId ? { schoolId } : {}),
      },
      select: growthTeacherSelect,
    });
  } else {
    teachers = await db.user.findMany({
      where: { role: "TEACHER", ...(schoolId ? { schoolId } : {}) },
      select: growthTeacherSelect,
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
    });
  }

  const rows = await buildGrowthRows(teachers);
  const roster: GrowthRosterRow[] = rows.map((row) => ({
    teacherId: row.teacher.id,
    teacherName: row.teacher.name,
    email: row.teacher.email,
    schoolId: row.teacher.schoolId,
    schoolName: row.teacher.schoolName,
    branchName: row.teacher.branchName,
    stage: row.teacher.stage,
    subject: row.teacher.subject,
    level: row.currentLevel,
    levelLabel: growthLevelLabel(row.currentLevel),
    suggestedLevel: row.suggestedLevel,
    nextLevel: row.nextLevel,
    nextLevelLabel: row.nextLevel ? growthLevelLabel(row.nextLevel) : null,
    coursesEnrolled: row.stats.assigned,
    coursesCompleted: row.stats.completed,
    completionPercentage: row.stats.percent,
    certificatesActive: row.stats.certificates,
    hoursCompleted: row.stats.hours,
    hoursTarget: ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET,
    avgBestPercentage: row.stats.avgPercentage,
    eligible: row.eligible,
    isActive: row.teacher.isActive,
  }));

  // Envelope augmentation — `rows` is a shallow copy so the collection
  // stays JSON-serializable (no self-referencing cycle).
  return Object.assign(roster, {
    ok: true as const,
    data: { rows: roster.slice() },
  });
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Platform / school stats                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface GrowthSchoolStats {
  schoolId: string | null;
  schoolName: string;
  teachers: number;
  eligible: number;
  certificates: number;
  /** Hours accumulated in the ACTIVE academic year (real completions). */
  hoursThisYear: number;
  /** Mean of the teachers' completion percentages (0 when empty). */
  avgCompletion: number;
  levelCounts: Record<GrowthLevelId, number>;
}

export interface PlatformGrowthStats {
  academicYear: string;
  targetHours: number;
  totals: {
    teachers: number;
    eligible: number;
    certificates: number;
    hoursThisYear: number;
    avgCompletion: number;
  };
  byLevel: Array<{ id: GrowthLevelId; nameAr: string; count: number }>;
  schools: GrowthSchoolStats[];
}

/**
 * Aggregated growth statistics for the /growth landing page. `schoolId`
 * narrows everything to one school (office manager); null = platform.
 */
export async function getPlatformGrowthStats(
  schoolId?: string | null
): Promise<PlatformGrowthStats> {
  const academicYear = await getActiveAcademicYear();

  const [teachers, yearCompletions] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findMany({
      where: { role: "TEACHER", ...(schoolId ? { schoolId } : {}) },
      select: growthTeacherSelect,
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
    }),
    db.courseCompletion.findMany({
      where: { academicYear },
      select: { hours: true, user: { select: { id: true, schoolId: true } } },
    }),
  ]);

  const rows = await buildGrowthRows(teachers);

  const hoursByTeacher = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const completion of yearCompletions) {
    if (schoolId && completion.user.schoolId !== schoolId) continue;
    hoursByTeacher.set(
      completion.user.id,
      (hoursByTeacher.get(completion.user.id) ?? 0) + Number(completion.hours ?? 0)
    );
  }

  const emptyLevels = (): Record<GrowthLevelId, number> => ({
    T0: 0, T1: 0, T2: 0, T3: 0, T4: 0, T5: 0,
  });

  const schools = new Map<string, GrowthSchoolStats>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const key = row.teacher.schoolId ?? "platform";
    let bucket = schools.get(key);
    if (!bucket) {
      bucket = {
        schoolId: row.teacher.schoolId,
        schoolName: row.teacher.schoolName ?? "غير محدد",
        teachers: 0,
        eligible: 0,
        certificates: 0,
        hoursThisYear: 0,
        avgCompletion: 0,
        levelCounts: emptyLevels(),
      };
      schools.set(key, bucket);
    }
    bucket.teachers += 1;
    if (row.eligible) bucket.eligible += 1;
    bucket.certificates += row.stats.certificates;
    bucket.hoursThisYear += hoursByTeacher.get(row.teacher.id) ?? 0;
    bucket.avgCompletion += row.stats.percent;
    bucket.levelCounts[row.currentLevel] += 1;
  }

  const schoolList = [...schools.values()].map((bucket) => ({
    ...bucket,
    hoursThisYear: Math.round(bucket.hoursThisYear * 10) / 10,
    avgCompletion:
      bucket.teachers === 0
        ? 0
        : Math.round(bucket.avgCompletion / bucket.teachers),
  }));
  schoolList.sort((a, b) => a.schoolName.localeCompare(b.schoolName, "ar"));

  const byLevel = GROWTH_LEVELS.map((level) => ({
    id: level.id,
    nameAr: level.nameAr,
    count: schoolList.reduce((sum, bucket) => sum + bucket.levelCounts[level.id], 0),
  }));

  const totalTeachers = rows.length;
  const totalPercent = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.stats.percent, 0);

  return {
    academicYear,
    targetHours: ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET,
    totals: {
      teachers: totalTeachers,
      eligible: rows.filter((row) => row.eligible).length,
      certificates: rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.stats.certificates, 0),
      hoursThisYear:
        Math.round(
          [...hoursByTeacher.values()].reduce((sum, hours) => sum + hours, 0) * 10
        ) / 10,
      avgCompletion:
        totalTeachers === 0 ? 0 : Math.round(totalPercent / totalTeachers),
    },
    byLevel,
    schools: schoolList,
  };
}

/**

export interface TeacherGrowthProjection {

/** Assessments the teacher can actually see (course-bound + school-wide). */
async function teacherVisibleAssessments(teacherId: string, schoolId: string | null) {
  return db.assessment.findMany({
    where: {
      status: "PUBLISHED",
      OR: [
        ...(schoolId ? [{ schoolId }] : []),
        { course: { completions: { some: { userId: teacherId } } } },
      ],
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      status: true,
      attempts: {
        where: { userId: teacherId },
        orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
        select: {
          id: true,
          status: true,
          percentage: true,
          passed: true,
          submittedAt: true,
        },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 50,
  });
}

export async function getTeacherGrowth(
  teacherId: string
): Promise<TeacherGrowthProjection | null> {
  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: teacherId },
    select: growthTeacherSelect,
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER") return null;

  const [rows, hours, history] = await Promise.all([
    buildGrowthRows([teacher]),
    teacherHoursSummary(teacherId),
    teacherGrowthHistory(teacherId, 20),
  ]);
  const row = rows[0];
  if (!row) return null;

  // Assigned published courses (platform-wide + own school), HTML parity.
  const assignedCourses = await db.course.findMany({
    where: {
      status: "PUBLISHED",
      OR: [{ schoolId: null }, ...(teacher.schoolId ? [{ schoolId: teacher.schoolId }] : [])],
    },
    select: { id: true, titleAr: true, estimatedHours: true, status: true },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });

  const completions = await db.courseCompletion.findMany({
    where: { userId: teacherId, courseId: { in: assignedCourses.map((course) => course.id) } },
    select: {
      courseId: true,
      completedAt: true,
      bestPercentage: true,
      certificateId: true,
    },
  });
  const completionByCourse = new Map(completions.map((item) => [item.courseId, item]));

  const assessments = await teacherVisibleAssessments(teacherId, teacher.schoolId);
  const assignments = teacher.schoolId
    ? await db.assignment.findMany({
        where: {
          schoolId: teacher.schoolId,
          status: { in: ["PUBLISHED", "CLOSED"] },
          OR: [
            { audienceMode: "ALL_TEACHERS" },
            {
              audienceMode: "TEACHERS",
              targetTeacherIdsJson: { contains: teacher.id },
            },
            ...(teacher.branchId
              ? [{ audienceMode: "BRANCHES", targetBranchIdsJson: { contains: teacher.branchId } }]
              : []),
          ],
        },
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          status: true,
          dueAt: true,
          totalPoints: true,
          submissions: {
            where: { teacherId },
            select: { status: true, submittedAt: true, scoreTotal: true },
          },
        },
        orderBy: { dueAt: "desc" },
        take: 50,
      })
    : [];

  const certificates = await db.certificate.findMany({
    where: { teacherId },
    orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" },
    take: 20,
    select: {
      id: true,
      certificateNumber: true,
      titleAr: true,
      status: true,
      issuedAt: true,
    },
  });

  return {
    teacher: {
      id: teacher.id,
      name: teacher.name,
      schoolName: teacher.school?.nameAr ?? null,
      stage: teacher.stage,
      subject: teacher.subject,
    },
    currentLevel: row.currentLevel,
    currentLabel: growthLevelLabel(row.currentLevel),
    nextLevel: row.nextLevel,
    nextLabel: row.nextLevel ? growthLevelLabel(row.nextLevel) : null,
    suggestedLevel: row.suggestedLevel,
    suggestedLabel: growthLevelLabel(row.suggestedLevel),
    completionPercentage: row.stats.percent,
    coursesAssigned: row.stats.assigned,
    coursesCompleted: row.stats.completed,
    eligible: row.eligible,
    academicYear: hours.academicYear,
    hoursCompleted: hours.hours,
    hoursTarget: hours.target,
    hoursPercent: hours.percent,
    courses: assignedCourses.map((course) => {
      const completion = completionByCourse.get(course.id);
      return {
        id: course.id,
        titleAr: course.titleAr,
        hours: course.estimatedHours,
        status: course.status,
        completed: Boolean(completion),
        completedAt: completion?.completedAt ?? null,
        bestPercentage: completion?.bestPercentage ?? null,
        certificateId: completion?.certificateId ?? null,
      };
    }),
    assessments: assessments.map((assessment) => {
      const graded = assessment.attempts.filter(
        (attempt) => attempt.percentage !== null
      );
      const best = graded.reduce<number | null>(
        (best, attempt) =>
          best === null || (attempt.percentage ?? 0) > best
            ? (attempt.percentage ?? 0)
            : best,
        null
      );
      return {
        id: assessment.id,
        titleAr: assessment.titleAr,
        status: assessment.status,
        attempts: assessment.attempts.length,
        bestPercentage: best,
        passed: graded.some((attempt) => attempt.passed === true),
        lastAttemptAt: assessment.attempts[0]?.submittedAt ?? null,
      };
    }),
    assignments: assignments.map((assignment) => ({
      id: assignment.id,
      titleAr: assignment.titleAr,
      status: assignment.status,
      dueAt: assignment.dueAt,
      submissionStatus: assignment.submissions[0]?.status ?? null,
      submittedAt: assignment.submissions[0]?.submittedAt ?? null,
      score: assignment.submissions[0]?.scoreTotal ?? null,
      totalPoints: assignment.totalPoints,
    })),
    certificates: certificates.map((certificate) => ({
      id: certificate.id,
      certificateNumber: certificate.certificateNumber,
      titleAr: certificate.titleAr,
      status: certificate.status,
      issuedAt: certificate.issuedAt,
    })),
    history,
  };
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — outcome-measurement dashboard service (role-adaptive).
 *
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                → platform-wide AGGREGATES per school
 *                                (no record access, no operational data).
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER → school impact overview: survey response
 *                                rates, stage comparisons list, follow-up
 *                                completion, reported challenges/support.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     → same shape restricted to their own
 *                                surveys + responsible follow-ups.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY         → read-only school aggregates within grants.
 *
 * Every figure is computed from persisted rows with an explicit
 * denominator. Observed deltas are labeled as such — no causality
 * claims and no invented baselines anywhere in this module.
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  canViewPlatformImpact,
  canViewSurveyResults,
  canViewSurveySummaries,
  type SurveyActor,
} from "@/lib/surveys/access";
import { getFollowUpMetrics, type FollowUpMetrics } from "@/lib/followups/service";
import { getSurveyMetrics, type SurveyMetrics } from "@/lib/surveys/service";
import { surveyFail, type SurveyResult } from "@/lib/validation/surveys";
import { IMPACT_SCHOOLS_LIMIT } from "@/config/surveys";

export interface ImpactStagePairRow {
  surveyId: string;
  surveyTitle: string;
  stage: string;
  submittedCount: number;
  hasComparisonData: boolean;
}

export interface SchoolImpactOverview {
  surveys: SurveyMetrics;
  followUps: FollowUpMetrics;
  /** Published/closed stage surveys eligible for pre/post comparison. */
  stageSurveyCount: number;
}

export interface PlatformSchoolImpactRow {
  schoolId: string;
  schoolName: string;
  surveysCount: number;
  submittedResponses: number;
  followUpsCount: number;
  completedFollowUps: number;
}

export interface PlatformImpactStats {
  schools: PlatformSchoolImpactRow[];
  totals: {
    schools: number;
    surveys: number;
    submittedResponses: number;
    followUps: number;
    completedFollowUps: number;
  };
}

export async function getSchoolImpactOverview(
  ctx: SurveyActor
): Promise<SurveyResult<SchoolImpactOverview>> {
  if (!canViewSurveySummaries(ctx.role)) {
    return surveyFail("لوحة قياس الأثر متاحة للأدوار الإدارية المدرسية فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const [surveys, followUps] = await Promise.all([
    getSurveyMetrics(ctx),
    getFollowUpMetrics(ctx),
  ]);
  if (!surveys.ok) return surveys;
  if (!followUps.ok) return followUps;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      surveys: surveys.data,
      followUps: followUps.data,
      stageSurveyCount: await countStageSurveys(ctx),
    },
  };
}

/** Stage surveys (pre/after) in scope — the input to impact comparison. */
async function countStageSurveys(ctx: SurveyActor): Promise<number> {
  let schoolId = ctx.schoolId;
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    const grant = await db.deputyGrant.findFirst({ where: { userId: ctx.id }, select: { schoolId: true } });
    schoolId = grant?.schoolId ?? null;
  }
  if (!schoolId) return 0;
  const where: Record<string, unknown> = {
    schoolId,
    stage: { in: ["PRE_TRAINING", "AFTER_TRAINING"] },
    status: { in: ["PUBLISHED", "CLOSED"] },
  };
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") where.ownerUserId = ctx.id;
  return db.survey.count({ where });
}

/**
 * Stage-pair candidates for the impact dashboard: stage surveys with a
 * pairing code, listed with submission counts. The actual pairing math
 * lives in getStageComparison (survey service) per survey page.
 */
export async function listStagePairCandidates(
  ctx: SurveyActor
): Promise<SurveyResult<ImpactStagePairRow[]>> {
  if (!canViewSurveyResults(ctx.role)) {
    return surveyFail("غير مصرح", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  let schoolId = ctx.schoolId;
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    const grant = await db.deputyGrant.findFirst({ where: { userId: ctx.id }, select: { schoolId: true } });
    schoolId = grant?.schoolId ?? null;
  }
  if (!schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("النطاق المدرسي غير محدد", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const where: Record<string, unknown> = {
    schoolId,
    stage: { not: null },
    linkPairCode: { not: null },
    status: { in: ["PUBLISHED", "CLOSED"] },
  };
  if (ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") where.ownerUserId = ctx.id;

  const surveys = await db.survey.findMany({
    where,
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      stage: true,
      _count: { select: { responses: { where: { status: "SUBMITTED" } } } },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 20,
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: surveys.map((survey) => ({
      surveyId: survey.id,
      surveyTitle: survey.titleAr,
      stage: survey.stage ?? "",
      submittedCount: survey._count.responses,
      hasComparisonData: survey._count.responses > 0,
    })),
  };
}

export async function getPlatformImpactStats(
  ctx: SurveyActor
): Promise<SurveyResult<PlatformImpactStats>> {
  if (!canViewPlatformImpact(ctx.role)) {
    return surveyFail("إحصاءات المنصة متاحة لمدير المنصة فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const schools = await db.school.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
    orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
    take: IMPACT_SCHOOLS_LIMIT,
  });

  const rows: PlatformSchoolImpactRow[] = [];
  let surveysTotal = 0;
  let responsesTotal = 0;
  let followUpsTotal = 0;
  let completedTotal = 0;

  for (const school of schools) {
    const [surveysCount, submittedResponses, followUpsCount, completedFollowUps] = await Promise.all([
      db.survey.count({ where: { schoolId: school.id } }),
      db.surveyResponse.count({ where: { schoolId: school.id, status: "SUBMITTED" } }),
      db.followUp.count({ where: { schoolId: school.id } }),
      db.followUp.count({ where: { schoolId: school.id, status: "COMPLETED" } }),
    ]);
    rows.push({
      schoolId: school.id,
      schoolName: school.nameAr,
      surveysCount,
      submittedResponses,
      followUpsCount,
      completedFollowUps,
    });
    surveysTotal += surveysCount;
    responsesTotal += submittedResponses;
    followUpsTotal += followUpsCount;
    completedTotal += completedFollowUps;
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      schools: rows,
      totals: {
        schools: schools.length,
        surveys: surveysTotal,
        submittedResponses: responsesTotal,
        followUps: followUpsTotal,
        completedFollowUps: completedTotal,
      },
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — transactional email provider abstraction.
 *
 * Design rules:
 *  - Server-side only. Credentials never leave this module; the UI sees
 *    only a configured/not-configured boolean (see integrations status).
 *  - Zero new dependencies: the provider is called over HTTPS with the
 *    platform's global fetch (Resend HTTP API), with a hard timeout.
 *  - Honest results: the caller receives either a real provider message
 *    id or a structured failure with a SANITIZED error category. Nothing
 *    here ever claims success without the provider confirming it.
 *  - Tests inject their own fetch implementation; production never does.
 */

export interface EmailSendInput {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface EmailSendResult {
  /** Provider message id — persisted on EmailDelivery for tracing. */
  messageId: string;
}

/** Sanitized error surfaced to the queue worker (stored on the row). */
export class EmailProviderError extends Error {
  /** One of EMAIL_ERROR_CATEGORIES — safe to persist and display. */
  category: string;
  /** Short, sanitized human message (provider raw text is truncated). */
  detail: string;

  constructor(category: string, detail: string) {
    super(detail);
    this.name = "EmailProviderError";
    this.category = category;
    this.detail = detail;
  }
}

export interface EmailProvider {
  kind: string;
  send(input: EmailSendInput): Promise<EmailSendResult>;
}

export interface ResendProviderConfig {
  apiKey: string;
  from: string;
  /** Optional reply-to address (validated same as from). */
  replyTo?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS_DEFAULT = 10_000;
const MAX_RESPONSE_SNIPPET = 160;

function truncate(text: string): string {
  const clean = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return clean.length > MAX_RESPONSE_SNIPPET ? `${clean.slice(0, MAX_RESPONSE_SNIPPET)}…` : clean;
}

function categorizeStatus(status: number): string {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return "AUTH";
  if (status === 400 || status === 422) return "VALIDATION";
  if (status === 429) return "RATE_LIMIT";
  return "PROVIDER";
}

/**
 * Builds the Resend HTTP provider. `fetchImpl` exists ONLY for tests —
 * production callers use the default global fetch.
 */
export function createResendProvider(
  config: ResendProviderConfig,
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch,
): EmailProvider {
  const doFetch = fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  return {
    kind: "RESEND",
    async send(input: EmailSendInput): Promise<EmailSendResult> {
      const timeoutMs = config.timeoutMs ?? REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS_DEFAULT;
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
      try {
        const response = await doFetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
          method: "POST",
          signal: controller.signal,
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${config.apiKey}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            from: config.from,
            to: [input.to],
            subject: input.subject,
            html: input.html,
            text: input.text,
            ...(config.replyTo ? { reply_to: config.replyTo } : {}),
          }),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          const bodyText = await response.text().catch(() => "");
          throw new EmailProviderError(
            categorizeStatus(response.status),
            `provider responded ${response.status}: ${truncate(bodyText) || "(no body)"}`,
          );
        }

        const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as { id?: unknown } | null;
        const messageId = typeof payload?.id === "string" ? payload.id : "";
        if (!messageId) {
          throw new EmailProviderError(
            "PROVIDER",
            "provider accepted the message but returned no message id",
          );
        }
        return { messageId };
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof EmailProviderError) throw error;
        if (error instanceof Error && error.name === "AbortError") {
          throw new EmailProviderError("NETWORK", `request timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
        }
        throw new EmailProviderError(
          "NETWORK",
          `network failure: ${error instanceof Error ? truncate(error.message) : "unknown"}`,
        );
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    },
  };
}

/* ---- Configuration resolution ------------------------------------- */

const EMAIL_ADDRESS_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$/;

/** Extracts the bare address from "Name <a@b.c>" or "a@b.c" forms. */
export function extractEmailAddress(value: string): string | null {
  const angle = value.match(/<\s*([^>]+)\s*>/);
  const candidate = (angle ? angle[1] : value).trim();
  return EMAIL_ADDRESS_RE.test(candidate) ? candidate.toLowerCase() : null;
}

export type ResolvedEmailProvider =
  | { configured: true; provider: EmailProvider; fromAddress: string }
  | { configured: false; reason: string };

/**
 * Resolves the active provider from environment variables. Never throws,
 * never logs secret values — the returned shape is safe to render
 * (booleans + reason keys only; the API key itself is not included).
 *
 * Required environment variables (documented in .env.example):
 *   RESEND_API_KEY  — secret API key for the Resend account.
 *   EMAIL_FROM      — "Platform Name <no-reply@domain>" or "no-reply@domain".
 *   EMAIL_REPLY_TO  — optional.
 */
export function resolveEmailProvider(): ResolvedEmailProvider {
  const apiKey = (process.env.RESEND_API_KEY ?? "").trim();
  const from = (process.env.EMAIL_FROM ?? "").trim();
  const replyTo = (process.env.EMAIL_REPLY_TO ?? "").trim();

  if (!apiKey) return { configured: false, reason: "MISSING_RESEND_API_KEY" };
  if (!from) return { configured: false, reason: "MISSING_EMAIL_FROM" };
  const fromAddress = extractEmailAddress(from);
  if (!fromAddress) return { configured: false, reason: "INVALID_EMAIL_FROM" };
  if (replyTo && !extractEmailAddress(replyTo)) {
    return { configured: false, reason: "INVALID_EMAIL_REPLY_TO" };
  }

  return {
    configured: true,
    provider: createResendProvider({
      apiKey,
      from,
      ...(replyTo ? { replyTo: extractEmailAddress(replyTo) ?? undefined } : {}),
    }),
    fromAddress,
  };
}

/** Masks an email for UI display: `ab***@domain.tld`. Never reverses. */
export function maskEmail(email: string): string {
  const at = email.indexOf("@");
  if (at <= 0) return "***";
  const local = email.slice(0, at);
  const domain = email.slice(at + 1);
  const head = local.slice(0, Math.min(2, local.length));
  return `${head}${"*".repeat(Math.max(3, Math.min(6, local.length - head.length)))}@${domain}`;
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — Arabic RTL transactional email templates.
 *
 * All templates render server-side into self-contained HTML (inline CSS,
 * dir="rtl") plus a plain-text fallback. Values are HTML-escaped; the
 * only URL interpolated into an href is the app's own absolute URL built
 * from APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (validated by appPublicOrigin()).
 *
 * Bilingual support: the platform UI is Arabic-first, so emails ship in
 * Arabic only — no half-translated English mirrors (consistent with the
 * rest of the product).
 */

const PLATFORM_NAME = "منصة تطوير المعلمين بمنارة قرطبة";
const BRAND_BLUE = "#1D5BD6";

export interface RenderedEmail {
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text: string;
}

export function escapeHtml(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

/** Arabic date+time formatting consistent with the in-app formatDate. */
export function formatEmailDate(date: Date | string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!date) return "—";
  const value = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date);
  if (Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) return "—";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
    numberingSystem: "latn",
  }).format(value);
}

function layout(options: {
  title: string;
  bodyHtml: string;
  schoolName?: string | null;
  cta?: { label: string; url: string } | null;
  footerNote?: string | null;
}): { html: string; text: string } {
  const { title, bodyHtml, schoolName, cta, footerNote } = options;
  const issuer = schoolName ? `${PLATFORM_NAME} — ${schoolName}` : PLATFORM_NAME;
  const ctaHtml = cta
    ? `<table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="margin:24px auto 0"><tr><td style="border-radius:10px;background:${BRAND_BLUE}"><a href="${escapeHtml(cta.url)}" style="display:inline-block;padding:12px 28px;font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffffff;text-decoration:none;border-radius:10px">${escapeHtml(cta.label)}</a></td></tr></table>`
    : "";
  const ctaText = cta ? `\n${cta.label}: ${cta.url}` : "";
  const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title></head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f1f5f9;font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;direction:rtl">
  <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="background:#f1f5f9;padding:24px 12px">
    <tr><td align="center">
      <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="max-width:560px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;overflow:hidden">
        <tr><td style="background:${BRAND_BLUE};padding:20px 28px;text-align:center">
          <div style="color:#ffffff;font-size:16px;font-weight:bold">${escapeHtml(issuer)}</div>
        </td></tr>
        <tr><td style="padding:28px">
          <h1 style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:19px;color:#0f172a;line-height:1.6">${escapeHtml(title)}</h1>
          <div style="font-size:14px;color:#334155;line-height:1.9">${bodyHtml}</div>
          ${ctaHtml}
        </td></tr>
        <tr><td style="background:#f8fafc;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:16px 28px">
          <p style="margin:0;font-size:12px;color:#64748b;line-height:1.8">${
            footerNote
              ? escapeHtml(footerNote)
              : "هذه رسالة آلية من المنصة. لإدارة تفضيلات الإشعارات تفضّل بزيارة صفحة «تفضيلات الإشعارات» داخل حسابك."
          }</p>
        </td></tr>
      </table>
    </td></tr>
  </table>
</body>
</html>`;
  const text = `${title}\n\n${stripTags(bodyHtml)}${ctaText}\n\n— ${issuer}`;
  return { html, text };
}

function stripTags(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

      const rendered = layout({
        title: "أحسنت — أكملت مقررًا تدريبيًا",
        bodyHtml: `${greeting(params)}<br>استوفيت جميع متطلبات مقرر<strong>«${escapeHtml(params.courseTitleAr)}»</strong> وفق قواعد الإكمال المعتمدة. قد تكون مؤهلًا لشهادة إتمام — راجع صفحة النمو المهني.`,
        cta,
        schoolName: name,
      });
      return { subject: `إكمال مقرر: ${params.courseTitleAr}`, ...rendered };
    }
    case "generic-notification": {
      if (!params.titleAr) return null;
      const rendered = layout({
        title: params.titleAr,
        bodyHtml: `${greeting(params)}<br>${escapeHtml(params.bodyAr ?? "")}`,
        cta,
        schoolName: name,
      });
      return { subject: params.titleAr, ...rendered };
    }
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — integrations status & delivery health (role-scoped, secret-free).
 *
 * What each role sees (server-enforced):
 *  - SUPER_ADMIN: platform-wide provider configuration state (booleans +
 *    the non-secret from-address) and platform-wide delivery aggregates.
 *  - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: delivery aggregates for THEIR school only.
 *  - EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY: read-only aggregates for granted schools.
 *  - EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR / TEACHER: forbidden (they manage their own
 *    notifications & preferences instead).
 *
 * Secrets policy: API keys, CRON_SECRET and provider credentials are NEVER
 * returned — only configured/not-configured booleans. Recipient emails are
 * masked (a***@domain.tld) and no message bodies exist on delivery rows.
 */

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  EMAIL_DELIVERY_STATUSES,
  EMAIL_ERROR_CATEGORY_LABELS,
  appPublicOrigin,
} from "@/config/notifications";
import { resolveEmailProvider, maskEmail } from "@/lib/integrations/email/provider";
import type { AnalyticsActor, AnalyticsResult } from "@/lib/analytics/access";

export interface PlatformIntegrationStatus {
  email: {
    configured: boolean;
    providerKind: "RESEND" | "NONE";
    fromAddress: string | null;
    reason: string | null;
  };
  scheduler: {
    cronSecretConfigured: boolean;
    internalSchedulerEnabled: boolean;
    appOriginConfigured: boolean;
  };
}

/** Environment-derived status. Contains zero secret values by construction. */
export function getPlatformIntegrationStatus(): PlatformIntegrationStatus {
  const resolved = resolveEmailProvider();
  return {
    email: resolved.configured
      ? { configured: true, providerKind: "RESEND", fromAddress: resolved.fromAddress, reason: null }
      : { configured: false, providerKind: "NONE", fromAddress: null, reason: resolved.reason },
    scheduler: {
      cronSecretConfigured: Boolean((process.env.CRON_SECRET ?? "").trim()),
      internalSchedulerEnabled: (process.env.ENABLE_INTERNAL_SCHEDULER ?? "").trim() === "true",
      appOriginConfigured: Boolean(appPublicOrigin()),
    },
  };

export interface DeliveryFailureRow {
  id: string;
  subject: string;
  template: string;
  status: string;
  errorCategory: string | null;
  errorCategoryLabel: string | null;
  toEmailMasked: string;
  attemptCount: number;
  maxAttempts: number;
  provider: string | null;
  providerMessageId: string | null;
  lastAttemptAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface DeliveryHealth {
  totals: Record<string, number>;
  queueDepth: number;
  recentFailures: DeliveryFailureRow[];
  scope: "PLATFORM" | "SCHOOL";
}

/**
 * Role-scoped delivery health. Failures carry sanitized categories only —
 * the raw provider detail lives on the row for authorized operators but is
 * intentionally not surfaced through this read model either.
 */
export async function getDeliveryHealth(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
): Promise<AnalyticsResult<DeliveryHealth>> {
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || actor.role === "TEACHER") {
    return { ok: false, message: "حالة التكاملات متاحة لإدارة المنصة والمدارس فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const scope =
    actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? { where: {} as Record<string, unknown> }
      : await resolveScopeWhere(actor);

  if (scope === null) {
    return { ok: false, message: "لا توجد مدارس مصرّح لك بالاطلاع عليها", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const where = scope.where;
  const scopeKind: "PLATFORM" | "SCHOOL" = "schoolId" in where ? "SCHOOL" : "PLATFORM";

  const [statusCounts, failures] = await Promise.all([
    db.emailDelivery.groupBy({
      by: ["status"],
      where,
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
    db.emailDelivery.findMany({
      where: { ...where, status: "FAILED" },
      orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
      take: 10,
      select: {
        id: true,
        subject: true,
        template: true,
        status: true,
        toEmail: true,
        attemptCount: true,
        maxAttempts: true,
        provider: true,
        providerMessageId: true,
        lastErrorCategory: true,
        lastAttemptAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const totals: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const status of EMAIL_DELIVERY_STATUSES) totals[status] = 0;
  for (const group of statusCounts) totals[group.status] = group._count._all;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      totals,
      queueDepth: totals.QUEUED ?? 0,
      scope: scopeKind,
      recentFailures: failures.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        subject: row.subject,
        template: row.template,
        status: row.status,
        errorCategory: row.lastErrorCategory,
        errorCategoryLabel:
          row.lastErrorCategory &&
          row.lastErrorCategory in EMAIL_ERROR_CATEGORY_LABELS
            ? EMAIL_ERROR_CATEGORY_LABELS[
                row.lastErrorCategory as keyof typeof EMAIL_ERROR_CATEGORY_LABELS
              ]
            : null,
        toEmailMasked: maskEmail(row.toEmail),
        attemptCount: row.attemptCount,
        maxAttempts: row.maxAttempts,
        provider: row.provider,
        providerMessageId: row.providerMessageId,
        lastAttemptAt: row.lastAttemptAt ? row.lastAttemptAt.toISOString() : null,
        createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    },
  };
}

/** Resolves the tenant WHERE fragment for school-level actors; null = forbidden. */
async function resolveScopeWhere(
  actor: AnalyticsActor,
): Promise<{ where: Record<string, unknown> } | null> {
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" && actor.schoolId) {
    return { where: { schoolId: actor.schoolId } };
  }
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") {
    const { resolveReadableSchoolIds } = await import("@/lib/analytics/access");
    const readable = await resolveReadableSchoolIds(actor);
    if (!readable.ok || readable.data.length === 0) return null;
    // Aggregate across granted schools (one → exact filter, many → IN).
    return {
      where:
        readable.data.length === 1
          ? { schoolId: readable.data[0] }
          : { schoolId: { in: readable.data } },
    };
  }
  return null;
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* IT_COORDINATOR service — the coordinator's ENTIRE world.             */
/*                                                                      */
/* Exactly two capabilities, both enforced server-side:                 */
/*   1. Teacher ↔ supervisor assignments (assign / transfer / remove)   */
/*      for the coordinator's OWN school;                               */
/*   2. Teacher account recovery: issues the SAME single-use expiring   */
/*      password-reset token used by the public flow (hash-only at      */
/*      rest, 1h expiry, atomic single use) and emails it to the        */
/*      teacher's own address through the existing mail provider.       */
/*                                                                      */
/* Security contract:                                                   */
/*   - schoolId comes from the session context, never from the client;  */
/*   - no password is ever displayed, generated or logged — the link    */
/*     goes ONLY to the teacher's own email (never mailto:);            */

/*   - responses never disclose whether another school's teacher exists.*/

/**
 * Teachers of the coordinator's school with their current supervisor,
 * filterable by free text / branch / assignment status and paginated.
 * The school scope is FORCED from the context — a tampered filter can
 * never widen the result beyond the coordinator's own school.
 */
export async function listItWorkspace(
  ctx: ItCoordinatorContext,
  rawQuery: unknown
): Promise<ItServiceResult<ItWorkspaceData>> {
  const parsed = itTeacherQuerySchema.safeParse(rawQuery);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من معايير البحث ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const query = parsed.data;

  const where = {
    schoolId: ctx.schoolId, // forced — never from the client
    role: "TEACHER" as const,
    ...(query.q
      ? {
          OR: [
            { name: { contains: query.q } },
            { email: { contains: query.q.toLowerCase() } },
          ],
        }
      : {}),
    ...(query.branchId ? { branchId: query.branchId } : {}),
    ...(query.status === "ASSIGNED"
      ? { teacherSupervision: { isNot: null } }
      : {}),
    ...(query.status === "UNASSIGNED"
      ? { teacherSupervision: { is: null } }
      : {}),
  };

  const [total, teachers, supervisors, branches] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.count({ where }),
    db.user.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
        teacherSupervision: {
          include: {
            supervisor: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
            assignedBy: { select: { name: true } },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      skip: (query.page - 1) * IT_PAGE_SIZE,
      take: IT_PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
    db.user.findMany({
      where: {
        schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
        role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
        isActive: true,
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
    }),
    db.branch.findMany({
      where: { schoolId: ctx.schoolId, isActive: true },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    }),
  ]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / IT_PAGE_SIZE));

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: teachers.map((teacher) => ({
        id: teacher.id,
        name: teacher.name,
        email: teacher.email,
        branchName: teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
        isActive: teacher.isActive,
        isVerified: teacher.emailVerifiedAt !== null,
        viaRegistrationLink: teacher.registrationLinkId !== null,
        registeredAt: teacher.createdAt,
        supervisor: teacher.teacherSupervision?.supervisor ?? null,
        supervisorAssignedAt: teacher.teacherSupervision?.updatedAt ?? null,
        supervisorAssignedBy: teacher.teacherSupervision?.assignedBy?.name ?? null,
      })),
      supervisors,
      branches,
      total,
      page: Math.min(query.page, pageCount),
      pageCount,
      pageSize: IT_PAGE_SIZE,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Assign (or transfer) a teacher to a supervisor. Both accounts must
 * belong to the coordinator's OWN school; the teacher must be a
 * TEACHER and the target an ACTIVE EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR. The change
 * runs in a transaction — the previous row (unique per teacher) is
 * replaced, so the former supervisor loses explicit access immediately.
 */
export async function assignItTeacher(
  ctx: ItCoordinatorContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<ItServiceResult<{ teacherId: string; supervisorId: string }>> {
  const parsed = itAssignTeacherSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const [teacher, supervisor] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.teacherId } }),
    db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.supervisorId } }),
  ]);

  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || teacher.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المعلم غير موجود داخل مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة",
      code: "NOT_FOUND",
    };
  }
  if (
    !supervisor ||
    supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    supervisor.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId
  ) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المشرف المختار غير موجود داخل مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة",
      code: "NOT_FOUND",
    };
  }
  if (!supervisor.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "حساب المشرف المختار موقوف — اختر مشرفًا نشطًا",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.teacherSupervisorAssignment.deleteMany({
      where: { teacherId: teacher.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
    });
    await tx.teacherSupervisorAssignment.create({
      data: {
        teacherId: teacher.id,
        supervisorId: supervisor.id,
        schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
        // Assignment audit — who performed this assignment.
        assignedById: ctx.id,
      },
    });
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { teacherId: teacher.id, supervisorId: supervisor.id } };
}

/** Remove a teacher's current supervisor (idempotent, school-checked). */
export async function removeItTeacherSupervisor(
  ctx: ItCoordinatorContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<ItServiceResult<{ teacherId: string }>> {
  const parsed = itRemoveTeacherSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.teacherId },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المعلم غير موجود داخل مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة",
      code: "NOT_FOUND",
    };
  }

  await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.deleteMany({
    where: { teacherId: teacher.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { teacherId: teacher.id } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Account recovery                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ItRecoveryOutcome {
  /** Honest delivery flag — false means the provider failed/unconfigured. */
  emailSent: boolean;
  /** Masked target address (e.g. a***@domain) — never the token/link. */
  maskedEmail: string;
}

const RECOVERY_TTL_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000; // 1 hour
const MAX_LINKS_PER_TEACHER_PER_HOUR = 3;
const MAX_LINKS_PER_COORDINATOR_PER_HOUR = 20;

/** Reset-link URL builder — same shape as the public forgot-password flow. */
function passwordResetUrl(appBaseUrl: string, rawToken: string): string {
  return `${appBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/reset-password?token=${encodeURIComponent(rawToken)}`;
}

/** a***@domain — enough for the coordinator to confirm the target. */
function maskEmail(email: string): string {
  const [local, domain] = email.split("@");
  if (!local || !domain) return "•••";
  const head = local.slice(0, 1);
  return `${head}${"•".repeat(Math.min(3, Math.max(1, local.length - 1)))}@${domain}`;
}

/**
 * Per-coordinator in-process limiter (defense in depth on top of the
 * durable per-teacher cap). Documented limitations mirror the login
 * limiter: counters reset on restart and are not shared across
 * instances; the durable per-teacher cap below always applies.
 */
const coordinatorIssuance = new Map<string, number[]>();

function coordinatorRateLimited(coordinatorId: string): boolean {
  const now = Date.now();
  const recent = (coordinatorIssuance.get(coordinatorId) ?? []).filter(
    (t) => now - t < RECOVERY_TTL_WINDOW_MS
  );
  coordinatorIssuance.set(coordinatorId, recent);
  return recent.length >= MAX_LINKS_PER_COORDINATOR_PER_HOUR;
}

function recordCoordinatorIssuance(coordinatorId: string): void {
  const recent = coordinatorIssuance.get(coordinatorId) ?? [];
  recent.push(Date.now());
  coordinatorIssuance.set(coordinatorId, recent);
}

/**
 * Issue a recovery link for ONE teacher of the coordinator's school.
 * The raw token is NEVER returned, displayed or logged — it travels
 * exclusively inside the email sent to the teacher's own address via
 * the platform's existing mail provider.
 */
export async function issueItRecoveryLink(
  ctx: ItCoordinatorContext,
  raw: unknown,
  deps: { appBaseUrl: string; mailer?: MailSender }
): Promise<ItServiceResult<ItRecoveryOutcome>> {
  const parsed = itRecoverySchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  if (coordinatorRateLimited(ctx.id)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لقد أرسلت العديد من روابط الاستعادة خلال الساعة الأخيرة — حاول لاحقًا",
      code: "RATE_LIMITED",
    };
  }

  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.teacherId },
  });

  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || teacher.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المعلم غير موجود داخل مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة",
      code: "NOT_FOUND",
    };
  }
  if (!teacher.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "حساب هذا المعلم موقوف — تفعيل الحساب يتم من إدارة المدرسة أولًا",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  // Durable rate limit — tokens actually issued for this account in the
  // last hour (each issuance also voids previous unused tokens, so this
  // window reflects real recovery pressure).
  const since = new Date(Date.now() - RECOVERY_TTL_WINDOW_MS);
  const recentLinks = await db.passwordResetToken.count({
    where: { userId: teacher.id, createdAt: { gte: since } },
  });
  if (recentLinks >= MAX_LINKS_PER_TEACHER_PER_HOUR) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        "تم إرسال عدة روابط استعادة لهذا الحساب خلال الساعة الأخيرة — انتظر قليلًا قبل إعادة المحاولة",
      code: "RATE_LIMITED",
    };
  }

  // Same pipeline as the public forgot-password flow: 256-bit token,
  // SHA-256 hash stored, 1h expiry, atomic single use.
  const rawToken = await issuePasswordResetToken(teacher.id);
  recordCoordinatorIssuance(ctx.id);

  const mailer = deps.mailer ?? defaultMailSender;
  const sent = await mailer({
    to: teacher.email,
    ...buildPasswordResetEmail(
      teacher.name,
      passwordResetUrl(deps.appBaseUrl, rawToken)
    ),
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: { emailSent: sent.ok, maskedEmail: maskEmail(teacher.email) },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Dashboard statistics (real counts, own school only)                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Real, school-scoped counters for the IT coordinator dashboard. */
export async function getItDashboardStats(
  schoolId: string
): Promise<ItDashboardStats> {
  const since24h = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const [teachersActive, supervisorsActive, assignedActive, recoveryLinks24h] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.user.count({
        where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
      }),
      db.user.count({
        where: {
          schoolId,
          role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
          isActive: true,
        },
      }),
      db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.count({
        where: { schoolId, teacher: { isActive: true } },
      }),
      db.passwordResetToken.count({
        where: {
          createdAt: { gte: since24h },
          user: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER" },
        },
      }),
    ]);

  return {
    teachersActive,
    supervisorsActive,
    assignedActive,
    unassignedActive: Math.max(0, teachersActive - assignedActive),
    recoveryLinks24h,
  };
}

import nodemailer, { type Transporter } from "nodemailer";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Real email delivery via SMTP (nodemailer).                           */
/*                                                                      */
/* Configuration comes exclusively from environment variables — never   */
/* committed secrets. Two modes:                                        */
/*   EMAIL_MODE=ethereal  DEV ONLY: a throwaway Ethereal test account   */
/*                        is created at runtime; messages are real SMTP */
/*                        deliveries viewable through a preview URL    */
/*                        printed to the SERVER console (the URL does   */
/*                        not contain any token). Never use in prod.    */
/*   otherwise            SMTP_HOST/SMTP_PORT/SMTP_SECURE/SMTP_USER/    */
/*                        SMTP_PASS/MAIL_FROM are used.                 */
/*                                                                      */
/* Honesty contract: senders return { ok: false } on ANY failure and    */
/* callers must not treat the message as sent. Tokens are never logged; */
/* nothing sensitive is embedded in URLs besides the one-time token     */
/* itself (passwords are never in URLs).                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface MailPayload {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text: string;
}

export type MailSender = (
  payload: MailPayload
) => Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }>;

let cachedTransport: Transporter | null | undefined;

async function getTransport(): Promise<Transporter | null> {
  if (cachedTransport !== undefined) return cachedTransport;

  const {
    SMTP_HOST,
    SMTP_PORT,
    SMTP_SECURE,
    SMTP_USER,
    SMTP_PASS,
    EMAIL_MODE,
  } = process.env;

  if (EMAIL_MODE === "ethereal") {
    // DEV ONLY — throwaway account, real SMTP delivery, web preview.
    const account = await nodemailer.createTestAccount();
    cachedTransport = nodemailer.createTransport({
      host: account.smtp.host,
      port: account.smtp.port,
      secure: account.smtp.secure,
      auth: { user: account.user, pass: account.pass },
    });
    return cachedTransport;
  }

  if (SMTP_HOST) {
    cachedTransport = nodemailer.createTransport({
      host: SMTP_HOST,
      port: Number(SMTP_PORT ?? 587),
      secure: SMTP_SECURE === "true",
      auth: SMTP_USER ? { user: SMTP_USER, pass: SMTP_PASS ?? "" } : undefined,
    });
    return cachedTransport;
  }

  // No provider configured — senders will report honest failure.
  cachedTransport = null;
  return null;
}

export const defaultMailSender: MailSender = async (payload) => {
  try {
    const transport = await getTransport();
    if (!transport) {
      return { ok: false, error: "smtp_not_configured" };
    }
    const info = await transport.sendMail({
      from: process.env.MAIL_FROM ?? "منارة قرطبة <no-reply@manara-qurtuba.local>",
      ...payload,
    });

    // Dev preview link only — the URL itself contains no token.
    if (process.env.EMAIL_MODE === "ethereal") {
      const preview = nodemailer.getTestMessageUrl(info);
      if (typeof preview === "string") {
        console.info("[mail:dev-preview]", preview);
      }
    }
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "[mail] delivery failed:",
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
    );
    return { ok: false };
  }
};
