/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Media storage configuration — Cloudflare R2.                         */
/*                                                                      */
/* Honest degradation contract: when the R2 environment variables are   */
/* missing, DIRECT UPLOADS ARE DISABLED (isR2Configured → false) and    */
/* every UI surface must say so in plain Arabic instead of pretending.  */
/* External-URL media input keeps working with zero configuration.      */
/*                                                                      */
/* Credentials live ONLY on the server — this module is imported by     */
/* server code exclusively (actions, API routes). Client bundles never  */
/* see it: the client learns only the FINAL public URL of a file.       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type MediaKind = "image" | "video" | "document";

function positiveNumber(env: string | undefined, fallback: number): number {
  const parsed = Number(env);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback;
}

/** Upload size ceilings — server-verified (and pre-checked client-side). */
export const MEDIA_LIMITS = {
  /** Generic images (covers, program art, …). */
  image: positiveNumber(process.env.MEDIA_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES, 5 * 1024 * 1024),
  /** Lesson/course videos. Presigned PUT — never proxied through Next. */
  video: positiveNumber(process.env.MEDIA_MAX_VIDEO_BYTES, 512 * 1024 * 1024),
  /** School branding logos (matches lib/branding/validation LOGO_MAX_BYTES). */
  logo: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  /** Training attachments: PDF / Word / Excel / PowerPoint / audio /
   * text documents uploaded from the supervisor's device. */
  document: positiveNumber(process.env.MEDIA_MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES, 25 * 1024 * 1024),
} as const;

export const IMAGE_MIME_TYPES = [
  "image/png",
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/webp",
  "image/gif",
] as const;

export const VIDEO_MIME_TYPES = [
  "video/mp4",
  "video/webm",
  "video/quicktime",
] as const;

/** Training attachments — documents and audio. Images ride the "image"
 * kind (existing MIME list), everything else office-document/audio. */
export const DOCUMENT_MIME_TYPES = [
  "application/pdf",
  "application/msword",
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
  "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint",
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation",
  "application/vnd.ms-excel",
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
  "audio/mpeg",
  "audio/mp4",
  "audio/wav",
  "audio/x-wav",
  "audio/ogg",
  "text/plain",
] as const;

export function allowedMimeTypesFor(kind: MediaKind): readonly string[] {
  if (kind === "image") return IMAGE_MIME_TYPES;
  if (kind === "document") return DOCUMENT_MIME_TYPES;
  return VIDEO_MIME_TYPES;
}

export function maxBytesFor(kind: MediaKind): number {
  if (kind === "image") return MEDIA_LIMITS.image;
  if (kind === "document") return MEDIA_LIMITS.document;
  return MEDIA_LIMITS.video;
}

export function isAllowedMimeType(kind: MediaKind, mimeType: string): boolean {
  return (allowedMimeTypesFor(kind) as readonly string[]).includes(mimeType);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* R2 environment                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface R2StorageConfig {
  accountId: string;
  accessKeyId: string;
  secretAccessKey: string;
  bucket: string;
  /** Optional public base (custom domain or r2.dev). No trailing slash. */
  publicBaseUrl: string | null;
}

const R2_REQUIRED_ENV = [
  "R2_ACCOUNT_ID",
  "R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
  "R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
  "R2_BUCKET_NAME",
] as const;

/**
 * Resolved R2 config, or null when ANY required variable is missing.
 * Never throws — callers decide how to degrade.
 */
export function readR2Config(): R2StorageConfig | null {
  const accountId = process.env.R2_ACCOUNT_ID?.trim();
  const accessKeyId = process.env.R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID?.trim();
  const secretAccessKey = process.env.R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY?.trim();
  const bucket = process.env.R2_BUCKET_NAME?.trim();
  if (!accountId || !accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey || !bucket) return null;

  const rawPublic = process.env.R2_PUBLIC_URL?.trim() ?? "";
  let publicBaseUrl: string | null = null;
  if (rawPublic) {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(rawPublic);
      // Only https public bases — mixed content would be blocked anyway.
      if (parsed.protocol === "https:") {
        publicBaseUrl = parsed.origin + parsed.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "");
      }
    } catch {
      publicBaseUrl = null;
    }
  }

  return { accountId, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, bucket, publicBaseUrl };
}

/** Exactly-which variables are missing — powers the honest Arabic error. */
export function missingR2Env(): string[] {
  return R2_REQUIRED_ENV.filter((name) => !process.env[name]?.trim());
}

export function isR2Configured(): boolean {
  return readR2Config() !== null;
}

export const R2_ENDPOINT_BASE = "r2.cloudflarestorage.com";

/** Presigned URL lifetime for direct browser PUTs. */
export const PRESIGN_PUT_EXPIRES_SECONDS = 600;
/** Presigned GET lifetime used by the /api/media proxy redirect. */
export const PRESIGN_GET_EXPIRES_SECONDS = 300;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Cloudflare R2 storage service (server-only).                         */
/*                                                                      */
/* S3-compatible API through the official AWS SDK v3. The client is     */
/* created LAZILY and cached — importing this module never touches the  */
/* network and never requires credentials (they are needed only when a  */
/* storage operation actually runs).                                    */
/*                                                                      */
/* Key layout (collision-safe, tenant-scoped, kind-scoped):             */
/*   media/school-<schoolId>/image/2025/11/<rand>-<safe-name>.<ext>     */
/*   media/platform/video/2025/11/<rand>-<safe-name>.<ext>              */
/* Original filenames are preserved as DB metadata (originalName) and   */
/* slugified into the key for human-readable object listings.           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

import "server-only";

import {
  DeleteObjectCommand,
  GetObjectCommand,
  HeadObjectCommand,
  PutObjectCommand,
  S3Client,
} from "@aws-sdk/client-s3";
import { getSignedUrl } from "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner";
import crypto from "crypto";

import {
  PRESIGN_GET_EXPIRES_SECONDS,
  PRESIGN_PUT_EXPIRES_SECONDS,
  R2_ENDPOINT_BASE,
  readR2Config,
  type MediaKind,
} from "@/lib/media/config";

/** Thrown with a stable code so callers can map it to Arabic copy. */
export class MediaStorageError extends Error {
  code:
    | "R2_NOT_CONFIGURED"
    | "OBJECT_NOT_FOUND"
    | "OBJECT_TOO_LARGE"
    | "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE";

  constructor(
    code: MediaStorageError["code"],
    message: string
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "MediaStorageError";
    this.code = code;
  }
}

let cachedClient: S3Client | null = null;

function s3Client(): S3Client {
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) {
    throw new MediaStorageError(
      "R2_NOT_CONFIGURED",
      "Cloudflare R2 environment variables are not configured"
    );
  }
  if (!cachedClient) {
    cachedClient = new S3Client({
      region: "auto",
      endpoint: `https://${cfg.accountId}.${R2_ENDPOINT_BASE}`,
      credentials: {
        accessKeyId: cfg.accessKeyId,
        secretAccessKey: cfg.secretAccessKey,
      },
      requestChecksumCalculation: "WHEN_REQUIRED",
      responseChecksumValidation: "WHEN_REQUIRED",
    });
  }
  return cachedClient;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Keys                                                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function pad2(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
}

/** Keep a readable, filesystem-safe fragment of the original filename. */
function safeNameFragment(originalName: string, max = 60): string {
  const base = originalName.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? "file";
  const dot = base.lastIndexOf(".");
  const stem = (dot > 0 ? base.slice(0, dot) : base)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\u0600-\u06FF._-]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
    .slice(0, max);
  return stem || "file";
}

export function extensionForMime(mimeType: string): string | null {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    "image/png": "png",
    "image/jpeg": "jpg",
    "image/webp": "webp",
    "image/gif": "gif",
    "video/mp4": "mp4",
    "video/webm": "webm",
    "video/quicktime": "mov",
  };
  return map[mimeType] ?? null;
}

export interface BuildMediaKeyInput {
  kind: MediaKind;
  mimeType: string;
  originalName: string;
  /** Tenant scope: school id, or null for platform-level (SUPER_ADMIN). */
  schoolId: string | null;
}

export function buildMediaKey(input: BuildMediaKeyInput): string {
  const ext = extensionForMime(input.mimeType) ?? "bin";
  const now = new Date();
  const scope = input.schoolId ? `school-${input.schoolId}` : "platform";
  const rand = crypto.randomBytes(8).toString("hex");
  const name = safeNameFragment(input.originalName);
  return (
    `media/${scope}/${input.kind}/` +
    `${now.getFullYear()}/${pad2(now.getMonth() + 1)}/` +
    `${rand}-${name}.${ext}`
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* URL <-> key resolution                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** App-relative serving path when no public base is configured. */
export function mediaApiPathFor(key: string): string {
  const encoded = key
    .split("/")
    .map((segment) => encodeURIComponent(segment))
    .join("/");
  return `/api/media/${encoded}`;
}

/**
 * Final URL stored in the database for an R2 object:
 *  - with R2_PUBLIC_URL → direct public CDN/object URL;
 *  - without → the authenticated /api/media/… proxy (private by default).
 */
export function publicUrlFor(key: string): string {
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  const base = cfg?.publicBaseUrl ?? null;
  return base ? `${base}/${key}` : mediaApiPathFor(key);
}

/** Is this URL something this app manages in R2 (vs an external URL)? */
export function isManagedMediaUrl(url: string): boolean {
  if (url.startsWith("/api/media/")) return true;
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (cfg?.publicBaseUrl && url.startsWith(`${cfg.publicBaseUrl}/`)) return true;
  return false;
}

/** Inverse of publicUrlFor — null for external/unmanaged URLs. */
export function keyFromManagedUrl(url: string): string | null {
  if (url.startsWith("/api/media/")) {
    try {
      return url
        .slice("/api/media/".length)
        .split("/")
        .map((segment) => decodeURIComponent(segment))
        .join("/");
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (cfg?.publicBaseUrl && url.startsWith(`${cfg.publicBaseUrl}/`)) {
    return url.slice(cfg.publicBaseUrl.length + 1);
  }
  return null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Object operations                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Presigned PUT — the browser uploads DIRECTLY to R2 (progress via XHR);
 * the Next.js server never streams large files through an action. */
export async function presignedPutUrl(
  key: string,
  contentType: string
): Promise<string> {
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) {
    throw new MediaStorageError("R2_NOT_CONFIGURED", "R2 is not configured");
  }
  const command = new PutObjectCommand({
    Bucket: cfg.bucket,
    Key: key,
    ContentType: contentType,
  });
  return getSignedUrl(s3Client(), command, {
    expiresIn: PRESIGN_PUT_EXPIRES_SECONDS,
  });
}

export interface HeadInfo {
  sizeBytes: number;
  contentType: string | null;
}

export async function headObject(key: string): Promise<HeadInfo | null> {
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) {
    throw new MediaStorageError("R2_NOT_CONFIGURED", "R2 is not configured");
  }
  try {
    const out = await s3Client().send(
      new HeadObjectCommand({ Bucket: cfg.bucket, Key: key })
    );
    return {
      sizeBytes: out.ContentLength ?? 0,
      contentType: out.ContentType ?? null,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    const name = (error as { name?: string })?.name;
    if (name === "NotFound" || name === "404") return null;
    const meta = error as { $metadata?: { httpStatusCode?: number } };
    if (meta?.$metadata?.httpStatusCode === 404) return null;
    throw new MediaStorageError(
      "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : "R2 HEAD failed"
    );
  }
}

export async function deleteObject(key: string): Promise<void> {
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) {
    throw new MediaStorageError("R2_NOT_CONFIGURED", "R2 is not configured");
  }
  await s3Client().send(
    new DeleteObjectCommand({ Bucket: cfg.bucket, Key: key })
  );
}

/** Presigned GET — used by the /api/media proxy for private media. */
export async function presignedGetUrl(key: string): Promise<string> {
  const cfg = readR2Config();
  if (!cfg) {
    throw new MediaStorageError("R2_NOT_CONFIGURED", "R2 is not configured");
  }
  return getSignedUrl(
    s3Client(),
    new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: cfg.bucket, Key: key }),
    { expiresIn: PRESIGN_GET_EXPIRES_SECONDS }
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Media reference safety — orphan prevention.                          */
/*                                                                      */
/* Before an R2 object is deleted we count every database reference to  */
/* its stored URL. Only when the count reaches ZERO is the object       */
/* actually removed. Shared media (the same URL used by two schools or  */
/* two lessons) is therefore never destroyed by one side's edit.        */
/*                                                                      */
/* The list below must cover every URL-bearing media column. When a new */
/* media field is added to the schema, register it here — one line.     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

import "server-only";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

import { deleteObject, isManagedMediaUrl, keyFromManagedUrl } from "@/lib/media/r2";

/**
 * All references (across tenants) to an exact media URL.
 * Extend this function whenever a new media URL column is introduced.
 */
export async function countMediaReferences(url: string): Promise<number> {
  const [schools, lessons] = await Promise.all([
    db.school.count({ where: { logoUrl: url } }),
    db.courseLesson.count({ where: { videoUrl: url } }),
  ]);
  return schools + lessons;
}

export type ReleaseResult =
  | { released: true; deletedKey: string | null }
  | { released: false; reason: "EXTERNAL_URL" | "STILL_REFERENCED"; references: number };

/**
 * Called when a media URL is being replaced or cleared. Deletes the R2
 * object behind `url` ONLY when it is platform-managed AND no database
 * row references it anymore. External URLs pass through untouched, and
 * shared objects survive (caller keeps serving them).
 */
export async function releaseMediaIfUnreferenced(url: string | null | undefined): Promise<ReleaseResult> {
  if (!url || !isManagedMediaUrl(url)) {
    return { released: false, reason: "EXTERNAL_URL", references: 0 };
  }
  const references = await countMediaReferences(url);
  if (references > 0) {
    return { released: false, reason: "STILL_REFERENCED", references };
  }
  const key = keyFromManagedUrl(url);
  if (!key) return { released: false, reason: "EXTERNAL_URL", references: 0 };
  await deleteObject(key);
  return { released: true, deletedKey: key };
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\lib\media\video-url.ts

/**
 * Media URL intelligence — shared by the course builder preview, the
 * lesson player, the learning hub and the media proxy checks.
 *
 * Responsibility: classify a saved media URL into a provider and, for
 * embeddable providers (YouTube/Vimeo), extract the canonical video id
 * and the embed URL. Pure functions only — no network, no DB, safe to
 * import from client and server components alike.
 *
 * Security: URL parsing is strict (URL constructor), ids are validated
 * against tight character sets, and the returned embed URLs are always
 * built from validated parts — never by echoing user text back.
 */

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Public shape                                                        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ParsedEmbed {
  provider: "youtube" | "vimeo";
  /** Validated provider video id (safe charset only). */
  videoId: string;
  /** Start offset in seconds when the URL carries a timestamp (t= / start=). */
  startSeconds: number | null;
  /** Ready-to-iframe embed URL (privacy-friendly youtube-nocookie host). */
  embedUrl: string;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* YouTube                                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Canonical YouTube id: exactly 11 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Everything
 * else is rejected before it can ever reach an iframe or the player API.
 */
const YOUTUBE_ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$/;

function parseStartSeconds(url: URL): number {
  // Both ?t=30s / ?t=1m10s (watch + shorts) and ?start=70 (embed links).
  const raw = url.searchParams.get("t") ?? url.searchParams.get("start") ?? "";
  if (!raw) return 0;
  const value = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!value) return 0;
  // Compound forms like 1h2m3s — parse unit by unit, ignore anything else.
  const compound = value.match(/^(?:(\d+)h)?(?:(\d+)m)?(?:(\d+)s?)?$/);
  if (compound && (compound[1] || compound[2] || compound[3])) {
    return (
      Number(compound[1] ?? 0) * 3600 +
      Number(compound[2] ?? 0) * 60 +
      Number(compound[3] ?? 0)
    );
  }
  const plain = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(plain) && plain > 0 ? Math.floor(plain) : 0;
}

/**
 * Extract a YouTube video id from every format trainers actually paste:
 *   youtube.com/watch?v=ID           youtu.be/ID
 *   youtube.com/embed/ID             youtube.com/shorts/ID
 *   youtube.com/live/ID              m.youtube.com / music.youtube.com
 * plus arbitrary extra query parameters (timestamps, playlists, si=…).
 * Returns null for non-YouTube or invalid ids — never throws.
 */
export function parseYouTubeUrl(raw: string): {
  videoId: string;
  startSeconds: number;
} | null {
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(trimmed);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") return null;

  const host = url.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, "");
  const isYouTube =
    host === "youtube.com" ||
    host === "m.youtube.com" ||
    host === "music.youtube.com" ||
    host === "youtube-nocookie.com" ||
    host === "youtu.be";
  if (!isYouTube) return null;

  let candidate: string | null = null;
  if (host === "youtu.be") {
    // Short links: the first path segment IS the id.
    candidate = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean)[0] ?? null;
  } else if (url.searchParams.get("v")) {
    // Classic watch links (and /embed?type=…&v=… variants).
    candidate = url.searchParams.get("v");
  } else {
    // Path-based forms: /embed/ID, /shorts/ID, /live/ID, /v/ID.
    const segments = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    const marker = segments.findIndex(
      (segment) =>
        segment === "embed" ||
        segment === "shorts" ||
        segment === "live" ||
        segment === "v"
    );
    if (marker >= 0 && segments[marker + 1]) {
      candidate = segments[marker + 1];
    }
  }

  if (!candidate) return null;
  // Strip any trailing junk (defensive; URL parsing usually did already).
  const videoId = candidate.split(/[?#]/)[0] ?? "";
  if (!YOUTUBE_ID_PATTERN.test(videoId)) return null;

  return { videoId, startSeconds: parseStartSeconds(url) };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Vimeo                                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const VIMEO_ID_PATTERN = /^\d{6,10}$/;

export function parseVimeoUrl(raw: string): { videoId: string } | null {
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(trimmed);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") return null;
  const host = url.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, "");
  if (host !== "vimeo.com" && host !== "player.vimeo.com") return null;
  const segments = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  // vimeo.com/76979871 — the id is the first segment; player.vimeo.com
  // wraps it: /video/76979871.
  const candidate =
    host === "player.vimeo.com" && segments[0] === "video"
      ? (segments[1] ?? "")
      : (segments[0] ?? "");
  if (!VIMEO_ID_PATTERN.test(candidate)) return null;
  return { videoId: candidate };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Public helpers                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Classify any saved media URL. Returns null when the URL is neither a
 * YouTube nor a Vimeo link (uploaded R2 videos and direct files are NOT
 * embeddable — they go through the real <video> players).
 */
export function parseEmbeddableVideoUrl(raw: string): ParsedEmbed | null {
  const youtube = parseYouTubeUrl(raw);
  if (youtube) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ rel: "0", modestbranding: "1" });
    if (youtube.startSeconds > 0) params.set("start", String(youtube.startSeconds));
    return {
      provider: "youtube",
      videoId: youtube.videoId,
      startSeconds: youtube.startSeconds > 0 ? youtube.startSeconds : null,
      embedUrl: `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${youtube.videoId}?${params.toString()}`,
    };
  }
  const vimeo = parseVimeoUrl(raw);
  if (vimeo) {
    return {
      provider: "vimeo",
      videoId: vimeo.videoId,
      startSeconds: null,
      embedUrl: `https://player.vimeo.com/video/${vimeo.videoId}`,
    };
  }
  return null;
}

/** True when the URL belongs to the YouTube family (any format). */
export function isYouTubeUrl(raw: string): boolean {
  return parseYouTubeUrl(raw) !== null;
}

/** True when the URL is a direct video file our <video> player can play. */
export function isDirectVideoUrl(raw: string): boolean {
  if (!raw || isYouTubeUrl(raw) || parseVimeoUrl(raw)) return false;
  return true;
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  MESSAGE_TYPE_LABELS,
  isMessageType,
  type MessageType,
} from "@/config/growth";
import { notifyMessageReceived } from "@/lib/notifications/center";
import { supervisorScopedTeacherRecords } from "@/lib/growth/service";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — supervisor -> teacher platform messaging                   */
/* (HTML v38/v40 parity: نوع الرسالة + نص الرسالة، إرسال عبر المنصة).   */
/*                                                                      */
/* Every message is a persisted TeacherMessage row bound to real user   */
/* ids and ALSO flows through the notification center (category         */
/* MESSAGES) so the teacher's bell lights up. Scope rules (fail-closed):*/
/*   - EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR: only teachers inside their own scope     */
/*     (explicit assignment ∪ branch coverage, own school).             */
/*   - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: only teachers of their own school.   */
/*   - SUPER_ADMIN: any teacher.                                        */
/*   - TEACHER / EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY: never send (read-only roles).      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface MessageActor {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

export type MessageServiceResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code?: "FORBIDDEN" | "NOT_FOUND" | "VALIDATION_ERROR" };

export interface MessageRow {
  id: string;
  type: MessageType;
  typeLabel: string;
  body: string;
  senderId: string;
  senderName: string;
  recipientId: string;
  recipientName: string;
  readAt: Date | null;
  createdAt: Date;
}

const MAX_BODY_LENGTH = 2000;

/** The row shape shared by inbox and sent views. */
const messageSelect = {
  id: true,
  type: true,
  body: true,
  readAt: true,
  createdAt: true,
  sender: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
  recipient: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
} as const;

type MessageDbRow = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  body: string;
  readAt: Date | null;
  createdAt: Date;
  sender: { id: string; name: string };
  recipient: { id: string; name: string };
};

function toRow(message: MessageDbRow): MessageRow {
  const type: MessageType = isMessageType(message.type) ? message.type : "FOLLOW_UP";
  return {
    id: message.id,
    type,
    typeLabel: MESSAGE_TYPE_LABELS[type],
    body: message.body,
    senderId: message.sender.id,
    senderName: message.sender.name,
    recipientId: message.recipient.id,
    recipientName: message.recipient.name,
    readAt: message.readAt,
    createdAt: message.createdAt,
  };
}

/** Can this actor message this teacher? (scope + recipient sanity) */
async function canSendTo(actor: MessageActor, recipientId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const recipient = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: recipientId },
    select: { role: true, isActive: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!recipient || recipient.role !== "TEACHER" || !recipient.isActive) return false;

  switch (actor.role) {
    case "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR": {
      const scoped = await supervisorScopedTeacherRecords(actor.id);
      return scoped.ok && scoped.data.some((teacher) => teacher.id === recipientId);
    }
    case "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER":
      return Boolean(actor.schoolId) && recipient.schoolId === actor.schoolId;
    case "SUPER_ADMIN":
      return true;
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

export interface SendMessageInput {
  recipientId: string;
  type: string;
  body: string;
}

/** Compose + deliver one message (persisted + notified). */
export async function sendMessage(
  actor: MessageActor,
  input: SendMessageInput
): Promise<MessageServiceResult<MessageRow>> {
  const body = input.body.trim();
  if (!isMessageType(input.type)) {
    return { ok: false, message: "نوع الرسالة غير صالح", code: "VALIDATION_ERROR" };
  }
  if (body.length < 2 || body.length > MAX_BODY_LENGTH) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: `نص الرسالة مطلوب (حتى ${MAX_BODY_LENGTH} حرفًا)`,
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  if (!(await canSendTo(actor, input.recipientId))) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا تملك صلاحية مراسلة هذا المعلم",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  const created = await db.teacherMessage.create({
    data: {
      senderId: actor.id,
      recipientId: input.recipientId,
      type: input.type,
      body,
    },
    select: messageSelect,
  });

  await notifyMessageReceived({
    recipientId: input.recipientId,
    messageId: created.id,
    senderName: created.sender.name,
    typeLabel: MESSAGE_TYPE_LABELS[isMessageType(created.type) ? created.type : "FOLLOW_UP"],
    preview: body.length > 140 ? `${body.slice(0, 139)}…` : body,
  });

  return { ok: true, data: toRow(created) };
}

/** The actor's inbox (received messages, newest first). */
export async function listInbox(userId: string): Promise<MessageRow[]> {
  const rows = await db.teacherMessage.findMany({
    where: { recipientId: userId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 100,
    select: messageSelect,
  });
  return rows.map(toRow);
}

/** Messages the actor has sent (newest first). */
export async function listSent(senderId: string): Promise<MessageRow[]> {
  const rows = await db.teacherMessage.findMany({
    where: { senderId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 100,
    select: messageSelect,
  });
  return rows.map(toRow);
}

/** Ownership-safe mark-read (a foreign id matches nothing). */
export async function markMessageRead(
  userId: string,
  messageId: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const result = await db.teacherMessage.updateMany({
    where: { id: messageId, recipientId: userId, readAt: null },
    data: { readAt: new Date() },
  });
  return result.count > 0;
}

export async function unreadMessagesCount(userId: string): Promise<number> {
  return db.teacherMessage.count({ where: { recipientId: userId, readAt: null } });
}

export interface MessageRecipient {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  schoolName: string | null;
}

/**
 * The teachers this actor may message — the compose dialog list. The
 * list is resolved server-side from the actor's session scope.
 */
export async function composeRecipients(
  actor: MessageActor
): Promise<MessageRecipient[]> {
  switch (actor.role) {
    case "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR": {
      const scoped = await supervisorScopedTeacherRecords(actor.id);
      if (!scoped.ok) return [];
      return scoped.data
        .filter((teacher) => teacher.isActive)
        .map((teacher) => ({
          id: teacher.id,
          name: teacher.name,
          schoolName: teacher.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ar"));
    }
    case "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER": {
      if (!actor.schoolId) return [];
      const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
        where: { role: "TEACHER", isActive: true, schoolId: actor.schoolId },
        select: { id: true, name: true, school: { select: { nameAr: true } } },
        orderBy: { name: "asc" },
        take: 500,
      });
      return teachers.map((teacher) => ({
        id: teacher.id,
        name: teacher.name,
        schoolName: teacher.school?.nameAr ?? null,
      }));
    }
    case "SUPER_ADMIN": {
      const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
        where: { role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
        select: { id: true, name: true, school: { select: { nameAr: true } } },
        orderBy: { name: "asc" },
        take: 500,
      });
      return teachers.map((teacher) => ({
        id: teacher.id,
        name: teacher.name,
        schoolName: teacher.school?.nameAr ?? null,
      }));
    }
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\lib\notifications\center.ts

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 1 — the notification center: ONE real persistence path for     */
/* every platform event (replaces the old mock/demo bell data).         */
/*                                                                      */
/* Design rules:                                                        */
/*   - Recipients are always SERVER-RESOLVED user ids (never names,    */
/*     never client payloads);                                          */
/*   - destinationUrl is an INTERNAL path only (sanitized below);       */
/*   - eventId gives per-recipient idempotency: a repeated event        */
/*     collapses into the original row instead of duplicating;          */
/*   - in-app delivery respects the user's NotificationPreference       */
/*     (the preference row is created on demand — model defaults).      */
/*                                                                      */
/* Batch 2 adds the MESSAGES and GROWTH categories plus the three       */
/* helpers used by messaging, the growth ladder and account security.  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Canonical categories the preferences model knows about. */
export const NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES = [
  "ASSIGNMENTS",
  "COURSES",
  "CERTIFICATES",
  "SURVEYS",
  "MESSAGES",
  "GROWTH",
] as const;
export type NotificationCategory = (typeof NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES)[number];

/** Canonical event keys written by this module. */
export const NOTIFICATION_TYPES = {
  coursePublished: "COURSE_PUBLISHED",
  courseCompleted: "COURSE_COMPLETED",
  lessonProgress: "COURSE_LESSON_PROGRESS",
  impactSurveyReady: "IMPACT_SURVEY_READY",
  impactResponseReceived: "IMPACT_RESPONSE_RECEIVED",
  messageReceived: "MESSAGE_RECEIVED",
  growthLevelSet: "GROWTH_LEVEL_SET",
  growthPromoted: "GROWTH_PROMOTED",
  passwordResetByAdmin: "PASSWORD_RESET_BY_ADMIN",
} as const;

/** Cap the list payload — the topbar and the page paginate client-side. */
const LIST_LIMIT = 50;
const MAX_BODY_LENGTH = 500;
const MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 150;

export interface CreateNotificationInput {
  userId: string;
  type: string;
  category: NotificationCategory;
  titleAr: string;
  bodyAr: string;
  /** INTERNAL path ("/...") — built server-side, never client input. */
  destinationUrl?: string | null;
  resourceType?: string | null;
  resourceId?: string | null;
  eventId?: string | null;
}

export interface CenterNotification {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  category: string;
  titleAr: string;
  bodyAr: string;
  destinationUrl: string | null;
  readAt: Date | null;
  createdAt: Date;
}

function sanitizeInternalPath(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  // Internal paths only: must start with a single "/", never "//".
  if (!value.startsWith("/") || value.startsWith("//")) return null;
  return value.slice(0, 500);
}

function clampText(value: string, max: number): string {
  return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : value;
}

/**
 * Ensure the preference row exists, then decide whether in-app delivery
 * is on for this category. Missing row == model defaults (all on).
 */
async function inAppAllowed(
  userId: string,
  category: NotificationCategory
): Promise<boolean> {
  let preference = await db.notificationPreference.findUnique({
    where: { userId },
  });
  if (!preference) {
    preference = await db.notificationPreference.create({
      data: { userId },
    });
  }
  if (!preference.inAppEnabled) return false;
  switch (category) {
    case "ASSIGNMENTS":
      return preference.assignments;
    case "COURSES":
      return preference.courses;
    case "CERTIFICATES":
      return preference.certificates;
    case "SURVEYS":
      return preference.surveys;
    default:
      return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Create one notification. Idempotent per (userId, eventId) — a repeated
 * event collapses silently into the existing row (P2002 is expected).
 */
export async function createNotification(
  input: CreateNotificationInput
): Promise<CenterNotification | null> {
  if (!input.userId) return null;
  const allowed = await inAppAllowed(input.userId, input.category);
  if (!allowed) return null;

  const created = await db.notification
    .create({
      data: {
        userId: input.userId,
        type: input.type,
        category: input.category,
        titleAr: clampText(input.titleAr, MAX_TITLE_LENGTH),
        bodyAr: clampText(input.bodyAr, MAX_BODY_LENGTH),
        destinationUrl: sanitizeInternalPath(input.destinationUrl),
        resourceType: input.resourceType ?? null,
        resourceId: input.resourceId ?? null,
        eventId: input.eventId ?? null,
      },
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      // Duplicate event for this recipient -> keep the original row.
      if (
        typeof error === "object" &&
        error !== null &&
        "code" in error &&
        (error as { code?: string }).code === "P2002"
      ) {
        return null;
      }
      throw error;
    });
  return created;
}

/** The owner's notifications, newest first (ownership-filtered). */
export async function listNotifications(
  userId: string,
  limit = LIST_LIMIT
): Promise<CenterNotification[]> {
  return db.notification.findMany({
    where: { userId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: Math.min(Math.max(1, limit), 100),
  });
}

export async function unreadCount(userId: string): Promise<number> {
  return db.notification.count({ where: { userId, readAt: null } });
}

/** Mark every notification of the owner read (bulk, ownership-safe). */
export async function markAllNotificationsRead(userId: string): Promise<number> {
  const result = await db.notification.updateMany({
    where: { userId, readAt: null },
    data: { readAt: new Date() },
  });
  return result.count;
}

/**
 * Mark ONE notification read — the WHERE clause carries the owner id,
 * so a foreign id simply matches nothing (no error, no leak).
 */
export async function markNotificationRead(
  userId: string,
  notificationId: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const result = await db.notification.updateMany({
    where: { id: notificationId, userId },
    data: { readAt: new Date() },
  });
  return result.count > 0;
}

/**
 * Course published -> notify every ACTIVE TEACHER of the audience.
 * Platform-wide courses (schoolId null) reach every active teacher;
 * school courses reach that school's teachers only. The deep link
 * carries the REAL course id (never a length or an index).
 */
export async function notifyCoursePublished(input: {
  courseId: string;
  courseTitleAr: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
  actorId: string;
}): Promise<number> {
  const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
    where: {
      role: "TEACHER",
      isActive: true,
      ...(input.schoolId ? { schoolId: input.schoolId } : {}),
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  let created = 0;
  for (const teacher of teachers) {
    if (teacher.id === input.actorId) continue;
    const notification = await createNotification({
      userId: teacher.id,
      type: NOTIFICATION_TYPES.coursePublished,
      category: "COURSES",
      titleAr: "تدريب منشور جديد",
      bodyAr: `تم نشر الدورة «${input.courseTitleAr}» — افتح الدورة وابدأ التعلّم.`,
      destinationUrl: `/academy/learn/${input.courseId}`,
      resourceType: "Course",
      resourceId: input.courseId,
      eventId: `COURSE_PUBLISHED:${input.courseId}`,
    });
    if (notification) created += 1;
  }
  return created;
}

/**
 * Phase 11 — email outbox dispatcher (bounded, idempotent, multi-worker safe).
 *
 * Processing model:
 *  - Rows live in EmailDelivery with status QUEUED → PROCESSING → SENT/FAILED.
 *  - Claiming is a conditional updateMany(status = QUEUED → PROCESSING), so
 *    two concurrent workers can never claim/send the same row twice.
 *  - Temporary failures retry with bounded backoff (EMAIL_RETRY_BACKOFF_MINUTES)
 *    up to maxAttempts; then the row is FAILED permanently with a sanitized
 *    error category for authorized troubleshooting.
 *  - Stale QUEUED rows older than EMAIL_QUEUE_MAX_AGE_HOURS are abandoned as
 *    EXPIRED so the queue cannot grow unbounded while a provider is down.
 *  - When no provider is configured, NOTHING is claimed and the run reports
 *    configured:false — the honest state (rows stay queued, status pages
 *    explain, no fake success).
 *
 * Triggered by the secured POST /api/cron/dispatch endpoint (external
 * scheduler) — never by an assumed always-on dev server.
 */

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  EMAIL_DISPATCH_BATCH_LIMIT,
  EMAIL_QUEUE_MAX_AGE_HOURS,
  EMAIL_RETRY_BACKOFF_MINUTES,
} from "@/config/notifications";
import {
  resolveEmailProvider,
  EmailProviderError,
  type EmailProvider,
} from "@/lib/integrations/email/provider";
import { renderQueuedNotificationEmail } from "@/lib/notifications/emails";

export interface DispatchSummary {
  configured: boolean;
  note?: string;
  claimed: number;
  sent: number;
  retried: number;
  failedPermanent: number;
  expired: number;
}

function backoffMinutes(attemptNumber: number): number {
  const index = Math.min(attemptNumber - 1, EMAIL_RETRY_BACKOFF_MINUTES.length - 1);
  return EMAIL_RETRY_BACKOFF_MINUTES[Math.max(0, index)];
}

/** Mirrors the delivery outcome onto the owner's Notification row. */
async function mirrorNotificationEmailStatus(
  notificationId: string | null,
  emailStatus: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!notificationId) return;
  await db.notification
    .updateMany({ where: { id: notificationId }, data: { emailStatus } })
    .catch(() => null);
}

/**
 * Abandons ancient QUEUED rows (bounded sweep) as EXPIRED. Queued while
 * the provider was unconfigured must not sit forever.
 */
async function expireStaleRows(now: Date): Promise<number> {
  const cutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - EMAIL_QUEUE_MAX_AGE_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const stale = await db.emailDelivery.findMany({
    where: { status: "QUEUED", createdAt: { lt: cutoff } },
    select: { id: true, notificationId: true },
    take: 200,
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
  });
  for (const row of stale) {
    const updated = await db.emailDelivery.updateMany({
      where: { id: row.id, status: "QUEUED" },
      data: {
        status: "FAILED",
        lastErrorCategory: "EXPIRED",
        lastErrorMessage: "queue age exceeded the configured maximum",
        lastAttemptAt: now,
      },
    });
    if (updated.count > 0) await mirrorNotificationEmailStatus(row.notificationId, "FAILED");
  }
  return stale.length;
}

/**
 * Processes up to `limit` queued emails. Pass `provider` ONLY in tests
 * (mock provider); production resolves from environment variables.
 */
export async function processEmailOutbox(options?: {
  provider?: EmailProvider;
  now?: Date;
  limit?: number;
  workerId?: string;
}): Promise<DispatchSummary> {
  const now = options?.now ?? new Date();
  const workerId = options?.workerId ?? `worker-${process.pid}`;
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(1, options?.limit ?? EMAIL_DISPATCH_BATCH_LIMIT), 100);

  const resolved =
    options?.provider !== undefined
      ? { configured: true, provider: options.provider }
      : resolveEmailProvider();
  if (!resolved.configured) {
    // Honest no-op: nothing is claimed, nothing is reported as sent.
    await expireStaleRows(now);
    return {
      configured: false,
      note: "EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED — queued messages are preserved and will be attempted once a provider is configured",
      claimed: 0,
      sent: 0,
      retried: 0,
      failedPermanent: 0,
      expired: 0,
    };
  }

  await expireStaleRows(now);

  const candidates = await db.emailDelivery.findMany({
    where: { status: "QUEUED", nextAttemptAt: { lte: now } },
    select: { id: true },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    take: limit,
  });

  const summary: DispatchSummary = {
    configured: true,
    claimed: 0,
    sent: 0,
    retried: 0,
    failedPermanent: 0,
    expired: 0,
  };

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    // Optimistic claim — conditional on status so concurrent workers skip.
    const claimed = await db.emailDelivery.updateMany({
      where: { id: candidate.id, status: "QUEUED" },
      data: { status: "PROCESSING", lockedAt: now, lockedBy: workerId },
    });
    if (claimed.count !== 1) continue;
    summary.claimed += 1;

    const row = await db.emailDelivery.findUnique({
      where: { id: candidate.id },
      select: {
        id: true,
        notificationId: true,
        attemptCount: true,
        maxAttempts: true,
        subject: true,
      },
    });
    if (!row) continue;

    // Render at send time (bodies are never stored).
    const rendered = await renderQueuedNotificationEmail(row.id);
    if (!rendered.ok) {
      await db.emailDelivery.update({
        where: { id: row.id },
        data: {
          status: "FAILED",
          lastErrorCategory: "VALIDATION",
          lastErrorMessage: "source notification no longer renderable",
          lastAttemptAt: now,
        },
      });
      await mirrorNotificationEmailStatus(row.notificationId, "FAILED");
      summary.failedPermanent += 1;
      continue;
    }
    if (!rendered.to) {
      await db.emailDelivery.update({
        where: { id: row.id },
        data: {
          status: "FAILED",
          lastErrorCategory: "VALIDATION",
          lastErrorMessage: "recipient address unavailable",
          lastAttemptAt: now,
        },
      });
      await mirrorNotificationEmailStatus(row.notificationId, "FAILED");
      summary.failedPermanent += 1;
      continue;
    }

    try {
      const result = await resolved.provider.send({
        to: rendered.to,
        subject: rendered.subject,
        html: rendered.html,
        text: rendered.text,
      });
      await db.emailDelivery.update({
        where: { id: row.id },
        data: {
          status: "SENT",
          provider: resolved.provider.kind,
          providerMessageId: result.messageId,
          attemptCount: { increment: 1 },
          lastAttemptAt: new Date(),
          sentAt: new Date(),
          lastErrorCategory: null,
          lastErrorMessage: null,
        },
      });
      await mirrorNotificationEmailStatus(row.notificationId, "SENT");
      summary.sent += 1;
    } catch (error) {
      const category = error instanceof EmailProviderError ? error.category : "PROVIDER";
      const detail =
        error instanceof EmailProviderError ? error.detail : "unknown provider failure";
      const attemptNumber = row.attemptCount + 1;
      const permanent = attemptNumber >= row.maxAttempts;
      await db.emailDelivery.update({
        where: { id: row.id },
        data: {
          status: permanent ? "FAILED" : "QUEUED",
          attemptCount: attemptNumber,
          lastAttemptAt: new Date(),
          lastErrorCategory: category,
          lastErrorMessage: detail,
          ...(permanent
            ? {}
            : {
                nextAttemptAt: new Date(now.getTime() + backoffMinutes(attemptNumber) * 60_000),
              }),
          lockedAt: null,
          lockedBy: null,
        },
      });
      if (permanent) {
        await mirrorNotificationEmailStatus(row.notificationId, "FAILED");
        summary.failedPermanent += 1;
      } else {
        summary.retried += 1;
      }
    }
  }

  return summary;
}

/**
 * Full scheduled tick: expirations + queue processing. Reminder scans run
 * through runScheduledScans() (reminders.ts) and are invoked by the cron
 * route separately so each scan can be tested in isolation.
 */
export async function runDispatcherTick(options?: {
  provider?: EmailProvider;
  now?: Date;
  limit?: number;
}): Promise<DispatchSummary> {
  return processEmailOutbox(options);
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\lib\notifications\emails.ts

/**
 * Phase 11 — email queueing & sending orchestration.
 *
 * Two distinct flows (kept separate on purpose):
 *
 *  1. NOTIFICATION emails (optional, preference-gated) → persisted as a
 *     QUEUED EmailDelivery row and sent later by the dispatcher. Message
 *     bodies are never stored — the dispatcher re-renders them from the
 *     linked notification at send time (dedupeKey `notif:<id>`).
 *
 *  2. ACCOUNT-SECURITY emails (verification / reset / password changed)
 *     are attempted IMMEDIATELY. Security payloads contain single-use
 *     token URLs, so they are never persisted or queued — the raw token
 *     exists only inside the rendered message. Failures are recorded with
 *     sanitized categories only.
 *
 * Honesty: nothing in this module reports success without the provider
 * confirming it (messageId present).
 */

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  appPublicOrigin,
  EMAIL_MAX_ATTEMPTS_DEFAULT,
} from "@/config/notifications";
import {
  EmailProviderError,
  resolveEmailProvider,
} from "@/lib/integrations/email/provider";
import {
  renderEmailTemplate,
  type EmailTemplateKey,
  type EmailTemplateParams,
} from "@/lib/integrations/email/templates";

export type QueueOutcome =
  | { ok: true; deliveryId: string }
  | { ok: false; reason: "DUPLICATE" | "NO_EMAIL" };

export type SecurityEmailOutcome =
  | { ok: true; messageId: string }
  | { ok: false; configured: false }
  | { ok: false; errorCategory: string };

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 1. Notification emails → durable queue                              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Queues the email counterpart of an in-app notification. Idempotent via
 * dedupeKey (unique): retrying the same notification never double-queues.
 */
export async function queueNotificationEmail(input: {
  notificationId: string;
  userId: string;
  toEmail: string;
  category: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
  subject: string;
}): Promise<QueueOutcome> {
  if (!input.toEmail) return { ok: false, reason: "NO_EMAIL" };
  const existing = await db.emailDelivery.findUnique({
    where: { dedupeKey: `notif:${input.notificationId}` },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (existing) return { ok: false, reason: "DUPLICATE" };

  const row = await db.emailDelivery.create({
    data: {
      toEmail: input.toEmail,
      toUserId: input.userId,
      subject: input.subject,
      template: "generic-notification",
      category: input.category,
      schoolId: input.schoolId,
      notificationId: input.notificationId,
      status: "QUEUED",
      maxAttempts: EMAIL_MAX_ATTEMPTS_DEFAULT,
      dedupeKey: `notif:${input.notificationId}`,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, deliveryId: row.id };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 2. Account-security emails → immediate, never persisted with token  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Attempts a security email right now. Returns an honest outcome:
 *  - ok + messageId  → provider confirmed delivery acceptance.
 *  - configured:false → no provider is configured; the caller must tell
 *    the user the truth (the attempt is still recorded as NOT_CONFIGURED
 *    so the integrations status page reflects reality).
 *  - errorCategory → sanitized provider/network failure classification.
 */
export async function sendSecurityEmailNow(input: {
  toEmail: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  schoolId?: string | null;
  templateKey: EmailTemplateKey;
  params: EmailTemplateParams;
}): Promise<SecurityEmailOutcome> {
  const rendered = renderEmailTemplate(input.templateKey, input.params);
  if (!rendered) {
    await recordSecurityAttempt(input, null, "VALIDATION", "template rendering failed");
    return { ok: false, errorCategory: "VALIDATION" };
  }

  const resolved = resolveEmailProvider();
  if (!resolved.configured) {
    await recordSecurityAttempt(input, rendered.subject, "NOT_CONFIGURED", resolved.reason);
    return { ok: false, configured: false };
  }

  try {
    const result = await resolved.provider.send({
      to: input.toEmail,
      subject: rendered.subject,
      html: rendered.html,
      text: rendered.text,
    });
    await recordSecurityAttempt(
      input,
      rendered.subject,
      null,
      null,
      resolved.provider.kind,
      result.messageId,
    );
    return { ok: true, messageId: result.messageId };
  } catch (error) {
    const category =
      error instanceof EmailProviderError ? error.category : "PROVIDER";
    const detail =
      error instanceof EmailProviderError ? error.detail : "unknown provider failure";
    await recordSecurityAttempt(input, rendered.subject, category, detail, resolved.provider.kind);
    return { ok: false, errorCategory: category };
  }
}

/** Records a security-email attempt WITHOUT storing any rendered body. */
async function recordSecurityAttempt(
  input: { toEmail: string; userId?: string | null; schoolId?: string | null },
  subject: string | null,
  errorCategory: string | null,
  errorMessage: string | null,
  provider?: string,
  providerMessageId?: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const now = new Date();
  await db.emailDelivery
    .create({
      data: {
        toEmail: input.toEmail,
        ...(input.userId ? { toUserId: input.userId } : {}),
        subject: subject ?? "(security email)",
        template: "security",
        category: "ACCOUNT",
        ...(input.schoolId ? { schoolId: input.schoolId } : {}),
        status: errorCategory === null ? "SENT" : "FAILED",
        ...(provider ? { provider } : {}),
        ...(providerMessageId ? { providerMessageId } : {}),
        lastErrorCategory: errorCategory ?? undefined,
        lastErrorMessage: errorCategory === "NOT_CONFIGURED"
          ? "email provider is not configured on this deployment"
          : errorMessage ?? undefined,
        lastAttemptAt: now,
        ...(errorCategory === null ? { sentAt: now } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true },
    })
    .catch(() => null);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 3. Dispatcher-side rendering (no bodies stored)                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Re-renders a queued notification email at SEND time from the linked
 * notification + recipient + school. Returns null when the source rows
 * disappeared (deleted user/notification) — the row is then abandoned
 * as VALIDATION-failed rather than sent broken.
 */
export async function renderQueuedNotificationEmail(emailDeliveryId: string): Promise<
  | {
      ok: true;
      to: string;
      subject: string;
      html: string;
      text: string;
      providerKind: string;
    }
  | { ok: false; errorCategory: "VALIDATION" }
> {
  const row = await db.emailDelivery.findUnique({
    where: { id: emailDeliveryId },
    select: { toEmail: true, subject: true, notificationId: true },
  });
  if (!row || !row.notificationId) return { ok: false, errorCategory: "VALIDATION" };

  const notification = await db.notification.findUnique({
    where: { id: row.notificationId },
    select: {
      titleAr: true,
      bodyAr: true,
      destinationUrl: true,
      user: { select: { name: true, email: true, school: { select: { nameAr: true } } } },
    },
  });
  if (!notification) return { ok: false, errorCategory: "VALIDATION" };

  const origin = appPublicOrigin();
  const actionUrl = origin && notification.destinationUrl
    ? `${origin}${notification.destinationUrl}`
    : null;

  const rendered = renderEmailTemplate("generic-notification", {
    recipientName: notification.user?.name ?? null,
    schoolName: notification.user?.school?.nameAr ?? null,
    titleAr: notification.titleAr,
    bodyAr: notification.bodyAr,
    actionUrl,
  });
  if (!rendered) return { ok: false, errorCategory: "VALIDATION" };

  return {
    ok: true,
    to: row.toEmail || notification.user?.email || "",
    subject: rendered.subject,
    html: rendered.html,
    text: rendered.text,
    providerKind: "RESEND",
  };
}

type JsonValue = string | number | boolean | null | JsonValue[] | { [key: string]: JsonValue };

/** Parse a JSON string column defensively ("" / null / bad JSON -> []). */
function parseIdList(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.trim() === "") return [];
  try {
    const parsed: JsonValue = JSON.parse(value);
    return Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? parsed.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
      : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/** Arabic due-date text for notification bodies (Cairo time). */
function formatDueDate(dueAt: Date | null): string {
  if (!dueAt) return "";
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
      dateStyle: "long",
      timeStyle: "short",
      timeZone: "Africa/Cairo",
    }).format(dueAt);
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

export interface AssignmentPublishedHookInput {
  id: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
  titleAr: string;
  dueAt: Date | null;
  audienceMode: string;
  targetTeacherIdsJson: string | null;
  targetBranchIdsJson: string | null;
  publishedAt: Date;
}

/**
 * Assignment PUBLISHED -> every targeted ACTIVE TEACHER.
 * Recipients are resolved SERVER-SIDE from the persisted audience
 * columns (never from client input): explicit teacher ids, else the
 * teachers of the target branches, else the whole school's teachers
 * (platform-wide assignments reach every active teacher).
 */
export async function notifyAssignmentPublished(
  input: AssignmentPublishedHookInput
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const teacherIds = parseIdList(input.targetTeacherIdsJson);
    const branchIds = parseIdList(input.targetBranchIdsJson);

    let recipients: Array<{ id: string }> = [];
    if (input.audienceMode === "TEACHERS" && teacherIds.length > 0) {
      recipients = await db.user.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: teacherIds }, role: "TEACHER", isActive: true },
        select: { id: true },
      });
    } else if (input.audienceMode === "BRANCHES" && branchIds.length > 0) {
      recipients = await db.user.findMany({
        where: {
          role: "TEACHER",
          isActive: true,
          branchId: { in: branchIds },
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });
    } else {
      recipients = await db.user.findMany({
        where: {
          role: "TEACHER",
          isActive: true,
          ...(input.schoolId ? { schoolId: input.schoolId } : {}),
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });
    }

    const dueText = formatDueDate(input.dueAt);
    const bodyAr = dueText
      ? `واجب جديد: «${input.titleAr}» — آخر موعد للتسليم ${dueText}.`
      : `واجب جديد: «${input.titleAr}» — راجع التفاصيل وابدأ العمل عليه.`;

    for (const recipient of recipients) {
      await createNotification({
        userId: recipient.id,
        type: "ASSIGNMENT_PUBLISHED",
        category: "ASSIGNMENTS",
        titleAr: "واجب جديد مكلف به",
        bodyAr,
        destinationUrl: ASSIGNMENTS_URL,
        resourceType: "Assignment",
        resourceId: input.id,
        eventId: `ASSIGNMENT_PUBLISHED:${input.id}:${recipient.id}`,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    eventError("notifyAssignmentPublished", error);
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Follow-ups (المتابعات)                                              */
/*                                                                     */
/* Batch 1 regression fix: the follow-ups module (src/lib/followups/    */
/* service.ts) has always imported these four hooks — they are part    */
/* of the module's public contract and are restored here on top of     */
/* the REAL notification center.                                        */
/*                                                                     */
/* The input is deliberately tolerant (every field optional + index     */
/* signature): the follow-ups service owns the call shapes, and this    */
/* hook reads only the fields it knows, resolving the rest from the    */
/* database when possible. Like every hook here: BEST-EFFORT — a       */
/* failure is logged, never thrown into the business flow.             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface FollowUpNotificationInput {
  followUpId?: string;
  id?: string;
  title?: string;
  followUpTitle?: string;
  teacherId?: string;
  teacherName?: string;
  supervisorId?: string;
  supervisorName?: string;
  creatorId?: string;
  creatorName?: string;
  actorId?: string;
  status?: string;
  oldStatus?: string;
  dueAt?: Date | string | null;
  sharedWithIds?: string[];
  sharedWith?: string[];
  // Tolerant index signature: the follow-ups service may pass richer
  // objects — unknown extra fields are ignored, never rejected.
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

function asText(value: unknown): string {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value;
  if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") return String(value);
  return "";
}

function asOptionalId(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "" ? value.trim() : null;
}

async function followUpRecipients(
  input: FollowUpNotificationInput
): Promise<{ teacherId: string | null; supervisorId: string | null }> {
  // Explicit ids win; otherwise resolve the follow-up row from the DB.
  let teacherId = asOptionalId(input.teacherId);
  let supervisorId = asOptionalId(input.supervisorId) ?? asOptionalId(input.creatorId);
  const followUpId = asOptionalId(input.followUpId) ?? asOptionalId(input.id);
  if ((!teacherId || !supervisorId) && followUpId) {
    const followUp = await db.followUp.findUnique({
      where: { id: followUpId },
      select: {
        teacherId: true,
        createdById: true,
        assignment: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      },
    });
    if (followUp) {
      teacherId = teacherId ?? followUp.teacherId;
      supervisorId = supervisorId ?? followUp.createdById;
    }
  }
  return { teacherId, supervisorId };
}

function followUpDeepLink(followUpId: string | null): string {
  return followUpId ? `/assignments?followUp=${followUpId}` : ASSIGNMENTS_URL;
}

/** FOLLOW-UP CREATED -> the assigned teacher. */

    const followUpId = asOptionalId(input.followUpId) ?? asOptionalId(input.id);
    const title = asText(input.title) || asText(input.followUpTitle) || "متابعة جديدة";
    await createNotification({
      userId: teacherId,
      type: "FOLLOW_UP_CREATED",
      category: "ASSIGNMENTS",
      titleAr: "متابعة جديدة مكلف بها",
      bodyAr: `أُنشئت متابعة «${title}» — راجع التفاصيل والموعد المستحق.`,
      destinationUrl: followUpDeepLink(followUpId),
      resourceType: "FollowUp",
      resourceId: followUpId,
      eventId: followUpId ? `FOLLOW_UP_CREATED:${followUpId}` : null,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    eventError("notifyFollowUpCreated", error);
  }
}

/** FOLLOW-UP STATUS CHANGED -> the teacher AND the supervisor sides. */

    const followUpId = asOptionalId(input.followUpId) ?? asOptionalId(input.id);

    const oldStatus = asText(input.oldStatus);
    const statusText = oldStatus ? ` من «${oldStatus}» إلى «${status}»` : ` إلى «${status}»`;

      });

      await createNotification({
        userId: supervisorId,
        type: "FOLLOW_UP_STATUS_CHANGED",
        category: "ASSIGNMENTS",
        titleAr: "تحديث حالة متابعة",

        destinationUrl: followUpDeepLink(followUpId),
        resourceType: "FollowUp",
        resourceId: followUpId,
        eventId: null,
      });

    eventError("notifyFollowUpStatusChanged", error);
  }
}

/** FOLLOW-UP SHARED -> every explicitly shared recipient. */
export async function notifyFollowUpShared(
  input: FollowUpNotificationInput
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const followUpId = asOptionalId(input.followUpId) ?? asOptionalId(input.id);
    const title = asText(input.title) || asText(input.followUpTitle) || "متابعة";
    const explicit = Array.isArray(input.sharedWithIds)
      ? input.sharedWithIds.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string" && id !== "")
      : [];
    const legacy = Array.isArray(input.sharedWith)
      ? input.sharedWith.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string" && id !== "")
      : [];
    const actorId = asOptionalId(input.actorId) ?? asOptionalId(input.creatorId);

    const recipients = [...new Set([...explicit, ...legacy])].filter(
      (id) => id && id !== actorId
    );
    for (const recipientId of recipients) {
      await createNotification({
        userId: recipientId,
        type: "FOLLOW_UP_SHARED",
        category: "ASSIGNMENTS",
        titleAr: "مشاركة متابعة",
        bodyAr: `شارُكت معك متابعة «${title}» — راجع تفاصيلها وحالتها.`,
        destinationUrl: followUpDeepLink(followUpId),
        resourceType: "FollowUp",
        resourceId: followUpId,
        eventId: followUpId ? `FOLLOW_UP_SHARED:${followUpId}:${recipientId}` : null,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    eventError("notifyFollowUpShared", error);
  }
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\lib\notifications\reminders.ts

/**
 * Phase 11 — scheduled reminder scans (idempotent, bounded).
 *
 * Both scans are SAFE TO RUN REPEATEDLY: every notification carries a
 * deterministic eventId, and the DB unique (userId, eventId) collapses
 * replays. Re-running a scan therefore never produces duplicate
 * notifications — it simply becomes a no-op.
 *
 * Scans:
 *  1. Assignment deadline reminders — PUBLISHED assignments whose dueAt
 *     falls inside the next DEADLINE_REMINDER_WINDOW_HOURS. Recipients are
 *     the DB-verified targeted teachers minus anyone who already submitted
 *     (reminding a submitted teacher is spam). One reminder per recipient
 *     per UTC day bucket.
 *  2. Course completions — the platform computes completion on the fly
 *     (every PUBLISHED assessment bound to the course has a PASSED attempt
 *     for that teacher). The scan detects newly-completed pairs and
 *     notifies each exactly once per (teacher, course) lifetime.
 *
 * Triggered only through the secured cron endpoint — never by timers that
 * assume an always-running dev server.
 */

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  COURSE_COMPLETION_BATCH_LIMIT,
  DEADLINE_REMINDER_BATCH_LIMIT,
  DEADLINE_REMINDER_WINDOW_HOURS,
} from "@/config/notifications";
import { parseJsonIds, isTeacherTargeted } from "@/lib/assignments/access";
import { notify, notifyMany } from "@/lib/notifications/service";
import { formatEmailDate } from "@/lib/integrations/email/templates";

export interface ReminderScanSummary {
  scanned: number;
  notified: number;
  skipped: number;
}

function utcDayBucket(date: Date): string {
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 1. Assignment deadline reminders                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function scanAssignmentDeadlineReminders(now: Date = new Date()): Promise<ReminderScanSummary> {
  const windowEnd = new Date(now.getTime() + DEADLINE_REMINDER_WINDOW_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const assignments = await db.assignment.findMany({
    where: { status: "PUBLISHED", dueAt: { gt: now, lte: windowEnd } },
    select: {
      id: true,
      schoolId: true,
      titleAr: true,
      dueAt: true,
      audienceMode: true,
      targetTeacherIdsJson: true,
      targetBranchIdsJson: true,
    },
    orderBy: { dueAt: "asc" },
    take: DEADLINE_REMINDER_BATCH_LIMIT,
  });

  const summary: ReminderScanSummary = { scanned: assignments.length, notified: 0, skipped: 0 };
  const bucket = utcDayBucket(now);

  for (const assignment of assignments) {
    const targeting = {
      audienceMode: assignment.audienceMode,
      targetTeacherIds: parseJsonIds(assignment.targetTeacherIdsJson),
      targetBranchIds: parseJsonIds(assignment.targetBranchIdsJson),
    };

    // DB-verified targeted, ACTIVE teachers of the owning school.
    const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
      where: { role: "TEACHER", schoolId: assignment.schoolId, isActive: true },
      select: { id: true, branchId: true },
    });
    const targeted = teachers.filter((teacher) => isTeacherTargeted(targeting, teacher));

    // Already-submitted teachers (non-draft) must not be nagged.
    const submissions = await db.assignmentSubmission.findMany({
      where: { assignmentId: assignment.id, teacherId: { in: targeted.map((t) => t.id) } },
      select: { teacherId: true, status: true },
    });
    const submittedIds = new Set(
      submissions.filter((row) => row.status !== "DRAFT" && row.status !== "RETURNED").map((row) => row.teacherId),
    );
    const recipients = targeted.filter((teacher) => !submittedIds.has(teacher.id));
    summary.skipped += targeted.length - recipients.length;
    if (recipients.length === 0) continue;

    const dueText = formatEmailDate(assignment.dueAt);
    const outcome = await notifyMany(
      recipients.map((teacher) => teacher.id),
      {
        type: "ASSIGNMENT_DEADLINE_REMINDER",
        titleAr: "تذكير: موعد تسليم واجب يقترب",
        bodyAr: `موعد تسليم واجب «${assignment.titleAr}» في ${dueText}. لم نستلم تسليمك بعد — يُرجى التقديم قبل انتهاء المهلة.`,
        resourceType: "Assignment",
        resourceId: assignment.id,
        destinationUrl: `/my-assignments/${assignment.id}`,
        eventId: `deadline-reminder:${assignment.id}:${bucket}`,
        email: true,
      },
    );
    summary.notified += outcome.created;
  }

  return summary;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* 2. Course completion detection                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function scanCourseCompletions(now: Date = new Date()): Promise<ReminderScanSummary> {
  // Passed attempts on course-bound PUBLISHED assessments → (user, course) pairs.
  const attempts = await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
    where: { status: "PASSED", assessment: { status: "PUBLISHED", courseId: { not: null } } },
    select: { userId: true, assessment: { select: { courseId: true } } },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    take: 5000,
  });
  const passedPairs = new Set(
    attempts
      .filter((attempt) => attempt.assessment.courseId)
      .map((attempt) => `${attempt.userId}:${attempt.assessment.courseId}`),
  );

  // Active enrollments in PUBLISHED courses.
  const enrollments = await db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
    where: { status: "ACTIVE", course: { status: "PUBLISHED" } },
    select: { userId: true, courseId: true, course: { select: { titleAr: true } } },
    orderBy: { enrolledAt: "desc" },
    take: 5000,
  });

  const completed = enrollments.filter((row) => passedPairs.has(`${row.userId}:${row.courseId}`));
  if (completed.length === 0) {
    return { scanned: enrollments.length, notified: 0, skipped: 0 };
  }

  // Filter out pairs already notified (deterministic eventId per pair).
  const eventIds = completed.map(
    (row) => `course-completed:${row.userId}:${row.courseId}`,
  );
  const existing = new Set<string>();
  const CHUNK = 80;
  for (let index = 0; index < eventIds.length; index += CHUNK) {
    const slice = eventIds.slice(index, index + CHUNK);
    const rows = await db.notification.findMany({
      where: { eventId: { in: slice } },
      select: { eventId: true },
    });
    for (const row of rows) if (row.eventId) existing.add(row.eventId);
  }

  const fresh = completed.filter(
    (row, position) => !existing.has(eventIds[position]),
  );
  const bounded = fresh.slice(0, COURSE_COMPLETION_BATCH_LIMIT);

  let notified = 0;
  for (const row of bounded) {
    const outcome = await notify({
      userId: row.userId,
      type: "COURSE_COMPLETED",
      titleAr: "أحسنت — أكملت مقررًا تدريبيًا",
      bodyAr: `استوفيت جميع متطلبات مقرر «${row.course.titleAr}» وفق قواعد الإكمال المعتمدة. قد تكون مؤهلًا لشهادة إتمام — راجع صفحة النمو المهني.`,
      resourceType: "Course",
      resourceId: row.courseId,
      destinationUrl: `/my-growth`,
      eventId: `course-completed:${row.userId}:${row.courseId}`,
      email: true,
    });
    if (outcome.ok && outcome.created) notified += 1;
  }

  return { scanned: enrollments.length, notified, skipped: completed.length - notified };
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\lib\notifications\service.ts
