/**
 * Phase 11 — core in-app notification service.
 *
 * Guarantees:
 *  - OWNERSHIP: every read/mutation path filters on userId server-side.
 *  - IDEMPOTENCY: event-driven notifications carry a stable eventId and
 *    the DB unique (userId, eventId) makes retries harmless — a replayed
 *    event resolves to the original row, never a duplicate.
 *  - PREFERENCES: enforced HERE, server-side, for every category except
 *    ACCOUNT (security/account messages are never gated — they are
 *    required for secure operation). Users cannot opt out of those.
 *  - SAFETY: destinationUrl passes safeInternalUrl() before storage;
 *    external URLs are dropped, not stored.
 *  - RESILIENCE: notify() never throws into the caller's business flow —
 *    a notification failure must not fail a publish/grade/issue action.
 */

import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  CATEGORY_PREFERENCE_FIELD,
  NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_BY_TYPE,
  NOTIFICATIONS_BELL_LIMIT,
  NOTIFICATIONS_MAX_SCAN,
  NOTIFICATIONS_PAGE_SIZE,
  NOTIFICATION_TYPES,
  type NotificationCategory,
  type NotificationType,
} from "@/config/notifications";
import { safeInternalUrl } from "@/lib/notifications/urls";
import { queueNotificationEmail } from "@/lib/notifications/emails";

export type NotifyOutcome =
  | { ok: true; created: boolean; notificationId: string | null }
  | { ok: false; reason: "INVALID_TYPE" | "USER_NOT_FOUND" | "USER_INACTIVE" | "ERROR" };

export interface NotifyInput {
  userId: string;
  type: NotificationType;
  titleAr: string;
  bodyAr: string;
  titleEn?: string | null;
  bodyEn?: string | null;
  resourceType?: string | null;
  resourceId?: string | null;
  destinationUrl?: string | null;
  /**
   * Stable idempotency key (unique per recipient). REQUIRED for events
   * that can be retried (fan-outs, scans); one-shot writes may omit it.
   */
  eventId?: string | null;
  /** Queue the email counterpart (respects preferences + provider state). */
  email?: boolean;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Preferences (persisted, enforced server-side)                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface NotificationPreferenceView {
  userId: string;
  inAppEnabled: boolean;
  emailEnabled: boolean;
  assignments: boolean;
  assessments: boolean;
  courses: boolean;
  surveys: boolean;
  followups: boolean;
  certificates: boolean;
  platform: boolean;
}

/** Loads the user's preferences, creating the row with defaults on first touch. */
export async function getOrCreatePreferences(userId: string): Promise<NotificationPreferenceView> {
  const existing = await db.notificationPreference.findUnique({ where: { userId } });
  if (existing) return existing;
  try {
    return await db.notificationPreference.create({ data: { userId } });
  } catch {
    // Concurrent first-touch — re-read.
    const row = await db.notificationPreference.findUnique({ where: { userId } });
    if (!row) throw new Error("notification preference unavailable");
    return row;
  }
}

const PREFERENCE_BOOLEAN_KEYS = [
  "inAppEnabled",
  "emailEnabled",
  "assignments",
  "assessments",
  "courses",
  "surveys",
  "followups",
  "certificates",
  "platform",
] as const;

export type PreferencePatch = Partial<Record<(typeof PREFERENCE_BOOLEAN_KEYS)[number], boolean>>;

/**
 * Applies a validated boolean patch. Account-security mail is NOT part of
 * this model by design — there is no flag that can disable it anywhere.
 */
export async function updatePreferences(
  userId: string,
  patch: PreferencePatch,
): Promise<NotificationPreferenceView> {
  const data: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  for (const key of PREFERENCE_BOOLEAN_KEYS) {
    if (typeof patch[key] === "boolean") data[key] = patch[key] as boolean;
  }
  await getOrCreatePreferences(userId);
  return db.notificationPreference.update({ where: { userId }, data });
}

function categoryPrefers(pref: NotificationPreferenceView, category: NotificationCategory): boolean {
  if (category === "ACCOUNT") return true; // never gated
  const field = CATEGORY_PREFERENCE_FIELD[category];
  const value = (pref as unknown as Record<string, boolean>)[field];
  return value !== false;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Core creation                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function categoryEnabledForUser(
  userId: string,
  category: NotificationCategory,
): Promise<{ pref: NotificationPreferenceView; inApp: boolean; email: boolean }> {
  const pref = await getOrCreatePreferences(userId);
  const categoryOn = categoryPrefers(pref, category);
  return {
    pref,
    // ACCOUNT (security) is always delivered in-app and by email.
    inApp: category === "ACCOUNT" ? true : pref.inAppEnabled && categoryOn,
    email: category === "ACCOUNT" ? true : pref.emailEnabled && categoryOn,
  };
}

/**
 * Creates one notification for one recipient. Safe to call from any
 * business flow; failures are reported, never thrown.
 */
export async function notify(input: NotifyInput): Promise<NotifyOutcome> {
  try {
    if (!NOTIFICATION_TYPES.includes(input.type)) {
      return { ok: false, reason: "INVALID_TYPE" };
    }
    const category = NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_BY_TYPE[input.type];

    const user = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.userId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        isActive: true,
        schoolId: true,
        notificationPreference: true,
      },
    });
    if (!user) return { ok: false, reason: "USER_NOT_FOUND" };
    if (!user.isActive) return { ok: false, reason: "USER_INACTIVE" };

    const destination = input.destinationUrl ? safeInternalUrl(input.destinationUrl) : null;
    const flags = await categoryEnabledForUser(user.id, category);

    // In-app off for this category → the event is not delivered at all:
    // the email channel is the counterpart of the same event, not an
    // independent copy. ACCOUNT (security/account) is NEVER gated.
    if (!flags.inApp) {
      return { ok: true, created: false, notificationId: null };
    }

    const created = await db.notification
      .create({
        data: {
          userId: user.id,
          type: input.type,
          category,
          titleAr: input.titleAr,
          bodyAr: input.bodyAr,
          ...(input.titleEn ? { titleEn: input.titleEn } : {}),
          ...(input.bodyEn ? { bodyEn: input.bodyEn } : {}),
          ...(input.resourceType ? { resourceType: input.resourceType } : {}),
          ...(input.resourceId ? { resourceId: input.resourceId } : {}),
          ...(destination ? { destinationUrl: destination } : {}),
          ...(input.eventId ? { eventId: input.eventId } : {}),
          emailStatus: null,
        },
        select: { id: true },
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        // Unique (userId, eventId) violation → the event was already
        // processed; idempotent replay resolves to "already created".
        if (
          error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
          error.code === "P2002"
        ) {
          return null;
        }
        throw error;
      });

    if (!created) {
      // Replayed event: also make sure the email counterpart exists once.
      if (input.email && flags.email && input.eventId) {
        const existingNotification = await db.notification.findFirst({
          where: { userId: user.id, eventId: input.eventId ?? undefined },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        if (existingNotification) {
          await queueNotificationEmail({
            notificationId: existingNotification.id,
            userId: user.id,
            toEmail: user.email,
            category,
            schoolId: user.schoolId,
            subject: input.titleAr,
          }).catch(() => null);
        }
      }
      return { ok: true, created: false, notificationId: null };
    }

    // Email counterpart (queued — dispatcher sends it honestly).
    if (input.email && flags.email) {
      const queued = await queueNotificationEmail({
        notificationId: created.id,
        userId: user.id,
        toEmail: user.email,
        category,
        schoolId: user.schoolId,
        subject: input.titleAr,
      }).catch(() => null);
      await db.notification
        .update({
          where: { id: created.id },
          data: { emailStatus: queued && queued.ok ? "QUEUED" : "DISABLED" },
          select: { id: true },
        })
        .catch(() => null);
    } else {
      await db.notification
        .update({
          where: { id: created.id },
          data: { emailStatus: "DISABLED" },
          select: { id: true },
        })
        .catch(() => null);
    }

    return { ok: true, created: true, notificationId: created.id };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: "ERROR" };
  }
}

/**
 * Fan-out to many recipients (assignment/survey publish, reminders).
 * Duplicate ids are collapsed; the whole batch is bounded. Every
 * recipient goes through the same preference + idempotency machinery.
 */
export async function notifyMany(
  userIds: readonly string[],
  input: Omit<NotifyInput, "userId">,
): Promise<{ created: number; skipped: number; failed: number }> {
  const uniqueIds = Array.from(new Set(userIds.filter((id) => typeof id === "string" && id)));
  let created = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  const CONCURRENCY = 25;
  for (let index = 0; index < uniqueIds.length; index += CONCURRENCY) {
    const slice = uniqueIds.slice(index, index + CONCURRENCY);
    const outcomes = await Promise.all(slice.map((userId) => notify({ ...input, userId })));
    for (const outcome of outcomes) {
      if (outcome.ok) {
        if (outcome.created) created += 1;
        else skipped += 1;
      } else if (outcome.reason === "USER_INACTIVE" || outcome.reason === "USER_NOT_FOUND") {
        skipped += 1;
      } else {
        failed += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return { created, skipped, failed };
}

export interface NotificationListItem {
  id: string;
  type: string;

  titleAr: string;

  emailStatus: string | null;
  readAt: string | null;

  items: NotificationListItem[];
  unreadCount: number;
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  total: number;
}

const isoOrNull = (value: Date | null): string | null => (value ? value.toISOString() : null);

export async function listNotifications(options: {
  userId: string;
  unreadOnly?: boolean;
  page?: number;
  pageSize?: number;
}): Promise<NotificationListPage> {
  const pageSize = Math.min(
    Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.pageSize ?? NOTIFICATIONS_PAGE_SIZE)),
    50,
  );
  // Phase 12: bound the page index — an unbounded ?page= produces huge
  // OFFSET scans on the DB for no benefit (history is capped by design).
  const requestedPage = Math.min(Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.page ?? 1)), 500);
  const where = {
    userId: options.userId,
    ...(options.unreadOnly ? { readAt: null } : {}),
  };

  const [rows, total, unreadCount] = await Promise.all([
    db.notification.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: [{ createdAt: "desc" }, { id: "desc" }],
      take: pageSize,
      skip: (requestedPage - 1) * pageSize,
      select: {
        id: true,
        type: true,
        category: true,
        titleAr: true,
        bodyAr: true,
        destinationUrl: true,
        emailStatus: true,
        readAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
      },
    }),
    db.notification.count({ where }),
    db.notification.count({ where: { userId: options.userId, readAt: null } }),
  ]);

  return {
    items: rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      type: row.type,
      category: row.category,
      titleAr: row.titleAr,
      bodyAr: row.bodyAr,
      destinationUrl: row.destinationUrl,
      emailStatus: row.emailStatus,
      readAt: isoOrNull(row.readAt),
      createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    })),
    unreadCount,
    page: requestedPage,
    pageSize,
    total,
  };
}

/** Latest notifications for the bell dropdown (bounded). */
export async function listRecentNotifications(

    page: 1,

}

/**
 * Phase 11 — safe internal notification destinations.
 *
 * Notifications may carry a destinationUrl that the UI renders as a
 * link. Because that value is stored in the database and rendered in
 * multiple surfaces, it is validated against a strict internal allow-list
 * at WRITE time: anything that is not a relative in-app path is dropped
 * (never stored), which structurally prevents open redirects and
 * `javascript:`/data: injection.
 */

/** First path segments allowed as notification destinations (existing app routes). */
const ALLOWED_SEGMENTS = [
  "dashboard",
  "assignments",
  "my-assignments",
  "surveys",
  "my-surveys",
  "follow-ups",
  "my-follow-ups",
  "certificates",
  "my-certificates",
  "growth",
  "my-growth",
  "analytics",
  "reports",
  "archive",
  "impact",
  "notifications",
  "integrations",
  "verify",
  "account",
] as const;

const MAX_DESTINATION_LENGTH = 300;

/**
 * Validates and normalizes a notification destination. Returns the safe
 * relative path (starting with a single "/") or null when the value is
 * not a safe internal destination — callers simply omit the link then.
 */
export function safeInternalUrl(raw: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof raw !== "string") return null;
  const value = raw.trim();
  if (!value || value.length > MAX_DESTINATION_LENGTH) return null;

  // Reject absolute URLs, protocol-relative, backslash tricks and control chars.
  if (value.startsWith("//") || value.includes("\\") || value.includes("\0")) return null;
  if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/.test(value)) return null;
  if (!value.startsWith("/")) return null;
  if (/[\r\n\t]/.test(value)) return null;

  const pathPart = value.split("?")[0].split("#")[0];
  const segment = pathPart.split("/").filter(Boolean)[0];
  if (!segment) return null;
  if (!(ALLOWED_SEGMENTS as readonly string[]).includes(segment)) return null;

  return value;
}

/**
 * Convenience builder: prefix + optional id is the dominant pattern
 * (e.g. `/assignments/${id}`). Returns null for unsafe/missing ids so
 * callers never persist a broken link.
 */
export function internalPath(segment: string, id?: string | null): string | null {
  if (id !== undefined && id !== null) {
    // Ids are server-generated cuids; only allow url-safe characters.
    if (typeof id !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(id)) return null;
    return safeInternalUrl(`/${segment}/${id}`);
  }
  return safeInternalUrl(`/${segment}`);
}

/**
 * Batch 3 — platform-level settings backed by the EXISTING SystemSetting
 * key/value table (no schema change, no migration).
 *
 * Keys (stable, documented):
 *   platform.name          — displayed platform identity (default: منارة)
 *   platform.tagline       — displayed tagline (default: مكتب التطوير التربوي)
 *   platform.supportEmail  — optional support contact
 *   academicYear.active    — the active academic year consumed by the
 *                            training-archive service (pre-existing key)
 *
 * Reads degrade gracefully: a database hiccup returns the built-in
 * defaults instead of crashing layout/pages. Writes are performed ONLY
 * by the SUPER_ADMIN server action (src/app/actions/platform-settings.ts).
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export interface PlatformSettings {
  platformName: string;
  platformTagline: string;
  supportEmail: string;
  activeAcademicYear: string;
}

export const PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS = {
  platformName: "platform.name",
  platformTagline: "platform.tagline",
  supportEmail: "platform.supportEmail",
  activeAcademicYear: "academicYear.active",
} as const;

/** Built-in fallbacks — identical to the shipped config branding. */
const DEFAULTS: PlatformSettings = {
  platformName: "منارة",
  platformTagline: "مكتب التطوير التربوي",
  supportEmail: "",
  activeAcademicYear: "",
};

export async function getPlatformSettings(): Promise<PlatformSettings> {
  try {
    const rows = await db.systemSetting.findMany({
      where: { key: { in: Object.values(PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS) } },
      select: { key: true, value: true },
    });
    const byKey = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.key, row.value]));
    return {
      platformName:
        byKey.get(PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.platformName)?.trim() ||
        DEFAULTS.platformName,
      platformTagline:
        byKey.get(PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.platformTagline)?.trim() ||
        DEFAULTS.platformTagline,
      supportEmail:
        byKey.get(PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.supportEmail)?.trim() ??
        DEFAULTS.supportEmail,
      activeAcademicYear:
        byKey.get(PLATFORM_SETTING_KEYS.activeAcademicYear)?.trim() ??
        DEFAULTS.activeAcademicYear,
    };
  } catch {
    // Never let a settings read break a page render.
    return { ...DEFAULTS };
  }
}

/** Low-level upsert used by the SUPER_ADMIN server action. */
export async function savePlatformSetting(
  key: string,
  value: string
): Promise<void> {
  await db.systemSetting.upsert({
    where: { key },
    update: { value },
    create: { key, value },
  });
}

import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { hashToken } from "@/lib/auth/one-time-tokens";
import type { AdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { schoolScopeError } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { getActiveSchoolBrandingById, getActiveSchoolBrandingBySlug, type ResolvedBranding } from "@/lib/branding";
import {
  registrationLinkCreateSchema,
  registrationLinkRevokeSchema,
  zodUsersFieldErrors,
  type RegistrationLinkServiceResult,
} from "@/lib/validation/registration-links";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* School-specific teacher self-registration links.                     */
/*                                                                      */
/* Security contract:                                                   */
/*   - The URL carries a 256-bit CSPRNG raw token; the database stores  */
/*     ONLY its SHA-256 hash (same hash-at-rest policy as the email     */
/*     verification / password reset tokens).                           */
/*   - Exactly ONE active link per school: create/regenerate runs in a  */
/*     transaction that deactivates every previous active link.         */
/*   - Revocation is permanent for that link; previously registered     */
/*     teachers keep their accounts untouched.                          */
/*   - Tenant scope: office/school managers are structurally confined   */
/*     to their own school (schoolId from the session, never from the   */
/*     client); SUPER_ADMIN may target any school explicitly.           */
/*   - Registration resolves the school from the token SERVER-SIDE —    */
/*     a client-supplied school id is never trusted.                    */
/*   - The raw token is shown exactly once (at creation) and is never   */
/*     logged; a lost link is recovered by generating a new one.        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function generateRawLinkToken(): string {
  return randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
}

/** Absolute registration URL for a raw token (no trailing slashes). */
export function registrationLinkUrl(appBaseUrl: string, rawToken: string): string {
  return `${appBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/register/${encodeURIComponent(rawToken)}`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Create / revoke                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CreatedRegistrationLink {
  id: string;
  /** The raw token — returned ONCE, only from this creation result. */
  rawToken: string;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
}

/**
 * Generate a new registration link for the managed school. Any previous
 * ACTIVE link of the school is deactivated atomically (regeneration
 * semantics), so at most one link can accept registrations at a time.
 */
export async function createRegistrationLink(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<RegistrationLinkServiceResult<CreatedRegistrationLink>> {
  const parsed = registrationLinkCreateSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من البيانات المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  // Tenant resolution — school managers/office managers are pinned to
  // their own school; only the platform owner picks a target school.
  const schoolId =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? input.schoolId : ctx.schoolId;
  if (!schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "اختر المدرسة التي سيُنشأ لها رابط التسجيل",
      fieldErrors: { schoolId: "يجب اختيار المدرسة" },
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const scope = schoolScopeError(ctx, schoolId);
  if (scope) return scope;

  const school = await db.school.findUnique({ where: { id: schoolId } });
  if (!school) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المدرسة المختارة غير موجودة", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (!school.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المدرسة غير مفعّلة حاليًا — لا يمكن إنشاء روابط تسجيل لها",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  const expiresAt = input.expiresInDays
    ? new Date(Date.now() + input.expiresInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    : null;

  const rawToken = generateRawLinkToken();
  const link = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // «One active link per school» — revoke previous actives first.
    await tx.registrationLink.updateMany({
      where: { schoolId, isActive: true },
      data: { isActive: false, revokedAt: new Date() },
    });
    return tx.registrationLink.create({
      data: {
        schoolId,
        tokenHash: hashToken(rawToken),
        isActive: true,
        expiresAt,
        createdBy: ctx.id,
      },
      select: { id: true, expiresAt: true },
    });
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: { id: link.id, rawToken, expiresAt: link.expiresAt },
  };
}

/**
 * Revoke a registration link permanently. Only links of the managed
 * school are reachable — any other id is indistinguishable from a
 * non-existent one (no cross-school probing).
 */
export async function revokeRegistrationLink(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<RegistrationLinkServiceResult<{ linkId: string }>> {
  const parsed = registrationLinkRevokeSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من البيانات المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const schoolId = ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? null : ctx.schoolId;
  const link = await db.registrationLink.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.linkId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!link || (schoolId && link.schoolId !== schoolId)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "رابط التسجيل غير موجود ضمن نطاق مدرستك",
      code: "NOT_FOUND",
    };
  }
  if (ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    const scope = schoolScopeError(ctx, link.schoolId);
    if (scope) return scope;
  }
  if (!link.isActive) {
    return { ok: true, data: { linkId: link.id } }; // idempotent no-op
  }

  await db.registrationLink.update({
    where: { id: link.id },
    data: { isActive: false, revokedAt: new Date() },
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { linkId: link.id } };
}

export interface RegistrationLinkRow {
  id: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
  revokedAt: Date | null;
  createdByName: string | null;
  /** Teachers created through this link (derived — single source). */
  registrationsCount: number;
  /** Most recent registration through this link. */
  lastRegistrationAt: Date | null;
}

export interface RegistrationLinksView {
  schoolId: string;
  schoolName: string;
  schoolIsActive: boolean;
  hasActiveLink: boolean;
  links: RegistrationLinkRow[];
}

/**
 * Link history + derived stats for the managed school. The school id
 * comes from the session context (or an explicit SUPER_ADMIN target
 * re-checked by schoolScopeError) — never from the client.
 */
export async function listRegistrationLinks(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  targetSchoolId: string
): Promise<RegistrationLinkServiceResult<RegistrationLinksView>> {
  const scope = schoolScopeError(ctx, targetSchoolId);
  if (scope) return scope;

  const school = await db.school.findUnique({
    where: { id: targetSchoolId },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true, isActive: true },
  });
  if (!school) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المدرسة غير موجودة", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }

  const links = await db.registrationLink.findMany({
    where: { schoolId: school.id },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });

  // createdBy is a plain id column (audit); resolve names in one query.
  const creatorIds = [...new Set(links.map((l) => l.createdBy))];
  const creators = creatorIds.length
    ? await db.user.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: creatorIds } },
        select: { id: true, name: true },
      })
    : [];
  const creatorName = new Map(creators.map((u) => [u.id, u.name]));

  // Derived per-link stats — one grouped query over users.
  const linkIds = links?.map((l) => l.id) ?? [];
  const grouped = linkIds.length
    ? await db.user.groupBy({
        by: ["registrationLinkId"],
        where: {
          role: "TEACHER",
          registrationLinkId: { in: linkIds },
        },
        _count: { _all: true },
        _max: { createdAt: true },
      })
    : [];
  const statsByLink = new Map(
    grouped.map((g) => [
      g.registrationLinkId as string,
      { count: g._count._all, last: g._max.createdAt },
    ])
  );

  const rows: RegistrationLinkRow[] = links.map((link) => ({
    id: link.id,
    isActive: link.isActive,
    createdAt: link.createdAt,
    expiresAt: link.expiresAt,
    revokedAt: link.revokedAt,
    createdByName: creatorName.get(link.createdBy) ?? null,
    registrationsCount: statsByLink.get(link.id)?.count ?? 0,
    lastRegistrationAt: statsByLink.get(link.id)?.last ?? null,
  }));

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      schoolId: school.id,
      schoolName: school.nameAr,
      schoolIsActive: school.isActive,
      hasActiveLink: rows.some((r) => r.isActive),
      links: rows,
    },
  };
}

/* Token resolution (public side)                                       */

export type RegistrationTokenStatus =
  | "valid"
  | "invalid"
  | "revoked"
  | "expired";

export interface RegistrationSchoolProfile {
  id: string;
  nameAr: string;
  nameEn: string | null;
  slug: string;
  logoUrl: string | null;
  brandColor: string;
  brandTagline: string | null;
}

export interface RegistrationTokenContext {
  status: "valid";
  linkId: string;
  expiresAt: Date | null;
  school: RegistrationSchoolProfile;
  /** Active branches of the registration school (home-branch picker). */
  branches: { id: string; nameAr: string }[];
}

export type RegistrationTokenResolution =
  | RegistrationTokenContext
  | { status: Exclude<RegistrationTokenStatus, "valid"> };

/**
 * Resolve a raw registration token SERVER-SIDE. The school association
 * comes exclusively from the link record — a tampered request can never
 * register into another school.
 */
export async function resolveRegistrationToken(
  rawToken: string
): Promise<RegistrationTokenResolution> {
  const token = (rawToken ?? "").trim();
  if (!token || token.length > 128) return { status: "invalid" };

  const link = await db.registrationLink.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash: hashToken(token) },
    include: {
      school: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          nameAr: true,
          nameEn: true,
          slug: true,
          logoUrl: true,
          brandColor: true,
          brandTagline: true,
          isActive: true,
          branches: {
            where: { isActive: true },
            select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
            orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!link) return { status: "invalid" };
  if (!link.isActive || !link.school.isActive) return { status: "revoked" };
  if (link.expiresAt && link.expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
    return { status: "expired" };
  }

  return {
    status: "valid",
    linkId: link.id,
    expiresAt: link.expiresAt,
    school: {
      id: link.school.id,
      nameAr: link.school.nameAr,
      nameEn: link.school.nameEn,
      slug: link.school.slug,
      logoUrl: link.school.logoUrl,
      brandColor: link.school.brandColor,
      brandTagline: link.school.brandTagline,
    },
    branches: link.school.branches,
  };
}

/**
 * /register/{param} entry resolution — the single route accepts the
 * token format; a legacy school-slug param resolves to a friendly
 * "registration runs through your school's dedicated link" screen
 * (the raw token is never recoverable from its hash, so a slug can never
 * mint a live link — managers generate/share the token URL instead).
 */
export type RegisterEntryResolution =
  | { kind: "token"; resolution: RegistrationTokenResolution }
  | { kind: "school_closed" }
  | { kind: "invalid" };

export async function resolveRegisterEntry(
  rawParam: string
): Promise<RegisterEntryResolution> {
  const param = (rawParam ?? "").trim();
  if (!param) return { kind: "invalid" };

  const byToken = await resolveRegistrationToken(param);
  if (byToken.status !== "invalid") {
    return { kind: "token", resolution: byToken };
  }

  const school = await db.school.findUnique({
    where: { slug: param },
    select: { isActive: true },
  });
  if (school && school.isActive) return { kind: "school_closed" };
  return { kind: "invalid" };
}

/** Branding for the register gate — token or legacy slug resolution. */
export async function resolveRegisterBranding(
  rawParam: string
): Promise<ResolvedBranding> {
  const param = (rawParam ?? "").trim();
  const byToken = await db.registrationLink.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash: hashToken(param) },
    select: { schoolId: true },
  });
  if (byToken) return getActiveSchoolBrandingById(byToken.schoolId);
  return getActiveSchoolBrandingBySlug(param);
}

export interface RegistrationStats {
  /** All TEACHER accounts of the scope (any state). */
  totalTeachers: number;
  /** Accounts created through self-registration links. */
  viaLinks: number;
  /** Registered, email not yet verified (cannot sign in yet). */
  awaitingVerification: number;
  /** Verified but no Educational Supervisor assigned yet. */
  verifiedUnassigned: number;
  /** Currently assigned to a supervisor (active teachers). */
  assigned: number;
}

export async function getSchoolRegistrationStats(
  schoolId: string
): Promise<RegistrationStats> {
  const [totalTeachers, viaLinks, awaitingVerification, assigned] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.user.count({ where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER" } }),
      db.user.count({
        where: { schoolId, role: "TEACHER", registrationLinkId: { not: null } },
      }),
      db.user.count({
        where: {
          schoolId,
          role: "TEACHER",
          isActive: true,
          emailVerifiedAt: null,
        },
      }),
      db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.count({
        where: { schoolId, teacher: { isActive: true } },
      }),
    ]);

  // Verified-but-unassigned: verified ACTIVE teachers without a current
  // supervisor row. Computed as a direct query to stay exact when
  // unassigned inactive teachers exist.
  const verifiedUnassigned = await db.user.count({
    where: {
      schoolId,
      role: "TEACHER",
      isActive: true,
      emailVerifiedAt: { not: null },
      teacherSupervision: { is: null },
    },
  });

  return {
    totalTeachers,
    viaLinks,
    awaitingVerification,
    verifiedUnassigned,
    assigned,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — CSV serialization with the ORIGINAL platform's format:     */
/* UTF-8 BOM (so Excel opens Arabic correctly), CRLF line endings and   */
/* RFC-4180 quoting — byte-compatible with the HTML v11Csv/v13 exports. */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function escapeCell(value: unknown): string {
  return `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
}

/** Serialize rows to the exact original CSV dialect (BOM included). */
export function toCsv(rows: Array<Array<string | number | null | undefined>>): string {
  const body = rows
    .map((row) => row.map(escapeCell).join(","))
    .join("\r\n");
  return `\uFEFF${body}`;
}

/** Response headers for a CSV/JSON file download (Arabic filename safe). */
export function downloadHeaders(filename: string, mime: string): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers();
  headers.set(
    "Content-Disposition",
    `attachment; filename="${filename}"; filename*=UTF-8''${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`
  );
  headers.set("Content-Type", `${mime}; charset=utf-8`);
  headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
  return headers;
}

export type ReportActor =
  | { role: "SUPER_ADMIN"; id: string; schoolId: string | null }
  | { role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"; id: string; schoolId: string }
  | { role: "SCHOOL_MANAGER"; id: string; schoolId: string }
  | { role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"; id: string; schoolId: string | null };

/**
 * Tenant filter for office/admin reports (null = whole platform).
 * SCHOOL_MANAGER mirrors DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: both are
 * structurally confined to their OWN school — the id comes from the
 * session/DB, never from a client payload.
 */
function schoolWhere(actor: ReportActor, schoolId?: string | null) {
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || actor.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER") {
    return { schoolId: actor.schoolId };
  }
  if (actor.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") {
    return { schoolId: actor.schoolId ?? undefined };
  }
  return schoolId ? { schoolId } : {};
}

export type ReportFormat = "csv" | "json";

  filename: string;
  mime: string;
  body: string;
}

/* ------------------------- Training report ------------------------ */

/** v11ExportCSV — one row per course completion. */
export async function buildTrainingReport(actor: ReportActor): Promise<ReportFile> {
  const completions = await db.courseCompletion.findMany({
    where: { user: schoolWhere(actor) },
    orderBy: { completedAt: "desc" },
    select: {
      hours: true,
      bestPercentage: true,
      completedAt: true,
      certificateId: true,
      user: { select: { name: true, teacherSupervision: { select: { supervisor: { select: { name: true } } } } } },
      course: { select: { titleAr: true, school: { select: { nameAr: true } }, instructor: { select: { name: true } } } },
    },
    take: 5000,
  });

  const rows: Array<Array<string | number | null>> = [
    ["المعلم", "الدورة", "المشرف", "المدرسة", "النتيجة", "الساعات", "الشهادة", "التاريخ"],
  ];
  for (const completion of completions) {
    rows.push([
      completion.user.name,
      completion.course?.titleAr ?? "—",
      completion.user.teacherSupervision?.supervisor.name ?? completion.course?.instructor?.name ?? "",
      completion.course?.school?.nameAr ?? "",
      completion.bestPercentage ?? "",
      completion.hours ?? "",
      completion.certificateId ?? "",
      completion.completedAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    ]);
  }

  return {
    filename: "Qurtuba_Training_Report.csv",
    mime: "text/csv",
    body: toCsv(rows),
  };
}

/* --------------------- Supervisor analytics ------------------------ */

export interface SupervisorAnalyticsRow {
  teacherId: string;
  teacherName: string;
  schoolName: string;
  assigned: number;
  completed: number;
  percent: number;
  hours: number;
  avgPercentage: number;
  certificates: number;
  level: string;
}

/**
 * v13ExportSupervisorTeachers — the supervisor's assigned-teachers
 * analytics. The supervisor's scope is explicit assignments ∪ branch
 * coverage within their own school; the KPIs mirror the print report.
 */
export async function buildSupervisorAnalytics(
  actor: ReportActor & { role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" }
): Promise<
  ReportFile & {
    kpis: { teachers: number; courses: number; rate: number; totalHours: number };
    rows: SupervisorAnalyticsRow[];
  }
> {
  const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: actor.id },
    select: { schoolId: true, supervisorAssignments: { select: { branchId: true } } },
  });
  const schoolId = supervisor?.schoolId ?? null;
  const branchIds = supervisor?.supervisorAssignments.map((row) => row.branchId) ?? [];

  const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
    where: {
      role: "TEACHER",
      isActive: true,
      ...(schoolId ? { schoolId } : {}),
      OR: [
        { teacherSupervision: { supervisorId: actor.id } },
        ...(branchIds.length > 0 ? [{ branchId: { in: branchIds } }] : []),
      ],
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      schoolId: true,
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      growthLevel: true,
      courseCompletions: { select: { courseId: true, hours: true, bestPercentage: true } },
      certificates: { where: { status: "ISSUED" }, select: { id: true } },
    },
    take: 2000,
  });

  const teacherSchoolIds = [
    ...new Set(teachers.map((teacher) => teacher.schoolId).filter(Boolean)),
  ] as string[];
  const platformCourses = await db.course.findMany({
    where: { status: "PUBLISHED", schoolId: null },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  const schoolCourses = teacherSchoolIds.length
    ? await db.course.findMany({
        where: { status: "PUBLISHED", schoolId: { in: teacherSchoolIds } },
        select: { id: true, schoolId: true },
      })
    : [];

  const rows: SupervisorAnalyticsRow[] = teachers.map((teacher) => {
    const assignedIds = new Set(platformCourses.map((course) => course.id));
    for (const course of schoolCourses) {
      if (course.schoolId === teacher.schoolId) assignedIds.add(course.id);
    }
    const done = teacher.courseCompletions.filter((completion) => assignedIds.has(completion.courseId));
    const percent = assignedIds.size
      ? Math.round((done.length / assignedIds.size) * 100)
      : 0;
    const hours =
      Math.round(
        teacher.courseCompletions.reduce((sum, completion) => sum + Number(completion.hours ?? 0), 0) * 10
      ) / 10;
    const percentages = teacher.courseCompletions
      .map((completion) => completion.bestPercentage)
      .filter((value): value is number => typeof value === "number");
    const avg = percentages.length
      ? Math.round((percentages.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / percentages.length) * 10) / 10
      : 0;
    return {
      teacherId: teacher.id,
      teacherName: teacher.name,
      schoolName: teacher.school?.nameAr ?? "",
      assigned: assignedIds.size,
      completed: done.length,
      percent,
      hours,
      avgPercentage: avg,
      certificates: teacher.certificates.length,
      level: growthLevelLabel(teacher.growthLevel),
    };
  });
  rows.sort((a, b) => a.teacherName.localeCompare(b.teacherName, "ar"));

  const totalAssigned = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.assigned, 0);
  const totalCompleted = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.completed, 0);
  const csvRows: Array<Array<string | number | null>> = [
    ["المعرف", "المعلم", "المدرسة", "الدورات المسندة", "الدورات المكتملة", "نسبة الإنجاز", "الساعات", "متوسط الاختبار", "الشهادات", "المستوى"],
    ...rows.map((row) => [
      row.teacherId,
      row.teacherName,
      row.schoolName,
      row.assigned,
      row.completed,
      `${row.percent}%`,
      row.hours,
      `${row.avgPercentage}%`,
      row.certificates,
      row.level,
    ]),
  ];

  return {
    filename: "Qurtuba_Supervisor_Teachers_Analytics.csv",
    mime: "text/csv",
    body: toCsv(csvRows),
    kpis: {
      teachers: rows.length,
      courses: platformCourses.length + schoolCourses.length,
      rate: totalAssigned ? Math.round((totalCompleted / totalAssigned) * 100) : 0,
      totalHours: Math.round(rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.hours, 0) * 10) / 10,
    },
    rows,
  };
}

/**

  const roleLabels: Record<string, string> = {

    ["الاسم", "الصلاحية", "البريد الإلكتروني", "المدرسة", "الحالة", "آخر دخول"],
  ];
  for (const account of accounts) {
    rows.push([
      account.name,
      roleLabels[account.role] ?? account.role,
      account.email,
      account.school?.nameAr ?? "",
      account.isActive ? "نشط" : "موقوف",
      account.lastLoginAt ? account.lastLoginAt.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ") : "لم يسجل الدخول",
    ]);
  }

  return {
    filename: "Qurtuba_User_Accounts.csv",
    mime: "text/csv",
    body: toCsv(rows),
  };
}

/** v11ExportJSON — the full bundle with the ORIGINAL top-level keys. */
export async function buildBundleReport(actor: ReportActor): Promise<ReportFile> {
  const where = schoolWhere(actor);

  const [teachers, supervisors, courses, completions, certificates, impactResponses] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.user.findMany({
        where: { role: "TEACHER", ...where },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          email: true,
          stage: true,
          subject: true,
          growthLevel: true,
          isActive: true,
          school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
          teacherSupervision: { select: { supervisor: { select: { name: true } } } },
        },
        take: 5000,
      }),
      db.user.findMany({
        where: { role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", ...where },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          email: true,
          isActive: true,
          school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
        },
        take: 2000,
      }),
      db.course.findMany({
        where,
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          category: true,
          status: true,
          estimatedHours: true,
          school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
          instructor: { select: { name: true } },
        },
        take: 2000,
      }),
      db.courseCompletion.findMany({
        where: { user: where },
        select: {
          id: true,
          courseId: true,
          userId: true,
          hours: true,
          bestPercentage: true,
          academicYear: true,
          completedAt: true,
          certificateId: true,
          user: { select: { name: true } },
          course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
        },
        take: 10000,
      }),
      db.certificate.findMany({
        where: { teacher: where },
        select: {
          id: true,
          certificateNumber: true,
          titleAr: true,
          status: true,
          issuedAt: true,
          teacher: { select: { name: true } },
          course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
        },
        take: 10000,
      }),
      db.surveyResponse.findMany({
        where: {
          schoolId:
            actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || actor.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
              ? actor.schoolId
              : undefined,
        },
        select: {
          id: true,
          status: true,
          submittedAt: true,
          respondent: { select: { name: true } },
          survey: { select: { titleAr: true, course: { select: { titleAr: true } } } },
        },
        take: 10000,
      }),
    ]);

  const payload = {
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    teachers: teachers.map((teacher) => ({
      id: teacher.id,
      name: teacher.name,
      email: teacher.email,
      school: teacher.school?.nameAr ?? "",
      stage: teacher.stage ?? "",
      subject: teacher.subject ?? "",
      supervisor: teacher.teacherSupervision?.supervisor.name ?? "",
      growthLevel: growthLevelLabel(teacher.growthLevel),
      status: teacher.isActive ? "نشط" : "موقوف",
    })),
    supervisors: supervisors.map((supervisor) => ({
      id: supervisor.id,
      name: supervisor.name,
      email: supervisor.email,
      school: supervisor.school?.nameAr ?? "",
      status: supervisor.isActive ? "نشط" : "موقوف",
    })),
    courses: courses.map((course) => ({
      id: course.id,
      title: course.titleAr,
      trainer: course.instructor?.name ?? "",
      school: course.school?.nameAr ?? "",
      category: course.category,
      hours: course.estimatedHours,
      status: course.status,
    })),
    completions: completions.map((completion) => ({
      id: completion.id,
      teacher: completion.user.name,
      course: completion.course?.titleAr ?? "",
      courseId: completion.courseId,
      hours: completion.hours,
      score: completion.bestPercentage,
      academicYear: completion.academicYear,
      date: completion.completedAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      certId: completion.certificateId,
    })),
    certificates: certificates.map((certificate) => ({
      id: certificate.id,
      serial: certificate.certificateNumber,
      teacher: certificate.teacher.name,
      title: certificate.titleAr,
      course: certificate.course?.titleAr ?? "",
      status: certificate.status,
      issuedAt: certificate.issuedAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    })),
    impactResponses: impactResponses.map((response) => ({
      id: response.id,
      respondent: response.respondent?.name ?? "",
      survey: response.survey?.titleAr ?? "",
      course: response.survey?.course?.titleAr ?? "",
      status: response.status,
      submittedAt: response.submittedAt?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) ?? "",
    })),
  };

  return {
    filename: "Qurtuba_Manara_Report.json",
    mime: "application/json",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2),
  };
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — report export builders.
 *
 * Formats (all rendered from the SAME buildReport() dataset the screen
 * shows — no separate data path, no silent fallback to empty files):
 *   • CSV        — UTF-8 with BOM (Arabic opens correctly in Excel),
 *                  CRLF rows, RFC-quoted cells, formula-injection guard.
 *   • Excel XML  — SpreadsheetML 2003 (.xls): preserves Arabic, right-to
 *                  -left sheet, styled header, meta rows. No new deps.
 *   • Print/PDF  — the print view page uses the browser print engine
 *                  (native Arabic shaping + @page A4) — see
 *                  /reports/[reportId]/print.
 *
 * Formula-injection mitigation (OWASP): text cells starting with =, +,
 * - or @ are prefixed with a single quote so spreadsheet engines treat
 * them as text. Numeric cells produced by the report builders are never
 * escaped (they are typed numbers, not user input).
 */

import type { ReportCellValue, ReportColumn, ReportData } from "@/lib/reports/service";
import { EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT } from "@/config/analytics";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Cell handling                                                        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Leading =, +, - or @ is how spreadsheet engines start a formula. */
const FORMULA_LEAD = /^[=+@\-]/;

export function isUnsafeFormulaText(value: string): boolean {
  return value.length > 0 && FORMULA_LEAD.test(value);
}

/** Neutralizes spreadsheet formula injection for TEXT cells. */
export function escapeCsvCell(raw: string): string {
  const neutralized = isUnsafeFormulaText(raw) ? `'${raw}` : raw;
  if (/[",\n\r]/.test(neutralized)) {
    return `"${neutralized.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return neutralized;
}

export function escapeXmlText(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&apos;");
}

function cellString(value: ReportCellValue): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "—";
  return String(value);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* CSV                                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export function buildReportCsv(report: ReportData): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  // Meta header (Arabic preserved; generatedAt is ISO for tooling).
  lines.push(escapeCsvCell(report.meta.titleAr));
  lines.push(
    escapeCsvCell(
      [
        report.meta.schoolName ? `المدرسة: ${report.meta.schoolName}` : null,
        report.meta.branchName ? `الفرع: ${report.meta.branchName}` : null,
        report.meta.dateRangeLabel ? `الفترة: ${report.meta.dateRangeLabel}` : null,
        `تاريخ التوليد: ${report.meta.generatedAt.toISOString()}`,
      ]
        .filter((part) => part !== null)
        .join(" | ")
    )
  );
  lines.push("");

  if (report.columns.length > 0) {
    lines.push(report.columns.map((column) => escapeCsvCell(column.label)).join(","));
    const limited = report.rows.slice(0, EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT);
    for (const row of limited) {
      lines.push(
        report.columns
          .map((column) => {
            const value = row.values[column.key] ?? null;
            if (typeof value === "number") return String(value);
            return escapeCsvCell(cellString(value));
          })
          .join(",")
      );
    }
    if (report.rows.length > EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT) {
      lines.push(escapeCsvCell(`تنبيه: تم اقتصار الملف على أول ${EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT} صفًا من ${report.rows.length}.`));
    }
  }

  if (report.sections) {
    for (const section of report.sections) {
      lines.push("");
      lines.push(escapeCsvCell(section.titleAr));
      for (const item of section.items) {
        lines.push(`${escapeCsvCell(item.label)},${escapeCsvCell(item.value)}`);
        if (item.note) lines.push(escapeCsvCell(`ملاحظة: ${item.note}`));
      }
      if (section.note) lines.push(escapeCsvCell(section.note));
    }
  }

  // BOM first so Excel detects UTF-8 Arabic.
  return `\uFEFF${lines.join("\r\n")}\r\n`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* SpreadsheetML (Excel-compatible .xls)                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function xmlCell(value: ReportCellValue, columnType: ReportColumn["type"]): string {
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    return `<Cell><Data ss:Type="Number">${value}</Data></Cell>`;
  }
  const text = escapeXmlText(cellString(value));
  if (
    columnType === "percent" &&
    typeof value === "string" &&
    value.trim() !== "" &&
    !Number.isNaN(Number(value))
  ) {
    return `<Cell><Data ss:Type="Number">${Number(value)}</Data></Cell>`;
  }
  return `<Cell><Data ss:Type="String">${text}</Data></Cell>`;
}

export function buildReportExcelXml(report: ReportData): string {
  const rows: string[] = [];
  const titleCell = (text: string, bold = false) =>
    `<Cell ss:StyleID="${bold ? "header" : "meta"}"><Data ss:Type="String">${escapeXmlText(text)}</Data></Cell>`;

  rows.push(`<Row>${titleCell(report.meta.titleAr, true)}</Row>`);
  const metaParts = [
    report.meta.schoolName ? `المدرسة: ${report.meta.schoolName}` : null,
    report.meta.branchName ? `الفرع: ${report.meta.branchName}` : null,
    report.meta.scopeNote,
    report.meta.dateRangeLabel ? `الفترة: ${report.meta.dateRangeLabel}` : null,
    `تاريخ التوليد: ${report.meta.generatedAt.toISOString()}`,
  ].filter((part) => part !== null);
  rows.push(`<Row>${titleCell(metaParts.join(" — "))}</Row>`);
  rows.push(`<Row></Row>`);

  if (report.columns.length > 0) {
    rows.push(
      `<Row>${report.columns
        .map((column) => `<Cell ss:StyleID="header"><Data ss:Type="String">${escapeXmlText(column.label)}</Data></Cell>`)
        .join("")}</Row>`
    );
    const limited = report.rows.slice(0, EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT);
    for (const row of limited) {
      rows.push(
        `<Row>${report.columns.map((column) => xmlCell(row.values[column.key] ?? null, column.type)).join("")}</Row>`
      );
    }
    if (report.rows.length > EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT) {
      rows.push(
        `<Row>${titleCell(`تنبيه: تم اقتصار الملف على أول ${EXPORT_ROW_LIMIT} صفًا من ${report.rows.length}.`)}</Row>`
      );
    }
  }

  if (report.sections) {
    for (const section of report.sections) {
      rows.push(`<Row></Row>`);
      rows.push(`<Row>${titleCell(section.titleAr, true)}</Row>`);
      rows.push(`<Row>${titleCell("البند")}<Cell><Data ss:Type="String">القيمة</Data></Cell></Row>`);
      for (const item of section.items) {
        rows.push(
          `<Row>${titleCell(item.label)}<Cell><Data ss:Type="String">${escapeXmlText(item.value)}</Data></Cell></Row>`
        );
        if (item.note) {
          rows.push(`<Row>${titleCell(`ملاحظة: ${item.note}`)}</Row>`);
        }
      }
      if (section.note) {
        rows.push(`<Row>${titleCell(section.note)}</Row>`);
      }
    }
  }

  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?mso-application progid="Excel.Sheet"?>
<Workbook xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet"
 xmlns:ss="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet">
 <Styles>
  <Style ss:ID="header">
   <Font ss:Bold="1" ss:Color="#FFFFFF"/>
   <Interior ss:Color="#1D5BD6" ss:Pattern="Solid"/>
  </Style>
  <Style ss:ID="meta">
   <Font ss:Color="#334155"/>
  </Style>
 </Styles>
 <Worksheet ss:Name="${escapeXmlText(report.meta.titleAr.slice(0, 28))}">
  <WorksheetOptions xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:excel">
   <DisplayRightToLeft/>
  </WorksheetOptions>
  <Table>
   ${rows.join("\n   ")}
  </Table>
 </Worksheet>
</Workbook>`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Download filename helpers                                            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** ASCII fallback + RFC 5987 UTF-8 name so Arabic filenames survive. */
export function contentDispositionFor(filenameBase: string, extension: string): string {
  const ascii = `report-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.${extension}`;
  const encoded = encodeURIComponent(`${filenameBase}.${extension}`);
  return `attachment; filename="${ascii}"; filename*=UTF-8''${encoded}`;
}

/**
 * Phase 10 — report center service: catalog, server-side filter
 * validation and report builders for the four back-office roles.
 *
 * Invariants:
 *   • ONE dataset per report: the preview page, the print view and the
 *     CSV/Excel export endpoints all call buildReport() — exports can
 *     never contain data the screen would not show.
 *   • Every filter is validated server-side (Zod + database checks):
 *     users cannot reach unauthorized schools/branches/teachers by
 *     manipulating query strings.
 *   • Every percentage has an explicit denominator; empty datasets
 *     produce empty tables with honest messages — never fake rows.
 *   • Survey reports aggregate only; individual answers stay in the
 *     survey module under its own privacy rules.
 *   • Row hard cap (REPORT_ROW_LIMIT) protects report generation.
 */
