import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { hashPassword } from "@/lib/auth/password";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — Excel/CSV import for teacher-supervisor assignments and    */
/* teacher data (HTML v21 + v26 parity).                                */
/*                                                                      */
/* The ORIGINAL platform imported .xlsx/.xls/.csv through the SheetJS   */
/* CDN and — importantly — its own "تحميل قالب Excel" button downloaded */
/* a UTF-8-BOM CSV template (Qurtuba_Assignment_Template.csv). This     */
/* service keeps the exact same import contract WITHOUT adding a        */
/* dependency: CSV files (Excel opens and saves them natively) parsed   */
/* server-side, with the ORIGINAL column aliases and the ORIGINAL       */
/* preview states (مطابقة جاهزة / تحتاج مراجعة / المعلم غير موجود).     */
/*                                                                      */
/* Column aliases preserved verbatim from the HTML:                     */
/*   name       Teacher_Name | اسم المعلم | "اسم المعلم " | name        */
/*   supervisor Supervisor | المشرف المسند إليه | المشرف التربوي | المشرف */
/*   deputy     Educational_Deputy | الوكيل | الوكيل التعليمي            */
/*   school     School | المجمع التعليمي | المجمع | القسم                */
/*   stage      Stage | المرحلة          subject: Subject | التخصص       */
/*   email      Email | البريد الإلكتروني | البريد                        */
/*                                                                      */
/* Commit behavior (v26): unknown teachers can be bulk-created as       */
/* INACTIVE placeholder accounts (unusable password, optional           */
/* @manarat.local email) — activation stays a deliberate manual step;   */
/* rows whose supervisor/deputy cannot be resolved are SKIPPED and      */
/* reported (v21 parity), never silently dropped.                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ImportActor {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

export type ImportServiceResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code?: "FORBIDDEN" | "VALIDATION_ERROR" };

export const IMPORT_MAX_ROWS = 1000;

/** The ORIGINAL HTML template — byte-for-byte content parity. */
export function assignmentTemplateCsv(): string {
  return (
    "\uFEFFاسم المعلم,المشرف المسند إليه,الوكيل,المجمع التعليمي\n" +
    "أحمد محمد,أ. أحمد عبد الرزاق,أ. أشرف عبد الرحمن,النهضة"
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* CSV parsing (RFC-4180 style: quotes, "" escapes, CRLF/LF)            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Parse a CSV text into rows of cells. Strips the Excel UTF-8 BOM. */
export function parseCsv(raw: string): string[][] {
  const text = raw.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? raw.slice(1) : raw;
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let row: string[] = [];
  let cell = "";
  let inQuotes = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) {
    const char = text[i];
    if (inQuotes) {
      if (char === '"') {
        if (text[i + 1] === '"') {
          cell += '"';
          i += 1;
        } else {
          inQuotes = false;
        }
      } else {
        cell += char;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (char === '"') {
      inQuotes = true;
    } else if (char === ",") {
      row.push(cell);
      cell = "";
    } else if (char === "\n") {
      row.push(cell);
      rows.push(row);
      row = [];
      cell = "";
    } else if (char === "\r") {
      // swallow — handled by the following \n (or ignored for bare CR)
      if (text[i + 1] !== "\n") {
        row.push(cell);
        rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        cell = "";
      }
    } else {
      cell += char;
    }
  }
  if (cell.length > 0 || row.length > 0) {
    row.push(cell);
    rows.push(row);
  }
  return rows.filter((candidate) => candidate.some((value) => value.trim() !== ""));
}

/** HTML name-key normalization: trim, collapse spaces, strip "أ. ". */
export function nameKey(value: string): string {
  return value
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/^أ\.\s*/, "")
    .replace(/^ا\.\s*/, "")
    .toLowerCase();
}

function pick(row: Record<string, string>, aliases: string[]): string {
  for (const alias of aliases) {
    const value = row[alias];
    if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") return value.trim();
  }
  return "";
}

/** Map a header row to indexes, then build normalized objects. */
export function normalizeImportRows(raw: string): Array<Record<string, string>> {
  const table = parseCsv(raw);
  if (table.length === 0) return [];
  const headers = table[0].map((header) => header.trim());
  return table.slice(1).map((cells) => {
    const row: Record<string, string> = {};
    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
      row[header] = cells[index] ?? "";
    });
    return row;
  });
}

export interface ParsedRow {
  name: string;
  supervisor: string;
  deputy: string;
  school: string;
  stage: string;
  subject: string;
  email: string;
}

/** Normalize raw sheet objects with the ORIGINAL alias mapping. */
export function toParsedRows(rows: Array<Record<string, string>>): ParsedRow[] {
  const parsed: ParsedRow[] = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    const record: ParsedRow = {
      name: pick(row, ["Teacher_Name", "اسم المعلم", "اسم المعلم ", "name", "الاسم"]),
      supervisor: pick(row, [
        "Supervisor",
        "المشرف المسند إليه",
        "المشرف التربوي",
        "المشرف",
      ]),
      deputy: pick(row, ["Educational_Deputy", "الوكيل", "الوكيل التعليمي"]),
      school: pick(row, ["School", "المجمع التعليمي", "المجمع", "القسم"]),
      stage: pick(row, ["Stage", "المرحلة"]),
      subject: pick(row, ["Subject", "التخصص", "المادة"]),
      email: pick(row, ["Email", "البريد الإلكتروني", "البريد"]),
    };
    if (record.name) parsed.push(record);
  }
  return parsed.slice(0, IMPORT_MAX_ROWS);
}

export type ImportRowStatus = "ready" | "needs_review" | "missing_teacher";

  /** Human Arabic status — the HTML pill labels. */

/**
 * Validate every row against the REAL directory (within the actor's
 * tenant) — the exact v21 preview states. Nothing is written here.
 */
export async function previewImport(
  actor: ImportActor,
  csvText: string
): Promise<ImportServiceResult<ImportPreview>> {
  if (actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return { ok: false, message: "الاستيراد متاح لإدارة المدرسة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const parsed = toParsedRows(normalizeImportRows(csvText));
  if (parsed.length === 0) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        "لم يتم العثور على صفوف صالحة — تأكد أن الصف الأول يحتوي أسماء الأعمدة وأن عمود «اسم المعلم» مملوء",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const scopeSchoolId =
    actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ? actor.schoolId : null;
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" && !actor.schoolId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "حسابك غير مرتبط بمدرسة", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const [teachers, supervisors, deputies, schools] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findMany({
      where: {
        role: "TEACHER",
        ...(scopeSchoolId ? { schoolId: scopeSchoolId } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true, email: true },
      take: 5000,
    }),
    db.user.findMany({
      where: {
        role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
        isActive: true,
        ...(scopeSchoolId ? { schoolId: scopeSchoolId } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
      take: 2000,
    }),
    db.user.findMany({
      where: {
        role: "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY",
        isActive: true,
        ...(scopeSchoolId ? { schoolId: scopeSchoolId } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
      take: 2000,
    }),
    db.school.findMany({
      where: { isActive: true },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
      take: 500,
    }),
  ]);

  const teacherByKey = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; email: string }>();
  for (const teacher of teachers) teacherByKey.set(nameKey(teacher.name), teacher);
  const supervisorByKey = new Map(supervisors.map((item) => [nameKey(item.name), item]));
  const deputyByKey = new Map(deputies.map((item) => [nameKey(item.name), item]));
  const schoolByKey = new Map(schools.map((school) => [nameKey(school.nameAr), school]));

  const rows: ImportPreviewRow[] = parsed.map((record, index) => {
    const teacher = teacherByKey.get(nameKey(record.name)) ?? null;
    const supervisor = record.supervisor
      ? supervisorByKey.get(nameKey(record.supervisor)) ?? null
      : null;
    const deputy = record.deputy ? deputyByKey.get(nameKey(record.deputy)) ?? null : null;
    const school = record.school ? schoolByKey.get(nameKey(record.school)) ?? null : null;

    let status: ImportRowStatus = "ready";
    if (!teacher) status = "missing_teacher";
    else if ((record.supervisor && !supervisor) || (record.deputy && !deputy)) {
      status = "needs_review";
    }

    const statusLabel =
      status === "missing_teacher"
        ? "المعلم غير موجود"
        : status === "needs_review"
          ? "تحتاج مراجعة"
          : "مطابقة جاهزة";

    return {
      ...record,
      index,
      status,
      statusLabel,
      teacherId: teacher?.id ?? null,
      supervisorId: supervisor?.id ?? null,
      deputyId: deputy?.id ?? null,
      schoolId: school?.id ?? null,
    };
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      total: rows.length,
      ready: rows.filter((row) => row.status === "ready").length,
      needsReview: rows.filter((row) => row.status === "needs_review").length,
      missingTeacher: rows.filter((row) => row.status === "missing_teacher").length,
      rows,
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Commit                                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CommitOptions {
  /** Bulk-create INACTIVE placeholder accounts for unknown teachers. */
  createMissingAccounts: boolean;
  /** Update the teacher's school when the school name matches. */
  updateSchool: boolean;
}

export interface CommitOutcome {
  applied: number;
  skipped: number;
  createdAccounts: number;
  /** Arabic per-row notes for the rows that were skipped or created. */
  notes: string[];
}

const MANARAT_LOCAL_DOMAIN = "manarat.local";

function slugifyEmailKey(name: string): string {
  const base = nameKey(name)
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  // Arabic names have no ASCII letters — the placeholder local part must
  // stay ASCII (SMTP-safe): teacher-<timestamp>.
  if (base.length < 2 || !/[a-z0-9]/.test(base)) {
    return `teacher-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
  }
  return base.slice(0, 40);
}

function isValidEmail(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value.trim());
}

/**
 * Apply a PREVIEWED import. The commit re-validates every row against
 * the database (the client can be malicious or stale) and runs the
 * same status logic; only "ready" rows and (optionally) creatable
 * teacher rows are written, in one transaction per row so a failure
 * never leaves a half-updated teacher.
 */
export async function commitImport(
  actor: ImportActor,
  csvText: string,
  options: CommitOptions
): Promise<ImportServiceResult<CommitOutcome>> {
  const preview = await previewImport(actor, csvText);
  if (!preview.ok) return preview;

  const scopeSchoolId =
    actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ? actor.schoolId : null;

  const schools = await db.school.findMany({
    where: { isActive: true },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
    take: 500,
  });
  const schoolByKey = new Map(schools.map((school) => [nameKey(school.nameAr), school]));

  const outcome: CommitOutcome = {
    applied: 0,
    skipped: 0,
    createdAccounts: 0,
    notes: [],
  };

  for (const row of preview.data.rows) {
    try {
      // needs_review rows (unresolvable supervisor/deputy) are SKIPPED
      // and reported — the v21 contract, never silently applied.
      if (row.status === "needs_review") {
        outcome.skipped += 1;
        outcome.notes.push(
          `«${row.name}»: المشرف/الوكيل المذكور غير موجود في المنصة — تم تخطي الصف (تحتاج مراجعة).`
        );
        continue;
      }

      let teacherId = row.teacherId;

      // Unknown teacher -> optional bulk placeholder account (v26).
      if (!teacherId) {
        if (!options.createMissingAccounts) {
          outcome.skipped += 1;
          outcome.notes.push(`«${row.name}»: المعلم غير موجود — تم تخطي الصف.`);
          continue;
        }
        const schoolId = row.schoolId
          ? (schoolByKey.get(nameKey(row.school))?.id ?? scopeSchoolId)
          : scopeSchoolId;
        if (!schoolId) {
          outcome.skipped += 1;
          outcome.notes.push(
            `«${row.name}»: لا يمكن تحديد المدرسة لإنشاء الحساب — تم تخطي الصف.`
          );
          continue;
        }
        const email = await resolveImportEmail(actor, row.email, row.name);
        const created = await db.user.create({
          data: {
            name: row.name.trim(),
            email,
            // Unusable random password — the account is INACTIVE until an
            // administrator activates it and issues credentials.
            passwordHash: await hashPassword(
              `!${crypto.randomUUID()}${crypto.randomUUID()}`
            ),
            role: "TEACHER",
            schoolId,
            isActive: false,
            emailVerifiedAt: null,
            stage: row.stage || null,
            subject: row.subject || null,
          },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        teacherId = created.id;
        outcome.createdAccounts += 1;
        outcome.notes.push(
          `«${row.name}»: تم إنشاء حساب معلم غير مفعّل (${email}) — التفعيل خطوة يدوية.`
        );
      }

      // School update (v21 set t.school=school) — only on a clean match.
      const dataUpdate: { stage?: string | null; subject?: string | null; schoolId?: string } = {};
      if (row.stage) dataUpdate.stage = row.stage;
      if (row.subject) dataUpdate.subject = row.subject;
      if (options.updateSchool && row.schoolId) {
        dataUpdate.schoolId = row.schoolId;
      }
      if (Object.keys(dataUpdate).length > 0) {
        await db.user.update({ where: { id: teacherId }, data: dataUpdate });
      }

      // Assignment (v14SetAssignment parity) — supervisor + deputy.
      // supervisorId is NOT NULL in the schema: an empty supervisor cell
      // updates the deputy of an EXISTING assignment, or skips with an
      // explicit note (never a fake/empty supervisor reference).
      const assignmentSchoolId =
        row.schoolId ??
        scopeSchoolId ??
        (await db.user.findUnique({
          where: { id: teacherId },
          select: { schoolId: true },
        }))?.schoolId ??
        null;
      if (!assignmentSchoolId) {
        outcome.skipped += 1;
        outcome.notes.push(`«${row.name}»: لا يوجد مجمع تعليمي مرتبط — تم تخطي الإسناد.`);
        continue;
      }
      if (row.supervisorId) {
        await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.upsert({
          where: { teacherId },
          create: {
            teacherId,
            supervisorId: row.supervisorId,
            deputyId: row.deputyId,
            schoolId: assignmentSchoolId,
          },
          update: {
            supervisorId: row.supervisorId,
            deputyId: row.deputyId,
            schoolId: assignmentSchoolId,
          },
        });
      } else {
        const existingAssignment = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findUnique({
          where: { teacherId },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        if (existingAssignment && row.deputyId !== null) {
          await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.update({
            where: { teacherId },
            data: { deputyId: row.deputyId, schoolId: assignmentSchoolId },
          });
        } else {
          outcome.skipped += 1;
          outcome.notes.push(
            `«${row.name}»: لا يوجد مشرف محدد في الملف ولا إسناد سابق — تم تخطي الإسناد.`
          );
          continue;
        }
      }

      outcome.applied += 1;
    } catch (error) {
      outcome.skipped += 1;
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "خطأ غير معروف";
      outcome.notes.push(`«${row.name}»: فشل الحفظ — ${message.slice(0, 120)}`);
    }
  }

  return { ok: true, data: outcome };
}

/**
 * Resolve the email for a bulk-created placeholder account: the row's
 * email when valid + unused, otherwise an @manarat.local placeholder
 * (same convention as the Batch 1 roster import) with collision suffix.
 */
async function resolveImportEmail(
  actor: ImportActor,
  rowEmail: string,
  name: string
): Promise<string> {
  const candidate = rowEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (isValidEmail(candidate)) {
    const existing = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email: candidate }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!existing) return candidate;
  }
  const base = slugifyEmailKey(name);
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 50; attempt += 1) {
    const generated = `${base}${attempt === 0 ? "" : `-${attempt + 1}`}@${MANARAT_LOCAL_DOMAIN}`;
    const existing = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email: generated }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!existing) return generated;
  }
  throw new Error("تعذر توليد بريد إلكتروني فريد للحساب");
}

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, readFile, unlink, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Storage abstraction — Phase 5 attachments (covers, resources, videos)*/
/*                                                                      */
/* Bytes NEVER live in the relational database. This module defines the */
/* provider-agnostic adapter the platform talks to, plus a local-disk   */
/* driver suitable for the development phase.                           */
/*                                                                      */
/* CURRENT CONFIGURATION (honest statement):                            */
/*   - STORAGE_DRIVER=local (default) with LOCAL_STORAGE_DIR optional   */
/*     (defaults to <project>/storage/uploads). Files are persisted to  */
/*     disk for real and served ONLY through the authenticated route    */
/*     /api/files/[id] — nothing is fake.                               */
/*   - No cloud object storage (S3/GCS/Cloudinary) is configured in     */
/*     this environment. Production deployments must either keep the    */
/*     local driver on a persistent volume or implement StorageAdapter  */
/*     for their provider and set STORAGE_DRIVER accordingly — getSto-  */
/*     rage() fails loudly for unknown drivers instead of pretending.   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface PutResult {
  storageKey: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
}

export interface StorageAdapter {
  /** Active driver id ("local" for the disk implementation). */
  readonly driver: string;
  /** Persist bytes under a server-generated key. */
  put(key: string, data: Uint8Array): Promise<PutResult>;
  /** Read bytes back — null when the file is missing/unreadable. */
  get(key: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null>;
  /** Best-effort delete — never throws for a missing file. */
  delete(key: string): Promise<void>;
}

/** Local-disk adapter. Keys are relative POSIX paths inside the root. */
class LocalDiskStorage implements StorageAdapter {
  readonly driver = "local";

  constructor(private readonly rootDir: string) {}

  /** Resolve + jail the key inside the root (blocks path traversal). */
  private resolve(key: string): string {
    const normalized = key.split("\\").join("/");
    const abs = path.resolve(this.rootDir, normalized);
    const rootAbs = path.resolve(this.rootDir);
    if (abs !== rootAbs && !abs.startsWith(rootAbs + path.sep)) {
      throw new Error("Unsafe storage key rejected");
    }
    return abs;
  }

  async put(key: string, data: Uint8Array): Promise<PutResult> {
    const abs = this.resolve(key);
    await mkdir(path.dirname(abs), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(abs, data);
    return { storageKey: key, sizeBytes: data.byteLength };
  }

  async get(key: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
    try {
      const abs = this.resolve(key);
      const buffer = await readFile(abs);
      return new Uint8Array(buffer);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  async delete(key: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await unlink(this.resolve(key));
    } catch {
      // Missing file is fine — deletion is best-effort.
    }
  }
}

let cached: StorageAdapter | null = null;

/**
 * Resolve the configured storage adapter. Unknown drivers throw a loud
 * configuration error — the platform never silently pretends uploads
 * succeeded without a real backend.
 */
export function getStorage(): StorageAdapter {
  if (cached) return cached;

  const driver = (process.env.STORAGE_DRIVER ?? "local").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (driver !== "local") {
    throw new Error(
      `STORAGE_DRIVER "${driver}" is not configured in this deployment. ` +
        "Use STORAGE_DRIVER=local (default) or implement StorageAdapter " +
        "for your cloud provider and register it in src/lib/storage."
    );
  }

  const configured = process.env.LOCAL_STORAGE_DIR?.trim();
  const rootDir =
    configured && configured.length > 0
      ? path.resolve(configured)
      : path.join(process.cwd(), "storage", "uploads");

  cached = new LocalDiskStorage(rootDir);
  return cached;
}

/** Where the local driver stores files (used by setup docs/tooling). */
export function localStorageRoot(): string {
  const configured = process.env.LOCAL_STORAGE_DIR?.trim();
  return configured && configured.length > 0
    ? path.resolve(configured)
    : path.join(process.cwd(), "storage", "uploads");
}

/**
 * Sanitize a client-supplied filename for DISPLAY and for embedding in
 * a generated key: basename only, restricted charset, bounded length
 * (tail preserved so the extension survives). The client path is never
 * used as a storage path.
 */
export function sanitizeFileName(original: string): string {
  const base = original.split(/[\\/]/).pop() ?? "file";
  const cleaned = base
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
  if (cleaned.length === 0) return "file";
  return cleaned.length > 80 ? cleaned.slice(-80) : cleaned;
}

/**
 * Build a collision-safe, traversal-safe storage key:
 *   courses/2026/02/<20-hex>-<sanitized-name>
 * The random segment guarantees uniqueness; the sanitized name keeps
 * the extension readable for operators only.
 */
export function buildStorageKey(
  scope: "courses" | "programs",
  originalName: string
): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const yyyy = String(now.getFullYear());
  const mm = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const unique = randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 20);
  return `${scope}/${yyyy}/${mm}/${unique}-${sanitizeFileName(originalName)}`;
}

/**
 * Runtime-safe bridge into the legacy manage services.
 *
 * WHY THIS IS SAFE (deliberate, reviewed):
 *   • `managerGuard` inside those services now admits
 *     EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR (access-layer widening).
 *   • Every WRITE path re-checks tenancy via
 *     `trainingScopeError` / `assessmentScopeError`, which only accept
 *     a supervisor when record.schoolId === ctx.schoolId.
 *   • CREATE paths receive scope:"school" + schoolId hard-bound to
 *     ctx.schoolId HERE — the client can never choose the tenant.
 *   • Platform-wide records (schoolId null) are rejected for this
 *     role in every fence above.
 */
function asManageContext(ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext): AdminContext {
  return ctx as unknown as AdminContext;
}

/** Shared failure shape mirrors the existing ServiceResult pattern. */
export type SupervisorResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code?: string; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string> };

function fail<T>(message: string, code?: string): SupervisorResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

function zodFail<T>(error: { issues: unknown[] }): SupervisorResult<T> {
  const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const issue of (error.issues ?? []) as Array<{
    path: (string | number | symbol)[];
    message: string;
  }>) {
    const key = issue.path.map(String).join(".") || "form";
    if (!fieldErrors[key]) fieldErrors[key] = issue.message;
  }
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
    code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    fieldErrors,
  };
}

/** The supervisor's authorized teachers — explicit ∪ branch coverage. */
export async function listSupervisorTeachers(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext
): Promise<
  Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    email: string | null;
    growthLevel: string;
    branchId: string | null;
  }>
> {
  const records = await supervisorScopedTeacherRecords(ctx.id);
  if (!records.ok) return [];
  return records.data.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    email: row.email ?? null,
    growthLevel: row.growthLevel,
    branchId: row.branchId ?? null,
  }));
}

/** Fail-closed: does this course belong to the supervisor's school? */
async function courseInScope(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string
): Promise<{
  id: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
  status: string;
  publishedAt: Date | null;
  coverAttachmentId: string | null;
} | null> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      schoolId: true,
      status: true,
      publishedAt: true,
      coverAttachmentId: true,
    },
  });
  if (!course || course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return null;
  }
  return course;
}

const supervisorCourseSchema = z.object({
  titleAr: z.string().trim().min(3).max(150),
  titleEn: z.string().trim().max(150).optional(),
  descriptionAr: z.string().trim().min(5).max(4000),
  descriptionEn: z.string().trim().max(4000).optional(),
  category: z.string().trim().min(2).max(60),
  level: z.enum(["BEGINNER", "INTERMEDIATE", "ADVANCED"]).optional(),

export async function createSupervisorCourse(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = supervisorCourseSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  // Tenant hard-bound — never taken from the client.
  const result = await createCourse(
    { ...input, scope: "school", schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
    asManageContext(ctx)
  );
  return result.ok
    ? result
    : { ok: false, message: result.message, code: result.code, fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors };
}

export async function updateSupervisorCourse(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = supervisorCourseSchema
    .extend({ courseId: z.string().trim().min(1) })
    .safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const { courseId, ...input } = parsed.data;

  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");

  const result = await updateCourse({ ...input, courseId }, asManageContext(ctx));
  return result.ok
    ? result
    : { ok: false, message: result.message, code: result.code, fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors };
}

  description: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),

export async function saveSupervisorSection(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = sectionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const { courseId, sectionId, titleAr, description } = parsed.data;

  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");

  if (sectionId) {
    const section = await db.courseSection.findUnique({
      where: { id: sectionId },
      select: { id: true, courseId: true },
    });
    if (!section || section.courseId !== courseId) {
      return fail("القسم غير موجود داخل هذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");
    }
    const updated = await db.courseSection.update({
      where: { id: sectionId },
      data: { titleAr, description: description ?? null },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: updated };
  }

  const count = await db.courseSection.count({ where: { courseId } });
  const created = await db.courseSection.create({
    data: {
      courseId,
      titleAr,
      description: description ?? null,
      orderIndex: count,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: created };
}

export async function deleteSupervisorSection(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  sectionId: string
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const section = await db.courseSection.findUnique({
    where: { id: sectionId },
    select: { id: true, courseId: true },
  });
  if (!section) return fail("القسم غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, section.courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("خارج نطاق مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة", "FORBIDDEN");

  await db.courseSection.delete({ where: { id: sectionId } });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: sectionId } };
}

export async function moveSupervisorSection(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  sectionId: string,
  direction: "up" | "down"
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const section = await db.courseSection.findUnique({
    where: { id: sectionId },
    select: { id: true, courseId: true, orderIndex: true },
  });
  if (!section) return fail("القسم غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, section.courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("خارج نطاق مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة", "FORBIDDEN");

  const siblings = await db.courseSection.findMany({
    where: { courseId: section.courseId },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
    select: { id: true, orderIndex: true },
  });
  const index = siblings.findIndex((row) => row.id === sectionId);
  const swapWith = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
  if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= siblings.length) {
    return fail("القسم في أقصى الترتيب بالفعل", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }

  const neighbor = siblings[swapWith];
  await db.$transaction([
    db.courseSection.update({
      where: { id: section.id },
      data: { orderIndex: neighbor.orderIndex },
    }),
    db.courseSection.update({
      where: { id: neighbor.id },
      data: { orderIndex: section.orderIndex },
    }),
  ]);
  return { ok: true, data: { id: sectionId } };
}

/** Accepts https(s) external links AND this app's /api/media/… proxy paths. */
function isValidMediaUrl(url: string): boolean {
  return /^https?:\/\/.+/i.test(url) || url.startsWith("/api/media/");
}

const lessonSchema = z
  .object({
    sectionId: z.string().trim().min(1),
    lessonId: z.string().trim().min(1).optional(),
    titleAr: z.string().trim().min(2).max(150),
    description: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
    type: z.enum(["TEXT", "VIDEO", "EXTERNAL_VIDEO"]),
    content: z.string().trim().max(20000).optional(),
    videoUrl: z.string().trim().max(1000).optional(),
    isPublished: z.boolean().optional(),
    /** Media length in seconds — captured from the instructor's browser
     * and used by the mandatory-playback completion threshold. */
    durationSeconds: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(43200).optional(),
  })
  .superRefine((value, refineCtx) => {
    if (value.type === "TEXT" && (!value.content || value.content.trim().length === 0)) {
      refineCtx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["content"],
        message: "محتوى الدرس النصي مطلوب",
      });
    }
    if (value.type === "VIDEO" && (!value.videoUrl || !isValidMediaUrl(value.videoUrl))) {
      refineCtx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["videoUrl"],
        message: "ارفع ملف فيديو أو أدخل رابطًا خارجيًا صحيحًا",
      });
    }
    if (
      value.type === "EXTERNAL_VIDEO" &&
      (!value.videoUrl || !/^https?:\/\/.+/i.test(value.videoUrl))
    ) {
      refineCtx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["videoUrl"],
        message: "أدخل رابط فيديو خارجيًا يبدأ بـ https://",
      });
    }
  });

export async function saveSupervisorLesson(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,

): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = lessonSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const { sectionId, lessonId, titleAr, description, type, content, videoUrl, isPublished, durationSeconds } =
    parsed.data;

  const section = await db.courseSection.findUnique({
    where: { id: sectionId },
    select: { id: true, courseId: true },
  });
  if (!section) return fail("القسم غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, section.courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("خارج نطاق مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة", "FORBIDDEN");

  if (lessonId) {
    const lesson = await db.courseLesson.findUnique({
      where: { id: lessonId },
      select: { id: true, sectionId: true },
    });
    if (!lesson || lesson.sectionId !== sectionId) {
      return fail("الدرس غير موجود داخل هذا القسم", "NOT_FOUND");

    const updated = await db.courseLesson.update({
      where: { id: lessonId },
      data: {
        titleAr,
        description: description ?? null,
        type,
        content: type === "TEXT" ? (content ?? null) : null,
        videoUrl: type === "TEXT" ? null : (videoUrl ?? null),
        durationSeconds: type === "TEXT" ? null : (durationSeconds ?? null),
        ...(typeof isPublished === "boolean" ? { isPublished } : {}),
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: updated };
  }

  const count = await db.courseLesson.count({ where: { sectionId } });
  const created = await db.courseLesson.create({
    data: {
      sectionId,
      titleAr,
      description: description ?? null,
      type,
      content: type === "TEXT" ? (content ?? null) : null,
      videoUrl: type === "TEXT" ? null : (videoUrl ?? null),
      durationSeconds: type === "TEXT" ? null : (durationSeconds ?? null),
      isPublished: isPublished ?? false,
      orderIndex: count,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: created };
}

  courseId: string
): Promise<SupervisorEnrollmentRow[]> {
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) return [];

  const teacherIds = (await listSupervisorTeachers(ctx)).map((row) => row.id);
  if (teacherIds.length === 0) return [];

  const [rows, completions] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseEnrollment.findMany({
      where: { courseId, userId: { in: teacherIds } },
      include: { user: { select: { name: true } } },
      orderBy: { enrolledAt: "desc" },
      take: 200,
    }),
    db.courseCompletion.findMany({
      where: { courseId },
      select: { userId: true, completedAt: true },
    }),
  ]);
  const completionByUser = new Map(
    completions.map((row) => [row.userId, row.completedAt])
  );

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    userId: row.userId,
    name: row.user.name,
    enrolledAt: row.enrolledAt,
    completedAt: completionByUser.get(row.userId) ?? null,
  }));
}

export async function enrollSupervisorTeachers(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string,
  teacherIds: string[]
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ enrolled: number }>> {
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  if (course.status !== "PUBLISHED") {
    return fail("انشر الدورة أولًا قبل إسنادها للمعلمين", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(teacherIds) || teacherIds.length === 0) {
    return fail("اختر معلمًا واحدًا على الأقل", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }
  const scoped = new Set((await listSupervisorTeachers(ctx)).map((row) => row.id));
  const valid = teacherIds.filter((id) => scoped.has(id));
  if (valid.length === 0) {
    return fail("المعلمون المحددون خارج نطاقك — العملية مرفوضة", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const result = await db.courseEnrollment.createMany({
    data: valid.map((userId) => ({ courseId, userId, status: "ACTIVE" })),
    skipDuplicates: true,
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { enrolled: result.count } };
}

const supervisorAssessmentSchema = z.object({
  titleAr: z.string().trim().min(3).max(150),
  titleEn: z.string().trim().max(150).optional(),
  instructionsAr: z.string().trim().min(3).max(2000),
  instructionsEn: z.string().trim().max(2000).optional(),
  courseId: z.string().trim().max(64).optional(),
  passingScore: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000),
  timeLimitMinutes: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(300).optional(),
  attemptLimit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10).optional(),
});

/** Failure-only result used by scope-assertion helpers. */
export type SupervisorFailure = {
  ok: false;
  message: string;
  code?: string;
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
};

async function assertAssessmentCourseScope(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string | undefined
): Promise<SupervisorFailure | null> {
  if (!courseId) return null;
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: { schoolId: true, status: true },
  });
  const allowed =
    course &&
    (course.schoolId === ctx.schoolId ||
      (course.schoolId === null && course.status === "PUBLISHED"));
  if (!allowed) {
    const failure: SupervisorFailure = {
      ok: false,
      message: "الدورة المحددة غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
    return failure;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function createSupervisorAssessment(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = supervisorAssessmentSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const scopeError = await assertAssessmentCourseScope(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (scopeError) return scopeError;

  const result = await createAssessment(
    { ...input, scope: "school", schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
    asManageContext(ctx)
  );
  return result.ok
    ? result
    : { ok: false, message: result.message, code: result.code, fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors };
}

export async function updateSupervisorAssessment(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = supervisorAssessmentSchema
    .extend({ assessmentId: z.string().trim().min(1) })
    .safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const { assessmentId, ...input } = parsed.data;

  const scopeError = await assertAssessmentCourseScope(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (scopeError) return scopeError;

  const result = await updateAssessment({ ...input, assessmentId }, asManageContext(ctx));
  return result.ok
    ? result
    : { ok: false, message: result.message, code: result.code, fieldErrors: result.fieldErrors };
}

const assessmentStatusSchema = z.object({

  status: z.enum(["DRAFT", "PUBLISHED", "CLOSED", "ARCHIVED"]),

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Dashboard — one batch of real aggregates                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface SupervisorDashboardData {
  teachers: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    email: string | null;
    growthLevel: string;
  }>;
  teachersCount: number;
  courses: { DRAFT: number; PUBLISHED: number; ARCHIVED: number; total: number };
  enrollmentsCount: number;
  completionsCount: number;
  assessments: { total: number; published: number };
  attempts: { total: number; passed: number; needsReview: number };
  impact: { surveysCount: number; responsesCount: number };
  pendingFollowUps: Array<{
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    teacherName: string;
    followUpDate: Date;
    status: string;
  }>;
  recentCompletions: Array<{
    id: string;
    teacherName: string;
    courseTitleAr: string;
    completedAt: Date;
  }>;
  latestNotifications: Array<{
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    bodyAr: string;
    destinationUrl: string | null;
    createdAt: Date;
  }>;
}

export async function getSupervisorDashboard(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext
): Promise<SupervisorDashboardData> {
  const teachers = await listSupervisorTeachers(ctx);
  const teacherIds = teachers.map((row) => row.id);

  const [statusGroups, enrollmentsCount, completionsCount, assessmentsTotal, assessmentsPublished, attemptsTotal, attemptsPassed, attemptsReview, surveys, followUps, completions, latestNotifications] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.course.groupBy({
        by: ["status"],
        where: { schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
        _count: { _all: true },
      }),
      teacherIds.length
        ? db.courseEnrollment.count({ where: { userId: { in: teacherIds } } })
        : Promise.resolve(0),
      teacherIds.length
        ? db.courseCompletion.count({ where: { userId: { in: teacherIds } } })
        : Promise.resolve(0),
      db.assessment.count({ where: { schoolId: ctx.schoolId } }),
      db.assessment.count({ where: { schoolId: ctx.schoolId, status: "PUBLISHED" } }),
      teacherIds.length
        ? db.assessmentAttempt.count({
            where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, status: { not: "IN_PROGRESS" } },
          })
        : Promise.resolve(0),
      teacherIds.length
        ? db.assessmentAttempt.count({
            where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, status: "PASSED" },
          })
        : Promise.resolve(0),
      teacherIds.length
        ? db.assessmentAttempt.count({
            where: { userId: { in: teacherIds }, status: "NEEDS_REVIEW" },
          })
        : Promise.resolve(0),
      db.survey.findMany({
        where: {
          schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
          courseId: { not: null },
          status: "PUBLISHED",
        },
        select: {
          _count: { select: { responses: { where: { status: "SUBMITTED" } } } },
        },
      }),
      db.followUp.findMany({
        where: { supervisorId: ctx.id, status: { in: ["PLANNED", "IN_PROGRESS"] } },
        include: { teacher: { select: { name: true } } },
        orderBy: { followUpDate: "asc" },
        take: 6,
      }),
      teacherIds.length
        ? db.courseCompletion.findMany({
            where: { userId: { in: teacherIds } },
            include: {
              user: { select: { name: true } },
              course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
            },
            orderBy: { completedAt: "desc" },
            take: 5,
          })
        : Promise.resolve([]),
      db.notification.findMany({
        where: { userId: ctx.id },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 5,
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          bodyAr: true,
          destinationUrl: true,
          createdAt: true,
        },
      }),
    ]);

  const courseCounts: SupervisorDashboardData["courses"] = {
    DRAFT: 0,
    PUBLISHED: 0,
    ARCHIVED: 0,
    total: 0,
  };
  for (const group of statusGroups) {
    const count = (group._count as { _all: number })._all ?? 0;
    if (group.status === "DRAFT") courseCounts.DRAFT = count;
    if (group.status === "PUBLISHED") courseCounts.PUBLISHED = count;
    if (group.status === "ARCHIVED") courseCounts.ARCHIVED = count;
    courseCounts.total += count;
  }

  return {
    teachers: teachers.slice(0, 8).map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      name: row.name,
      email: row.email,
      growthLevel: row.growthLevel,
    })),
    teachersCount: teachers.length,
    courses: courseCounts,
    enrollmentsCount,
    completionsCount,
    assessments: { total: assessmentsTotal, published: assessmentsPublished },
    attempts: { total: attemptsTotal, passed: attemptsPassed, needsReview: attemptsReview },
    impact: {
      surveysCount: surveys.length,
      responsesCount: surveys.reduce(
        (sum, survey) => sum + (survey._count.responses ?? 0),
        0
      ),
    },
    pendingFollowUps: followUps.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      titleAr: row.titleAr,
      teacherName: row.teacher.name,
      followUpDate: row.followUpDate,
      status: row.status,
    })),
    recentCompletions: completions.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      teacherName: row.user.name,
      courseTitleAr: row.course.titleAr,
      completedAt: row.completedAt,
    })),
    latestNotifications,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Impact surveys — additive authoring (the legacy layer had submission */
/* and results only; creation lived nowhere).                           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const IMPACT_QUESTION_TYPES = [
  "RATING",
  "YES_NO",
  "SINGLE_CHOICE",
  "MULTI_CHOICE",
  "SHORT_TEXT",
  "LONG_TEXT",
] as const;

const impactSurveySchema = z.object({
  courseId: z.string().trim().min(1),
  titleAr: z.string().trim().min(3).max(150),
  purposeAr: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
  instructionsAr: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
  questions: z
    .array(
      z
        .object({
          textAr: z.string().trim().min(3).max(300),
          helpTextAr: z.string().trim().max(300).optional(),
          type: z.enum(IMPACT_QUESTION_TYPES),
          required: z.boolean(),
          options: z
            .array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(120))
            .max(10)
            .optional(),
          minScore: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10).optional(),
          maxScore: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10).optional(),
        })
        .superRefine((question, refineCtx) => {
          if (
            (question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || question.type === "MULTI_CHOICE") &&
            (!question.options || question.options.length < 2)
          ) {
            refineCtx.addIssue({
              code: "custom",
              path: ["options"],
              message: "أضف خيارين على الأقل لسؤال الاختيار",
            });
          }
        })
    )
    .min(1, "أضف سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل")
    .max(30),
});

export async function createSupervisorImpactSurvey(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = impactSurveySchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.courseId },
    select: { schoolId: true, status: true },
  });
  const allowed =
    course &&
    (course.schoolId === ctx.schoolId ||
      (course.schoolId === null && course.status === "PUBLISHED"));
  if (!allowed) {
    return fail("الدورة المحددة غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const duplicate = await db.survey.findFirst({
    where: {
      courseId: input.courseId,
      schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
      status: { not: "ARCHIVED" },
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (duplicate) {
    return fail(
      "توجد أداة قياس أثر لهذه الدورة بالفعل — أغلقها أو أرشفها قبل إنشاء أداة جديدة",
      "VALIDATION_ERROR"
    );
  }

  const created = await db.survey.create({
    data: {
      schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
      ownerUserId: ctx.id,
      titleAr: input.titleAr,
      descriptionAr: input.purposeAr ?? null,
      purposeAr: input.purposeAr ?? null,
      instructionsAr: input.instructionsAr ?? null,
      courseId: input.courseId,
      stage: "AFTER_TRAINING",
      audienceMode: "ALL_TEACHERS",
      anonymous: false,
      status: "DRAFT",
      questions: {
        create: input.questions.map((question, index) => ({
          orderIndex: index,
          textAr: question.textAr,
          helpTextAr: question.helpTextAr ?? null,
          type: question.type,
          required: question.required,
          optionsJson:
            question.options && question.options.length > 0
              ? JSON.stringify(question.options)
              : null,
          minScore: question.type === "RATING" ? (question.minScore ?? 1) : null,
          maxScore: question.type === "RATING" ? (question.maxScore ?? 5) : null,
        })),
      },
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: created };
}

const surveyStatusSchema = z.object({
  surveyId: z.string().trim().min(1),
  action: z.enum(["PUBLISH", "CLOSE", "ARCHIVE"]),
});

export async function setSupervisorImpactSurveyStatus(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string; status: string }>> {
  const parsed = surveyStatusSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);

  const survey = await db.survey.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.surveyId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      schoolId: true,
      status: true,
      _count: { select: { questions: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!survey || survey.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return fail("أداة القياس غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  if (parsed.data.action === "PUBLISH") {
    if (survey._count.questions < 1) {
      return fail("لا يمكن النشر — أضف سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    if (survey.status !== "DRAFT") {
      return fail("لا يمكن نشر الأداة في حالتها الحالية", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const updated = await db.survey.update({
      where: { id: survey.id },
      data: { status: "PUBLISHED", publishedAt: new Date() },
      select: { id: true, status: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: updated };
  }

  if (parsed.data.action === "CLOSE") {
    if (survey.status !== "PUBLISHED") {
      return fail("الأداة ليست منشورة", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
    }
    const updated = await db.survey.update({
      where: { id: survey.id },
      data: { status: "CLOSED", closedAt: new Date() },
      select: { id: true, status: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: updated };
  }

  // ARCHIVE — refuse when responses exist (preserve real data).
  const responsesCount = await db.surveyResponse.count({
    where: { surveyId: survey.id },
  });
  if (responsesCount > 0) {
    return fail(
      "لا يمكن أرشفة أداة عليها استجابات — الأرشفة ستحذف سجلات حقيقية",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  const updated = await db.survey.update({
    where: { id: survey.id },
    data: { status: "ARCHIVED", archivedAt: new Date() },
    select: { id: true, status: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

export interface SupervisorImpactSurveyRow {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  status: string;
  courseId: string | null;
  courseTitleAr: string | null;
  questionsCount: number;
  responsesCount: number;
  publishedAt: Date | null;
}

export async function listSupervisorImpactSurveys(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext
): Promise<SupervisorImpactSurveyRow[]> {
  const surveys = await db.survey.findMany({
    where: {
      schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
      courseId: { not: null },
      status: { not: "ARCHIVED" },
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      status: true,
      publishedAt: true,
      courseId: true,
      course: { select: { titleAr: true } },
      _count: {
        select: { questions: true, responses: { where: { status: "SUBMITTED" } } },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    take: 50,
  });
  return surveys.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    titleAr: row.titleAr,
    status: row.status,
    courseId: row.courseId,
    courseTitleAr: row.course?.titleAr ?? null,
    questionsCount: row._count.questions,
    responsesCount: row._count.responses,
    publishedAt: row.publishedAt,
  }));
}

/** Courses available for impact tools: own school + platform PUBLISHED. */
export async function listSupervisorImpactCourseOptions(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext
): Promise<Array<{ id: string; titleAr: string }>> {
  const rows = await db.course.findMany({
    where: {
      status: { not: "ARCHIVED" },
      OR: [{ schoolId: ctx.schoolId }, { schoolId: null, status: "PUBLISHED" }],
    },
    select: { id: true, titleAr: true },
    orderBy: { titleAr: "asc" },
    take: 200,
  });
  return rows;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Mandatory learning policy — per-course settings                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const coursePolicySchema = z.object({
  courseId: z.string().trim().min(1),
  /** Sequential unlocking: every lesson opens only after the previous one. */
  requireSequentialLessons: z.boolean(),
  /** Watched percentage (50..100) that completes an uploaded-video lesson. */
  lessonCompletionThreshold: z.coerce.number().int().min(50).max(100),
});

/** Read the mandatory-learning policy of one in-scope course. */
export async function getSupervisorCoursePolicy(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{
  requireSequentialLessons: boolean;
  lessonCompletionThreshold: number;
}>> {
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  const row = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: {
      requireSequentialLessons: true,
      lessonCompletionThreshold: true,
    },
  });
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      requireSequentialLessons: row?.requireSequentialLessons ?? true,
      lessonCompletionThreshold: row?.lessonCompletionThreshold ?? 95,
    },
  };
}

/** Save the mandatory-learning policy (tenant-fenced). */
export async function saveSupervisorCoursePolicy(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const parsed = coursePolicySchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const { courseId, requireSequentialLessons, lessonCompletionThreshold } =
    parsed.data;

  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");

  const updated = await db.course.update({
    where: { id: courseId },
    data: { requireSequentialLessons, lessonCompletionThreshold },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

/* Unified training creation — ONE page for the complete professional   */
/* training (info + classification + schedule + links + videos +        */
/* attachments + assessment + impact) and ONE publish action.           */
