/* Reuses: courseInScope fence, the existing lesson/assessment/impact   */
/* actions, the R2 media pipeline (request → PUT → confirm) and the     */
/* survey/assessment models. NOTHING new is introduced as a parallel    */
/* system: videos stay CourseLesson(VIDEO), attachments stay Attachment */
/* (kind RESOURCE), the final assessment stays Assessment+questions,    */
/* impact stays Survey(stage AFTER_TRAINING)+SurveyQuestion.            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

// Canonical option lists live in the shared (client-safe) config module
// and are re-exported here for server-side consumers.
export {
  TRAINING_TYPES,
  TRAINING_DOMAINS,
  TRAINING_SUBCATEGORIES,
  DEFAULT_PASSING_PERCENT,
  trainingTypeLabel,
  type TrainingTypeKey,
} from "@/config/training-domains";

import {
  DEFAULT_PASSING_PERCENT,
  TRAINING_DOMAINS,
  TRAINING_SUBCATEGORIES,
} from "@/config/training-domains";

const unifiedTrainingSchema = z
  .object({
    courseId: z.string().trim().min(1).optional(),
    titleAr: z.string().trim().min(3).max(150),
    titleEn: z.string().trim().max(150).optional(),
    descriptionAr: z.string().trim().min(5).max(4000),
    descriptionEn: z.string().trim().max(4000).optional(),
    category: z.string().trim().min(2).max(60),
    subcategory: z.string().trim().max(60).optional(),
    trainingType: z
      .enum(["VIRTUAL_LIVE", "RECORDED", "IN_PERSON", "OTHER"])
      .optional(),
    level: z.enum(["BEGINNER", "INTERMEDIATE", "ADVANCED"]).optional(),
    estimatedHours: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(200).optional(),
    programId: z.string().trim().max(64).optional(),
    /** ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or "" to clear. */
    scheduledAt: z.string().trim().max(40).optional(),
    meetingUrl: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
    youtubeUrl: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),
    supervisorInstructionsAr: z.string().trim().max(4000).optional(),
  })
  .superRefine((value, refineCtx) => {
    if (
      value.meetingUrl &&
      value.meetingUrl.length > 0 &&
      !value.meetingUrl.startsWith("https://")
    ) {
      refineCtx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["meetingUrl"],
        message: "رابط الاجتماع يجب أن يبدأ بـ https:// (Zoom أو Google Meet)",
      });
    }
    if (value.youtubeUrl && value.youtubeUrl.length > 0) {
      let youtubeValid = false;
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(value.youtubeUrl);
        const host = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, "");
        youtubeValid =
          parsed.protocol === "https:" &&
          (host === "youtube.com" ||
            host === "m.youtube.com" ||
            host === "youtu.be");
      } catch {
        youtubeValid = false;
      }
      if (!youtubeValid) {
        refineCtx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["youtubeUrl"],
          message: "أدخل رابط يوتيوب صحيحًا يبدأ بـ https:// (youtube.com أو youtu.be)",
        });
      }
    }
    if (value.scheduledAt && value.scheduledAt.length > 0) {
      const parsed = new Date(value.scheduledAt);
      if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
        refineCtx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["scheduledAt"],
          message: "تاريخ التدريب غير صالح",
        });
      }
    }
  });

/** Program relation check shared by the unified create/update paths. */
async function assertProgramInScope(
  schoolId: string,
  programId: string | undefined
): Promise<SupervisorFailure | null> {
  if (!programId) return null;
  const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
    where: { id: programId },
    select: { schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!program || (program.schoolId !== null && program.schoolId !== schoolId)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "البرنامج التدريبي المحدد غير متاح لمدرستك",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { programId: "البرنامج غير متاح لمدرستك" },
    };
  }
  return null;
}

function parseScheduledAt(raw: string | undefined): Date | null | "invalid" {
  if (!raw || raw.length === 0) return null;
  const parsed = new Date(raw);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? "invalid" : parsed;
}

/**
 * Save the unified training form — CREATE (new draft, school + trainer
 * hard-bound to the session) or UPDATE (tenant-fenced). Persists the
 * extended unified fields that the legacy createCourse/updateCourse
 * schemas do not carry; base-field validation mirrors the legacy rules.
 */
export async function saveSupervisorTraining(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string; created: boolean }>> {
  const parsed = unifiedTrainingSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  // Domain fence: the fixed Arabic domains — except a legacy course
  // keeping its own existing (free-key) category unchanged.
  if (!(TRAINING_DOMAINS as readonly string[]).includes(input.category)) {
    if (!input.courseId) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
        code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
        fieldErrors: { category: "اختر المجال الرئيسي من القائمة" },
      };
    }
    const existing = await db.course.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.courseId },
      select: { category: true },
    });
    if (!existing || existing.category !== input.category) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
        code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
        fieldErrors: { category: "اختر المجال الرئيسي من القائمة" },
      };
    }
  }

  if (input.subcategory && !(TRAINING_SUBCATEGORIES as readonly string[]).includes(input.subcategory)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { subcategory: "اختر التصنيف الفرعي من القائمة" },
    };
  }

  const scheduledAt = parseScheduledAt(input.scheduledAt);
  if (scheduledAt === "invalid") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      fieldErrors: { scheduledAt: "تاريخ التدريب غير صالح" },
    };
  }

  const data = {
    titleAr: input.titleAr,
    titleEn: input.titleEn ?? null,
    descriptionAr: input.descriptionAr,
    descriptionEn: input.descriptionEn ?? null,
    category: input.category,
    subcategory: input.subcategory || null,
    trainingType: input.trainingType ?? null,
    level: input.level ?? null,
    estimatedHours: input.estimatedHours ?? null,
    scheduledAt,
    meetingUrl: input.meetingUrl || null,
    youtubeUrl: input.youtubeUrl || null,
    supervisorInstructionsAr: input.supervisorInstructionsAr || null,
  };

  if (!input.courseId) {
    const programError = await assertProgramInScope(ctx.schoolId, input.programId);
    if (programError) return programError;
    const created = await db.course.create({
      data: {
        ...data,
        // Tenant + trainer hard-bound to the SESSION — never the client.
        schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
        createdById: ctx.id,
        instructorId: ctx.id,
        programId: input.programId || null,
        status: "DRAFT",
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: { id: created.id, created: true } };
  }

  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("التدريب غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");

  const programError = await assertProgramInScope(ctx.schoolId, input.programId);
  if (programError) return programError;

  const updated = await db.course.update({
    where: { id: course.id },
    data: { ...data, programId: input.programId || null },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: updated.id, created: false } };
}

/* --------------------------- Attachments --------------------------- */

/**
 * Remove a course attachment (Attachment kind RESOURCE bound to the
 * course). Tenant-fenced; the R2 object is released best-effort.
 */
export async function deleteSupervisorTrainingAttachment(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  attachmentId: string
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const attachment = await db.attachment.findUnique({
    where: { id: attachmentId },
    select: { id: true, courseId: true, provider: true, storageKey: true },
  });
  if (!attachment || !attachment.courseId) {
    return fail("المرفق غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  }
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, attachment.courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("خارج نطاق مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة", "FORBIDDEN");

  await db.attachment.delete({ where: { id: attachment.id } });

  if (attachment.provider === "R2") {
    try {
      const { publicUrlFor } = await import("@/lib/media/r2");
      const { releaseMediaIfUnreferenced } = await import("@/lib/media/references");
      await releaseMediaIfUnreferenced(publicUrlFor(attachment.storageKey));
    } catch {
      // Orphan cleanup is retried by maintenance; never block the delete.
    }
  }
  return { ok: true, data: { id: attachmentId } };
}

/* ------------------------- Passing percent ------------------------- */

const passingPercentSchema = z.object({
  assessmentId: z.string().trim().min(1),
  passingPercent: z.coerce.number().int().min(20).max(100),
});

/**
 * Persist the supervisor-chosen pass PERCENTAGE of the final assessment
 * and recompute the stored passing points immediately, so the live
 * threshold stays consistent between question edits.
 */
export async function setSupervisorAssessmentPassingPercent(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<{ id: string; passingPercent: number; passingScore: number }>> {
  const parsed = passingPercentSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);

  const assessment = await db.assessment.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.assessmentId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true, status: true, maxScore: true },
  });
  if (!assessment || assessment.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return fail("الاختبار غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (assessment.status === "ARCHIVED") {
    return fail("الاختبار مؤرشف — لا يمكن تعديله", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const pct = parsed.data.passingPercent;
  const maxScore = Math.max(assessment.maxScore, 0);
  const passingScore =
    maxScore > 0
      ? Math.min(maxScore, Math.max(1, Math.ceil((maxScore * pct) / 100)))
      : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(pct / 100));

  const updated = await db.assessment.update({
    where: { id: assessment.id },
    data: { passingPercent: pct, passingScore },
    select: { passingScore: true },
  });
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      id: assessment.id,
      passingPercent: pct,
      passingScore: updated.passingScore,
    },
  };
}

/* --------------------------- Publishing ---------------------------- */

const publishTrainingSchema = z.object({
  courseId: z.string().trim().min(1),
  /** Pass percentage applied to the final assessment on publish
   * (defaults to the stored value, then 60%). */
  passingPercent: z.coerce.number().int().min(20).max(100).optional(),
});

export interface PublishTrainingSummary {
  courseId: string;
  lessonsPublished: number;
  assessmentPublished: boolean;
  surveyPublished: boolean;
}

/**
 * Publish the complete training — the ONE server-validated entry point
 * behind the «نشر التدريب» button:
 *   1. tenant + content guards (≥1 section and ≥1 lesson),
 *   2. all lessons become visible to teachers,
 *   3. the course-bound final assessment is published with the pass
 *      threshold recomputed from the chosen percentage,
 *   4. the course-bound impact tool is published,
 *   5. the course itself flips to PUBLISHED (publishedAt set once),
 * all inside ONE transaction so teachers never see a half-configured
 * training and no partial publish can linger.
 */
export async function publishSupervisorTraining(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<SupervisorResult<PublishTrainingSummary>> {
  const parsed = publishTrainingSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return zodFail(parsed.error);

  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, parsed.data.courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("التدريب غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");

  const [sectionCount, lessons] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseSection.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
    db.courseLesson.findMany({
      where: { section: { courseId: course.id } },
      select: { id: true, isPublished: true },
    }),
  ]);
  if (sectionCount < 1 || lessons.length < 1) {
    return fail(
      "لا يمكن النشر — أضف فيديو تدريب واحدًا على الأقل (أو درسًا) قبل النشر",
      "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
    );
  }

  // The course-bound final assessment (if configured) must be complete.
  const assessment = await db.assessment.findFirst({
    where: { courseId: course.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId, status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
    select: { id: true, maxScore: true, passingPercent: true, status: true, _count: { select: { questions: true } } },
  });
  if (assessment && assessment._count.questions < 1) {
    return fail(
      "الاختبار النهائي مضبوط لكنه بلا أسئلة — أضف سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل قبل النشر",
      "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
    );
  }

  // The course-bound impact tool (if configured) must be complete.
  const survey = await db.survey.findFirst({
    where: { courseId: course.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId, status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
    select: { id: true, status: true, _count: { select: { questions: true } } },
  });
  if (survey && survey._count.questions < 1) {
    return fail(
      "أداة قياس الأثر مضبوطة لكنها بلا أسئلة — أضف سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل قبل النشر",
      "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
    );
  }

  const pct =
    parsed.data.passingPercent ?? assessment?.passingPercent ?? DEFAULT_PASSING_PERCENT;
  const assessmentMax = Math.max(assessment?.maxScore ?? 0, 0);
  const passingScore =
    assessmentMax > 0
      ? Math.min(assessmentMax, Math.max(1, Math.ceil((assessmentMax * pct) / 100)))
      : 1;

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.courseLesson.updateMany({
      where: { section: { courseId: course.id }, isPublished: false },
      data: { isPublished: true },
    });

    if (assessment) {
      await tx.assessment.update({
        where: { id: assessment.id },
        data: {
          status: "PUBLISHED",
          passingScore,
          passingPercent: pct,
        },
      });
    }

    if (survey && survey.status !== "PUBLISHED") {
      await tx.survey.update({
        where: { id: survey.id },
        data: { status: "PUBLISHED", publishedAt: new Date() },
      });
    }

    await tx.course.update({
      where: { id: course.id },
      data: {
        status: "PUBLISHED",
        // Set on the first successful publish; kept on re-publish.
        publishedAt: course.publishedAt ?? new Date(),
      },
    });
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      courseId: course.id,
      lessonsPublished: lessons.length,
      assessmentPublished: Boolean(assessment),
      surveyPublished: Boolean(survey),
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------ Unified workspace ------------------------ */

export interface TrainingWorkspaceQuestion {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  textAr: string;
  points: number;
  isRequired: boolean;
  orderIndex: number;
  options: Array<{ id: string; textAr: string }>;
  /** Supervisor-only answer-key projection for editing (never sent to
   * teachers — the taking path strips keys server-side). */
  correctOptionIds: string[];
  correctBool: boolean | null;
  modelAnswer: string | null;
  explanation: string | null;
}

export interface TrainingWorkspace {
  course: {
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    titleEn: string | null;
    descriptionAr: string;
    descriptionEn: string | null;
    category: string;
    subcategory: string | null;
    trainingType: string | null;
    level: string | null;
    estimatedHours: number | null;
    programId: string | null;
    status: string;
    scheduledAt: string | null;
    meetingUrl: string | null;
    youtubeUrl: string | null;
    supervisorInstructionsAr: string | null;
    instructorName: string;
    schoolName: string;
  };
  coverUrl: string | null;
  sections: Array<{
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    description: string | null;
    orderIndex: number;
    lessons: Array<{
      id: string;
      titleAr: string;
      description: string | null;
      type: string;
      content: string | null;
      videoUrl: string | null;
      attachmentName: string | null;
      durationSeconds: number | null;
      isPublished: boolean;
      orderIndex: number;
    }>;
  }>;
  attachments: Array<{
    id: string;
    originalName: string;
    mimeType: string;
    sizeBytes: number;
    url: string;
  }>;
  teachers: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  enrollments: Array<{ userId: string; name: string; completedAt: string | null }>;
  programs: Array<{ id: string; nameAr: string; platformWide: boolean }>;
  assessment: {
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    instructionsAr: string;
    status: string;
    passingScore: number;
    maxScore: number;
    passingPercent: number | null;
    attemptLimit: number | null;
    timeLimitMinutes: number | null;
    questions: TrainingWorkspaceQuestion[];
  } | null;
  survey: {
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    purposeAr: string | null;
    status: string;
    questionsCount: number;
  } | null;
}

function parseQuestionOptions(raw: string | null): Array<{ id: string; textAr: string }> {
  if (!raw) return [];
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed.filter(
      (item): item is { id: string; textAr: string } =>
        Boolean(item) &&
        typeof item === "object" &&
        typeof (item as { id?: unknown }).id === "string" &&
        typeof (item as { textAr?: unknown }).textAr === "string"
    );
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function parseQuestionAnswerKey(
  raw: string | null
): { optionIds: string[]; bool: boolean | null; modelAnswer: string | null } {
  if (!raw) return { optionIds: [], bool: null, modelAnswer: null };
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object") {
      return { optionIds: [], bool: null, modelAnswer: null };
    }
    const record = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    const optionIds: string[] = [];
    if (typeof record.optionId === "string") optionIds.push(record.optionId);
    if (Array.isArray(record.optionIds)) {
      for (const value of record.optionIds) {
        if (typeof value === "string") optionIds.push(value);
      }
    }
    return {
      optionIds,
      bool: typeof record.value === "boolean" ? record.value : null,
      modelAnswer: typeof record.modelAnswer === "string" ? record.modelAnswer : null,
    };
  } catch {
    return { optionIds: [], bool: null, modelAnswer: null };
  }
}

/**
 * Everything the unified editor renders, loaded in one place with the
 * same tenant fence as every other supervisor read (courseInScope).
 */
export async function getSupervisorTrainingWorkspace(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string
): Promise<SupervisorResult<TrainingWorkspace>> {
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) return fail("التدريب غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");

  const [row, teachers, enrollments, programs, coverAttachment] = await Promise.all([
    db.course.findUnique({
      where: { id: courseId },
      include: {
        instructor: { select: { name: true } },
        school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
        sections: {
          orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
          include: {
            lessons: {
              orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
              include: { attachment: { select: { originalName: true } } },
            },
          },
        },
        attachments: {
          where: { kind: "RESOURCE", lessonId: null },
          orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
        },
        assessments: {
          where: { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
          orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
          take: 1,
          include: {
            questions: { orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" } },
          },
        },
        surveys: {
          where: { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
          orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
          take: 1,
          select: {
            id: true,
            titleAr: true,
            purposeAr: true,
            status: true,
            _count: { select: { questions: true } },
          },
        },
      },
    }),
    listSupervisorTeachers(ctx),
    listSupervisorEnrollments(ctx, courseId),
    listSupervisorProgramOptions(ctx),
    course.coverAttachmentId
      ? db.attachment.findUnique({
          where: { id: course.coverAttachmentId },
          select: { storageKey: true },
        })
      : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);

  if (!row) return fail("التدريب غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");

  const { publicUrlFor } = await import("@/lib/media/r2");

  const assessmentRow = row.assessments[0] ?? null;
  const surveyRow = row.surveys[0] ?? null;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      course: {
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        titleEn: row.titleEn,
        descriptionAr: row.descriptionAr,
        descriptionEn: row.descriptionEn,
        category: row.category,
        subcategory: row.subcategory,
        trainingType: row.trainingType,
        level: row.level,
        estimatedHours: row.estimatedHours,
        programId: row.programId,
        status: row.status,
        scheduledAt: row.scheduledAt ? row.scheduledAt.toISOString() : null,
        meetingUrl: row.meetingUrl,
        youtubeUrl: row.youtubeUrl,
        supervisorInstructionsAr: row.supervisorInstructionsAr,
        instructorName: row.instructor?.name ?? ctx.name,
        schoolName: row.school?.nameAr ?? "مدرستك",
      },
      coverUrl: coverAttachment ? publicUrlFor(coverAttachment.storageKey) : null,
      sections: row.sections.map((section) => ({
        id: section.id,
        titleAr: section.titleAr,
        description: section.description,
        orderIndex: section.orderIndex,
        lessons: section.lessons.map((lesson) => ({
          id: lesson.id,
          titleAr: lesson.titleAr,
          description: lesson.description,
          type: lesson.type,
          content: lesson.content,
          videoUrl: lesson.videoUrl,
          attachmentName: lesson.attachment?.originalName ?? null,
          durationSeconds: lesson.durationSeconds,
          isPublished: lesson.isPublished,
          orderIndex: lesson.orderIndex,
        })),
      })),
      attachments: row.attachments.map((attachment) => ({
        id: attachment.id,
        originalName: attachment.originalName,
        mimeType: attachment.mimeType,
        sizeBytes: attachment.sizeBytes,
        url: publicUrlFor(attachment.storageKey),
      })),
      teachers: teachers.map((teacher) => ({ id: teacher.id, name: teacher.name })),
      enrollments: enrollments.map((enrollment) => ({
        userId: enrollment.userId,
        name: enrollment.name,
        completedAt: enrollment.completedAt
          ? enrollment.completedAt.toISOString()
          : null,
      })),
      programs: programs.map((program) => ({
        id: program.id,
        nameAr: program.nameAr,
        platformWide: program.platformWide,
      })),
      assessment: assessmentRow
        ? {
            id: assessmentRow.id,
            titleAr: assessmentRow.titleAr,
            instructionsAr: assessmentRow.instructionsAr,
            status: assessmentRow.status,
            passingScore: assessmentRow.passingScore,
            maxScore: assessmentRow.maxScore,
            passingPercent: assessmentRow.passingPercent,
            attemptLimit: assessmentRow.attemptLimit,
            timeLimitMinutes: assessmentRow.timeLimitMinutes,
            questions: assessmentRow.questions.map((question) => {
              const key = parseQuestionAnswerKey(question.answerKeyJson);
              return {
                id: question.id,
                type: question.type,
                textAr: question.textAr,
                points: question.points,
                isRequired: question.isRequired,
                orderIndex: question.orderIndex,
                options: parseQuestionOptions(question.optionsJson),
                correctOptionIds: key.optionIds,
                correctBool: key.bool,
                modelAnswer: key.modelAnswer,
                explanation: question.explanation,
              };
            }),
          }
        : null,
      survey: surveyRow
        ? {
            id: surveyRow.id,
            titleAr: surveyRow.titleAr,
            purposeAr: surveyRow.purposeAr,
            status: surveyRow.status,
            questionsCount: surveyRow._count.questions,
          }
        : null,
    },
  };
}

/** Placeholder title of an auto-created untouched draft course. */
export const SUPERVISOR_DRAFT_TITLE = "تدريب بدون عنوان";
const SUPERVISOR_DRAFT_DESCRIPTION =
  "مسودة تدريب جديدة — أكمل بيانات التدريب ثم اضغط «حفظ بيانات التدريب» قبل النشر.";

export interface SupervisorDraftHandle {
  id: string;
  created: boolean;
}

/**
 * GET-OR-CREATE the supervisor's scratch DRAFT course backing the
 * one-page creation flow.
 *
 * Reuse rule: the LATEST untouched draft (placeholder title, no
 * sections, no attachments, no assessment, no impact tool) is reused so
 * repeatedly opening the creation page never spams empty rows. A draft
 * that already carries content is left alone and a fresh one is created
 * — nothing the supervisor uploaded is ever silently discarded.
 *
 * Tenant + author are hard-bound to the SESSION (never the client), the
 * same as saveSupervisorTraining's create path.
 */
export async function ensureSupervisorTrainingDraft(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext
): Promise<SupervisorResult<SupervisorDraftHandle>> {
  const existing = await db.course.findFirst({
    where: {
      schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
      createdById: ctx.id,
      status: "DRAFT",
      titleAr: SUPERVISOR_DRAFT_TITLE,
      sections: { none: {} },
      attachments: { none: {} },
      assessments: { none: { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } } },
      surveys: { none: { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } } },
    },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (existing) {
    return { ok: true, data: { id: existing.id, created: false } };
  }

  const created = await db.course.create({
    data: {
      // Tenant + trainer hard-bound to the SESSION — never the client.
      schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
      createdById: ctx.id,
      instructorId: ctx.id,
      status: "DRAFT",
      titleAr: SUPERVISOR_DRAFT_TITLE,
      descriptionAr: SUPERVISOR_DRAFT_DESCRIPTION,
      category: TRAINING_DOMAINS[0],
      trainingType: "VIRTUAL_LIVE",
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: created.id, created: true } };
}

/* ---------------------- Academy: my trainings ---------------------- */

export interface SupervisorAcademyTrainingRow {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  status: string;
  category: string;
  estimatedHours: number | null;
  sectionsCount: number;
  lessonsCount: number;
  enrollmentsCount: number;
  hasAssessment: boolean;
  hasSurvey: boolean;
  updatedAt: string;
  publishedAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * The trainings the CURRENT supervisor created (createdById), any
 * status — the Academy workspace list. School-fenced; archived rows
 * included with their own pill so nothing the supervisor built ever
 * disappears from their view.
 */
export async function listSupervisorAcademyTrainings(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext
): Promise<SupervisorAcademyTrainingRow[]> {
  const rows = await db.course.findMany({
    where: { schoolId: ctx.schoolId, createdById: ctx.id },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    take: 60,
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      status: true,
      category: true,
      estimatedHours: true,
      updatedAt: true,
      publishedAt: true,
      _count: { select: { sections: true, enrollments: true } },
    },
  });
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];
  const ids = rows.map((row) => row.id);

  const [sections, assessments, surveys] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseSection.findMany({
      where: { courseId: { in: ids } },
      select: { courseId: true, _count: { select: { lessons: true } } },
    }),
    db.assessment.findMany({
      where: { courseId: { in: ids }, status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
      select: { courseId: true },
    }),
    db.survey.findMany({
      where: { courseId: { in: ids }, status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
      select: { courseId: true },
    }),
  ]);

  const lessonsByCourse = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const section of sections) {
    lessonsByCourse.set(
      section.courseId,
      (lessonsByCourse.get(section.courseId) ?? 0) + section._count.lessons
    );
  }
  const assessmentCourses = new Set(assessments.map((row) => row.courseId));
  const surveyCourses = new Set(surveys.map((row) => row.courseId));

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    titleAr: row.titleAr,
    status: row.status,
    category: row.category,
    estimatedHours: row.estimatedHours,
    sectionsCount: row._count.sections,
    lessonsCount: lessonsByCourse.get(row.id) ?? 0,
    enrollmentsCount: row._count.enrollments,
    hasAssessment: assessmentCourses.has(row.id),
    hasSurvey: surveyCourses.has(row.id),
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    publishedAt: row.publishedAt ? row.publishedAt.toISOString() : null,
  }));
}

/* ------------------- Training workspace: progress ------------------- */

export interface SupervisorTrainingProgressRow {
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  enrolledAt: string;
  completedAt: string | null;
  lessonsDone: number;
  /** null = the training has no (non-archived) final exam. */
  exam: {
    attemptsCount: number;
    needsReviewCount: number;
    bestPercentage: number | null;
    bestPassed: boolean | null;
  } | null;
  certificate: {
    id: string;
    certificateNumber: string;
    status: string;
  } | null;
  /** Identifiable impact response only — anonymous surveys cannot be
   * matched per teacher (aggregate count + results page instead). */
  impactSubmittedAt: string | null;
}

export interface SupervisorTrainingProgress {
  assessmentId: string | null;
  assessmentTitleAr: string | null;
  surveyId: string | null;
  surveyTitleAr: string | null;
  surveyAnonymous: boolean;
  surveyResponsesCount: number;
  lessonsTotal: number;
  rows: SupervisorTrainingProgressRow[];
}

/**
 * Per-teacher participation & results for ONE training — the read model
 * behind the unified workspace's progress section. Reads ONLY existing
 * models: CourseEnrollment, CourseLessonProgress, AssessmentAttempt,
 * Certificate, SurveyResponse. Every query is school/course fenced.
 */
export async function getSupervisorTrainingProgress(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string
): Promise<SupervisorResult<SupervisorTrainingProgress>> {
  const course = await courseInScope(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) {
    return fail("التدريب غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const [enrollments, lessonsTotal, assessment, survey] = await Promise.all([
    listSupervisorEnrollments(ctx, courseId),
    db.courseLesson.count({ where: { section: { courseId } } }),
    db.assessment.findFirst({
      where: { courseId, schoolId: ctx.schoolId, status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true },
    }),
    db.survey.findFirst({
      where: { courseId, schoolId: ctx.schoolId, status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      select: { id: true, titleAr: true, anonymous: true },
    }),
  ]);

  const base: SupervisorTrainingProgress = {
    assessmentId: assessment?.id ?? null,
    assessmentTitleAr: assessment?.titleAr ?? null,
    surveyId: survey?.id ?? null,
    surveyTitleAr: survey?.titleAr ?? null,
    surveyAnonymous: survey?.anonymous ?? false,
    surveyResponsesCount: 0,
    lessonsTotal,
    rows: [],
  };

  const userIds = enrollments.map((row) => row.userId);
  if (userIds.length === 0) return { ok: true, data: base };

  const [lessonProgress, attempts, certificates, surveyResponses] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.courseLessonProgress.findMany({
        where: { courseId, userId: { in: userIds } },
        select: { userId: true, lessonId: true },
      }),
      assessment
        ? db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
            where: {
              assessmentId: assessment.id,
              userId: { in: userIds },
              status: { in: ["NEEDS_REVIEW", "PASSED", "FAILED"] },
            },
            select: {
              userId: true,
              status: true,
              percentage: true,
              passed: true,
            },
          })
        : Promise.resolve(
            [] as Array<{
              userId: string;
              status: string;
              percentage: number | null;
              passed: boolean | null;
            }>
          ),
      db.certificate.findMany({
        where: { courseId, teacherId: { in: userIds } },
        orderBy: { issuedAt: "desc" },
        select: {
          id: true,
          certificateNumber: true,
          status: true,
          teacherId: true,
        },
      }),
      survey
        ? db.surveyResponse.findMany({
            where: {
              surveyId: survey.id,
              status: "SUBMITTED",
              ...(survey.anonymous
                ? {}
                : { respondentId: { in: userIds } }),
            },
            select: { respondentId: true, submittedAt: true },
          })
        : Promise.resolve(
            [] as Array<{ respondentId: string | null; submittedAt: Date | null }>
          ),
    ]);

  const lessonsDoneByUser = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of lessonProgress) {
    lessonsDoneByUser.set(row.userId, (lessonsDoneByUser.get(row.userId) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  const examByUser = new Map<
    string,
    { attemptsCount: number; needsReviewCount: number; bestPercentage: number | null; bestPassed: boolean | null }
  >();
  for (const attempt of attempts) {
    const current = examByUser.get(attempt.userId) ?? {
      attemptsCount: 0,
      needsReviewCount: 0,
      bestPercentage: null,
      bestPassed: null,
    };
    current.attemptsCount += 1;
    if (attempt.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW") current.needsReviewCount += 1;
    if (
      (attempt.status === "PASSED" || attempt.status === "FAILED") &&
      typeof attempt.percentage === "number"
    ) {
      if (
        current.bestPercentage === null ||
        attempt.percentage > current.bestPercentage
      ) {
        current.bestPercentage = attempt.percentage;
        current.bestPassed = attempt.status === "PASSED";
      }
    }
    examByUser.set(attempt.userId, current);
  }

  const certificateByUser = new Map(
    certificates.map((row) => [row.teacherId, row])
  );

  const impactByUser = new Map<string, string>();
  let impactCount = 0;
  for (const response of surveyResponses) {
    impactCount += 1;
    if (response.respondentId && response.submittedAt) {
      impactByUser.set(response.respondentId, response.submittedAt.toISOString());
    }
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      ...base,
      surveyResponsesCount: impactCount,
      rows: enrollments.map((enrollment) => {
        const exam = examByUser.get(enrollment.userId) ?? null;
        const certificate = certificateByUser.get(enrollment.userId) ?? null;
        return {
          userId: enrollment.userId,
          name: enrollment.name,
          enrolledAt: enrollment.enrolledAt.toISOString(),
          completedAt: enrollment.completedAt
            ? enrollment.completedAt.toISOString()
            : null,
          lessonsDone: lessonsDoneByUser.get(enrollment.userId) ?? 0,
          exam: exam
            ? {
                attemptsCount: exam.attemptsCount,
                needsReviewCount: exam.needsReviewCount,
                bestPercentage: exam.bestPercentage,
                bestPassed: exam.bestPassed,
              }
            : null,
          certificate: certificate
            ? {
                id: certificate.id,
                certificateNumber: certificate.certificateNumber,
                status: certificate.status,
              }
            : null,
          impactSubmittedAt: impactByUser.get(enrollment.userId) ?? null,
        };
      }),
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor training DELETION — the destructive counterpart of the    */
/* unified training editor.                                             */
/*                                                                      */
/* SAFETY MODEL (mirrors the supervision training service rules):       */
/*   1. TENANT FENCE: the course must exist AND belong to the           */
/*      supervisor's own school (schoolId from the SESSION, never the   */
/*      client). Platform-wide courses (schoolId null) and other        */
/*      schools' courses are always rejected fail-closed.               */
/*   2. ONE TRANSACTION: every database row is removed inside a single  */
/*      db.$transaction — either the whole training disappears or      */
/*      nothing changes (no partial deletion is ever visible).          */
/*   3. SCHEMA-ACCURATE (verified against prisma/schema.prisma — no     */
/*      guessing): deleting the Course row cascades (onDelete: Cascade) */
/*      sections -> lessons, lesson attachments, course attachments,    */
/*      enrollments, lesson progress, watch states, completions and     */
/*      comments. BUT exams (Assessment.courseId), impact surveys       */
/*      (Survey.courseId) and certificates (Certificate.courseId) use   */
/*      onDelete: SetNull — they would SURVIVE detached. They are       */
/*      therefore deleted EXPLICITLY BEFORE the course row, inside the  */
/*      same transaction, so their own cascades run too:                */
/*        - Assessment  -> AssessmentQuestion (options + answer key),   */
/*                         AssessmentAttempt (answers, MCQ scores,      */
/*                         essay answers, review scores)                */
/*        - Survey      -> SurveyQuestion, SurveyResponse,              */
/*                         SurveyAnswer, SurveyEvent                    */
/*        - Certificate -> CertificateEvent                             */
/*   4. UNRELATED DATA IS PRESERVED: school records that merely LINK    */
/*      to the course through SetNull keep their history —              */
/*      assignments (with submissions/grades), follow-up visit records, */
/*      surveys also linked to other content, certificates issued for   */
/*      a program (courseId null), TrainingArchive snapshots and        */
/*      append-only audit trails (ArchiveEvent, notifications). Their   */
/*      dangling course FK is nulled by the database itself.            */
/*   5. MEDIA CLEANUP IS REFERENCE-SAFE: storage keys are collected     */
/*      BEFORE the transaction; after it commits, every managed URL     */
/*      goes through releaseMediaIfUnreferenced, which deletes the      */
/*      stored object ONLY when zero rows still reference it — shared   */
/*      objects (e.g. the same URL reused elsewhere) are never          */
/*      destroyed. R2 deletion cannot join the DB transaction (external */
/*      system), so failures are counted, returned to the caller and    */
/*      logged with a stable [training-delete] prefix for the ops trail.*/
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

import type { SupervisorTrainingContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { releaseMediaIfUnreferenced } from "@/lib/media/references";
import { isManagedMediaUrl, publicUrlFor } from "@/lib/media/r2";
import type { SupervisorResult } from "@/lib/supervision/training";

function fail<T>(message: string, code?: string): SupervisorResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

/** Fail-closed tenant guard — same fence as every other supervisor write. */
async function courseInScopeForDelete(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string
): Promise<{ id: string; schoolId: string | null; coverAttachmentId: string | null } | null> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true, coverAttachmentId: true },
  });
  if (!course || course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId !== ctx.schoolId) {
    return null;
  }
  return course;
}

export interface DeleteTrainingSummary {
  id: string;
  /** Rows removed by the explicit pre-course deleteMany calls. */
  assessments: number;
  surveys: number;
  certificates: number;
  /** Rows cascaded with the course (pre-counted for the audit trail). */
  sections: number;
  lessons: number;
  attachments: number;
  enrollments: number;
  completions: number;
  lessonProgress: number;
  watchStates: number;
  comments: number;
  /** Managed media URLs queued for post-commit storage cleanup. */
  mediaQueued: number;
  /** Storage objects that could NOT be removed after the commit. */
  mediaCleanupFailures: number;
}

/**
 * Permanently delete ONE training course of the supervisor's own school
 * with all of its dependent data. The confirmation word ("DELETE") is a
 * CLIENT-side safeguard; this service re-verifies the only things that
 * matter server-side: an authenticated supervisor session and course
 * ownership inside the session's school.
 */
export async function deleteSupervisorTraining(
  ctx: SupervisorTrainingContext,
  courseId: string
): Promise<SupervisorResult<DeleteTrainingSummary>> {
  const course = await courseInScopeForDelete(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course) {
    return fail("التدريب غير موجود أو خارج نطاق مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  /* ---------------- Pre-reads (outside the transaction) ------------- */
  /* Lesson ids + managed video URLs — lesson video attachments carry
   * lessonId with a NULL courseId, so the lesson branch is REQUIRED to
   * catch every media object of this training. */
  const lessonRows = await db.courseLesson.findMany({
    where: { section: { courseId: course.id } },
    select: { id: true, videoUrl: true },
  });
  const lessonIds = lessonRows.map((lesson) => lesson.id);

  const attachmentRows = await db.attachment.findMany({
    where: {
      OR: [
        { courseId: course.id },
        { lessonId: { in: lessonIds } },
        ...(course.coverAttachmentId ? [{ id: course.coverAttachmentId }] : []),
      ],
    },
    select: { id: true, storageKey: true },
  });

  const [sectionsCount, enrollmentsCount, completionsCount, progressCount, watchCount, commentsCount] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.courseSection.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
      db.courseEnrollment.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
      db.courseCompletion.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
      db.courseLessonProgress.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
      db.lessonWatchState.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
      db.courseComment.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
    ]);

  /* Managed media URLs behind this training — resolved to URLs so the
   * shared release helper can re-count references after the commit. */
  const mediaUrls = new Set<string>();
  for (const attachment of attachmentRows) {
    mediaUrls.add(publicUrlFor(attachment.storageKey));
  }
  for (const lesson of lessonRows) {
    if (lesson.videoUrl && isManagedMediaUrl(lesson.videoUrl)) {
      mediaUrls.add(lesson.videoUrl);
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- The deletion transaction ------------------------ */
  /* Order is deliberate: the SetNull-bound owners are removed FIRST
   * (while their courseId still points at this course), then the course
   * row itself fans the remaining Cascade relations out. */
  let deletedAssessments = 0;
  let deletedSurveys = 0;
  let deletedCertificates = 0;

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // 1) Exams bound to this training — questions, options, answer keys,
    //    attempts, MCQ scores, essay answers and review grades all die
    //    with their own cascades (AssessmentQuestion/Attempt Cascade).
    const assessments = await tx.assessment.deleteMany({
      where: { courseId: course.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
    });
    deletedAssessments = assessments.count;

    // 2) The impact-measurement tool bound EXCLUSIVELY to this training.
    //    Surveys also linked to other content (program/lesson/assignment/
    //    certificate) survive untouched — the course FK nulls itself.
    const surveys = await tx.survey.deleteMany({
      where: {
        courseId: course.id,
        schoolId: ctx.schoolId,
        programId: null,
        lessonId: null,
        assignmentId: null,
        certificateId: null,
      },
    });
    deletedSurveys = surveys.count;

    // 3) Certificates issued FOR this training (CourseCompletion.certificateId
    //    is SetNull — completions are cascaded away by the course below).
    const certificates = await tx.certificate.deleteMany({
      where: { courseId: course.id, schoolId: ctx.schoolId },
    });
    deletedCertificates = certificates.count;

    // 4) The course row — cascades sections -> lessons, lesson + course
    //    attachments, enrollments, lesson progress, watch states,
    //    completions and comments (all onDelete: Cascade in the schema).
    await tx.course.delete({ where: { id: course.id } });
  });

  /* ---------------- Post-commit storage cleanup --------------------- */
  /* Best-effort and reference-safe: an object is removed only when no
   * row references its URL anymore. Failures never invalidate the
   * committed deletion — they are counted, returned and logged so the
   * maintenance sweep / ops trail can pick them up. */
  let mediaCleanupFailures = 0;
  for (const url of mediaUrls) {
    try {
      await releaseMediaIfUnreferenced(url);
    } catch (error) {
      mediaCleanupFailures += 1;
      console.error(`[training-delete] media cleanup failed for ${url}`, error);
    }
  }

  const summary: DeleteTrainingSummary = {
    id: course.id,
    assessments: deletedAssessments,
    surveys: deletedSurveys,
    certificates: deletedCertificates,
    sections: sectionsCount,
    lessons: lessonIds.length,
    attachments: attachmentRows.length,
    enrollments: enrollmentsCount,
    completions: completionsCount,
    lessonProgress: progressCount,
    watchStates: watchCount,
    comments: commentsCount,
    mediaQueued: mediaUrls.size,
    mediaCleanupFailures,
  };

  console.log(
    `[training-delete] course ${course.id} deleted by supervisor ${ctx.id} ` +
      `(school ${ctx.schoolId}) — assessments:${deletedAssessments} surveys:${deletedSurveys} ` +
      `certificates:${deletedCertificates} sections:${sectionsCount} lessons:${lessonIds.length} ` +
      `attachments:${attachmentRows.length} enrollments:${enrollmentsCount} media:${mediaUrls.size} ` +
      `mediaFailures:${mediaCleanupFailures}`
  );

  return { ok: true, data: summary };
}

/**
 * Phase 9 — pure access predicates and tenant scoping for impact
 * surveys, responses, follow-ups and outcome analysis.
 *
 * No DB access lives here — every rule is unit-testable and the service
 * layer composes these helpers. The actor is ALWAYS built server-side
 * from the session user after an explicit role check; client payloads
 * can never widen it.
 *
 * Role capability matrix (fixed by the product, enforced server-side):
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER — create/manage ALL school surveys,
 *                                manage school follow-ups, full results
 *                                of non-anonymous surveys, individual
 *                                responses of non-anonymous surveys.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR     — create/manage OWN surveys within the
 *                                assigned scope, follow-ups for covered
 *                                teachers, results of OWN surveys.
 *   EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY         — READ-ONLY school/branch summaries and
 *                                follow-up progress. Never creates,
 *                                publishes, closes or edits anything.
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                — platform-wide AGGREGATE statistics
 *                                only. Never edits school surveys,
 *                                never reads individual responses,
 *                                never modifies follow-up records.
 *   TEACHER                    — sees surveys targeted at them, submits
 *                                responses, sees own (identified)
 *                                response history and explicitly shared
 *                                follow-up info. Never supervisor notes.
 */
import { surveyFail, type SurveyErrorCode, type SurveyResult } from "@/lib/validation/surveys";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Actor identity (back-office; mirrors the Phase 7/8 actor types)      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface SurveyActor {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  role:
    | "SUPER_ADMIN"
    | "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"
    | "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
    | "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY";
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/**
 * Any authenticated viewer projection used by read paths that also
 * serve teachers (available surveys, own responses, shared follow-ups).
 * Built from the session — never from a payload.
 */
export interface SurveyViewer {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Role capabilities                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Survey creation/management: office managers (whole school) and
 * supervisors (own surveys within assigned scope). Deputies and the
 * Super Admin are intentionally excluded — read-only/aggregate roles.
 */
export function canCreateSurveys(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR";
}

/** Follow-up creation: same two operational roles, same scoping. */
export function canManageFollowUps(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR";
}

/** Read-only access to school survey lists/summaries (deputies included). */
export function canViewSurveySummaries(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
  );
}

/**
 * Aggregate results of a school survey: operational roles + deputies.
 * SUPER_ADMIN is excluded from per-survey results — platform aggregates
 * live in the impact service instead.
 */
export function canViewSurveyResults(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY"
  );
}

/**
 * Individual (respondent-identified) answers: operational roles only,
 * AND only for non-anonymous surveys (second check lives in the
 * service and can never be bypassed by role alone).
 */
export function canViewIndividualResponses(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" || role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR";
}

/** Platform-wide impact aggregates (Super Admin dashboard). */
export function canViewPlatformImpact(role: string): boolean {
  return role === "SUPER_ADMIN";
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Failure guards                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Surveys/follow-ups are always school-owned; a null/missing school
 * context can never match (this blocks SUPER_ADMIN operational access).
 */
export function surveyScopeError(
  ctx: { role: string; schoolId: string | null },
  schoolId: string
): SurveyResult<never> | null {
  if (ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return surveyFail(
      "الإدارة التشغيلية للاستبيانات المدرسية غير متاحة لحساب المنصة — الأدوار التشغيلية داخل المدرسة فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  if (!ctx.schoolId || ctx.schoolId !== schoolId) {
    return surveyFail(
      "لا تملك صلاحية الوصول إلى هذا الاستبيان — النطاق المدرسي مختلف",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export function createSurveyGuard(ctx: SurveyActor): SurveyResult<never> | null {
  if (!canCreateSurveys(ctx.role)) {
    return surveyFail(
      "إنشاء الاستبيانات متاح لمديري مكاتب التطوير والمشرفين التربويين فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("إنشاء الاستبيانات يتطلب نطاقًا مدرسيًا محددًا", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  return null;
}

export function manageFollowUpGuard(ctx: SurveyActor): SurveyResult<never> | null {
  if (!canManageFollowUps(ctx.role)) {
    return surveyFail(
      "إدارة سجلات المتابعة متاحة لمديري مكاتب التطوير والمشرفين التربويين فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  if (!ctx.schoolId) {
    return surveyFail("إدارة سجلات المتابعة تتطلب نطاقًا مدرسيًا محددًا", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  return null;
}

import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { z } from "zod";

import type { ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { canManageTraining } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  notifyImpactResponseReceived,
} from "@/lib/notifications/center";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 1 — impact measurement (قياس الأثر) on the Phase 9 Survey     */
/* models.                                                             */
/*                                                                     */
/* Restores the original HTML workflow end to end:                     */
/*   - impact tools live with the course (Survey bound to courseId,    */
/*     stage AFTER_TRAINING, published);                               */
/*   - a teacher can respond ONLY after a real CourseCompletion;       */
/*   - one response per teacher — re-submitting replaces the previous  */
/*     answers (the HTML submitImpact dedupe rule);                    */
/*   - office/supervisor results mirror the HTML dashboard: response   */
/*     count, average rating, per-question breakdowns;                 */
/*   - identified surveys keep respondent ids (platform-level truth),  */
/*     unlike the HTML's name-string matching.                         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type ImpactErrorCode =
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "COMPLETION_REQUIRED"
  | "SURVEY_CLOSED"
  | "VALIDATION";

export type ImpactResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      message: string;
      code?: ImpactErrorCode;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
    };

function impactFail<T>(
  message: string,
  code: ImpactErrorCode,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): ImpactResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Public question projection (no internal metadata leaks)             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ImpactQuestionView {
  id: string;
  orderIndex: number;
  textAr: string;
  helpTextAr: string | null;
  type: string;
  required: boolean;
  options: string[] | null;
  minScore: number | null;
  maxScore: number | null;
}

export interface ImpactSurveyView {
  surveyId: string;
  titleAr: string;
  descriptionAr: string | null;
  purposeAr: string | null;
  instructionsAr: string | null;
  questions: ImpactQuestionView[];
}

const SURVEY_TYPE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  RATING: "RATING",
  LIKERT: "RATING",
  YES_NO: "YES_NO",
  SINGLE_CHOICE: "SINGLE_CHOICE",
  MULTI_CHOICE: "MULTI_CHOICE",
  SHORT_TEXT: "SHORT_TEXT",
  LONG_TEXT: "TEXT",
};

function parseOptionsJson(raw: string | null): string[] | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function projectQuestion(question: {
  id: string;
  orderIndex: number;
  textAr: string;
  helpTextAr: string | null;
  type: string;
  required: boolean;
  optionsJson: string | null;
  minScore: number | null;
  maxScore: number | null;
}): ImpactQuestionView | null {
  const type = SURVEY_TYPE_MAP[question.type];
  if (!type) return null;
  return {
    id: question.id,
    orderIndex: question.orderIndex,
    textAr: question.textAr,
    helpTextAr: question.helpTextAr,
    type,
    required: question.required,
    options:
      type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || type === "MULTI_CHOICE"
        ? parseOptionsJson(question.optionsJson) ?? []
        : null,
    minScore: type === "RATING" ? question.minScore ?? 1 : null,
    maxScore: type === "RATING" ? question.maxScore ?? 5 : null,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Reads                                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

async function loadPublishedCourseSurvey(courseId: string) {
  const surveys = await db.survey.findMany({
    where: {
      courseId,
      status: "PUBLISHED",
      OR: [{ stage: "AFTER_TRAINING" }, { stage: null }],
    },
    include: {
      questions: { orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" } },
    },
    orderBy: { publishedAt: "desc" },
    take: 1,
  });
  return surveys[0] ?? null;
}

export interface MyImpactStatus {
  available: boolean;
  submitted: boolean;
  submittedAt: Date | null;
  /** Existing answers keyed by questionId (raw form values) so the
   *  form pre-fills them — the HTML openImpact edit rule. Identified
   *  surveys only; anonymous surveys never read back by identity. */
  previousAnswers: Record<string, string> | null;
  survey: ImpactSurveyView | null;
}

/** Raw form value for one stored answer (radio value / option text /
 *  textarea default) — mirrors how the original HTML pre-filled the
 *  impact form from the teacher's previous response. */
function formValueForAnswer(
  question: { type: string },
  answer: {
    valueNumber: number | null;
    valueText: string | null;
    selectedOptionsJson: string | null;
  }
): string | null {
  if (answer.valueNumber !== null && answer.valueNumber !== undefined) {
    return SURVEY_TYPE_MAP[question.type] === "YES_NO"
      ? answer.valueNumber === 1
        ? "1"
        : "0"
      : String(answer.valueNumber);
  }
  if (answer.selectedOptionsJson) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(answer.selectedOptionsJson);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && typeof parsed[0] === "string") return parsed[0];
    } catch {
      /* fall through */
    }
    return null;
  }
  return answer.valueText ?? null;
}

/** The teacher's impact status for one course (survey + own response). */
export async function getMyImpactStatus(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string
): Promise<ImpactResult<MyImpactStatus>> {
  const survey = await loadPublishedCourseSurvey(courseId);
  if (!survey || survey.questions.length === 0) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        available: false,
        submitted: false,
        submittedAt: null,
        previousAnswers: null,
        survey: null,
      },
    };
  }

  const [completion, response] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseCompletion.findUnique({
      where: { courseId_userId: { courseId, userId: viewer.id } },
      select: { id: true },
    }),
    survey.anonymous
      ? Promise.resolve(null)
      : db.surveyResponse.findFirst({
          where: {
            surveyId: survey.id,
            respondentId: viewer.id,
            status: "SUBMITTED",
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            submittedAt: true,
            answers: {
              select: {
                questionId: true,
                valueNumber: true,
                valueText: true,
                selectedOptionsJson: true,
              },
            },
          },
          orderBy: { submittedAt: "desc" },
        }),
  ]);

  // Pre-fill map for the edit flow (HTML parity): questionId -> raw
  // form value of the teacher's previously submitted answer.
  const previousAnswers = response
    ? Object.fromEntries(
        response.answers
          .map((answer) => {
            const question = survey.questions.find(
              (item) => item.id === answer.questionId
            );
            if (!question) return null;
            const value = formValueForAnswer(question, answer);
            return value !== null ? [question.id, value] : null;
          })
          .filter((entry): entry is [string, string] => entry !== null)
      )
    : null;

  const surveyView: ImpactSurveyView = {
    surveyId: survey.id,
    titleAr: survey.titleAr,
    descriptionAr: survey.descriptionAr,
    purposeAr: survey.purposeAr,
    instructionsAr: survey.instructionsAr,
    questions: survey.questions
      .map(projectQuestion)
      .filter((question): question is ImpactQuestionView => question !== null),
  };

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      available: completion !== null,
      submitted: response !== null,
      submittedAt: response?.submittedAt ?? null,
      previousAnswers,
      survey: surveyView,
    },
  };
}

const submittedAnswerSchema = z.object({
  questionId: z.string().min(1),
  valueNumber: z.number().int().optional(),
  valueText: z.string().max(2000).optional(),
  selectedOption: z.string().max(300).optional(),
});

const submitSchema = z.object({
  answers: z.array(submittedAnswerSchema).min(1).max(50),
});

export interface SubmitImpactOutcome {
  responseId: string;
  replaced: boolean;
}

/**
 * Submit (or replace) the teacher's impact response for a course.
 * Requires a real CourseCompletion — impact measurement follows the
 * completed learning, exactly like the original HTML workflow.
 */
export async function submitImpactResponse(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<ImpactResult<SubmitImpactOutcome>> {
  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return impactFail("قياس الأثر متاح للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const parsed = submitSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return impactFail("بيانات الاستجابة غير صالحة", "VALIDATION");
  }

  const completion = await db.courseCompletion.findUnique({
    where: { courseId_userId: { courseId, userId: viewer.id } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (!completion) {
    return impactFail(
      "قياس الأثر متاح بعد إتمام الدورة — أكمل متطلبات الدورة أولًا",
      "COMPLETION_REQUIRED"
    );
  }

  const survey = await loadPublishedCourseSurvey(courseId);
  if (!survey || survey.anonymous || survey.questions.length === 0) {
    return impactFail("لا توجد أدوات قياس أثر متاحة لهذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");
  }
  const now = Date.now();
  const windowOpen =
    (survey.opensAt === null || survey.opensAt.getTime() <= now) &&
    (survey.closesAt === null || survey.closesAt.getTime() >= now);
  if (!windowOpen) {
    return impactFail("فترة استجابة قياس الأثر منتهية", "SURVEY_CLOSED");
  }

  // Validate every answer against its question definition.
  const questionsById = new Map(survey.questions.map((q) => [q.id, q]));
  const prepared: Array<{
    questionId: string;
    valueNumber?: number;
    valueText?: string;
    selectedOptionsJson?: string;
  }> = [];
  const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};

  for (const answer of parsed.data.answers) {
    const question = questionsById.get(answer.questionId);
    if (!question) {
      fieldErrors[answer.questionId] = "سؤال لا يخص أدوات قياس هذه الدورة";
      continue;
    }
    const type = SURVEY_TYPE_MAP[question.type];
    if (type === "RATING") {
      const min = question.minScore ?? 1;
      const max = question.maxScore ?? 5;
      const value = answer.valueNumber;
      if (value === undefined || value < min || value > max) {
        fieldErrors[question.id] = `اختر تقييمًا من ${min} إلى ${max}`;
        continue;
      }
      prepared.push({ questionId: question.id, valueNumber: value });
    } else if (type === "YES_NO") {
      if (answer.valueNumber !== 0 && answer.valueNumber !== 1) {
        fieldErrors[question.id] = "اختر نعم أو لا";
        continue;
      }
      prepared.push({ questionId: question.id, valueNumber: answer.valueNumber });
    } else if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE") {
      const options = parseOptionsJson(question.optionsJson) ?? [];
      // A purely numeric option text arrives from the form action as
      // valueNumber — recover the option string from it (the HTML
      // <select> accepted any option text, numeric included).
      const candidate =
        answer.selectedOption ??
        (answer.valueNumber !== undefined ? String(answer.valueNumber) : undefined);
      if (!candidate || !options.includes(candidate)) {
        fieldErrors[question.id] = "اختر أحد الخيارات المتاحة";
        continue;
      }
      prepared.push({
        questionId: question.id,
        selectedOptionsJson: JSON.stringify([candidate]),
      });
    } else if (type === "MULTI_CHOICE") {
      const options = parseOptionsJson(question.optionsJson) ?? [];
      const candidate =
        answer.selectedOption ??
        (answer.valueNumber !== undefined ? String(answer.valueNumber) : undefined);
      if (!candidate || !options.includes(candidate)) {
        fieldErrors[question.id] = "اختر أحد الخيارات المتاحة";
        continue;
      }
      prepared.push({
        questionId: question.id,
        selectedOptionsJson: JSON.stringify([candidate]),
      });
    } else {
      const text = (answer.valueText ?? "").trim();
      if (!text) {
        fieldErrors[question.id] = "اكتب إجابتك النصية";
        continue;
      }
      prepared.push({ questionId: question.id, valueText: text.slice(0, 2000) });
    }
  }

  for (const question of survey.questions) {
    if (!question.required) continue;
    if (!prepared.some((answer) => answer.questionId === question.id)) {
      fieldErrors[question.id] = fieldErrors[question.id] ?? "هذا السؤال مطلوب";
    }
  }
  if (Object.keys(fieldErrors).length > 0) {
    return impactFail("راجع الإجابات المعلّمة", "VALIDATION", fieldErrors);
  }

  const respondentName = (
    await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: viewer.id },
      select: { name: true },
    })
  )?.name ?? "معلم";

  const transactionOutcome = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // HTML dedupe rule: one response per teacher per course — an
    // existing SUBMITTED response has its answers replaced in place.
    const existing = await tx.surveyResponse.findFirst({
      where: {
        surveyId: survey.id,
        respondentId: viewer.id,
        status: "SUBMITTED",
      },
      select: { id: true },
      orderBy: { submittedAt: "desc" },
    });

    if (existing && !survey.allowMultipleResponses) {
      await tx.surveyAnswer.deleteMany({ where: { responseId: existing.id } });
      await tx.surveyAnswer.createMany({
        data: prepared.map((answer) => ({
          responseId: existing.id,
          questionId: answer.questionId,
          valueNumber: answer.valueNumber ?? null,
          valueText: answer.valueText ?? null,
          selectedOptionsJson: answer.selectedOptionsJson ?? null,
        })),
      });
      await tx.surveyResponse.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: { submittedAt: new Date() },
      });
      return { id: existing.id, replaced: true };
    }

    const created = await tx.surveyResponse.create({
      data: {
        surveyId: survey.id,
        schoolId: survey.schoolId,
        respondentId: viewer.id,
        status: "SUBMITTED",
        submittedAt: new Date(),
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    await tx.surveyAnswer.createMany({
      data: prepared.map((answer) => ({
        responseId: created.id,
        questionId: answer.questionId,
        valueNumber: answer.valueNumber ?? null,
        valueText: answer.valueText ?? null,
        selectedOptionsJson: answer.selectedOptionsJson ?? null,
      })),
    });
    return { id: created.id, replaced: false };
  });

  // Notify the survey owner (office/supervisor) — post-commit, best effort.
  await notifyImpactResponseReceived({
    ownerUserId: survey.ownerUserId,
    courseId,
    surveyId: survey.id,
    courseTitleAr: (await db.course.findUnique({
      where: { id: courseId },
      select: { titleAr: true },
    }))?.titleAr ?? "الدورة",
    respondentName,
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { responseId: transactionOutcome.id, replaced: transactionOutcome.replaced } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Results (office / manager dashboards)                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ImpactQuestionResult {
  questionId: string;
  textAr: string;
  type: string;
  responses: number;
  /** RATING: average on the question scale. */
  average: number | null;
  /** RATING / YES_NO / choice: label -> count. */
  distribution: Array<{ label: string; count: number }> | null;
  /** TEXT: verbatim answers with respondent names (identified surveys). */
  texts: Array<{ name: string; text: string }> | null;
}

export interface ImpactCourseResults {
  courseId: string;
  courseTitleAr: string;
  surveyId: string;
  surveyTitleAr: string;
  responsesCount: number;
  /** Average of every numeric answer across the survey (x/5 style). */
  overallAverage: number | null;
  toolsCount: number;
  questions: ImpactQuestionResult[];
}

/**
 * Per-course impact results. Access: training managers (own school /
 * platform) or the survey owner — the same fence the manage lists use.
 */
export async function getImpactResults(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string
): Promise<ImpactResult<ImpactCourseResults>> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      schoolId: true,
      surveys: {
        where: { status: "PUBLISHED" },
        include: {
          questions: { orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" } },
          responses: {
            where: { status: "SUBMITTED" },
            include: {
              respondent: { select: { name: true } },
              answers: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: { publishedAt: "desc" },
        take: 1,
      },
    },
  });
  if (!course) return impactFail("الدورة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");

  const survey = course.surveys[0];
  if (!survey) return impactFail("لا توجد أدوات قياس أثر لهذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");

  // Access fence: training managers within EITHER tenant surface —
  // the course tenant (may be platform-wide/null) OR the survey
  // tenant (surveys are always school-owned) — plus the survey owner.
  const managerAllowed =
    (canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
      (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ||
        course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId ||
        survey.schoolId === viewer.schoolId)) ||
    survey.ownerUserId === viewer.id;
  if (!managerAllowed) {
    return impactFail(
      "نتائج قياس الأثر متاحة لمديري التدريب ومالك الأدوات فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }

  const responses = survey.responses;
  const numericValues: number[] = [];
  const questionResults: ImpactQuestionResult[] = [];

  for (const question of survey.questions) {
    const type = SURVEY_TYPE_MAP[question.type];
    const answers = responses.flatMap((response) =>
      response.answers.filter((answer) => answer.questionId === question.id)
    );
    const base = {
      questionId: question.id,
      textAr: question.textAr,
      type: type ?? question.type,
      responses: answers.length,
    };

    if (type === "RATING") {
      const min = question.minScore ?? 1;
      const max = question.maxScore ?? 5;
      const values = answers
        .map((answer) => answer.valueNumber)
        .filter((value): value is number => value !== null);
      values.forEach((value) => numericValues.push(value));
      const distribution = Array.from(
        { length: max - min + 1 },
        (_, index) => {
          const score = min + index;
          return {
            label: String(score),
            count: values.filter((value) => value === score).length,
          };
        }
      );
      questionResults.push({
        ...base,
        average: values.length
          ? Number((values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length).toFixed(2))
          : null,
        distribution,
        texts: null,
      });
    } else if (type === "YES_NO") {
      const values = answers
        .map((answer) => answer.valueNumber)
        .filter((value): value is number => value !== null);
      values.forEach((value) => numericValues.push(value));
      questionResults.push({
        ...base,
        average: null,
        distribution: [
          { label: "نعم", count: values.filter((value) => value === 1).length },
          { label: "لا", count: values.filter((value) => value === 0).length },
        ],
        texts: null,
      });
    } else if (type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || type === "MULTI_CHOICE") {
      const options = parseOptionsJson(question.optionsJson) ?? [];
      const picks = answers.flatMap((answer) => {
        if (!answer.selectedOptionsJson) return [];
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(answer.selectedOptionsJson);
          return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : [];
        } catch {
          return [];
        }
      });
      questionResults.push({
        ...base,
        average: null,
        distribution: options.map((option) => ({
          label: option,
          count: picks.filter((pick) => pick === option).length,
        })),
        texts: null,
      });
    } else {
      questionResults.push({
        ...base,
        average: null,
        distribution: null,
        texts: answers
          .filter((answer) => answer.valueText)
          .map((answer) => ({
            name:
              responses.find((response) =>
                response.answers.some((item) => item.id === answer.id)
              )?.respondent?.name ?? "مجهول",
            text: answer.valueText as string,
          })),
      });
    }
  }

  const overallAverage = numericValues.length
    ? Number(
        (numericValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numericValues.length).toFixed(2)
      )
    : null;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      courseId: course.id,
      courseTitleAr: course.titleAr,
      surveyId: survey.id,
      surveyTitleAr: survey.titleAr,
      responsesCount: responses.length,
      overallAverage,
      toolsCount: survey.questions.length,
      questions: questionResults,
    },
  };
}

/** Office overview: every school-scoped course that has impact tools. */
export async function listImpactOverview(viewer: ViewerIdentity): Promise<
  ImpactResult<
    Array<{
      courseId: string;
      courseTitleAr: string;
      responsesCount: number;
      overallAverage: number | null;
      completionsCount: number;
    }>
  >
> {
  if (!canManageTraining(viewer.role)) {
    return impactFail(
      "لوحة قياس الأثر متاحة لمديري التدريب فقط",
      "FORBIDDEN"
    );
  }
  const scopeWhere: Prisma.CourseWhereInput =
    viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN"
      ? {}
      : viewer.schoolId
        ? // Courses carrying their OWN school's tools (school courses)
          // OR platform courses whose impact tools belong to the school.
          {
            OR: [
              { schoolId: viewer.schoolId },
              {
                surveys: {
                  some: { status: "PUBLISHED", schoolId: viewer.schoolId },
                },
              },
            ],
          }
        : { id: "__none__" };

  const courses = await db.course.findMany({
    where: {
      ...scopeWhere,
      surveys: { some: { status: "PUBLISHED" } },
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      titleAr: true,
      surveys: {
        where: { status: "PUBLISHED" },
        select: {
          id: true,
          questions: { select: { type: true, minScore: true, maxScore: true } },
          responses: {
            where: { status: "SUBMITTED" },
            select: {
              answers: { select: { valueNumber: true } },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      completions: { select: { id: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    take: 50,
  });

  const rows = courses.map((course) => {
    const survey = course.surveys[0];
    const numericValues = survey
      ? survey.responses.flatMap((response) =>
          response.answers
            .map((answer) => answer.valueNumber)
            .filter((value): value is number => value !== null)
        )
      : [];
    return {
      courseId: course.id,
      courseTitleAr: course.titleAr,
      responsesCount: survey ? survey.responses.length : 0,
      overallAverage: numericValues.length
        ? Number(
            (numericValues.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numericValues.length).toFixed(2)
          )
        : null,
      completionsCount: course.completions.length,
    };
  });

  return { ok: true, data: rows };
}
