import type { AdminContext, SupervisorTrainingContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import type { TrainingErrorCode } from "@/lib/validation/training";

/**
 * Any context allowed into the training management service layer:
 * the administrative trio PLUS the educational supervisor (whose
 * tenant fence is identical — own school only, never platform-wide).
 */
export type TrainingManageContext = AdminContext | SupervisorTrainingContext;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Training academy — authorization & visibility predicates.            */
/*                                                                      */
/* Pure functions (no DB, no session) so the rules are unit-testable.   */
/* Tenancy rule: schoolId === null means PLATFORM-WIDE shared content;  */
/* only SUPER_ADMIN may create or manage platform-wide records.         */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Session-safe viewer identity used for read-side checks. */
export interface ViewerIdentity {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/** Minimal projection of program/course rows for visibility checks. */
export interface ScopedRecord {
  status: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

/**
 * Roles allowed to manage programs/courses/content. The educational
 * supervisor manages training for their OWN school only — the fence is
 * structural in `trainingScopeError` below (platform-wide records stay
 * SUPER_ADMIN-only).
 */
export function canManageTraining(role: string): boolean {
  return (
    role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ||
    role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
    role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"
  );
}

/**
 * Can this viewer see a PUBLISHED program/course in ordinary browsing?
 *   - platform-wide (schoolId null) -> every authenticated viewer
 *   - school-owned                  -> viewers of the same school only
 * Non-published records are NEVER visible through this predicate —
 * managers reach drafts through the manage-scope path below.
 */
export function canViewPublishedContent(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  record: ScopedRecord
): boolean {
  if (record.status !== "PUBLISHED") return false;
  if (record.schoolId === null) return true;
  return viewer.schoolId !== null && viewer.schoolId === record.schoolId;
}

/**
 * Prisma `where` fragment for teacher/staff catalog listings. SUPER_ADMIN
 * (platform manager) browses every published course; everyone else is
 * confined to platform-wide + their own school's published courses.
 */
export function publishedVisibilityWhere(viewer: ViewerIdentity): {
  status: string;
  OR?: Array<{ schoolId: string | null }>;
} {
  if (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return { status: "PUBLISHED" };
  }
  const scopes: Array<{ schoolId: string | null }> = [{ schoolId: null }];
  if (viewer.schoolId) scopes.push({ schoolId: viewer.schoolId });
  return { status: "PUBLISHED", OR: scopes };
}

export interface ScopeRejection {
  ok: false;
  message: string;
  code: TrainingErrorCode;
}

/**
 * Manage-scope enforcement for training records (mirror of the schools
 * `schoolScopeError` semantics, extended for nullable school scope):
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                -> any record (incl. platform-wide)
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER -> only records owned by their school
 *   SCHOOL_MANAGER             -> only records owned by their school
 *   anything else              -> always rejected (defense in depth)
 * Platform-wide records (schoolId null) can never be managed by a
 * school-scoped role — no exceptions.
 */
export function trainingScopeError(
  ctx: TrainingManageContext,
  recordSchoolId: string | null
): ScopeRejection | null {
  if (ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") return null;
  if (
    (ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
      ctx.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER" ||
      ctx.role === "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR") &&
    recordSchoolId !== null &&
    recordSchoolId === ctx.schoolId
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    ok: false,
    message:
      "ليس لديك صلاحية إدارة هذا المحتوى التدريبي — العملية مرفوضة",
    code: "FORBIDDEN",
  };
}

/**
 * Attachment access decision for the file-serving route.
 *   - SUPER_ADMIN              -> always allowed
 *   - managers                 -> attachments of their own school's
 *                                 records (any status) + platform-wide
 *                                 PUBLISHED records
 *   - everyone else            -> attachments of PUBLISHED records
 *                                 visible to their school only
 * Attachments without an owning course/program can never be accessed
 * (they do not exist through normal flows).
 */
export function canAccessAttachment(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  attachment: { courseId: string | null; programId: string | null },
  course: ScopedRecord | null,
  program: ScopedRecord | null
): boolean {
  if (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") return true;

  if (course) {
    if (
      canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
      course.schoolId !== null &&
      course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId
    ) {
      return true;
    }
    return canViewPublishedContent(viewer, course);
  }

  if (program) {
    if (
      canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
      program.schoolId !== null &&
      program.schoolId === viewer.schoolId
    ) {
      return true;
    }
    return canViewPublishedContent(viewer, program);
  }

  return false;
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — yearly training archives (HTML v26 parity).                */
/*                                                                      */
/* v26ArchiveYear snapshot-copied { courses, completions, certs } for   */
/* the academic year; v26StartYear moved the active year forward. Both  */
/* are implemented here against REAL rows: the snapshot is an immutable */
/* JSON payload stored on the TrainingArchive row (unique per year —    */
/* re-archiving a year REPLACES its snapshot, exactly like the HTML     */
/* state object did). Year boundaries never lose data.                  */
/*                                                                      */
/* Permissions: canAdministerSchool (SUPER_ADMIN / OFFICE) for every    */
/* write; the office is confined to its own school.                     */

export interface ArchiveActor {
  id: string;
  role: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
}

export type ArchiveServiceResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code?: "FORBIDDEN" | "VALIDATION_ERROR" | "NOT_FOUND" };

export interface ArchiveSnapshot {
  archivedAt: string;
  academicYear: string;
  schoolId: string | null;
  courses: Array<{
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    category: string;
    hours: number | null;
    status: string;
  }>;
  completions: Array<{
    id: string;
    courseId: string;
    userId: string;
    teacherName: string;
    hours: number | null;
    bestPercentage: number | null;
    completedAt: string;
    certificateId: string | null;
  }>;
  certificates: Array<{
    id: string;
    certificateNumber: string;
    teacherName: string;
    titleAr: string;
    status: string;
    issuedAt: string;
  }>;
}

export interface ArchiveSummaryRow {
  id: string;
  academicYear: string;
  archivedAt: Date;
  coursesCount: number;
  completionsCount: number;
  certificatesCount: number;
}

function actorScope(actor: ArchiveActor): string | null | "FORBIDDEN" {
  if (actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") return null; // platform-wide
  if (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" && actor.schoolId) {
    return actor.schoolId;
  }
  return "FORBIDDEN";
}

/**
 * Archive one academic year for the actor's scope. The snapshot is
 * derived from persisted completions (and their certificates) of that
 * year — the same rows the yearly table shows, frozen verbatim.
 */
export async function archiveYear(
  actor: ArchiveActor,
  year: string
): Promise<ArchiveServiceResult<ArchiveSummaryRow>> {
  const scope = actorScope(actor);
  if (scope === "FORBIDDEN") {
    return { ok: false, message: "الأرشفة السنوية متاحة لإدارة المدرسة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }

  const completions = await db.courseCompletion.findMany({
    where: { academicYear: year },
    select: {
      id: true,
      courseId: true,
      userId: true,
      hours: true,
      bestPercentage: true,
      completedAt: true,
      certificateId: true,
      user: { select: { name: true, schoolId: true } },
    },
  });
  const scoped = completions.filter(
    (completion) => scope === null || completion.user.schoolId === scope
  );

  const courseIds = [...new Set(scoped.map((completion) => completion.courseId))];
  const courses = await db.course.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: courseIds } },
    select: { id: true, titleAr: true, category: true, estimatedHours: true, status: true },
  });

  const certificateIds = [
    ...new Set(
      scoped
        .map((completion) => completion.certificateId)
        .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id))
    ),
  ];
  const certificates = await db.certificate.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: certificateIds } },
    select: {
      id: true,
      certificateNumber: true,
      titleAr: true,
      status: true,
      issuedAt: true,
      teacher: { select: { name: true } },
    },
  });

  const snapshot: ArchiveSnapshot = {
    archivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    academicYear: year,
    schoolId: scope,
    courses: courses.map((course) => ({
      id: course.id,
      titleAr: course.titleAr,
      category: course.category,
      hours: course.estimatedHours,
      status: course.status,
    })),
    completions: scoped.map((completion) => ({
      id: completion.id,
      courseId: completion.courseId,
      userId: completion.userId,
      teacherName: completion.user.name,
      hours: completion.hours,
      bestPercentage: completion.bestPercentage,
      completedAt: completion.completedAt.toISOString(),
      certificateId: completion.certificateId,
    })),
    certificates: certificates.map((certificate) => ({
      id: certificate.id,
      certificateNumber: certificate.certificateNumber,
      teacherName: certificate.teacher.name,
      titleAr: certificate.titleAr,
      status: certificate.status,
      issuedAt: certificate.issuedAt.toISOString(),
    })),
  };

  const scopeKey = archiveScopeKey(year, scope);
  const saved = await db.trainingArchive.upsert({
    where: { scopeKey },
    create: {
      academicYear: year,
      schoolId: scope,
      scopeKey,
      coursesCount: snapshot.courses.length,
      completionsCount: snapshot.completions.length,
      certificatesCount: snapshot.certificates.length,
      payloadJson: JSON.stringify(snapshot),
      createdById: actor.id,
    },
    update: {
      archivedAt: new Date(),
      coursesCount: snapshot.courses.length,
      completionsCount: snapshot.completions.length,
      certificatesCount: snapshot.certificates.length,
      payloadJson: JSON.stringify(snapshot),
      createdById: actor.id,
    },
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      id: saved.id,
      academicYear: saved.academicYear,
      archivedAt: saved.archivedAt,
      coursesCount: saved.coursesCount,
      completionsCount: saved.completionsCount,
      certificatesCount: saved.certificatesCount,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The archive list (أعوام مؤرشفة) — filtered by the actor's scope
 * column directly (no JSON parsing): SUPER_ADMIN sees every archive;
 * the office sees only its own school's archives.
 */
export async function listArchives(
  actor: ArchiveActor
): Promise<ArchiveServiceResult<ArchiveSummaryRow[]>> {
  const scope = actorScope(actor);
  if (scope === "FORBIDDEN") {
    return { ok: false, message: "السجل التدريبي متاح لإدارة المدرسة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const rows = await db.trainingArchive.findMany({
    where: scope === null ? {} : { schoolId: scope },
    orderBy: [{ academicYear: "desc" }, { archivedAt: "desc" }],
  });
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      academicYear: row.academicYear,
      archivedAt: row.archivedAt,
      coursesCount: row.coursesCount,
      completionsCount: row.completionsCount,
      certificatesCount: row.certificatesCount,
    })),
  };
}

/** One archive with its full payload (archive detail view). */
export async function getArchive(
  actor: ArchiveActor,
  year: string
): Promise<ArchiveServiceResult<{ summary: ArchiveSummaryRow; snapshot: ArchiveSnapshot }>> {
  const scope = actorScope(actor);
  if (scope === "FORBIDDEN") {
    return { ok: false, message: "السجل التدريبي متاح لإدارة المدرسة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const row = await db.trainingArchive.findUnique({
    where: { scopeKey: archiveScopeKey(year, scope) },
  });
  if (!row) return { ok: false, message: "لا يوجد أرشيف لهذا العام", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  let snapshot: ArchiveSnapshot;
  try {
    snapshot = JSON.parse(row.payloadJson) as ArchiveSnapshot;
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, message: "بيانات الأرشيف تالفة", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      summary: {
        id: row.id,
        academicYear: row.academicYear,
        archivedAt: row.archivedAt,
        coursesCount: row.coursesCount,
        completionsCount: row.completionsCount,
        certificatesCount: row.certificatesCount,
      },
      snapshot,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Start a new academic year (HTML v26StartYear) — moves the ACTIVE
 * year forward; completions stamped afterwards belong to the new year.
 */
export async function startAcademicYear(
  actor: ArchiveActor,
  year: string
): Promise<ArchiveServiceResult<{ year: string; previousYear: string }>> {
  if (!canAdministerSchool(actor.role)) {
    return { ok: false, message: "اعتماد عام دراسي جديد متاح للإدارة فقط", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  const { setActiveAcademicYear } = await import("@/lib/academic-year");
  const previousYear = await getActiveAcademicYear();
  const result = await setActiveAcademicYear(year);
  if (!result.ok) {
    return { ok: false, message: result.message, code: "VALIDATION_ERROR" };
  }
  return { ok: true, data: { year: result.year, previousYear } };
}

/** The current-year table for the archive page (real rows, scoped). */
export async function currentYearTable(actor: ArchiveActor): Promise<{
  year: string;
  rows: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof yearTeacherRows>>;
}> {
  const scope = actorScope(actor);
  const year = await getActiveAcademicYear();
  if (scope === "FORBIDDEN") {
    return { year, rows: [] };
  }
  const rows = await yearTeacherRows(year, scope);
  return { year, rows };
}

function archiveScopeKey(year: string, scope: string | null): string {
  return `${year}|${scope ?? "platform"}`;
}

import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";

import type { AdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import { trainingScopeError } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { getStorage, buildStorageKey } from "@/lib/storage";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  createLessonSchema,
  createSectionSchema,
  moveLessonSchema,
  moveSectionSchema,
  updateLessonSchema,
  updateSectionSchema,
  validateUpload,
  zodFieldErrors,
  type TrainingErrorCode,
  type TrainingResult,
} from "@/lib/validation/training";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Phase 5 — course content: sections, lessons, attachments.            */
/*                                                                      */
/* Every mutation resolves the actor from the session-backed context    */
/* and re-validates: section ∈ course, lesson ∈ section, attachment     */
/* ∈ course. Uploads go through validateUpload() and the storage        */
/* adapter — bytes are never stored in the database.                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function fail<T>(
  message: string,
  code?: TrainingErrorCode,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): TrainingResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

function validationFail<T>(error: { issues: unknown[] }): TrainingResult<T> {
  const fieldErrors = zodFieldErrors(error as never);
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
    fieldErrors,
    code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  };
}

/** Defense-in-depth guard shared with the service file. */
function managerGuard(ctx: AdminContext): TrainingResult<never> | null {
  if (ctx.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" && ctx.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "إدارة المحتوى التدريبي متاحة لمدير المنصة ومديري مكاتب التطوير فقط",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }
  return null;
}

/** Load a course and enforce the actor's manage scope over it. */
async function scopedCourse(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  courseId: string
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string; schoolId: string | null }>> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: { id: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = trainingScopeError(ctx, course.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;
  return { ok: true, data: course };
}

export async function createSection(
  raw: unknown,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = createSectionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (!course.ok) return course;

  const count = await db.courseSection.count({ where: { courseId: course.data.id } });
  const section = await db.courseSection.create({
    data: {
      courseId: course.data.id,
      titleAr: input.titleAr,
      description: input.description ?? null,
      orderIndex: count,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: section };
}

export async function updateSection(
  raw: unknown,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = updateSectionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (!course.ok) return course;

  const section = await db.courseSection.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.sectionId },
  });
  if (!section || section.courseId !== course.data.id) {
    return fail("القسم غير موجود أو لا ينتمي إلى هذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");
  }

  const updated = await db.courseSection.update({
    where: { id: section.id },
    data: { titleAr: input.titleAr, description: input.description ?? null },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

export async function deleteSection(
  courseId: string,
  sectionId: string,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, courseId);
  if (!course.ok) return course;

  const section = await db.courseSection.findUnique({
    where: { id: sectionId },
  });
  if (!section || section.courseId !== course.data.id) {
    return fail("القسم غير موجود أو لا ينتمي إلى هذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");
  }

  // Collect attachment storage keys BEFORE deletion so the files can be
  // removed from the storage backend as well.
  const lessons = await db.courseLesson.findMany({
    where: { sectionId: section.id },
    select: { id: true, attachmentId: true },
  });
  const lessonIds = lessons.map((lesson) => lesson.id);
  const attachmentRows = await db.attachment.findMany({
    where: {
      OR: [
        { lessonId: { in: lessonIds } },
        { id: { in: lessons.map((l) => l.attachmentId).filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v)) } },
      ],
    },
    select: { id: true, storageKey: true },
  });

  await db.attachment.deleteMany({
    where: { id: { in: attachmentRows.map((row) => row.id) } },
  });
  await db.courseSection.delete({ where: { id: section.id } });

  const storage = getStorage();
  await Promise.all(attachmentRows.map((row) => storage.delete(row.storageKey)));

  return { ok: true, data: { id: section.id } };
}

export async function moveSection(
  raw: unknown,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = moveSectionSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (!course.ok) return course;

  const sections = await db.courseSection.findMany({
    where: { courseId: course.data.id },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  const index = sections.findIndex((section) => section.id === input.sectionId);
  if (index === -1) {
    return fail("القسم غير موجود أو لا ينتمي إلى هذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");
  }
  const targetIndex = input.direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
  if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= sections.length) {
    return { ok: true, data: { id: input.sectionId } }; // already at the edge
  }

  const current = sections[index];
  const neighbor = sections[targetIndex];
  await db.$transaction([
    db.courseSection.update({
      where: { id: current.id },
      data: { orderIndex: targetIndex },
    }),
    db.courseSection.update({
      where: { id: neighbor.id },
      data: { orderIndex: index },
    }),
  ]);
  return { ok: true, data: { id: current.id } };
}

/** Shared attachment validation for VIDEO / RESOURCE lessons. */
async function validateLessonAttachment(
  courseId: string,
  attachmentId: string | undefined
): Promise<TrainingResult<never> | null> {
  if (!attachmentId) return null;
  const attachment = await db.attachment.findUnique({
    where: { id: attachmentId },
    select: { courseId: true },
  });
  if (!attachment || attachment.courseId !== courseId) {
    return fail(
      "الملف المرفق غير موجود أو لا ينتمي إلى هذه الدورة",
      "RELATION_ERROR"
    );
  }
  return null;
}

export async function createLesson(
  raw: unknown,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = createLessonSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (!course.ok) return course;

  const section = await db.courseSection.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.sectionId },
  });
  if (!section || section.courseId !== course.data.id) {
    return fail("القسم غير موجود أو لا ينتمي إلى هذه الدورة", "RELATION_ERROR");
  }

  const relationError = await validateLessonAttachment(
    course.data.id,
    input.attachmentId
  );
  if (relationError) return relationError;

  const count = await db.courseLesson.count({ where: { sectionId: section.id } });
  try {
    const lesson = await db.courseLesson.create({
      data: {
        sectionId: section.id,
        titleAr: input.titleAr,
        description: input.description ?? null,
        type: input.type,
        content: input.type === "TEXT" ? (input.content ?? null) : null,
        videoUrl:
          input.type === "EXTERNAL_VIDEO" ? (input.videoUrl ?? null) : null,
        attachmentId:
          input.type === "VIDEO" || input.type === "RESOURCE"
            ? (input.attachmentId ?? null)
            : null,
        orderIndex: count,
        isPublished: input.isPublished,
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: lesson };
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
      error.code === "P2002"
    ) {
      return fail("الملف المرفق مرتبط بدرس آخر بالفعل", "RELATION_ERROR");
    }
    return fail("تعذر إنشاء الدرس — حدث خطأ غير متوقع");
  }
}

export async function deleteLesson(

  lessonId: string,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {

export async function moveLesson(
  raw: unknown,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = moveLessonSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (!course.ok) return course;

  const lesson = await db.courseLesson.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.lessonId },
    include: { section: { select: { id: true, courseId: true } } },
  });
  if (!lesson || lesson.section.courseId !== course.data.id) {
    return fail("الدرس غير موجود أو لا ينتمي إلى هذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");
  }

  const siblings = await db.courseLesson.findMany({
    where: { sectionId: lesson.sectionId },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  const index = siblings.findIndex((item) => item.id === lesson.id);
  const targetIndex = input.direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
  if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= siblings.length) {
    return { ok: true, data: { id: lesson.id } };
  }

  const neighbor = siblings[targetIndex];
  await db.$transaction([
    db.courseLesson.update({
      where: { id: lesson.id },
      data: { orderIndex: targetIndex },
    }),
    db.courseLesson.update({
      where: { id: neighbor.id },
      data: { orderIndex: index },
    }),
  ]);
  return { ok: true, data: { id: lesson.id } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Attachments (covers, lesson resources, uploaded videos)              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface UploadAttachmentInput {
  /** COVER for course/program covers; RESOURCE for lesson files; VIDEO for uploaded lesson videos. */
  kind: "COVER" | "RESOURCE" | "VIDEO";
  courseId?: string;
  programId?: string;
  lessonId?: string;
  file: File;
}

export async function uploadAttachment(
  input: UploadAttachmentInput,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<
  TrainingResult<{ id: string; originalName: string; mimeType: string; sizeBytes: number }>
> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  // 1) Server-side type & size enforcement.
  const check = validateUpload({
    kind: input.kind,
    fileName: input.file.name,
    mimeType: input.file.type || "application/octet-stream",
    sizeBytes: input.file.size,
  });
  if (!check.ok) return fail(check.message, "INVALID_FILE");

  let courseId: string | null = null;
  let programId: string | null = null;
  let lessonId: string | null = null;

  if (input.kind === "COVER" && input.programId) {
    const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.programId },
      select: { id: true, schoolId: true, coverAttachmentId: true },
    });
    if (!program) return fail("البرنامج غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
    const scopeCheck = trainingScopeError(ctx, program.schoolId);
    if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;
    programId = program.id;

    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await input.file.arrayBuffer());
    const stored = await getStorage().put(
      buildStorageKey("programs", input.file.name),
      bytes
    );
    const oldCoverId = program.coverAttachmentId;
    const attachment = await db.attachment.create({
      data: {
        originalName: input.file.name,
        storageKey: stored.storageKey,
        mimeType: input.file.type,
        sizeBytes: stored.sizeBytes,
        kind: "COVER",
        programId,
        uploadedById: ctx.id,
      },
      select: { id: true, originalName: true, mimeType: true, sizeBytes: true },
    });
    await db.trainingProgram.update({
      where: { id: program.id },
      data: { coverAttachmentId: attachment.id },
    });
    if (oldCoverId) await removeAttachmentRows([oldCoverId]);
    return { ok: true, data: attachment };
  }

  if (!input.courseId) {
    return fail("معرّف الدورة أو البرنامج مطلوب", "VALIDATION_ERROR");
  }

  const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, input.courseId);
  if (!course.ok) return course;
  courseId = course.data.id;

  if (input.lessonId) {
    const lesson = await db.courseLesson.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.lessonId },
      include: { section: { select: { courseId: true } } },
    });
    if (!lesson || lesson.section.courseId !== courseId) {
      return fail("الدرس غير موجود أو لا ينتمي إلى هذه الدورة", "RELATION_ERROR");
    }
    lessonId = lesson.id;
  }

  // 2) Real storage write — server-generated safe key.
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await input.file.arrayBuffer());
  const stored = await getStorage().put(
    buildStorageKey("courses", input.file.name),
    bytes
  );

  // 3) Metadata row. Uploaded lesson videos are stored as RESOURCE kind
  //    attachments bound to the lesson; the lesson references them via
  //    attachmentId (set when the lesson is saved).
  const attachment = await db.attachment.create({
    data: {
      originalName: input.file.name,
      storageKey: stored.storageKey,
      mimeType: input.file.type,
      sizeBytes: stored.sizeBytes,
      kind: input.kind === "COVER" ? "COVER" : "RESOURCE",
      courseId,
      lessonId,
      uploadedById: ctx.id,
    },
    select: { id: true, originalName: true, mimeType: true, sizeBytes: true },
  });

  if (input.kind === "COVER") {
    const old = await db.course.findUnique({
      where: { id: courseId },
      select: { coverAttachmentId: true },
    });
    await db.course.update({
      where: { id: courseId },
      data: { coverAttachmentId: attachment.id },
    });
    if (old?.coverAttachmentId) {
      await removeAttachmentRows([old.coverAttachmentId]);
    }
  }

  return { ok: true, data: attachment };
}

export async function deleteAttachment(
  attachmentId: string,
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const attachment = await db.attachment.findUnique({
    where: { id: attachmentId },
    select: { id: true, courseId: true, programId: true },
  });
  if (!attachment) return fail("المرفق غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");

  if (attachment.courseId) {
    const course = await scopedCourse(ctx, attachment.courseId);
    if (!course.ok) return course;
  } else if (attachment.programId) {
    const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
      where: { id: attachment.programId },
      select: { schoolId: true },
    });
    if (!program) return fail("البرنامج غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
    const scopeCheck = trainingScopeError(ctx, program.schoolId);
    if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;
  } else {
    return fail("المرفق غير مرتبط بمحتوى معروف", "NOT_FOUND");
  }

  await removeAttachmentRows([attachment.id]);
  return { ok: true, data: { id: attachment.id } };
}

/** Delete attachment rows then their files from the storage backend. */
async function removeAttachmentRows(attachmentIds: string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (attachmentIds.length === 0) return;
  const rows = await db.attachment.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: attachmentIds } },
    select: { id: true, storageKey: true },
  });
  if (rows.length === 0) return;
  await db.attachment.deleteMany({
    where: { id: { in: rows.map((row) => row.id) } },
  });
  const storage = getStorage();
  await Promise.all(rows.map((row) => storage.delete(row.storageKey)));
}

/** Route-handler helper: attachment + owning record for access checks. */
export async function getAttachmentForAccess(attachmentId: string): Promise<{
  id: string;
  originalName: string;
  storageKey: string;
  mimeType: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
  courseId: string | null;
  programId: string | null;
  course: { status: string; schoolId: string | null } | null;
  program: { status: string; schoolId: string | null } | null;
} | null> {
  return db.attachment.findUnique({
    where: { id: attachmentId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      originalName: true,
      storageKey: true,
      mimeType: true,
      sizeBytes: true,
      courseId: true,
      programId: true,
      course: { select: { status: true, schoolId: true } },
      program: { select: { status: true, schoolId: true } },
    },
  });
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET, annualHoursPercent } from "@/config/growth";
import { getActiveAcademicYear } from "@/lib/academic-year";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 2 — annual training hours & the 35-hour yearly target.         */
/*                                                                      */
/* The HTML counted a teacher's hours as the sum of completed-course    */
/* hours (completion.hours, the original completion record field). The  */
/* Next.js engine snapshots the same value into CourseCompletion.hours  */
/* and stamps every completion with the ACTIVE ACADEMIC YEAR, so the    */
/* yearly view, the 35-hour target and the archive are all computed     */
/* from REAL persisted rows — never from client input.                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface TeacherHoursSummary {
  academicYear: string;
  hours: number;
  target: number;
  percent: number;
  completions: number;
  /** Per-year totals across the teacher's whole history (newest first). */
  byYear: Array<{ academicYear: string; hours: number; completions: number }>;
}

/** The teacher's own annual summary (teacher home + /reports view). */
export async function teacherHoursSummary(
  teacherId: string
): Promise<TeacherHoursSummary> {
  const academicYear = await getActiveAcademicYear();

  const grouped = await db.courseCompletion.groupBy({
    by: ["academicYear"],
    where: { userId: teacherId },
    _sum: { hours: true },
    _count: { _all: true },
  });

  const byYear = grouped
    .map((row) => ({
      academicYear: row.academicYear ?? "غير محدد",
      hours: Math.round((row._sum.hours ?? 0) * 10) / 10,
      completions: row._count._all,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.academicYear.localeCompare(a.academicYear, "ar"));

  const current = grouped.find((row) => (row.academicYear ?? "") === academicYear);
  const hours = Math.round((current?._sum.hours ?? 0) * 10) / 10;

  return {
    academicYear,
    hours,
    target: ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET,
    percent: annualHoursPercent(hours),
    completions: current?._count._all ?? 0,
    byYear,
  };
}

export interface YearTeacherRow {
  teacherId: string;
  teacherName: string;
  schoolName: string | null;
  completions: number;
  hours: number;
  academicYear: string;
}

/**
 * The per-teacher table of the yearly record page (HTML
 * v26TrainingArchivePage): كل معلم — عدد الدورات المكتملة والساعات
 * للعام الدراسي المحدد. `schoolId = null` means the whole platform
 * (SUPER_ADMIN view).
 */
export async function yearTeacherRows(
  year: string,
  schoolId: string | null
): Promise<YearTeacherRow[]> {
  const completions = await db.courseCompletion.findMany({
    where: { academicYear: year },
    select: {
      hours: true,
      user: { select: { id: true, name: true, schoolId: true, school: { select: { nameAr: true } } } },
    },
  });

  const byTeacher = new Map<string, YearTeacherRow>();
  for (const completion of completions) {
    if (schoolId && completion.user.schoolId !== schoolId) continue;
    const existing = byTeacher.get(completion.user.id);
    if (existing) {
      existing.completions += 1;
      existing.hours = Math.round((existing.hours + Number(completion.hours ?? 0)) * 10) / 10;
    } else {
      byTeacher.set(completion.user.id, {
        teacherId: completion.user.id,
        teacherName: completion.user.name,
        schoolName: completion.user.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        completions: 1,
        hours: Math.round(Number(completion.hours ?? 0) * 10) / 10,
        academicYear: year,
      });
    }
  }

  return [...byTeacher.values()].sort((a, b) => b.hours - a.hours);
}

export interface AnnualSchoolSummary {
  academicYear: string;
  target: number;
  teachersWithHours: number;
  totalHours: number;
  totalCompletions: number;
  /** Teachers who reached the 35-hour target this year. */
  reachedTarget: number;
  /** Completion percentage of the target averaged over active teachers. */
  averagePercent: number;
}

/**
 * School / platform aggregate for the reports hub — the 35-hour target
 * attainment computed from real completions.
 */
export async function annualSummary(
  schoolId: string | null
): Promise<AnnualSchoolSummary> {
  const academicYear = await getActiveAcademicYear();

  const completions = await db.courseCompletion.findMany({
    where: { academicYear },
    select: { userId: true, hours: true, user: { select: { schoolId: true } } },
  });

  const perTeacher = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const completion of completions) {
    if (schoolId && completion.user.schoolId !== schoolId) continue;
    perTeacher.set(
      completion.userId,
      (perTeacher.get(completion.userId) ?? 0) + Number(completion.hours ?? 0)
    );
  }

  const teachersWithHours = perTeacher.size;
  const totalHours =
    Math.round([...perTeacher.values()].reduce((sum, hours) => sum + hours, 0) * 10) / 10;
  const reachedTarget = [...perTeacher.values()].filter(
    (hours) => hours >= ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET
  ).length;
  const averagePercent =
    teachersWithHours === 0
      ? 0
      : Math.round(
          [...perTeacher.values()].reduce(
            (sum, hours) => sum + annualHoursPercent(hours),
            0
          ) / teachersWithHours
        );

  return {
    academicYear,
    target: ANNUAL_HOURS_TARGET,
    teachersWithHours,
    totalHours,
    totalCompletions: schoolId
      ? completions.filter((completion) => completion.user.schoolId === schoolId).length
      : completions.length,
    reachedTarget,
    averagePercent,
  };
}

FILE: D:\DevCore\Teachers-platform\src\lib\training\journey.ts

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

import {
  availabilityState,
  canViewPublishedAssessment,
} from "@/lib/assessment/access";
import { getCourseLearningStatus } from "@/lib/training/progress";
import type { ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { getMyImpactStatus } from "@/lib/surveys/impact";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Mandatory journey — the central SERVER-SIDE stage engine.            */
/*                                                                     */
/* Computes the four mandatory stages of the course completion         */
/* journey from REAL database state only (never from client input):    */
/*                                                                     */
/*   1. المرحلة الأولى:  محتوى الدورة   — every published lesson done. */
/*   2. المرحلة الثانية: الاختبار النهائي — every published course      */
/*      assessment passed (start/submit are enforced again inside the  */
/*      assessment service + the journey actions — defense in depth).  */
/*   3. المرحلة الثالثة: الشهادة       — CourseCompletion exists and   */
/*      the certificate is issued (signatory-gated, auto-issued).      */
/*   4. المرحلة الرابعة: قياس الأثر    — impact tools unlocked only    */
/*      after the completion (existing survey workflow, untouched).    */
/*                                                                     */
/* Every stage exposes: state (locked/available/in_progress/completed),*/
/* a 0..100 percent, an Arabic detail line and an Arabic lock reason.  */
/* The learn page renders this verdict; it never computes its own.     */
/*                                                                     */
/* Serializable by design: every Date is converted to an ISO string so */
/* the result can cross the RSC boundary into the client stepper.      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type JourneyStageState =
  | "locked"
  | "available"
  | "in_progress"
  | "completed";

export interface ExamOptionView {
  id: string;
  textAr: string;
}

/** A question served during a LIVE attempt — never contains the answer key. */
export interface ExamQuestionView {
  id: string;
  orderIndex: number;
  type: string;
  textAr: string;
  points: number;
  isRequired: boolean;
  options: ExamOptionView[];
}

/** The teacher's own saved draft answers for the live attempt (restore). */
export interface ExamSavedAnswer {
  questionId: string;
  choice?: string[];
  bool?: boolean;
  text?: string;
}

export interface JourneyExamRow {
  id: string;
  titleAr: string;
  instructionsAr: string;
  passingScore: number;
  maxScore: number;
  timeLimitMinutes: number | null;
  attemptLimit: number | null;
  attemptsUsed: number;
  remainingAttempts: number | null;
  passed: boolean;
  bestPercentage: number | null;
  /** True when a submitted attempt awaits MANUAL essay review — the
   * final score/certificate stay locked until the supervisor grades. */
  pendingReview: boolean;
  availability: "available" | "scheduled" | "closed";
  availableFrom: string | null;
  availableUntil: string | null;
  /** Arabic reason when this exam cannot be started right now (null = free). */
  startBlockReason: string | null;
  /** Start button allowed (TEACHER + lessons done + available + attempts left). */
  canStart: boolean;
  /** Live attempt (resume) — questions served WITHOUT answer keys. */
  activeAttempt: {
    id: string;
    deadlineAt: string | null;
    savedAnswers: ExamSavedAnswer[];
    questions: ExamQuestionView[];
  } | null;
}

export interface JourneyStage {
  key: "content" | "exam" | "certificate" | "impact";
  titleAr: string;
  state: JourneyStageState;
  /** 0..100 progress inside the stage itself. */
  percent: number;
  detailAr: string;
  /** Arabic reason when state === "locked" (null otherwise). */
  lockReason: string | null;
}

export interface JourneyView {
  courseId: string;
  isTeacher: boolean;
  /** 0..100 — whole journey (each stage weighs 25%). */
  overallPercent: number;
  /** Ordered: content -> exam -> certificate -> impact. */
  stages: JourneyStage[];
  exams: JourneyExamRow[];
  certificate: {
    issued: boolean;
    href: string | null;
    pendingReason: string | null;
  };
  impact: {
    available: boolean;
    submitted: boolean;
  };
}

export type JourneyResult =
  | { ok: true; data: JourneyView }
  | { ok: false; message: string };

/* ------------------------------ helpers ---------------------------- */

function parseExamOptions(raw: string | null): ExamOptionView[] {
  if (!raw) return [];
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    const options: ExamOptionView[] = [];
    for (const item of parsed) {
      if (
        item &&
        typeof item === "object" &&
        "id" in item &&
        typeof item.id === "string" &&
        "textAr" in item &&
        typeof item.textAr === "string"
      ) {
        options.push({ id: item.id, textAr: item.textAr });
      }
    }
    return options;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function parseSavedAnswers(raw: string | null): ExamSavedAnswer[] {
  if (!raw) return [];
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    const answers: ExamSavedAnswer[] = [];
    for (const item of parsed) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || !("questionId" in item)) continue;
      if (typeof item.questionId !== "string") continue;
      answers.push({
        questionId: item.questionId,
        choice: Array.isArray(item.choice)
          ? item.choice.filter((value: unknown): value is string => typeof value === "string")
          : undefined,
        bool: typeof item.bool === "boolean" ? item.bool : undefined,
        text: typeof item.text === "string" ? item.text : undefined,
      });
    }
    return answers;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function formatArabicDateTime(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
      dateStyle: "medium",
      timeStyle: "short",
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ");
  }
}

/* --------------------------- the engine ---------------------------- */

/**
 * Compute the mandatory journey of one viewer on one course. Read-only:
 * no writes here — the enforcement lives in the existing services
 * (lesson gate, startAttempt, submitAttempt, maybeCompleteCourse,
 * certificate issuance, impact submission) which the journey mirrors.
 */
export async function computeCourseJourney(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string
): Promise<JourneyResult> {
  const statusResult = await getCourseLearningStatus(viewer, courseId);
  if (!statusResult.ok) {
    return { ok: false, message: statusResult.message };
  }
  const status = statusResult.data;
  const isTeacher = viewer.role === "TEACHER";
  const now = Date.now();

  /* ------------------ Stage 1 — محتوى الدورة --------------------- */

  const totalLessons = status.totalLessons;
  const completedLessons = status.completedLessons;
  const contentPercent = totalLessons === 0 ? 100 : status.lessonsPercent;
  const lessonsUnlocked = totalLessons === 0 || completedLessons >= totalLessons;

  const contentStage: JourneyStage = {
    key: "content",
    titleAr: "المرحلة الأولى: محتوى الدورة",
    state:
      contentPercent >= 100
        ? "completed"
        : completedLessons > 0
          ? "in_progress"
          : "available",
    percent: contentPercent,
    detailAr:
      totalLessons === 0
        ? "لا توجد دروس منشورة في هذه الدورة — الانتقال مباشرة إلى الاختبار."
        : `أُنجز ${completedLessons} من ${totalLessons} درسًا — المشاهدة الإلزامية تُحتسب على الخادم.`,
    lockReason: null,
  };

  /* ------------------ Stage 2 — الاختبار النهائي ------------------ */

  const assessmentRows = await db.assessment.findMany({
    where: { courseId, status: "PUBLISHED" },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
  });
  const visibleExams = assessmentRows.filter((row) =>
    canViewPublishedAssessment(viewer, row)
  );

  const attempts = visibleExams.length
    ? await db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
        where: {
          userId: viewer.id,
          assessmentId: { in: visibleExams.map((row) => row.id) },
        },
        orderBy: { startedAt: "desc" },
      })
    : [];

  // Expire stale IN_PROGRESS attempts whose deadline passed without a
  // submission — mirrors startAttempt's expiry rule exactly.
  const staleIds = attempts
    .filter(
      (attempt) =>
        attempt.status === "IN_PROGRESS" &&
        attempt.deadlineAt !== null &&
        attempt.deadlineAt.getTime() <= now
    )
    .map((attempt) => attempt.id);
  if (staleIds.length > 0) {
    await db.assessmentAttempt.updateMany({
      where: { id: { in: staleIds }, status: "IN_PROGRESS" },
      data: { status: "EXPIRED" },
    });
  }

  const exams: JourneyExamRow[] = [];
  for (const row of visibleExams) {
    const own = attempts.filter((attempt) => attempt.assessmentId === row.id);
    const attemptsUsed = own.length;
    const passedAttempts = own.filter(
      (attempt) => attempt.status === "PASSED" || attempt.passed === true
    );
    const passed = passedAttempts.length > 0;
    const bestPercentage = passedAttempts.reduce<number | null>(
      (best, attempt) =>
        attempt.percentage !== null &&
        (best === null || attempt.percentage > best)
          ? attempt.percentage
          : best,
      null
    );
    const remainingAttempts =
      row.attemptLimit === null
        ? null
        : Math.max(0, row.attemptLimit - attemptsUsed);
    const availability = availabilityState(row);
    const live =
      own.find(
        (attempt) =>
          attempt.status === "IN_PROGRESS" &&
          (attempt.deadlineAt === null || attempt.deadlineAt.getTime() > now)
      ) ?? null;
    // Essay answers submitted but NOT yet graded by the supervisor —
    // stage 3 stays explicitly "pending evaluation" until reviewed.
    const pendingReview =
      !passed && own.some((attempt) => attempt.status === "NEEDS_REVIEW");

    let startBlockReason: string | null = null;
    let canStart = false;
    if (passed || live) {
      // Passed = stage done for this exam; live = resume instead of start.
      startBlockReason = null;
    } else if (pendingReview) {
      startBlockReason =
        "إجاباتك بانتظار تصحيح المشرف — ستظهر نتيجتك النهائية بعد مراجعة الأسئلة المقالية.";
    } else if (availability === "scheduled") {
      startBlockReason = `لم يبدأ توافر هذا الاختبار بعد — يفتح في ${
        row.availableFrom
          ? formatArabicDateTime(row.availableFrom.toISOString())
          : "الموعد المحدد"
      }`;
    } else if (availability === "closed") {
      startBlockReason = "انتهت فترة توافر هذا الاختبار";
    } else if (remainingAttempts !== null && remainingAttempts <= 0) {
      startBlockReason = `استهلكت كل المحاولات المسموحة (${row.attemptLimit}) لهذا الاختبار`;
    } else if (!lessonsUnlocked) {
      startBlockReason = `أكمل دروس الدورة أولًا — أنجزت ${completedLessons} من ${totalLessons} درسًا (${contentPercent}%)`;
    } else {
      canStart = isTeacher;
    }

    let activeAttempt: JourneyExamRow["activeAttempt"] = null;
    if (live && isTeacher) {
      const questions = await db.assessmentQuestion.findMany({
        where: { assessmentId: row.id },
        orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
        select: {
          id: true,
          orderIndex: true,
          type: true,
          textAr: true,
          points: true,
          isRequired: true,
          optionsJson: true,
        },
      });
      // The saved answers of THIS teacher's own attempt — restoring the
      // draft never exposes keys or scoring data (answersJson only holds
      // the teacher's own picks).
      const liveRow = own.find((attempt) => attempt.id === live.id) ?? null;
      activeAttempt = {
        id: live.id,
        deadlineAt: live.deadlineAt ? live.deadlineAt.toISOString() : null,
        savedAnswers: parseSavedAnswers(liveRow?.answersJson ?? null),
        questions: questions.map((question) => ({
          id: question.id,
          orderIndex: question.orderIndex,
          type: question.type,
          textAr: question.textAr,
          points: question.points,
          isRequired: question.isRequired,
          options: parseExamOptions(question.optionsJson),
        })),
      };
    }

    exams.push({
      id: row.id,
      titleAr: row.titleAr,
      instructionsAr: row.instructionsAr,
      passingScore: row.passingScore,
      maxScore: row.maxScore,
      timeLimitMinutes: row.timeLimitMinutes,
      attemptLimit: row.attemptLimit,
      attemptsUsed,
      remainingAttempts,
      passed,
      bestPercentage,
      pendingReview,
      availability,
      availableFrom: row.availableFrom ? row.availableFrom.toISOString() : null,
      availableUntil: row.availableUntil ? row.availableUntil.toISOString() : null,
      startBlockReason,
      canStart,
      activeAttempt,
    });
  }

  const examsTotal = exams.length;
  const examsPassedCount = exams.filter((exam) => exam.passed).length;
  const examsAllPassed = examsTotal === 0 || examsPassedCount === examsTotal;
  const examsPercent =
    examsTotal === 0 ? 100 : Math.round((examsPassedCount / examsTotal) * 100);
  const anyLiveAttempt = exams.some((exam) => exam.activeAttempt !== null);
  const anyPendingReview = exams.some((exam) => exam.pendingReview);

  const examStage: JourneyStage = (() => {
    if (!lessonsUnlocked) {
      return {
        key: "exam",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الثانية: الاختبار النهائي",
        state: "locked",
        percent: examsPercent,
        detailAr: "يُفتح الاختبار النهائي بعد إكمال جميع دروس الدورة.",
        lockReason: `أكمل جميع دروس الدورة أولًا — أنجزت ${completedLessons} من ${totalLessons} درسًا (${contentPercent}%)`,
      };
    }
    if (examsAllPassed) {
      return {
        key: "exam",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الثانية: الاختبار النهائي",
        state: "completed",
        percent: 100,
        detailAr:
          examsTotal === 0
            ? "لا يوجد اختبار نهائي منشور لهذه الدورة — تم استيفاء المتطلب."
            : `اجتزت جميع اختبارات الدورة (${examsPassedCount} من ${examsTotal}).`,
        lockReason: null,
      };
    }
    if (anyLiveAttempt) {
      return {
        key: "exam",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الثانية: الاختبار النهائي",
        state: "in_progress",
        percent: examsPercent,
        detailAr:
          "لديك محاولة اختبار جارية — أكملها وسلّم إجاباتك قبل انتهاء الوقت.",
        lockReason: null,
      };
    }
    if (anyPendingReview) {
      return {
        key: "exam",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الثانية: الاختبار النهائي",
        state: "in_progress",
        percent: examsPercent,
        detailAr:
          "سُلمت إجاباتك وتنتظر تصحيح المشرف للأسئلة المقالية — ستُعلن نتيجتك النهائية بعد المراجعة، وتُفتح الشهادة تلقائيًا عند الاجتياز.",
        lockReason: null,
      };
    }
    return {
      key: "exam",
      titleAr: "المرحلة الثانية: الاختبار النهائي",
      state: "available",
      percent: examsPercent,
      detailAr:
        "أكملت جميع دروس الدورة — الاختبار النهائي متاح الآن وفق قواعد المحاولات ودرجة النجاح.",
      lockReason: null,
    };
  })();

  /* ------------------ Stage 3 — الشهادة --------------------------- */

  const completion = status.completion;
  const certificateId = completion?.certificateId ?? null;
  const certificateHref = certificateId
    ? `/certificates/${certificateId}`
    : null;

  const certificateStage: JourneyStage = (() => {
    if (completion && certificateId) {
      return {
        key: "certificate",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الثالثة: الشهادة",
        state: "completed",
        percent: 100,
        detailAr: "شهادتك صادرة ومتاحة للعرض والتحميل من مكتبة الشهادات.",
        lockReason: null,
      };
    }
    if (completion) {
      return {
        key: "certificate",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الثالثة: الشهادة",
        state: "in_progress",
        percent: 50,
        detailAr:
          "تم تسجيل إتمام الدورة — شهادتك تنتظر توقيع مدير المدرسة وستُصدر تلقائيًا بمجرد توفّر الموقّع.",
        lockReason: null,
      };
    }
    return {
      key: "certificate",
      titleAr: "المرحلة الثالثة: الشهادة",
      state: "locked",
      percent: 0,
      detailAr: "تُصدر الشهادة تلقائيًا بعد إتمام الدورة.",
      lockReason: !lessonsUnlocked
        ? "أكمل محتوى الدورة أولًا — الشهادة تُصدر بعد إتمام الدروس والاختبار."
        : "اجتز الاختبار النهائي أولًا — الشهادة تُصدر بعد اجتياز جميع اختبارات الدورة.",
    };
  })();

  /* ------------------ Stage 4 — قياس الأثر ------------------------ */

  const impactResult = await getMyImpactStatus(viewer, courseId);
  const impact = impactResult.ok ? impactResult.data : null;
  const impactAvailable = impact?.available === true;
  const impactSubmitted = impact?.submitted === true;

  const impactStage: JourneyStage = (() => {
    if (!completion) {
      return {
        key: "impact",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الرابعة: قياس الأثر",
        state: "locked",
        percent: 0,
        detailAr: "أدوات قياس الأثر تُفتح بعد إتمام الدورة كاملة.",
        lockReason:
          "قياس الأثر يُفتح بعد إتمام الدورة — أكمل الدروس واجتز الاختبار النهائي أولًا.",
      };
    }
    if (!impactAvailable) {
      return {
        key: "impact",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الرابعة: قياس الأثر",
        state: "completed",
        percent: 100,
        detailAr:
          "لا توجد أدوات قياس أثر منشورة لهذه الدورة — تم استيفاء المتطلب.",
        lockReason: null,
      };
    }
    if (impactSubmitted) {
      return {
        key: "impact",
        titleAr: "المرحلة الرابعة: قياس الأثر",
        state: "completed",
        percent: 100,
        detailAr:
          "تم إرسال استجابتك لقياس الأثر — شكرًا لمساهمتك في تحسين التدريبات.",
        lockReason: null,
      };
    }
    return {
      key: "impact",
      titleAr: "المرحلة الرابعة: قياس الأثر",
      state: "available",
      percent: 0,
      detailAr:
        "شاركنا تجربتك بعد التطبيق — إجاباتك تساعد في قياس أثر هذا التدريب.",
      lockReason: null,
    };
  })();

  const overallPercent = Math.round(
    contentPercent * 0.25 +
      examsPercent * 0.25 +
      certificateStage.percent * 0.25 +
      impactStage.percent * 0.25
  );

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      courseId,
      isTeacher,
      overallPercent,
      stages: [contentStage, examStage, certificateStage, impactStage],
      exams,
      certificate: {
        issued: Boolean(certificateId),
        href: certificateHref,
        pendingReason:
          completion && !certificateId
            ? "تنتظر الشهادة توقيع مدير المدرسة — ستُصدر تلقائيًا بمجرد توفّر الموقّع."
            : null,
      },
      impact: {
        available: impactAvailable,
        submitted: impactSubmitted,
      },
    },
  };
}
