import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";

import type { ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { canManageTraining } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getActiveAcademicYear } from "@/lib/academic-year";
import {
  issueCourseCompletionCertificate,
  type CompletionCertificateOutcome,
} from "@/lib/certificates/auto-issue";
import {
  notifyCourseCompleted,
  notifyCourseLessonCompleted,
} from "@/lib/notifications/center";
import { isYouTubeUrl } from "@/lib/media/video-url";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Batch 1 — learning progress & course completion.                    */
/*                                                                     */
/* Closes the original HTML platform's learning loop on real data:     */
/*   enroll -> complete every published lesson -> pass every published */
/*   course assessment -> CourseCompletion (hours + best score) ->     */
/*   auto-issued certificate (when a school signatory exists) ->       */
/*   in-app notifications.                                             */
/*                                                                     */
/* Server-side only: the viewer identity always comes from the         */
/* session; every write re-checks course visibility, lesson            */
/* publication and enrollment. Progress marks and completions are      */
/* idempotent through DB unique constraints.                           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Result shape (mirrors the training service convention)              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type ProgressErrorCode =
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED"
  | "LESSON_NOT_PUBLISHED"
  | "ALREADY_COMPLETED"
  | /** manual completion rejected for video lessons */ "VIDEO_WATCH_REQUIRED"
  | /** sequential gate: previous lessons incomplete */ "LESSON_LOCKED"
  | "UNKNOWN";

export type ProgressResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      message: string;
      code?: ProgressErrorCode;
    };

function progressFail<T>(
  message: string,
  code: ProgressErrorCode
): ProgressResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === "P2002"
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Read model — the full learning status of one viewer on one course   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface LessonProgressRow {
  lessonId: string;
  completed: boolean;
  completedAt: Date | null;
}

/** Mandatory-playback watch ledger rows (resume + progress restore). */
export interface LessonWatchStateRow {
  lessonId: string;
  watchSeconds: number;
  maxPositionSeconds: number;
  lastPositionSeconds: number;
}

export interface CourseLearningStatus {
  courseId: string;
  enrolled: boolean;
  /** Mandatory-learning policy snapshot for the UI. */
  requireSequentialLessons: boolean;
  lessonCompletionThreshold: number;
  /** Watch ledger rows keyed by lesson (see LessonWatchStateRow). */
  watchStates: LessonWatchStateRow[];
  /** Published lessons of the course (the requirement pool). */
  totalLessons: number;
  completedLessons: number;
  /** 0..100 — completion of the published-lesson pool. */
  lessonsPercent: number;
  completedLessonIds: string[];
  lessons: LessonProgressRow[];
  /** Published assessments bound to this course. */
  assessments: Array<{
    id: string;
    titleAr: string;
    passingScore: number;
    maxScore: number;
    bestPercentage: number | null;
    passed: boolean | null;
    attemptsUsed: number;
    attemptLimit: number | null;
  }>;
  /** Every published lesson completed AND every published assessment passed. */
  requirementsMet: boolean;
  completion: {
    id: string;
    completedAt: Date;
    totalLessons: number;
    completedLessons: number;
    bestPercentage: number | null;
    hours: number | null;
    certificateId: string | null;
  } | null;
}

/**
 * Full learning status for the course learning page. Visibility rules
 * mirror getCourseForViewer (published + own school or platform-wide;
 * managers may preview their school's non-published courses).
 */
export async function getCourseLearningStatus(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string
): Promise<ProgressResult<CourseLearningStatus>> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      status: true,
      schoolId: true,
      estimatedHours: true,
      requireSequentialLessons: true,
      lessonCompletionThreshold: true,
      sections: {
        orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
        select: {
          lessons: {
            where: { isPublished: true },
            orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
            select: { id: true },
          },
        },
      },
      assessments: {
        where: { status: "PUBLISHED" },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
        select: {
          id: true,
          titleAr: true,
          passingScore: true,
          maxScore: true,
          attemptLimit: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!course) return progressFail("الدورة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  const publishedLessons = course.sections.flatMap((section) => section.lessons);

  const managerPreview =
    canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
    (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId);
  const allowed =
    managerPreview ||
    (course.status === "PUBLISHED" &&
      (course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId));
  if (!allowed) {
    return progressFail("هذه الدورة غير متاحة لك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const [progressRows, enrollment, attempts, completion, watchRows] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseLessonProgress.findMany({
      where: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id },
      select: { lessonId: true, completedAt: true },
    }),
    db.courseEnrollment.findUnique({
      where: { courseId_userId: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id } },
      select: { id: true },
    }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: {
        userId: viewer.id,
        assessmentId: {
          in: course.assessments.map((assessment) => assessment.id),
        },
      },
      select: {
        assessmentId: true,
        status: true,
        passed: true,
        percentage: true,
      },
    }),
    db.courseCompletion.findUnique({
      where: { courseId_userId: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id } },
      select: {
        id: true,
        completedAt: true,
        totalLessons: true,
        completedLessons: true,
        bestPercentage: true,
        hours: true,
        certificateId: true,
      },
    }),
    db.lessonWatchState.findMany({
      where: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id },
      select: {
        lessonId: true,
        watchSeconds: true,
        maxPositionSeconds: true,
        lastPositionSeconds: true,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const completedAtByLesson = new Map(
    progressRows.map((row) => [row.lessonId, row.completedAt])
  );
  const completedLessonIds = publishedLessons
    .filter((lesson) => completedAtByLesson.has(lesson.id))
    .map((lesson) => lesson.id);

  // Best percentage per assessment across the viewer's attempts
  // (mirrors the manual eligibility engine: passed = flag or status).
  const assessmentRows = course.assessments.map((assessment) => {
    const own = attempts.filter(
      (attempt) => attempt.assessmentId === assessment.id
    );
    const passedAttempts = own.filter(
      (attempt) => attempt.passed === true || attempt.status === "PASSED"
    );
    const bestPercentage = passedAttempts.reduce<number | null>(
      (best, attempt) =>
        attempt.percentage !== null &&
        (best === null || attempt.percentage > best)
          ? attempt.percentage
          : best,
      null
    );
    return {
      id: assessment.id,
      titleAr: assessment.titleAr,
      passingScore: assessment.passingScore,
      maxScore: assessment.maxScore,
      bestPercentage,
      passed: passedAttempts.length > 0,
      attemptsUsed: own.length,
      attemptLimit: assessment.attemptLimit,
    };
  });

  const totalLessons = publishedLessons.length;
  const completedLessons = completedLessonIds.length;
  const allLessonsDone = totalLessons === 0 || completedLessons >= totalLessons;
  const allAssessmentsPassed = assessmentRows.every(
    (assessment) => assessment.passed
  );

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      courseId: course.id,
      enrolled: enrollment !== null,
      requireSequentialLessons: course.requireSequentialLessons,
      lessonCompletionThreshold: course.lessonCompletionThreshold,
      watchStates: watchRows.map((row) => ({
        lessonId: row.lessonId,
        watchSeconds: row.watchSeconds,
        maxPositionSeconds: row.maxPositionSeconds,
        lastPositionSeconds: row.lastPositionSeconds,
      })),
      totalLessons,
      completedLessons,
      lessonsPercent:
        totalLessons === 0
          ? 100
          : Math.round((completedLessons / totalLessons) * 100),
      completedLessonIds,
      lessons: publishedLessons.map((lesson) => ({
        lessonId: lesson.id,
        completed: completedAtByLesson.has(lesson.id),
        completedAt: completedAtByLesson.get(lesson.id) ?? null,
      })),
      assessments: assessmentRows,
      requirementsMet: allLessonsDone && allAssessmentsPassed,
      completion: completion ?? null,
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Exam gating — the original HTML rule: no test before the lessons    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface LessonGateStatus {
  required: number;
  completed: number;
  percent: number;
  unlocked: boolean;
}

/**
 * Server-side exam gate for course-bound assessments: the attempt can
 * start only after EVERY published lesson of the course is completed
 * (the original HTML v11CanTest rule). Courses without published
 * lessons are vacuously unlocked — the assessment engine keeps its own
 * availability/enrollment/attempt rules on top of this gate.
 */
export async function lessonGateStatus(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string
): Promise<LessonGateStatus> {
  const [total, completed] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseLesson.count({
      where: { isPublished: true, section: { courseId } },
    }),
    db.courseLessonProgress.count({
      where: {
        userId: viewer.id,
        lesson: { isPublished: true, section: { courseId } },
      },
    }),
  ]);
  return {
    required: total,
    completed,
    percent: total === 0 ? 100 : Math.round((completed / total) * 100),
    unlocked: completed >= total,
  };
}

/** Rejection message for a locked exam — surfaced verbatim by the
 * assessment service when startAttempt runs before the lessons are done. */
export function lessonGateMessage(gate: LessonGateStatus): string {
  return `أكمل دروس الدورة أولًا قبل إجراء الاختبار — أنجزت ${gate.completed} من ${gate.required} درسًا (${gate.percent}%)`;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Writes — lesson completion                                          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface MarkLessonOutcome {
  alreadyCompleted: boolean;
  progressId: string;
  lessonsPercent: number;
  /** Set when this very mark satisfied the whole course. */
  courseCompleted: CourseCompletionOutcome | null;
}

/**
 * Mark one published lesson as completed for the viewer. TEACHERs are
 * auto-enrolled on the first mark (the original HTML "فتح التدريب"
 * behavior — opening the training starts it). Staff viewers
 * (managers/supervisors previewing) never write progress rows.
 */
export async function markLessonComplete(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string,
  lessonId: string,
  /** "watch" = called by the mandatory-playback heartbeat (trusted path). */
  options?: { source?: "manual" | "watch" }
): Promise<ProgressResult<MarkLessonOutcome>> {
  const lesson = await db.courseLesson.findUnique({
    where: { id: lessonId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      type: true,
      videoUrl: true,
      isPublished: true,
      section: {
        select: {
          courseId: true,
          course: {
            select: { id: true, status: true, schoolId: true, requireSequentialLessons: true },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!lesson || lesson.section.courseId !== courseId) {
    return progressFail("الدرس غير موجود في هذه الدورة", "NOT_FOUND");
  }
  const course = lesson.section.course;
  const managerPreview =
    canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
    (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId);
  const visible =
    managerPreview ||
    (course.status === "PUBLISHED" &&
      (course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId));
  if (!visible) {
    return progressFail("هذه الدورة غير متاحة لك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }
  if (!lesson.isPublished) {
    return progressFail("هذا الدرس غير منشور بعد", "LESSON_NOT_PUBLISHED");
  }

  // Mandatory playback: lessons backed by a WATCHABLE video complete
  // ONLY through the server-validated watch threshold — the heartbeat
  // path passes source:"watch" and skips this. Covers type VIDEO with a
  // stored URL (uploaded R2 files and YouTube links) and EXTERNAL_VIDEO
  // YouTube links; Vimeo or plain external links stay manually
  // verifiable, and a VIDEO row without any URL keeps its manual toggle
  // (nothing watchable to measure). This closes the EXTERNAL_VIDEO hole
  // where a direct action call could mark a video lesson complete
  // without watching it — the UI hides the button for exactly this set.
  const governableVideo =
    lesson.type === "VIDEO"
      ? lesson.videoUrl !== null
      : lesson.type === "EXTERNAL_VIDEO" &&
        lesson.videoUrl !== null &&
        isYouTubeUrl(lesson.videoUrl);
  if (governableVideo && options?.source !== "watch") {
    return progressFail(
      "تُنجز دروس الفيديو تلقائيًا بعد مشاهدة النسبة المطلوبة على الخادم",
      "VIDEO_WATCH_REQUIRED"
    );
  }

  // Sequential gate — every published lesson BEFORE this one must be
  // completed when the course enforces sequential learning. Applies to
  // BOTH paths (manual + heartbeat): API requests cannot skip ahead.
  if (course.requireSequentialLessons && viewer.role === "TEACHER") {
    const sections = await db.courseSection.findMany({
      where: { courseId: course.id },
      orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
      select: {
        lessons: {
          where: { isPublished: true },
          orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
          select: { id: true, titleAr: true },
        },
      },
    });
    const ordered = sections.flatMap((section) => section.lessons);
    const index = ordered.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === lesson.id);
    if (index > 0) {
      const previousIds = ordered.slice(0, index).map((entry) => entry.id);
      const completedRows = await db.courseLessonProgress.findMany({
        where: { userId: viewer.id, lessonId: { in: previousIds } },
        select: { lessonId: true },
      });
      const completedSet = new Set(completedRows.map((row) => row.lessonId));
      if (completedSet.size < previousIds.length) {
        const blocker = ordered
          .slice(0, index)
          .find((entry) => !completedSet.has(entry.id));
        return progressFail(
          `الدرس مقفل — أكمل درس «${blocker?.titleAr ?? "الدرس السابق"}» أولًا بالترتيب`,
          "LESSON_LOCKED"
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // Only teachers build progress; staff previews never write rows.
  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return progressFail("متابعة تقدم الدروس متاحة للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  // Auto-enroll on the first interaction (idempotent).
  const enrolled = await db.courseEnrollment.findUnique({
    where: { courseId_userId: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (!enrolled) {
    try {
      await db.courseEnrollment.create({
        data: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id, status: "ACTIVE" },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!isUniqueViolation(error)) throw error;
    }
  }

  const existing = await db.courseLessonProgress.findUnique({
    where: { lessonId_userId: { lessonId: lesson.id, userId: viewer.id } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  let progressId = existing?.id ?? "";
  let alreadyCompleted = false;
  if (existing) {
    alreadyCompleted = true;
  } else {
    try {
      const created = await db.courseLessonProgress.create({
        data: { courseId: course.id, lessonId: lesson.id, userId: viewer.id },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      progressId = created.id;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!isUniqueViolation(error)) throw error;
      const raced = await db.courseLessonProgress.findUnique({
        where: { lessonId_userId: { lessonId: lesson.id, userId: viewer.id } },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      progressId = raced?.id ?? "";
      alreadyCompleted = true;
    }
  }

  const gate = await lessonGateStatus(viewer, course.id);
  if (!alreadyCompleted) {
    await notifyCourseLessonCompleted({
      teacherId: viewer.id,
      courseId: course.id,
      lessonsPercent: gate.percent,
    });
  }

  // Every lesson done -> try to close the course now (a pending
  // assessment may still hold it back; maybeCompleteCourse re-checks).
  const courseCompleted = gate.unlocked
    ? await maybeCompleteCourse(viewer.id, course.id)
    : null;

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      alreadyCompleted,
      progressId,
      lessonsPercent: gate.percent,
      courseCompleted,
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Writes — course completion (idempotent, called from two paths)      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface CourseCompletionOutcome {
  created: boolean;
  completionId: string;
  hours: number | null;
  bestPercentage: number | null;
  certificate: CompletionCertificateOutcome | null;
  /** Why no certificate exists yet (null when one was issued/linked). */
  certificateBlockedReason: string | null;
}

/**
 * Create the CourseCompletion row when (and only when) the requirements
 * are met: every published lesson completed AND every published course
 * assessment passed. Idempotent — an existing completion short-circuits,
 * and concurrent callers collapse on the unique (courseId, userId)
 * constraint. Called after the last lesson mark and after any PASSED
 * attempt (auto-graded or manually reviewed).
 */
export async function maybeCompleteCourse(
  userId: string,
  courseId: string,
  certifiedById?: string
): Promise<CourseCompletionOutcome | null> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      schoolId: true,
      estimatedHours: true,
      sections: {
        select: {
          lessons: {
            where: { isPublished: true },
            select: { id: true },
          },
        },
      },
      assessments: { where: { status: "PUBLISHED" }, select: { id: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!course) return null;
  const publishedLessonIds = course.sections.flatMap(
    (section) => section.lessons
  );

  const existing = await db.courseCompletion.findUnique({
    where: { courseId_userId: { courseId: course.id, userId } },
    select: {
      id: true,
      hours: true,
      bestPercentage: true,
      certificateId: true,
    },
  });
  if (existing) {
    return {
      created: false,
      completionId: existing.id,
      hours: existing.hours,
      bestPercentage: existing.bestPercentage,
      certificate: existing.certificateId
        ? {
            certificateId: existing.certificateId,
            created: false,
            blockedReason: null,
          }
        : null,
      certificateBlockedReason: existing.certificateId
        ? null
        : "CERTIFICATE_PENDING",
    };
  }

  const [completedCount, attempts] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseLessonProgress.count({
      where: {
        userId,
        lesson: { isPublished: true, section: { courseId: course.id } },
      },
    }),
    db.assessmentAttempt.findMany({
      where: {
        userId,
        assessmentId: {
          in: course.assessments.map((assessment) => assessment.id),
        },
      },
      select: {
        assessmentId: true,
        status: true,
        passed: true,
        percentage: true,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const totalLessons = publishedLessonIds.length;
  if (totalLessons > 0 && completedCount < totalLessons) return null;

  for (const assessment of course.assessments) {
    const passed = attempts.some(
      (attempt) =>
        attempt.assessmentId === assessment.id &&
        (attempt.status === "PASSED" || attempt.passed === true)
    );
    if (!passed) return null;
  }

  const passedPercentages = attempts
    .filter(
      (attempt) => attempt.status === "PASSED" || attempt.passed === true
    )
    .map((attempt) => attempt.percentage)
    .filter((value): value is number => value !== null);
  const bestPercentage = passedPercentages.length
    ? Math.max(...passedPercentages)
    : null;

  let created: { id: string };
  try {
    created = await db.courseCompletion.create({
      data: {
        courseId: course.id,
        userId,
        courseSchoolId: course.schoolId,
        totalLessons,
        completedLessons: completedCount,
        bestPercentage,
        hours: course.estimatedHours ?? null,
        certifiedById: certifiedById ?? null,
        // Batch 2 — stamp the ACTIVE ACADEMIC YEAR so the annual hours,
        // the 35-hour target and the yearly archive count this row in
        // the right year (HTML v26 parity).
        academicYear: await getActiveAcademicYear(),
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (isUniqueViolation(error)) {
      const raced = await db.courseCompletion.findUnique({
        where: { courseId_userId: { courseId: course.id, userId } },
        select: { id: true, hours: true, bestPercentage: true },
      });
      return raced
        ? {
            created: false,
            completionId: raced.id,
            hours: raced.hours,
            bestPercentage: raced.bestPercentage,
            certificate: null,
            certificateBlockedReason: "CERTIFICATE_PENDING",
          }
        : null;
    }
    throw error;
  }

  // Auto certificate — best effort: a missing school signatory blocks
  // ONLY the certificate, never the completion itself.
  const certificate = await issueCourseCompletionCertificate({
    teacherId: userId,
    courseId: course.id,
    completionId: created.id,
  });

  if (certificate.certificateId) {
    await db.courseCompletion.update({
      where: { id: created.id },
      data: { certificateId: certificate.certificateId },
    });
  }

  await notifyCourseCompleted({
    teacherId: userId,
    courseId: course.id,
    completionId: created.id,
    certificateId: certificate.certificateId,
    hours: course.estimatedHours ?? null,
  });

  return {
    created: true,
    completionId: created.id,
    hours: course.estimatedHours ?? null,
    bestPercentage,
    certificate: certificate.certificateId
      ? {
          certificateId: certificate.certificateId,
          created: true,
          blockedReason: null,
        }
      : null,
    certificateBlockedReason: certificate.blockedReason,
  };
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";

import type { ViewerIdentity } from "@/lib/training/access";
import { canManageTraining } from "@/lib/training/access";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Mandatory learning — sequential unlocking & watch heartbeat.         */
/*                                                                      */
/* SERVER-SIDE ONLY enforcement:                                        */
/*   1. A published lesson is locked until every published lesson       */
/*      BEFORE it (sections by orderIndex, lessons by orderIndex) is    */
/*      completed — for TEACHER learners when the course's              */
/*      requireSequentialLessons policy is on. Managers preview freely. */
/*   2. Watch progress is a heartbeat ledger (LessonWatchState): the    */
/*      client can only REPORT a position; the server decides how much  */
/*      watch time that report is worth (capped by real elapsed wall   */
/*      clock — playback speed above 1x buys nothing), keeps the        */
/*      monotonic max position bounded by accumulated watch time, and   */
/*      is the ONLY writer of lesson completion for VIDEO lessons.      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/* ------------------------------ types ----------------------------- */

export interface SequenceLockInfo {
  locked: boolean;
  /** Title of the first incomplete lesson blocking this one (null when free). */
  lockedByTitle: string | null;
  /** The first not-yet-completed lesson in order (the "current" one). */
  current: boolean;
}

export interface LessonWatchSnapshot {
  watchSeconds: number;
  maxPositionSeconds: number;
  lastPositionSeconds: number;
  watchedPercent: number;
  completed: boolean;
}

export type WatchHeartbeatCode =
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "LESSON_LOCKED"
  | "LESSON_NOT_PUBLISHED"
  | "ROLE_FORBIDDEN"
  | "VALIDATION"
  | "UNKNOWN";

export type WatchHeartbeatResult =
  | {
      ok: true;
      data: {
        watchSeconds: number;
        maxPositionSeconds: number;
        lastPositionSeconds: number;
        watchedPercent: number;
        completed: boolean;
        justCompleted: boolean;
        thresholdPercent: number;
        skipped: boolean;
      };
    }
  | { ok: false; message: string; code?: WatchHeartbeatCode };

/* -------------------------- pure helpers -------------------------- */

/**
 * Compute per-lesson lock state from the flat published order and the
 * completion set. Pure — no DB, trivially testable. When sequential
 * learning is disabled every lesson is free; the first incomplete
 * lesson is still flagged as "current" for the UI.
 */
export function computeSequentialLocks(
  ordered: Array<{ id: string; titleAr: string }>,
  completedIds: readonly string[],
  requireSequential: boolean
): Map<string, SequenceLockInfo> {
  const completed = new Set(completedIds);
  const titleById = new Map(ordered.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.titleAr]));
  const result = new Map<string, SequenceLockInfo>();
  let firstIncompleteId: string | null = null;
  for (const lesson of ordered) {
    const isCompleted = completed.has(lesson.id);
    const current = firstIncompleteId === null && !isCompleted;
    if (current) firstIncompleteId = lesson.id;
    const blockedBy =
      requireSequential && !isCompleted && firstIncompleteId !== null;
    result.set(lesson.id, {
      locked: blockedBy && lesson.id !== firstIncompleteId,
      lockedByTitle:
        blockedBy && lesson.id !== firstIncompleteId
          ? (titleById.get(firstIncompleteId as string) ?? null)
          : null,
      current,
    });
  }
  return result;
}

/* ------------------------------ reads ----------------------------- */

export interface CourseLearningPolicy {
  requireSequentialLessons: boolean;
  lessonCompletionThreshold: number;
}

/** The mandatory-learning policy of one course (defaults when missing row). */
export async function getCourseLearningPolicy(
  courseId: string
): Promise<CourseLearningPolicy> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    select: {
      requireSequentialLessons: true,
      lessonCompletionThreshold: true,
    },
  });
  return {
    requireSequentialLessons: course?.requireSequentialLessons ?? true,
    lessonCompletionThreshold: course?.lessonCompletionThreshold ?? 95,
  };
}

/**
 * Flat published-lesson order of one course — the canonical sequence
 * (sections by orderIndex, then lessons by orderIndex).
 */
export async function getOrderedPublishedLessons(courseId: string): Promise<
  Array<{ id: string; titleAr: string; type: string; durationSeconds: number | null }>
> {
  const sections = await db.courseSection.findMany({
    where: { courseId },
    orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
    select: {
      lessons: {
        where: { isPublished: true },
        orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
        select: { id: true, titleAr: true, type: true, durationSeconds: true },
      },
    },
  });
  return sections.flatMap((section) => section.lessons);
}

/**
 * Server-side sequential gate for ONE lesson: is this viewer allowed to
 * open/play it right now? Enforces visibility + publication + the
 * sequential policy (managers bypass — preview mode). Used by the
 * heartbeat, the media proxy and (transitively) completion writes.
 */
export async function assertLessonPlayable(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string,
  lessonId: string
): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; message: string; code: WatchHeartbeatCode }> {
  const lesson = await db.courseLesson.findUnique({
    where: { id: lessonId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      isPublished: true,
      section: {
        select: {
          courseId: true,
          course: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              status: true,
              schoolId: true,
              requireSequentialLessons: true,
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!lesson || lesson.section.courseId !== courseId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الدرس غير موجود في هذه الدورة", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  const course = lesson.section.course;
  const managerPreview =
    canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
    (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId);
  const visible =
    managerPreview ||
    (course.status === "PUBLISHED" &&
      (course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId));
  if (!visible) {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذه الدورة غير متاحة لك", code: "FORBIDDEN" };
  }
  if (!lesson.isPublished) {
    return { ok: false, message: "هذا الدرس غير منشور بعد", code: "LESSON_NOT_PUBLISHED" };
  }
  if (!course.requireSequentialLessons || managerPreview || viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return { ok: true };
  }

  const ordered = await getOrderedPublishedLessons(course.id);
  const index = ordered.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === lesson.id);
  if (index <= 0) return { ok: true };

  const previousIds = ordered.slice(0, index).map((entry) => entry.id);
  const completedRows = await db.courseLessonProgress.findMany({
    where: { userId: viewer.id, lessonId: { in: previousIds } },
    select: { lessonId: true },
  });
  const completed = new Set(completedRows.map((row) => row.lessonId));
  if (completed.size < previousIds.length) {
    const firstIncomplete = ordered
      .slice(0, index)
      .find((entry) => !completed.has(entry.id));
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: `هذا الدرس مقفل — أكمل درس «${firstIncomplete?.titleAr ?? "الدرس السابق"}» أولًا بالترتيب`,
      code: "LESSON_LOCKED",
    };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

/* ---------------------------- heartbeats --------------------------- */

/** Minimum gap between accepted heartbeats (rate limit, ms). */
const HEARTBEAT_MIN_GAP_MS = 1500;
/** Wall-clock grace added to each delta cap (network/scheduling jitter). */
const HEARTBEAT_GRACE_SECONDS = 5;
/** Cap for the very first heartbeat of a lesson (resume warm-up). */
const FIRST_BEAT_CAP_SECONDS = 30;

/**
 * One playback heartbeat from the mandatory player. The client reports
 * its current position; the server alone decides how much watch time
 * that is worth and whether the lesson is completed. Anti-cheat:
 *   - delta is capped by REAL elapsed wall clock (+grace) — speeding up
 *     or hammering the action cannot inflate watchSeconds;
 *   - maxPosition can never exceed accumulated watch time;
 *   - completion fires only here, against the course threshold.
 */
export async function recordWatchHeartbeat(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string,
  lessonId: string,
  input: {
    positionSeconds: number;
    durationSeconds?: number | null;
    ended?: boolean;
  }
): Promise<WatchHeartbeatResult> {
  const gate = await assertLessonPlayable(viewer, courseId, lessonId);
  if (!gate.ok) return gate;

  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "متابعة تقدم المشاهدة متاحة للمعلمين فقط",
      code: "ROLE_FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  if (
    !Number.isFinite(input.positionSeconds) ||
    input.positionSeconds < 0 ||
    input.positionSeconds > 24 * 3600
  ) {
    return { ok: false, message: "قيمة تقدم غير صالحة", code: "VALIDATION" };
  }

  const [lesson, policy] = await Promise.all([
    db.courseLesson.findUnique({
      where: { id: lessonId },
      select: { id: true, durationSeconds: true },
    }),
    getCourseLearningPolicy(courseId),
  ]);
  if (!lesson) {
    return { ok: false, message: "الدرس غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const existing = await db.lessonWatchState.findUnique({
    where: { lessonId_userId: { lessonId, userId: viewer.id } },
  });

  const isFirstBeat = !existing;
  const elapsedSeconds = existing
    ? Math.max(0, (now.getTime() - existing.lastHeartbeatAt.getTime()) / 1000)
    : 0;

  // Rate limit: sub-1.5s repeated calls gain nothing — return the
  // current snapshot untouched so a spam loop cannot inflate watch time.
  if (existing && elapsedSeconds < HEARTBEAT_MIN_GAP_MS / 1000) {
    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        watchSeconds: existing.watchSeconds,
        maxPositionSeconds: existing.maxPositionSeconds,
        lastPositionSeconds: existing.lastPositionSeconds,
        watchedPercent: existing.reportedDurationSeconds
          ? Math.min(
              100,
              Math.round((existing.watchSeconds / existing.reportedDurationSeconds) * 100)
            )
          : 0,
        completed: await db.courseLessonProgress
          .findUnique({
            where: { lessonId_userId: { lessonId, userId: viewer.id } },
            select: { id: true },
          })
          .then((row) => row !== null),
        justCompleted: false,
        thresholdPercent: policy.lessonCompletionThreshold,
        skipped: true,
      },
    };
  }

  const prev = existing ?? {
    watchSeconds: 0,
    maxPositionSeconds: 0,
    lastPositionSeconds: 0,
    reportedDurationSeconds: null as number | null,
  };

  // Effective duration: instructor-captured value wins; otherwise the
  // client metadata (best-effort fallback, never trusted for storage).
  const duration =
    lesson.durationSeconds ??
    prev.reportedDurationSeconds ??
    (input.durationSeconds && Number.isFinite(input.durationSeconds)
      ? Math.min(Math.max(1, Math.floor(input.durationSeconds)), 24 * 3600)
      : null);

  const position = Math.min(input.positionSeconds, duration ?? input.positionSeconds);
  const delta = position - prev.lastPositionSeconds;

  let watchSeconds = prev.watchSeconds;
  if (delta > 0) {
    // A played second can advance the position by at most one second at
    // 1x — the cap below makes faster "progress" worthless.
    const cap = isFirstBeat ? FIRST_BEAT_CAP_SECONDS : elapsedSeconds + HEARTBEAT_GRACE_SECONDS;
    watchSeconds += Math.min(delta, cap);
  }
  if (duration !== null) {
    watchSeconds = Math.min(watchSeconds, duration);
  }

  // Monotonic ceiling bounded by honest watch accumulation.
  const maxPositionSeconds = Math.min(
    Math.max(prev.maxPositionSeconds, position),
    Math.max(watchSeconds, prev.maxPositionSeconds)
  );

  const thresholdRatio = Math.min(100, Math.max(50, policy.lessonCompletionThreshold)) / 100;
  const watchedPercent =
    duration && duration > 0
      ? Math.min(100, Math.round((watchSeconds / duration) * 100))
      : 0;

  const meetsThreshold =
    duration !== null && watchSeconds >= thresholdRatio * duration;
  const alreadyCompletedRow = await db.courseLessonProgress.findUnique({
    where: { lessonId_userId: { lessonId, userId: viewer.id } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  const completed = Boolean(alreadyCompletedRow);
  const justCompleted = meetsThreshold && !completed;

  await db.lessonWatchState.upsert({
    where: { lessonId_userId: { lessonId, userId: viewer.id } },
    create: {
      courseId,
      lessonId,
      userId: viewer.id,
      watchSeconds,
      maxPositionSeconds,
      lastPositionSeconds: position,
      reportedDurationSeconds:
        lesson.durationSeconds === null && duration !== null ? duration : null,
      lastHeartbeatAt: now,
    },
    update: {
      watchSeconds,
      maxPositionSeconds,
      lastPositionSeconds: position,
      reportedDurationSeconds:
        lesson.durationSeconds === null && duration !== null ? duration : undefined,
      lastHeartbeatAt: now,
    },
  });

  let courseCompleted = false;
  if (justCompleted) {
    // The ONLY completion path for VIDEO lessons — full server checks,
    // auto-enrollment, notifications and course completion live inside.
    const { markLessonComplete } = await import("@/lib/training/progress");
    const outcome = await markLessonComplete(viewer, courseId, lessonId, {
      source: "watch",
    });
    courseCompleted = outcome.ok && (outcome.data.courseCompleted?.created === true);
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      watchSeconds: Math.round(watchSeconds * 10) / 10,
      maxPositionSeconds: Math.round(maxPositionSeconds * 10) / 10,
      lastPositionSeconds: Math.round(position * 10) / 10,
      watchedPercent,
      completed: completed || justCompleted,
      justCompleted,
      thresholdPercent: policy.lessonCompletionThreshold,
      skipped: false,
    },
  };
}

/** Watch snapshot for the learning page (resume + progress restore). */
export async function listLessonWatchSnapshots(
  userId: string,
  courseId: string
): Promise<Map<string, LessonWatchSnapshot>> {
  const rows = await db.lessonWatchState.findMany({
    where: { userId, courseId },
    select: {
      lessonId: true,
      watchSeconds: true,
      maxPositionSeconds: true,
      lastPositionSeconds: true,
    },
  });
  const map = new Map<string, LessonWatchSnapshot>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    map.set(row.lessonId, {
      watchSeconds: row.watchSeconds,
      maxPositionSeconds: row.maxPositionSeconds,
      lastPositionSeconds: row.lastPositionSeconds,
      watchedPercent: 0,
      completed: false,
    });
  }
  return map;
}

function fail<T>(
  message: string,
  code?: TrainingErrorCode,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): TrainingResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code, fieldErrors };
}

function validationFail<T>(error: { issues: unknown[] }): TrainingResult<T> {
  // Narrow local cast — zod v4 ZodError shape.
  const fieldErrors = zodFieldErrors(error as never);
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
    fieldErrors,
    code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  };
}

/** Resolve the owning school for a new program/course from the actor. */
function resolveScope(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  scope: "platform" | "school",
  schoolId: string | undefined
): { ok: true; schoolId: string | null } | { ok: false; message: string; code: TrainingErrorCode } {
  if (ctx.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER") {
    if (scope === "platform") {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message:
          "المحتوى المشترك على مستوى المنصة متاح لمدير المنصة فقط",
        code: "FORBIDDEN",
      };
    }
    return { ok: true, schoolId: ctx.schoolId };
  }
  // SUPER_ADMIN
  if (scope === "platform") return { ok: true, schoolId: null };
  if (!schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "اختر المدرسة المالكة للمحتوى",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  return { ok: true, schoolId };
}

/** Defense-in-depth guard: content mutations are manager-only. */
function managerGuard(ctx: AdminContext): TrainingResult<never> | null {
  if (!canManageTraining(ctx.role)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "إدارة المحتوى التدريبي متاحة لمدير المنصة ومديري مكاتب التطوير فقط",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }
  return null;
}

/** Program options for the course form: own (non-archived) + platform PUBLISHED. */
export async function listProgramOptionsForManage(
  ctx: AdminContext
): Promise<{ id: string; nameAr: string; schoolId: string | null; platformWide: boolean }[]> {
  if (ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    const rows = await db.trainingProgram.findMany({
      where: { status: { not: "ARCHIVED" } },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true, schoolId: true },
      orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
    });
    return rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      nameAr: row.nameAr,
      schoolId: row.schoolId,
      platformWide: row.schoolId === null,
    }));
  }
  const rows = await db.trainingProgram.findMany({
    where: {
      status: { not: "ARCHIVED" },
      OR: [{ schoolId: ctx.schoolId }, { schoolId: null, status: "PUBLISHED" }],
    },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true, schoolId: true },
    orderBy: { nameAr: "asc" },
  });
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    nameAr: row.nameAr,
    schoolId: row.schoolId,
    platformWide: row.schoolId === null,
  }));
}

}

export async function createProgram(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = createProgramSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const scope = resolveScope(ctx, input.scope, input.schoolId);
  if (!scope.ok) return scope;

  const nameNorm = normalizeContentName(input.nameAr);
  const duplicate = await db.trainingProgram.findFirst({
    where: { nameNorm, schoolId: scope.schoolId },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (duplicate) {
    return fail(
      "يوجد برنامج بنفس الاسم في هذا النطاق بالفعل",
      "DUPLICATE",
      { nameAr: "اسم البرنامج مستخدم بالفعل" }
    );
  }

  const program = await db.trainingProgram.create({
    data: {
      schoolId: scope.schoolId,
      nameAr: input.nameAr,
      nameEn: input.nameEn ?? null,
      nameNorm,
      descriptionAr: input.descriptionAr,
      descriptionEn: input.descriptionEn ?? null,
      category: input.category,
      status: "DRAFT",
      createdById: ctx.id,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: program };
}

export async function updateProgram(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = updateProgramSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.programId },
  });
  if (!program) return fail("البرنامج غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = trainingScopeError(ctx, program.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  // Scope never changes after creation (moving content across tenants
  // is intentionally unsupported).
  const nameNorm = normalizeContentName(input.nameAr);
  const duplicate = await db.trainingProgram.findFirst({
    where: { nameNorm, schoolId: program.schoolId, id: { not: program.id } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (duplicate) {
    return fail(
      "يوجد برنامج بنفس الاسم في هذا النطاق بالفعل",
      "DUPLICATE",
      { nameAr: "اسم البرنامج مستخدم بالفعل" }
    );
  }

  const updated = await db.trainingProgram.update({
    where: { id: program.id },
    data: {
      nameAr: input.nameAr,
      nameEn: input.nameEn ?? null,
      nameNorm,
      descriptionAr: input.descriptionAr,
      descriptionEn: input.descriptionEn ?? null,
      category: input.category,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

}

/* Courses — manage side                                                */

export interface CourseManageFilters {
  q?: string;
  status?: string;
  category?: string;
  programId?: string;
  page?: number;
}

export interface Paginated<T> {
  rows: T[];
  total: number;
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
}

export async function listCoursesForManage(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  filters: CourseManageFilters
): Promise<TrainingResult<Paginated<CourseCatalogRow>>> {
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const where: Prisma.CourseWhereInput =
    ctx.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? {} : { schoolId: ctx.schoolId };

  if (filters.q && filters.q.trim().length > 0) {
    where.titleAr = { contains: filters.q.trim() };
  }
  if (
    filters.status &&
    (CONTENT_STATUSES as readonly string[]).includes(filters.status)
  ) {
    where.status = filters.status;
  }
  if (filters.category && filters.category.trim().length > 0) {
    where.category = filters.category.trim();
  }
  if (filters.programId && filters.programId.trim().length > 0) {
    where.programId = filters.programId.trim();
  }

  const total = await db.course.count({ where });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / COURSES_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  const rows = await db.course.findMany({
    where,
    include: {
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      _count: { select: { sections: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
    skip: (page - 1) * COURSES_PAGE_SIZE,
    take: COURSES_PAGE_SIZE,
  });

  const lessonCounts = await lessonsCountByCourse(
    rows.map((row) => row.id),
    false
  );

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        category: row.category,
        level: row.level,
        estimatedHours: row.estimatedHours,
        status: row.status,
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
        coverAttachmentId: row.coverAttachmentId,
        programId: row.programId,
        programName: row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
        schoolName: row.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        sectionsCount: row._count.sections,
        lessonsCount: lessonCounts[row.id] ?? 0,
      })),
      total,
      page,
      pageCount,
    },
  };
}

/** Batch-compute lesson counts per course id (optionally published only). */
async function lessonsCountByCourse(
  courseIds: string[],
  publishedOnly: boolean
): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  if (courseIds.length === 0) return {};
  const sections = await db.courseSection.findMany({
    where: { courseId: { in: courseIds } },
    select: { id: true, courseId: true },
  });
  const sectionToCourse = new Map(sections.map((s) => [s.id, s.courseId]));
  const lessons = await db.courseLesson.findMany({
    where: {
      sectionId: { in: sections.map((s) => s.id) },
      ...(publishedOnly ? { isPublished: true } : {}),
    },
    select: { sectionId: true },
  });
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const lesson of lessons) {
    const courseId = sectionToCourse.get(lesson.sectionId);
    if (courseId) counts[courseId] = (counts[courseId] ?? 0) + 1;
  }
  return counts;
}

/* --------------------------- create/update ------------------------- */

export async function createCourse(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = createCourseSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const scope = resolveScope(ctx, input.scope, input.schoolId);
  if (!scope.ok) return scope;

  const relationError = await validateCourseRelations(
    scope.schoolId,
    input.programId,
    input.instructorId
  );
  if (relationError) return relationError;

  const course = await db.course.create({
    data: {
      schoolId: scope.schoolId,
      programId: input.programId ?? null,
      titleAr: input.titleAr,
      titleEn: input.titleEn ?? null,
      descriptionAr: input.descriptionAr,
      descriptionEn: input.descriptionEn ?? null,
      category: input.category,
      level: input.level ?? null,
      estimatedHours: input.estimatedHours ?? null,
      instructorId: input.instructorId ?? null,
      status: "DRAFT",
      createdById: ctx.id,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: course };
}

export async function updateCourse(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = updateCourseSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await db.course.findUnique({ where: { id: input.courseId } });
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = trainingScopeError(ctx, course.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  const relationError = await validateCourseRelations(
    course.schoolId,
    input.programId,
    input.instructorId
  );
  if (relationError) return relationError;

  const updated = await db.course.update({
    where: { id: course.id },
    data: {
      programId: input.programId ?? null,
      titleAr: input.titleAr,
      titleEn: input.titleEn ?? null,
      descriptionAr: input.descriptionAr,
      descriptionEn: input.descriptionEn ?? null,
      category: input.category,
      level: input.level ?? null,
      estimatedHours: input.estimatedHours ?? null,
      instructorId: input.instructorId ?? null,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

/** Program + instructor relation validation shared by create/update. */
async function validateCourseRelations(
  schoolId: string | null,
  programId: string | undefined,
  instructorId: string | undefined
): Promise<TrainingResult<never> | null> {
  if (programId) {
    const program = await db.trainingProgram.findUnique({
      where: { id: programId },
      select: { schoolId: true },
    });
    if (!program) {
      return fail("البرنامج المحدد غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
    }
    if (program.schoolId !== null && program.schoolId !== schoolId) {
      return fail(
        "البرنامج المحدد لا ينتمي إلى نطاق هذه الدورة",
        "RELATION_ERROR"
      );
    }
  }
  if (instructorId) {
    const instructor = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: instructorId },
      select: { schoolId: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!instructor || !instructor.isActive) {
      return fail("المدرّب المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط", "NOT_FOUND");
    }
    if ((instructor.schoolId ?? null) !== schoolId) {
      return fail(
        "المدرّب المحدد لا ينتمي إلى نطاق هذه الدورة",
        "RELATION_ERROR"
      );
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* --------------------------- publish workflow ---------------------- */

export async function setCourseStatus(
  raw: unknown,
  actor?: AdminContext
): Promise<TrainingResult<{ id: string; status: string; publishedAt: Date | null }>> {
  const ctx = actor ?? (await requireAdmin());
  const guard = managerGuard(ctx);
  if (guard) return guard;

  const parsed = setCourseStatusSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);
  const input = parsed.data;

  const course = await db.course.findUnique({ where: { id: input.courseId } });
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");
  const scopeCheck = trainingScopeError(ctx, course.schoolId);
  if (scopeCheck) return scopeCheck;

  if (input.status === "PUBLISHED") {
    const [sectionCount, lessonCount] = await Promise.all([
      db.courseSection.count({ where: { courseId: course.id } }),
      db.courseLesson.count({ where: { section: { courseId: course.id } } }),
    ]);
    if (sectionCount < 1 || lessonCount < 1) {
      return fail(
        "لا يمكن نشر الدورة — أضف قسمًا واحدًا على الأقل ودرسًا واحدًا على الأقل قبل النشر",
        "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
      );
    }
  }

  const updated = await db.course.update({
    where: { id: course.id },
    data: {
      status: input.status,
      ...(input.status === "PUBLISHED"
        ? { publishedAt: course.publishedAt ?? new Date() }
        : {}),
    },
    select: { id: true, status: true, publishedAt: true },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: updated };
}

export interface PublishedCourseFilters {
  q?: string;
  category?: string;
  programId?: string;
  mine?: boolean;
  page?: number;
}

export async function listPublishedCourses(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  filters: PublishedCourseFilters
): Promise<TrainingResult<Paginated<CourseCatalogRow>>> {
  const visibility = publishedVisibilityWhere(viewer);
  const where: Prisma.CourseWhereInput = { ...visibility };

  if (filters.q && filters.q.trim().length > 0) {
    where.titleAr = { contains: filters.q.trim() };
  }
  if (filters.category && filters.category.trim().length > 0) {
    where.category = filters.category.trim();
  }
  if (filters.programId && filters.programId.trim().length > 0) {
    where.programId = filters.programId.trim();
  }
  if (filters.mine) {
    where.enrollments = { some: { userId: viewer.id } };
  }

  const total = await db.course.count({ where });
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / COURSES_PAGE_SIZE));
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(1, filters.page ?? 1), pageCount);

  const rows = await db.course.findMany({
    where,
    include: {
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      _count: { select: { sections: true } },
      enrollments: {
        where: { userId: viewer.id },
        select: { id: true },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { publishedAt: "desc" },
    skip: (page - 1) * COURSES_PAGE_SIZE,
    take: COURSES_PAGE_SIZE,
  });

  const lessonCounts = await lessonsCountByCourse(
    rows.map((row) => row.id),
    true
  );

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        titleAr: row.titleAr,
        category: row.category,
        level: row.level,
        estimatedHours: row.estimatedHours,
        status: row.status,
        updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
        coverAttachmentId: row.coverAttachmentId,
        programId: row.programId,
        programName: row.program?.nameAr ?? null,
        schoolName: row.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        sectionsCount: row._count.sections,
        lessonsCount: lessonCounts[row.id] ?? 0,
        enrolled: row.enrollments.length > 0,
      })),
      total,
      page,
      pageCount,
    },
  };
}

/** Full learning view for one published course (access-checked). */
export async function getCourseForViewer(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string
): Promise<TrainingResult<CourseLearningView>> {
  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: courseId },
    include: {
      program: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      school: { select: { nameAr: true } },
      instructor: { select: { name: true } },
      sections: {
        orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
        include: {
          lessons: {
            where: { isPublished: true },
            orderBy: { orderIndex: "asc" },
            include: { attachment: { select: { originalName: true } } },
          },
        },
      },
      enrollments: {
        where: { userId: viewer.id },
        select: { id: true, enrolledAt: true },
      },
      attachments: {
        where: { kind: "RESOURCE", lessonId: null },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");

  // Visibility: published + own school or platform-wide for everyone;
  // managers additionally preview their own school's (or any, for the
  // platform admin) non-published courses through the learning view.
  const managerPreview =
    canManageTraining(viewer.role) &&
    (viewer.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId);
  const allowed =
    managerPreview ||
    (course.status === "PUBLISHED" &&
      (course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId));
  if (!allowed) {
    return fail("هذه الدورة غير متاحة لك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const sections: ViewerSection[] = course.sections.map((section) => ({
    id: section.id,
    titleAr: section.titleAr,
    description: section.description,
    orderIndex: section.orderIndex,
    lessons: section.lessons.map((lesson) => ({
      id: lesson.id,
      titleAr: lesson.titleAr,
      type: lesson.type,
      description: lesson.description,
      content: lesson.content,
      videoUrl: lesson.videoUrl,
      attachmentId: lesson.attachmentId,
      attachmentName: lesson.attachment?.originalName ?? null,
      durationSeconds: lesson.durationSeconds,
      orderIndex: lesson.orderIndex,
    })),
  }));

  const publishedLessonsCount = sections.reduce(
    (sum, section) => sum + section.lessons.length,
    0
  );

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      course: {
        id: course.id,
        titleAr: course.titleAr,
        titleEn: course.titleEn,
        descriptionAr: course.descriptionAr,
        descriptionEn: course.descriptionEn,
        category: course.category,
        subcategory: course.subcategory,
        trainingType: course.trainingType,
        level: course.level,
        estimatedHours: course.estimatedHours,
        status: course.status,
        coverAttachmentId: course.coverAttachmentId,
        scheduledAt: course.scheduledAt ? course.scheduledAt.toISOString() : null,
        meetingUrl: course.meetingUrl,
        youtubeUrl: course.youtubeUrl,
        supervisorInstructionsAr: course.supervisorInstructionsAr,
        programName: course.program?.nameAr ?? null,
        instructorName: course.instructor?.name ?? null,
        schoolName: course.school?.nameAr ?? null,
      },
      sections,
      publishedLessonsCount,
      attachments: course.attachments.map((attachment) => ({
        id: attachment.id,
        originalName: attachment.originalName,
        mimeType: attachment.mimeType,
        sizeBytes: attachment.sizeBytes,
        url: publicUrlFor(attachment.storageKey),
      })),
      enrollment: course.enrollments[0]
        ? {
            id: course.enrollments[0].id,
            enrolledAt: course.enrollments[0].enrolledAt,
          }
        : null,
    },
  };
}

/** One published lesson + navigation outline (access-checked). */
export async function getLessonForViewer(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  courseId: string,
  lessonId: string
): Promise<TrainingResult<LessonLearningView>> {
  const view = await getCourseForViewer(viewer, courseId);
  if (!view.ok) return view;

  const outline = view.data.sections;
  const flat = outline.flatMap((section) =>
    section.lessons.map((lesson) => ({ sectionTitle: section.titleAr, lesson }))
  );
  const index = flat.findIndex((entry) => entry.lesson.id === lessonId);
  if (index === -1) {
    return fail("الدرس غير متاح — قد يكون مسودة أو غير موجود", "NOT_FOUND");
  }

  const entry = flat[index];
  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      course: view.data.course,
      sectionTitle: entry.sectionTitle,
      lesson: entry.lesson,
      outline,
      prevLessonId: index > 0 ? flat[index - 1].lesson.id : null,
      nextLessonId:
        index < flat.length - 1 ? flat[index + 1].lesson.id : null,
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Enrollment                                                           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface EnrollmentOutcome {
  alreadyEnrolled: boolean;
  enrollmentId: string;
}

export async function enrollTeacher(
  viewer: ViewerIdentity,
  raw: unknown
): Promise<TrainingResult<EnrollmentOutcome>> {
  const parsed = enrollSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return validationFail(parsed.error);

  if (viewer.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return fail("التسجيل في الدورات متاح للمعلمين فقط", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const course = await db.course.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.courseId },
    select: { id: true, status: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!course) return fail("الدورة غير موجودة", "NOT_FOUND");

  const visible =
    course.status === "PUBLISHED" &&
    (course.schoolId === null || course.schoolId === viewer.schoolId);
  if (!visible) {
    return fail("هذه الدورة غير متاحة لتسجيلك", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  const existing = await db.courseEnrollment.findUnique({
    where: { courseId_userId: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  if (existing) {
    return { ok: true, data: { alreadyEnrolled: true, enrollmentId: existing.id } };
  }

  try {
    const enrollment = await db.courseEnrollment.create({
      data: { courseId: course.id, userId: viewer.id, status: "ACTIVE" },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: { alreadyEnrolled: false, enrollmentId: enrollment.id } };
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
      error.code === "P2002"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        data: { alreadyEnrolled: true, enrollmentId: "existing" },
      };
    }
    return fail("تعذر إتمام التسجيل — حدث خطأ غير متوقع");
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Dashboard metrics                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface AcademyMetrics {
  coursesTotal: number;
  coursesPublished: number;
  programsTotal: number;
  enrollmentsCount: number;
}

/** Real persisted academy metrics scoped by school (null = platform). */
export async function getAcademyMetrics(
  schoolId: string | null
): Promise<AcademyMetrics> {
  const courseWhere: Prisma.CourseWhereInput = schoolId ? { schoolId } : {};
  const programWhere: Prisma.TrainingProgramWhereInput = schoolId
    ? { schoolId }
    : {};
  const enrollmentWhere: Prisma.CourseEnrollmentWhereInput = schoolId
    ? { user: { schoolId } }
    : {};

  const [coursesTotal, coursesPublished, programsTotal, enrollmentsCount] =
    await Promise.all([
      db.course.count({ where: courseWhere }),
      db.course.count({
        where: { ...courseWhere, status: "PUBLISHED" },
      }),
      db.trainingProgram.count({ where: programWhere }),
      db.courseEnrollment.count({ where: enrollmentWhere }),
    ]);

  return { coursesTotal, coursesPublished, programsTotal, enrollmentsCount };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Form option helpers                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export async function getInstructorOptions(
  ctx: AdminContext,
  schoolId: string | null
): Promise<{ id: string; name: string }[]> {
  if (!schoolId) return []; // platform-wide courses: instructors come later
  const rows = await db.user.findMany({
    where: {
      schoolId,
      role: { in: ["TEACHER", "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR"] },
      isActive: true,
    },
    select: { id: true, name: true },
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
  });
  return rows;
}

async function requireAdmin(): Promise<AdminContext> {
  // Services are called from server actions that already resolved the
  // context; this fallback exists for tests and keeps the signature
  // symmetric with the schools service.
  const { requireAdminContext } = await import("@/lib/auth/dev-admin");
  return requireAdminContext();
}
