const dateTimeLabel = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-EG", {
  day: "numeric",
  month: "long",
  year: "numeric",
  hour: "numeric",
  minute: "2-digit",
});

function lastLoginLabel(date: Date | null): string | null {
  return date ? dateTimeLabel.format(date) : null;
}

function relationError(
  message: string,
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>
): UsersServiceResult<never> {
  return { ok: false, message, fieldErrors, code: "RELATION_ERROR" };
}

/**
 * Defense in depth: administrative mutations require an administrative
 * role. In production the server action already redirects other roles
 * via requireAdminContext — this gate keeps the SERVICE safe even when
 * called with a deputy/supervisor/teacher/IT context.
 */
function adminActorError(actor: AdminContext): UsersServiceResult<never> | null {
  if (
    actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ||
    actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    actor.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "غير مصرح لك بهذه العملية الإدارية — العملية مرفوضة",
    code: "FORBIDDEN",
  };
}

/** The two school-scoped administrators — always confined to own school. */
function isSchoolScopedAdmin(
  actor: AdminContext
): actor is Extract<AdminContext, { schoolId: string }> {
  return (
    actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
    actor.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Directory (read-side)                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Role-scoped, filterable, paginated user directory.
 *   - SUPER_ADMIN: platform-wide, optional school filter;
 *   - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER / SCHOOL_MANAGER: forced to their OWN
 *     school — a client-supplied schoolId filter is IGNORED.
 * A tampered branchId simply yields zero rows (the forced school scope
 * stays in the WHERE clause) — no data leaks, no errors to probe with.
 */
export async function listUsersForDirectory(
  actor: AdminContext,
  rawQuery: unknown
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<UserDirectoryResult>> {
  const parsed = directoryQuerySchema.safeParse(rawQuery);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "معايير التصفية غير صالحة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const query = parsed.data;

  const effectiveSchoolId = isSchoolScopedAdmin(actor)
    ? actor.schoolId // forced — never from the client
    : query.schoolId;

  const where: Prisma.UserWhereInput = {
    ...(effectiveSchoolId ? { schoolId: effectiveSchoolId } : {}),
    ...(query.role ? { role: query.role } : {}),
    ...(query.status ? { isActive: query.status === "ACTIVE" } : {}),
    ...(query.branchId ? { branchId: query.branchId } : {}),
    ...(query.q
      ? {
          OR: [
            { name: { contains: query.q } },
            { email: { contains: query.q.toLowerCase() } },
          ],
        }
      : {}),
  };

  const [total, users] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.count({ where }),
    db.user.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
        branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      skip: (query.page - 1) * USERS_PAGE_SIZE,
      take: USERS_PAGE_SIZE,
    }),
  ]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / USERS_PAGE_SIZE));

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      rows: users.map((user) => ({
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        isActive: user.isActive,
        isVerified: user.emailVerifiedAt !== null,
        schoolName: user.school?.nameAr ?? null,
        branchName: user.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
        createdAtLabel: formatDateLabel(user.createdAt),
        lastLoginLabel: lastLoginLabel(user.lastLoginAt),
      })),
      total,
      page: Math.min(query.page, pageCount),
      pageCount,
      pageSize: USERS_PAGE_SIZE,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Full detail for the management view. School-scoped administrators may
 * only view users of their own school (SUPER_ADMIN rows are school-less
 * and are therefore structurally out of their reach).
 */
export async function getUserDetailForAdmin(
  actor: AdminContext,
  userId: string
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<UserDetailView>> {
  if (!userId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "معرّف المستخدم مفقود", code: "VALIDATION_ERROR" };
  }

  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    include: {
      school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      teacherSupervision: {
        include: { supervisor: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
      },
      supervisorAssignments: {
        include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true, stage: true } } },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
      deputyGrants: {
        include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!user) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (isSchoolScopedAdmin(actor) && user.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك عرض حسابات خارج مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      id: user.id,
      name: user.name,
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      isActive: user.isActive,
      isVerified: user.emailVerifiedAt !== null,
      school: user.school,
      branch: user.branch,
      createdAtLabel: formatDateLabel(user.createdAt),
      lastLoginLabel: lastLoginLabel(user.lastLoginAt),
      supervisor: user.teacherSupervision?.supervisor ?? null,
      supervisorBranches: user.supervisorAssignments.map((a) => a.branch),
      deputyGrants: user.deputyGrants.map((grant) => ({
        id: grant.id,
        branchId: grant.branchId,
        branchName: grant.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
      })),
    },
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Staff account creation (super admin / school admins)                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface StaffAccountOutcome {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  emailSent: boolean;
}

/**
 * Per-actor creation matrix (product rule, enforced HERE server-side):
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                -> SCHOOL_MANAGER, IT_COORDINATOR,
 *                                 DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER + staff
 *   SCHOOL_MANAGER             -> DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER only,
 *                                 for their OWN school
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER -> staff roles only, for their OWN school
 * A school can have at most ONE active SCHOOL_MANAGER (single signatory).
 * The canonical map lives in validation/users.ts (client-safe) so the
 * creation form and this service can never drift apart.
 */

/**
 * Create a school staff account. The role comes from the schema
 * whitelist that EXCLUDES SUPER_ADMIN, the per-actor matrix above is
 * enforced here, the school is forced from the actor's context
 * (school-scoped admins) or validated explicitly (super admin), and the
 * account is NEVER pre-verified: the existing email-verification flow
 * is reused (an invite email with a single-use expiring token). A
 * failed provider is reported honestly via emailSent: false — the
 * account is NOT marked verified.
 */
export async function createStaffAccount(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: AdminContext,
  deps: { appBaseUrl: string; mailer?: MailSender }
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<StaffAccountOutcome>> {
  const gate = adminActorError(actor);
  if (gate) return gate;

  const parsed = staffAccountSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  // Per-actor creation matrix — a stricter rule than the schema enum.
  const allowedRoles = CREATABLE_ROLES_BY_ACTOR[actor.role] ?? [];
  if (!allowedRoles.includes(input.role)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "دورك الحالي لا يسمح بإنشاء حسابات بهذا الدور",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  // Tenant resolution — school-scoped admins can NEVER create outside
  // their own school; the client-supplied schoolId is ignored for them.
  const schoolId = actor.role === "SUPER_ADMIN" ? input.schoolId : actor.schoolId;
  if (!schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المدرسة مطلوبة",
      fieldErrors: { schoolId: "اختر مدرسة" },
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const school = await db.school.findUnique({ where: { id: schoolId } });
  if (!school) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المدرسة غير موجودة",
      fieldErrors: { schoolId: "اختر مدرسة صحيحة" },
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  if (!school.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المدرسة غير مفعّلة — لا يمكن إضافة حسابات لها",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  // Single school manager rule: a school works with ONE active manager.
  if (input.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER") {
    const existingManager = await db.user.findFirst({
      where: { role: "SCHOOL_MANAGER", schoolId, isActive: true },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (existingManager) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "هذه المدرسة لديها مدير نشط بالفعل — كل مدرسة تعمل بمدير واحد",
        fieldErrors: { role: "المدرسة لديها مدير بالفعل" },
        code: "FORBIDDEN",
      };
    }
  }

  let branchId: string | null = null;
  if (input.branchId) {
    const branch = await db.branch.findUnique({ where: { id: input.branchId } });
    if (!branch || branch.schoolId !== schoolId || !branch.isActive) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "الفرع المختار غير تابع للمدرسة المستهدفة",
        fieldErrors: { branchId: "اختر فرعًا من فروع هذه المدرسة" },
        code: "RELATION_ERROR",
      };
    }
    branchId = branch.id;
  }

  try {
    const user = await db.user.create({
      data: {
        name: input.name,
        email: input.email, // normalized by the schema
        passwordHash: await hashPassword(input.password),
        role: input.role, // whitelist + matrix enforced — never SUPER_ADMIN
        schoolId,
        branchId,
        isActive: true,
        emailVerifiedAt: null, // never silently verified
      },
    });

    // Reuse the existing verification pipeline (single-use expiring
    // token; hash-at-rest; tokens never logged).
    const rawToken = await issueEmailVerificationToken(user.id);
    const mailer = deps.mailer ?? defaultMailSender;
    const sent = await mailer({
      to: user.email,
      ...buildVerificationEmail(
        user.name,
        `${deps.appBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(rawToken)}`
      ),
    });

    return {
      ok: true,
      data: {
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        emailSent: sent.ok,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      typeof error === "object" &&
      error !== null &&
      "code" in error &&
      (error as { code?: string }).code === "P2002"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم بالفعل لحساب آخر",
        fieldErrors: { email: "البريد مستخدم بالفعل" },
        code: "DUPLICATE_EMAIL",
      };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "حدث خطأ غير متوقع — حاول مرة أخرى" };
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Profile updates                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Administrative profile edit: display name + branch assignment ONLY.
 * The role, school and account state are NOT part of the schema — no
 * payload can escalate or move a user between schools. SUPER_ADMIN rows
 * are protected; school-scoped admins are confined to their own school.
 */
export async function updateUserProfileByAdmin(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: AdminContext
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ id: string; name: string }>> {
  const parsed = adminProfileUpdateSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const gate = adminActorError(actor);
  if (gate) return gate;

  const target = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.userId } });
  if (!target) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (target.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "حسابات مدير المنصة محمية — لا يمكن تعديلها من هنا",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }
  if (isSchoolScopedAdmin(actor) && target.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك تعديل حسابات خارج مدرستك",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  // Branch semantics: undefined => keep; "" => clear; id => assign
  // (validated against the user's own school).
  let branchUpdate: string | null | undefined;
  if (input.branchId === undefined) {
    branchUpdate = undefined; // keep current assignment
  } else if (input.branchId === "") {
    branchUpdate = null; // explicit clear
  } else {
    if (!target.schoolId) {
      return relationError("لا يمكن إسناد فرع لحساب لا يتبع أي مدرسة");
    }
    const branch = await db.branch.findUnique({ where: { id: input.branchId } });
    if (!branch || branch.schoolId !== target.schoolId) {
      return relationError("الفرع المختار غير تابع لمدرسة المستخدم", {
        branchId: "اختر فرعًا من فروع مدرسة المستخدم",
      });
    }
    branchUpdate = branch.id;
  }

  const updated = await db.user.update({
    where: { id: input.userId },
    data: {
      name: input.name,
      ...(branchUpdate !== undefined ? { branchId: branchUpdate } : {}),
    },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: updated.id, name: updated.name } };
}

/**
 * Self-service profile edit. Only the display name can change — the
 * schema contains no other field, so role, school, branch, supervisor
 * and account state are structurally impossible to alter from here.
 */
export async function updateOwnProfile(
  raw: unknown,
  userId: string
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ id: string; name: string }>> {
  const parsed = adminProfileUpdateSchema.pick({ name: true }).safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (!user.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "الحساب غير مفعّل — لا يمكن تعديل الملف الشخصي",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  const updated = await db.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: { name: parsed.data.name },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { id: updated.id, name: updated.name } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Supervisor scope & teacher assignments                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Replace a supervisor's branch scope (transactional whole-list
 * replace). Every branch must belong to the supervisor's own school —
 * cross-school branch assignments are rejected.
 */
export async function setSupervisorBranches(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: AdminContext
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ supervisorId: string }>> {
  const parsed = supervisorBranchesSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const gate = adminActorError(actor);
  if (gate) return gate;

  const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: input.supervisorId },
  });
  if (!supervisor) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.schoolId) {
    return relationError("الهدف يجب أن يكون مشرفًا تربويًا تابعًا لمدرسة");
  }
  // Captured after narrowing — usable inside the transaction callback.
  const supervisorSchoolId = supervisor.schoolId;
  if (isSchoolScopedAdmin(actor) && supervisor.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك إدارة مشرفين خارج مدرستك",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  // Deduplicate + validate every branch against the supervisor's school.
  const branchIds = [...new Set(input.branchIds)];
  if (branchIds.length > 0) {
    const branches = await db.branch.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: branchIds }, schoolId: supervisorSchoolId },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (branches.length !== branchIds.length) {
      return relationError("بعض الفروع غير تابعة لمدرسة المشرف — أعد الاختيار");
    }
  }

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.supervisorAssignment.deleteMany({ where: { supervisorId: supervisor.id } });
    for (const branchId of branchIds) {
      await tx.supervisorAssignment.create({
        data: { supervisorId: supervisor.id, schoolId: supervisorSchoolId, branchId },
      });
    }
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { supervisorId: supervisor.id } };
}

/**
 * Assign (or re-assign) a teacher's current supervisor. Both users must
 * belong to the SAME school; the teacher must be a TEACHER and the
 * target an EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR. The change runs in a transaction:
 * the previous row (unique per teacher) is replaced, so the former
 * supervisor loses explicit access immediately — unless another valid
 * grant (branch coverage) still applies.
 */
export async function assignTeacherSupervisor(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: AdminContext
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ teacherId: string; supervisorId: string }>> {
  const parsed = teacherSupervisorSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const gate = adminActorError(actor);
  if (gate) return gate;

  const [teacher, supervisor] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.teacherId } }),
    db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.supervisorId } }),
  ]);

  if (!teacher) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (!supervisor) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (teacher.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return relationError("الإسناد متاح لمعلمي المنصة فقط");
  }
  if (supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.schoolId) {
    return relationError("المُسند إليه يجب أن يكون مشرفًا تربويًا تابعًا لمدرسة");
  }
  if (!teacher.schoolId || teacher.schoolId !== supervisor.schoolId) {
    return relationError(
      "لا يمكن إسناد معلم ومشرف من مدرستين مختلفتين — العملية مرفوضة"
    );
  }
  if (isSchoolScopedAdmin(actor) && teacher.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك إسناد معلمين خارج مدرستك",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.teacherSupervisorAssignment.deleteMany({
      where: { teacherId: teacher.id },
    });
    await tx.teacherSupervisorAssignment.create({
      data: {
        teacherId: teacher.id,
        supervisorId: supervisor.id,
        schoolId: teacher.schoolId!,
      },
    });
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: { teacherId: teacher.id, supervisorId: supervisor.id },
  };
}

/** Remove a teacher's current supervisor (idempotent, scope-checked). */
export async function removeTeacherSupervisor(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: AdminContext
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ teacherId: string }>> {
  const parsed = removeTeacherSupervisorSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.teacherId },
  });
  if (!teacher) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }

  const gate = adminActorError(actor);
  if (gate) return gate;

  if (isSchoolScopedAdmin(actor) && teacher.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك إسناد معلمين خارج مدرستك",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.deleteMany({
    where: { teacherId: teacher.id },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { teacherId: teacher.id } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Deputy read scope                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Replace a deputy's read scope inside the deputy's OWN school:
 * either school-wide (branchId null) or an explicit branch list.
 * Cross-school grants are impossible — the school comes from the
 * deputy's account, never from the client.
 */
export async function setDeputyScope(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: AdminContext
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ deputyId: string }>> {
  const parsed = deputyScopeSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const gate = adminActorError(actor);
  if (gate) return gate;

  const deputy = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.deputyId } });
  if (!deputy) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (deputy.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY" || !deputy.schoolId) {
    return relationError("الهدف يجب أن يكون وكيلًا تعليميًا تابعًا لمدرسة");
  }
  if (isSchoolScopedAdmin(actor) && deputy.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك إدارة وكلاء خارج مدرستك",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  const branchIds = [...new Set(input.branchIds)];
  if (input.mode === "branches" && branchIds.length > 0) {
    const branches = await db.branch.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: branchIds }, schoolId: deputy.schoolId },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (branches.length !== branchIds.length) {
      return relationError("بعض الفروع غير تابعة لمدرسة الوكيل — أعد الاختيار");
    }
  }

  const rows =
    input.mode === "school"
      ? [{ userId: deputy.id, schoolId: deputy.schoolId, branchId: null as string | null }]
      : branchIds.map((branchId) => ({
          userId: deputy.id,
          schoolId: deputy.schoolId!,
          branchId: branchId as string | null,
        }));

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.deputyGrant.deleteMany({ where: { userId: deputy.id } });
    for (const row of rows) {
      await tx.deputyGrant.create({ data: row });
    }
  });

  return { ok: true, data: { deputyId: deputy.id } };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Role workspace readers                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Supervisor workspace: authorized branch scope + the teachers they may
 * see, each labelled with WHY (explicit assignment vs branch coverage).
 */
export async function getSupervisorWorkspace(
  supervisorId: string
): Promise<SupervisorWorkspace | null> {
  const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: supervisorId },
    include: {
      supervisorAssignments: {
        include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true, stage: true } } },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!supervisor || supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.schoolId) {
    return null;
  }

  const branchIds = supervisor.supervisorAssignments.map((a) => a.branchId);

  const branchDerived =
    branchIds.length > 0
      ? await db.user.findMany({
          where: {
            role: "TEACHER",
            isActive: true,
            schoolId: supervisor.schoolId,
            branchId: { in: branchIds },
          },
          include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } },
        })
      : [];

  const explicitRows = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId, schoolId: supervisor.schoolId },
    include: {
      teacher: { include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } } },
    },
  });

  type Row = SupervisorWorkspace["teachers"][number];
  const byId = new Map<string, Row>();
  for (const teacher of branchDerived) {
    byId.set(teacher.id, {
      id: teacher.id,
      name: teacher.name,
      email: teacher.email,
      branchName: teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
      source: "branch",
      isVerified: teacher.emailVerifiedAt !== null,
    });
  }
  for (const row of explicitRows) {
    if (row.teacher && row.teacher.isActive && row.teacher.schoolId === supervisor.schoolId) {
      byId.set(row.teacher.id, {
        id: row.teacher.id,
        name: row.teacher.name,
        email: row.teacher.email,
        branchName: row.teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
        source: "explicit",
        isVerified: row.teacher.emailVerifiedAt !== null,
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    branches: supervisor.supervisorAssignments.map((a) => a.branch),
    teachers: [...byId.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ar")),
  };
}

/**
 * Deputy overview (read-only): granted schools/branches with real
 * per-branch teacher counts. Only granted scope is ever read.
 */
export async function getDeputyOverview(
  deputyId: string
): Promise<DeputyOverview | null> {
  const deputy = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: deputyId },
    select: { id: true, role: true },
  });
  if (!deputy || deputy.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY") return null;

  const grants = await db.deputyGrant.findMany({
    where: { userId: deputyId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
  });

  const schoolIds = [...new Set(grants.map((g) => g.schoolId))];
  const schools: DeputyOverview["schools"] = [];

  for (const schoolId of schoolIds) {
    const grantedBranchIds = grants
      .filter((g) => g.schoolId === schoolId && g.branchId)
      .map((g) => g.branchId!);
    const wholeSchool = grants.some((g) => g.schoolId === schoolId && !g.branchId);

    const branches = await db.branch.findMany({
      where: {
        schoolId,
        ...(wholeSchool ? {} : { id: { in: grantedBranchIds } }),
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    });

    const branchesWithCounts = await Promise.all(
      branches.map(async (branch) => ({
        id: branch.id,
        nameAr: branch.nameAr,
        stage: branch.stage,
        isActive: branch.isActive,
        teachersCount: await db.user.count({
          where: { schoolId, branchId: branch.id, role: "TEACHER" },
        }),
      }))
    );

    const school = await db.school.findUnique({
      where: { id: schoolId },
      select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
    });
    if (school) {
      schools.push({ id: school.id, nameAr: school.nameAr, branches: branchesWithCounts });
    }
  }

  return {
    grants: grants.map((g) => ({ id: g.id, schoolId: g.schoolId, branchId: g.branchId })),
    schools,
  };
}

/** Own-profile projection for /my-profile and the teacher dashboard. */
export async function getOwnProfileView(
  userId: string
): Promise<OwnProfileView | null> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    include: {
      school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      teacherSupervision: {
        include: { supervisor: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!user) return null;

  return {
    name: user.name,
    email: user.email,
    role: user.role,
    isActive: user.isActive,
    isVerified: user.emailVerifiedAt !== null,
    school: user.school,
    branch: user.branch,
    supervisor: user.teacherSupervision?.supervisor ?? null,
    createdAtLabel: formatDateLabel(user.createdAt),
    lastLoginLabel: lastLoginLabel(user.lastLoginAt),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* IT coordinator workspace (the role's TWO permitted powers)           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Full IT workspace payload — real stats + supervisor/teacher rosters,
 * ALL confined to the IT coordinator's own school (re-read from the DB,
 * never trusted from the caller).
 */
export async function getItWorkspace(
  ctx: ItCoordinatorContext,
  query: {
    q?: string;
    status?: "ALL" | "ACTIVE" | "INACTIVE";
    assignment?: "ALL" | "ASSIGNED" | "UNASSIGNED";
  }
): Promise<ItWorkspaceData | null> {
  const it = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: ctx.id },
    select: { role: true, schoolId: true },
  });
  if (!it || it.role !== "IT_COORDINATOR" || !it.schoolId) return null;
  const schoolId = it.schoolId;

  const q = query.q?.trim() ?? "";
  const status = query.status ?? "ALL";
  const assignment = query.assignment ?? "ALL";

  const teachers = await db.user.findMany({
    where: {
      schoolId,
      role: "TEACHER",
      ...(status === "ACTIVE"
        ? { isActive: true }
        : status === "INACTIVE"
          ? { isActive: false }
          : {}),
      ...(q
        ? {
            OR: [
              { name: { contains: q } },
              { email: { contains: q.toLowerCase() } },
            ],
          }
        : {}),
    },
    include: {
      branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      teacherSupervision: {
        include: { supervisor: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
      },
    },
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
  });

  const filteredTeachers = teachers.filter((teacher) =>
    assignment === "ASSIGNED"
      ? teacher.teacherSupervision !== null
      : assignment === "UNASSIGNED"
        ? teacher.teacherSupervision === null
        : true
  );

  const supervisors = await db.user.findMany({
    where: { schoolId, role: "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR", isActive: true },
    select: { id: true, name: true },
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
  });

  const supervisorsWithCounts = await Promise.all(
    supervisors.map(async (supervisor) => ({
      ...supervisor,
      assignedCount: await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.count({
        where: { supervisorId: supervisor.id, schoolId },
      }),
    }))
  );

  const school = await db.school.findUnique({
    where: { id: schoolId },
    select: { id: true, nameAr: true },
  });
  if (!school) return null;

  const assignedTeachers = teachers.filter(
    (teacher) => teacher.teacherSupervision !== null
  ).length;

  return {
    school,
    stats: {
      teachersTotal: teachers.length,
      activeTeachers: teachers.filter((teacher) => teacher.isActive).length,
      supervisorsTotal: supervisors.length,
      assignedTeachers,
      unassignedTeachers: teachers.length - assignedTeachers,
    },
    supervisors: supervisorsWithCounts,
    teachers: filteredTeachers.map((teacher) => ({
      id: teacher.id,
      name: teacher.name,
      email: teacher.email,
      isActive: teacher.isActive,
      isVerified: teacher.emailVerifiedAt !== null,
      branchName: teacher.branch?.nameAr ?? null,
      supervisor: teacher.teacherSupervision?.supervisor ?? null,
    })),
  };
}

/**
 * IT power 1 — assign (or move) a teacher's supervisor. Same-school
 * guarantee on BOTH sides, transactional replace (the previous row is
 * deleted), and the IT coordinator can never touch another school.
 */
export async function assignTeacherSupervisorByIt(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: ItCoordinatorContext
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ teacherId: string; supervisorId: string }>> {
  const parsed = teacherSupervisorSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const [teacher, supervisor] = await Promise.all([
    db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.teacherId } }),
    db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.supervisorId } }),
  ]);

  if (!teacher || !supervisor) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (teacher.role !== "TEACHER") {
    return relationError("الإسناد متاح لمعلمي المنصة فقط");
  }
  if (supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" || !supervisor.schoolId) {
    return relationError("المُسند إليه يجب أن يكون مشرفًا تربويًا تابعًا لمدرسة");
  }
  if (
    !teacher.schoolId ||
    teacher.schoolId !== actor.schoolId ||
    supervisor.schoolId !== actor.schoolId
  ) {
    return relationError("لا يمكن إسناد معلمين أو مشرفين خارج مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة");
  }

  await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.teacherSupervisorAssignment.deleteMany({
      where: { teacherId: teacher.id },
    });
    await tx.teacherSupervisorAssignment.create({
      data: {
        teacherId: teacher.id,
        supervisorId: supervisor.id,
        schoolId: teacher.schoolId!,
      },
    });
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: { teacherId: teacher.id, supervisorId: supervisor.id },
  };
}

/** IT power 1 (b) — remove a teacher's supervisor (idempotent). */
export async function removeTeacherSupervisorByIt(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: ItCoordinatorContext
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<{ teacherId: string }>> {
  const parsed = removeTeacherSupervisorSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: parsed.data.teacherId },
  });
  if (!teacher) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (!teacher.schoolId || teacher.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return relationError("لا يمكن تعديل إسنادات معلمين خارج مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة");
  }

  await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.deleteMany({
    where: { teacherId: teacher.id },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: { teacherId: teacher.id } };
}

/**
 * IT power 2 — request a password-reset email for ONE teacher of their
 * own school. Reuses the EXISTING secure pipeline: single-use hashed
 * token, expiry, session revocation on use, and the configured mail
 * provider (never mailto links, never password disclosure). Rate
 * limited to 3 reset emails per teacher per hour (DB-based).
 */
export async function requestTeacherRecoveryByIt(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: ItCoordinatorContext,
  deps: { appBaseUrl: string; mailer?: MailSender }
): Promise<UsersServiceResult<TeacherRecoveryOutcome>> {
  const parsed = teacherRecoverySchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "أدخل بريدًا إلكترونيًا صحيحًا",
      fieldErrors: zodUsersFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const teacher = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: normalizeEmail(parsed.data.teacherEmail) },
  });
  if (!teacher || teacher.role !== "TEACHER" || teacher.schoolId !== actor.schoolId) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يوجد معلم بهذا البريد داخل مدرستك",
      code: "NOT_FOUND",
    };
  }
  if (!teacher.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "حساب المعلم موقوف — استعادة كلمة المرور متاحة للحسابات النشطة فقط",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  // Rate limit: at most 3 reset emails per teacher per hour.
  const oneHourAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const recentTokens = await db.passwordResetToken.count({
    where: { userId: teacher.id, createdAt: { gte: oneHourAgo } },
  });
  if (recentTokens >= 3) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تم إرسال عدد كبير من روابط الاستعادة لهذا الحساب خلال الساعة الأخيرة — حاول لاحقًا",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  const rawToken = await issuePasswordResetToken(teacher.id);
  const mailer = deps.mailer ?? defaultMailSender;
  const sent = await mailer({
    to: teacher.email,
    ...buildPasswordResetEmail(
      teacher.name,
      `${deps.appBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/reset-password?token=${encodeURIComponent(rawToken)}`
    ),
  });

  return {
    ok: true,
    data: {
      teacherName: teacher.name,
      teacherEmail: teacher.email,
      emailSent: sent.ok,
    },
  };
}

import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import type { AdminContext } from "@/lib/auth/dev-admin";
import {
  hashPassword,
  verifyDummyPassword,
  verifyPassword,
} from "@/lib/auth/password";
import {
  consumeEmailVerificationToken,
  consumePasswordResetToken,
  issueEmailVerificationToken,
  issuePasswordResetToken,
} from "@/lib/auth/one-time-tokens";
import {
  buildPasswordResetEmail,
  buildVerificationEmail,
  defaultMailSender,
  type MailSender,
} from "@/lib/mail/mailer";
import {
  createOfficeManagerSchema,
  normalizeEmail,
  passwordResetSchema,
  teacherRegistrationSchema,
  zodAuthFieldErrors,
  type AuthResult,
} from "@/lib/validation/auth";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* User & account service layer.                                        */
/*                                                                      */
/* Every rule the phase spec mandates lives HERE (server-side), not in  */
/* forms: school validation for self-registration, forced TEACHER role, */
/* duplicate-email suppression without existence disclosure, single-use */
/* tokens, inactive-account handling, and role-escalation guards.       */
/* Server actions are thin wrappers; UI never enforces security.        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type SafeAccount = Omit<
  Prisma.UserGetPayload<{ include: { school: { select: { id: true; nameAr: true } } } }>,
  "passwordHash"
>;

function toSafeUser(user: Prisma.UserGetPayload<{
  include: { school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } };
}>) {
  const { passwordHash: _passwordHash, ...safe } = user;
  return safe;
}

/** Build an absolute URL from a base that actions derive from headers. */
function verificationUrl(appBaseUrl: string, rawToken: string): string {
  return `${appBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/api/auth/verify-email?token=${encodeURIComponent(rawToken)}`;
}

function passwordResetUrl(appBaseUrl: string, rawToken: string): string {
  return `${appBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/reset-password?token=${encodeURIComponent(rawToken)}`;
}

export type RegisterTeacherResult =
  | {
      ok: true;
      /** "duplicate_suppressed" never reveals account existence. */
      status: "created" | "duplicate_suppressed";
      emailSent: boolean;
    }
  | { ok: false; message: string; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>; code?: string };

export interface RegisterTeacherDeps {
  /** Base URL (from request headers) used to build the emailed link. */
  appBaseUrl: string;
  /** Injectable sender for tests; production uses the SMTP mailer. */
  mailer?: MailSender;
}

/**
 * Self-registration for teachers via a school-specific link:
 * no roster matching, no approval gate, never pre-verified, and the
 * role is forced to TEACHER — the input cannot choose a role.
 */
export async function registerTeacher(
  raw: unknown,
  deps: RegisterTeacherDeps
): Promise<RegisterTeacherResult> {
  const parsed = teacherRegistrationSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodAuthFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  // Re-validate the registration context on the server — the slug from
  // the URL must resolve to an ACTIVE school; client hints are ignored.
  const school = await db.school.findUnique({ where: { slug: input.slug } });
  if (!school || !school.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "رابط التسجيل غير صالح أو أُغلق التسجيل لهذه المدرسة",
      code: "REGISTRATION_CLOSED",
    };
  }

  // Optional home branch must belong to this school and stay active.
  let branchId: string | null = null;
  if (input.branchId) {
    const branch = await db.branch.findUnique({
      where: { id: input.branchId },
    });
    if (!branch || branch.schoolId !== school.id || !branch.isActive) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "الفرع المحدد غير متاح للتسجيل في هذه المدرسة",
        fieldErrors: { branchId: "اختر فرعًا من قائمة الفروع المتاحة" },
        code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      };
    }
    branchId = branch.id;
  }

  // Duplicate prevention — normalized email + DB unique constraint.
  // The public response is IDENTICAL either way (no existence leak).
  const existing = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email: input.email } });
  if (existing) {
    return { ok: true, status: "duplicate_suppressed", emailSent: false };
  }

  const user = await db.user.create({
    data: {
      name: input.name,
      email: input.email, // already normalized by the schema
      passwordHash: await hashPassword(input.password),
      role: "TEACHER",
      schoolId: school.id,
      branchId,
      isActive: true,
      emailVerifiedAt: null,
    },
  });

  const rawToken = await issueEmailVerificationToken(user.id);
  const mailer = deps.mailer ?? defaultMailSender;
  const sent = await mailer({
    to: user.email,
    ...buildVerificationEmail(user.name, verificationUrl(deps.appBaseUrl, rawToken)),
  });

  return { ok: true, status: "created", emailSent: sent.ok };
}

export type VerifyEmailStatus = "ok" | "invalid" | "used" | "expired";

export async function verifyEmailToken(
  rawToken: string
): Promise<{ status: VerifyEmailStatus }> {
  if (!rawToken) return { status: "invalid" };
  const result = await consumeEmailVerificationToken(rawToken);
  return { status: result.status };
}

/**
 * Resend a verification email. The response is always generic — the
 * caller cannot learn whether the address belongs to an account.
 */
export async function resendVerificationEmail(
  email: string,
  appBaseUrl: string,
  deps?: { mailer?: MailSender }
): Promise<{ ok: true }> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: normalizeEmail(email) },
  });

  if (user && user.isActive && user.role === "TEACHER" && !user.emailVerifiedAt) {
    const rawToken = await issueEmailVerificationToken(user.id);
    const mailer = deps?.mailer ?? defaultMailSender;
    await mailer({
      to: user.email,
      ...buildVerificationEmail(user.name, verificationUrl(appBaseUrl, rawToken)),
    });
  }

  return { ok: true };
}

/* Credentials / login                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type AuthFailureCode =
  | "INVALID_CREDENTIALS"
  | "INACTIVE"
  | "EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED";

export type AuthenticateResult =
  | { ok: true; userId: string; tokenVersion: number }
  | { ok: false; code: AuthFailureCode; message: string };

export async function authenticateCredentials(
  email: string,
  password: string
): Promise<AuthenticateResult> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: normalizeEmail(email) },
  });

  if (!user) {
    // Timing-equalized rejection — same cost as a real hash check.
    await verifyDummyPassword(password);
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
      message: "بيانات الدخول غير صحيحة — تحقق من البريد وكلمة المرور",
    };
  }

  const passwordMatches = await verifyPassword(password, user.passwordHash);
  if (!passwordMatches) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
      message: "بيانات الدخول غير صحيحة — تحقق من البريد وكلمة المرور",
    };
  }

  if (!user.isActive) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "INACTIVE",
      message: "تم إيقاف هذا الحساب — تواصل مع إدارة المنصة أو إدارة مدرستك",
    };
  }

  // Email-verification enforcement applies to teachers (self-registered
  // accounts). Provisioned administrative accounts arrive pre-verified.
  if (user.role === "TEACHER" && !user.emailVerifiedAt) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED",
      message: "يجب تأكيد بريدك الإلكتروني قبل تسجيل الدخول — تحقق من صندوق الرسائل",
    };
  }

  // Persist the last sign-in time (Phase 4) — displayed in the user
  // directory/details; never treated as a security signal.
  await db.user.update({
    where: { id: user.id },
    data: { lastLoginAt: new Date() },
  });

  return { ok: true, userId: user.id, tokenVersion: user.tokenVersion };
}

/** Invalidate every existing session of a user (logout everywhere). */
export async function revokeAllSessions(userId: string): Promise<void> {
  await db.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: { tokenVersion: { increment: 1 } },
  });
}

/**
 * Request a reset email. The response NEVER reveals account existence;
 * the reset email is only sent for real, active accounts.
 */
export async function requestPasswordReset(
  email: string,
  appBaseUrl: string,
  deps?: { mailer?: MailSender }
): Promise<{ ok: true }> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: normalizeEmail(email) },
  });

  if (user && user.isActive) {
    const rawToken = await issuePasswordResetToken(user.id);
    const mailer = deps?.mailer ?? defaultMailSender;
    await mailer({
      to: user.email,
      ...buildPasswordResetEmail(user.name, passwordResetUrl(appBaseUrl, rawToken)),
    });
  }

  return { ok: true };
}

export type ResetPasswordResult = AuthResult<{ userId: string }>;

export async function resetPassword(raw: unknown): Promise<ResetPasswordResult> {
  const parsed = passwordResetSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodAuthFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  const passwordHash = await hashPassword(parsed.data.password);
  const result = await consumePasswordResetToken(parsed.data.token, passwordHash);

  switch (result.status) {
    case "ok":
      return { ok: true, data: { userId: result.userId! } };
    case "expired":
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "انتهت صلاحية رابط إعادة التعيين — اطلب رابطًا جديدًا",
        code: "TOKEN_EXPIRED",
      };
    case "used":
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "تم استخدام رابط إعادة التعيين مسبقًا — اطلب رابطًا جديدًا",
        code: "TOKEN_USED",
      };
    default:
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "رابط إعادة التعيين غير صالح",
        code: "TOKEN_INVALID",
      };
  }
}

export type CreateOfficeManagerResult = AuthResult<SafeAccount>;

/**
 * Create a DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER account. Hard guarantees:
 *   - actor must be SUPER_ADMIN (checked here, again, on the server);
 *   - the role is forced — no input can create a SUPER_ADMIN;
 *   - provisioned accounts are pre-verified (created by the platform).
 */
export async function createOfficeManager(
  raw: unknown,
  actor: AdminContext
): Promise<CreateOfficeManagerResult> {
  if (actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "إنشاء حسابات الإدارة متاح لمدير المنصة فقط",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  const parsed = createOfficeManagerSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
      fieldErrors: zodAuthFieldErrors(parsed.error),
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }
  const input = parsed.data;

  const school = await db.school.findUnique({ where: { id: input.schoolId } });
  if (!school) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "المدرسة المحددة غير موجودة",
      fieldErrors: { schoolId: "اختر مدرسة موجودة" },
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    };
  }

  try {
    const user = await db.user.create({
      data: {
        name: input.name,
        email: input.email,
        passwordHash: await hashPassword(input.password),
        role: "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER", // forced — never from input
        schoolId: school.id,
        isActive: true,
        emailVerifiedAt: new Date(),
      },
      include: { school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } },
    });
    return { ok: true, data: toSafeUser(user) };
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      typeof error === "object" &&
      error !== null &&
      "code" in error &&
      (error as { code?: string }).code === "P2002"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "البريد الإلكتروني مستخدم بالفعل لحساب آخر",
        fieldErrors: { email: "هذا البريد مسجل بالفعل" },
        code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      };
    }
    return { ok: false, message: "تعذر إنشاء الحساب — حدث خطأ غير متوقع" };
  }
}

export type SetAccountActiveResult = AuthResult<SafeAccount>;

/**
 * Activate/deactivate an account (Phase 4 scope: BOTH administrative
 * roles, each inside its own boundary):
 *   - SUPER_ADMIN: any account except SUPER_ADMIN rows and themselves;
 *   - DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: only accounts of their OWN school
 *     (schoolId comes from the DB session, never the client).
 * SUPER_ADMIN rows are protected for everyone. Deactivation revokes
 * live sessions immediately via tokenVersion.
 */
export async function setAccountActive(
  userId: string,
  isActive: boolean,
  actor: AdminContext
): Promise<SetAccountActiveResult> {
  // Defense in depth: only administrative roles may toggle accounts —
  // teachers/supervisors/deputies/IT are rejected here even if a future
  // caller forgets the action-level redirect.
  if (
    actor.role !== "SUPER_ADMIN" &&
    actor.role !== "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" &&
    actor.role !== "SCHOOL_MANAGER"
  ) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "غير مصرح لك بإدارة الحسابات — هذه العملية إدارية فقط",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }
  if (userId === actor.id) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك تغيير حالة حسابك الشخصي",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  const target = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!target) {
    return { ok: false, message: "المستخدم غير موجود", code: "NOT_FOUND" };
  }
  if (target.role === "SUPER_ADMIN") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكن إيقاف حساب مدير المنصة — هذه العملية محمية",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }
  if (
    (actor.role === "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER" ||
      actor.role === "SCHOOL_MANAGER") &&
    target.schoolId !== actor.schoolId
  ) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: "لا يمكنك إدارة حسابات خارج مدرستك — العملية مرفوضة",
      code: "FORBIDDEN",
    };
  }

  // Deactivation revokes live sessions immediately via tokenVersion.
  const updated = await db.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: {
      isActive,
      tokenVersion: isActive ? undefined : { increment: 1 },
    },
    include: { school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } },
  });
  return { ok: true, data: toSafeUser(updated) };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Role-scoped read helpers (supervisor / deputy boundaries)            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Teachers visible to a supervisor — the single source of the
 * supervisor boundary (Phase 4 semantics):
 *   1. EXPLICIT assignments (TeacherSupervisorAssignment), and
 *   2. branch-derived teachers of the branches assigned to them
 *      (the Phase 3 boundary, preserved),
 * both confined to the supervisor's OWN school and ACTIVE accounts
 * only. When a teacher's explicit assignment moves to another
 * supervisor, the former supervisor keeps visibility ONLY if another
 * valid grant (branch coverage) still applies.
 */
export async function listTeachersForSupervisor(supervisorId: string) {
  const supervisor = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: supervisorId },
    include: { supervisorAssignments: { select: { branchId: true } } },
  });
  if (
    !supervisor ||
    supervisor.role !== "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR" ||
    !supervisor.schoolId
  ) {
    return [];
  }

  const branchIds = supervisor.supervisorAssignments.map((a) => a.branchId);

  const branchDerived =
    branchIds.length > 0
      ? await db.user.findMany({
          where: {
            role: "TEACHER",
            isActive: true,
            schoolId: supervisor.schoolId, // never outside the supervisor's school
            branchId: { in: branchIds },
          },
          include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } },
        })
      : [];

  const explicitRows = await db.teacherSupervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId, schoolId: supervisor.schoolId },
    include: {
      teacher: {
        include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } } },
      },
    },
  });

  // Merge by id — explicit rows win; keep ACTIVE teachers only.
  const byId = new Map<string, (typeof branchDerived)[number]>();
  for (const teacher of branchDerived) byId.set(teacher.id, teacher);
  for (const row of explicitRows) {
    if (
      row.teacher &&
      row.teacher.isActive &&
      row.teacher.schoolId === supervisor.schoolId
    ) {
      byId.set(row.teacher.id, row.teacher);
    }
  }

  return [...byId.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ar"));
}

/** Branches a supervisor is assigned to (their own school only). */
export async function listSupervisorAssignments(supervisorId: string) {
  return db.supervisorAssignment.findMany({
    where: { supervisorId },
    include: { branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true, stage: true } } },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
  });
}

/** Explicit read-only grants for a deputy (school-wide or per branch). */
export async function listDeputyGrants(deputyId: string) {
  return db.deputyGrant.findMany({
    where: { userId: deputyId },
    include: {
      school: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
      branch: { select: { id: true, nameAr: true } },
    },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
  });
}

/** School identity for registration screens (public-safe fields). */
export async function getRegistrationSchool(slug: string) {
  return db.school.findUnique({
    where: { slug },
    select: {
      id: true,
      nameAr: true,
      nameEn: true,
      slug: true,
      logoUrl: true,
      brandColor: true,
      isActive: true,
      branches: {
        where: { isActive: true },
        select: { id: true, nameAr: true, stage: true },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });
}

import { z } from "zod";

import {
  ATTEMPT_LIMIT_MAX,
  ATTEMPT_LIMIT_MIN,
  ASSESSMENT_STATUSES,

  .max(4000, "تعليمات الاختبار طويلة جدًا (الحد الأقصى 4000 حرف)");

const instructionsEnField = z

const passingScoreField = z.preprocess(

    .int("درجة النجاح يجب أن تكون عددًا صحيحًا")
    .min(PASSING_SCORE_MIN, `أقل درجة نجاح مقبولة ${PASSING_SCORE_MIN}`)

    .optional()

/** Accepts Date instances (service/tests) or datetime-local strings (forms). */
function datetimeField(label: string) {
  return z.preprocess(
    (v) => {
      if (v === "" || v === null || v === undefined) return undefined;
      if (v instanceof Date) return v;
      const parsed = new Date(String(v));
      return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? v : parsed;
    },
    z
      .date({ message: `${label} غير صالحة` })
      .optional()
  );
}

  passingScore: passingScoreField,
  timeLimitMinutes: timeLimitField,
  attemptLimit: attemptLimitField,
  availableFrom: datetimeField("تاريخ بداية التوافر"),
  availableUntil: datetimeField("تاريخ نهاية التوافر"),
};

const availabilityWindowRefine = <T extends {
  availableFrom?: Date;
  availableUntil?: Date;
}>(data: T, ctx: z.RefinementCtx) => {
  if (data.availableFrom && data.availableUntil) {
    if (data.availableUntil.getTime() <= data.availableFrom.getTime()) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["availableUntil"],
        message: "نهاية التوافر يجب أن تكون بعد بدايته",
      });
    }
  }
};

export const createAssessmentSchema = z
  .object(assessmentBaseShape)
  .superRefine(availabilityWindowRefine);

});

export const questionOptionInputSchema = z.object({

export interface QuestionOptionInput {
  textAr: string;

const questionBaseShape = {
  type: z.enum(QUESTION_TYPES, { message: "نوع السؤال مطلوب" }),
  textAr: z
    .string({ message: "نص السؤال مطلوب" })
    .trim()
    .min(QUESTION_TEXT_MIN, `نص السؤال يجب ألا يقل عن ${QUESTION_TEXT_MIN} أحرف`)
    .max(QUESTION_TEXT_MAX, `نص السؤال طويل جدًا (الحد الأقصى ${QUESTION_TEXT_MAX} حرفًا)`),
  textEn: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(QUESTION_TEXT_MAX, "نص السؤال بالإنجليزية طويل جدًا")
    .optional()
    .transform((v) => (v && v.length > 0 ? v : undefined)),
  points: z.preprocess(
    (v) => (v === "" || v === null || v === undefined ? undefined : Number(v)),
    z
      .number({ message: "درجة السؤال يجب أن تكون رقمًا" })
      .int("درجة السؤال يجب أن تكون عددًا صحيحًا")
      .min(QUESTION_POINTS_MIN, `أقل درجة سؤال مقبولة ${QUESTION_POINTS_MIN}`)
      .max(QUESTION_POINTS_MAX, `درجة السؤال كبيرة جدًا (الحد الأقصى ${QUESTION_POINTS_MAX})`)
  ),
  isRequired: z.boolean().default(true),
  explanation: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(EXPLANATION_MAX, `التغذية الراجعة طويلة جدًا (الحد الأقصى ${EXPLANATION_MAX} حرفًا)`)
    .optional()
    .transform((v) => (v && v.length > 0 ? v : undefined)),
  /** Choice types only — texts; the server generates option ids. */
  options: z.array(questionOptionInputSchema).max(OPTIONS_MAX).default([]),
  /** Choice types only — indexes into the submitted options array. */
  correctOptionIndexes: z
    .array(z.number().int().min(0).max(OPTIONS_MAX - 1))
    .max(OPTIONS_MAX)
    .default([]),
  /** TRUE_FALSE only. */
  correctValue: z.boolean().optional(),
  /** SHORT_ANSWER only — grading reference for the human reviewer. */
  modelAnswer: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(SHORT_ANSWER_MAX, "الإجابة النموذجية طويلة جدًا")
    .optional()
    .transform((v) => (v && v.length > 0 ? v : undefined)),
};

/**
 * Type-conditional validation. Unsupported or mismatched configurations
 * are REJECTED explicitly — the meaning of a question is never silently
 * changed (e.g. missing correct answer, correct answer referencing a
 * nonexistent option, options on non-choice types).
 */
export const questionInputSchema = z
  .object(questionBaseShape)
  .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
    const isChoice = data.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || data.type === "MULTIPLE_CHOICE";

    if (isChoice) {
      if (data.options.length < 2) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["options"],
          message: "أسئلة الاختيار تحتاج إلى خيارين على الأقل",
        });
        return;
      }
      if (data.correctOptionIndexes.length === 0) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["correctOptionIndexes"],
          message: "حدّد الإجابة الصحيحة",
        });
        return;
      }
      for (const index of data.correctOptionIndexes) {
        if (index >= data.options.length) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            path: ["correctOptionIndexes"],
            message: "الإجابة الصحيحة تشير إلى خيار غير موجود",
          });
          return;
        }
      }
      const unique = new Set(data.correctOptionIndexes);
      if (unique.size !== data.correctOptionIndexes.length) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["correctOptionIndexes"],
          message: "لا يمكن تكرار الإجابة الصحيحة",
        });
        return;
      }
      if (data.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" && unique.size !== 1) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["correctOptionIndexes"],
          message: "سؤال الإجابة الواحدة يقبل إجابة صحيحة واحدة فقط",
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (data.type === "TRUE_FALSE") {
      if (typeof data.correctValue !== "boolean") {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["correctValue"],
          message: "حدّد الإجابة الصحيحة (صح أو خطأ)",
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (data.type === "SHORT_ANSWER") {
      // No auto grading — the model answer is an optional reviewer aid.
      return;
    }

    // Exhaustiveness guard: unknown types are rejected explicitly.
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: "custom",
      path: ["type"],
      message: "نوع السؤال غير مدعوم",
    });
  });

export const createQuestionSchema = questionInputSchema.and(z.object({
  assessmentId: idField("معرّف الاختبار"),
}));

export const updateQuestionSchema = createQuestionSchema.and(z.object({
  questionId: idField("معرّف السؤال"),
}));

  assessmentId: idField("معرّف الاختبار"),
  questionId: idField("معرّف السؤال"),
  direction: z.enum(["up", "down"], { message: "اتجاه الترتيب غير صالح" }),
});

export const deleteQuestionSchema = z.object({
  questionId: idField("معرّف السؤال"),
});

/**
 * Phase 7 — Zod validation for assignments, submissions and review.
 *
 * Every write path re-validates its raw input here (Arabic messages),
 * mirroring the Phase 6 validation layer. Client payloads are NEVER
 * trusted: ids, scores, statuses and dates are all re-checked.
 *
 * Version note: written against the zod v3/v4 COMMON API subset — no
 * `required_error` / `invalid_type_error` / `errorMap` params (removed
 * in v4) and no `z.undefined()` inside unions (v4 runtime rejects it).
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import {
  AUDIENCE_MODES,
  MAX_CRITERION_POINTS,
  MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH,
  MAX_FEEDBACK_LENGTH,
  MAX_RUBRIC_CRITERIA,
  MAX_SUBMISSION_TEXT,
  MAX_TARGET_IDS,
  MAX_TITLE_LENGTH,
} from "@/config/assignments";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Result contract (same shape as the assessment layer)                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type AssignmentErrorCode =
  | "VALIDATION_ERROR"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "RELATION_ERROR"
  | "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
  | "DEADLINE_PASSED"
  | "ALREADY_SUBMITTED"
  | "NOT_AVAILABLE"
  | "FILE_INVALID";

export type AssignmentResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      message: string;
      code: AssignmentErrorCode;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
    };

export function assignmentFail<T>(
  message: string,
  code: AssignmentErrorCode
): AssignmentResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

/** Flatten a ZodError into { "path.to.field": "رسالة" } — Arabic msgs live in the schemas. */
export function zodFieldErrors(error: z.ZodError): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const issue of error.issues) {
    const key = issue.path.join(".") || "form";
    if (!out[key]) out[key] = issue.message;
  }
  return out;
}

export function validationFail<T>(error: z.ZodError): AssignmentResult<T> {
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
    code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    fieldErrors: zodFieldErrors(error),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Primitive helpers                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const trimmedArabic = (max: number, label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    // Missing/non-string form fields degrade to "" so the Arabic
    // required-message below fires (works on zod v3 and v4 alike).
    (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(1, `${label} مطلوب`)
      .max(max, `${label} يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${max} حرفًا)`)
  );

const optionalTrimmed = (max: number, label: string) =>
  z
    .preprocess(
      // undefined/null/non-string degrade to "" (never z.undefined() inside
      // a union — v4 rejects that shape at runtime; this form is identical
      // on v3 and v4).
      (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
      z.string().trim().max(max, `${label} يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${max} حرفًا)`)
    )
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : null));

/** Form selects send "" for "none" — normalize to undefined before validation. */
const optionalId = (label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    (value) => (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() === "" ? undefined : value),
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .max(64, `${label} غير صالح`)
      .optional()
  );

const idList = (max: number) =>
  z
    .array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(64))
    .max(max, `القائمة تتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${max} عنصرًا)`)
    .default([]);

/** Accepts datetime-local strings ("2026-03-01T08:30") and ISO strings. */
const coerceDate = (label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    (value) => {
      if (value instanceof Date) return value;
      if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") return new Date(value);
      if (typeof value === "number") return new Date(value);
      return undefined;
    },
    z.date().refine((date) => !Number.isNaN(date.getTime()), `${label} غير صالح`)
  );

/** Checkbox payloads arrive as "on"/"true"/"1" — never trust coercion alone. */
const booleanish = z
  .preprocess(
    (value) => value === true || value === "true" || value === "on" || value === 1 || value === "1",
    z.boolean()
  )
  .default(false);

export function parseDate(value: unknown): Date | null {
  if (value instanceof Date) return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value;
  if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") {
    const date = new Date(value);
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
  }
  return null;
}

const rubricCriterionInput = z.object({
  titleAr: trimmedArabic(200, "عنصر التقييم"),
  maxPoints: z
    .number()
    .int("درجة عنصر التقييم يجب أن تكون عددًا صحيحًا")
    .min(1, "أقل درجة للعنصر هي 1")
    .max(MAX_CRITERION_POINTS, `أقصى درجة للعنصر هي ${MAX_CRITERION_POINTS}`),
});

const assignmentCoreFields = {
  titleAr: trimmedArabic(MAX_TITLE_LENGTH, "عنوان التكليف"),
  titleEn: optionalTrimmed(MAX_TITLE_LENGTH, "العنوان بالإنجليزية"),
  descriptionAr: trimmedArabic(MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, "وصف/تعليمات التكليف"),
  descriptionEn: optionalTrimmed(MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, "الوصف بالإنجليزية"),
  programId: optionalId("البرنامج التدريبي"),
  courseId: optionalId("الدورة التدريبية"),
  sectionId: optionalId("القسم"),
  lessonId: optionalId("الدرس"),
  audienceMode: z.enum(AUDIENCE_MODES),
  teacherIds: idList(MAX_TARGET_IDS),
  branchIds: idList(MAX_TARGET_IDS),
  dueAt: coerceDate("تاريخ الاستحقاق"),
  allowLate: booleanish,
  lateUntil: coerceDate("نهاية القبول المتأخر").optional(),
} as const;

/** Cross-field business rules shared by create + update. */
function assignmentFormRefinements<
  T extends {
    audienceMode: (typeof AUDIENCE_MODES)[number];
    teacherIds: string[];
    branchIds: string[];
    dueAt: Date;
    lateUntil?: Date | null;
  },
>(input: T, ctx: z.RefinementCtx): void {
  if (input.lateUntil && input.lateUntil.getTime() <= input.dueAt.getTime()) {
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
      message: "يجب أن تكون نهاية القبول المتأخر بعد تاريخ الاستحقاق",
      path: ["lateUntil"],
    });
  }
  if (input.audienceMode === "TEACHERS" && input.teacherIds.length === 0) {
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
      message: "حدد معلمًا واحدًا على الأقل لهذه الفئة",
      path: ["teacherIds"],
    });
  }
  if (input.audienceMode === "BRANCHES" && input.branchIds.length === 0) {
    ctx.addIssue({
      code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
      message: "حدد فرعًا واحدًا على الأقل لهذه الفئة",
      path: ["branchIds"],
    });
  }
}

export const createAssignmentSchema = z
  .object(assignmentCoreFields)
  .superRefine(assignmentFormRefinements);

export const updateAssignmentSchema = z
  .object({
    assignmentId: z.string().trim().min(1, "معرّف التكليف مطلوب"),
    ...assignmentCoreFields,
  })
  .superRefine(assignmentFormRefinements);

export const setAssignmentStatusSchema = z.object({
  assignmentId: z.string().trim().min(1, "معرّف التكليف مطلوب"),
  status: z.enum(["DRAFT", "PUBLISHED", "CLOSED", "ARCHIVED"]),
});

export const saveRubricSchema = z.object({
  assignmentId: z.string().trim().min(1, "معرّف التكليف مطلوب"),
  criteria: z
    .array(rubricCriterionInput)
    .max(MAX_RUBRIC_CRITERIA, `الحد الأقصى ${MAX_RUBRIC_CRITERIA} عناصر تقييم`),
});

const submissionText = z

/**
 * Phase 8 — Zod validation for certificates, revocation, verification
 * and growth params.
 *
 * Every write path re-validates its raw input here (Arabic messages),
 * mirroring the Phase 6/7 validation layer. Client payloads are NEVER
 * trusted: teacher ids, content ids, statuses and dates are all
 * re-checked against the database inside the service layer.
 *
 * Schema shapes are version-agnostic (zod v3 and v4): no
 * required_error/invalid_type_error params, no z.undefined() inside
 * unions — preprocess degrades missing fields instead.
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import {
  MAX_CERT_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH,
  MAX_CERT_TITLE_LENGTH,
  MAX_REVOCATION_REASON_LENGTH,
  MAX_VERIFICATION_QUERY_LENGTH,
} from "@/config/certificates";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Result contract (same shape as the assessment/assignment layers)     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type CertificateErrorCode =
  | "VALIDATION_ERROR"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "RELATION_ERROR"
  | "TEACHER_INVALID"
  | "CONTENT_INVALID"
  | "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
  | "ALREADY_ISSUED"
  | "ALREADY_REVOKED"
  | "RATE_LIMITED";

export type CertificateResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      message: string;
      code: CertificateErrorCode;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
    };

export function certificateFail<T>(
  message: string,
  code: CertificateErrorCode
): CertificateResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

/** Flatten a ZodError into { "path.to.field": "رسالة" } — Arabic msgs live in the schemas. */
export function zodFieldErrors(error: z.ZodError): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const issue of error.issues) {
    const key = issue.path.join(".") || "form";
    if (!out[key]) out[key] = issue.message;
  }
  return out;
}

export function validationFail<T>(error: z.ZodError): CertificateResult<T> {
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
    code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    fieldErrors: zodFieldErrors(error),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Primitive helpers                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const trimmedArabic = (max: number, label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    // Missing/non-string form fields degrade to "" so the Arabic
    // required-message below fires (works on zod v3 and v4 alike).
    (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(1, `${label} مطلوب`)
      .max(max, `${label} يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${max} حرفًا)`)
  );

const optionalTrimmed = (max: number, label: string) =>
  z
    .preprocess(
      (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
      z.string().trim().max(max, `${label} يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${max} حرفًا)`)
    )
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : null));

const requiredId = (label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(1, `${label} مطلوب`)
      .max(64, `${label} غير صالح`)
  );

/**
 * Accepts datetime-local strings and ISO strings; empty degrades to
 * undefined (optional field). Manual preprocess keeps v3/v4 parity.
 */
const optionalDate = (label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    (value) => {
      if (value instanceof Date) return value;
      if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") return new Date(value);
      return undefined;
    },
    z
      .date()
      .refine((date) => !Number.isNaN(date.getTime()), `${label} غير صالحة`)
      .optional()
  );

/** Verification query: free text (number or code) — normalized later in the service. */
const verificationQuery = z.preprocess(
  (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
  z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(4, "أدخل رقم الشهادة أو رمز التحقق")
    .max(MAX_VERIFICATION_QUERY_LENGTH, `الاستعلام يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${MAX_VERIFICATION_QUERY_LENGTH} حرفًا)`)
);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Schemas                                                              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const issueCertificateSchema = z.object({
  teacherId: requiredId("المعلم"),
  /** COURSE | PROGRAM — selects how contentId is interpreted. */
  contentType: z.enum(["COURSE", "PROGRAM"]),
  contentId: requiredId("المحتوى التدريبي"),
  /** Optional overrides — the server derives sensible defaults. */
  titleAr: optionalTrimmed(MAX_CERT_TITLE_LENGTH, "عنوان الشهادة"),
  titleEn: optionalTrimmed(MAX_CERT_TITLE_LENGTH, "العنوان الإنجليزي"),
  descriptionAr: optionalTrimmed(MAX_CERT_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, "وصف الشهادة"),
  descriptionEn: optionalTrimmed(MAX_CERT_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, "الوصف الإنجليزي"),
  /** Optional expiration (null = valid indefinitely). */
  expiresAt: optionalDate("تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية"),
});

export type IssueCertificateInput = z.infer<typeof issueCertificateSchema>;

export const revokeCertificateSchema = z.object({
  certificateId: requiredId("الشهادة"),
  reason: trimmedArabic(MAX_REVOCATION_REASON_LENGTH, "سبب الإلغاء"),
});

export type RevokeCertificateInput = z.infer<typeof revokeCertificateSchema>;

export const verifyCertificateSchema = z.object({
  query: verificationQuery,
});

export type VerifyCertificateInput = z.infer<typeof verifyCertificateSchema>;

/**
 * Normalizes a verification query for lookup: uppercase + strip every
 * non-alphanumeric char (spaces/dashes from grouped display codes).
 */
export function normalizeVerificationQuery(raw: string): string {
  return raw.toUpperCase().replace(/[^0-9A-Z]/g, "");
}
