import { z } from "zod";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Educational stages                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Canonical stage keys persisted in the database. */
export const BRANCH_STAGES = ["primary", "intermediate", "secondary"] as const;

export type BranchStage = (typeof BRANCH_STAGES)[number];

/** Arabic labels for the canonical stage keys (UI only — never stored). */
export const BRANCH_STAGE_LABELS: Record<BranchStage, string> = {
  primary: "المرحلة الابتدائية",
  intermediate: "المرحلة المتوسطة",
  secondary: "المرحلة الثانوية",
};

export function branchStageLabel(stage: string): string {
  return BRANCH_STAGE_LABELS[stage as BranchStage] ?? stage;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Normalization helpers                                               */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Normalize a free-text name: trim, collapse internal whitespace and
 * lowercase (no case for Arabic — affects Latin only). Used for the
 * in-school branch uniqueness strategy, both in application checks and
 * in the DB-level unique constraint on `Branch.nameNorm`.
 */
export function normalizeName(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Build a URL-friendly slug from an English name. Arabic names cannot
 * produce Latin slugs, so callers fall back to a generated suffix when
 * only an Arabic name is available.
 */
export function slugify(value: string): string {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
}

/** Random suffix fallback used when no English name exists to slugify. */
export function generateFallbackSlug(): string {
  const random = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  return `school-${random}`;
}

/** Resolve the final slug from optional user input + both names. */
export function resolveSlug(
  slugInput: string | undefined,
  nameEn: string | undefined
): string {
  const explicit = slugInput?.trim();
  if (explicit) return explicit;
  const fromEnglish = nameEn ? slugify(nameEn) : "";
  if (fromEnglish.length >= 2) return fromEnglish;
  return generateFallbackSlug();
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Shared field rules                                                  */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const SLUG_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;
const HEX_COLOR_PATTERN = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/;
const URL_PATTERN = /^https?:\/\/\S+$/i;

const nameArField = z
  .string({ message: "الاسم بالعربية مطلوب" })
  .trim()
  .min(2, "الاسم بالعربية يجب ألا يقل عن حرفين")
  .max(120, "الاسم بالعربية طويل جدًا (الحد الأقصى 120 حرفًا)");

const nameEnField = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .max(120, "الاسم بالإنجليزية طويل جدًا (الحد الأقصى 120 حرفًا)")
  .optional()
  .transform((v) => (v && v.length > 0 ? v : undefined));

const slugField = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .max(64, "الرابط المختصر طويل جدًا (الحد الأقصى 64 حرفًا)")
  .optional()
  .transform((v) => (v && v.length > 0 ? v : undefined))
  .refine((v) => v === undefined || SLUG_PATTERN.test(v), {
    message:
      "الرابط المختصر يجب أن يحتوي على حروف إنجليزية صغيرة وأرقام وشرطات فقط (مثال: qurtuba-school)",
  });

const logoUrlField = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .max(500, "رابط الشعار طويل جدًا")
  .optional()
  .transform((v) => (v && v.length > 0 ? v : undefined))
  .refine((v) => v === undefined || URL_PATTERN.test(v), {
    message: "رابط الشعار غير صالح — يجب أن يبدأ بـ http:// أو https://",
  });

const brandColorField = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .optional()
  .transform((v) => (v && v.length > 0 ? v : undefined))
  .refine((v) => v === undefined || HEX_COLOR_PATTERN.test(v), {
    message: "لون الهوية يجب أن يكون بصيغة #RRGGBB (مثال: #1D5BD6)",
  });

const isActiveField = z.boolean().default(true);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* School schemas                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const createSchoolSchema = z.object({
  nameAr: nameArField,
  nameEn: nameEnField,
  slug: slugField,
  logoUrl: logoUrlField,
  brandColor: brandColorField,
  isActive: isActiveField,
});

/**
 * Convert a ZodError into a flat field → Arabic message map using only
 * `error.issues` (stable across Zod major versions).
 */
export function zodFieldErrors(error: z.ZodError): Record<string, string> {
  const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const issue of error.issues) {
    const key = issue.path.length > 0 ? String(issue.path[0]) : "_form";
    if (!fieldErrors[key]) fieldErrors[key] = issue.message;
  }
  return fieldErrors;
}

/** Uniform service-layer result consumed by actions, UI and tests. */
export type ServiceResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      /** Arabic, user-facing error message. */
      message: string;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
      code?: "VALIDATION_ERROR" | "DUPLICATE_SLUG" | "DUPLICATE_BRANCH" | "NOT_FOUND" | "RELATION_ERROR" | "FORBIDDEN";
    };

/**
 * Phase 9 — Zod validation for surveys, questions, responses and
 * follow-up records.
 *
 * Every write path re-validates its raw input here (Arabic messages),
 * mirroring the Phase 6/7/8 validation layer. Client payloads are NEVER
 * trusted: audience ids, content links, statuses and dates are all
 * re-checked against the database inside the service layer.
 *
 * Schema shapes are version-agnostic (zod v3 and v4): no
 * required_error/invalid_type_error params, no z.undefined() inside
 * unions — preprocess degrades missing fields instead.
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import {
  LIKERT_POINTS,
  MAX_FOLLOW_UP_NOTE_LENGTH,
  MAX_FOLLOW_UP_TITLE_LENGTH,
  MAX_LINK_PAIR_CODE_LENGTH,
  MAX_OPTION_TEXT_LENGTH,
  MAX_QUESTION_HELP_LENGTH,
  MAX_QUESTION_OPTIONS,
  MAX_QUESTION_TEXT_LENGTH,
  MAX_SURVEY_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH,
  MAX_SURVEY_INSTRUCTIONS_LENGTH,
  MAX_SURVEY_QUESTIONS,
  MAX_SURVEY_PURPOSE_LENGTH,
  MAX_SURVEY_TITLE_LENGTH,
  MAX_TARGET_IDS,
  MAX_TEXT_ANSWER_LENGTH,
  MIN_QUESTION_OPTIONS,
  RATING_MAX,
  RATING_MIN,
  SURVEY_AUDIENCE_MODES,
  SURVEY_QUESTION_TYPES,
  SURVEY_STAGES,
} from "@/config/surveys";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Result contract (same shape as the assessment/assignment layers)     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type SurveyErrorCode =
  | "VALIDATION_ERROR"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "RELATION_ERROR"
  | "AUDIENCE_INVALID"
  | "NOT_PUBLISHED"
  | "NOT_OPEN"
  | "ALREADY_SUBMITTED"
  | "REQUIRED_MISSING"
  | "ANSWER_INVALID"
  | "CLOSED"
  | "ARCHIVED"
  | "RATE_LIMITED";

export type SurveyResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      message: string;
      code: SurveyErrorCode;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
    };

export function surveyFail<T>(
  message: string,
  code: SurveyErrorCode
): SurveyResult<T> {
  return { ok: false, message, code };
}

/** Flatten a ZodError into { "path.to.field": "رسالة" } — Arabic msgs live in the schemas. */
export function zodFieldErrors(error: z.ZodError): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const issue of error.issues) {
    const key = issue.path.join(".") || "form";
    if (!out[key]) out[key] = issue.message;
  }
  return out;
}

export function validationFail<T>(error: z.ZodError): SurveyResult<T> {
  return {
    ok: false,
    message: "تحقق من الحقول المدخلة ثم أعد المحاولة",
    code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    fieldErrors: zodFieldErrors(error),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Primitive helpers                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

const trimmedArabic = (max: number, label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    // Missing/non-string form fields degrade to "" so the Arabic
    // required-message below fires (works on zod v3 and v4 alike).
    (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
    z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .min(1, `${label} مطلوب`)
      .max(max, `${label} يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${max} حرفًا)`)
  );

const optionalTrimmed = (max: number, label: string) =>
  z
    .preprocess(
      (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
      z.string().trim().max(max, `${label} يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${max} حرفًا)`)
    )
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : null));

const optionalId = (max = 64) =>
  z
    .preprocess(
      (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
      z.string().trim().max(max, "معرّف غير صالح")
    )
    .transform((value) => (value.length > 0 ? value : null));

const optionalDate = (label: string) =>
  z.preprocess(
    (value) => {
      if (value instanceof Date) return value;
      if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") return new Date(value);
      return undefined;
    },
    z
      .date()
      .refine((date) => !Number.isNaN(date.getTime()), `${label} غير صالحة`)
      .optional()
  );

const optionalBoolean = z.preprocess((value) => {
  if (typeof value === "boolean") return value;
  if (typeof value === "string") return value === "true" || value === "on" || value === "1";
  return false;
}, z.boolean());

/** JSON id-array field (audience targets) — tolerant parse, capped length. */
const optionalIdList = z.preprocess((value) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.trim() === "") return [];
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string") : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}, z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(64)).max(MAX_TARGET_IDS, "قائمة الاستهداف تتجاوز الحد المسموح"));

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Question schema (shared by create/update via the questions array)    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const questionSchema = z.object({
  /** Client-generated stable key for the builder UI; re-keyed server-side. */
  clientId: optionalId(64),
  textAr: trimmedArabic(MAX_QUESTION_TEXT_LENGTH, "نص السؤال"),
  helpTextAr: optionalTrimmed(MAX_QUESTION_HELP_LENGTH, "سؤال مساعد"),
  type: z.enum(SURVEY_QUESTION_TYPES),
  required: optionalBoolean,
  /** Choice options (SINGLE_CHOICE / MULTI_CHOICE only). */
  options: z
    .array(
      z.preprocess(
        (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),
        z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .min(1, "نص الخيار مطلوب")
          .max(MAX_OPTION_TEXT_LENGTH, `نص الخيار يتجاوز الحد الأقصى (${MAX_OPTION_TEXT_LENGTH} حرفًا)`)
      )
    )
    .max(MAX_QUESTION_OPTIONS, `الحد الأقصى ${MAX_QUESTION_OPTIONS} خيارات`)
    .optional()
    .default([]),
  /** RATING scale bounds; null → service applies 1..5 defaults. */
  minScore: z
    .preprocess(
      (value) => {
        if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return undefined;
        const num = Number(value);
        return Number.isFinite(num) ? num : undefined;
      },
      z.number().int().min(RATING_MIN).max(RATING_MAX).optional()
    ),
  maxScore: z
    .preprocess(
      (value) => {
        if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return undefined;
        const num = Number(value);
        return Number.isFinite(num) ? num : undefined;
      },
      z.number().int().min(RATING_MIN).max(RATING_MAX).optional()
    ),
});

export type QuestionInput = z.infer<typeof questionSchema>;

export const surveyDefinitionSchema = z
  .object({
    titleAr: trimmedArabic(MAX_SURVEY_TITLE_LENGTH, "عنوان الاستبيان"),
    titleEn: optionalTrimmed(MAX_SURVEY_TITLE_LENGTH, "العنوان الإنجليزي"),
    descriptionAr: optionalTrimmed(MAX_SURVEY_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, "وصف الاستبيان"),
    descriptionEn: optionalTrimmed(MAX_SURVEY_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, "الوصف الإنجليزي"),
    purposeAr: optionalTrimmed(MAX_SURVEY_PURPOSE_LENGTH, "الغرض"),
    instructionsAr: optionalTrimmed(MAX_SURVEY_INSTRUCTIONS_LENGTH, "التعليمات"),
    /** Optional evaluation stage (null = general survey). */
    stage: z
      .enum(SURVEY_STAGES)
      .optional()
      .nullable()
      .transform((value) => (typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 ? value : null)),
    // Optional content links (validated against the DB in the service).
    programId: optionalId(),
    courseId: optionalId(),
    lessonId: optionalId(),
    assignmentId: optionalId(),
    certificateId: optionalId(),
    /** Pairing code joining pre/post surveys (required for comparisons). */
    linkPairCode: optionalTrimmed(MAX_LINK_PAIR_CODE_LENGTH, "رمز الربط"),
    // Audience.
    audienceMode: z.enum(SURVEY_AUDIENCE_MODES),
    targetBranchIds: optionalIdList,
    targetTeacherIds: optionalIdList,
    // Response policy.
    anonymous: optionalBoolean,
    allowMultipleResponses: optionalBoolean,
    linkResponsesEnabled: optionalBoolean,
    // Response window.
    opensAt: optionalDate("تاريخ الفتح"),
    closesAt: optionalDate("تاريخ الإغلاق"),
    questions: z
      .array(questionSchema)
      .min(1, "أضف سؤالًا واحدًا على الأقل")
      .max(MAX_SURVEY_QUESTIONS, `الحد الأقصى ${MAX_SURVEY_QUESTIONS} سؤالًا`),
  })
  .superRefine((value, ctx) => {
    // Choice questions need 2..N non-empty options (post-trim check).
    value.questions.forEach((question, index) => {
      if (question.type === "SINGLE_CHOICE" || question.type === "MULTI_CHOICE") {
        const options = question.options.filter((option) => option.length > 0);
        if (options.length < MIN_QUESTION_OPTIONS) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            path: ["questions", index, "options"],
            message: `أضف خيارين على الأقل لهذا السؤال`,
          });
        }
      }
      if (question.type === "RATING" && question.minScore !== undefined && question.maxScore !== undefined) {
        if (question.minScore >= question.maxScore) {
          ctx.addIssue({
            code: "custom",
            path: ["questions", index, "maxScore"],
            message: "أقصى درجة يجب أن تكون أكبر من أدنى درجة",
          });
        }
      }
    });

    // Response-window consistency.
    if (value.opensAt && value.closesAt && value.opensAt.getTime() >= value.closesAt.getTime()) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["closesAt"],
        message: "تاريخ الإغلاق يجب أن يكون بعد تاريخ الفتح",
      });
    }

    // Anonymous linking configuration consistency (explicit config only).
    if (value.linkResponsesEnabled && (!value.anonymous || !value.linkPairCode)) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["linkResponsesEnabled"],
        message: "ربط الردود يتطلب استبيانًا مجهول الهوية ورمز ربط محددًا",
      });
    }

    // Stage comparisons need a content anchor + pair code.
    if (value.stage && (value.stage === "PRE_TRAINING" || value.stage === "AFTER_TRAINING")) {
      if (!value.programId && !value.courseId) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["stage"],
          message: "استبيانات ما قبل/بعد التدريب يجب أن ترتبط ببرنامج أو دورة تدريبية",
        });
      }
      if (!value.linkPairCode) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          path: ["linkPairCode"],
          message: "حدد رمز الربط لمقارنة نتائج ما قبل التدريب وما بعده",
        });
      }
    }

    // Branch/teacher audiences require explicit targets.
    if (value.audienceMode === "BRANCHES" && value.targetBranchIds.length === 0) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["targetBranchIds"],
        message: "حدد فروعًا واحدة على الأقل",
      });
    }
    if (value.audienceMode === "TEACHERS" && value.targetTeacherIds.length === 0) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["targetTeacherIds"],
        message: "حدد معلمين واحدًا على الأقل",
      });
    }
  });

export type SurveyDefinitionInput = z.infer<typeof surveyDefinitionSchema>;

export const answerInputSchema = z.object({

    .preprocess(
      (value) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : ""),

/**
 * True when the URL is https AND its host is on the allow-list.
 * The server never fetches arbitrary external URLs — this gate keeps
 * embedded players to YouTube/Vimeo only.
 */
export function isAllowedExternalVideoUrl(raw: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(raw);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:") return false;
    return (EXTERNAL_VIDEO_HOSTS as readonly string[]).includes(
      url.hostname.toLowerCase()
    );
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

      ctx.addIssue({

        path: ["videoUrl"],
        message: "رابط الفيديو الخارجي مطلوب",
      });
    }
    if ((v.type === "VIDEO" || v.type === "RESOURCE") && !v.attachmentId) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["attachmentId"],
        message: "ارفع الملف أولًا ثم احفظ الدرس",
      });
    }
  });

/* Upload validation — server-side type & size enforcement              */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface UploadValidationInput {
  kind: (typeof ATTACHMENT_KINDS)[number] | "VIDEO";
  fileName: string;
  mimeType: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
}

export type UploadValidationResult =
  | { ok: true }
  | { ok: false; message: string };

function mb(bytes: number): string {
  return `${Math.round(bytes / (1024 * 1024))} ميغابايت`;
}

/**
 * Enforce allowed MIME types and size caps per upload kind. MIME is the
 * browser-declared content type; the file-serving route never executes
 * uploads (inline rendering with explicit content types only), so this
 * accept-list plus size caps is the server-side gate.
 */
export function validateUpload(
  input: UploadValidationInput
): UploadValidationResult {
  const mimeType = input.mimeType.toLowerCase();
  const sizeBytes = input.sizeBytes;

  if (kindIs(input.kind, "COVER")) {
    if (!(ALLOWED_IMAGE_MIME as readonly string[]).includes(mimeType)) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "صورة الغلاف يجب أن تكون بصيغة PNG أو JPG أو WebP",
      };
    }
    if (sizeBytes <= 0) return { ok: false, message: "الملف فارغ" };
    if (sizeBytes > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: `حجم صورة الغلاف يتجاوز الحد المسموح (${mb(MAX_IMAGE_BYTES)})`,
      };
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }

  if (kindIs(input.kind, "VIDEO")) {
    if (!(ALLOWED_VIDEO_MIME as readonly string[]).includes(mimeType)) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: "الفيديو المرفوع يجب أن يكون بصيغة MP4 أو WebM",
      };
    }
    if (sizeBytes <= 0) return { ok: false, message: "الملف فارغ" };
    if (sizeBytes > MAX_VIDEO_BYTES) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        message: `حجم الفيديو يتجاوز الحد المسموح (${mb(MAX_VIDEO_BYTES)})`,
      };
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // RESOURCE — documents and media allowed as downloadable resources.
  if (!(ALLOWED_DOCUMENT_MIME as readonly string[]).includes(mimeType)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message:
        "نوع الملف غير مسموح — المسموح: PDF، Word، Excel، PowerPoint، صور، نص، فيديو MP4/WebM",
    };
  }
  if (sizeBytes <= 0) return { ok: false, message: "الملف فارغ" };
  // Videos uploaded as lesson resources follow the video size cap.
  const cap = (ALLOWED_VIDEO_MIME as readonly string[]).includes(mimeType)
    ? MAX_VIDEO_BYTES
    : MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES;
  if (sizeBytes > cap) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      message: `حجم الملف يتجاوز الحد المسموح (${mb(cap)})`,
    };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

function kindIs(
  kind: UploadValidationInput["kind"],
  target: (typeof ATTACHMENT_KINDS)[number] | "VIDEO"
): boolean {
  return kind === target;
}

/* Result type                                                          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export type TrainingErrorCode =
  | "VALIDATION_ERROR"
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  | "FORBIDDEN"
  | "RELATION_ERROR"
  | "DUPLICATE"
  | "PUBLISH_BLOCKED"
  | "INVALID_FILE";

/** Uniform service-layer result consumed by actions, UI and tests. */
export type TrainingResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      /** Arabic, user-facing error message. */
      message: string;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
      code?: TrainingErrorCode;
    };

  return normalizeName(value);
}

import { z } from "zod";

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Shared field rules for user-related schemas.                        */
/* Kept identical to the rules in validation/auth.ts so behavior is    */
/* uniform across the authentication and user-management modules.      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Normalize an email address for storage and lookups. */
export function normalizeUserEmail(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().toLowerCase();
}

export function emailFieldRules() {
  return z
    .string({ message: "البريد الإلكتروني مطلوب" })
    .trim()
    .min(3, "البريد الإلكتروني مطلوب")
    .max(254, "البريد الإلكتروني طويل جدًا")
    .refine((v) => /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v), {
      message: "صيغة البريد الإلكتروني غير صحيحة",
    })
    .transform(normalizeUserEmail);
}

export function nameFieldRules() {
  return z
    .string({ message: "الاسم مطلوب" })
    .trim()
    .min(2, "الاسم يجب ألا يقل عن حرفين")
    .max(120, "الاسم طويل جدًا (الحد الأقصى 120 حرفًا)");
}

/** Shared password policy: 8+ chars, at least one letter and one digit. */
export function passwordFieldRules() {
  return z
    .string({ message: "كلمة المرور مطلوبة" })
    .min(8, "كلمة المرور يجب ألا تقل عن 8 أحرف")
    .max(128, "كلمة المرور طويلة جدًا (الحد الأقصى 128 حرفًا)")
    .refine((v) => /\p{L}/u.test(v) && /\d/.test(v), {
      message: "كلمة المرور يجب أن تحتوي على حرف واحد ورقم واحد على الأقل",
    });
}

import { z } from "zod";

  emailFieldRules,

  passwordFieldRules,

/** Rows per page for the user directory (server-enforced). */
export const USERS_PAGE_SIZE = 10;

/** Roles that can be filtered on in the directory (all seven). */
export const DIRECTORY_ROLE_FILTER = [
  "SUPER_ADMIN",
  "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER",
  "SCHOOL_MANAGER",
  "IT_COORDINATOR",
  "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY",
  "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
  "TEACHER",
] as const;

/**
 * Union of roles any administrative actor may create via the
 * staff-account flow. WHO may create WHAT is a stricter per-actor
 * matrix enforced inside the service layer:
 *   SUPER_ADMIN                -> SCHOOL_MANAGER, IT_COORDINATOR,
 *                                 DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER + staff
 *   SCHOOL_MANAGER             -> DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER (own school)
 *   DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER -> staff roles only (own school)
 * No path anywhere can create a SUPER_ADMIN.
 */
export const STAFF_CREATABLE_ROLES = [
  "SCHOOL_MANAGER",
  "IT_COORDINATOR",
  "DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER",
  "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
  "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY",
  "TEACHER",
] as const;

export type StaffCreatableRole = (typeof STAFF_CREATABLE_ROLES)[number];

/**
 * The per-actor creation matrix — THE single source of truth, shared by
 * the service layer (server enforcement) and the creation form (UI
 * options). Client-safe: this file imports only zod + field rules, so
 * client components can consume the map without pulling the DB layer.
 */
export const CREATABLE_ROLES_BY_ACTOR: Record<
  string,
  readonly StaffCreatableRole[]
> = {
  SUPER_ADMIN: [...STAFF_CREATABLE_ROLES],
  SCHOOL_MANAGER: ["DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER"],
  DEVELOPMENT_OFFICE_MANAGER: [
    "EDUCATIONAL_SUPERVISOR",
    "EDUCATIONAL_DEPUTY",
    "TEACHER",
  ],
};

  page: z.coerce

/** Same uniform shape as the schools module ServiceResult. */
export type UsersServiceResult<T> =
  | { ok: true; data: T }
  | {
      ok: false;
      /** Arabic, user-facing error message. */
      message: string;
      fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
      code?:
        | "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        | "FORBIDDEN"
        | "NOT_FOUND"
        | "RELATION_ERROR"
        | "DUPLICATE_EMAIL";
    };

export function zodUsersFieldErrors(error: z.ZodError): Record<string, string> {
  const fieldErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const issue of error.issues) {
    const key = issue.path.length > 0 ? String(issue.path[0]) : "_form";
    if (!fieldErrors[key]) fieldErrors[key] = issue.message;
  }
  return fieldErrors;
}

/**
 * Minimal ambient types for the `qrcode` package (the package itself
 * ships no TypeScript declarations). Only the APIs used by
 * src/lib/certificates/qr.ts are declared.
 */
declare module "qrcode" {
  export interface QRCodeToDataURLOptions {
    width?: number;
    margin?: number;
    scale?: number;
    errorCorrectionLevel?: "L" | "M" | "Q" | "H";
    color?: {
      dark?: string;
      light?: string;
    };
  }

  export function toDataURL(
    text: string,
    options?: QRCodeToDataURLOptions
  ): Promise<string>;

  const QRCode: {
    toDataURL: typeof toDataURL;
  };

  export default QRCode;
}
